review_content: The rooms in the Intercontinental Hotel are beautiful  Subdued colors  perfect for restful evening after sightseeing all day  The lobby bar and Victoria Bar were great for appetizers and drinks before we went to the Gardens By the Bay light show  and also for casual dining after running around the city and gardens all day

Really enjoyed every aspect of this hotel  The friendly staff and many nearby shopping food options made for an extremely convenient stay  The local MRT Bugis station made for extremely efficient travel options as well  Myself and my colleagues enjoyed our long stay in the area  Thank you to the local staff for the welcoming atmosphere

My husband and I love visiting the Intercon in Singapore  The lounge is excellent and the rooms are spacious and comfortable  Check in is a breeze and uncle Peter is always there to carry our bags and greet us with a smile

Great buffet breakfast  spacious room and beautiful layout  Service was good and location was perfect  only the swimming pool area was a little small  The room on the other hand was spacious  the bed was large and comfortable  Would come here again for stay cation definitely

This is my 3rd stay at the InterContinental and have been exceedingly happy Presentation is fabulous  Food is superb and location is second to none  This time my wife and 5 year old daughter stayed with me and they loved the pool facilities

Great staff   great time with good selection of food and winesLocated close to metro and in the bugis shopping centerWe had a suite and it was relly good for my family alsoDedicated lounge for family is ok so my young son had fine

The hotel has just completed an entire renovation and it looks bright  fresh and clean  The rooms are refurbished modern and the layout is very practical I liked the location   walking distance to great shopping centers  etc The InterContinental Club Lounge offers a good selection of breakfast  afternoon teas  drinks during Happy Hour and a wide range of snacks

Excellent hotel  large rooms  great service  awesome food  Right next to Bugis Market  in fact  a side door opens directly into Bugis Junction  Stayed here twice on family holidays and absolutely loved it  And the breakfast buffet was consistently excellent

Awesome hotel in a great location  close to bugis MRT station  Stayed in a newly reburbished room on a high floor  and wasn  39 t disappointed  Rooms are spacious  bright and very well finished  Huge tv with a wide choice of HD channels in various languages  Great breakfast spread and service  Overall a great stay

As good as you can expected  Not matching the Raffles but close  Good value for business stay  Convenient to access the Financial District with the new MRT line and with local shopping experience but not crowded at vicinity

Great location for shopping sightseeing and eating out  Great concierge  Very friendly helpful front desk  Spacious rooms with well appointed bathrooms   7th floor wasnice and quiet   Small pool but useful for late afternoon swim  Apart from a small problem with daily papers   everything else was very good  Bugis shopping mall three minutes walk

Delicious food in restaurant  friendly staff  and great accessibility from other places  If i have any chance to visit singapore again  i would stay in this hotel  I strongly recommand anyone visiting singapore stay in the intercontinental hotel

Located at the heart of Singapore  it was such a amzing place to be  The interior of the hotel was exquisite as well as comfortable and convenient  Not to mention the friendly staff who were very helpful  I would stay at this hotel at my next visit for sure

Great location  outstanding staff  In fact nothing wrong at all  It is an older hotel  so classic rather than contemporary  We had a holiday with our 3 kids for 1 week and could find nothing to complain about at all  We stayed 8th floor junior suite plus 1 room  Breakfasts worth having too

The hotel is located in the Bugis precinct and close to Orchard RoadThe personalised check in was very well done and it was such a relief to go straight to our room after a long flight from India and sleep until lunch timeThe Concierge are very knowledgeable  and have guided us to the right places Recommended

We had a great vacation in Singapore We stayed at the Intercontinental  where the service  the property and the staff were superlative  Great location and a brilliant hotel  Thoroughly recommend this property for anyone who wants to be a bit away from the usual Orchard Road area

Will stay at this hotel again  Everything I found with this hotel was fabulous  From the extra large bath towels to a stand alone shower  The swimming pool was good  Location is the best  Staff very attentive  The breakfast is the same wherever you stay in Asia it  39 s an international buffet  It was good

Great hotel  well located in Singapore  I was lucky enough to be upgraded to one of the suites  unfortunately I didn  39 t have time to make use of all the extra space but the gesture was much appreciated  Service was as always excellent

We spent one night at this hotel prior to leaving on a cruise  The room was very comfortable  The swimming pool on the roof was very nice  We were able to get Avery good rate via Hotwire  Service was excellent  Hotel is adjacent to affording very convenient access to restaurants and shops

clean hotel  friendly staff  Not much nearby for night ventures  but can take the bus or Subway to all attractions  Near Arab street if you are into ethnic experience Everything nearby closes at 10 pm so plan on going ot Singapore river for dinner if you arrive late

This is a great hotel in the center of Bugis Shopping Arcade  The location is one of the best reasons to stay at this hotel  As you step out of the hotel you are right in the middle and around the hotel are many markets  street stall and shops within walking distance
Good location   the room is very clean and Excellent Services  I will definitely stay at this hotel again during my next visit

Good staff  good breakfast  good service  great location If room was spacious  it was pretty old style decorated but okay Bugis is nice  close to Clarke Quay and Raffles Hotel by foot Will surely be back some day  I need to test swimming pool  amp  spa next time

Lovely mixture of old and new  Check in very welcoming and efficient  Similarly for check out  Comfortable room where everything works as they should  Somewhat dated and improvement to furnishing needed  Did not dine in as hotel located in an amazing area with huge variety of food outlets and shops  Would stay again

The local Peranakan architecture and interior decor is reflected in this hotel  Luxurious interiors with a lot of local interest at your doorstep  We were in a heritage room and it was lovely  The breakfasts in the Club were superb and we used the lounge to wind down after hot walks outside  Top notched hotel

Great staff willing to help the restaurant at breakfast was just amazing  the waiting staff were brilliant  The rooms were very clean and comfortable also the pool area spot on  It was next to the Bugis shopping mall and the subway was nearby  1st  class  i will definitely stay again thanks a lot

stayed there for 5 nights this October  and I can say the stay was enjoyable the hotel is located in a central spot    the breakfast is just amazing the room service is good  but the rooms are fancy and comfortable i will go back again to it if I am visiting Singapore thanks

In the best location  right near the Bugis markets  The staff were very lovely and the rooms were beautiful  they have a lot of character  English provincial fusion with Asian furniture  The pool is also lovely

The best hotel I have every stayed in Singapore  Great location and neighboring the Bugis Junction Shopping Mall  Wonderful staff   very helpful  Rooms are big and beautiful  Excellent breakfast spread with lots of options  Good dining experience too Truly recommended

I stayed here for 2 nights and was very impressed with how friendly  professional and helpful the staff were  My room was enormous  and very clean  I thought that breakfast in the Olive Tree was very good   plenty of choice  fresh food  lots of helpful staff

Stayed for 2 weeks  great service  Very clean rooms  Free internet  which is nice for this class of hotel The breakfast is one of the best I have ever had  Lots of choices  and excellent food  Good location in Singapore  Would definitely go back on my next trip

We stayed here on our first trip to Singapore  It was great  Rooms were clean  staff friendly and very accommodating  Great location  Brigid shopping mall next door and a short walk to Metro  amp  surrounding attractions  Buffett breakfast was amazing  Wide variety of food  We would highly recommend staying here

A short 2 night stay to celebrate a birthday  This hotel always presents to a very high standard  great location  Club floor great value  Staff welcoming and friendly  Beautiful colonial decor  Close to shopping precinct and food  Raffles city

We came from lengthy trip from Indonesia  The Intercontinental hotel was like an oasis for us  We got good night sleep  ate all the food we were missing for so long  my favorite beer in nice bar  pool for relaxation   Breakfast room was quite busy  but you the quality of the food were excellent

Have been staying there many times over the years  Excellent service  curtious staff super rooms and facilities good food and a nice place to watch soccer at Victoria Bar  Will definitely recommend for leisure or business  The MRT and cinema is just next to the hotel  Architecture Nyonya Peranakan Style    class

everything perfect  nice location  you can walk to bugis station metro easily from victoria street  not far  around bugis station have a lot of shopping malls  easy to connection to down town city center  also from victoria street  you can get bus to city easily  if you take bus from victoria street mostly bus going to city  nothing to worry

You can always expect Intercontinental Hotels to be clean  close to where you need to be with friendly staff in any city you go to  the Singapore was no different  There was nothing negative to say about it  nice hotel and very clean  Would stay there again

We stayed as a family in interconnecting rooms  For some reason the only rooms available had a handicapped bathroom with a sink that are to our thighs  The rooms are well appointed   the beds are super comfortable  Pool is nice although small  Recommended more as a business hotel rather than a family vacation  Buffet breakfast is great

Great Hotel  Great Service and Great Location  Next to Burgis MRT and adjoins to shopping mall  Pretty central location and walkable to most areas  Staff friendly and helpful  The buffet breakfast was wonderful  Try the teh tea for breakfast my favourite  Wifi could have been better for a business traveller  Overall will stay there again

Nice location as it is located very close to Bugis MRT Near Bugis Village so you can do some cheap shopping in the evening Many  quot street hawker quot  type of food across the hotel  Great for late dinner  or lunch evening snacks  Building is beautiful and seems to be a historic site Room is quite dated but is still nice

This is my favourite hotel in Sing  Great gym  open 24 hours   club bar is awesome  brilliant location  what  39 s not to like Typically very attentive service Big rooms  for Singapore  that are even bigger when you  39 re on the club floor

Very centralRooms were very spaciousFriendly staffBathroom were cleanBreakfast was goodBugis mall was attached to the hotelAnd metro was just below the hotelView from room was goodThe main central lounge area was beautiful the building is old charm and kept very wellThe bar is very good and trendy

Stayed for GP weekend as a family in the club rooms They worked hard to get us into a room early despite no early check in Club lounge services were outstanding  Couldn  39 t fault the service in any way

First time at this hotel and really enjoyed it Excellent location large rooms service very good Even a shopping center next door with a small market  Check in was easy   Bed very comfortable and nice amenities

My wife and I stayed here in early september  Our room was incredibly quiet and comfortable with a great bathroom  Good internet and fast  We used the gym which is well equipped and the pool only had the 2 of us in it on the afternoon we swam  Great location with easy walking to many of the local attractions

I am a frequent user of Intercontinental Hotels  This one is not so good  In fact the worst  Perhaps Asian standards are slipping  The rooms are old as well  Service in restaurant was OK The front desk is exceptionally rude and slow

Decent enough location  away from most of the hubbub   neatly stylish without going OTT on the decor  fairly priced  excellent facilities and service  All in all I would stay here again   certainly in preference to the entirely unsatisfactory rabble of other tarted up boarding houses such as the Amara  the Copthorne or the Innotel

5 star hotel with a bit of Character located in an excellent locationExcellentlocation   Bugis Junction   Shopping and restaurants nearbySize of bed rooms   35 sqm   pretty good for the value for moneySleep Qualtiy  ExcellentClub Lounge   Staff  selection of drinks  atmosphereGood Room Decor  Classical not for everybodyOutdoor Pool

Overall it was definitely a 5 star stay with all employees having a genuine hospitable approach Room was amazing  definitely worth upgrading The guys at the concierge were great too  with many remarks comments suggestions Wish we stayed here longer  23 27th December

From check in to check out our short stay in Singapore was perfect  Staff were excellent  refurbished room was perfect  great bathroom and comfortable bed  The ambiance of the hotel was perfect for our short stay and added to the whole Singapore experience  Would certainly stop here again if in town

This one is ideal to pamper yourself and get world class comfort at great price  Hotel is centrally located and has many shopping centres in close vicinity  It also has a tube station at 100 m distance  Hotel ambience and service is extraordinary and a must stay package destination

once step into the hotel  I am actually attracted by the lobby design  a bit old school kind but feel comfort  Room is clean and comfort  Location is great  near city and shopping mall just besides  Easy to get food  Bugis area just have too many choices of cuisines

We stayed at business room at Inter Con Singapore in June 13  this hotel is conveniently located very near the Bugis Junction MRT station Room is big  service is good  breakfast is excellent  but there are still some other disadvantages  beds are too soft and the soundproof was pretty bad  I could heard people in the next room?

A magnificent hotel  right close to many shopping malls  and a shirt walk from the interesting touristic sights  Excellent service  good personnel  clean  free Internet  I had a lovely stay and would suggest anyone to spend some time there

Great Hotel   close to attractions   taxis ready available  Excellent breakfast  Friendly and helpful staff  Very comfortable beds  Clean and spacious  We enjoyed the lounge where we could use the internet   morning tea and afternoon tea was also provided  Would choose this hotel again

This was the hotel we stayed at for the first stop on our honeymoon  Lovely welcome  Chocolates and stawberries with chocolate sauce in our room  Fabulous room with large bed  Hotel is right next to a shopping mall so you can enjoy the air con en route to the train station  Very quiet at night  Brilliant service by all the staff

We spent 5 nights in this warm and friendly Hotel in June  The staff are very professional  service orientated and extend the signature Singapore warmth of hospitality  The hotel is uniquely Singaporean and very well positioned  close to shopping and transport  We stayed  quot shop house quot  and thoroughly enjoyed it  We look forward to our return to our Singapore  quot home quot

Everything is perfect with this hotel  A comfortable and clean room  The staff were all really friendly and pleasant We enjoyed the daily breakfast  where a good fresh selection was available The area that the hotel is in is very convenient  The hotel is attached to a shopping centre and is located in a busy shopping area

after requested for a hard pillow during my last visit  this time i checked into a room with a hard pillow placed on the bed  without me requesting it   service at the club lounge was always excellent  InterContinental Singapore always strives to be the best  always

With a great pool  fitness centre and a huge laidback lounge area drink service  live piano  original artworks and impressive afternoon tea  or simply use the free wifi  I loved this centrally located quality hotel  Very helpful and professional staff and beautiful room  deep bath with crystals to relax in

We really enjoyed staying at this hotel and we were overwhelmed by the excellent service  Our club room was wealth worth the money as we enjoyed breakfast  high tea and cocktails in the club lounge  We will definitely return for a longer stay next time as it is one of the best hotels that we have stayed in

I have stayed here twice and both times found the experience excellent  Every staff member was helpful and happy  The rooms are great I was upgraded to a junior suite on one of the stays  these rooms are magnificent  The gym is basic but has everything you need  The pool and bars are worth a visit as well  Highly recommended

Nothing more to say than        MAGNIFICENT  I have lost count of the number of times we have stayed at this hotel but the service is consistently the best we have recieved on any of our travels anywhere in the world  Thank you to the staff and management for their constant   39 attention to detail  39

Had a great stay  enjoyed the club room  gym was excellent  close to transport and good food  staff excellent  Rooms good size and clean neat and tidy  This was our 4th stay at this hotel and will not be our last

This is an excellent hotel  The rooms are newly refurbished with a very nice size HDTV  Beds are comfortable  services are great  breakfast is good  club lounge is way above average  I  39 m glad we  39 ve chosen this hotel on our recent trip  I  39 d likely book this hotel again when returning to Singapore

Our trip starts from Batam May 25  2013  we are going for Birthday trip for my office mate  we gonna celebrate with our close friends  The receptionist was perfect and fast getting room  all the best for themmm    wanna visit again

Stayed there before my marathon run last year  The bed was the best that I have ever slept in  Location wise  its right smack in the middle of Bugis commercial area served by an MRT stationjust a couple of mins walk away  Will definitely return

i have stayed at this property multiple times and am very happy with the staff  lounge and overall quality of the hotel  The breakfast and drinks are a pricey  compared to the local shops  The cab lines can be long so be prepared  I absolutely will stay again

Good  Best location  walking distance from the Bugis train station  Be spoilt for choice with the many restaurants  Bugis Junction  Relax at night at the lobby lounge  where a Pianist serenades you with relaxing tunes  Room is spacious Bad

First class in every way  Staff so friendly  Basic rooms are wonderful  Executive club is second to none  a must upgrade  Brilliant breakfast  Lots to do nearby  I will only use this hotel in Singapore  Thank you very much intercontinental

Great rooms  clean  bright  and happy  I am an Ambassador and rank this IC higher than most big city IC  39 s for business or leasure stay  We were upgraded on checkin into a business room that i believe is no different than the deluxe room which is the base size  Big room and nice view

This is a top Hotel where everything is just perfect  The friendliness of the Staff is just great and deserves a special mentioning  The location next to the Library is just perfect to reach many things very easy  Certainly will be back

Great hotel  Well located and cordial staff  The Thai restaurant menu is great  They served from the restaurant menu in the room  Had sent the menu card  The room was spacious  The club lounge was excellent with lots of food and drinks on the house

the hotel is very good comfortables roomsgood size  the hotel location is great in a walk distance from many good placesI didn  39 t enjoyed the breakfast buffet very much good but not greatI had a little problem with the staff due to some problem regarding the corporate ratebut in overall was a good experiance

What I enjoyed about this hotel is the comfortable size of the room and a bed which provides a good nights rest  The location of the hotel is an added bonus with easy reach to food  drinks and shopping without leaving the comfort of air conditioning  a must in this tropic island nation

The hotel is located just beside a big shopping mall with many shops and food eateries  an ideal location for my family  The hotel provides good service and house keeping  Service was prompt and rooms are very clean  Location is perfect  near CBD area  MRT  underground from the mall
stayed at this hotel again last week the club team led by anna remains the benchmark for me Service and club lounge par excellence  Just renovated The beds must be the most comfortable in the world

We had a club room and it was large and comfortable  The only drawback was the long walk from reception  Food was good and the staff in the lounge were efficient  perhaps though a little stern and unfriendly  The location was pretty good  I would stay here again

We booked 3 nights in Club rooms  and were not disappointed  The Front desk was very helpful  the rooms were lovely  in the old residences  beautifully appointed  The Lounge provided excellent food especially breakfast  Mostly the staff were wonderful

hotel is excellent  well located  courteous and helpful staff  you really feel welcome here rooms are good  i highly recommend club lounge breakfast was good and it offers a lot of options rooms were good  housekeeping was efficient we loved the hotel and will gladly come backon the negative side  the wifi was painfully slow

nice Hotel to stay  in Heart of Singapore  lobby is awesome  a very good meeting place  Lobby gives feeling of a Fort area  all over decent property to stay  hotel is heavily booked always  pls book well in advance OR go for promotional prices by booking it at Singapore airport travel desk when you land

In the hustle of Middle Road  the Intercontinental is a haven Check in took a few minutes and the young lady actually walked me up to my room Large room   spacious and exceptionally clean The staff in the Lobby area were very attentive and polite

This is our favorite hotel in Singapore  This was our third visit in the last few years and the hotel is better than ever  We booked a club room for our two night stay  The room had all the amenities you could ask for  The Club Lounge was great for a complimentary breakfast

We had a wonderful time at the Inter Continental over Christmas  The hotel lobby and lounge areas are beautiful  The ambience is civilised and the service is exemplary  Breakfast is tasty and plentiful  Rooms are spacious and classically furnished  My only criticism is that the concierge desk could be a bit better informed  especially when it comes to restaurants

Stayed 2 nights  Comfortable beds  Great amenities  Close to Bugis Shops  Centrally located  Excellent service  Great views from our room  1404  Breakfast was great  Loved to have stayed a few extra days  Recommend hotel any one staying in Singapore

At half the price of Raffles  the Intercontinental is an excellent hotel  Service was impeccable  the room was spacious and comfortable  and the location was perfect for a quick visit to Singapore  We had a Club level room and the amenities were a good value

I stayed here twice during my previous two trips to Singapore  Though it is away from the bustle of the downtown business district  it is easily accesible and is very located within walking distance of several good restaurants and nightlife  The staff are very friendly and helpful too

The beds were so comfortable with pillow selection cards  The staff were friendly and helpful would return at any time  The breakfast was on until late and the guests at the hotel were lovely andrespectful  All facilities exceeded expectations as this hotel is in heart of the city and yet has a suburban tinge

Good facilities  very good service  nice location  Rooms were clean and spacious  Although it is located in a busy area  rooms were quite  Shopping mall downstairs is a good plus  Swimming pool is quite nice

What to say about this hotel      Classy is the only word that comes to my mind No need to mention the elegant and friendly service       so a place to stay if you happen to be in SingaporeAlways staying there when in town and will never change whatever other options exist

The location of the hotel was good  next to a shopping center and lots of stores and good restaurants nearby  The building itself was unique and the decor inside was elegant  The room was spacious and spotless  As usual  the hotel staff was rather professional like those of other Intercon hotels

This hotel is really great Location is perfect    Bugis MRT  metro  The restaurant  lobby etc are really nice The room have all what you need and the level of service is perfect A place to stay in Singapore

We enjoyed a two night stay in the Intercontinental before boarding our cruise ship  The hotel is older than many in Singapore  but immaculately maintained  preserving its  quot old world quot  elegance The staff is friendly and very helpful  The breakfast buffet was excellent  with a wide variety of offerings

The Hotel is very clean  nice  almost noble in its facilities  The room was big  I did not like at all the front desk service which was unpleasant and profit oriented  Tried to charge me three nights although I stayed only one and this for VIP member

Every time I travel to Sinagpore staying in the Intercontinental is a must  One of the best hotels in the world due to the beautiful rooms  furnishings  lobby  lounges  breakfast and certainly the staff members  Very reasonable price for the quality of service received  Can  39 t wait to be back

InterContinental is one of the best Hotel i stayed Good Location  Clean Hotel  Buffet Breakfast was awesome    Lot of varieties Well mannered staffs   Helped two time to unlock my locker as well room   Also Plenty of good shopping  amp  eateries are everywhere

Hotel is very quiet  Breakfast is satisfactory  bed is good  shower flow is low but hot  I found it more challenging to get a taxi in the morning compared to other hotels in the area  no problem unless you are in a rush Plenty of good eateries and shopping is everywhere

We enjoyed our stay in this hotel and in Singapore  Location is perfect  it  39 s in Bugis mall  and met is just right next to it  Upon check in we were greeted by friendly staff and also throughout our stay  Room is beautifully furnished  we were located at their shophouses unit  Love it  There are  Lot of restaurants nearby

We arrived after midnight and was greeted very warmly  Cab fare from airport was  23 Very nice room  Complimentary Wi Fi  Excellent breakfast  Attached to Bugis mall  Room was very comfortable  Stayed two nights before and one night after a cruise

We stayed at the hotel for 4 nights  It has a wonderful location  within walking distance to most attractions and restaurants  The service was very good  especially the service offered by the executive lounge   it made my   39 working holiday  39  a very pleasant one The hotel has a pleasant feeling to it and the afternoon teas are a special occasion

I had a most pleasant surprise and stay at the InterContinental hotel in Singapore recently The services accorded by the Executive Lounge is superb The host  Ms Anne is particular is a great asset to the hotel Thank you  amp  Thumbs Up to InterContinental Singapore Datin Irene Gan

Lovley hotel  we stayed on the executive floor which includes breakfast and canapes and drinks from 5 to 7 in the evenings  We did not eat in their restaurant so cannot comment on that  but did look lovley passing by it Centrally located

Great location helpful staff would definitely stay again  Wondeerful city to explore  ended a 6 week cruise with 3 days there  Funky Chinese restaurants and Indian fare  Good city to do serious shopping ie  Jewelry  watches etc

Nothing is ever a problem here  Upgraded to a Junior Suite  Booked a room with Club access  Perfect location for site seeing  Can take the train from the airport to Bugis Station a block from the hotel

Spent one night here on a short stay in Singapore and was really impressed with the spacious room  air con that worked  complimentary laundry and a drink as well as first class service  I couldn  39 t have asked for more

The staff was the most polite and helpful that we have seen  They seemed to anticipate our requests before we made them  Our room was immaculate and spacious and housekeeping appeared as soo as we left the room to straighten up

Lovely hotel  great room  very comfortable bed  very nice breakfast  The hotel is very light and well located  We also stayed at another well known five star hotel on Marina Bay and it was not nearly as nice as this hotel

Great location only walking distance from Clarke Quay  Beautiful hotel designed and decorated in a Paranakan style  Elegant and stylish  Food was good with an excellent lunch buffet  Highly recommended

Beautiful style and elegance   very smart  sophisticated and friendly staff  The room was so comfortable with every luxury you could think of  The food was lovely and the place is situated centrally   close to shops and restaurants  Honestly  there was not a single thing I would change  Definitely going there again

We were recently at the intercontinental hotel lobby lounge  There  39 s a live band there and they sounded fabulous  A must place to go for a drink  chit chat with friends unwind and listen to live music

Stayed at The Intercontinental hotel for one night   Nice gym   pool  Friendly staff  Amazing Victorian style in the rooms and the lobby  Big rooms  I got a suite upgrade with was pretty amazing  All was clean  Breakfast triple AAA  Nice juices and selection

Place to stay if you want luxury in a central location  Lovely hotel  the breakfasts are great with lots of choice  The bar is good and has a good selection  You can walk to raffles for a skin in 15 mins or the harbour for restaurants and bars in 15 mins as well  Great great location

Staff were very attentive and the club lounge was first class  The room was of a very high standard  I would have no hesitation in staying at this hotel again  My only complaint would be that prices in the lounge were excessive I felt

This hotel was wonderful  Upgraded room  helpful staff  secluded pool area  beautifully painted and decorated  luxurious bed with a pillow menu in case you didn  39 t like the already amazing pillows  large bathroom  conveniently located  safe area  I couldn  39 t say anything bad about this hotel  Worth every penny

Very comfy beds  Staff are nice  Not centrally located  Long walk from major tourist areas  Short taxi to marina or shopping area  Lobby is elegant  Will stay again  Tried local breakfast I think it was Malay

Loved every bit of my stay in this hotel from the lovely layout to the wonderfully warm staff who checked me in early much to my delight and surprise to the comfortable rooms that were a great welcome after a shut eye flight  I would go back to stay there any day

Awesome hotel rooms are huge n the staff very friendly  Better than marina sands as far as the total experience goes It is value for money and right in the city CenterThe rooms are very neat and the view is awesome as well

Elegant  but not unapproachable  Convenient to CBD  but reasonably out of the chaos Main restaurant is nothing special  Concierge staff is   39 ok  39   but failed to commit an opinion on anything Great club floor I  39 ll return again soon  for sure

Great location in Singapore  near shopping mall  restaurants  bars  But enjoyed the hotel Club lounge the most  with the excellent service from staff  and the variety of snacks and drinks  both in the afternoon and in the evening  Breakfast excellent in the lounge as well  Would go back anytime here  when visiting Singapore again

We had just traveled from a complete pit in Phuket  so it felt incredible checking into the Intercontinental  It by far had the best beds of all our hotels on our trip  even better than the Peninsula   If I  39 m back in Singapore  I  39 ll definitely be back at this hotel

Stayed in the hotel for two nights in January 2013  Most comfortable bed I have ever slept in  All members of staff extremely friendly and helpful  Only negative aspect of the hotel is that there is no free wifi in the rooms  Location is perfect

We thoroughly enjoyed our stay here  Booked into a Club Room and couldn  39 t have been happier with the accommodation and facilities  A minor glitch with the room safe was sorted in record time Staff were all extremely pleasant  professional and accommodating

Stayed for 4 nights 23 27 December  No complaints whatsoever  Located in a busy part of town but you wont notice the bustle from the sanctuary of your room  Breakfasts are good and staff are very attentive

We stayed over Xmas in a club room for 4 nights  The hotel is beautiful esp the lobby lounge and the club lounge  What sets it apart is the extremely helpful and friendly staff  The location is also great  connected to a mall and a great street market  Would definitely stay there again

Our favourite hotel  The staff are very attentive  thoughtful and polite  They couldn  39 t do enough to make us feel welcome  The beds are just wonderful for a good nights sleep  I would highly recommend this hotel for it  39 s central location  friendly staff great food and a great nights sleep

Stayed for a couple of nights in the Intercon  the staff  amp  service was excellent  great location and the room was really nice  The front desk staff was quick  amp  efficient  and the bed was super comfy  Bathroom was nice  amp  big  Overall a very satisfying  amp  comfortable stay at the Intercon  Would definitely return again

Spotlessly clean hotel  great location for business travel  Consistent performer for many years  Tastefully decorated shop house rooms  Standard rooms in hotel tower well maintained and comfortable  Suite rooms on top floor large though in need of return  Relaxing and well decorated main lounge

Perfect in every way  from the exceeding helpful friendly staff  fantastic facilities  great location and wide variety of dinning options  We thoroughly enjoyed our stay over the festive season and have already planned to return later in the new year

spacious room  walking distance to all the happenings in bugis area  close to almost any public facilities including transports  well  what more do you expect of a hotel  surely intercon lives up to its name

Great hotel  great location  great room  Nothing to fault in this lovely hotel  Delicious breakfast with great variety  Loved the fresh juice bar  All rooms very quiet and tastefully decorated  High speed wifi for free too

We stayed overnight on our way to Paris  Hotel staff were very attentive  rooms are large  bed is excellent  Pool area very nice  The breakfast is actually worth the price  which is very rare   the choice and quality of the food was top notch  Importantly for us  the broadband was very fast  even the free service

Can  39 t go wrong with the Intercon  Service was good  staff was attentive  and the rooms well furnished  They had a very nuce and warm Christmas ambience and atmosphere  Location is excellent as well for my casual shopping purposes  On the downside  having stayed here before  several years ago  the hotel is getting dated relative to the competition

Our room at the intercontinental was great  nice view  extra comfortable bed  great location to explore town  Service was excellent  and all staff were friendly  Breakfast was ok  simple  nothing special  Got a tourist train pass to explore town   10 well worth it

Friday evening  arrived at the airport and was whisked by the private limo  It was great as the weather is nice and the driver is friendly who greets us with generous smile  He mentioned the places of interests that close to our hotel  Upon reaching the hotel  we were again greeted by the Guest Service Exec and she showed us to the room which is located at the Club Floor I like the room the moment we entered  its spacious and the design of the furniture blends in well  We did our check in procedure in the room  Wow      We like this service  No hussle and waiting at the lobby     She explained what is included in the package and the location of the breakfast We went to have our breakfast   Olive Tree and surprise surprise  they have wide variety of asian breakfast  Nasi Lemak is to die for It is a MUST TRY   For dessert  they do serve peranakan kueh Next morning  we went to the club Lounge to have the breakfast but its a little dissapointment  The variety on the table is not as spread as Olive Tree  and  they have more porky meat served  We had to request for chicken sausage instead The chef is willing to cook something for us for next day but we are already leaving We went to have tea at the club lounge and selection of cookies pastries and nyonya kueh is excellent  I tried mostly and in the evening  again we went to have our cocktails and their Singapore Sling is well done  My man loves drinking it Upon our check out  it is swiftly done and the bell man assists us with our baggage and making sure its not wet as it was raining on that day Our stay is a pleasure one and for what we experience is Excellente  We love to come back again and get another great experience Room Tip  Raffles hotel is just a stone throw awaySee more room tips

I ve now stayed here several times over the last 2 years  I know not to go for the old style rooms  effectively in an annex overlooking the shopping area as the rooms can be cold and uncomfortableI stayed this time with wife  young infant and young child  We booked through Booking com and paid extra for Breakfast  Check in process is typically very friendly and efficient    service standards in Asia are so  so much better than in Europe and the USA  Anyway we were told that the booking didnt include breakfast   I thought I d take it up with Booking   as I ve never experienced this beforeOne of my main gripes is that this hotel seems to get more expensive as each month goes by   it seems to be twice the price it was 2 years ago  with me typically paying  350  400 Sing a night   2 years ago I was paying  200  250 Sing a nightI stay here because its a pleasant walk of 20 minutes to my officeYou dont get free internet   this is disgusting for a hotel this priceBreakfasts are expensive but they are greatThe hotel has an excellent location on Bugis Street so you can check out 100 s of cheap restuarants and go for one that doesnt put an automatic service charge on Rooms are a decent size  beds are very comfortableStaff  especially Robert is very good   he helps you get Taxi s   I simply cannot give this hotel more than 3 stars due to the pricing  breakfast issue with my booking and the fact it doesnt give free internet as standard  I will be looking at alternative hotel choices for my next visit

The hotel is part of a restored site  The site now consists of a large shopping mall perfect for youngsters  a lot of food outlets and most importantly  have direct access to MRT Bugis station  EW12   This is good as the sun in Singapore is burningly hot but heavy showers in the day are very common  The room we have is a shophouse room  The front desk staff told us it is a kind of signature rooms of the hotel which are restored from old shophouses  So we accepted the offer gladly  These rooms are only available on the second and third floor and some of them are far away from the lifts and may take some steps to reach  But we love it perfectly  We like the old wood floor  nice bed and large bathroom  Only one minor fault   minor stain in the bathtub Staff is very attentive  The front desk staff is friendly to offer us detailed description on the differences between a normal deluxe room and the shophouse room when we asked  He led us to our room himself after checkin  The concierge staff is nice and efficient when approached for advice  An old staff recommended us to a very good local restaurant  A young concierge staff is particularly good   he checked us to see if we could find our way to a rib soup restaurant when we met the other day  The house keeping staff is attentive   he she  who we have not met  noticed that we used more conditioner and left us with an extra bottle  in addition to the replacement one  The breakfast is good with variety of typical American breakfast items as well as local food  The lasi lemak and sambal were tasty  I especially enjoyed a breakfast room with natural sunlight The fitness center opens 24 hours a day  though a bit small  The swimming pool is OK  It may appear to be small but it is common in city hotels

Our taxi took us along the beautifully landscaped Airport Boulevard and into the city centre  with great views of downtown Singapore  the Esplanade area and the Singapore Flyer  akin to the London Eye   The InterContinental  IC  is situated on Middle Road  in a great location between the Colonial Core and Little India  ideal for exploring the whole of the island  I had a booked a Club Room for 6 nights  for the very reasonable price of a little over ? 850  Upon pulling up at the entrance  the taxi door was immediately opened for us  our bags taken  and a sincere welcome to the IC was given  We had arrived at around 10am  and despite the official check in time being 2pm  we were immediately escorted up to the Club Lounge  on the second floor  for our private check in  The lounge has recently been relocated from the 10th floor  where our room was  to the 2nd floor  and as such is a brand new interior with views on one side of the quaint shopping area and on the other of the splendid lobby lounge  both a floor below  Our check in was completed so smoothly and efficiently that we really didn t have to do anything but sign on the dotted line  and I was given a pashmina as the IC Ambassador present   IC Ambassador is a paid for membership scheme which gives various benefits at IC properties  including guaranteed complimentary room upgrades and complimentary Priority Club Gold membership   We were offered breakfast in the lounge  but declined and opted to be escorted straight up to our room as we were feeling a little worse for wear after the long flight from London  Our room was beautifully appointed with great views across the Colonial Core as far as the Esplanade area and down onto the hotel swimming pool below  The large bathroom  entrance hall and bedroom was immaculately clean and had every amenity you d want from a five star hotel  without going overboard  Because we required two beds and were already in the highest available category of room with two beds  the Ambassador room upgrade was not offered  but instead  upon enquiring  we did receive a sizeable discount on the final bill  The IC is an almost faultless hotel  From the delightfully courteous and professional staff  especially in the Club Lounge  to the beautiful interior design and ambiance  the IC is one of those hotels that makes you feel truly special  without being insincere  In room dining was of an excellent quality  and the amenities of the Club Lounge were superb  From breakfast  through afternoon tea to evening cocktails and hors d oeuvres  the standard never faltered  One minor criticism of the Club Lounge is that the internet on their PCs was painfully slow  although it may have been quicker when using the complimentary wifi service on one s own laptop  Our check out was extended to 7pm  another benefit of Ambassador status  After checking out in the lounge  we hopped into a taxi to take us on the short 15 minute journey back to Changi  leaving the truly remarkable InterContinental Singapore behind with heavy hearts Room Tip  Book in advance direct with IC See more room tips
