If you are looking to experience the peranakan  old shophouse kind of charm in S pore  this is the place to stay     very convenient location and good service  Particularly enjoyed the breakfast and the lounge     friendly and personable services     huge room   only drawback  no wireless Will consider returning for next visit     an excellent alternative to hotels on Orchard Rd

After departing the ship Arcadia we stayed in this oldish style but beautiful stylish hotel for three nights  At the time of choosing this hotel we mainly did so to use some accumulated points with Priority Club however I feel that those travelers wanting to stay in a hotel that is surrounded by some classy shopping as well as the cheap markets should be made aware of all the benefits this hotel offers   look no further if you enjoy comfort  quality and wonderful service We were allocated a corner room  the room was large great King size bed   very comfortable lounge type chairs and table  The bathroom was exquisite  very large by hotel standards that I have seen also provided a wonderful selection of bathroom products  plenty of large soft white towels  which seem to be replenished twice daily As we were staying on our points we decided to upgrade to a hotel CLUB room which provided access to the Hotel Club  This was well worth while  delightful breakfast  all day refreshments  afternoon tea and pre dinner drinks and eats  The pre dinner eats were almost enough for a meal especially if you had had a large lunch The service provided in this area by the staff was exceptional The restaurant had great food with excellent presentation The staff throughout the hotel would have been overall the best we have experienced in our world wide travels extending over 20 years  This will always now be our first hotel of choice when we visit Singapore

From the moment we arrived at the Intercontinental in Singapore  it was fantastic  I could not fault the service we received from front counter staff  to hospitality staff  to cleaners  Everyone was so pleasant  Being a Priority Club member we were upgraded to a Club Room with the benefits of the Club Lounge  I can only say that the presentation of the food served in the Club Lounge was to say the least  grand  Breakfast was great and having your own personal egg chef making whatever eggs you wanted was great The location at Bugis Junction also makes this one of the greats in Singapore  Shopping directly downstairs and with the MTR there as well within easy access to any other part of Singapore  This is definitely one of the hotels in Singapore to stay

We stayed here for a couple of days en route to Sydney  We booked a club room which is well worth the extra for the inclusive breakfast  snacks  evening drinks and comfort not to mention the use of the club lounge on the the last day until you have to leave  irrespective of your checkout time Everything was spotless  the room was supremely comfortable and as in most Asian establishments the people were polite and helpful  We ate in the Olive Tree restaurant which was great fun especially as were in there on Valentine s night with all the young Singaporean couples and were treated as  quot one of the family quot  as it were  The outdoor pool area was good for daytime relaxing alhough not especially private being overlooked and subject to some street noise it didn t spoil the experience All in all a very comfortbale break and a good stop off if you are there either for a holiday or on your way to from somewhere else and just want a stopover Room Tip  If you can   go for a Club Room deal See more room tips

This was my 4th stay  and it was the best  My previous 3 stays I was not totally happy with the room  low floors with no view  This time  I got a room on the 10th floor with a very nice view  When checking in  front desk welcomed me and acknowledged that I was a return guest  and walked me to the elevator  The room was wonderful  The bed was super comfy  I can finally say I had an excellent stay at the InterContinental

Stayed in the spacious King Club Premier Room with my children  we were provided two extra beds at no extra charge   Room is a bit dated with no wireless internet connection  which was very annoying  Check in Check out done was at club lounge  afternoon tea spread was unimpressive  Decided to have breakfast at the Olive Tree restaurant on the ground floor instead of the club lounge for better variety and space  The pool is also tiny and the spa pool was not functioning when we were there  It took housekeeping an entire day to press one shirt and I had to call up to request for it in the evening  Concierge was also unresponsive  took 2 calls and 15 20 minutes for them to send someone up to assist with the luggage during check out  10am  hardly a busy time  Positives would be the Bugis Junction shopping experience and the excellent Cantonese restaurant on the same level of the club lounge  Everything else was mediocre at best

I stayed here for a week whilst on business in Singapore The attitude of the staff at this hotel must be commended   excellent service is uniform throughout the hotel  Everyone I encountered was very friendly and nothing was too much of a problem   from arranging a taxi to providing directions The room itself was very spacious and was cleaned to a high standard on a daily basis  The bathroom had both a bath and a shower and built from marble throughout   very nice Location of this hotel is very good   close to Bugis MRT station and walkable to pretty much everywhere downtown Food is a strong point in this hotel   although one of the restaurants was closed for refurbishment during my stay  I had excellent breakfasts in the club lounge and good quality lunches in the downstairs restaurant that is open to the public Rooftop swimming pool is a nice touch   and great for cooling down in Singapore s high humidity Negatives Not many at all    The bar service at the pool could run for longer hours   it closes quite early in the evening if I remember correctly The gym is also in need of a little modernisation   a good selection of equipment  but very drab interior  Some air conditioning in the changing rooms would also not go amiss Overall   a really great hotel   and if you can afford it  a great place to stay if you are on vacation in Singapore too

This hotel is timeless in not only its architecture but its quality and service  After an unpleasant experience at the much vaunted Marina Bay our return stay at the intercontinental was excellent  The room was spacious  beautifully appointed and very comfortable ?  you gotta love a pillow menu  The service was excellent but as with all of these high end hotels the ground floor establishments were not cheap  We dined at the Japanese restaurant ?  lovely but was shut on the weekends   We had a couple of drinks in the main bar ?  nice but expensive  The concierge deserves a special mention ?  didn¡¯t seem to matter how obscure a request ?  they had an answer

For many years I have been travelling twice a year and as an A Club member always stay at Sofitel hotels in Club rooms  As there is no Sofitel in Singapore I tried the Interecontinental at Club level  The comparison is interesting particularly as my previous stay had been at the Metropole in Hanoi  Tthe Intercontinental rooms are big and have everything required to make the stay comfortable but the room somehow was a bit tired  The overall quality and finish of the Sofitel rooms is superior That aside I am of the opinion that the overall hotel experience at the Intercontinental was faultless  The bed was the most comfortable I have slept in The service was outstanding whether it was the front desk  the club  Olive Tree  bell boy  room service or room make up  Everyone was friendly and helpfuland very efficient  We arrived at 7am and were given a room ASAP  The next day we requested a room on a higher floor and this was provided without any fuss  The room service was the fastest I have ever experienced  It seemed I had no sooner put down the phone and my order arrived For thr extra cost the cub was outstanding  the food  drinks and service was great even though the club was at times quite crowded The one negative was the availablity of the computers in the Club room  As it was a short holiday I did not take my laptop and found that the club only had two computers available  What was annoying was that young children were constantly using them and it therefore was difficult to access the internet  This was the only disappointing aspect of the Club Lounge  Overall an excellent hotel experience in a very convenient location  If you can afford it try club  if not I believe you will still have a great stay

The Icon has consistently maintained the highest standards for the 4 star property that it is  The staff is also consistently excellent with special recognition to the check in person  Nadiah Hanipah  She was very pleasant and helpful  We would also like to recognize some of the employees of the Olive Tree Restaurant such as Selvanathan  Suann Chin and Wong T  H   chef  who worked the morning breakfast buffet  Although we only stayed at the Icon for 2 nights this time  on the second morning they recognized us by name and also confirmed our drink preference from the day before  1 coffee and 1 carrot juice  asking us if we wanted the same thing that second morning  It was nice to see T  H  Wong as he has been there for the last decade or so whereas virtually the entire staff has come and gone throughout the years  While the staff is excellent  we have noticed a slight errosion of quality and selection in the buffet choices from previous visits over the past decade The room is quite clean and comfortable and well appointed  There is a bed turndown every night with room slippers layed out alongside the bed  Toiletries and fresh towels will even be replenished at that time as well as during the normal morning cleaning

Stayed for four nights in an Intercontinental Club room  All staff at the hotel were friendly and welcoming  regardless of who you came into contact with  The hotel is well located adjoining the Bugis Junction mall  with the MRT in the basement of the mall offering easy transport options Stayed in a Club room decorated in the local Shophouse section of the hotel  The room was a reasonable size and well appointed with a very comfortable bed  The room was a little dark during the day time as some of the shutters on the window did not open  Otherwise comfortable and quiet Only had breakfast in the Olive Tree restaurant which offered a good range of options and attentive staff  Cannot comment on the other restaurants  The Club Lounge offers good value with breakfast  snacks during the day and evening drinks canapes The pool area is pleasant and well laid out  although it does not get sun in the morning Overall a great stay at this hotel with friendly staff and a good level of comfort Room Tip  Club rooms offer additional benefits and are worth the extraSee more room tips

I stayed at this property for business last year  I have stayed at numerous Intercontinental Properties in other countries and had expected same level of standards and service  but that was not the case The rooms were OK  not too lavishly decorated  the TV was not a flat screen  The lobby was very average  so was the lounge to have pre dinner drinks  I was not too happy with the pillows as they were too hard  and rang up to request something softer  They didn t have any soft pillows  The breakfast was also disappointing  with 2 star hotels in Thailand offering better value and much wider range Definitely giving this hotel a miss for next business trip to Singapore

travelling year round on business i get to stay in the some great hotels and this is one of them   however they are getting too aggressive with their pricing    Breakfast  44 SGD per person 24 Hr Internet  29 SGD per 24hours 1 water and 1 coffee during a meeting in Lobby  26 SGD6pm checkout 50     260 SGD half day rate      Tea and Coffee Making facilities very basic   3star standard     Bathroom amenities   Elemis   great quality      Beds great   but rooms very tired and quiet dated     Check around in Singapore   there is better

Stayed for a week on business  The hotel is conveniently located    i e   walking distance to offices  you walk out the back door to a shopping complex and a basement of restaurants  Walk a few blocks to the exotic alleys of restaurants serving more diverse cuisine  Subway is also in the same shopping complex  Very convenient The room was clean spacious  including the bathroom  No complaints  I had a great stay  I would recommend to both business  amp  leisure travelers

Every time I come to Singapore I stay here  the rooms are comfortable and equip  the bathrooms have everything you need  the staff cannot do enough for you  Wireless Internet in the rooms is only above floor 14 but you can pick it up just about one below  Lots to do and see near by  but as ever in Singapore nothings more than a short cheap taxi ride away if you don t fancy a walk in the heat

We have stayed in some good and not so good hotels in Europe and Asia  The InterContinental must rate as the very best  We booked the Club Floor and arrived at the hotel at around 8 00 am  after a flight from Paris  We were welcomed by name at the reception desk and taken immediately to the Club Floor and served breakfast  We thought that we would have to wait until 2 00 pm for a room but  no  our room was available  The service was seamless  professional and friendly  The snacks and drinks on the Club Floor were excellent and it kept coming  Our room was extremely comfortable  Concierge service was knowledgeable and friendly  Nothing was too much trouble for any of the staff and we were always greeted by name and with a friendly smile  The InterContinental is well located  This is an exceptioanl hotel Phil  amp  Marilyn Brisbane

We have stayed at a number of Intercontinental Hotels in Australia and Asia  but this was easily the most impressive  The service was attentive and professional throughout the hotel  lt was unusually consistent in this respect  It was not a case of a couple of especially good staff  everyone we came in contact with gave excellent customer service Also worthy of mention was The Club Lounge  which offered an especially good range of food and an even better  evening cocktails  selection  Unlike the usual suspects  wine  beer and spirits  the lounge had a cocktail menu  with a variety of unusual selections  Having said that  we had the breakfast in the main restaurant and it was also outstanding  The whole hotel is highly recommended

Hi got this hotel on a blind bidding website and paid a reasonable price for it  Despite having lived in SIngapore I had never had much to do with this hotel  for some reason Bugis was never a place I went to much  I was pleasantly surprised and would happily stay there again Pros Exceptionally comfortable bedElemis bath productsPool  although small  had nice big loungers and got plenty of sunlight which many Singaporean hotels do not due to shadows from high riseRight on top of shopping centre with exceptional food hall and lots of choices  God knows why anyone would pay for breakfast at hotel rates when you can get something delicious in the shopping centre for next to nothing  apart from opening time I guess   shops don t open until 10 00 am  Full double sized twin beds Cons  can t think of any really  would certainly stay again

If a little pricey at times  this hotel has it all  wonderfully comfortable and functional rooms  the best breakfast buffet we had ever seen  offering both western and oriental food  caring and friendly staff  and a location that allows for walking in the city  or diving into the subway system next door to go further afield  We will most definitely go back

This is a flagship hotel for the chain and it shows  I stayed for only two nights but both were excellent in every respect in terms of the time spent in hotel and room  The restaurants are extraordinary  The location is literally right in the middle of the best shopping district and seconds from business and entertainment mecca  The rooms are literally worth twice what they charge  At the higher level  the concierge service is incredible  including a lounge that makes the finest first class international airline lounges look bad  All the glamour and quality of Raffles  Singapore s best known  and close  hotel  but  100 a night less expensive    for a vastly higher level room

Ever wondered where the heck those places are that just seem to be in the middle of everything   Well the Intercontinental is one of those places  right in the middle of Singapore yet calm  quiet and decidely spacious Stayed here early August 2011 and found it to be great  admittedly it was in a Executive or Club room  shophouse King room  but it was great  Right next door to Bugis Shopping Centre   amp  train station   as well as being 10 minutes walk from the Town Hall station where you can purchase the transport Tourist Pass  Pool area at the back nicely tucked away  if your looking for a 5   place to stay which wont break the bank and has quiet  comfortable and central location then I highly reccomendthe Intercontinental  It really feels like an  old fashioned  hotel with great modern day equipment and levels of service Room Tip  Club level worth the extra  See more room tips

Stayed a week for business meetings at the hotel  They had the best all around price for the meeting room and hotel rooms combined  The Hotel is a bit dated but the room was nice enough  No wireless so you had to be hard wired in which was a hassle  The bathroom had both a soaking tub and a separate shower with a great wide shower head  The breakfast buffet and lunch buffet were nice although it was included so I didn t see what the  quot nice quot  cost

From the moment we checked in until the moment we left all our needs were taken care of with the minimum of fuss  We stayed in an Executive room which gave us access to the Club Room  This is the best Club Room we have accessed  great wines  great cocktails and canapes  Breakfast had good choices and afternoon tea was also offered but we didn t get to this  although I m sure it would have been excellent based on the other services  The staff were all very attentive without being over crowding  this was reflective in the whole hotel not just the Executive area  I would recommend this hotel to anyone wanting a break in Singapore

We stayed here on a recommendation from the travel agent  an excellent and enjoyable stay Location is excellent with all main sights within walking distance  Well appointed with comfortable rooms had everything I needed and expected from a business class hotel  Great breakfast choices  The staff were very polite and helpful   cheerful and taking personal interest in showing us how to enjoy local place  I warmly recommend it

Stayed for 3 nights and loved it  Rooms are a bit dated but well maintained  spacious and clean  Staff friendly and went out of their way to help  Breakfast was good  and the beds were plush and provided a great nights sleep  Location is good with plenty of shopping nearby  and the rest of the city is easily reached with a taxi  This hotel will be my  1 choice the next time I go back to Singapore

Summary InterContinental Singapore is a top quality hotel in a good area  Bugis  in Singapore Arriving at InterContinental Singapore InterContinental Singapore is  usually  a quick taxi ride from Singapore Airport  I arrived this time at around 11pm  Check in was quick and my Ambassador status was recognised with an upgrade to a larger premium room that included a sofa and a small dining table  I was also given a welcome gift  a shawl   Some water  fruit and chocolates were waiting in the room InterContinental Singapore itself I ve stayed many times at this hotel  It is stylish and comfortable with good attention to detail  Being directly connected to the Bugis shopping centre is very handy  Staff are usually very friendly and helpful Rooms The rooms are comfortable  modern  quiet  just a few elevator noises in the premium rooms  and very well equipped  A newspaper is delivered each morning  My L shaped room had a good sized living area Meals I m not a great fan of buffet restaurants but the Intercontinental Singapore s is one of the best I ve tried  Dinner is a little more relaxed while breakfast can get crowded Leaving InterContinental Singapore Check out was quick and simple  Within minutes I was in a taxi on my way to the airport

I stayed 2 nights for business and it was a good stay but nothing too special  The staff were all very friendly and helpful  but the hardware  i e  the room conditions and style  is a bit dated and could use a refresh  The public areas are very nice and the breakfast in the morning is excellent One area for improvement would be offer free internet  expensive at Sin 30

I have stayed at this hotel several times  I was upgraded to a Chop House room a while back and regret taking the upgrade  The Chop House side is a great room and I love the feel of the history but the location is not very good in relation to Burgis Street  The street kept me awake later than I wanted to be and the trash pickup woke me very early  I have since stayed and declined the Chop House upgrade and have been very happy staying here at least four times in the last year or so  Stick to the main house and you will not be disappointed with your stay

The Intercontinental provided professional service and gave me the privacy I needed in the middle of the Bugis bustle The room itself is a joy  I fell asleep in seconds in the bath  My iPod plugged on the dock provided went right into the speakers in the bathroom so I really did get a lullaby Breakfast is in a sunny enclave with a nice healthy spread of muesli and omelette with the usual asian and western offerings  I just like the simplicity of it all At SGD250 for a 2day 1night weekend stay  you get the understated luxury without going bust

I have stayed at this hotel three times since April and really do recommend it  It is not as modern as say the Conrad rooms  but it is very classy and the location is top notch It is located by Bugis Junction  you can get to the MRT without getting wet  and gives you access to the shopping in Bugis Mall  the Junction Market and the Luna centre a few minutes walk  five minutes more gives you City Hall area for the mall there  Food wise there are courts under Bugis Mall  stalls just beyond Bugis Junction and the strret directly across from the hotel  I think Lien Sieng  is nothing but interesting places to eat  Chijmes is 5 minutes away Room wise the hotel rooms are good  well laid out and equipped  but not the big TV screens you can get elsewhere  Wireless networking works well  Beds are big and comfortable  if a tad high Twice I have used the exec lounge in the hote and it is classy   food range generally limited but drink is served quickly and with a smile  staff are top notch  It is laid out with Peranakan furniture  making it warm in feel  The main lobby of the hotel is similar and a treat to relax in I have once had one of the Shophouse style rooms  I was surprised to find it facing the main road  so had to careful with my windows shower etc  but it was definately nice otherwise  but dark However it s the bell boys that make it for me  My luggage carries a tag for easy recognition at the airport   it s the colours and name of the soccer team I support  On my last two visits the bell boys recognised it and came to say quot  welcome back quot    that s a touch missing in many hotels

Another great stay at this wonderful hotel  If you can  then book a Club room for an even greater experience with top benefits including lounge access  which provides for a real luxury experience with complementary drinks and food  Formal  but friendly staff makes this hotel an excellent place to stay  The only improvements I d like to see are WIFI signals in the Victoria bar and the outside Pool area  which would make for useful business or leisure Internet access use whilst relaxing in these nice surroundings  Thanks again for a great stay

This hotel is in the Central Business District in Singpore  A litle away from for example Samposa Island or even Orchard Road  The location better for business than tourism I think  The lobby is wonderful with an atmosphere that feels like colonial Singapore  The rooms are large and nice with good bathrooms  In my bathroom the shower was leaking so badly that the water came out from the wall near the floor  Maintennance needed The staff was friendly enough and all small things worked out  I was not too happy about the room service lady that came 45 minutes early with somebody elses breakfast  and finally left when understanding that she had the wrong room  or the service person that was blatantly sending out hot air when I asked for a late check out  It is OK to say no  but not to give answers that are rather obivously wrong  Also the room serivce breakfast was mostly good  except that in a location as Singapore I expec the fruit to be ripe and sweet  if not I can eat in my native Norway  All in all a litle dissapointing for a hotel that is supposed to be on the upper levels as far as hotels go  It is not a cheap hotel and the ambitions are higher what I saw  Also being Priority member did not help getting a real answer when it came to a 15 00 check out

I stayed at the InterContinental in July of 2011  in a King Club room  and I must say that this is by far the best service I ve ever experienced in a hotel  Other recent reviews have discussed its great location  nice rooms  and comfortable beds  and I agree with those positive reviews  I would like to focus my review on the hotel s amazing service  and why I will now opt to stay in InterContinental hotels over other brands in my future travels  From the time I arrived until the time I checked out  the staff made me feel as though my satisfaction was the most important part of their job  I had access to the Club lounge  and the service staff in the Club remembered me every day and even remembered what drink I usually preferred and which newspaper I liked to read  I ordered room service two or three times  and room service was usually faster than the time estimated  and the food was always delivered with a smile The real distinction in service actually came after I checked out of the hotel  I emerged from my taxi at the airport and suddenly realized that I had left cash in several currencies in my hotel room  The total amount of cash equaled several hundred U S  dollars  Naturally  I thought of returning to the hotel to see if it was still there  but I then realized that I did not have time to do that and still make my flight  I called the hotel  and talked with Ms  Loy  a credit officer  She sent housekeeping into the room  and they found the file folder that I d accidentally left containing the currencies  I offered her a reward if she could send it to me  but she refused to accept one  saying that this was part of her job  Rather than send the cash and coins to me  she converted the cash amounts to Singapore dollars  and even found people willing to buy the various coins   There were also coins of different currencies   She then credited the entire amount to my account  I was amazed with this level of service  as I had truly expected never to see that money again   Even as I write this  I m still shocked  And they would not accept a reward   My experience has made an InterContinental customer out of me  Shortly after this trip  a friend of mine called asking about my hotel recommendations in another Asian city  and I unhesitatingly advised him to choose the InterContinental  I ve made similar recommendations to other friends  as well  They say that word of mouth marketing is the most effective tool in the hospitality industry  hopefully  at least a few people choose the Hotel InterContinental in Singapore because of my experience there

Stayed 3 nights with wife and 2 young kids  The location of the hotel is perfect  It is connected to the Bugis Village Shopping Centre with plenty of F amp B outlets and tons of shopping  There s plenty of local hawker fare as well all round the hotel  The Bugis MRT is accessed directly through the shopping center  With the MRT  you can get to anywhere in Singapore  If you are driving  parking is free and you get to park in the underground car park of the shopping centre The hotel is the typical InterCons with well appointed rooms and good service Will definitely return

I stayed at the IC for a week in Sept  2011 for business  Chose the IC to get Priority Club points  Stayed in a club room with the access to the club lounge  Could have breakfast in either the club lounge or the downstairs restaurant Pros 1  Great location with great shopping and dining all around the hotel  including a metro stop under the Bugis shopping center attached to the hotel  2  Great club lounge  Decent breakfast and evening cocktail food and drink  Only complaint here is that they need a larger area where guests get food  Need to spread it out more  3  Very decent  helpful staff  Cons 1  Downstairs restaurant has better breakfast selection than club lounge but there was a wait to get into there every morning I tried  Waited for 15  minutes a couple of times and then went to the club lounge 2  Workout area is small and not well equiped  Pool is also relatively small 3  Drinks in lobby lounge and Victoria s Pub are outrageously priced  I understand it is an upscale hotel   but drink prices are absurd 4  Club room was small for what I was expecting  Not really more than an average hotel room with a  very comfortable   king bed Overall I liked staying there but not sure for the price I would return  even given the points  As many of the reviews here say   for the amount of money per night at the IC there are lots of other nice places around Singapore in that price range Room Tip  Get a room on the pool side of the hotel   no noise from the busy side and front streets See more room tips

As a regular traveller to Singapore  I stayed at the Intercontinental Hotel together with my wife during a recent visit  Given the large number of good hotels in the city  standards for this type of establishment have to be high and we were certainly not disappointed  The Hotel is excellently appointed with some rooms being recently re furbished and its central location is really handy for most of the usual attractions  We found the staff very helpful  polite and attentive  more so than some of the higher price hotels  We were on a club level and the afternoon teas and evening cocktails were definitely not to be missed  The pool   gym were a bit small but overall a great place to stay    we ll definitely be going back Room Tip  Try the Shophouse rooms they  39 re a bit different to the normal hotelSee more room tips

Perhaps I expected a bit too much from this hotel after reading the other reviews  It s a good hotel but there are others in Singapore which are just as good  Hotel staff are always polite and courtious in Singapore so you will find this kind of service at any good quality hotel  Swimming pool was very small  and so can be over run with kids at times  We stayed at the club rooms and was told that there was no wireless in the rooms  and TV didn t even have a menu on it  There is however  wireless in the club lounge  Afternoon tea and drinks at the club lounge was ok  it was in par with the other club lounges in other similar type hotels Most hotels in Singapore offer free local calls but not this one  as soon as you dial out  you are charged  4SD  Yep  and I was even calling a free call number  Taxi was very difficult to get during peak hours due to the conferences in the hotel  so it is much better to book a taxi just incase   especially if you need to go to the airport by a certain time  Breakfast in the club floor had limited selection but still good  Go have breakfast at the Olive tree for a greater selection Overall  ok stay  nothing to rave about  I wouldn t go back in a hurry as there are other as good quality hotels with better packages on offer in Singapore

Overall had a great stay in a premier room with club room access  Club lounge is spacious and quiet  Afternoon tea and breakfast spread in the club lounge was ok and there was a good selection of evening canapes  Staff in the club lounge were extremely polite and friendly although the man that checked me out of my room could have been a little friendlier and perhaps smiled  Room was clean and spacious  Club lounge benefits allows you to have breakfast in the hotel s Olive Tree restaurant but most of the food in the buffet is cold  eg  old pancakes waffles etc  and staff in the restaurant are inefficient  I ordered a tea but they brought me a coffee  and the chef sprayed butter at me as I neared the pancake counter The only complaint that I have is that we had to wait quite a long time to check in because the rooms were not ready yet even though it was 4pm  Staff in the club lounge were very polite and apologetic about this though  Also our room  number 301  was right opposite the gym so is a bit noisy because you can hear people going to and from the gym All in all we had a very enjoyable stay because of the staff in the club lounge

This must be the 7th or 8th time I have stayed here and I always enjoy the experience At reception I was escorted to check in to the new executive lounge  was smaller and different floor last time I stayed   Very spacious  Note  Fullerton Hotel management   they let children in  Not only that  the staff were lovely with them Room was an average size and fine for the three nights we were there  My wife found the Bugis market and that was it   my bank balance decreased daily  The location is great and close to Little India  Arab Quarter and a block behind Raffles Breakfast in the executive club was very good as was the evening canapes and drinks  We tried breakfast in the lobby cafe one day   20 minutes and 3 requests to get a cup of coffee  And there can t have been more than fifty people at breakfast  Very disappointing but probably an off day Staff   very nice and friendly  our luggage was in our room by the time I walked in  threw my bag down and ran downstairs for a cigarette  Room service was very good and a relatively wide choice I rate this hotel highlyRoom Tip  It  39 s worth paying the extra to get a club room See more room tips

We stayed twice at the Interconti during a trip to Indonesia and both stays were fabulous As Ambassador Members we had great rooms  at the first visit we had a Junior Suite on the 13th floor and on the second visit in newly renovated Shophouse Room on 2nd floor  Both were great  Shophouse certainly has a modern more trendy style  We used the Intercontinental Club and enjoyed the extra service it provides  complimentary Wifi  some snacks and drinks  Happy Hour etc The beds are absoluteley the best   We had the best rest in 3 weeks each time stayed there The staff was great  helpful and very friendly  We were thrilled  when we stepped out of the taxi  the bell boy actually rememberd that we had been there only three weeks ago  when he said  quot welcome back quot Pool  amp  Gym are fine  Hotel location is very good  near in walking distannce to many attractions or only a quick taxi ride away  We will go back again

Great location in more historic centre but near little India  financial district and Orchard road   Great feel and mix of colonial and modern feel Good pool for a roof level pool  very good breakfasts  great lounge with creative cocktails  Big rooms in a city centre hotel are a rarity  Did not feel like being in a bit city conference hotel

Its everything you would expect with InterContinental  The staff are amazingly friendly and attentive  going out of their way to help and the also seemed to remember us and asked how our day shopping was etc  Its clean  the food is good  the restaurant had good choices  If its too hot or raining to go far there is a connected mall with good shopping  Its also not far from MRT  Orchid Rd and other attractions  The only bad thing I could say is that they decided to knock on my door just before 10pm at night for the turn down  which is a little late  so remember to put up the do not disturb

We re giving this hotel a very rare 5 out of 5 as everything during our stay was just perfect  We transit through Singapore many times during the year and were getting a little tired of our usual hotel choices so chose this hotel for a change  We were very glad we did  From the moment we arrived to the moment we left we experienced a very personal and warm level of service from everyone from the doorman to the reception staff to the pool guy  This went well beyond our expectations for a large international chain hotel where one gets quite used to receiving the bare minimum   the staff here were without fail excellent  We stayed in one of the newly renovated club shophouse rooms which was very well done and has been refurbished to a very high standard  While not enormous  the room was a good size with all of the amenities you would expect and most importantly the most comfortable hotel bed Ive come across in years of travelling  The club lounge is a very pleasant place to retreat to for some peace and quiet with highly attentive staff and a decent range of snacks of beverages and they make a mean espresso  The in house chinese restaurant was very good and room service breakfast also good  Staff in the lobbly lounge were just charming  Pool area pleasant but as others have mentioned a little on the small size for a hotel of this size and was completely full every time we were there  Overall  a refreshingly excellent hotel stay  Well done team

I stayed here three times on Business during 2010 and 2011 because it was close to my Regional office  I m afraid that my experience was not particularly good  The check in was very average and on the first occasion I got lost going up to my room there was no advice on directions  On my second visit I was directed to a room and when I opened the door the room was already occupied  Quality of room service was average at best and information from reception and concierge was only okay  I was given a wrong exchange rate when I asked for the exchange rate for HK   The Club Lounge is nice  and the location is convenient  you see a lot of reviewers mentioning this  but the pool is tiny and the loungers are often full  I did wonder who the GM was  I m still not sure  In all my three visits I never saw or heard from him her  completely anonymous  not a good sign  Overall the hotel is okay  but having stayed in Singapore a lot there are many hotels which are better

Lovely lobby  and public areas  The guest room was large and with a good bathroom  The shower had a water leakage so that water came out of the wall near the floor  so maintennance might be a problem  I found the staff to be less than helpful and service minded at the times when I really needed them  Food   tried room serice breakfast only  was mediocre

We didn t get into the hotel until almost midnight  amp  checked out the next day but the room was very comfortable  amp  the water  amp  fruit left in the room was a lovely touch  The breakfast was grand probably not as nice as the Fairmont but it was still enjoyable The best aspect for us was the club lounge  I had read on here to ask for an upgrade to use the club lounge and I did it cost  100    For this we had access to  breakfast  afternoon tea  amp  cocktails  It was just great value  amp  a great facility for us to use  Our flight didn t leave until 11 10pm so we had a walk around came back  amp  had high tea  had a lovely swim  amp  lounge at the pool area  amp  then after showering we had champagne  amp  hors d oeuvre before heading off to the airport for our hideous 13 5 hr flight to London Room Tip  Ask about club loungeSee more room tips

This was a return visit of 3 days after 6 months absence The service again was brilliant and the hotel although aging was in top condition with refurbished rooms  at least in the area we paid for Location is great with direct access to the undergound taking in most of Singapore We were particularly impressed with Peter the lobby ambassador who provided a wealth of local information and this is a position that other hotels should adopt as our aging populationtravels and requires that little extra assistance We were disappointed with only one change that has been made recently Breakfast at the Olive Tree was the highlight of my previous visits and a change in format has reduced the Asian influence considerably Sure there is a fine layout but we visit the region to experience the local food and this has largely been replaced by western style dishes  Dont change what was working so well   We will return next year as the staff are professional and the best we have encountered in Asia  and that takes some beating

I need to say sometimes it needs an incident to find best of pleasure  Mr  Sakdapol Thongjan  Bern   he knows absolutely to take care customers and make them a part of the Intercontinental family  my compliments Despite this fabulous service of Khun Bern  the intercontinetal Singapore provides superb quality of rooms in a friendly location with many places of entertainment and nightlife I will be back soon

This was our second stay at the Intercontinental Hotel in Singapore and this time I opted for a Standard Club King Room and with Ambassador Membership  received an upgrade to a Shophouse Club Room  Recently rennovated  this room was located on the corner of the building on the 2nd floor   same level as the club lounge  Since the room faced Victoria Street  my first thoughts were of road noise    and whilst there was a low hum  even during the busiest time of day   the room was sufficiently quiet  However  in the future I would suggest just one level higher would be even better The shophouse King rooms are reasonable size  the double vanity is certainly a benefit for couples  the King bed functional and comfortable  The Pillow Menu will suit most people and for the technophiles  the Bose Wave Player  ipod connectivity and plenty of power points will be welcome  To use your ipod though  you ll still need to request the remote cable function from room service  I liked the layout of the room  the extra lighting and the old Singapore Shophouse feel  For larger rooms you can request the shophouse suites which add a living room area  All shophouse suites are located quite close to the club lounge  We also experienced a Standard Club King  19th Floor  due to a maintenance issue with our room which required us to be moved immediately and which was handled impeccably by the hotel staff and management  As this happenned on the last day of our stay our check out was also extended which was very much appreciated  Standard rooms are quite bright and have different views and have standard  no double vanity  bathrooms  however these are certainly comfortable rooms and I would have no hesitation in recommending them as the lead in and particularly to upgrade from if you are an Ambassador member For us  Intercontinentals are about the Club  The friendly staff  the personal service and greeting  the variation in food  the ambience and location  each Intercontinental Club can be the difference in a great or ordinary experience  in my opinion   This time  it seems like new staff are settling in although I do believe they were trying very hard and most of the time I found them pleasant and helpful  The lounge is well located  easily accessible and is tastefully furnished  What lets this club down based on other experiences is the variation of food  Maybe I am being overly picky but after Dubai and Hong Kong  afternoon tea really was a let down and evening pre dinner fare was only reasonable That said  I will always recommend club access because it represents fantastic value  With a room service hotel restaurant  amp  Bar Soda  Coke  costing S 7 50  theres a saving right there   And often the rooms are only S 30  50 more a night  When you add food  Breakfast Afternoon tea pre dinner snacks   Internet  and drinks  sodas anyttime club is open    quite simply   Club Rooms are the best option The truth is  buying a drink at this hotel will hurt your pocket  2 Bottles of Tiger Beer  local  and 1 Coffee cost S 39 00  1 coke soda costs S 7 50  a cocktail around S 13  so enjoying several of these each night during happy hour in the club   the savings add up quickly  If youre not staying in club rooms  there is a 7 11 close by and the Bugis Mall connects directly to the Hotel providing shops  cinemas and MRT access On the flip side  food costs in both restaurants and room service seemed quite reasonable and again there is huge range just outside the door The question is would I go back  Definately Room Tip  Standard Shophouse Club   suggest 2nd floorSee more room tips

We stayed at the Intercontinental for the third time on our way home from Europe  This time  we had my in laws with us  who hadn t stayed in a hotel as lovely as the Intercontinental before  We splurged on club rooms  which we were grateful for  as we arrived at the hotel at around 8 9am after flying from London  and could stay in the club lounge until our rooms were ready  My father in law ended up spending our entire two and a half day stay at the Raffles Medical Centre due to food poisoning from something he ate in London  Being so close to the hospital made the stress of the hospitalisation much easier on my mother in law  My 4 5 year old daughter slept on a fold out bed in our room  Her bed was beatifully made each day  and her bedtime cuddly toys displayed on the bed  rather than discarded to the side  Nice little touches  We had breakfast each day in the club lounge  and went to the happy hour one night  The food was all great  as was the service

Recentlly had cause to be in Singapore on business and stayed for 5 nights at the Intercontontental  Enjoyed the experience  Courtious staff  good restaurants  particularly the recently reponed Chinese  and the good facilities  small issue with the room staff not clearing a coffee cup and leaving a cleaning cloth in the bathroom  Good location easy to get to the subway at Burgis and close enough to Marina bay for early morning walk to see the grand sites on the developing Singapore skyline Room Tip  Room 1514 has extra spaceSee more room tips

The hotel and staff were great  Excellent service  Escorted to my room at checkin  I travel to Singapore quite often and  as you know  it is almost always a bit warmer than comfortable  So cold AC is important to me  I hate when I get back from a long day evening night with customers and the room is hot because house keeping turned off the AC  I was there for 2 nights and it happened both nights even though I asked the front desk to  quot please make sure quot  it didn t happen  with a reminder after the first night  I was pretty upset the second night  They also missed my wake up call one morning as well  So nice hotel and the staff try  but it seems they just miss on the  important to the customer  details  at least this time   At checkout I spoke to the manager and his only consolation was giving me his card and telling me he would take care of me next time  we shall see whether that was sincere or a  quot get out of my face quot  gesture

Sometimes  quot New quot  is not always better  I have stayed at this property many many times over the last ten years in various room classifications   most recently twice September early October on the club floor   the rooms have been upgraded from the straits raffles look furniture to a suedo Italianate Faux chinoiserie look   the rooms felt cramped  you fall over a velvet tub chair and footstool oddly placed parallel to the bed   look like an afterthought   this was room 242 club level   It just felt fake designer borax walnut with transfer inlay The other more worrying change was the staff   never felt the insincere  quot have a nice day  quot  attitude before   don t get me wrong it all works but compared with most Intercontinental property s in Asia and judging from previous visits   this is a pace behind not great for IHC as the competition in Singapore is fantastic   The Grand Prix was on in September so if Management was not on top of things  particularly when they where charging premium rates for this period it would be of concern to IHC Group i would presume I suppose as a Platinum Ambassador with IHC I am concerned that one my favorite hotels is under performing   My advice is do your research Singapore has a lot to offer perhaps a late check out and a room upgrade could be sacrificed for exceptional accommodation top restaurants and service at the other top listed trip advisory hotels

I stayed 5 nights at the Intercontinental Singapore  and it was a wonderful experience  The room was well quipped  with a spacious bathroom and a very comfortable king size bed  Appreciated the little but unexpected touches of bath salts  and a choice of 7 different types of pillows  turn down service  The staff were helpful and polite  though slightly lacking in the genuine warmth and interest which other reviewers have noted on which was a bit disappointing  Perhaps this warmth is only reserved for corporate travellers  Priority Club travellers or those who had booked direct with the hotel   Some of the room service staff had a poor command of English  room service was too early in the morning  The air conditioning was a little cold  However overall I would recommend the Intercontinental Location was great  a few subway stops from Orchard Road  Near the hotel was the Bugis market  Li Xiang Street with many restaurants  Located above Bugis MRT  and a shopping centre also made the location more convenient

It was my first trip to Singapore accompanying a group of almost 150 people from a reputed corporate client in India If you are a first time traveller to Singapore  then the Intercontinental hotel is like a breath of fresh air  Just one look at the hotel exterior and the spacious lobby  the friendly staff who welcome you and are at your beck and call  is just enough to make you feel at home  The breakfast area is huge and spaced out  a wide range of breads  hot and cold dishes  Indian and vegetarian dishes and freshly squeezed juices are real soothing to the eyes  The rooms are quite large  clean and adequately equipped with all that you need be it in the main room  the cupboard or the bathroom itself  The main attraction being  that is located bang in the middle of the shopping area  called the Bugis Junction  which snakes out and criss crosses inbetween the hotel  You will be spoiled silly with the many  shop till you drop  options apart from the Junction i e  Bugis Village  Bugis Street  Albert Square  Burlington Mall and the BHG Mall   As far as location is concerned  it is located about 10 minutes from the Mustafa Shopping Centre  Serangoon Road  Little India and if your local tongue desires  the Indian restaurants as well  If you are out touring the entire day and need to grab a bite to eat  there is a 7 11 just in front of the hotel where you can get anything under the sun   A real treat of a hotel

Due to our wedding banquet  we were entitled to 1 night stay at the bridal suite on level 3  I liked the exclusivity of the suites and you get a small  quot corridor quot  before reaching the door  The room was comfortable for us and our guests except we had 1 that faced the gym so we couldn t keep our curtains opened all the time  The room facilities were great and service excellent  There was even a pot of warm red dates tea for my tea ceremony even though I only asked for tea cups  Very considerate Couple of things we realised   there was no dressing table  where I could sit at and do my make up unlike the usual standard rooms  although the wardrobe did have a large enough mirror  We also found it strange for the toilet  At the other hotels  usually the bottom of the glass doors of the cubicle to the shower and toilet bowl are matted  but here it is completely see through  It was quite weird to sit on the toilet bowl seeing someone else showering  The breakfast buffet was good and great variety   good food  The butlers were friendly and greeted us whenever we entered  Except that valet parking with cars parked out in the open sun  ended up with very warm interior when we retrieved our car

One of the best hotels I stay in worldwide and overall best Intercontinental hotel anywhere  Service is top notch  rooms delightful and decor harmonius  In house Chinese restaurant offers Delectable food whilst Olive Tree on ground floor had Best French Onion soup I have tasted  However what crowns everything about this hotel with is the Club Level lounge and the superbly trained staff who attend to your every need but with genuine warmth and delight  It is always a pleasure to arrive at this hotel and genuine dismay at having to leave again

We followed tne advice of another Trip Advisor traveller and booked a Club Floor room I must say it was excellent  the breakfast was VG and you could use either the Club Lounge or the restaurant on tne ground floor  Both were excellent The room had the most comfortable bed  the bathroom had a seperate shower and bath beautiful toiletries and after travelling through the UK for 10 days  then Spain for 26 days we finally had an iron and ironing board in the room  I hate ironing but I do think hotels should provide this facility in the room  I only went for afternoon tea in the Club Lounge once but it was very nice  little cakes  open sandwiches and an assortment of asian food The Club Lounge from 5 30 to 7 30 was extremely good value  drinks and an assortment of hot and cold food such as spring rolls  curry puffs  small noodle samplers and heaps of other delicous small dishesThe staff are very professional and friendly really great Tne huge lounge is really elegant  Worth having a coffee or drink just to soak up the atmosphere The hotel has a direct access into a shopping centre whih is also a very good centre  heaps of shops and food I would love to return to this hotelRoom Tip  Book a club room it  39 s the best valueSee more room tips

My husband and I are so impressed with the Intercontinental Hotel at Bugis  Singapore  The rooms are immaculate and spacious  The water pressure in the bathroom is amazingly good  with lots of hot water  The location of the hotel is ideal for shopping  food and access to the MRT  It is attached to Bugis Junction Shopping Centre  which in turn is next to the Bugis MRT station  It is also across the road from the Bugis Markets  At the other end of the markets is a large hawker centre  We were spoilt for choice in terms of food  with not only the hawker centre  but also a food court and lots of little food shops in Bugis Junction  plus a supermarket in Bugis Junction for fruits and emergency supplies  and the markets sold trays of sliced fruit  snacks and drinks What impressed us the most about the hotel  however  is the service  No waiting in lines to check in  No waiting for our luggage to be delivered to the room  And there is a button on the room phone labelled  Instant Service   which is pretty much what it says  I was greeted by name over the phone and my requests were delivered in mere minutes The hotel had a main pool  a spa pool and a baby pool  which our toddler loved  It is also much better value for money than many hotels along Orchard Rd We love this hotel and would definitely stay at this hotel again on our next trip to Singapore

room  370  was beautifully furnished and a perfect combination of modern amenities with Peranakan features  The giant TV was amazing to watch from in bed  along with playing music by connecting my ipod to it  Toiletries are from the White Company  London  so excellent quality and refreshed twice daily  along with a lovely turn down service at night  Just great to come back to one s room after dinner to not just a clean room with fresh supply of towels etc   but also nice touches like different  Peranakan kueh  cakes each night  dimmed lighting  curtains already closed etc My room s view was directly over the mall of Bugis Junction   I actually ate at a restaurant facing my room  MOF Japanese  by chance one night   and its wonderful to be connected to the amenities of this mall  Kinokuniya bookshop  Cold Storage supermarket and countless eateries for example  as well as immediate access to the MRT without having to venture outside into the heat and humidity Having access to omelette station and a myriad of other food choices  so really no need to head down to the main breakfast room in the  quot Olive tree quot  which is far busier and not as comfortable   Access is Singapore

We stayed here for 4 nights in the newly renovated Shop House Rooms on a cracking deal which gave us executive lounge access  internet and breakfast included in our rate The hotel was wonderful and we adored everything about it  The whole place just sparkles and the staff are amongst the friendliest hotel staff I have encountered at any hotel  anywhere in the world    so helpful and they really do know Singapore like the back of their hand Our room was spacious with a very comfortable king bed with nice linens  a sofa and a work desk and 3 giant windows looking down into Bugis Junction  The tv is a huge flat screen The bathroom was huge by London standards with a massive tub and huge walk in shower But the best thing about the hotel were the warm and welcoming staff that assisted us with any request with a smile We enjoyed our stay at Intercontinental Singapore very much and look forward to returning very soon Room Tip  Try the shop house rooms  Newly renovated and come with perks that the regular rooms don  39 t  Also   See more room tips

We booked this hotel as we wanted a lux start to our trip and we were not disappointed  The hotel is very grand with a large reception  lounge  bar  amp  fab staff  The doorman  amp  staff gave us excellent information regarding trip  amp  where the best places to eat were  Raffles is 5 mins away by foot  Orchard street is a 10 15mins walk  We got taxie everywhere as they were so cheap  We visited the Zoo  sentosa Island resort and spend several hours shopping   Our hotel room was large  amp  very comfortable  with all the small touches you would expect from a 5 star hotel  The swimming pool was outside and looked very inviting

We stayed for four nights at Intercontinental Singapore Hotel  Fantastic Service  Nice and big units but the gem of the hotel is the Italian Restaurant  We ate breakfast every day  hard to miss that nice buffet and one night we went for dinner  What a Italian food  so good  i felt like i was in Italy  and we have been many times in Italy We will stay there next time  No doubts

Our colleagues recommended that we stay at the Intercontinental ratherthan Raffles  were we usually stay  This was a mistake  The rooms werenot very nice  it smelled of smoke and the internet connection was unreliable and dropped every 10 mins  Not acceptable for a biz hotel in Singapore Even though our company has a good relationship with the Intercontinental  they were unaccommodating and even difficult  Our reservation needed to be extended by 1 night and we were repeatedly told that this was impossible  I checked again at 10pm the night priorto check out and confirmed that no rooms were available Understandable with short notice  we reserved a room at Raffles  But  upon checking out the in the morning  luggage in hand and on our way to Raffles for 1 night  we were told that our reservation was extendedand we would be charged for canceling  It was quite a hassle  Needlessto say  we checked out and move to Raffles for one night  I wish we had stayed there to begin with  I will not make that mistake twice

I booked a second stay at the IC in May of 07  I stayed there previously in August 04  I wasn t disappointed  This is one of the best IC ever and the service and the room were just delightful  The chinese restaurant on the first floor is fine but I would pass the one on the lobby next to the bar except maybe for breakfast Keep it up and I ll certainly come back

This is a very nice hotel and because I booked the room online I got a fair price  140EUR night   I arrived again to the hotel on my way back to Sweden a week later and booked a room 3 days in advance  This time it was three times the price with a much smaller room and no view altough I am a member in Priority club  This time it was not worth it The room my first trip was very nice  clean and avarage size  Not to small and not big  Service was everywhere  Almost too much cameras and staff watching all the time The Japanese restaurant on the hotel was fabulous  I ate there two times and was not dissapointed  As for the chineese restaurant  it was a disaster  It took ages before we could order  When we ordered we wanted a small dish from the menu  We were asked if we wanted rice with that and said fried rice  Then it took ages again before the waitress explained that they misplaced our order  When we got our food we got a third dish with rice and vegetables  not fried rice to go with our food  She then claimed that they don t serve fried rice at that chineese restaurant  The food was not good and the price way too high  Service was unacceptable and we had to pay for an expensive side dish we did not want  Both thumbs DOWN

We stayed at the Transit Hotel in Singapore Airport on the way from New Zealand to London last year  but it was too noisy and uncomfortable  even for one night  so for the return trip we stayed at the Intercontinental instead  It was definitely the right decision  It didn t cost much more than the airport hotel  because it was one of the Singapore Stopover promotion hotels at the time  and the standard was  so  much higher The complimentary shuttle to the hotel was problem free  and we were upgraded at check in to a lovely  huge  room  with a wonderful bathroom  and beautiful windows overlooking a courtyard  However  the courtyard turned out to be connected to the bar area  and it was Chinese New Year  When I realised it was going to be too noisy  I contacted the front desk  and they immediately had us moved to a completely quiet room  It wasn t a problem at all  The new room was a bit smaller  but still very comfortable  with soft beds and pillows   things I definitely value after a long flight The hotel is connected to a mall  which is handy because there s a small supermarket in the mall  so we could stock up on munchies for the day  I would definitely stay here again next time we go through Singapore

We stayed at the IC hotel for a week in 2007   October The rooms and service are of excellent standard The location is central to all attractions and shopping in Singapore For those wishing to relax their is a great pool area with lounges and umbrellas to keep you out of the midday sun Food in the hotel is expensive   however  the hotel is adjacent to the Bugis centre that hosts a number of great dining alternatives at very reasonable prices  Sketches and Fish on the Go were great  Ifyou want something on the run Maccas is available for a quick fix I have attached some photos from our twin share superior room  One bed was a queen and the other a king sized single   still with ample room for other furniture

My husband and I did a stopover in Singapore on our way to and from Australia  and we stayed at the InterContinental in Singapore for a total of six days  three at the beginning of the trip and three at the end   The InterCon is in a great location  close to the Arab Quarter and the old colonial area  near Raffles  The hotel itself is a beautiful colonial building with an old wing and a newer tower  On our first visit  we stayed in a room in the new tower  The room was wonderful with a very comfortable king size bed and lovely furniture and decorations  The large modern bathroom had both a full size bathtub and a separate shower stall  The room also had a small safe  black out curtains  a large LCD screen television and cable On our second visit  the staff gave us a room in the old wing  which is situated above a shopping area  The room was overlooking the street and was rather quiet  and it was large with lovely hardwood floors  However  there was a plumbing problem   we had a steady leak coming through the ceiling by our door  We alerted the staff to the problem  and they switched us to another room in the same wing  Unfortunately  this room overlooked the shopping area and was rather noisy  We finally ended up in a room in the new tower area again  which was again very nice The breakfast was very good  with a huge buffet  but it was relatively expensive  The bar was really cozy  we ended a few of our days there with a tall drink I would definitely recommend this hotel to anyone traveling to Singapore  but I would also warn them to avoid rooms in the old wing overlooking the shopping area  if possible  Aside from this issue  the hotel is wonderful  and the staff is very pleasant and accommodating

Our family of 2 adults and 2 children  aged 3  amp  5  stayed here for 4 nights in August  I agree with previous reviews that the hotel is an excellent location  We were upgraded to a junior suite on a club floor  The positive of this was the size of the room was excellent  The downside was the floor we were on was a smoking floor  Being non smokers the smell particularly in the evenings was unpleasant  I agree with a previous review that room service could have been better  Coffee and milk was rarely left in our room  Our telephone wouldn t work and despite several requests to fix  no one came  The doormen provided excellent service and were very friendly We would have no hesitation in staying at this hotel again

The Intercontinental is an excellent hotel  well located in a central area and attached to a great shopping centre in beautiful Singapore  Most of the highlights have already been mentioned by previous reviewers  so I won t go in to great depth  We stayed in a club room  which was well worth the extra money  we got a good deal booking direct via the priority club website  very reasonable compared to many of the other top hotels given that it was Chinese New Year during our stay too  The service we received was absolutely exemplary  with staff going out of their way to help us on a number of occasions  We did find our room  on the third floor  was quite noisy from functions which were going on in the hotel in the evenings  so I would ask for a room on a higher floor  I would highly recommend this place

I decided against staying in my usual hotel for cost reasons and location  The IC is more centrally located and easy to get to by taxi to the usual attractions I arrived at 1230 and after ten minutes at the check in desk  was informed that the room wasn t ready  The check in staff was friendly and even helped me link my Priority club point to my frequent flyer miles  When I returned 45 mins later arch  Therefore  if you are queueing on one side  if the counter on the other side becomes available  you can t actually see past the pillars  Also  after standing in the queue  a lady became We stayed here for 5 nights after spending 2 nights somewhere else in Singapore  and whilst it is not big and flash like some other modern hotels it is extremely nice and well presented  The rooms are nice  the food is good and the staff are very helpful  The central city location  close to shops  transport and attractions  and many within easy walking distance make it a great place to stay  The pool is also very nice  There are plenty of places to shop and eat around the hotel which are everything from cheap to not very cheap

Stayed here for my first trip to Singapore in an Executive room  with my parents returning for their fourth trip  Wow  They really know how to impress their guests  The staff were always friendly  hospitable and incredibly helpful  The rooms are fantastic  just the right size with great  comfortable beds  The Executive Lounge is also a gem   Free internet  Wireless or they have computers you can use   a staff member always there to help you book restaurants  tours or other accommodation if need be  as well as cocktails  regular refreshments and food   all the time  The Intercontinental Singapore is a fantastic hotel  great value for money  and in a great spot in Singapore as well   a very convenient location  The Olive Garden has a great buffet breakfast as well so try to have it included in your room rate and you will not be disappointed  There is also a shopping centre that leads out from the hotel with a food court  chemist  grocery store   everything you could imagine  Honestly would not stay anywhere else in Singapore  My grandparents stayed at Marina Bay Sands and it was quite awful   they had to line up for breakfast  there are so many rooms and not enough seats  and the buildings are just so enormous  So many people in one place  The Intercontinental is definitely the way to go when staying in Singapore  Absolutely wonderful

We stopped over in Singapore on our way to Sydney  The hotel was booked for us by husband s company as it was only a five minute walk to their office The staff in the hotel were very friendly and nothing seemed to be too much trouble for them always smiling  They even got a little upset if you attempted to move your own luggage Our room was large and comfortable  with a nice comfy bed which was very welcome to get a good night s sleep after a 13 hour flight from Heathrow  Overall we though the room was kept clean and tidy by the housekeeping staff The public areas of the hotel are clean and spacious with plenty of places to sit and enjoy a cup of tea  although be warned  as with every hotel these items work out quite expensive  Breakfast was an interesting experience  the buffet is the usual fair of cooked meets  cheese  pastries etc  There is also a  hot  buffet which serves curry  There is also an a la carte breakfast menu  which did cause some confusion when we ordered from it  Some of my husband s new colleagues met us for breakfast and ordering from this menu caused a lot of confusion and I don t think we got what we ordered  Apparently this is not uncommon  Never mind  the food was still nice  We did not eat in the restaurants so cannot comment on these There is a shopping mall attached to the back of the hotel and is only about five minutes walk from Raffles  Overall a nice hotel for a stopover in Singapore

?  wonderful hotel with excellent service and friendly staff The hotel is very nice area inside shopping malls  Spacious rooms with neoclassical decoration ? nd rich breakfast  Do not forget to enjoy the wonderful pool  10 minutes by taxi will be in the cable car with which you can go to Sentosa Park in all other sights of Singapore ? lso suggest you do the tourist bus round the city

This Hotel is just lovely  it has a particular charm and style  Stayed in a Club room with Int Club facilities   a definite recommendation The Hotels location is good  with easy access to MRT or an easy stroll to the harbour Rooms are spacious  high standard and very clean Food quality is very good with many choices available The staff are professional  attentive and welcoming  Stayed for 6 nights at for start of Chinese New Year Room Tip  Book a Club Room  the extra facilities and benefits are worth it See more room tips

I had an amazing visit and it was due part to the Intercontinental Singapore  Upon arrival  check in was smooth and flawless  The king room was amazing with spacious room  clean bathroom  and great air conditioning  The hotel staff go out of their way to make you feel like a welcomed guest  My favorite part of the hotel was the location of the strip mall connected to the side of the hotel  Fun local stores and food markets are located just steps outside the hotel  Air conditioned as well   I loved using the fitness room every morning and enjoyed the pool on occasion  Thanks for a great trip Intercontinental

We chose the InterContinental Singapore for our getaway from Hong Kong during the Chinese New Year  as well as for our personal events  We booked a club room with various privileges  which we realized was of much greater value than expected  Our check in  amp  check out were processed by a club lounge staff with utmost efficiency in a very friendly manner  Indeed  every staff at the club lounge offered us a heartwarming service in a professional way  When we asked for a way to some attractions unfamiliar to us such as the Universal Studio  amp  Dempsey Hill  we were given a map with detailed directions  Thanks to their accurate tips and the hotel s location  we were able to get to those spots very easily  Wherever we go to  this hotel is super conveniently situated in a core of this garden city  We appreciated its location literally every time we went out  amp  came back  We also liked breakfast served in the club lounge  The stewed prunes seasoned with star anise were my favorite  We tried Olive Tree s buffet breakfast too  however  we still preferred a coziness in the club lounge  Our room was always kept clean by hard working housekeeping staff  and air con was easy to control according to our preference  Now we are sure not so many hotels in Singapore could compare with the InterContinental in terms of service  amp  location Room Tip  Requesting rooms near the elevators may be a good ided if you like a quick access to outside  as som   See more room tips

Stayed 6 days at a Premier Room  Checked in at the club lounge  and was offered a room upgrade to newly renovated shophouse room at level 2  same floor as the lounge   Viewed both rooms before deciding to decline the offer  as the room which I booked  although not renovated  was a 50  sq m junior suite  on high floor in main wing  while the shophouse room was a mere 30  sq m  How could this be an upgrade beats me Roomwise  I was happy with the space  as there is a dining table and a sofa lounge  The view overlooked Parkview Square from afar  and the air conditioned Bugis Junction Mall almond cookies which I have sampled during teatime  and would like to purchase them if possible  When I next visited the lounge  the receptionist had already packed 2 jars of the tarts and cookies in a presentation box with the receipt from the Chinese restaurant   how s that for efficiency and thoughtfulness  Breakfast in my opinion is better at the club lounge than the Olive Tree Restaurant downstairs  even though the latter has variety  At the club lounge  Mr Amin the chef prepared eggs in whatever way we need  and is always cheerful and chatty  unlike the buffet breakfast downstairs  The bacon at the club is better and crispier than the ones downstairs too Overall  this is an above average and decent hotel  with staff greeting you at the corridors and holding the lift for you  The Stayed at here for 2 nights in Novemeber 2011 with my daughter  Nothing I can complain about at all  room was amazing  bed was comfortable  both the bedroom and bathroom were spotless  Breakfast was delicious with an abundance of choice  Loved the fresh fruit juice bar  Service from check in to check out was professional and helpful  Location at Bugis is perfect  Just walk out the doors of the Hotel and you are in the shopping centre with everything you need  coffee  food  supermarket  chemist  shops for retail therapy it was all there  After reading some of the reviews about this Hotel before we arrived last year I was uncertain if I had made the best choice in accommodation  however it have no hesitation in reccommending this hotel to family and friends  In fact it was so enjoyable that we are going back again in a few weeks and this time for a longer stay

My first stay with InterContinental Singapore was great  The Front Office staffs were very helpful and cheerful  They have the initiative   Good start In the room  it was fully furnished with necessities and iPhone charger was available upon request  The ultra soft yet firm bed was really  really comfortable   I enjoyed snugging under the duvet  BUT  it gets too hot after sometime  So  I had to snug and takeoff all night  which was a pleasant hassle  haha  However  the smoke detector right above the bed was extremely annoying   the red light keep flashing and I had a hard time not looking at it Breakfast at Olive Tree was so busy  we were offered Orange Juice while on the wait list  It did not take long  10mins  before we got ourselves a table  It was an extensive range of food  with nice peranankan touch  the prawns were really tasty   The buffet line was however not centralized  it was all over the restaurant  Internet is still chargeable which never fails to puzzle me  especially in this era  Checking out was a breeze and we enjoyed our 2 day stay
