This certainly isn t the most spectacular Intercontinental property around  and the rooms have a slightly older feel than most of their other hotels I ve stayed at   particularly the bathrooms which aren t as spacious and decked out with multiple shower options  double sinks  etc This is a VERY nice hotel though  The staff is excellent  breakfast delicious  and the gym has multiple cardio options along with one of the best free weight set ups I ve seen in a hotel  For me though it s all about the location and price  You re away from the high end shopping on Orchard Road and all the high priced hotels that go with that area  You re also away from all the useless  mediocre Western restaurants there that cater to tourists  Instead the Intercon puts you steps away from Arab street and a short walk from Little India and all the great food options those locals hold  Plus you re essentially attached to the Bugis subway stop and shopping mall  so getting anywhere in Singapore is a breeze Unless you re only flying in to shop Orchard Road I can t imagine why you d stay anywhere else

We were expecting the Hotel to have the wow factor and it did not meet our expectations  The Hotel is looking a bit  tired  with scruff marks everywhere  Our deluxe room was large but on the plain side  It was furnished with antique furniture but none of it matched  I guess it was a case of being more  shabby chick   The bathroom was lovely but the room itself just lacked something  it felt a little bare and unhomely  There was no view of any significance  The bed was very comfortable The staff were okay and hubby noted how the lady rushed us through our check in  which came across as being sterile Breakfast was a letdown as we were expecting a better standard here also but was pretty much a typical breakfast that you would find in a four star  Singapore  Hotel I have to say that my husband appreciated this Hotel much more than I did  He enjoyed the spaciousness and the ground floor areas  Had we booked a club room we may have found that wow factor and would not go there again unless we did The location is excellant

This is the second time I ve stayed at this lovely hotel  Each stay has involved just one night   a quick break on the long journey homewards to Australia  It s an elegant and gorgeous hotel   I adore the furniture in the public areas and the cafe restaurant on the ground floor  which provides arguably the best coffee in Singapore and a very good breakfast  The only complaint is the lack of vegetarian options on the dinner menu   just one dish which was all vegetable and I d have liked more than that  That said  there s a Turkish restaurant down the street and of course  the famous Indian quarter if one has the time The quietness of the room  the comfort of the bed  the crisp linen and the separate shower all combine to make their standard room an absolute pleasure

Nothing exiting here  But everything you expect from an InterContinental Bit old fashioned  but extremely well kept with the fresh smell of wood polish throughout the place  If you know the InterContinental Grand Stanford Hong Kong  you will know what to expect  Larger rooms  but less cozy As IC Ambassador we were upgraded from the standard deluxe 38m2 to a 55m2 junior suite The membership extra s make it a decent loyalty program  In Singapore you will find rooms which are much more hip or luxurious  but these IC rooms just seem to work by intuition  Great beds  And you re here for a good sleep aren t you  And there is a full ironing board in the room When you arrive by MRT from the airport  it looks like a direct line  but you will have to make a platform change at the second station from the airport   you will find the signposting to the hotel not very clear  And it s not an easy walk through the mall with all that luggage  Next time we will take the taxi like we did on the way back The location is not the best in town  but it s above the MRT and we did walk most of our destinations like Raffles City  Marina Square and Orchard Road  Two bus lines bring you straight back to the hotel from Orchard or again  take the taxi  SGD 4 00 from Raffles City  SGD 5 00 from Orchard and Sands  evening surcharges excluded   The pool is also not the best in town  But it s large and relaxing enough  No pool service  but pool towels and staff available on call  Good pool beds  The extremely high price for WIFI  over SGD 30 00 a day  is disappointing  Not even complementary for Ambassadors  It would be a reason to choose an other hotel  The hotel says it is concerned with mother nature  Why putting all those lights on after turndown service  Please stop this At check out our bill was not accurate  Causing some commotion  I had to prove the right room rate with a print out of my reservation  They missed my 50 USD food and beverage credit  Check your bill carefully  Breakfast is ok but expensive  Egg service is slow and they did forget my order twice and on both days we took breakfast at the hotel  If breakfast is not included  you might want to try the bakery at the National Library opposite the hotel where you can sit outside  The IC is a decent hotel to stay  No wows  just traditional good rooms and service  Hope they will give some more attention to details  like they do in Hong Kong  and I might give it a five star rating again  Right now I also might consider the same price competition like Swissotel  Pan Pacific  Regent  Meritus Marina  Fairmont and Conrad

I feel this could be a very good hotel   but isn t  While I have only stayed here once  and I came wanting to like the place  I have learnt enough to doubt whether I would consider returning In principle there is quite a bit to like about this hotel  It is in a tasteful building with a pretty lobby  although not immediately at the vehicular entry to the hotel  and is attached to the charismatic Bugis Junction shopping centre  with classical Singaporean shopfronts in airconditioned comfort as well as an MRT station  Sadly the finishing touches are what are lacking  The rooms feel cramped and the views  even on high floors  feel industrial and constraining  Although there are Elemis toiletries in the bathrooms  and a pleasant fruit bowl is provided on arrival  the installations seem tired  Wait staff  although doing their job technically adequately  were tired and disinterested Service in fact was often brusque  I was interrogated for sitting in the lobby without ordering a drink  I understand there must be problems with flow over from the shopping centre  but I was reasonably well dressed and the majority of tables were empty   After late check out was granted I was called three times in the hour before the agreed time asking whether I was ready to check out yet The check in staff were unwelcoming and disconnected   and while I admit bias in that my Priority Club Gold status yielded absolutely no upgrades or concessions  which is their entitlement   my friend  who is Priority Club Platinum and a member of the Ambassador program as well  got an upgrade in name only  his room was exactly the same  and was denied access to the club lounge  If you can t please that kind of customer with what they would consider basics then you have got problems All in all it certainly does not make a compelling argument to return  While it isn t a four star hotel  frankly in this price range it should be doing much better

I was there for a short one night stay  The check in process was fast and uneventful  Reception was okay  not outstanding  and more impersonal than expected  The reception had nice checkered flooring my opinion  it s too  quot backward quot  for a hotel of this class  and there was not even a single USB port or a docking station for playing back music in my iPhone iPod  In comparison  the Pan the fact that certain amenities such as the shaving kit  comb  sewing kit and such were not provided as default items in the room  Customers will need to call for such items  I would prefer the hotel to be more generous in this regard The view from the lower floors were not that great  I had one which was facing the shopping area  The window area was  quot blocked quot  by the writing table and so compensated by turning down the water temperature to less than 25  i think   Something is not right with the shower tap Breakfast was alright with nothing to shout about  with a few hits and misses  The excellent part was you get to eat in a  quot courtyard quot  with natural lighting in part of the dining area  which I think was an excellent idea  Chicken porridge was pretty good  however  the naan was in the clay pot for so long that it was hard and dry  Being a hotel in the heart of cultural Singapore  the Nasi Lemak dish was depressingly below par  I wished they could just improve this traditional dish that is so adored by our locals here  If I remember correctly  breakfast is about  38 per head if that is not included in your room package  I would say that it might be cheaper if you just head for the nearby food establishment around the area for breakfast I found that the milk dispensing container for the cereal had operational issues  In the window of time I had my breakfast there  the tap of the milk container failed to turn off and milk split all over the counter top on to the floor  The poor staff had to drop what they were doing to clean the mess  Not a good thing In terms of the lobby  it was nice and quiet  with carpeted flooring  very suitable for a drink and chat with friends and colleagues  Location wise  it was very near to Bugis MRT   just a 3 minutes walk to the station  and there were a lot of food to be tried in the basement where it s food heaven for the local and tourists alike If you like electronics and computer gadgets  it is very near to the Sim Lim Square   about 10 minutes stroll  through the Bugis Village  and straight down  You can also visit the nearby Kwan Im Thong Hood Cho Temple  which devotees will pray and contribute flowers to the temple  Generally  the hardware of the hotel is there and well done  but personally  comparing the two  I prefer Pan Pacific hotel better by a notch  The view is probably slightly better  and service a little more personal  which is my preferred interaction with hotels  Good hotel otherwise Room Tip  Get a high floor  If you dislike overseeing the road  ask for the one facing the shopping mall See more room tips

I stay here regularly and it s always a pleasure to come back to IC Singapore  The service is always warm and professional  but maybe not as personal and genuine as you find other places in SE Asia  but then this is Singapore  The Club lounge is great with outstanding service and a good selection of food and beverage  The rooms are  as the rest of the hotel  very comfortable  however  I have never really liked the Shophouse suites  Not because of the suites them self  they are very nice  but I don t like the feeling of staying inside a shopping mall

I ve reviewed the IC at Bugis before  but stayed again in May 2012 and was gratified to discover the standard has been maintained in all aspects   service  rooms  facilities and general atmosphere  If you are lucky as I was to stay in a club room you ll be rewarded with the most amazing yet unobtrusive service  I feel it s worth paying the extra to experience such fine service  not to mention the excellent drinks and snacks   For me it s also about staying at Bugis and being part of the bustling shopping centre and market  with Little Arab India short strolls away  I m very pleased to know that one of my favourite places to stay continues to provide all of the things I loved about it the first time

Stayed here for 2 nights in may for the first time  I m a regular business visitor to Singapore and normally stay at the Mandarin  The Intercontinental was more expensive and disappointing  Check in took a long time  the hotel corridors and rooms are a bit dated and starting to look tired and a bit shabby in places  I ordered room service one night that was average at best  My room rate included breakfast and on check out I was charged as had taken this in my room  When I challenged this the receptionist was very surly and unhelpful  There are no outside bars or restaurants at the hotel  unlike the mandarin  which after a LNG day at the office it s nice to be able to get some fresh air  Also rooms don t have windows that open and the air conditioning was either off or freezing cold  On thie plus side the door men were super friendly  Wouldn t rush back at all

I have only stayed here a couple of times but the Intercontinental name speaks for itself  Whats nice about this hotel is the location right next to Bugis MRT so you can get to Marina Bay  Orchard shopping and Entertainment and China Town all withing 10 20 minutes  The food court above the station is also great for many international and local foods Room Tip  A beautiful restaurant and breakfast roomSee more room tips

i lived briefly in Singapore  in the Bugis area and have had arranged friends to stay at Intercontinental  this hotel together with Bugis surrounding had grown to have sentimental values to me  After these years  was happy to revisit this hotel and all the good memories were re lived  everything was just as perfect  this Intercontinental is an absolutely brilliant marriage of colonial charm with classy old school 5 star hotel features well maintained  Rooms are very spacious and well outfitted  the bed is to die for  i have a hastens at home but their bed is better       wonderful bathroom  Location is also the best   the hotel is connected directly to Bugis MRT  you won t even have to go outdoors to reach the train  this also means direct MRT connection to the airport  Bugis is also very close to everything  like 5 mins walk to City Hall  raffles hotel  esplanade etc   also right next to little india and arab street  and bugis is a street food paradis  i am missing it right now     swimming pool is fab   it s like a hanging garden hidding you from the busy crowd just 3 floors below  I will always stay there whenever I am in Singapore

This was our third visit to the Singapore IC and we enjoyed just as much  It s in an excellent position within walking distance one way to say Arab St and to Raffles the other  Bugis Junction is just outside the back entrance of the hotel We stayed in a club room once again   the rooms and bathrooms are very well equipped and comfortable  The Club Lounge is excellent and the staff there are lovely  You could eat enough there not to have to eat outside the hotel but with all the delicious food in Singapore it would be shame not to sample it  We will be staying there again later this year and also for a couple of days before Easter next year

I ve stayed at this Intercontinental Hotel a number of times  amp  will continue to return as it is an exceptional quality hotel in Singapore  Last trip was with the family   wife  amp  two young daughters  We booked a Junior Suite  amp  were upgrade to a Shop House Suite  I m an Ambassador member   This room is very spacious  amp  a unique mix of modern  amp   quot olden style charm quot   What was great was that it has a master room that is separated by a wall  amp  doors with the lounge room meaning that when the kids went to sleep at night in the lounge  we were able to watch TV  amp  relax in the master room without disturbing them  The only downside of the Shop House Suite rooms is the fact that they back onto the shopping centre  amp  it can get a bit noisy even with all the doors shut  But if you don t mind a little noise  then the rooms are very nice  comfortable  amp  spacious  I ve also stayed in other rooms in this hotel including one time where we were upgraded to the Ambassador Suite   amazing  Huge  amp  spacious like a house  The hotel is very convenient being adjacent to Bugis Junction  amp  shopping centre  The MRT is a short walk as well  Buffet breakfast is very good with a good variety of food  A few more healthy options would be good if anything but overall very good  If you can afford it  get the Club lounge as the cocktails  amp  food at night are excellent  amp  the lounge itself is very comfortable  Great fitness centre here as well  All in all  an excellent hotel that we will continue to return to for business  amp  family holidays Room Tip  Shop house suites are spacious  amp  comfortable but can be noisy as they are adjacent to shopping c   See more room tips

Stayed at this hotel after having spent a week in a hospital in Singapore due to an accident  It was a fantastic stay  The rooms were really nice  The parquet wooden floors and decoration gave the room a lot of charm  Definitely a great idea of getting rid of the usual carpet floor in hotel rooms  The service was great  anywhere you went in the hotel  My arm was in a cast and the hotel staff went out of their way to help me  The buffet Italian restaurant was pretty good  Have not tried the other ones  Finally  the location is quite convenient  Adjacent to a new shopping centre  walking distance from the Marina and a short  cheap  cab drive away from Orchard Road  Definitely going back there on my next trip to Singapore Room Tip  Choose one of the Shophouse rooms which have recently been renovatedSee more room tips

We stayed 6 nights as part of a combined business and leisure trip  We had two different reservations that were properly reconciled when checking in  The Hotel has a very central location within walking distance of restaurants and museums  and in addition porters are efficient at getting taxis if you need to travel further  The Business King rooms are reasonably spacious and well furbished  in a rather traditional style  with marble bathrooms and separate shower booth  This booking offer includes wireless internet  multiple devices   two pieces of dry cleaning per day  non cumulative  and breakfast  In addition our week end booking included late check out at 4pm  convenient for the evening flights back from Singapore  All this has been thoroughly explained at check in  which was friendly and efficient  The hotel boasts a swimming pool with sundeck  and has a well equipped fitness room with both treadmills and weight machines  Large choice of breakfast  local  English  continental  with good dimsums and plenty of fresh fruit  including juice and smoothies   Check out was equally efficient  The only minor problem had to do with charging a deposit from the debit card used for booking  which failed despite the card being perfectly valid  after a couple of e mail exchanges the Hotel agreed to charge the deposit at check in  which in reality was a simple authorisation   I ve seen this problem in another Hotel in Singapore  so it may have nothing to do with the Intercontinental  Overall  great value and service  highly recommended

This review is well overdue   I have stayed at the intercontinental in Singapore over 12 times in the last few years and on every visit  the quality of service  the attitude of the staff  the cleanliness and comfort of the rooms and the general ambience and luxury of the hotel itself is second to none The shophouse rooms and premier rooms are highly recommended and paying extra for access to the club lounge and the superb service therein  is also worth its weight in gold  I dont normally call out staff for special praise but Matthew and Anne in the club lounge are an absolute credit to the hotel and always a pleasure to see This review may sound a little  gushing  and generally I do tend to be fairly candid and frank but when a hotel is exceptional it deserves to be praised   this hotel and its staff are exceptional

We stayed a night on way to Sydney from London  What a great spot to stop  We caught the MRT from airport direct to hotel    SGD2 per person  Checked in at 9 am and they were kind enough to let us access our room immediately  The club lounge topped off the experience    The staff cant do enough for you and the food is amazing  Breakfast the next morning was also amazing  Will stay again next time and have told others to do the same Room Tip  Choose a club lounge room    Absolutely worth the extra cost See more room tips

I love the look of this hotel lobby not modern not fancy but comfortable elegance  I have stayed here several times and keep coming back because  1 The shop house rooms are a bit of old singapore while being all that you would expect from a large luxury chain hotel 2  the club level benefits include a great breakfast and a excellent happy hour food and drink combo and 3  the location is close to the MRT for easy in city transport while being walkable to shopping and a nostalgic drink at Raffles Hotel  without the over the top room rates Room Tip  Book a shop house room with club level privledgesSee more room tips

This hotel OK  conventiently attached to the Bugis shopping mall and approx a 15 minute walk to the Marina Bay  The hotel itself and the rooms are clean however the air in the rooms and the hotel in general was quite damp  even for Singaporean Standards   There is a Clark Hatch fitness centre inside although the equipment is as dated as the rest of the hotel  Next time I am in Singapore I will most likely go with the slightly higher room rate  not much more  and something slightly newer and closer to the Marina

We only spent one night here  as we had an overnight stopover  however I have previously stayed at this property before  My overall feeling about this stay was ok   nothing out of this world but nothing bad either As we were only here for one night  I booked a Standard Room  the cheapest available   Due to IC Royal Ambassador status  we were provided complimentary Club Access  The Club Lounge proved to be the highlight of our stay The room was clean and super spacious  but dated     it could use a thorough refresh  There is an entry with coffee making facilities etc  and storage space  The bathroom is really big for a  standard room   Standard IC Elemis bathroom amenities  Last time I was here  I stayed in a newly renovated Shophouse Room  and if I return  I will be sure to book this room type As mentioned earlier  the Club Lounge is definitely a highlight  Good food selection for both breakfast and evening canapes  with hot and cold selections  friendly staff  There is an egg   omlette chef at the breakfast sitting  Cocktails available in the evening  a nice addition  rather than mixing spirits or a selection beer   wine only   How can you not order a Singapore Sling in Singapore I think the location is great  the hotel is attached to a shopping centre   only minutes to a supermarket  quick eats  shops     I found taxis really reasonable  making it easy to get around This hotel is fair value if you can pick up a decent rate  At peak times this hotel can become pricey  in which case I would look elsewhere Room Tip  Book a Shophouse Room  and if possible  Club Access  The Club Lounge here is one of the best amongst   See more room tips

Excellent hotel we were lucky enough to have a room with a great view of Singapore  Hotel staff very friendly and on the few times I required their assistance they were quick to respond and very helpful  Location is good too  the MRT at Bugis is very near by  I will definitely stay there again  The breakfast buffet is enormous at Intercontinental with an exceptional choice of food

I travelled to Singapore for business from 30 May till 1 June 2012 and stayed at the Intercontinental  My stay included the room and daily breakfast  As it was a business trip  and in view I would be flying into Singapore on the 7 30am flight from Kuala Lumpur and arriving at Changi at 8 30am  my secretary made specific requests for an early check in to which no response from the hotel was provided Upon my arrival  again I requested for an early check in to which the receptionist pointedly said early check in s are subject to availability and may be chargeable as an extra night s stay  I found the staff s mannerisms to be hostile and off putting  I told him if it is necessary to charge for early check in  I guess I don t have a choice in spite of my secretary s numerous requests previously which went unattended  In the end  they conceded and allowed the early check in at no extra costs  My room was on the 6th floor and I found the hotel itself to be very old  The room was freezing cold despite me switching up the temperature  The bathroom was spacious with both a shower and a bath  The bed was comfortable and the amenities were adequate One peculiar and annoying thing about this hotel is that a member of staff is sent up to guest rooms everyday to make checks on the mini bar which was quite puzzling and disturbing  Everyday of my stay I had a Filipino male staff requesting to do mini bar checks up to the point that I suggested sarcastically the hotel should keep the mini bar outside the room so I m not disturbed to open the door for such checks  It was irritating to say the least The service was average  when a request for a lint roller was made to clean my business clothes  the staff on the service line did not understand what a lint roller meant  A lot of description had to be given before the correct item was despatched  A simple in room dining of a club sandwich took 30 minutes to be delivered  this is just a sandwich mind you  if I had ordered a gourmet meal I probably would have to wait 24 hours for delivery Breakfast was good  the spread had a good variety but the arrangement left a lot to be desired  The food were too spread out and as a result guests had to walk all over the place  The eggs were made to order but in spite of the size of the restaurant and the large amount of tables  there was only one chef making eggs  the poor chap was struggling to keep up with orders The Japanese restaurant had a nice ambience but the food was mediocre  The price of the food was unreasonably high for such poor quality  The sashimi was not very fresh  I asked for a spoon twice before they provided me one and the restaurant was not even crowded  I d hate to imagine what service would be like if the restaurant was crowded Overall  for the price I was charged for this hotel  I was quite disappointed with its service  I was told by my Singaporean clients the intercontinental is not the best hotel for value for money  There are better hotels out there  Needless to say  I won t be returning for my next trip to Singapore

We stayed here for 2 nights on the way back to Australia from London  Nice calming atmosphere after a 12 hour flight  with old style decor in the public rooms  Room was good with adequate size and nice bathroom  Fine quality towels  robes and bed linen Service was generally good  apart from a slow check in process Breakfast was good with wide choice to select from  If you want to avoid the expensive restaurants in the hotel for your meals then Bugis shopping area is immediately adjacent to the hotel with wide range of cheap local food in the food halls We caught the shuttle service from Changi airport to hotel  wait was only 5 minutes and cost was low    9 each  Only shared with one other couple  However when returning to airport for our onward flight the hotel couldn t book them so we had to get a taxi  which in fact only cost  13 Taxis are generally cheap in Singapore though the MTR rail system is first rate and easy to use

When writing reviews on Singapore hotels you need to appreciate that even an average hotel here could well be considered first class elsewhere particularly outside Asia  There is nothing wrong with this hotel it is just not special in the Singapore context  The few times I have stayed here has been on price rather than preference  It is old by local standards and rather small but the rooms and facilities are OK but not exciting  What I don t like about Intercontinental Hotels everywhere is not matter what your status in Priority Club it means nothing at these hotels  Even the comparatively lowly Holiday Inns in Singapore do far more for far less if you happen to be a high ranking Priority Club type  You are unlikely to find a bad hotel in Singapore so often the choice is about location and this one isn t bad  Although it is not really close to anything special unless you are into libraries   have to be careful here the wife is a librarian   it is not far from a host of tourist things  So if the price is right it is OK but don t expect any extras or even a welcome note

We recently stayed at the Intercontinental for two nights  on our way back to Australia from Amsterdam  We had booked a Club Intercontinental room through Expedia  and we were so impressed with this hotel   It is very tastefully furnished with Peranakan artifacts  and has a very welcoming feel to it  The staff are genuinely warm yet very professional  The Club Lounge on the second floor is great   delicious snacks and a nice library with interesting books   Rooms are very spacious and the beds soo comfortable  Position of the hotel is fantastic as it is within walking distance of Little India  the Arab area and a Heritage walking tour Just past Bugis street a great hawker food area  and the Bugis MRT station right next to the hotel as well We felt rejuvenated when we left  hope to be back  Congratulations to all the staff Room Tip  The Club rooms so you can access the Club LoungeSee more room tips

Just spent 8 days in Singapore at the Interncontinental  The service there was simply outstanding  none better  The location made it walkable to just about everything  or no more than a 10 minute cab drive away  The gym was satisfactory  nothing special with a few treadmills and the like  but it was open 24 hours and was spotlessly clean  The breakfast was also a highlight  and came with the room   a near cruise ship quality buffet with custom omletts as well as a good variety of Asian and European morning fare  All around an exceptional property

Stayed 5 nights for a business trip and the Intercontinental was a perfect choice  Comfortable beds  extremely helpful staff and a super convenient location at the Bugis train station  You could easily walk to the river or take the metro for locations further away  Only negative was the ridiculously high price to eat in the hotel itself  but this was easily rectified by stepping outside  not even outside  as it is connected  and eating at one of the nearby restaurants

Booked for a three night stay and was happy to find we had our booking upgraded to a newly refurbished room on the 2nd floor  Huge room with two double beds and fine furnishings  Large bathroom with separate shower and an entry hall  Breakfast was great  with a large assortment available  Had to wait a couple of times to get a table  as it was very busy  but we were seated elsewhere and were served juice and had fresh pastries on the coffee tables Loved that we had the choice of different pillows  The sheets were white crisp and although that s normally a good thing  they were on the noisy side when you moved  Check in out was a breeze and staff were all very friendly and polite  Would book again

Love this hotel for it s club rooms  Free afternoon tea  breakfast and the best thing  free cocktails and food from 5 30 until 7 30pm  What a great service  Staff are impeccable  and I really cannot say there is one fault  The pool area is small but lovely and welcome respite  Rooms are perfectly sized  good solid bathrooms with robes and all you could ask for  Water  fruit and chocolates  Taxis are also daily available  Next to bugis   shopping centre  Will definitely stay here again

My fianc?  and I stayed at the Intercontinental Singapore for 2 nights at the beginning of June 2012  We chose the Intercontinental as although it was not the cheapest choice  we felt that the hotel seemed of a good standard  and in a good location  We were not disappointed  Every member of staff we encountered was helpful and professional  in particular  Peter the Concierge could not do enough to assist us  He was very helpful in terms of planning bus routes giving us detailed directions to local attractions  Our room at the Intercontinental was nothing short of fabulous  We had booked a standard room  so did not expect anything particularly spectacular  so we were pleasantly surprised by the high standard of d? cor  and the outstanding cleanliness  The bed was easily the most comfortable bed we have ever encountered  we found ourselves rushing back to the hotel in the evenings just to get into bed and lounge  The pillow menu was a nice touch  and a staff member knocked the door every evening to enquire as to what pillow we would like to try next  The bathroom was large and spacious  with a bath and separate shower cubicle  It was extremely well appointed  Elemis toiletries  bathsalts  fresh white robes daily  We could not have asked for more  There was a comprehensive tea and coffee selection  along with a kettle and cups  obviously  and water was replenished as and when required  several times a day if need be   On the first evening we had delicious petit fours delivered to our room which  again  was a nice touch  The hotel pool area was very smart and clean  and also proved to be an excellent suntrap  Fresh towels were readily available  and the sun loungers themselves were padded and exceptionally comfortable  no nasty plastic loungers here   The location of the hotel was fantastic  a 5 minute walk to Raffles hotel  a soulless tourist trap  but worth going to indulge in the obligatory Singapore Sling and have a tacky photo taken   We walked to Arab Street for dinner one night  and had a delicious Turkish meal overlooking the impressive mosque  We also walked to Little India  which was around a 15 minute walk away  and well worth a look  Again  the Quays are all within walking distance  no more than a 30 minute walk  However the bus services are also very regular and cheap  and given the killer heat in Singapore  jumping on an air conditioned bus for a few stops is a good option  We spent one day at the beach at Sentosa which was pleasant  but had an oddly ¡®fake¡¯ feel to it  Disney by Sea almost  We caught the local bus for a couple of dollars each  and then jumped on the mono rail from Sentosa to the beach  again  just a couple of dollars   Taxis in Singapore are expensive  and difficult to source at times  and I would absolutely recommend the local buses  Similarly  when arriving at the airport  if you go to the information desk in the arrivals hall  they will book you on a shuttle bus  which only costs 9 SD per person  and which drops you to your hote

this hotel need some good renovating done two yearsago I stay in this hotel and had some isuess with and now again after 2 years give them second chance and they will not see me come back for sure1 I had room reserved that I know they have  large lcd tv ipod dock         but I got some miniature room with small tv outdated furniture                               2 internet is  54 cents a minute but not mater you use one hour or five hours they will charge you 30 for 24 hours3 I am Platinum member for last 14 years and they did not even try to offer upgrade4  food is average hotel food but extremly expensive  bottle of perrier mineral water  9 25 WOW 5  housekeeping extremly noise in the morningIn all I dont think I will be back  maybe for night that see did they improve

I regularly stay in this hotel when on business trips to Singapore as it is handy for our office  but if I came on a leisure visit  I would also be very happy to stay here  Good things  The rooms are immaculate  with very comfortable beds  Elemis toiletries and reliable internet access and as you would expect  the hotel service is also impeccable  I have never come across a member of the hotel team who has given me anything less but perfect service  It is also rather handily situated by Bugis Junction  a good sized shopping and eating area  I particularly love the way they have managed to preserve some of the traditional shop houses Not so good things  Very little to pick up on to be honest  though I thought they could provide a larger public area for guests to use  I couldn t get back into my room one morning because they were cleaning it  so I went downstairs but the only place I could find to sit was in the bar area  which meant I had purchase an expensive pot of tea  equivalent to GBP13 50  I didn t really want

This hotel has everything   brilliant location in the central Bugis district   near to great shops  restaurants and three minutes walk from the famous Raffles Hotel  the kind of comfort you expect in the Intercontinental   beds with the thickest mattresses you almost float on and pillows you want to buy  I m told they are expensive and you can feel it  and above all staff who recognise you and address you by name  welcome you back and show friendliness but never familiarity  The hotel might have a very grand lounge but underneath that is a home from home atmosphere where the service is friendly and if you want it totally unobtrusive  Pay the little extra and get access to the club lounge  where food and wine is complimentary  You ll be waited on hand and foot and there always seems to be food around  Jay in the club lounge has some wonderful lines when you re not sure whether to have a top up    quot Sir  this is not wine  it s medicine  My physician recommends it for jet lag quot   or how about this one   quot Sir  the law in Singapore is strict about expiry dates on wine glasses  your glass will expire in 20 seconds  How about finishing it and then I can top you up and keep within the law quot  Truly wonderful  I have arrived home and am having to pour my own wine  I can t get used to it  I might have to go back  Go once and you will become an Intercon addict Room Tip  Go higher for the view if you can  although if you want to pay a bit extra they have amazing new sui   See more room tips

We have just returned from a six night stay at the Intercontinental Singapore  What a lovely hotel  great location  staff and service  Arriving late at night check in was seamless and very efficient and as a Platinum Priority member they upgraded us to a suite which was spacious and beautifully appointed  I have noticed some other PC reviewers have given harsh reviews on PC benefits but we were afforded every courtesy  The location of the hotel next to shopping  mrt station and availability of eating outlets and groceries etc was fantastic  I think if your were just having a short couple of night stay in Singapore this would be a great choice as it has everything you could need right on your doorstep  Nothing was too much trouble the cleaning of our room was prompt and exceptionally well done  breakfast was also very good and the pool area relaxing   although no sun till afternoons   I will definitely recommend this hotel to friends visiting and would stay there again on our next visit Room Tip  Our suite overlooked the pool so room was quiet and also very spacious See more room tips

The hotel location is very convenience  specially if you plan most of yours traveling by MRT   It s a very short walk from Bugis MRT  It s right next to the bugis junction  which is also convenience to find something to eat after a long business day  Easy traveling to and from Airport  Not only the Hotel location is great  but the people who works at the hotel is who really make the difference  The staffs are friendly  The room is clean and comfortable    Isn t it great that you can enjoy a hot bath in a nice and cozy room after a long walking day in Singapore

We visit Singapore regularly and have tried most of the 5 star hotels  Whilst not the most up scale hotel in Singapore we enjoy the Intercontinental because of it handy location to shops  restaurants  and other facilities  The club lounge is impressive and service is always of a high standard  As an  Ambassador  level customer  can be purchased at a reasonable price  our upgraded room was spacious and will equipped   wi fi included with upgrade Room Tip  We avoid the   39 shop house  39  rooms   they have not outlook and are rather remote from the rest   See more room tips

Stayed here for two nights on a very good advanced purchase rate and as a Royal Ambassador member was upgraded to a Shophouse Room which included club lounge benefits  The room is quite spacious and comfortable and the shower has strong water pressure  Amenities provided were  quot The White Company quot  and i prefer them to the usual Elemis or L Occtaine you find at other Intercontinentals  The lounge is comfortable and well appointed  however the food offering in the evening cocktail could definitely be improved   fish nuggets with ketchup doesn t quite enhance the air of sophistication  I ordered room service on one night  and all four of my choices were unavailable sold out   so i settled to order from their Chinese menu   food was just ok Overall  it was a very comfortable stay  The hotel has plenty of shops restaurants around it  and would serve as a good base for tourists  But if travelling solo on business  I would probably return back to the Holiday Inn Room Tip  Shophouse rooms are refurbished and very comfortable See more room tips

Not only the Hotel architecture is awesome  but the people that works at the hotel is who really make the difference  Less than excellent service and personalized attention is not an option  The room accomodions where out of this world  the executive lounge quality and service are the best I ve ever experienced in all my previous travelling  We regret not staying longer Very special thanks to Anne and Anna at the Executive Lounge for their unique service and attention during our stay

Wonderful building which is furnished in a traditional style with some beautiful Chinese pieces which give the hotel that proper  quot Singapore ambience quot  We stayed three nights in a club room  which  as other reviewers have stated  is a great deal Fabulous bedroom and access to the club lounge with cocktails drinks and enough food to skip dinner if you so wish  although dining out in Singapore is such a great experience we only had a couple of glasses of wine and a couple of cocktails  Even so  the service in the club lounge was so good that it really felt like a truly special place to spend any time We took our nephew for a buffet lunch one day in the ground floor restaurant and I must say the quality and the quantity of the food was terrific  Anyway  enough superlatives for one review Its a great hotel   book it  And if you re thinking of booking a standard room   think again and go for the club room Room Tip  Club room on a high foor See more room tips

We have just spent a week of pure R amp R at the Intercontinental Singapore  We booked a Club Shophouse Room which was quitely located within the Hotel complex  The room was very spacious with large plantation shutters overlooking nearby Bridge Street  The only small deficiency we felt was that the bedroom TV was not wired for movie viewing on that one night we planned an early night in  This Hotel is a very special treat with genuine caring service delivered impecably by staff clearly devoted to what they do  The ambience of the public areas is amazing with a great number of outstanding flower arrangements and clever proxemics  The Club Lounge was consistently top class in terms of service  the food and beverages  This Hotel is only couple of minutes walk from Bugis MRT and has a very pleasant air conditioned shopping mall right beside the Hotel  This is our second stay here and we look forward to coming back again

The Intercontinental in Singapore was built in a much older era and today it maintains many of those older features while offering comfort  convenience and helpful staff We stayed in one of the  quot shophouse quot  apartments which while small was beautifully appointed and looked out onto the street  which has now been roofed and converted to a cafe   The windows still retain the wooden shutters We have stayed at a number of Intercontinents recently and while Singapore offers the Intercontinental  quot service quot  it is not as good as the Hong Kong Intercontinental  Suggestion  If you are coming to Singapore  make sure you visit the Marina Bay Sands resort and Shoppes at Marina Bay Sands   an absolutely amazing experience

First thing about this hotel is it s location   you can access majority of tourist attractions by foot  for the distant ones  you can use a subway   Raffles Place   Bugis   Esplanade MRT stations are quite near  Despite the fact  that location is central  hotel is surprisingly quiet  Secondly  hotel interiors look quite unusual  compared with other Intercontinental properties   they re made in colonial style with nice peranakan touches  paintings  patterns  etc    Service is on the highest level  as one would expect from Interconti    hotel staff is always there to assist you  There s a few restaurants bars inside the hotel  but there s nothing outstanding about them  in my humble opinion    especially  keeping in mind  that there are a lot of fancy places in a walking distance  including Raffles Long Bar  Salt Tapas  amp  Bar etc    The only negative thing   is a paid internet  Despite the fact that I m a plat  ambassador  no free internet was offered  as staff explained  internet is free for ambassadors  when room is booked using  quot Best Flexible Rate quot  option  otherwise  you would have to pay up to whopping 35 SGD per day   Tip for travelers   although there s no free dedicated shuttle bus from   to the airport  you can use airport shuttle bus service  which is very cheap and can bring you to the destination just in 20 minutes Room Tip  There  39 s a number of rooms  located on a second floor  with their windows facing shopping area   See more room tips

I am a resident of Singapore and constantly go to the restaurant olive tree at intercontinental to buy cakes and pastries  I have to say the cakes and pastries are of top quality and that is why i visit there often  During my visit today as I have done several times in the past asked for black forest cakeas my kids and some friends I was visiting love that cake  I just casually asked if any of them contain alcohol knowing well that most of the cakes unless stated will not contain alcohol  I was shocked when the person at the counter and the chef later corroborated that the black forest cake contains alcohol  I was very disturbed as unknowingly I was feeding my children in the past cakes containing alcohol  I complained and I thought I was heard  I was assured of action but I am shocked at the fact that cakes are sold which contains alcoholl  I have seen many kids eat those cakes at the restaurant   my kids being one of them I hope intercontinental will learn something from this and take appropriate action  I give them a 1 rating for the thoughtlessness and recklessness exhibited

Amazing service  Traveling overseas with a 8 5 month old baby is a daunting and stressful exercise  but the staff made our stay not only a pleasure  but a breeze  No request was attended with anything less than complete dedication and the need to please  The staff at the lobby lounge were amazing and entertained our baby so hubby and I could enjoy a drink  Room service were respectful of the need to move silently  so as to not wake our baby  and the setup and food served were fabulous  No matter how many spoons our baby dropped on the floor at breakfast each morning  each was replaced swiftly and with a smile despite the fact that we expressed it was unnecessary  It is a quiet hotel  and the lift are fast but don t make you feel like you ve moved more than a floor  The location is perfect  shopping centre and lanes just down stairs  and the MRT is in the basement of the shopping centre  Where else do all the staff wear Burberry and babies get a tiny feather down doona  amp  pillow  Just gorgeous  We will never stay anywhere else

Perfectly located in the center of town  especially if you like walking  it s about 20 30 minutes to most things   Orchard Road  Little India  the riverfront  Chinatown  Nice  clean   quot rooftop quot  pool  Staff friendly and helpful  especially Peter  the Lobby Ambassador  But they don t have free wifi access in the lobby and pool areas  Charge me  12 for a cup of coffee and  50 for breakfast  i get that  but then make me pay to sit in your lobby and do my work  that s petty  That one small aspect is important to me as a business traveller and will probably influence my decision next time

I booked seven nights for myself and my young daughter  It is centrally located a with many attractions within walking distance The concierge are endlessly attentive and special mention should go to Peter who lives and breathes customer service nothing is too much trouble The rooms a clean and well appointed   housekeeping prompt and efficient The buffet breakfast is plentiful with both western and eastern selections  The lounge menu is slightly overpriced as is the very fancy Chinese restaurant onsite  There is also a privately owned JApanese restaurant on site which is very expensive The pool is not large but more than adequate with a ver pleasant aspect and attentive pool bar service at times It is a graceful and peaceful hotel with beautiful interiors and the inclusion of the traditional shophouses transports you to another time The Inhouse Internet is ridiculously expensive so look for a deal with it included in the room price Ther are malls just outside the hotel which provide excellent access to hawker style food and restaurants

Singapore is always the most relaxing of my business destinations and Intercontinental at Singapore only reinforces this  On business  I checked into this rather colonial style landmark building in the downtown Bugis for couple of days and was pleasantly surprised with the British style room and very calm surrounds  The hotel leads itself into a mall and it s coffee shop also provides an entry from the pavement market  The coffee shop does provide a wholesome breakfast but vegetarians have limited options  The food options are not very much for vegetarian Indians but perhaps sufficient for a global traveler  The good part is that it is near to the Little India which provides whole lot of options  The hospitality as always is impeccable with the Intercontinental Group Room Tip  Always try the new block See more room tips

I stayed here from the 2nd to 5th July  I caught the MRT there and it was an easy short walk from the Bugis station  I checked in on my birthday and was delighted to be treated to a delicious birthday cake later that evening  I stayed in a deluxe room on the 8th floor  Some of the furnishings were looking a bit  tired   but the bathroom and bed were excellent  The staff were professional and unobtrusive  The location was good   it was within walking distance of several attractions  including Raffles Hotel and the Singapore Flyer

My wife and I decided to go see the most modern city in south east asia  We chose the interconintinental based on other trip advisor reviews  The service is amazing  Our check in was smooth and we had no problems checking in at 12 30pm  We were offered free wifi  two free piece of laundry per day  news paper and our choices of luxury pillows and blankets  We stayed in the older room which is showing its age  But the room is very clean and it s spacious  The breakfast had good quality food and tasty entres covering the four ethnic groups that populate singapore  My favorite was the smoke salmon and fresh fruit juices  In the evening their is a pianist in the lounge who is quite good  The hotel is located a few steps to the tour bus stop  restaurants  subway train MRT  and shopping   It s adjacent  connected  to the Bugis mall  which we found very handy  Good shopping and large selection of restaurants in this mall  And the layout of the mall is modern  We never used the pool  We thought it was a little cold  There appeared to be smaller tubs in the pool area which were also cold  We were hoping those were hot tubs We would like to give this hotel a five but the rooms are a little dated  it could use a handful more food entres in the breakfast buffet and the pool was to cold for our liking  4out of 5  We would stay here again because of the quality of food  service and location Been to Singapore Trivibe

Purpose of our 3 night visit was as a stopover to refresh our memories of Singapore  Arrival at the hotel is nothing exceptional  despite handing over our passports the receptionist assured us we were another couple    walking to our shophouse room was like walking through a rabbit warren  The hallways were quite shabby and in need of updating  Our room was very nice  but we did find that servicing of the room  especially the bathroom  was not always thorough The main restaurant was good for breakfast  but not exceptional  I was initially excited by the juice bar  but taking half an hour to deliver such juice made it too difficult to bother  We found the service to vary from very bad to excellent The club lounge was manned by very helpful and professional staff  Cocktail time was very good  but you do need to arrive early to get a table  Drinks included several cocktails including Singapore Slings and Aussie Domain Chandon sparkling  The afternoon tea wasn t worth rushing back for The nearby location of Bugis St MTR station was really useful for getting around for shopping  amp  sightseeing  and purchasing a 3 day tourist travel card was cheap and efficient Would I stay at this property again   Probably not  It was good for what we wanted to do  but if there s a next time it would probably be somewhere like the Mandarin or Fullerton Bay Room Tip  Apparently the Shophouse rooms are the most recently renovated   great decor See more room tips

I stayed here whilst on a business trip for 2 days booking through the hotel website 2 days before arrival  I stayed in the first floor colonial section of the hotel rather than in the more modern tower  The hotel check in was good and the receptionist showed me to the room  The lobby and common areas were very nice  the main lobby area has very high ceilings which makes it look quite grand  The room itself was large and the room again had nice colonial touches with wooden shutters on the windows and the bathroom with classic fittings  The colonial section I stayed in was not accessible by lift but by a staircase from the main lobby so people with mobility problems may be limited to the modern sections Breakfast was served in the caf?  off the main lobby area with the usual extensive buffet selection  The breakfast was not included in the room rate nor was internet ?  there was an offer for both at S 50 per day  It was cheaper to use the data roaming on my mobile  The hotel is in a good location next to the Bugis MRT and also adjoining Bugis Junction with plenty of food options outside the hotel  Chjmes is a short walk away  There¡¯s a 7 eleven across the road where you can purchase sim cards for your phone  you need to take your passport  On the day of check out I had meetings but was able to use the shower in the fitness centre before leaving for the airport  The concierge also helped me to arrange collection of photos from a nearby photo printing shop  In summary  good service  nice hotel  good location ? but at an average of SGD380 per night is not a cheap option  However  compared to our previous hotel stay in Novotel Clarke Quay   average rate SGD338  it¡¯s better to pay a little extra for the better environment

Top service from the moment we arrived  Excellent luggage service  great check in experience at the club lounge  We were upgraded to a Shop House room  Large TV  DVD Player  free wifi and broadband  separate bath and shower  Complimentary bottled water  newspaper and fruit selection  A real king bed   not dodgey zipped together singles  Quality Elemis bathroom products and nice large fluffy bathsheets  amp  robes Excellent location  impeccably clean and quiet Decent range of cocktails wines and beers and great food served during the cocktail hour in the club lounge  Its the staff that really make this place what it is  Very freindly  knowledgeable but not in your face  Nothing is too much trouble or in the too hard basket I have stayed here previously and will be staying here again Room Tip  We have never had a bad room See more room tips

I was on a official trip for 3nights  this one was on our approved hotel list  the place is close to a metro  bugis junction   even if you reach early  we reached 830am local time  they are kind enough to make a room available so that you can freshen up  the rooms are nice and simple  The gymn has a large area but the equipments appear somewhat old  While I did not use the pool  a colleague did use said that it was too small  perhaps good enough to be classified only a child s pool back home in India the place also has starbucks  24 hour one  and a McD close by  but other than that hardly any veg place nearby  and post 1030am it could be difficult to find food  thats when i got lucky  the staff got me a custom veg pizza done for me and I had it there relaxing in the lobby with live piano playing on  that was one of he good memory there the staff and service is good

Stayed in the Intercontinental Singapore for a week on business and it was a relatively comfortable experience  First on the hotel  the Peranakan decos is a true experience for a culture that s only unique to Singapore and Malaysia  The main entrance is well hidden  but any taxi driver in Singapore should know how to get to the hotel  The basic rooms are a little simple  but your bathroom will include both a shower and a tub  Fair decent number of cable channels for your pleasure  in house gym is 24 hours open  and accessible only with the room key card during odd hours at night  Food wise  there are quite a number of choices  from room service  bar  lounge  cafe  chinese and japanse outlets  What surprises me was the lack of peranankan cuisine  which is the sole vital point that the hotel sells itself  If hotel food is becoming a turn off  just walk over to the connected shopping mall Bugis Junction where there are plenty of food choices  grcocers  etc  If restaurant food is still a turn off  walk across the street for a local coffeehouse meal and drinks  at much discounted price Location wise  it is conveniently located off the business district  If you are going into the business district in the morning  forget the car or taxi as the morning trafiic will mean longer travelling time  Just walk out of the hotel  into the shopping mall  and you will find the underground  which is so well connected to the underground in the business district  Getting into the business district is just a matter of less than 15 minutes All in all  the Intercontinental Singapore is a good choice and well connected to public transport and highways  My main complaint is that the the food  especially breakfast at the hotel cafe was quite a disappointment  as it looks surprising boring and is just like another hotel buffet breakfast  Personal preferences meant I would instead grab a few freshly baked croissants from the bakery on the go in the connected shopping mall while making my way to the underground in the morning Room Tip  To to ask for higher floors where you can see activities outside  Lower floors might mean your windo   See more room tips

I have stayed in this hotel many times  currently staying there now  it still has great service  location  rooms  a certain elegance etc  However  it s room service food is suddenly abysmal  After arriving from a long flight I ordered some items from the menu  they arrived within 10 minutes  That was when I knew it wouldnt be good and sure enough  it was by far the worst room service quality food I have ever experiEnced in years of travelling  The next afternoon I had a late lunch in their Olive Tree restaurant  This used to be great but the Club Sandwich I ordered was putrid  plastic chicken  reheated bacon  listless  wilting and tasteless salad I ordered room service from their Man Fu Yuan restaurant and I can honestly say that the braised beef brisket is the worst thing I have been served in any establishment in years  All fat and grizzle Their entertainment system is a joke  Firstly  there is no guide in the room to let you know how to operate the thing  for which you need two remote controls  Unlike any other 5 star hotel I have stayed at anywhere in the world  When you eventually find your way in  expecting as the in room guide says to  preview recently released movies  there is nothing of the sort  The movie prieviewing was Mission Impossible 1  The list of  recently released movies  is completely misleading  What 5 star hotel has literally no recent movies to watch   and I mean nothing from the past 5 years  Shamefully misleading  I have stayed in this hotel about 10 times  as it has always been great but  something has gone very wrong

My daughter and I were so very lucky to be ungraded to the Shophouse room and were pleasantly suprised with all the benefits to had to offer  The room was very comfortable and the beds and the pillows were amazing  we actually bought a pillow each   All the staff were extremely friendly and couldn t do enough for you  They concierge desk was so very approachable and fully explained where all tourist spots were  as the location of this wonderful hotel in only half an hour away from most  The hotel is apart of an air conditioned shopping centre and across the road from the market  As for the food the hotel itself has the best buffet breakfast I have ever seen  ours was included in our room   Chef s making your omelette to order and any other egg dishes you desire  Five star food all the way  The free afternoon tea  included in our room  was also great  The evening buffet was again out of this world  Fresh seafood in abundance  from prawns to crayfish to oysters to crab claws the list goes on  A choice of western and local food is also top quality  Don t get me started on the desserts yum        In conclusion I would highly recommend this hotel not only for it s location or food but for the staff and how helpful and very friendly they are  Management should be very proud of their staff Room Tip  If you can afford the upgrade to any of the other rooms do so as breakfast and afternoon tea is incl   See more room tips

My husband and I stayed here with our 8 month old baby for 8 nights in a Shophouse room  We checked in at 11 30pm and were greated warmly  our taxi door was opened and our luggage carried inside for us  Check in was a breeze  We were escorted through the hotel to our room so we knew which lift to use and where to go  Our luggage arrived to our room only two minutes later which was excellent so we could get the baby to bed quickly  We had breakfast in the Olive Tree every morning which had a wide variety of food to suit different nationalities  Eggs were cooked by the chef on request so they are done just the way you want  On weekends when it is busy they set up a second breakfast area with chef in The Lounge which is fantastic as you can have a very comfortable seat and people watch while you eat breakfast  The staff are always checking to make sure you have everything you need and make you your coffee on request just the way you like it  When walking around the hotel you are always greeted formally by staff and with a naturally warm smile and the concierge knows everything there is to know about everything  The foyer has a stand with an array of tourist brochures and maps so you are never short of something to do  Our room was very comfortable and the bathroom was very large   It took us 3 minutes to walk from the foyer to our room and we found it very easy to navigate  Our room was quiet and the curtains were excellent at keeping the light out  Alternatively you could open the shutters completely and watch the world go by outside  The Club Lounge was excellent and is at its quietest at midday  on numerous occasions we were the only ones in there  and at its busiest during cocktail hour  The staff were all very polite and helpful and the drinks and food during cocktail hour were amazing with a mouth watering selection to choose from  There are two computers available for your use  alternatively you can log in to their network  the details of which are sitting on each of the club lounge tables  The hotel is within walking distance to many attractions  It is also connected to the Bugis St shopping mall which is huge and has hundreds of major retail brands  pharmacies  restuarants  a supermarket and a brilliant food court Tips  1  Dont get a private car from the airport the taxi rank outside is well organised and quick and it only costs about  20sg to get to the hotel  We fitted our two massive suitcases a pram and a baby cot as well as our onflight bags and us in easily 2  Taxis are everywhere and easy to hail  The hotel can easily hail one for you and you never have to wait more than a minute before one arrives  Just make sure you give the street name to the taxi driver as well as the destination as they go by street name  3  Taxis are very very cheap  We used them all the time as we could travel to all our destinations for around  5sg  4  If you have kids you can buy all your nappies  baby food  bottles  formula  baby wipes ect from the Cold Storage under the hotel in Bugis St  prices are the same  A note to the hotel manager  Please place a ramp to one side of the stairs leading to the club lounge and the shophouse rooms  We noticed that there were a few families with prams staying in the shophouse rooms who would greatly benefit from this and unless my husband and I were together we could not get a sleeping baby up and down the stairs on our own which makes it impossible if I wanted to take the baby back to the room on my own for a sleep A special thank you to all the staff in The Lounge and specifically Meldryne in the Club Lounge who entertained our baby on quite a few occassions so we could have a few minutes to enjoy our drink in peace  you are all great assets to the hotel

This place is worth the money  It is attached to a mall  is very central and the service is great  The room was comfortable and looked well cared for  i felt safe there and it was close to transportation  The best part is the staff  I would stay here again just based on that  They were helpful and personable  Staff here if you get a chance  the place is good  I don t think you ll be disappointed

Location is fantastic with Bugis Junction MRT station just downstairs along with all sorts of shops  supermarkets and department stores The staff in this property have always been extremely welcoming and the concierge on my last stay was very accommodating in arranging tickets for Universal Studios over on Sentosa The rooms have always been clean and comfortable  and the breakfast buffet downstairs is one of the most superior I have seen in any Intercontinental Hotel If you are looking for a good location  reasonable price  and friendly staff this property is worth checking out Room Tip  Shop House Suites are nice  however can be a little bit noisey with the traffic due to the proximity   See more room tips

Stayed in a shophouse room which had been renovated Some parts of the hotel were old and looked it The room had an excellent bathroom and a large flat screen tv No instructions were left on how to use tv or music system The louvres on the windows tended to make the room too dark The Hotel was like a maze yet no map was given to find your way back The club lounge was nicely done but to our taste extremely cold Too cold to enjoy evening drinks some nights Food selection for afternoon tea in the lounge was poor Although a non smoker I like the odd cigar on holiday I was amazed to learn there was no garden area for smokers Guest had to leave the Hotel and smoke on the roadside I cant imagine a cigarette smoker wanting to stay here Either way it should be clearly stated on their website that this is theirs or Government policy We found breakfast reasonable but choice not great The pool area was nice but the lounger covers were dirty with no one on duty but a bell to ring The hotel is still a taxi journey to most areas like the Marina and taxis are not cheap There is however an MRT station not too far away Although my wife is a Gold Ambassador with the Intercontinental we would not stay here again The Hotel in many parts is only 3 star Room Tip  Make sure its renovatedSee more room tips

I came here first a few times  perhaps 8 years ago  Now I visited in June 2012 and this place is getting a bit dated My room could have done with new paint job  so many areas with specks of paint missing  There was a pillar in the room which looked as though a child had drawn all over it with pen  Seriously   is this meant to be 5 star  Clean it up please The lobby is the best thing here  Lovely atmosphere just sitting down there with a beer and some nuts    i could sit there all day   The concierge wasn t great either  I asked him to book me a meal at a restaurant  just as we were going out for the day  He said he would and would leave a note in the hotel room  We got back  no note  So we just went to the restaurant    unfortunately we couldn t find it at Chijmes   We think the restaurant must have closed down in the 8 years since I was last there     then why didn t the concierge tell us he couldn t book it instead of leaving us wandering around like idiots for half an hour  Rubbish For that  and the lack of paint   2 stars from me

Hotel is located next to Bugis Junction shopping complex This Singapore hotel  served by an efficient subway MRT  is also located close to the Central Business District  Suntec Singapore International Convention  amp  Exhibition Centre  Marina Bay  Orchard Road shopping and entertainment district as well as the Chinatown Heritage Centre  The Sentosa Island resort is only a short 10 minutes drive away  Olive Tree restaurant  the all day dining restaurant features an extensive buffet of international delights and a delectable ala carte menu  Located at the lobby level Hotel has modern amenities for comfort and convenienceRoom Tip  INSIDER EXPERIENCES AND PRACTICAL VALUE  special offers include the elements you need to get the mo   See more room tips

I have stayed here several times principally for business  The public areas have a very colonial feel perhaps in the same theme as the famed Raffles and Fullerton hotels  The hotel  like most hotels within a stones throw or Orchard Road  is located close to the Marina  shops and Bugis station The breakfast here is adequate but less impressive than other hotels in Singapore like the Pan Pacific  Regent  Holiday inn etc

Being a PG Platinum Member  we usually stay at IC Hotels all over the world  This was our first time at the InterCon Singapore  It was a great stay  from the moment I arrived and being acknowledged as a PG Member  until the moment that I left  all was good  To mention a few things  the friendliness of the staff  the SUPERB breakfast buffet with the to die for mini almond croissants  wow  we loved them so much we could not stop eating them    We were there  me and my colleagues  in a week where there was a special dinner Seafood Buffet  You should have seen what gorgeous foods they had lined up  simply divine  really the hotel went out of their way to present the best of the best Seafoods I ever ate  Chech out those if I remember correctly to be australian lobsters  not sure   but every thing on the buffet was superb quality  fresh and very very tasty   Try it next opportunity you get  My room  or should I call it suite  was fantastic  slept very very well  It is nice after a days hard work  to being able to relax in your room and have a good nights rest before the following day starts InterCon Singapore  we ll  all  be back soon for our next Fair  Thanks for a great stay

Stayed here for a few nights this Spring  Location is perfect for business in city center  It s a hike to the airport  especially considering the traffic  Staff was friendly and spoke English very well  Concierge recommendations were also very helpful  Lobby and common areas of the hotel were tastefully done  The air conditioning was sporadic in the hallways and with the size of the hotel  it was easy to work up a sweat due to Singapore s climate  The room was spacious and ever square inch of the bathroom was marble This is one of the nicest Intercons I ve had the pleasure of visiting  Highly recommended The buffet breakfast is a must   don t let the high price scare you  it s amazing food  For Singaporean cuisine  skip the downtown area   go down to the UDMC Seafood Centre for some chili crab

Our group consisted 2 families with children ranging from 4 to 9 years of age This hotel embeds European Flair It gives a feeling of quaintness and exclusivity Beds are comfy and baths spacious  No problems with the wifi either  The toiletries luxurious  There is not much choice for breakfast but the quality is good  The decor is tastefully done Location convenient  It s adjacent to the malls which makes food hunting very easy especially with kids and at the end of a long day when feet are tired  Will definitely stay here again

I love this hotel  this is the 2nd time I stayed there  it is a near the cbd area  easy access to swissotel and raffless area  the twin sharing room can fit for 3 4 pax together  and very comforable pillows and bedcover the cleanliness is amazing  i just love the white classic nostalgic interior  always bring a rendevous feeling  the location is spot on  connecting door to bugis junction  my favorite place to eat and shop  my family can enjoy nasi padang at lower level foodcourt or swensen at ground floor  all halal   and of course for shopping  the bugis market only across the road where you can buy fashion  souvenir at cheap price  a must visit location when you are in singapore  back to intercontinental the staff is very helpful and provide you with excellent service

I booked the room directly with the hotel and accepted their offer to join the Ambassador Club for an additional USD 200  mostly because they guarantee a room upgrade and a 4pm late check out which fit perfectly with our travel plans  In addition it also meant that we would get a complimentary internet connection From the very friendly and courteous welcome right through to our check out the staff made us welcome  The check in process was quickly completed and the desk clerk actually followed us all the way to our room  no  232   which turned out to be a good thing as it was located quite some distance away from the lobby and would have been hard to find without someone to show us the way  The porters had taken care of our luggage on arrival and it arrived at our room a few minutes after we got there  And the cot we had requested was also delivered soon after we arrived The room was quite large and was quite nicely decorated  The king size bed was excellent  and unlike at some other hotels it actually felt like a king size bed  There was also a desk  a large flat screen TV with a good selection of channels  a safe  a DVD player and a Bose stereo  a small cupboard with a mini bar and a small sofa  There were also a couple of quite comfortable slippers and dressing gowns  The floor was wooden but the bed was placed on a large carpet  And the only issue with the room was quite a few scratches on the floor just in front of the sofa The bathroom was also quite large and comfortable with two sinks  a toilet  a large bathtub and a spacious shower cubicle The Intercontinental wasn¡¯t our first choice of hotel and we ended up booking a room there as there were no rooms available at the other hotels we were looking at  But it turned out to be a really good choice for our short visit to Singapore  Its central location meant that we were within walking distance of many city centre attractions  The breakfast was good  and the service both there and in the lobby bar was good

Historically I have more or less stayed at the Grand Hyatt when I visit Singapore  but this time I decided to try the Intercon as I had never stayed there  and I am glad to say that I made this choice I had booked a club room which is part of renovated  quot shop houses quot  and while you do not really appreciate this  what is good is that the rooms are on the lower levels  as is the club lounge  2nd floor  The room is well designed with iPhone iPod charging point  and sufficient media facilities if you need to be entertained indoors should the weather change suddenly or while you wait for that sudden short shower of rain to disappear One thing to note is that the reading light switch on the left hand side of the bed operates the right hand light and vice versa  something that I only discovered on the second day after sleeping with the light on all night after a bit of investigation The staff are extremely helpful with one lady showing me the  quot short cut quot  between the lounge and the room  Breakfast  high tea and evening cocktails were excellent during my 4 day stay  and lots of interesting parts of Singapore very accessible by walking as the hotel is very centrally located  Orchard Road is not too far away  best to use a taxi or MRT  but where I wanted to go was no more than a 15 minute walk in any direction  Funan center  Sim Lim Square   Very convenient is the Bugis shopping center area which is connected to the hotel itself There is no doubt in my mind where I will be staying on my next visit to SingaporeRoom Tip  Ask for a room with an outside view as some of the shophouses face a wall about 4 meters away See more room tips

Stayed here with the family  2 adults and 2 small children  for a long weekend  We were given a room upgrade on check in  A decent buffet breakfast was included in the price of the room The location of the hotel is outstanding  The Bugis mall is right next door for some decent mall shopping  while many other destinations are easily accessible by walking  MRT  or taxi  While we were there  we hit Universal Studios  the Zoo  and the new Gardens by the Bay  all were easily accessible  We didn t eat at the hotel except for breakfast  as there are too many great places to eat in Singapore that we wanted to hit  We were tempted by the high tea that was complemented by the British colonial ambience of the hotel lobby and adjacent areas Parking was free for one entry per day in the garage which is shared with the mall  We were upgraded to a suite and which offered plenty of space  The furnishings were decent and we had no issues with the room  The service was outstanding as the check in process could not have gone more smoothly and we felt welcomed by the staff throughout our stay
