I have stayed at the Intercontinental Singapore a few times with my most recent stay in July 2012  Pros   Excellent location in Bugis Junction  near the MRT  supermarkets  shops  restaurants etc  The direct access to Bugis Junction shopping centre is very useful  Lobby and public areas have lots of character  Facilities  pool  gym  restaurants  are good  Staff and service are generally very professional and competent  The better rooms  eg  the shophouse and club rooms  are spacious and comfortableCons   Cheaper rooms can be a little small  out of date and feel a little tired  My most recent room directly overlooked a corridor which was somewhat unappealing  On my most recent stay  the cleanliness of the bathroom wasn t the best  eg  there were leftover hairs stuck to the side of the shower and on the vanity   Internet costs S 40  per day which is very expensive these days when many most hotels around the world include it for freeOverall this is still a very good hotel and I will most likely return given the positives  but perhaps some of the cheaper rooms could be refurbished

Frankly  my recent stay at this hotel was unsatisfactory  Checkin process was smooth and the room was also clean and comfortable  Most of the Singapore hotels are in good locations and so is this hotel   near to CBD  walking distance from some shopping malls streets The issues I had were mainly with house keeping  Very poor service especially in the evenings   dustbins were not emptied  used towels were not replaced etc  The other main issue was with the service desk phone   most of them did not speak English well and I had to repeat myself a few times to be understood Internet connection was good but the cable jack was broken  I asked for a replacement but did not get one Gym equipment are out dated and maintenance is poor  Also  i didn t see anyone cleaning the same after use Staff were friendly  Breakfast choices were good  Room service menu was I felt kinda limited There is a lot of room for improvement at this hotel

The hotel itself is centrally located in Singapore  close to everything  In fact  it is located in and rises from the shopping mall  The rooms are small er but still quite nice and comfortable  It is  however  a bit pricey for both the room rates and anything else you wish to purchase  The service  though  is very friendly and professional  and the staff try to help guests where possible

Upon our late arrival  we were given an incorrect room key and disturbed a guest  The staff was very apologetic and the remainder of our stay was pleasant  The breakfast had many delicious options and the coffee was exeptional  The staff was very accommodating as we planned for a midnight departure  by allowing us to store our bags as well as use the gym shower facilities before departing  The location is excellent for both shopping and sightseeing

This is a wonderful hotel  and the best I ve stayed at in Singapore  The staff could not be more helpful and are pleasant without being over the top  The food and restaurant is excellent and breakfast is fantastic   a great range of fresh and healthy food to meet all tastes  The hotel is very centrally located and close to everything  All round 5 out of 5

I use to stay near or on Orchard road but since June of 2010  I have stayed in this hotel every time with my family or by myself if need be  I love the location near restaurants from   to       near a church  MTR  Supermarket  bus line  shops from no brands to brand names and drinking places  My only problem this time is the bed cushions it is too soft for my taste  I thought of asking them to change but I did not bother anymore Either for business or pleasure this is my home in Singapore  period

Our stay at the Intercontinental Singapore has surpassed all expectations  We would not hesitate to recommend the hotel for it s friendly and professional service  location and value for money  We stayed in a shophouse club room which we would highly recommend for value and also for the personal service that you receive  The staff have gone above and beyond to ensure we had a most memorable holiday experience  The location is ideal being right next door to Bugis junction markets and the architecture of the hotel and surrounds adds to the experience and enjoyment of the Singapore culture  Everything was first class and we look forward to our next visit Room Tip  Shophouse club rooms large and newly renovatedSee more room tips

My husband and I stayed at this hotel for one night in July 2012  It s a old  historic building located close to shopping and restaurants  which was great  It s a gorgeous property  We stayed in a Club Level room  which was also beautiful and very private  These rooms look almost like individual cottages that are tucked away on the side of the hotel and overlook the busy street below  The Club Level was slightly disappointing  There was only a small variety of food and drinks available  and alcohol was served for only a couple hours in the evening  I was very surprised to find that I couldn t order a beer in the afternoon  even when I offered to bill it to my room  Considering the cost of some of the refreshments offered during the day  it would seem to be wise to offer beer and wine as well  At the cocktail hour I ordered a glass of wine before remembering that I needed to make a phone call to my daughter back home  I went to leave the lounge with my glass of wine and was told that I could not do that  My room was a good five minute walk from the lounge  and I knew that my call would take some time  The woman was very stern about the rules and only after I became a little upset did she finally allow me to take my glass of wine with me  I found that to be rude and unaccommodating  In addition to that  I counted seven children under the age of 14 in the Club Lounge  along with several other teenage children  I personally do not wish to be around children when I travel  so I was not terribly happy with this either  My mindset with the Club Level Lounge is that this is a place for business travelers and people who want some extra peace and quiet when traveling  Overall  I was disappointed with the Club Level  but the rest of the staff  rooms  amenities  etc  were all fantastic  I d like to give the hotel another try because it has a great location and is such a beautiful property  but I doubt I ll do the Club Level there again

I was amazed by the hotel room especially the bathroom  amp  the toiletories are good to use  The bathtub is big  deep  amp  definitely my baby boy s beloved  The bed is soft  amp  comfortable but it is not my cup of tea as it is too soft  Overall  the room is big but the TV is the eye sore of all   too small  Front desk  amp  concierge are helpful  amp  friendly  amp  surely up to 5  international hotel standard  The hotel location is good as it s connected to Bugis Junction which full of eateries  amp  shopping outlets  Needless to say but it is walking distance to MRT station Room Tip  Try to ask for a corner  amp  higher floor  bigger  amp  nicer view See more room tips

This is the second time we have stayed here and we will certainly be back As my wife is a member of the Ambassador Club  our check in was in the Club Lounge where the staff are friendly  professional and a delight to talk to  From my passport it was noted that I had a birthday while we were staying and we mentioned we also had our wedding anniversary to celebrate as well We were upgraded from the shophouse room we had booked to one of the shophouse suites which was sheer luxury  Apart from the other benefits  fresh fruit was supplied each day  Everything was spotlessly clean and the bath towels were big  white and fluffy  They were also changed morning and night if they had been used which they tended to be when we had been out sight seeing in the humid climate of Singapore  Staff in the lounge presented us with a plate of chocolate strawberries and hand made chocolates on our anniversary  while on my birthday four of the staff presented me with a lovely chocolate cake and sang happy birthday to me   very touching  To top it off  when we got back to our suite there were heart shaped jam tarts  more chocolate and a good bottle of Shiraz waiting for us The hotel has old world charm and is situated in the Bugis centre so it is close to shops  buses and trains  Taxis are easy to catch at the hotel and are reasonably priced In all areas of the hotel the staff are courteous and helpful  they would have to be one of the hotels greatest assets Room Tip  Pay the extra cost to have access to the Club Lounge as you can have breakfast there  drinks are ava   See more room tips

I have stayed at the Intercontinental several times and it never disappoints  We were upgraded to a Club Room which was very nice and the Club facilities are second to none  Mr Raj in the club lounge looked after us like family  The room was spacious as was the bathroom with separate shower and bath  Nice toiletries and plenty of counter space for everything  Lovely thick towels and plenty of them  Really really clean even in the corners  Housekeeping was excellent  Tea and coffee supplied  Plenty of wardrobe space with lots of hangers and a big safe  Breakfast was supurb   plenty of nice fruit   which was different every day  This hotel is right next to Bugis MRT station so is really easy to get to from the airport  It is also right in the middle of all the shopping you could possibly want  Would recommend a trip on the Singapore Flyer   terrific view Mr Hock Kim on the concierge desk was so helpful in tracking down some miniatures we wanted  he really went out of his way and we were most grateful  Would never hesitate in recommending this hotel and will definitely stay here again when in Singapore

I had my birthday party in one of the suites in Intercontinental Bugis  was quite pleased with the service and the extra touch the hotel put in   a free 1kg cake delivered by the manager herself and despite hotel rules that no more than 4 adults in the room  I have a party of over 20 people  and yet still get the best service Room Tip  You might want a suite   See more room tips

Stayed for 7 days in July  and enjoyed it immensely  Arrived after early morning flight  but no problems checking in early  Upgraded to shophouse room which was very pleasant  The hotel is decorated throughout with peranaken objects which provides quite a beautiful and luxurious setting  The club lounge provides a quieter lounge setting for that break from the outside  and away from the larger numbers at breakfast  Staff were excellent  helpful and friendly  Location is great   Little India and the arab quarter are both walkable  and transport buses and trains are easy to get  Thoroughly recommended

Stayed for 2 nights in May  emailed reservations department prior to arrival mentioning about Wife s Birthday  and were we wowed by their efforts They offered us a massive Penthouse suite for an additional upgrade fee and can i say that the room was enormous  It had the high ceilings and was on the 2nd highest floor  Room was immaculate and clean and we were given Club Benefits as well which had the Breakfast and Pre dinner Snacks and Drinks included Wife was bowled over when the Club Lounge ladies greeted us in our suite with a birthday cake singing her  happy birthday  and giving her a small gift  Outdoor pool was large and had the cabana which we made use of fully by enjoying the afternoon sun Hotel is right within in the Bugis shopping district which meant that you could stay cool as the shopping centre is all sheltered and you do not need to step outside in the humidity Lobby Lounge was great as well if you wanted to have a drink and watch the pianist play tunes on weekends Great hotel with outstanding service  loved the Peranankan  Malay Chinese  influences in the building design

Booked this hotel during a Priority Plus promotion got a very good rate  had read a number of good reviews though there were a few negative reviews Arrived at 00 30 in the morning after out flight from Bangkok  really not sure what to expect at that hour  as out taxi pulled up the bell boy ran out and collected our bags  welcomed by a very pleasant guy at reception and the check in process was quick and efficient Shown to the lift and was advised that we needed to use our key card to activate the lift to our room on the seventh floor  We had only booked the standard deluxe room  but as regular visitors to Singapore this was probably the nicest room we have ever stayed in Room spotlessly clean  very comfortable bed  room a good size and nice bathroom Room rate included breakfast  the breakfast buffet was of a high quality and a good variety  Restaurant staff all very friendly and efficient  I noticed one guest ordering his eggs with a rude and aggressive manner  his egg order was delivered with a smile  why do some people treat staff like that Didn t eat in the restaurants apart from breakfast  but we did enjoy a nightcap in the very pleasant Victoria Bar Hotel was probably the best we have stayed in in Singapore and an excellent location  we will definitely stay there again Thanks very much to all the staff for making our short stay so enjoyable  in a

We stayed in a deluxe room   and it was very spacious  However  upon settling down  I noticed that the room was quite tired  There were a few stains on the headboard and on the wall  it wasn t very visible and wasn t much of a bother as the beds were clean and comfortable  They also provide a pillow menu   which was helpful as I wasn t a fan of the pillow that was provided in my room  Bathroom was spacious and elemis toiletries were provided Service was very professional and prompt  requests were often fulfilled within a short period of time  The location was definitely one of the selling points  providing access to the mall next to it  and the area itself is surrounded by lots of eateries and shops  Breakfast was included in our rate  The spread was very generous with choices between local and continental breakfast  The variety was good and personally me and my mum were very impressed  Service can be a bit slow when it is packed but most of the time it s okay  It d be great if the hotel can give the tired rooms a bit of a lift as I don t think customers would be impressed paying the full rate  Definitely considering coming back to this hotel the next time I m in Singapore

Based on a friends recommendation  I stayed at the Intercontinental Singapore and as I make monthly trips to Singapore decided to join their loyalty program  Ambassador Club  US  200   For this healthy fee I¡¯m supposed to get guaranteed room upgrades  late check out  and free fruit oh joy  Well I didn¡¯t get upgraded and got their very sta

We stayed at the InterContinental twice  First on the way to Europe from Australia for one night and on the way back for two nights  On our first visit  we stayed in a Shopfront Club room  which was a colonial refurbished room  looking onto the shopping arcade  It was beautifully quiet and very spacious  We were travelling with our 3 year old  so the 2 x Queen beds were perfect  yes  I got to sleep with the restless toddler   The room had a lounge you could sit in  large flat screen tv and a fantastic bathroom  We arrived late at night an upon check in got this room on a deal which included wi fi and breakfast  In addition  we had access to the Club Lounge  where food and drinks were served  This was great for a snack mid afternoon  The service was fantastic and I was particularly impressed with how great the staff were keeping my son entertained and interacting with him  We were able to extend our departure time from the room by a few hours  which was very convenient  On our return trip  we again stayed but for 2 nights this time  We had considered upgrading to the Shopfront room again  but it was about double the price of what we had paid previously so booked a standard room  We arrived in Singapore at 5 30am after a night flight from Paris and just wanted to get horizontal into a comfy bed  Although we had booked  we were too early for our standard room  but we were able to go to the pool spa area and rest  sleep  until our room was ready  We got into our room around 10am which was great  Again breakfast was included but unfortunately wi fi wasn t unless we were in the hotel lobby area  Unfortunately  the wi fi did not work  even in the common areas of the hotel so as we had become part of the membership program with the hotel on our outbound trip  we argued that the price of the room should include wi fi  which eventually the staff provided  This was an ongoing discussion over the first day or our stay  As we checked out on day two not long before heading to the airport  we were informed by the person looking after us that we were entitled to a welcome drink as part of our membership  We didn t realise this as we had received no information to explain what our membership provided  It was a shame we hadn t been told about this when we arrived  I ll put this down to a break down in language which was unfortunate  We were able to get a later check out and the facilities at the hotel meant we could hang out around the pool and use the facilities there to shower and prepare for the last leg of our trip  Breakfast was great and generally the service was fantastic  The rooms are fabulous  regardless of new or Shopfront rooms  The location is wonderful  It is walking distance to great shopping and many restaurants  After a day along Orchard Road  it was nice to get back to our hotel and the relative quiet but then to also have the shops and a great department store that the locals frequent just around the corner  Bugis Junction is great for bits and pieces  the MRT is very close and the hop on off bus was just around the corner outside Raffles  This is a great place to stay if you are in Singapore

I have stayed here on business quite a few times and enjoy it so much that I decided to share the expeience with my wife on the way back to London from Perth  WA  As soon as we stepped out of the cab from the airport  the staff couldn t have been more friendly or more helpful  We chose to eat out for the 3 nights we stayed  as there is so much choice in Singapore for eating out   But we did have breakfast and were not disappointed with either the quality or quantity  Will definitely return Room Tip  There are many different rooms to choose from  many with different views  from those that overlook t   See more room tips

Hotel is in a great location  Few mins from MRT and only 30 mins from airport  Check in was easy and fast  room was great  nice amenities throughout the room  walk in shower  bathtub  bathrobe  Buffet breakfast was good  spread was not as grand as some other 5 star hotels but still food was yummy  Concierge was really helpful  more than willing to take an extra step to find what I needed  such as directions  making a reservation for restaurant  etc  Check out was also easy and fast  Overall it was a great stay and I will recomend it to others without hesitation Just one thing  hotel charges 30 SGD per day for internet  if you use for more than 1 hour   so watch out

I really enjoyed my stay at this hotel  The location is excellent  in the heart of Singapore downtown  close to bugis MRT  The room is large and the bed very confortable  wonderfull linen quality   Above all the air con was extremely quiet   quite a rarety even for 5 star hotels  The bathroom was large and proposed both a bath and a shower  Elenis products were provided What I liked best was also the nice colonial atmosphere and the extreme care given to the guests  I received an email before departure from europe to inquire about my flight and they provided me a room at 9 00Am for me  1 hour after arrival  without any charge  Most of all  they really did all their best to answer my request for a quiet room  I want to give a special thanks to the manager on duty on 18 07 evening that provided me a room clearly ready for another customer to ensure I do not suffer from construction noise I thank to team of Intercontinental that help me feel at home for my stay Clearly other 5 stars hotel  Swisxxx  I previously experienced has no such customer focus  no early check in possible  no possibility to change room for lift noise even if you don t sleep

Stayed here at the end of July  Very easy to get to from Changi Airport by MRT  The staff were very helpful and friendly when checking in and the concierge was brilliant when it came to visiting attractions and finding our way to our next hotel  When we enquired about getting to Suntec City to experience the Singapore Duck  the staff even transported us there in the Intercontinental car The rooms were VERY comfortable  to the extent that it was a challenge to get up in the mornings After backpacking for 4 weeks  this was our first hotel room to have a bath aswell as a shower Our room was cleaned very well each day  our tea coffee restocked aswell as our shampoo  conditioner etc The location was perfect  we could see Raffles from our room  We were just a short walk from Suntec City and Bugis and City Hall MRT stations We enjoyed lounging by the pool and spending time in the sauna and jacuzzi  There was no one else using them at this time  which added to our experience We did not have breakfast at the hotel  but there are a range of different small cafes around just a short walk away offering breakfast for around  4

I have stayed here a few times and like this property  Rooms are large and often the rates here are better than other 3 or 4 star Singapore hotels if you book 21 days before via the hotel website  Breakfast reasonable but slightly dissappointed with the pastries which were very average and no where as good as what they sell in the deli  Good professional helpful staff and I will definately keep coming back

My husband and I have just spent 7 nights at the Intercontinental and had a wonderful stay here  We loved our Shophouse room and it was so quiet  we slept very well  We had access to the Club lounge which really added to the stay  It was so nice after a busy day out to come back and relax here with a cocktail or two and some lovely food  All the staff were so friendly and helpful  Raj in particular will keep you entertained  We had breakfast in the restaurant downstairs the first morning  which had an amazing array of choice  then the second morning went to the Club lounge and although the choice isn t as wide  ended up eating here for the rest of our stay  The hotel is close to Bugis Steet which has lots of shops and restaurants and an MRT station  so all very convenient  Lots of other interesting areas including little India and Arab Steeet within walking distance  And anywhere else we wanted to go with the city area tended to be less than  10 a taxi ride

I stayed at the Intercontinental Hotel for a night and was absolutely blown away by the level of customer service  and overall quality of the hotel  Couple that with a great location    Bugis Junction is right outside    and you ve got a winner One small quibble    breakfast was adequate but not as full featured as b fasts I ve had at other Intercontinental Hotels of its ilk  And the cafe latte was not good  flat as opposed to frothy milk  bitter   But the hotel s other charms more than compensate

I was fortunate enough to stay at this hotel while traveling for work  The room was huge and very well kept  The service was excellent and the breakfast provided everything needed to start the day  Lucky for me the hotel is connected to shopping  I forgot how humid it is in Singapore and only packed long sleeve shirts  I had to buy a short sleeve shirt for the evenings  Plenty of places to eat and drink nearby but I would have to suggest the restaurant inside the hotel  WOW   It was one of my best meals  It is a cab ride away from the downtown sights but close enough that it only took a few minutes to get there

This is a beautifully elegant hotel in a very good location  Stayed here for 3 nights and really enjoyed my stay  Amazing lobby and lounge and we paid a bit extra to use the Club Lounge which was well worth the money  High quality staff who can t do enough for you  Next time I m in Singapore  I will definitely stay here

Hard to fault this hotel  We stayed there during a long stopover on our way to Australia  Despite our late arrival  there was enough staff to greet us and take us to our room  which was the most impressive suite on the third floor  The location is close to everything and taxis are cheap and plentiful  Hotel s got very impressive restaurants and a small  but clean pool  My only regret is I wish I stayed longer

We stayed here on our way to New Zealand  We were greeted by very friendly reception staff who checked us in with great efficiency  Our room was on the 10th floor looking out towards the Singapore skyline  The room was very spacious and a very comfortable bed with a good choice of pillows on the menu  All staff from security to managers went out of their way to say hello and make you feel very much at home Food at breakfast was good  a vast selection made it hard to choose from but I m sure I tried quite a bit just to make sure I had picked from the best We stayed for three nights and the location was ideal  close enough to the centre of the city but easy enough to get around with little hassle If I return to Singapore I would be very happy to book the Intercontinental again

Stayed 3 nights  Lovely room  beautiful hotel and fantastic staff  Great location for everything you could want or need  We travelled down to Bugis village to pick up some fresh local fruit for a great price  a stark contrast to the price of F  amp  B in the hotel   6 for a pork bun     13 for 1 cappucino and it wasn t even nice    this was really disappointing but not a big deal as there are shops literally under the hotel open til about 10 30pm and lots of good eating places there  On the whole pretty good  I d stay again at the right price

My mum and I stayed here for 4 nights in July and I cannot say enough good things  The staff are lovely and very helpful and the hotel lobby is very grandeur  Room was dated but still very nice and Mum and I both agreed that the beds were the comfiest we have ever slept in   Bathroom was fantastic  Location is great   5 min walk from Bugis MRT  room service outstanding  buffet breakfast delicious   especially the fresh made juices  Everything about this hotel and the staff has made it a certainty that I will be staying here again on my next trip to Singapore  Thank you to everyone at the Intercontinental that made our trip most enjoyable

This was my second stay here  I was here last year and in my review mentioned the coldness of the staff  Why did I go here again  The value can t be beat  Since this hotel is not on Orchard Street  To noisy anyhow  the rate is lower  Also  for the quality of the rooms  it s a bargain  AND it s right next to Burgis Market and LOT S of restaurants  Plus it s a quieter location This time though the staff was a complete turn around  Maybe because it was my honeymoon  but almost everyone was friendly  outgoing and helpful  I can t believe everyone I met knew it was my honeymoon  The morning afternoon doorman who was also there last year should just move on though  He just seems bored and has never smiled  He was the exception though  I asked for an upgrade to a premier room and was given it too  This is one of the largest  if not largest  rooms I have stayed in that was not categorized as a suite  Daily fruit and Italian bottled water  as last year  was put out every morning  I don t know if this is because I m a Priority member or not  Forgot to ask I was happy to see the improvement in a classy good value hotel such as this  My only place to stay in Singapore for sure

Dont travel in new year timeAs we did  the aim was to eat out and shop as much as we could and nothing was open  well not nothing about 10  of singapore was open  It was a waste of time  as for the hotel  they had no record of our arrival  it took 4 women and about 45 mins to sort out the error  Everyone at the hotel pointed us in the direction to go and shop yet no one could tell us it was all closed so we wasted money on taxis going to a close place  The breakfast was shocking  disorganized  for such a high standard hotel i was shocked with the wait to get in  the emptyness of food and staff  and when you got some food from the buffet it was average  Tables were left unattended  Maybe they had staff off too  hence the disarray  When we go back to singapore it will not be in new year time nor at this hotel

Super classic hotel with excellent rooms  super service  and lovely pool area  The Intercontinental is just next door to Busig junction  shopping area   and walking distance to Raffles and Chimes  You do need to take the metro  which is very close by  or a cab to get to the good part of Orchard I can strongly recommend this hotel   one of the best I have ever stayed on  and I do about 500 000 airmiles a year

I stayed at the Intercontinental in Singapore on a 4 day  3 night business trip in August 2012  The hotel has an old Edwardian style charm but neverthless sits well in this modern  vibrant city  Service was excellent without being over the top  and the bedroom  I stayed in a Club level room  was very comfortable   just as well as I needed to sleep because of jetlag  The Club Lounge and the breakfast served there were excellent   an oasis of peace   while the outdoor pool was truly relaxing  For shoppers  which I am not     there are loads of them nearby  and the very interesting hop on hop off city busy tour has a stop right beside the hotel  Thank you for your kind hospitality

Stayed here for the sixth time in August 2012 on the way home from Paris My wife and I love staying here The staff are so welcoming and cannot do enough for you The club Intercontinental is the way to go The ambience of the lounge where at breakfast afternoon tea or evening cocktails is something that has to be experienced to be believed The food is excellent the rooms are very clean and spacious The location of the hotel is very handy to most attractions We will be staying here again Don t change a thing Room Tip  Try the club rooms See more room tips

We stayed at Intercontinental Singapore in the first week of August  2012  repeaters  and we were again satisfied of the great location and the great paeceful lobby  I can really recommend for the warm athmospere and the cleaness of the room  Concierge is always a true partner in all choices for dinner and shopping  I can recommend  the reception could be nicer  but  it is the only thing Ishould change

The InterContinental Singapore is well situated for exploring Singapore  The Bugis MRT station is a 2 3 minute walk away through a covered area  in fact  you can take the MRT straight from Changi airport to Bugis as they are both on the East West  green  line  The Bugis Junction and Bugis  malls are directly connected to the hotel so shopping and the basics are close at hand  The room is about what you d expect for a 4 5 star hotel  comfortable bed with a wide selection of pillows  including body pillows  available  Very quiet at night even though it s directly connected to a mall  The fitness center is OK   equipment is a little outdated but works just fine  The pool is nice but not too large or deep  more of a lounging pool than a pool for swimming  The hotel restaurant was satisfactory   very nice but not outlandish or overly expensive  I was most appreciative of the service I received at the IC Singapore   staff was very helpful  assisted me in getting some things I was after  located some food items I was wanting  gave good restaurant recommendations  etc  In summary   good hotel for business travelers or older couples  4 5 star quality in a great location  Would not recommend for families  especially with younger children

The hotel is very grand in appearance from the outside  The lobby and reception area are simple yet very nice and inviting  Check in was longer than usual but they were busy during this period so understandable  Staff around the hotel are very helpful  However I was a little annoyed that the porter was expecting a tip  I usually tip them but I find it rude that they should be expecting it  Room itself is clean and it has all the usual things you would expect from a 5 star hotel  However the room did feel a little old fashioned  Room service was great  I always define a hotel s food by how well they can make a club sandwich and Interon have got it spot on  All in all though  its not really anything special  There are some other 5 star hotels in the area that are cheaper and better  The overall stay was comfortable and pleasant but certainly not in the top tier of hotels I ve been to in Singapore

I stayed for a week last week and had no complaints   except prehaps the fact that my room was a fair hike from the main entrance  It is a funny layout with a wing of the hotel extending out around a shopping mall  I literally had to walk a few hundred metres to get anywhere in the hotel which after a while was tedious  But the hotel is old school charm and my room was big  comfortable bed and extremely quiet  The gym is filled with really old equipment  so although not bad size   is not particularly good  But better than nothing  Breakfast was fine   I ate in the club lounge to avoid too many kids screaming  Was fine So overall a good option   well located  old but nice hotel and very good service  Was fine as I was travelling on business  But certainly not on par with the likes of Fullerton Bay Hotel   Room Tip  The wing was a bit of a hike   but very quiet and rooms were large See more room tips

I recently booked to return to this great hotel but was surprised and not happy to have to pay an extra  30 for second person sharing my room  I have never had to do that anywhere in the world but was told by the reservation supervisor because my rate was very good and that is what they do in Singapore  What a shame  I feel the hotel is trying any way to extract more money from a loyal customer like me

I travelled from the USA to take in the Singapore F1 Grand Prix arriving just after midnight  I contacted the hotel in advance to arrange ground transportation for me  this they did for a modest fee and I was greeted at the top of the air bridge by a smartly presented young man who escorted me to Customs and onwards to the waiting Mercedes  The driver was very professional  chilled water and refreshing towel in the car for me and a wifi enabled iPad  Upon arriving at the hotel I was greeted and brought directly to my room  I had been upgraded to an Exec room on the 15th floor  and was checked in in the room  Complimentary water and fresh fruits were available and I got comfortable after my 20 hour journey  Great shower with complimentary robes  a deep tub if you preferred  and the most sublime bed with crisp white linens  Next day I availed of the buffet breakfast which was available in the Olive restaurant  great selection and nicely presented  Being out until late evening I took in room dining a couple of times and it arrived promptly and hot  prices very reasonable  I can t think of a negative thing about my entire stay  had the car service again to return me to the airport  the entire experience optimises everything that is Singapore  I will stay here again on my next visit Room Tip  A good 7 11 right across from the hotel in stead of pricey minibar options  High floors looking towa   See more room tips

First time to Singapore and stayed here for 2 weeks  Service was excellent  one of best hotel pools I ve been too and one of the best breakfasts I have had  besides the omelette guys ignored my existence   Dinners were very good but very expensive  The toilet had a smell coming from it which filled up the room every so often  Id stay here again but would look at other options to have another experience

I love this hotel      Situated near the famous Bugis street and directly connected to Bugis Junction Mall  amp  Bugis MRT station  it s a very strategically located hotel The room is spacious  and I like the way the vintage room decoration  The hotel buildeing it self is like a colonial old building but well maintained  And as any othe Intercontinental hotel  the pillow menu is extraordinary accompanied by a very comfortable bed The bathroom is equipped with bathtub  something rare in singapore  I would recommend this hotel to anyone

Here on Business for 4 day stop before heading to Melbourne which fortunatly coincided with the Singapore F1 Grand Prix weekend   Not planned i promise   Read some reviews to get an idea where i was staying  some do not do it justice  My expierence in visting Singapore for the first time  has been greatly enriched by staying here Centrally located to Raffles City shopping  Bugios market  and the infamous Raffles Hotel  everything is in reach  Also was 2mins from the F1 track Seen some reviews about service and manner but i found the staff extremely friend and helpful  Got a good morning from evert member of staff when i left for the office  was asked if i knew where i was going when i went out in the evening and if i needed directions to anywhere  This for a newbie in Singapore  instantly makes you at ease Room is what you expect for a hotel of this calibur  Bathroom was very luxurious and the be has been the most comfortable i slept outside my own   which been travelling is saying something  Regardless of why you are here  and cannot comment on other people s expirences but i had a very comfortable stay and would recommend to my colleagues

The Intercontinental is near the Raffles hotel and reasonably central  It is not in the business district  so it is 20minutes by taxi  Taxis can be hard to find  so this is not ideal if there on business Staff are excellent The Club Lounge is good  albeit not inexpensive at around S 80 per night additional  Includes breakfast  internet  evening drinks and limited access to a meeting room

I m a guest since 1999 and it s my preferred hotel in Singapore  I like the charming atmosphere  the colonial style  the location and the breakfast We had a room in the main building  classic style  quiet  with everything you need Breakfast  one of the best I have ever eaten  Lots of choice and delicious food  vegetables and salad corner  salmon  eggs station  Indian corner  yogurt and muesli  fruits  croissants and jam  potatoes  sausages  dim sum  fresh juices   and everything is fantastic Pool  we spent there a relaxing day  we ordered sandwiches  tuna and turkey  with vegetables served with frites   very tasty Location is perfect  connected with Bugis Junction and metro station Con  wi fi is not free  charged 30    SGD a day  I hope the hotel policy will change in the future

Staff needs better training  just can t think outside the box and some of their practices resemble Holiday Inns or lesser ranked hotels  Club Lounge costs extra  50 a day  which helps to insulate customer from some if the service problems Pool is small  no staff in duty Food is ok but uncreative  Chinese restaurant overpriced but has some good tea Not bad compared to other Singapore hotels at its level but could be improved

I stay at this hotel around 10 times per year on business  Without fail I am treated with courtesy  called by name every time and receive appropriate treatment for my PC Royal Platinum Ambassador status  The rooms are well appointed and large  but apart from the Shophouse rooms  are probably due for upgrade in the near future  The Club lounge is large and features waiter service as well as self  service  breakfast is OK but the Olive Tree restaurant has a much wider choice  The hotel works for me because it s close to the MRT and only a couple of stops from the office  For tourists  Orchard Road may be a better choice  but actually nowhere s far from anywhere in Singapore Room Tip  The second and third floors can be noisy during the day as they overlook the shopping mall See more room tips

When I am in Singapore  I normally stay at the InterContinental and each time I stay there I understand why  The wonderful experience starts about one week before my stay  when I receive an e mail asking me when my flight arrives and when I expect to arrive at the hotel  That sounds pretty normal  as you would assume a hotel would be interested in when their guests will be arriving so when they have down time the desk staff can perform any pre check in activities that will make the check in process for the guest more efficient  Well  the InterContinental Singapore has gotten this procedure down to a science  The complete hotel staff is extremely attentive to their guest wishes  The ¡°Instant Service¡± button on the phone in your room  like all other InterContinental  actually works  Whether for business or pleasure  this is a fantastic hotel  Nicely located  reasonably priced and extremely friendly Room Tip  Ask for one of the Shophouses See more room tips

I stayed at the Intercontinental as part of a business trip and would not normally do a review for what was a standard work stay  but I left a valuable electronic item in my hotel room and the hotel were simply excellent in getting it back to me in my home country the following week  Such good customer service should be noted The location of the hotel is a bit away from the river   as with all hotels in Singapore  work out where you will be spending your time before you book  The advantage of this is that it is right by a shopping centre  literally out the back door  and cinema  so you can have easy acces if you choose Room Tip  The rooms have light barrier blinds triple layered  which is great for those of us that sleep lightSee more room tips

The hotel is conveniently located at the end of the Bugis mall  It is easily accessed from the airport by either taxi or MRT  Good location for shopping and exploring the city  Although the hotel has a clear business focus we would recommend it for leisurely travelers as well Like the title says  everything at the hotel is satisfying  from the amenities in the large  bright bathroom to the d? cor of the room and services offered  What might be missing is that extra vibe that makes you go ¡°WOW¡±  However  at the Intercontinental in Singapore you are satisfied and happy Best ? We enjoyed our stay on the club level  the room was smaller than some club levels we have experienced before in club level hotels but it was comfortable  quiet  and the food and service of the staff at the lounge was exemplaryWe were fortunate for a late check out and an opportunity to stay in the lounge for a few hours before a late night flight

Terrible experience from the start of arriving at the hotel  I had a car rental and drove my family to the hotel  The front door man  who is rude  told me he would only give my 10 mins to park my car at the side or he will have to start charging me valet  So I had to rush in with my family with baby  get them checked in with the rooms  then rush back out to park my car somewhere else  Half an hour later  I got back to my rooms  realizing my luggages have not arrived  So I went downstairs to the lobby  and saw my luggages  still sitting next to the concierge desk  Totally frustrated  I took them to my room by myself  Years of traveling all over the world  This is definitely a first in a top class hotel

The hotel and rooms are very good  The bed is extremely comfortable and the bathroom is spacious enough and has all that one could need There is free wifi in the room which is a big plus The breakfast buffet is boring  After day 1  there is very little variety for non Asians  Eggs  fruits  cereals and bakery items was a repeat for my entire stay  Pancakes and waffles were lousy  Lunch buffet was horrible  As a non Asian  there was very little that I could eat  This was a big negative for me especially in an international chain The location is not bad at all  Even though it is quite a distance from Orchard Road  the hotel is attached to Bugis shopping centre  There s pretty much everything one might need and Orchard is a 15 min  cab ride away I won t necessarily stay there again as I prefer hotels on Orchard Road and because of the breakfast and lunch buffet  But overall a good hotel

At the end of a 1 month holiday in Europe  we decided to have a stopover in Singapore and booked a room with Club Lounge access What a joy after a 16 hour flight to enjoy the softest and most comfortable bed with a menu for different pillows was fantastic Could not say anything bad about the services offered in the Club Lounge from the breakfast through to cocktails the service was superb Must give a special thanks to Raj and Nana who were so accommodating  Would definitely return

Stayed here for 3 nights in August The hotel is top class as you d expect of the Intercontinental  Rooms are well appointed  the wifi works excellently  the bathroom is fantastic  and there are sufficient bathroom amenities  The gym is large enough  though some of the equipment could be upgraded Poolside area is good  though not all that spacious The hotel is located just next to the National library  not really close to any MRT  so you ll need a cab  unless you want to walk about Breakfast room is huge and a solid selection is on offer The lobby area is a nice place to have an afternoon tea and relax  Victoria pub is small ish  but totally sufficient for a couple of beers

After staying other hotels  it is very happy to return to the authentic charming InterContinental Singapore  The service was excellent and always beyond our expectation  prompt services upon arrival by porter  receptionist and tel operator who address us by name when answer our call  We received the requested pillow as we wish  lavender  The bed was very comfortable  The most outstanding was the air condition system  it was so quiet and not disturbing our sleep

Me and my husband stayed at this hotel for 4 nights in september whilst attending the F1 grand prix The hotel is clean and beautifully decorated  with spacious communal areas  The staff are very attentive  and friendly  The room was clean with wonderfully comfy beds and a lovely bathroom  and the maids came in twice a day We did not make any use of hotel restaurants or other facilities so cannot comment on those  The hotel was a short walk from the metro station and the sights of singapore  although with the heat and humidity  some visitors may prefer to use taxis or the metro to get about  Our only issue was the wifi service which basically did not work even in the lobby area with the staff trying different passwords A nice place to stay on the whole and we will probably return there again

look it was absolutely fine with very good levels of service  but I ve been spoilt with all the new hotels in Singapore in Asia that have a 21st century vibe in the decor and architecture  and the InterConti Sing is just not that  lots of pink ish marble instead of wenge and glass   if you don t like the hotels with glass walled bathrooms that can be flooded with light from the main bedroom  then you ll quite likely be fine with this InterConti   but not for me   oh and v upset that in the sports bar  they have two big TVs in two different rooms but can only show one channel across the whole bar   so I was suppoed to watch an A senal game   and the in room TV didn t have sports channel with football on either   tongue only a litte bit in cheek

This is the most customer oriented staff I have ever seen  They go out of their way to make your stay pleasant not only at the motel  but in Singapore as well  They refresh your room amenities twice a day and will bring you things with no apparent expectation of tip  One of the lobby attendants gave me  a first time visitor  great advice on where to clothes shop for my wife  While what Tokyoprof says about the pool is true  I don t think a review like this can do much to change a motel s structure Yes  the prices are rip off high  especially in the large lobby where they have short order food and liquor  But if you don t like it  there are lots of places to go nearby that are cheaper Singapore of course is free market paradise  Within walking distance of the motel  you can go to all economic strata of shopping areas  Cheap o bazaar type market  trendy malls for the spoiled brats spending their fast food job money  plus my favorite Raffles Mall  It seems they do fine without silly zoning laws so that you can easily find a great mix of businesses The food was good  but then I am not picky  Or  I m kind of a barbarian and would not know good gourmet from mac and cheese

As you would expect fromIntercontinental  the rooms are very comfortable  the staff are very helpful and facilities are lovely  I particularly like the pillow menu so that I can get a pillow that I like  it really does make a difference   My only complaint is the charge for in room wifi  I am a Priority Club member so I get free wifi in the lobby but when I want to check my emails after dinner  it is a pain having to come done to the lobby or be charged a userous rate for wifi in my room  Your room rates should more than cover this convenience as there are many lesser hotels that manage to build this in  It is a pity to have to complain about this as everything else was wonderful

We left London in a downpour and arrived likewise in Singapore  Being Platinum Priority Club members  we were duly upgraded to the Club level rooms  which meant that we had free access to the Club Lounge The Club Lounge has a happy hhour between 17 30 and 19 30   wall to wall cocktails including the legendary Singapore Sling It s hard to pick out what was particularly special about the place  The location  the atmosphere  the staff  the service  All brilliant  Internet access was excellent  Restaurant  Chinese  perfect  No noise from the street  You just can t fault it The perfect springboard for High Tea at Raffles Room Tip  Join the Priority ClubSee more room tips

Hubby  adult son and I stayed at the Intercontinental Singapore for 9 nights in July and we couldn t fault it  Super clean  delicious buffet breakfasts and the concierges were the most helpful we have ever come across  The location was perfect   in the middle of all the various areas of Singapore that we wanted to visit  One door actually fronts onto a shopping mall  Being the shopper in the family  I was in heaven  The only less than perfect issue was the Internet access  To use Internet in the room was very  very expensive but we eventually were offered free access in the lobby area  This ended up being a lovely experience for us every night as the hotel employs a piano player who plays the most soothing music every night from about 6 12pm  I was moved to tears on several occasions by his beautiful music  I still think of it from time to time  even now  We loved Singapore so will definitely return one day and once again will choose the Intercontinental Hotel for our stay  Highly recommended

As titled  the location of this hotel is just perfect  Situated next to Bugis Junction mall  just across the road from Bugis street for hawker food and small shops of knick knacks  The MRT is under the mall or if you re feeling fit enough to walk  you can walk all the way up to City Hall and even Orchard Road Breakfast is standard  I love the salad bar for its freshness and the juice bar where you ask the bartender for any juice mix you want  I stayed in the deluxe room and it s very spacious with a huge bed  choices of pillows  nice smelling amenities  and marbled bathroom  I have mixed review for the staff though  I entered the hotel looking very tired and disheveled  looking forward to have a speedy check in  Unfortunately the Front Desk staff didn t greet me at all and ignored me until I approached one of them and asked to be checked in  After check in  the staff accompanied us to the elevator himself which is nice and somehow make up his lack of attention before The room service staff are very helpful and responded quickly every time we called  including helped us book a taxi for 7 person for our trip back to the airport which turned out to be a BMW taxi  Though a bit expensive  it fits all our luggage  including some IKEA boxes  and it certainly is nice to travel in style A few days after check out  my mother told me that the hotel has not released her credit card from the deposit she made upon checked in  She called the hotel straight away but they can not offer a satisfactory explanation as to why the deposit is not released yet  It finally was released around 10 days after we checked out from the hotel which is strange and very unexpected from a 5 star hotel

Pros  Fabulous location  pleasant building  great beds  decent food  Generally  all basic needs meet  Con  Staff were just ok  apart from two people  no one was worth remembering  but a few were worth forgetting Duty manager Ann Anne did well   she came to personally apologize for someone else s error  Ms Jess Yap at Front Desk was the stand out performer  In a tribe of staff who appeared to be  quot going through the motions quot   Jess was absolutely outstanding  alert  interested  upbeat  caring  In a word  she was engaged  Well done Jess

Booked 3 nights in a Deluxe room and wanted to add 4th at same price  Was offered a room with similar price and once agreed was then told it was no longer available  This experience made us worry the stay would be substandard and we moved from hotel on our last night due to the excessive price rise All this said  the hotel and service exceeded our expectations  Speedy check and escorted to the lifts by the same person  The room was large and decorated nicely  King size bed with choice of pillows  Huge bathroom with bath and separate shower  good amenties provided  Buffet breakfast was included and it also exceeded expectations with many choices including good coffee and healthy food  Location was good for us and allowed us to walk to many places including MRT stations that took us further afield  A shopping mall is located at the back of the hotel providing restaurants and hawkers food  All up an enjoyable stay and would stay again at the right price

Have stayed here on many occasions  and as a fairly loyal Intercon customer  I also stay at Intercons across the region  I usually book rooms that include access to the Club lounges whenever I stay at any Intercon  and my experiences in Intercon lounges across Asia has been very good  the lounge at this property is a standout  I cannot point to a single issue that makes it better  I think the fit out and food is slightly better than other Intercons  however the staff are both friendly and highly efficient regardless of the request There many hotel choices in Singapore with better appointed rooms however I will continue to support this hotel

This is the third time I stayed at the InterContinental Hotel in Singapore  Habit  I guess   its close to great hawker food courts and a food street  And a great food hall at the bottom of Bugis Junction shopping complex All three times I stayed in a Club Room  This time  I got  quot upgraded quot  to a shopfront room  This is a room in the reclaimed and restored older part of the complex which used to be historical shop fronts  The fictures are beautiful  the furnishings very comfortable  But  and I know this is a silly thing to say  but my room was quite a hike from the rest of the hotel  through corridors  across walkways and through doors  At the end of a long day of meetings  the mental exercise was difficult  And I made the wrong turn quite a few times The only other gripe is the gym  It is tired  The machines are old  and space cramped and it could use with a good new lick of paint  The pool side was outdoors  which is good for tan topups  but there isn t a lot of space lounge chairs  So it gets full up very quickly On saying that  the service was flawless  The staff really friendly and helpful

Recently my wife and i celebrated our first wedding anniversary and stayed at this beautiful hotel I would highly recommend this hotel as it has so much old world charm and the staff are enchanting  My wife and I travel a lot and always feel at home when we stay at Intercontinental Hotels  we are ambassador members   This is very important when you travel especially when you come home from busy day site seeing or business Where the hotel is located is right in the best district for shopping as we found out    lots of ladies fashion here girls  This is where all the locals shop as its thousand times cheaper than Orchard road  Also you are not far away from Little India and China town like everybody else has commented Also do yourself a favour as you deserve     upgrade to the  quot Club Lounge quot  as the staff make you feel welcomed and are very efficient and great sense of humour  Not only this its also very classy and its thousand times lot cheaper than if you had to buy your drinks at other local establishments If you ever wanted to stay at the famous Raffles Hotel then look no further than Intercontinental Singapore  As it is the league as this beautiful old world Hotel

Having been to Singapore a few times and stayed in varying locations   this was perfect  Right next to Bugis Shopping Mall  across the road from Bugis markets and a walk into the shopping centre and down to the MTR   perfect Breakfast each day was buffet of course  eggs cooked any which way on the spot and plenty of choice from everything else Rooms were lovely of course as a 5 star hotel should be  Service was just there   Wherever you went anyone was ready willing and able to point us in the right direction

For my 15th anniversary  my wife and I booked ourselves a 2 night stay  Having stayed at various hotels around the world  i must say that i am impressed with this Singapore hotel The service staff that greeted us on our checking in was faultless and they had a professional yet genuine style to their service  Jess Yap who helped check us in walked us to the lifts after the speedy and fuss free checking in  Jess shared that as this was our special celebration with the hotel  she has arranged for us to get a nicer room  When we saw the room  we were pleasantly surprised  The room is a bit old but has not lost its charm  The toilet was well lit and clean  The amenities were fragrant and pleasant too  Everything that is supposed to work did The rooms were well endowed  Although the TV can certainly be improved  as some channels were grainy or not available   the bed certainly made up for the TV  It was one of the most comfortable beds and we really had problems telling ourselves to get up in the morning  The gym  as mentioned by our trippers  was a bit old and the machines could do with an upgrade  It is otherwise acceptable as it had a good selection of cardio machines and weights  The pool was small but decent  There was even a sheltered jacuzzi and plenty of deck chairs to laze away the day  The hotel was busy when we stayed but nevertheless their attention to detail was not compromised  I liked the nice touch arranged by Michael  As it was our anniversary celebration  there were little heart shaped cookies left in our room and the bath tub was sprinkled with rose petals  Nice touch  I was certainly impressed and look forward to celebrating more anniversaries with this hotel

only  Moet Imperial I don t know how they can justify that  but anyway I digress  let me mention the breakfast at the IC in Singapore   It was absolutely amazing I DID get it free  but I would glady made muffins  green tea muffin  Awesome    pastries  croissant  breads and cakes A Continental  European  breakfast bar with fruits  delightful papaya and Sarawak pineapple   meats and cheeses from around the world  there was every cooked breakfast food you could imagine  American pancakes   quot Full English quot  cooked items  a fresh omelette station  Indian and Malaysian curries  Chinese dim sum  a vast selection of teas and freshly prepared coffees  and every major world newspaper you can think of  and some you probably can t Even the fruit juice they had out was something special  Standard orange or pineapple from concentrate  Oh no  This was fresh squeezed orange juice and fresh squeezed pineapple with a hint of melon  and there was even a pitcher of fresh watermelon juice Another great stay at one of my favourite hotels in the world  It can be a grand hotel or if like me like that home from home feeling it is that too  It s a beautiful building with magnificent great lounge but its the staff who make this hotel special  Not once did I pass any staff member and not get a cheery greeting  Carry a bag and they are right over to ask to carry it  The club lounge is equally special and I sat there to prepare an important presentation  It was not going well  But whether it was printing  PCM help or just a bit of friendly but discrete encouragement Anita Anna and Raj were right there  Truly great

This has got to be the best hotel experience we ve ever had  Everything ran as smooth as silk  Our 10th floor room was decorated with understated elegance and a spectacular view of the city  Amenities were abundant and luxurious  Linens were spotless and made of crisp fine quality brushed cotton  Towels were huge  absorbent and plentiful  Pillow menu  of course  Turn down service  definitely  But those components were not what made the InterContinental so special  It s the staff  Someone has been doing a masterful job of making sure that each and every employee is immaculate  eager to be of service  totally responsible and reliable and always bearing a cheerful countenance  We were not demanding guests but this is surely a place for demanding guests  Your wish is their command and they all seem so happy to help  They all go the extra mile  every step of the way We booked a Club plan and it was a major bargain  Highly recommended  This gave us entry to the Club Lounge with it s dedicated personnel and marvelous food options  All included  We started with a sumptuous breakfast  In late afternoon they serve High Tea with a variety of delicious cheeses  sandwiches and pastries  Early evening is cocktail hour which features fabulous hors d oeuvres such as steamed dumplings  stuffed grape leaves  salmon and on and on and on  In an expensive city like Singapore where the only cheap food is sold by hawkers  this is an elegant alternative to dining out  Service is wonderful and food is gourmet all the way  Cocktail hour  of course  features free liquor  wine and beer  in addition to soft drinks  And  we didn t ask but the staff saw our boarding passes were for a 7am flight so they suggested a breakfast box delivered to our room at 3  It was delicious and lovely It s hard to overstate the case for the InterContinental  If you go to Singapore this is the place  Centrally located  you will feel right at home except that home is not usually so smoothly run and beautiful

stayed here for one night whilst I took my two kids to Universal Studios  The hotel is only a few mins walk from the nearest MRT station The room was clean and tidy The buffet breakfast was very good but was disappointed with the buffet dinner  went down about 7 30pm and nearly every hot food option was empty  was there for about an 30 mins and still no fresh supplies  My daughter ordered steak from the menu rather than have the buffet and I was not happy at being charged extra for a portion of steak fries Staff however were helpful and friendly

This is a great hotel for both business and pleasure  Located next to the Bugis shopping centre  easy walking distance to Raffles and next to he MRT The room was clean spacious and the staff were superb  I still can t get over the Concierge welcomed me by name  how did he know The restaurant in the hotel was very nice  we tried the Olive Tree  this is an international buffett and was excellent  Any buffett that has lobster and oysters is a good one for me But get out and try the street food  not the restaurants in the shopping centres  but down the side streets  proper street food enjoyed by the locals  see my other reviews of Singapore for details of the Steamboat BBQ

We arrived early like 9 00 am and were not sure if we would have to wait for a room  we did notour room was true luxury some ten days earlier we had been at the Taj Clubhouse in Chennai and the rooms at the Intercontinental were well superior  the bed was magnificent with a true feather matters  the service was also good We did the Singapore flyer but had to Que for over an hour  a mistake  the ride was good but the que for me unacceptable the concierge was so helpful and when I inquired about an internet caffe to do my online airline check in she immediately took over and did it for me  absolutely wonderful serviceRoom Tip  i believe all rooms are good in this hotelSee more room tips

For details and pictures  visit  http   dairycream blogspot sg 2013 01 aroma hotel intercontinental singapore htmlFor the log cakes this year  the new Gula Melaka Chendol Log Cake tasted the best out of the three types available in slices  This coconut cream coated cake had just the right balance of the fragrant Gula Melaka in both the mousse and the sponge  making it difficult to stop at one slice The traditional Valrhona Chocolate Logcake  available each xmas  was mediocre and the sparse amount of chocolate pearls did not help to enhance the texture The Rum and Raisin Log cake was both good and bad  The rum mousse stood out with sufficient rum taste but the raisins were plain and the vanilla custard centre had too much gelatine and became chewier than a marshmallow

Just spent 5 days at the IC with the family  We were staying at the shophouse suites  The services were excellent   all the way from planning for our arrival to the actual stays  from greeting us with a smooth speedy checkins to a no hassle checkout process  everything was just superb  The shophouse suites offered a unique experience just above the shopping district  During the day  it might be a little bit noisier but the mall closes at night which was not a problem at all  The shophouse rooms were nicely renovated which offers a nice balance of colonial decor with modern amenities  Overall  highly recommended for tourists looking for top notch hotel

Quite an aged property but this shouldn t matter too much when the exceedingly colossal  flamboyant and comfortable lobby lounge makes up for it  if not  the service offered herewith definitely will  Every member of the staff we interacted with was evidently well trained and always put in their best efforts to meet our demands  from the check in kiosk to the concierge to the buffet restaurant and even to housekeeping  the staff at Intercontinental never ceased to go the extra mile and managed to impress us a ton during our stay  There was a night when our little girl wanted a few color pencils to draw pictures with  I was merely looking into the possibility of such an availability by simply pressing the instant service button on the phone  yet instantly became shocked at the level of service this hotel had to offer when a manager greeted me at my door with a warm smile  alongside a handful of different color pencils For some reason  our girl contracted food poisoning and this was when the hotel truly unveiled its 5 star quality  We were already checking out from the hotel and there was still an afternoon before our flight was due to take off  but when the concierge learnt that a little guest of their hotel was suffering from an upset stomach  they gave us back the room key and we were allowed to rest there for another 4 hours This established development  needless to say  lives up to its name and has taken well care of us during our 4 day stay  Just a gentle note  the hotel may be interested in refurbishing its facilities to further elevate the impressiveness  such as the fitness centre and the swimming pool  both of which appear to be dated Would definitely come back in time to come  The asian hospitality here pamper you and the only thing you need to do is put your feet up  Keep up the good work

I stayed recently for 2 nights on a stopover between Nepal and Australia  I arrived at 1am  stressed and tired after a long day flying  I was immediately and warmly welcomed by a front desk staff member  I wish I could remember his name   he was brilliant  who checked me in quickly with a lovely upgrade and escorted me to the elevators  It was such a seamless check in  not to be taken for granted  some of the other hotels in the same category create such drama   and much needed after a long day  My bags arrived quickly  which meant I could get to sleep The room itself was exceptionally handled brilliantly  as were all of the calls to the instant service team  Would I stay here again  Definitely

My main problem with this property was I did not get to spend enough time here  Wonderful old charm hotel with nothing being to much trouble for the staff  One of the best Buffets for all meals in The Olive Tree restaurant I have ever encountered and fantastic quality the staff there are quick efficient and very helpful Rooms are fantastically quiet big and roomy and the bed is die to for almost wanted to take it home The Lounge service a wonderful afternoon high tea and also some beautiful cocktails while reclining in relaxing overstuffed leather armchairs You kind of get a sort of feeling as you look round at the ornate ceilings and the Peranakan restoration architecture and the piano playing in the background you are the last days of the British Raj It s a wonderful property not too big  not to small  nothing is to much trouble and is convenient and close to everything If you get the chance spoil yourself and stay here if in Singapore

Absolutely loved this hotel  From the start of the booking process  until check out  I couldn t have been more pleased with the service  This is a truly  classy hotel  The hotel location was perfect as it adjoined the Bugis Junction  a shopper s paradise  It was also close to so many food options  The rooms were beautiful  classically decorated  I received an email during booking to ask of our arrival time  and when we checked in  the front desk staff were perfectly prepared for our arrival  Check in was a breeze and when we arrived at our rooms  it was warmly lit  beds turned down  with bed slippers laid out for us  The beds and pillows were extremely comfortable  There was even a pillow menu to suit your exact needs  We couldn t have felt more welcome  Our room had a lovely view of the pool and some of the Singapore skyline  including the Marina Bay Sands Skypark  The other reserved room for our family had a fantastic view of Bugis Junction  The hotel itself was very quiet and you could tell had more classy  business clientele  The concierge was so gracious  and she assisted us in advising of our daytime sightseeing  shopping and food plans  This was definitely one of more memorable hotel visits  Thank you Intercontinental

My wife and I stayed for one night to break up the flight from Europe to Australia  When I made the reservation  I asked for a room on a high floor  so to have a view  When we checked in  I asked again for a room with a view  and was told that yes  absolutely  the room that we were assigned had a view of the pool  So  it was with some surprise and disappointment when I drew the curtains on our 4th floor room to find a lovely view of a tall green wall about 8 feet from the window  No view of anything  at all    So thanks for that I went down to reception and complained  and was offered a room on a higher floor  although by this stage by wife had unpacked and had run a bath  so we weren t moving  Why  I would like to know  were we not initially given a higher room if one was available  And why did the receptionist get it so wrong  I suggested that perhaps a complimentary drink in the bar  worth a grand total of around  17  might be offered as compensation  but no  that wasn t going to happen Furthermore  for a five star hotel  I thought the service was rather average  I ve also stayed in the Ritz Carlton and the Crowne Plaza in Singapore  The R C in particular has excellent service   so much better than the Intercontinental  The pool at the Intercontinental is also a bit small and none too exciting  Even the pool at the Crowne Plaza is much better  The down side of the pool at the Crowne is that is has a great view of the Ritz Carlton  and one looks over longingly wishing one was staying there instead   On the plus side  the room was well decorated and the bed was extremely comfortable  however  in short  I doubt I will stay here again Room Tip  Forget the Intercontinental and stay at the Ritz Carlton See more room tips

I travel to Singapore regularly and would stay at the InterContinental every time if it was within walking distance to my office  Unfortunately the difficult in getting taxis back to the hotel each night forces me to stay elsewhere  However I have stayed here several times and this was my hotel of choice when my family travelled with me this trip  This is a delightful hotel with excellent club facilities  From the moment you arrive you are welcomed warmly and the friendliness and service extends throughout the entire stay  Highly recommend for both business travellers and families

Stayed at this delightful property over xmas in shophouse club room for four nights  From check in to check out this hotel did not disappoint  The Lounge was delightful in ambiance  club staff to match and the food and drink quite up to standard  Our room was very comfortable with the treats waiting for us in the evening  delicious  Whilst the hotel was obviously very busy  the standard throughout was excellent  all staff pleasant  friendly and helpful when necessary  We were sorry to leave to continue our holiday  and with luck  will be back

In Singapore the choice quality hotels is wide and they are located throughout the city and even on Sentosa Island  For example if you are looking to spend all your time shopping on Orchard Road choose a hotel in that area  However public transport is excellent across the island so it is easy to get around provided you close to an MRT station The Intercontinental Hotel is located above Bugis station  It has the advantage of having easy access to a range of eateries  including an amazing range of stalls as well as quite a range of shops  There is a supermarket and department store We have used this hotel for more than 10 years  The rooms have always been clean and well presented and the beds are first rate so sleeping off any jet lag need be no problem  Room service is efficient with a good range from the conventional to items from the hotel s Japanese and Chinese restaurants  The staff are always helpful and courteous If you want complete luxury  at a price   the limousine service from the airport includes an airside greeting and an escort from there to the car  The check in took place in our room and the cases arrived before this was completed We have used all the restaurants in the hotel and on this occasion we ate in the Olive Tree and enjoyed a fish main from the a la carte menu rather than eating from the buffet  The fish was excellently cooked and was a generous portion  As we were there for Christmas we enjoyed a superb brunch on 25th  nicely presented and a good range of food to chose from  The service was excellent Having praised the hotel there was a small quibble  The toiletries were not a well known brand  in the international sense  and we found the shampoo was so poor that when we were out at a nearby shopping centre we bought a brand that we knew would be to our liking

My wife and I spent one night at the Intercontinental  We had a plane to Brisbane the next night  When we arrived they upgraded us to a suite    which was nice  The gentleman who went with us to the room  with our bags  had NO clue how to operate anything in the room   much less how to get some ice  We had been told that breakfast was served until 10 30 the next morning  Since we arrived late we went down for breakfast at 9 30  Oh my gosh     Our server then tells us at 10 00 that the breakfast would be closing  She then proceeded to set all the tables around us for lunch  The rest of the restaurant continued with breakfast  Clearly we had a server problem who wanted us to leave  The rest of the staff around the front desk  bar  etc was super  One or two poorly trained employees can sure sour your experience

I stayed here for three nights on vacation after Christmas before traveling to Hong Kong  Overall  it was a truly excellent stay  and would be my first choice hotel if I return to Singapore for the room and location ROOM  The room was booked by an IHG rewards member  so we received an automatic upgrade to a beautiful suite overlooking the city  The room was spacious  with plenty of living space and closet drawer space for two  The huge  comfy bed was in a separate nook  The bathroom was large and Westernized  with a separate glass walled shower and soaking tub  I have no complaints AMENITIES  The hotel provides a number of luxury amenities  such as a free breakfast buffet and a nice pool and gym  I don t usually partake in hotels  breakfast buffets  but jet lag had me awake at 8 00 AM every day so I was able to enjoy the excellent variety of Western and Asian breakfast foods as well as wonderful fresh fruits  cheeses  juices  and more  The gym was standard and clean  and the pool looked lovely  LOCATION  The location truly cannot be beat  You re right in the center of the action  a few blocks from Raffles  Long Bar  Little India Arab Street  the Singapore Art Museum  and plenty of restaurants and shopping  The hotel is connected to a mall with some decent shops if you need something and quick bites  try the Toast coffee house  It had all the conveniences and luxuries of Raffles or other nearby luxury hotels  without the exorbitant price SERVICE  The service was friendly and attentive  but not too attentive so as to be bothersome  I rarely saw or heard housekeeping  though they did a great job  The front desk staff was always available to help with luggage  arranging taxis  or arranging a wonderful bus tour of the city  OVERALL  It was an excellent stay and I wouldn t hesitate to stay here again Room Tip  Try to get an upgrade to a suite and or a city view See more room tips
