My husband  amp  I stayed at this great hotel for a week in July 2012  The service throughout the hotel was impressive  Location very convenient to the metro  shopping centres  amp  dining places We purchased the Club level room which meant anytime we could to the club for cold hot drinks with snacks  for morning  amp  afternoon tea   In addition I was able to read overseas newspapers while there We ate the buffet breakfast at the main level of the hotel     amazing selection of food  Western  amp  Eastern style   The chef got to know us really well  amp  made divine tasting omeletes for us Nearly every day my hubby swam   the hotel pool while I relaxed on the lounge  Since we had an early flight back to Vancouver  we asked the reception staff if we could have breakfast in our room   4 30am    they said we could get some sandwiches  However when I phoned room service to request this we could instead an amazing breakfast   4 30am We got oatmeal  toast  fresh fruits  coffee  amp  OJ We have stayed in many hotels but this was the best one so far

Great hotel for business trips as well as for leisure  Excellent location  adjacent to the Bugis Mall  a short drive from Orchard Road  Singapore s Shopping district  and close to lot of interesting places in and around Singapore The service is out of the world  Special thanks to Jana in the Club Lounge who was ever helpful and took great care of us  The other staff in the Club Lounge were also courteous The Club Lounge serves excellent food and drinks Overall it was value for the money paid  Would definitely like to be back there in my next trip Room Tip  Choose the Club rooms which provides access to the escellent Club Lounge See more room tips

The InterContinental Singapore is my current favourite hotel in Singapore and I have stayed there 4 times over the past 3 months  so much so that I consider it my home away from home  The location is perfect for me  close enough to major business locations that I can be anywhere within 15 minutes by taxi  as well as being on top of a train station offering me an alternate during those times when sudden thunder and rain storms jam the roads and make hailing a cab as impossible as buying chewing gum  Being part of the Bugis Junction complex you have several shopping centres at your fingertips and literally hundreds of food options right on your doorstep  Everything from cinemas  chemists  clothing  accessories  computer  pet shops  book stores and more is within a few minutes  walk and an added bonus is across the road in the form of local restaurants serving incredible  fresh fare such as Bak Kut Teh  Roti  Laksa and much more The hotel itself is quiet and spacious  Public spaces such as the lobby lounge offer an inviting level of comfort and luxury and a sumptuous menu  especially for afternoon tea  whose combined result is a dangerous level of complacency where one could easily while away a lot of time without noticing  Olive Tree for breakfast is always busy and perhaps not the best option for someone seeking a private  quiet feed  It s not the best hotel breakfast in Singapore and I would call it very ordinary but it  does the job   Having said that  their fresh waffles could be some of the best in the world   it s just unfortunate they re not on the buffet every day My absolute favourite room type are the Shophouse rooms which are much larger than the standard rooms and exceedingly brighter  The foyer entrance to the room is simply spacious and walking into the room proper you are greeted by stunning accents such as the art deco lighting  an over stuffed sofa with silk cushions  marble topped tea cart  Chinese cabinet  large built in entertainment wall and a functional work desk with ergonomic chair  The bed is extremely comfortable with a generous  thick pillow top thrown in just to make sure you get the perfect nights  sleep  The highlight of these rooms are the floor to ceiling wooden louvre doors that open out over courtyards and let in plenty of light  The bathroom is again designed to be generous with space offering two side by side sinks  a large bathtub  shower and toilet  Towels are as thirsty as the weary traveller and lemon verbena bath products are a real delight Another reason I choose to keep coming back is the level of service which I find to be a perfect balance of warm  amp  welcoming and anticipating needs while giving you your space  Every single member of staff stops to greet you as you walk past  allowing you your space but also a quiet reminder that if you do need anything that they are there  i e  they haven t walked off ignoring you  Sadly room service food is not the best quality and I find it difficult to eat onsite  The Victoria Bar feels a bit mis matched compared to the rest of the property however being connected to so many F amp B options just outside the hotel  this is not a problem Room Tip  Try a Shophouse room for a true Singaporean experience See more room tips

I stayed at the Inter Continental hotel for 5 nights on business  initial impressions were good   service was high at check in  I must say this continued throughout my stay  I was talked in to a club upgrade  due to the free Internet   however discovered this was already available  I didn t really use any other of the benefits and really should have cancelled it The room was very mediocre  really in need of a refurb  the furniture was very out dated  On the plus side was pretty clean  although I found a number of hairs in the bathroom  The room was quite big and actually very comfortable  the bed in particular was excellent Ate at the Olive restaurant on first night  awful   food was average  but had atmosphere of cafeteria   lots of children  Lounge was pleasant  Location of hotel was good  right next to Bugis mall  although a bit low end   more for teenagers  10 mins from Orchard Road Top tips for Singapore   The bar at the top of Marina Bay Sands is amazing  it s worth a visit for the views and overall experience  Is expensive but well worth it   Take an umbrella   when it rains it really rains  almost a daily occurrence   Taxis are a nightmare on friday night and when in rains  the MRT is really quick  air conditioned and easy to use  Don t be scared  it s the best subway I have ever used   Avoid SunTec City Mall like the plague  it s really depressing   Vivo City is the best mall for mid range shops  I didn t visit   but I hear the shoppes at Marina Bay Sands are the best for luxury shopping  Singapore is no cheaper than uk for most things  thanks to high inflation and a strong sgd  However I noticed apple products were c20  cheaper than uk

I staid in this hotel for three nights with my wife when we relocated to Singapore  It was our  quot home base quot  for apartment hunting and exploring our new home town  The first impression was very good  friendly service  nice interior  great bed  everything you wish for  While we didn t enjoy the facilities much  we were out most of the time   the hotel is conveniently located to explore the city  Very close to Bugis Station  on the green line  and also several shopping malls  even though this is true about almost every place in Singapore  We did enjoy the pool and the pool area even though it is a bit small for a large hotel  With four swimmers doing laps  there is not much more space  Anyhow  all in all a very good address that comes with the usual Intercontinental price markup

I used to find Intercontinental Singapore an overrated hotel given the way their staff treat the customers  very cold n mechanical  This impression changed when I stayed with them this time  I m surprised with room upgrades to their shophouse suite and also the thoughtfulness in terms of getting a right sized pair of bathroom slippers for my boy  The room is something I never expect in terms of size n layout  all excellent Room Tip  If u have some cash to spare  try out their shophouse suite    You will love it    See more room tips

From the minute I landed in Singapore I fell in love with the city  The people  the incredible food  all the things to do  and most importantly   a home while away from home   the Intercontinental Singapore  Superb service  a professional  and fun  staff  well appointed rooms  a beautiful pool  and convenient to everything  I am planning  3 years in advance  another trip to Singapore that will begin at 80 Middle Road  Thanks to everyone at the hotel that made my too brief stay memorable

Really appreciate this hotel  but over time I see need for some changes to little things that might irritate travelers  The first one should be very easy  make the Internet connection easier to hooked up to when you use a smartphone or a tablet  Second  invest a little in the gym as it is a bit small and pretty outdated  I like the club lounge  excellent service there  in the evening  in the morning it is ok with the comment that the breakfast selection is quite a bit smaller as the one downstairs  I d recommend to stay here because of its service  good location  and club lounge  Although I have to admit that part of my reason is that I haven t tried anything else in the area  maybe I should         Room Tip  Include the club lounge and stay in the main buildingSee more room tips

First rate room  very quiet  nice amenities  excellent restaurant with great european and asian inspired breakfast  Within walking distance of Raffles hotel  amp  Singapore river front  Fun  funky shopping center adjacent to the hotel  Enjoy tea in the hotel lounge  A bit pricey but that s what you get in the city with the 3rd highest per capita income in the world Room Tip  Ask for a room overlooking the courtyard See more room tips

My colleagues and I stayed at this hotel for nearly a week during our visit to Singapore  It is a great hotel with staff focused on service and customer satisfaction  Coordinating booking for 9 rooms was not easy  staff at hotel try to help our need  Check in at hotel was really quick and smooth  staff at front desk are the best in the hotel I have to say  I have been upgraded because my gold statue with priority club  Hotel strategically located in the heart of Singapore  Bugis shopping mall is connected with the hotel  Bugis Junction subway station is also part of the complex  It only cost 2 dollars from Airport by subway  amazing  Room is big  bed is comfortable and bathroom is renovated  but the hotel facilities in general are dated  Swimming pool is great on the roof top  Gym is small and dated  spa and sauna are part of changing room at gym  Service at lounge bar and breakfast restaurant are pretty average  really depends on who you get  Quality of breakfast is good but nothing great  Coffee is good and fresh squeezed juice are available but I did not discover until the third day  Breakfast at weekend seems less desirable than during the weekdays  Roti bread can hardly eat during weekend  rock hard  I reported to the hotel lobby manager and she took it very seriously  definitely the quality improved on next day  All in all it was very pleasant stay at this hotel  considering the service provided by the hotel in this unhappy society  I will definitely come back in the future

We stayed in this hotel only for 2 nights  but it s one of the best hotel that we ever stay When we arrived to the hotel  the reception staff was really accommodating  They were asking about our plan  where we would like to go and very eager to provide some information  They also upgraded our room to Junior suite  Wonderful  One of the elderly staff brought us to our room  he showed us all the hotel facilities and once again very eager to provide information Our room was huge  very clean and so beautiful  Bathroom was big and nice  The interior of the room was really classy and there was a touch of vintage  We really love it Too bad the night after we checked in i was sick until we checked out the day after  So i couldn t enjoy my stay as much as i want  But luckily  this hotel is connected to the shopping mall  Bugis Junction  It offered everything that you need  Breakfast in the hotel was good  But too bad in the rush hour  the staff seems to forget you  So no tea coffee  quot pronto quot  and not even a smile  But overall  all the food is delicious  Wonderful pastries and i love the selection of fresh fruit juices  Exquisite We would really love to come back to this hotel  Two thumbs up for Intercontinental that exceeded our expectations

We stayed for 2 nights and enjoyed staying at InterContinental Singapore The staff was very friendly  the breakfast was good  the pool area was nice and the bed was heavenly  The location is great  right next to Bugis Junction and close to both Orchard Road and Clarke Quay  Our room on the 6th floor looked a little tired  but overall that did not affect the comfort of our stay

Enjoyed the hotel on a recent 3 night stay  Great colonial feel in the reception and dinning areas where I had a fantastic breakfast and gives the hotel an air of calm in such a busy city Good location with plenty of shopping and eateries next door in the mall and walkable distances from lots of great sights and other good places to eat  The only little comment was the changing room facilities and the hallway between the health centre and pool were pretty shabby compared to everything else at the hotel

I recently travelled to Singapore for 5 days to visit my young daughter who is working in the fashion industry for 3 months  As this was my first time travelling overseas alone  I wanted to find accommodation which made me feel comfortable and safe  Intercontinental Singapore exceeded my expectations  The location is fantastic  a shopping mall  Bugis Junction  adjacent to the hotel  with a department store  supermarket and numerous small well known shops and a variety of eateries all a couple of minutes away  Having a train stop directly under the shopping mall was very convenient  and with some help from the very friendly locals  so easy to use to explore this beautiful city  Was also very close to Raffles Hotel  overpriced drinks  but a  quot must do quot    Orchard Rd  Clarke Quay  dining and river boat rides   Marina Bay  Chinatown etc  The hotel itself exudes  quot Olde World quot  charm  particularly in the Lobby Lounge  where my daughter and I enjoyed High Tea and late night supper whilst listening to the piano being played  The pool area is lovely  just the place to unwind  however i missed not being able to order a cool drink  as I have done around the pool at other Singapore hotels  The breakfast in Olive Tree was included in my room rate and  whilst there was ample choice  I noticed that  at busy times  the level of service dropped and I could hear adjacent diners having to ask numerous times for cups of tea  coffee  water etc to be delivered to their tables The room  on the 6th floor  was very comfortable  however I would request higher floor next time to get a better view towards Marina Bay  Housekeeping staff were very friendly and efficient  Actually all hotel staff were quick to greet me as I moved around the hotel  which was really lovely  particularly as I was alone most of the time  The Busines Centre Staff were very accommodating of my need to use the internet there daily to keep in touch with family back home and I really appreciated this All in all  I had an excellent experience at Intercontinental Singapore  I am hoping to return there in April for another lovely stay

We chose a club level room as we had just completed a tour of several countries and thought we d appreciate creature comforts  How right we were Our room was lovely and comfortable  Service in the club room was impeccable  Everyone made it their business to know our names and to make certain we had everything we could possibly need  The excellent service helped make our stay on Singapore a wonderful one

First of all this review is based on the assumption that the hotel delivered on what you should expect and I m pleased to say that it didn t disappoint  The rooms was great  great amenities  service and the club lounge is perfect  Great location and ambience the place was a great place to spend a few days and some weekend time  Yes it s a bit more expensive than some but if you catch Expedia on the right day there are deals  Highly recommended if you are planning a stay as a couple or a short business trip you won t be disappointed

We return here because our last visit during IFFS our stay was impeccable  and again this time  Nice room  Junior Suite  Great Service and both the buffet breakfast and dinner are fantastic   Only minor point of attention is the Poor Selection and Replenishment of the Cheese corner  Im a cheese fanatic but everytime I was there i only saw some poor crackers  grapes and leftovers  a bit disappointing since i was a long staying guest  8 days or so  The Service overall in the hotel is great  very friendly staff everywhere  the atmosphere in the hotel is very relaxing and enjoyable  Access to the Metro system is very nearby so going to the EXPO was a piece of cake  See you again soon InterCon Singapore

Superb hotel with great amenities   gym  pool  restaurants  bar with spacious rooms perfect for the business traveller or holiday couple  Situated right on Bugis junction and close to shops but just a short walk from the Marina and other down town areas  Nice chinese malay style interior  Beautifully decorated  Free Wifi and all facilities required in the room   tea coffee  mini bar  iron etc

Right in the centre of Singapore city across the road from Raffles hotel s it has great service  walk into a air conditioned shopping mall if the weather is to humid or hot for your liking  They have a huge communial bar and food area and the choices are excellent  especially hi tea  Would recommend for those who have a couple of nights to see Singapore Room Tip  ask for a room looking outward into the street See more room tips

I stayed here for two weeks on a business trip and thoroughly enjoyed the location  It is not a cheap hotel and you are definitely paying for the location of the property  The interior wasn t all that grand or impressive although there was nothing really to complain about  The bedroom finishes were nice and the bed was soft almost to the extreme  The breakfast in the business lounge was nice  not huge but tasty  I ate in the 1st floor restaurant a few times but it was pretty claustrophobic and loud and they wouldn t let me sit out in the larger room sort of off from the lobby without first filling the entire  quot normal quot  eating area  One complaint I had was that I do not like to have housekeeping service my room every day or even every other day  especially on long business trips since the hotel room becomes my home away from home and I appreciate the privacy  This particular Intercontinental was very persistent on cleaning my room in that they left several slips under the door every day the  quot do no disturb quot  sign was up and also called the room to see if I wanted room service  I understand it is probably their policy to clean the room every day and other hotels I have stayed in did this as well  but for long er term guests  our privacy is very important to us  I wasn t thrilled with the room rate changing several times throughout the stay  I m not sure what the deal was with that but it made filling out expense reports annoying Finally  for the Priority Club members out there  be careful in that most non US Intercontinentals only give you 2 000 points per stay as opposed to the typical 10 points per dollar found in the US and the rest of the IHG group  I definitely missed out on a lot of points because of this  makes me almost wish I would have stayed in the Holiday Inn or Crowne Plaza by the airport  Overall  the people were very nice  especially those in the business lounge  I will probably try a different hotel next time  especially on any longer stays in S pore Room Tip  My room was waaayyy in the back of the building  nearly a 2 minute walk from the lobby  This might n   See more room tips

I stayed here as part of a meeting  4 nights  4 8 March 2013  I paid average rate of SGD300  no breakfast  a night including tax booked via Carlson Wagonlit Travel  I loved the size and spaciousness of my room   it was huge and comfortable  The bed with a super fluffy mattress overlay   felt like I was sleeping on a cloud  It was magic  Best sleep in ages  Pillows were clearly very high quality and I slept soundly  The wallpaper  paint and furniture are due for refurb however   it was somewhat 80 s style with dented paint work on doorways etc  Nevertheless  I enjoyed my stay immensely  the 3 day meeting in Vault I meeting room went very well and the daily lunch at the Olive Tree Buffet Restaurant was superb  Could not fault the choice and variety other than them running out of delicious salmon sushi  You could not want for any food item and the dessert options were just magic  The service throughout the hotel was nothing but totally professional  kind and helpful   10 10 for that  My constructive suggestion is soft refurb for rooms and addition of Nespresso machine in each guest room  Other 4 5 star hotels have that as standard now like Swissotel   and just having a kettle with Nescafe satchel does not cut it at SGD300  a night  incl tax   The minibar was also limited but minibar seems to be going out of vogue now  so you could do away with that now The location above Bugis MRT is excellent   I used MRT to travel a couple of stops to Raffles Place and visit the Merlion Fountain and take some fantastic photos of the laserlight show at the Marina Bay Sands Hotel around 9pm each night  What a sight to see   Then stop for late dinner at Fullerton Hotel   ooh la la  that was nice   All in all  solid business hotel with lovely Lobby to meet for drinks  really nice ambience

InterContinental is one of the best Hotel i stayed  i have visited Singapore many time but this was the best hotel i have stayed  it is a bit expensive but it is worht it  location is very nice  walking distance from the metro station  very close to the river front it has a shopping mall sdjacent to it and it also has many small resturants around the hotel  perfect hotel to stay if you are travelling with family  staff is excellent

after a 5 week tour of n z this was our final stop over before home   i had read good reviews on trip advisor and the hotel lived up to all reviews beautiful bedroom with whiter then white sheets lovely cosy bed and pillows   bath room good size with plenty of white fluffy towels and robes   slippers laid out by your bed and bed turned down nightly   lovely attentive charming staff in breakfast room and loads of choice from cereal to full english omelette fresh fruit yoghurts   cheese cold meats etc   keep up the good work intercontinental you did us proud   pool area kept lovely and clean and so quiet  Room Tip  15 th floor lovely view of singapore sky lineSee more room tips

We returned again for our annual visit to the Intercontinental  This is home away from home in Singapore  For us it is a resort in the city  Great location near Bugis MRT  near Orchard and for us a nice walk to Little India and Arab  Clarke Quay and Fullerton We arrived a few days early since we were in transit to leave some of our bags  We were met again by Peter Kan whose new title is Lobby ambassador  We first met him when he was managing the Club Lounge  He remembered us from the past and then whisked our bags away and we were off to our next stop  Upon our return a few days later Peter whisked us up to the Club Lounge for check in  We are Ambassador Platnium which may help but we were upgraded to a junior suite for our 6 night stay  Peter then returned bringing me upstairs to check out the room while my wife settled into the lounge for tea time  All of our bags were waiting for us  The suite was large similar to the deluxe room in general layout but the bed is in a large alcove  As always the bed was very fluffy and comfortable  The bath and shower excellent with large fluffy bath towels and bathrobes  The only issue I have with the room and the rooms in general is that there are not enough draws for longer stays  We used the TV stand cabinet but for an elegant hotel It would be better if they had draws cabinet  The work desk is comfortable with 2 outlets  Wi Fi was generally good  though it did seem slow at times Our favorite part of the hotel is the Club  While it is expensive 90   day we use it nominally all day  We have a full breakfast  have drinks for the day  and have the cocktail hours  The cocktail hours basically makes up our dinner so we generally don t need to go out after 7 30 for anything unless we want to go somewhere  The food quality and quality is excellent  For us the only issue is when you stay for 6 days you start to cycle through some of the same hot items  though as long as the food is good it is a quibble  The best part for us is the service  Generally the people there have been there long term and remember us and our drink orders from prior times  This trip Vivian basically took  quot personal care quot  of us though it appears she does that with others in the lounge  My wife wanted a condiment for breakfast not normally found in the Club  Vivian found it and every day brought it to the table just after we sat down  On her vacation day she had her  quot delegate quot  do it for her  Definitely  excellent service  Jana Kwasnik  the manager has a very good team  Nana  Raj  Ann  Eva    and the place runs smoothly  The people are very open to tell us about where they are from and what they like and dislike  This gives us a good perspective on SE Asia where most of the people are from  Some people may not like that but it is what makes the Hotel very human not faceless Since we had a 7 00 plane we checked out the night before and arranged an early wakeup call and coffee  on time   We still highly recommend this hotel and will be back next year Room Tip  Add the club to any roomSee more room tips

My family and I stayed in late March 2013 on a long weekend  Well appointed rooms  including comfortable beds  pillow menu  good soundproofing  Shower and bath combo was also appreciated  The buffet breakfast was copious  diverse  including a few Asian and Indian dishes   Location is excellent  close to the Raffles and central district  Specifically  Mr  Kelvin was particuarly helpful prior to and during our stay  making sure our needs were met  We will certainly return to this property on our next trip to Singapore

We have stayed at this hotel a number of times and our experiences have been positive  However this time our first day and night was very uncomfortable  To be fair this may have been the outcome of the staff trying too hard to please   for example  after a four hour wait for a room we were shown to a large suite on the top floor  The room had obviously not been used for a long time and when getting ready for bed we found the toilet leaking across the bathroom floor  The repairs took an hour and a half before we could retire   there were more problems but further description is not helpful The next morning we spoke to the deputy club manager and explained why we were disappointed  From that moment the situation changed   the manager  Ms Anna Lau  immediately set about making the rest of our stay very enjoyable  Well done     Overall  in comparison the our stay at the Intercontinental Hong Kong a few weeks earlier  the Singapore facility lacked the quality control and overall service standard of the its sister hotel  Club refreshments were of much lower standard  However the Club itself is outstanding in regard to its fittings and comfort We will return because the location of the hotel is very convenient and the Club facility is quiet good  However another faulty start such as we experienced on this trip will point us to another hotel chain Room Tip  Request a room facing the pool for the best view  We do not like the   39 shop front  39  club room   See more room tips

Second time at this hotel  Last time a few years ago in a Deluxe Room  this time I chose a Club Room  The moment you walk into this hotel you feel welcomed  comfortable and start to relax  The Club room was supremely comfortable with all the amenities you might need  The Staff in the Club Lounge were wonderful  The food and drinks presented in the Club Lounge were top quality and it was a pleasant  quiet place to relax  Staff took care of you and I looked forward to walking into the Club Lounge each time  The Reception Lobby area and the Lounge are beautifully decorated  I thoroughly enjoyed my stay and the hotels location makes it a great choice for both business or leisure travellers

A 5 day stay in a luxury suite  with a balcony that overlooks the marketplace is magnificent  Ambassitor membership had us upgraded to this room with access to the club lounge  the club lounge provides  substantial breakfast catering for eastern  western and continental palates  Afternoon tea was amazing and a two hour cocktail  happy hour  every evening was brilliant  The Hotel was next door to the bugis shopping complex  a great shopping experience  Service at the Intercontinental has been 2nd to none  I will definitely stay here next time I m in Singapore

We stayed here on our way home from 6 weeks in Australia and it was pure luxury from start to finish It is a bit tricky to find as it is accessed from a shopping mall but as soon as you walk through the door you know you are in a 5 star hotel  Service was excellent and you are made to feel so welcome by all staff who cannot do enough to help The room was a good size with a king size bed and decent sized bathroom with separate shower cubicle The rooftop pool and spa were amazing as was the restaurant I could have stayed weeks here and would definitely go back if I was in Singapore  Highly recommended

I stayed at the InterConti for 3 nights on a business trip  The hotel is spacious  luxurious and welcoming  After a less than satisfactory hotel experience in HK directly before this felt like heaven  Rooms are large and well appointed with very comfortable beds  The hotel has decent facilities such a fitness centre and outdoor pool  I managed to get a good deal on Expedia   luxury accommodation at a very fair price  book well ahead seems to be the best approach  Food and drink are relatively expensive  but that is to be expected in a 5 star establishment  In summary I thoroughly recommend this hotel for your next visit to Singapore

Stayed at the Intercon for 4 nights in March   verry happy with the choice  Liked the location  attached to a newer shopping center to help escape the heat  amp  Bugis Junction nearby has stalls galore  Walking distance  15 mins  to  quot little India quot   amp  the riverfront  Arab Street abiout 10 mins  Marina  amp  Chinatown a quick cab ride away  Raffles Hotel 2 blocks Rooms  sevice  amp  amenities all superb  Pool a little on the small side  but still OK for laps  Great bfast buffet  Excellent staff

I go to Singapore every month and this is my preferred hotel  It is great for business trips due to its location  It is an old hotel and that translates to large rooms  It is also over the MRT which is a great advantage especially during peak hours or rain when getting taxis is tough  I would recommend the breakfast there as well as the Japanese restaurant  The service and attention by all staff members are commendable  Would definitely recommend

A great hotel with friendly and helpful staff  My husband and I Stayed here for 5 nights during the Easter holidays the location is really good as it is connected to the Bugis mall which is also connected to the MRT which made getting around singapore very easy  It s just a few minutes walk to the Raffles mall  Also the Hop on Hop off bus stop is 2 mins walk away The staff are incredibly helpful  Our first night we did have a issue with noisey next door guest at 1am disturbing our sleep after a 18 hr flight  However 1ph call to the front desk manager and it was sorted  We even got a fruit basket and chocolates the next morning as a apology for the disturbance  Going that extra mile to make us feel welcome and ensuring that we have a pleasant stay was very much appreciated     They do have very comfy beds and a nice choice of pillows  We loved the turndown service as well Thank you for making our stay so comfortable

The Intercontinental was great for business trips 15 years ago and now is just as memorable for our family trip to Singapore  The location is very good and the staff really goes the extra mile to help  My husband had a bout with kidney stones during our stay and the staff helped connect him with a specialist at Raffles the same day and assisted us with many unplanned follow ups at the hospital for 3 days  They pampered us with a free upgrade and suggested their club plan which was so worth it  The club does a great happy hour which makes the whole experience so comfortable  The breakfast was another highlight with a wonderful selection and excellent coffee  So impressed

I was here on a flying visit and it s a beautiful hotel  Breakfast buffet was excellent  Despite me being a platinum Priority Club member  they weren t able to guarantee late check out and confirmed upon checkout that I wasn t entitled to any points  as I had booked through a 3rd party for the room   I also felt rushed during breakfast  waiters hovering over me waiting me to take my dish or plate as soon as it was empty  and upon checkout  they had simply cut me off from the wifi access I had in my room  I d like to feel a valued customer  not just simply seen as trying to get me in and out of the room breakfast  etc Room Tip  Ask to not have a room overlooking Bugis Junction   very bright and noisySee more room tips

Again and again  I ve stayed in Intercontinental Hotel Singapore  and the stay never disappoint me  I ve stayed there a couple of times both as a couple and with my children  the standard of service is excellent  Thank you Fiona  from front desk  who help sort out my room stay  as an ambassador  I had a free night weekend stay  but was struggling to book the right rates to qualify  Service from the staff of Intercontinental Singapore were top notch for me and my family  Will look forward to coming back

Arrival  We arrived at about 7pm and were brought to the club lounge for check in as I am a Royal Ambassador  The staff checked us in and I asked about dress code to the lounge as I saw a couple of guests walk into the lounge in shorts and flip flops  The staff advised that they try to enforce a no shorts policy but it seems that it is not working as per my daily observations Room  The hotel kindly upgraded us into the Ambassador Suite second highest room type   The room was large and beautiful albeit looking dated  But the view from the room made up for the dated look of the room Staff  It is unfortunate that the doormen never opened the door for us when we walked in or left the property  I only remember the door being opened once as we left the property on the last day  The lounge staff was very nice  especially Raj  some of the other staff seem to be in another world especially when you have to make 3 requests for a drink  Overall most of the staff was pleasant  The evening finger food provided in the lounge were usually deep fried and I avoided the evening service on 2 occasions We tried the gym in the hotel and it was adequate  I asked for ankle weights to work out on my legs as I have knee replacements but was advised by the gym staff that they do not carry these weights as not all gyms provide them  Overall I had 2 reservations at this property  one for 1 night and another for 3 nights but was surprised to only receive one arrival gift for the 2 stays Yes  I will recommend this property as the location is excellent and the breakfast spread is very good Room Tip  Try to book a Club RoomSee more room tips

We are leaving here tomorrow  and will certainly miss service  both the front desk and especially the concierge  Having traveled through Europe and Americas  we have not come across such warm and welcoming  friendly service staff before  Special mention for Swathi at the concierge desk  who made us feel like family  with excited welcome and wonderful suggestions  at times better than our tour guides in the city  Wish we could bring her home with us    Rooms are spacious  we were in 1208   but not really a view here  since hotel is located in the business district  and other high rises block the view  There is an updated bathroom with separate shower and soaking tub  and a pillow menu to choose from  Wifi is included  even though our reservation did not say it  There is a nice outdoor pool and a wonderful breakfast  make sure to get in included To get the best rate  we booked through Intercontinental website  where rates were better than those offered locally or by travel engines  like Expedia All in all  a great experience  not a single negative comment here  If we ever come back  will stay here Room Tip  ask for a higher floor  although people living downstairs were just as happySee more room tips

Amazing hotel I would put it in the same basket as versace on the goldcoast if not better   Rooms beautifully appointed bathroom is amazing had a great soak in the bath after a very long flight   Wifi in room is fantastic   Make sure you get the buffet included in the room you book   Omlette station is great   Pillow menu is also 5 star   I wish we could have stayed longer but have to carry on with our trip today

I loved the classic Peranakan style of this hotel  My room on the 15th floor was elegant and spacious  with a king size bed  sitting area and workstation  and a large bathroom with tub and separate shower  As an Ambassador member  I had access to the Club Lounge  which served delicious breakfast each day  as well as afternoon tea and evening cocktails and snacks  However  It is the service that deserves special mention at the Intercontinental Singapore   absolutely nothing was too much trouble for the helpful and attentive staff  who made my stay a pleasure from start to finish This is a true five star experience  and I hope to return again soon

I recently stayed in a Shophouse suite at the Intercontinental Singapore  The suite was beautifully decorated and in pristine shape  Everything was luxurious  the linens  woodwork  chandeliers and fixtures  The balcony overlooked a former street  now an indoor shopping mall which may not be to everyone s liking  However it was true to its Shophouse history  Noise was not a problem  The hotels service was exemplary and all staff members were helpful  friendly and accomodating  The location was very convenient and centrally located  only two blocks from the venerable Raffles hotel and shopping  Raffles was fun to visit but very busy with tourists  me included  I would highly recommend a stay at the Intercontinental Singapore

We stayed three nights and as a Platinum member we got upgraded to a lovely room  Singapore can get hot  sticky and crowded but once you step through the hotel doors you instantly relax in the cool  beautifully appointed public areas which have the colonial Pernakatan style  This was our 10th wedding anniversay treat and the hotel laid on wine and fruit basket each day which was a lovely touch  The breakfast buffet choice was plentiful with good choice of both local and Western food and it changed from day to day which was pleasing  The facilities in our room were top class from the bedding to the toiletries  Location is ideal near to Bugis market and with the excellent MRT  subway  system almost below the hotel  Throughout our stay the staff were most helpful and friendly and we had a wonderful time

Booked a shophouse club room for my wife s Birthday Celebration  The staff at the club lounge were really nice and presented her with an awesome chocolate cake which we took nearly 2 days to finish  The room was great although the toilet had a little funny damp smell to it  We aired the room for a bit and it went away in less than half an hour  The bed was really comfortable and we loved the decor  It s a nice place to hide away and is really quiet  Shopping is just downstairs and across the road at bugis village so it s really convenient  The club lounge is the biggest we have ever been to  Evening cocktails are a MUST  The champagne is great and we almost couldn t stop eating the finger food  Service is excellent and unobtrusive  Will definitely come again Breakfast at the Olive Tree restaurant was only so so  Nothing fantastic about it

I love the hotel lobby lounge   its high ceiling with art nouveau peranakan style painting on the ceiling  At the same time  you find the combination of Eastern and Victorian style decor  It s very relaxing to sit down  have a cup of tea and read a book  We stayed in a deluxe room which was huge  The bed was very comfortable  We had everything we need for  My parents stayed in business room  same size but on the higher floor   The hotel is next to Bugis MRT station and plenty of shops and dining areas surrounding it  Fitness room is open for 24 hours  Breakfast was serves in Olive Tree restaurant  Fresh juice daily and plenty of selection  I recommend people to stay here for convenience  spacious room and very friendly staff Room Tip  Deluxe room is huge  If you have extra cash to spend  ask for club room See more room tips

Despite it s age  this hotel maintains a wonderful grandeur  Rooms are larger and wonderfully appointed  and everything about the facility is top notch  All the small touches you d expect are there  from premium bathroom sundries in room to comfy slippers  and exquisite bedding The service and attention is simply sublime  You cant get too far without being greeted  or having someone ask how they can assist  Overall  a lack of pretention    They really  quot get it quot  in the true Asian style

I stayed for one night at the intercontinental in Singapore and I have to say it is the best room I have stayed in  I had a club room and as an ambassador I was upgraded to a suite along with 2 colleagues who were travelling with me and I had booked the rooms  We were treated extremely well and the food at the Chinese restaurant in the hotel was exquisite  Well done Intercontinental Singapore for such a great experience

Away from the busy Singapore  Intercontinental hotel has provided a very relaxing stay  It has been an enjoyable stay and the location incredibly convenient at Bugis  right in the heart of shopping  MRT is a few minute walk from Bugis MRT  I was here for 2 nights and was provided the business executive room on level 14  which meant housekeeping twice per day  morning newspaper  complimentary fruits  chocolates  internet and breakfast was included  The bathroom was exceptionally clean and well maintain given its that the hotel is quite old but full of rich character The service was exceptionally good  For exampleGreat communication with the hotel staff  I had scheduled a meeting during my stay  the day I checked in my client could not make it and had phone up Hotel reception earlier  I received letter from the hotel staff informing this as well  PROSuperb service  warm and welcoming right from reception to dining staff to room cleaners  King size bed  soft pillow varietyvery neat and tidy  Wide variety of breakfast choice from western  bacon and eggs   singaporean  chinese  congee  rice   to indian curries  CONSThe hotel room does smell slightly damp when i first walked inRoom Phone was sightly dirty  odd odour Room rates can be expensive for some Room Tip  Business executive rooms are worth itSee more room tips

I only stayed a night here but it was thoroughly worth it  I dreaded having to wait until 2pm to check in as I d arrived at 6am  but the hotel reception had a fabulous Peranakan Room available when I arrived at 7am   seven stars for that much appreciated touch  The room was not what I d requested  but I regard it as even better  fitted out in a traditional timbered style  with beautiful furnishings and appointments  It is only a floor above street level  so not too private and no view  but you can easily cocoon yourself here and forget about what is outside  I chose the IC because it partly consists of a historic restored section  with all the character  spaciousness and scale not many hotels have  And it is very elegant without being gimmicky and brash Much appreciated also was the selection of teas and coffees  choice of pillows and the softest bed experience in a long time I can t really fault any aspect of my stay   although the room is on the other side of the main lobby from tower and pool  so you need to walk through the public areas with shorts and flip flops past all the business people if you re heading to the gym or pool Also my room was serviced three times in the short twenty hours stay I had   that s service The hotel is also very conveniently connected to shops and Bugis MRT all undercover   a very central location Certainly lives up to the ICH reputation  Loved it Room Tip  If you would like a characterful room   would recommend the ones fitted out in the Peranakan style   See more room tips

Stayed here for three nights recently  We usuall stay in Chinatown or the Orchard area  so was not sure what to expect staying around the Bugis Civic area  It turned out to be an excellent location   a short walk to the colouful Arab Street and Little India  and just a few stops on the MRT from Orchard Road and other sites  such as the highly recommended Gardens By the Bay   The hotel is also attached to the Bugis Junction shopping mall  which has quite an interesting design incorporating old shophouses in an air conditioned atrium arcade The hotel itself is showing some of its nearly 20 year age in places  but overall I think it is a beautfiul and classy hotel  The soaring lobby lounge is undoubtedly the highlight of the hotel  The pool deck is a little small but still provides a nice respite on a hot afternoon  One of the highlights was the excellent breakfast  I have never seen such a wide array of food available covering Chinese  Malay  Indian and  English American   nor such freshness  all eggs are cooked to order  not sat stewing in a bain marie swamp  Our room was spacious  beautifully furnished and comfortable  The bed was lovely  My only niggle was that the door to the corrdior was a bit thin and I could hear more than I wanted to  There are plenty of eating options around the hotel  as there is everywhere in Singapore  Apart from the huge array of options in the mall  there are also at least three hawker centres nearby  just look underneath the public housing complexes   a large open air market  and a few streets with rows of shophouses containing a range of eateries and bars  The Bugis train station is attached to the hotel A great hotel in a great city

Taxi from the airport about S 23  which was WAY WAY less than what the hotel wanted for an airport pick up  Check in was efficient and the room  King Double  nice and spacious  very comfortable bed with all the usual amenities you expect of a hotel like the Intercontinental  Breakfast buffet was plentiful with a decent enough spread on offer ?  although for

Faithfully a fan of S pore s oriental touch and its Western savvy   My family and I have patronized this hotel since year 2006  Loved its lounge  its people  its comfort  One could expect hygiene in the bundle of what s called the basics in S pore  To our surprise  the Intercon SG has turned into a backyard guesthouse represented by untrained staffs at the lounge and especially in housekeeping  Hygiene alarm  Dirty towel in the wash basin and repulsively stained toilet all in one greeted our arrival  Never mind  we were upset enough that they placed us at the far end above the shop lot whereby getting there from the lobby meant a footpath through the maze of neverland  With a sleeping toddler slung over the shoulder  pushing through multiple doors and simultaneously yanking a stroller up and down the stairways  like those in the opera house minus a few steps   weren t quite a solicited adventure  So tired we jumped in bed to nap hoping to beat the jet lag later  And so we thought we were invited to a cocktail at the club floor as it s included in the room  We showed up  but a very kind lady quickly appeared before we entered the room  offered us the idea of a kid friendly party place  Too appealing for parents  We were ushered all the way down to a sectioned space behind the piano  behind the grand lounge  By this time  we became more cynical  But that s okay  Let s see what they have to offer  The mislabeled fancy cocktail arrived  kid still waiting to see what the play  quot room quot  has to offer  We politely asked for some crayons and drawing paper  Then dusted our butt and healed away  We then asked the concierge for a place nearby to find cooling tea  taking advantage of Asia s herbal wonders  The Malay concierge sent me to China Town  Asked a fine gentleman who was guarding the door towards Bugis junction  We appreciated him much more than the desk  On our way out  bell service was incredibly slow  My husband helped to load the luggages into a maxi cab which was by the way growing fungus inside  tipped the bell service of hotel  got in the cab  The concierge  bell service team turned their back before our door was shut to embark  We were frankly quite amused  The only fine experiences were the quality of bed perched in a spacious room and the rooftop swimming pool  One noticeable difference from previous experience  housekeeping team was no longer the cheerful Singaporean aunties but a young fleet of foreigners  Missing the old touch of authentic Intercon  A far distance in terms of service quality from Intercon Kowloon HK

Yet another excellent stay at this hotel  As ever the service levels were exemplary especially in the Club Lounge  our thanks to Raj for his amusing anecdotes and especially to Jana  i hope that s right   for the very fast in room check in service after being met at the hotel entrance We had a complimentary upgrade to a Shophouse room which was very comfortable and immaculately presented  This is a hotel where the people really do care and just don t go through the motions like some others  Highly recommended Room Tip  A club room with breakfast included represents good value as opposed to buying breakfast separately See more room tips

The building is grand  and the rooms are nice  The service  however  was bad enough that I don t plan to ever return  I tried to book a taxi to the airport when I arrived at reception  I was told that I needed a van that would cost  75 for the 15 minute ride  I paid less than  20 for the taxi from the airport to the hotel   I asked the concierge for the stationwagon size taxi like the one that brought me to the airport  and the concierge said he would book one  The day before I was set to leave  I went to the concierge to confirm the booking  and he  another staffer  said the concierge booked the van  When I told him I requested the stationwagon  he called the cab company  then told me it was not available on such short notice  I asked him why it wasn t booked earlier  but he didn t know and didn t look into it  I then contacted the manager and asked him why my request was ignored  At first the manager claimed that the sort of car I requested could not be booked  I told the manager that wasn t true    the concierge had tried to book the specific car I wanted and failed only because it wasn t available  not because it couldn t be done  The manager then claimed that the hotel doesn t use the cab company that offers the type of car I wanted because it s a small  unreliable company  I m not sure that s true  but the inconsistent answers from the manager and concierge cast doubt on everything they said to excuse their shortcomings  In the end  the price difference didn t bother me much  since I had to pay extra in advance booking and other surcharges anyways  But the experience with the concierge and manager was bad enough to dampen my trip to Singapore and make me wish I had decided to stay elsewhere

Fantastic Hotel with exceptional staff and service  Upgraded to a suite on the Club floor and it was spectacular  Huge suite with 5 star furnishings and amenities  The Club Loounge is spaceous with beautiful decor but I wish that they would have inforced the  no shorts and thongs  rule  We were advised on check in of this but each time we visited the Lounge there were guests there is shorts adn thongs  I understandf that it is diffucult to enforce this without taking the rick iof having then an unhappy guest but for those who adhere to the rule does t look good  The staff are very professional and friendly  Great breakfast in the Club Lounge

I booked a club room for one night and upon check in was upgraded to a Shophouse room  The young man checking me in  walked me to my room  He explained a few things and wished me a nice stay  The room itself was nice with a very comfortable bed  I faced the outside street but had zero noise  none  The bathroom was large with good pressure  I really like the rooms at this hotel  I have stayed here many times before but always just booked a normal room  The club lounge was very large but honestly I was not all that impressed  I arrived at 7pm and most of the food was gone  The staff were very busy getting drinks for people and cleaning up  I found it odd they were not replacing the cheese  and other food  I did have a nice charming Indian man ask me my preferred beverage once I sat down  I had two glasses of wine and it was 730pm  On the minute they started clearing everything out  At other hotels in Singapore  Conrad  Hilton  MO  Ritz  even when the  quot happy hour quot  is over there is no rush to clear things  Not here at the Intercon  It was like a race to see how fast they could clear the wine and booze away  The food really did not matter because as I stated before   7pm it was empty anyway  Overall I like this hotel  It has a good location connected to the small mall  The beds are great  However I really was shocked at the club lounge  Not impressed at all with the service and food

Got upgraded to a Shophouse room as I had joined the Ambassador Club  Room was comfortable and well appointed Couple of little niggles such as the light switch arrangement wasnt very obvious   press switch twice to turn off reading lights  Bose system didnt recognise my iPhone etc And most annoying was a wifi system which required several attempts to get their login page including a requirement to clear cache and cookies on a few attempts  There must be a simpler system   certainly seems to be in pretty much every other hotel I have ever stayed at  Although I recall the ITG in Agra had a weird system as well  I would have thought the need for complex usernames and passwords was pretty much behind us   who is going to steal their data allowance Anyway  the hotel is very attractive in a colonial way  the nibbles and breakfast in the Club were very good  Drink selection was pretty mediocre   Johnny Walker Red  really  However they rose to the occasion and got me a Macallan on request Easy walk through mall to Bugis MTR  taxis were readily available The real winner at the hotel was the staff who were all very helpful  professional and pleasant  Well done Oh  and some fabulous flower arrangements   kudos to whoever does them

Colonial style hotel is in an excellent location and directly connected to a mall and the Bugis MRT  The mall food court is a great place to get a quick bite  a sweet treat  or a morning coffee  Staff at the hotel are excellent   very friendly and helpful  Room was spacious and had digital A C which worked great  The bathroom could use an update  The main lobby is beautiful  with old world furnishings and gorgeous chandeliers Room Tip  Our room faced the side street  and was very quiet See more room tips

Family of four stayed for 2 nights  Location s great  very convenient  The standard room was clean and bathroom was spacious and clean  However the service was below average compared to other intercontinental I had stayed    Standard service was fine  but do not even bother with personalised service  Staffs at the front desk were unwilling to help and always gave you excuses why they cannot help you  I do not recommend anyone to stay there  Better value elsewhere

Hotel is well situated and exactly what you would expect from a 5 star corporate hotel  Service was excellent  we arrived early  1 30  but room was ready and porters were very helpful  Location of the hotel is excellent   handy for the traditional Raffles treats and also within walking distance of the main attractions  Near to metro link which provides a cheap and efficient way of getting around Singapore and is not at all threatening at night Room Tip  Great location   Raffles is just down the road See more room tips

I have stayed at this hotel many times but by recent experience of the Shophouse Club room highlights why this is still my favourite choice in this city  Spacious and luxurious  the room is a pleasure to spend time in  even if the view is only of the adjacent  and sometimes noisy  shopping mall  The club lounge is outstanding and well worth the extra cost

My wife and I stayed 6 nights in a Club room at the InterContinental March 22 28  2013  We have stayed there many times since the hotel opened in the mid 90 s  The reason we always return to this hotel is it never fails to deliver 5 star service in a very good location  As soon as we entered the hotel we were greeted by Peter who has worked there since the opening and he remembered our names  He escorted us to the Club for check in and we were in our beautiful  upgraded room in minutes  From that point things just got better  The Club was up to their usual high standards with a new concept  no children during cocktail hour  Great idea  I like children but the Club is a place to relax and have a drink without dealing with noisy kids  They provide another place with the same benefits for parents with children  The food selection and wines were excellent  We had the option of breakfast in the club or the restaurant  We went for the restaurant and the selection and service was excellent  I could go on but to sum it up we wouldn t think of staying anywhere else in Singapore  This hotel maintains high standards and it s one of those places you hate to leave  Thank you InterContinental Singapore  We will see you again Room Tip  Try a Club room  The benefits are worth the extra cost  We were in room 601 which was large  well ap   See more room tips

The Hotel just looks colonial  with beautiful while shuttered windows and white concrete  It s near a great local mall  with direct access  and near the Arab quarter  interesting and fun  The service is just as you d expect from an Intercon  Breakfast is of high quality and the foyer is spectacular  If you get a chance  go the Club lounge Loved it  and great great views Room Tip  Get a room overlooking the Mall See more room tips

5 star service from start to finish   My wife and I spent 3 nights there prior to going on a nine night cruise to Vietnam   I can honestly say this is one the best Hotels we have ever stayed in the staff demonstrated customer service at a very high level and the club facilities were absolutely fantastic thank you Intercontinental for providing first class service  Room Tip  Go for a club room with free cocktails and food from 5 8pmSee more room tips

I love the location of this hotel  I also think that the staff do a great job  however some attention is needed in housekeeping to the fittings and fixtures which are getting a bit worn and shabby We had a club room which was superbly fitted some years ago however there were the previous occupants used slippers under the bed  very scratched wooden floors and furniture Club lounge not up to the usual Intercontinental standard       very odd opening hours There are so any top class hotels in Singapore  this one should have a good look around if it does not want to bereft behind Room Tip  Higher floors are probably the quietestSee more room tips

Stayed here last minute after altering holiday plans and was not disappointed  The staff all went out of their way to make us and our one year old feel at home and nothing was too much trouble  The pool area like the whole hotel was spotless  just wish it had been a tad warmer but got used to it   The room  319  was spacious and the bed super comfy  I struggled to get up in the morning till I went for breakfast  The choices at the breakfast was superb I ve never feasted so well     Location was great for restaurants  shops and for hopping onto the metro to get to the botanical gardens and other sights  We did eat twice in the restaurant  The first night a la carte steaks and burger reasonably ok not massive portions but nicely presented  The second night we had the buffet not sure if they alter this but if you love seafood and they don t you are in for a treat  There salad section was a sight with different fish   oysters  prawns  lobster tails and clams etc as not into fish a bit urgh to me but lots of folk seemed to be tucking in  I was fasinated with the desert area and put the pounds on as there was so much choice inc a chocolate fountain  Yummy  Id return and recommend for food  comfy spacious room  professional helpful staff and the cleanliness  Thanks for making our end holiday a treat

This was our fifth stay in this charming hotel and we wouldn t stay anywhere else  Staff were all unfailingly helpful and polite  We always stay in Club rooms and find them excellent value for the increased amenities  Pool area is adequate although we re not the sort to lie by the pool all day so it was fine for a cool down swim and Singapore Sling  Location excellent  On previous stays we had thought some rooms were looking a little tired although on this occasion we were in a newly renovated  shop front  room which was spacious and very quiet  The Intercontinental is not the sexiest hotel in Singapore but if you re looking for a beautiful gracious hotel  we think this is unbeatable

Well   I wouldn t come back to the hotel if it weren t great  right Was staying here on March 28th  for only one night with family  I call in for check in on a very short notice  due to a very bad experience with another accommodation in the city  and we need to escape fast Was served well  and they even give me an early check in   on such a short notice  we checked into our room at 9AM in the morning  and manage to take a sleep after a horrible sleepless night in the other hotel My daughter was tripped on the street just in front of the hotel  when I call the for a first aid kit  the receptionist was concerned and asked whether we re OK and need a doctor  My 5 years old daughter love the hotel too   and looked quite sad when we need to check out   p yuli amalia adinda Room Tip  We were staying on the second floor area  on the right side of the hotel  which does not equip with   See more room tips

Built in the  quot Old Colonial Hotel quot  style  it has very large  well appointed rooms  Good internet service  Every amenity I have ever seen in a hotel anywhere was provided The service was just ok  the bellmen were befuddled when several guests requested airport cabs at the same time in the morning  I just got aggressive and hailed one from the street The maids and room service were tops  though the room service prices would make a NY hotelier blush The location was not so good for me    would have preferred to be closer to China Town or the Harbor  but for most I m sure the local is great The most breathtaking aspect of this hotel is the price  Perhaps Singapore hotels are really all this expensive     if so  I m signing up for Priceline com or HotelTonight com     or staying in Malaysia

This was our first time at InterContinental Singapore and we were impressed with the location and the hotel rooms  As we arrived at the hotel in the evening there wasn t anybody to welcome the arriving guests  Staff at the reception were very process driven and we didn t them smiling or even offering any assistance  We mentioned at the desk it was our first time in Singapore but staff couldn t care less  During our stay we have few service issues and manager promised to look into the problem but never came back to us with any solution  overall  great location  nice rooms but bad service to push anyone away

This was my fourth stay over the past 5 6 years  As usual  the staff were extremely professional and helped to fix my room booking swiftly at check in  i had booked the wrong room type   Located at Bugis Junction  the hotel is close to many local hawker centres and nice restaurants  For tourists and business travellers alike this hotel is perfect  I will stay here next time I m in Singapore

The InterContinental Singapore is just one of the amazing hotels owned by the InterContinental Group  As soon as we checked into the hotel  we received a warm welcome by the a very friendly doorman  We were escorted to the inspiringly decorative check in where the hotel staff smoothly checked us into the hotel  The lady who checked us in soon brought us to the lift  It was an overall amazing check in experience  When we arrived in the room  we were greeted with a plate of fresh fruits and a letter that welcomes us  The morning breakfast offers amazing food with a huge selection  from Asian cuisine all the way to French Food  As the Lunar New Year in between our stay period  the management  present us with oranges and a red envelope  Our 4 night stay was concluded with a friendly check out

Enjoyed another great stay at the Intercontinental  I was fortunate to stay on the club floor and in one of the shophouse rooms  which are tremendous  I m happy to report the Club was better than ever   service is first class  special mention must go to Raj  who kept us entertained with his constant one liners  not to mention drink service  and nothing is too much trouble  Staying with Club access costs more but I feel it is completely worth it  If there is a reservation to be had it is  as one or two others have mentioned  with the pool  which is not huge and could benefit from a bit of a makeover  That said  I don t consider this a huge deal and there is plenty else about the hotel   in particular  the location  at Bugis  is sensational   that continues to make it five star for me

We went to Singapore for a quick trip around Easter time and fell in love with the city and the Intercontinental  The hotel is in an excellent location for walking to many of the sites you ll want to see  but it is also next to the Bugis subway stop which makes it super convenient when going further afield  Of course  the taxis are an excellent way to get around the city too and they re always readily available We had a beautiful room with Club access so we checked in via the Club  The women staffing the Club desk were very friendly and so helpful with advice and suggestions for things to see or do  They greet everyone warmly when you come in and wish you a pleasant day on the way out  The Club itself isn t huge but is very comfortable and has a great mix of seating areas and tables set up for a nice mix  plus they have cleverly used carved wooden screens to divide the room and keep the noise down at the same time  The warm materials make the room very relaxing and enjoyable  The food and beverage selection are great with a ton of options for breakfast and in the evening  and then a nice sampling of snacks in the afternoon with tea  Everyone is so friendly and the service was really great  We really liked that at breakfast time you could order your egg dish directly from the chef  They all made beautiful omelettes that weren t overdone in the slightest and they were generous with the fillings of your choice too  Since Singapore is so hot and humid  this was a great place to retreat to in the afternoon for tea or something cold to drink  a few snacks and lots of air conditioning The room was really lovely with shutters on the windows and a beautiful wood floor  The bed was so comfortable and the linens were excellent  I had my best nights of sleep in probably almost three months there  after a long series of hotels and serviced apartments   Even though our room overlooked a busy road we couldn t hear any of the outside noise in our room  And the air conditioning worked beautifully and kept us nice and cool in the hot Singapore weather  We also loved the big bathroom with the wonderful shower and big vanity  it wasn t a sprawling room or bathroom but they were perfectly sized  warm and inviting  and really relaxing The hotel and staff are absolutely wonderful and we will definitely be back on future visits to Singapore  I d highly recommend the Intercontinental to anyone paying a visit to Singapore whether for business or leisure Room Tip  I  39 d always suggest a Club room but this hotel really makes it worth it since the Club Lounge is   See more room tips

We experienced service  courtesy  and attention to our needs given graciously and abundantly by all staff persons from the front desk  wait staff  and other personnel  Our room had every comfort we expected  comfortable beds  quality linens  spacious bathroom  internet  good view of the city  and discrete housekeeping  The excellent breakfast buffet had an ample array of options from various cultures and tastes  All public areas exuded a sense of tranquility  This hotel is conveniently located adjacent to a mall that includes restaurants  shopping  and near colorful neighborhoods  eg   Little India  amp  Arab Street  Our three night stay is memorable

In Singapore for business and decided to try the InterContinental  April 25 28   Booked a business type package that included breakfast  laundry service  and internet  Appreciated an attentive staff and simply a very pleasant and comfortable environment in an excellent location  Previously stayed at the Pan Pacific  on Raffles  which was also a good experience  IC was a nice change and highly recommend for value and comfort  I will definitely stay there again Room Tip  Enjoyed visiting the Singapore Art Museum  within walking distance  See more room tips

We stayed in 2 interconnecting rooms from 27 30 April as we were 2 adults  amp  4 children  BookingDespite making our requests clear through the online booking 5 months before  calling to double check our requirements are known and even emailing Inn of reservations 2 days before arrival  a cot bed was still missing when we arrived  ServicePeter Kan the Lobby Ambassador has been wonderful showing us great nearby eats of local food  and even helping to push the baby stroller across the busy road  But pool is a big disappointment and the pool service is atrocious  The pool was very small  not well maintained with screeching crows hanging around to get at food scraps  Service was even worse  When we went at about 4pm  there was only 1 guy who looked very unwilling to work there  The place was piled high with plates and cutlery  probably from lunch hour  and he looked unhappy clearing  When I asked for the menu  he simply pointed to a card on the bar  telling me to go get it myself  Isn t it great RoomsRooms are spacious with high ceilings  Controls are simple nothing like some hotels with massive complicated control panels  Simple bedside lamps are great  much better than those ceiling down lights that can be too strong and create shadows  But the shower was surprisingly small  with a recess so small you can t put any normal bottle in it  so you end up putting your toiletries on the floor  LocationGreat location with a connecting mall and a Cold Storage supermarket  subway below and streets with local just across  Other malls like Raffles City are also within walking distance  Overall I might return if its just us adults and shopping is key  but not if we return with kids as the pool is very disappointing

I have been travelling to Singapore in general for 25 years and as a frequent business visitor for the last 5 years  I have habitually taken a Club Room at a GHA hotel but Thank goodness they were all full on an unexpected trip and I booked into the Intercontinental  From the check in on the Club floor to the check out on the same floor 4 days later I it was fantatstic  The breakfasts in the Club are some of the best I have had anywhere  the service from every member of staff I met was courteous and professional  The general feel and ambiance is one my wife and I have only felt in one other hotel and that is the Peninsular  the real one not the new tower block   in Hong Kong   a very understated luxury not one thing over or under done   just RIGHT  The location withing the Bugis Junction shopping complex is excellent and the hotel is within easy strolls of Raffles  why would you want to go there if your in this hotel   and other major shopping centres  Ok there is always one  small  whine   the gym is a little tired and way too small for the numbers that use it at 0600  We moved from this hotel to another out at Changi and they arranged  at a small charge  for the baggage to be sent across while we were out enjoying Singapore   FANTASTICAll in all I would recommend this hotel to anyone and will be using it from now on Room Tip  Not needed   rooms appear to be totally sound proof See more room tips

From arriving at the hotel  to leaving we were welcomed so wonderfully  It s great to stay in a hotel that has kept it s traditions but somehow moved with the times too We were upgraded to a chop house room and were a little worried about street noise  We needn t have the windows in our room were so good we couldn t here a thing from the street The club lounge is wonderful so full of character and luxury  the staff superb  fantastic service and they feel like old friends after a few days Internet access great everywhere which is so important on a business trip Room Tip  Chop house room was great   go for a club room if you can  The lounge is great and cocktail hour wo   See more room tips

Traveling on business and holding a small event in the hotel  I checked in early and my room was ready  a great start with a lovely room  Thought I would touch base with the event coordinator to check out our event space  however no reply from previous 3x emails and no answer on her mobile didnt seem promising  Finally heard from her and was told I could inly see the room then because she was unavailable the rest of the day    Basically a whole lot of no s and inflexibility  our customers wouldn t of had a clue however I was left with a VERY sour taste in my mouth with this hotel  such a shame as the front of house staff are great and the hotel beautiful  Enjoy your stay but don t try to get them to bend their rules for you

My wife and I booked a  quot Shophouse Room quot  which is in a renovated wing of this hotel  Firstly  this wing is a serious walk from the main elevators and there are 3 steps in the middle of your hike  This makes taking your own suitcases an unpleasant challenge  The room itself is fine with nice local touches  Closet space is limited to a wooden armoire One unpleasant characteristic of the entire hotel was stains and smudge marks everywhere on walls and doors  It looks like they used the wrong kind of paint as almost every room door I saw had visible dark stains and marks as did many walls  this was disappointing for a 5 star property  Breakfast was consumed once at the lounge club room and once at the main lobby breakfast room  you can t call it a restaurant because it clearly had no real kitchen and its tables were lobby coffee tables with short armchairs not designed for food consumption  The makeshift breakfast facilities were reflected by the very ordinary buffet with limited choices The breakfast in the club room was better because of the view and real eating furniture  Again though  the club did not have a kitchen and request for eggs  etc  were relayed downstairs and brought to the 11th floor for consumption This is property with potential but hampered by design defects that make it a 4 or 4 5 star hotel at most Room Tip  Be prepared to walk a great deal if you get a shophouse room See more room tips

We stayed in a shophouse club room for 3 nights in February  The room was newly decorated and more than adequate  Bed very comfortable The best part was the club lounge  They could not do enough for you  Happy hour every evening   drinks were filled before being empty  Breakfast coffee constantly being offered  But never overbearing  We stay quite often on club floors  but this is the best club lounge we have ever been in  Would certainly recommend upgrading for the price of the included extras it is worth every penny The highlight of our stay was the Dragon Dance performed for Chinese New Year  What a wonderful surprise

I agree this hotel could use a little updating but apart from that you can t really find fault in it Location is great  right off of Bugis  It s near the subway station  near access to good shopping and food places  Cab rides are also an excellent option considering the hot  humid Singapore weaather  Service is what you ll expect from Intercontinental  friendly and knowledgeable staff  The concierge was super accommodating and the fresh juice bar really made my mornings  One day they ran out of one ingredient for my juice and they asked me if I was returning the next day so they can make sure they have it  How awesome is that   Room and bathroom were both large  clean and tasteful  The only things I wasn t crazy about was the pool and fitness center

The InterCon in Singapore has a colonial style elegance which is in refreshing contrast to some of the other brasher new hotels  We stayed for a weekend in April and returned for a night two weeks later  As noted by other reviewers  the staff were amazingly helpful  For the first stay we had a lovely room with good views on the 15th floor but the second time we had less pristine accommodation on the third floor right by the gym  so there is some variation in standard  However  the decor in the public areas is exceptional  particularly the furnishings  plants and flower arrangements  Also this hotel actually manages to achieve a friendly  buzzy but still relaxing lobby bar  The breakfasts were good and on our last night we ate in the Olive Tree restaurant which  although almost empty  was excellent  The pool area too was restful and the pool itself refreshingly cool

Somehow the Intercon in Singapore succeeds to keep that modern  cosy  clean and fresh look  The location is superb  within a shopping centre and MRT station  The rooms are great  showers excellent  I am always happy to see that this Hotel succeeds in retaining their best and most experienced talent  Breakfast quality should however be improved  it used to be much better  The car jockey company handling the cars should be trained to comply with Intercon customer service standards  A bit rude those guys  All by all a great experience and we will be back again
