I had booked this hotel to attend meetings at the Marina Bay Sands but preferred to pay a lot less  about  200 vs  350  and also stay in a more urban environment with a little more character than the Marina Bay area  Cab rides back and forth ranged from 7 to 12SGD  The location is pretty good and there is a 7 11 across the street for any items needed after hours and the adjacent malls has a variety of shops  Very seamless hotel check in  The lobby near check in is on the small side and the woodwork looks like it could use a coat of paint  Around the corner where there is a  quot lobby quot  bar adjacent to a shopping mall entrance that is a bit nicer  My room was decent  booked a standard king room  I would categorize as average but nice  The bathroom was not horribly out of date but not the most modern either  The room was quiet and bed comfortable  Housekeeping service was good  WiFi service was free but lost the connection frequently  Overall very nice hotel  very good service but I just can t say I was impressed by any one thing   very good but not memorable for me

This is one of our favourite hotel in the world  Each time we travel to Singapore  we will try to stay here  Fantastic location  Fantastic room and service  Good size room and adequate amenities  Favourite club lounge too  Once we flew in from NY and I had a terrible flu and the staffs attended to me and gave me home remedy such as honey and lemon and upgraded us to a lovely room  They even send in extra pillows and tea to ensure I am we ll taken care of  Plus  their lemongrass signature hotel smell is something that we look forward to each time we come back  Their personal touch always makes us return to Intercontinenal  Would like to see halal food option in the near future though

We booked well in advance  through Priority Club and would recommend this hotel to all who want a city centre stay in SIngapore  We took a quick shuttle bus into town from the airport late at night  delivered to the door and the staff looked after us beautifully for the whole stay  The bar area was welcoming and busy and the restaurants are stylish and top quality  The pool is just wonderful  clean and sparkling and just what is needed to refresh during the day

We stayed here for a long weekend so wanted a hotel with a convenient location and service that would make our stay easy and enjoyable  We were in no way disappointed  We checked in very late at night but the process was made extremely easy and the staff were welcoming  They were also helpful in suggesting places to visit and helped us avoid the queues at Resort World Sentosa by booking our tickets for us  Our room was on the second floor and was huge  The room overlooks the main road but there was no noise at all  The bed was enormous and comfortable and the room had just about everything you d want  We also had the breakfast package  while at  25 is quite pricey  it is well worth it with a huge selection and excellent fresh juices  The pool area is good with a snack bar  dressing room and comfortable sun loungers  It was also never too busy during our stay I read some comments that suggested the hotel was in need of a revamp however the hotel is immaculately clean and I found the charm of this building and the rooms to outweigh any minor flaws  I will definitely be returning and would recommend this hotel

Been there  done that in many hotels in Asia  IC Singapore has this unique charm that is evident in its lobby lounge  club lounge and rooms  The people are warm and service is good  like most ICs around the world  and the location is just superb  You get the mall and train station walking out of the hotel The only cons is that the pool is not that huge but It wasnt a problem for me Special thanks to the service crew and people in making our stay memorable  It is after all a small celebration for my little girl birthday  and indeed she loves every single moment of this  Something must be right to keep a 4 year old saying    quot when are we coming back again  quot

Second stay here and not disappointed  Stayed in a standard room  but very comfortable and spacious  Lovely toiletries in bathroom  could not fault cleaning service  Staff all very efficient and pleasant  Hotel is in a very good location  from there I walked all over Singapore while my husband was in business meetings  But for the less energetic it is close to an MRT station Our only little negative would be that for the size of the hotel  the pool is quite small  During the week it was ok  but come Friday afternoon  when families obviously arrived for the weekend  there was pool overload  But not a major problem  And it would help if guests would take towels off the sunbed when they leave the pool  leaving them on the beds means that other guests don t know whether those beds are in use or free We would advise taking the breakfast inclusive rate  it is good value

We recently spent four nights here  It was fine  but pretty impersonal  It is a very large hotel  that feels more like a business hotel than somewhere to stay on holiday  but I imagine a lot of hotels in Singapore feel the same  Still  the rooms were large and clean and the bed was very comfortable indeed  The room service was overpriced  and not of a particularly good quality  so wouldn t recommend  The pool was nice  but the bar was shut   not sure why  The best thing about the hotel was its location   you can pretty much walk anywhere in Downtown from it  which is a real bonus  and if you want to stray further afield  you are right next to Bugis junction MTR station  Would probably look for something different if we go back

I stayed at the Intercontinental Singapore while on business trip  In my mind  this is the best place to stay in Singapore  The hotel is centrally located with easy access to shopping and sight seeing  The lobby AMD the rooms are nicely decorated and very comfortable  The breakfast is excellent But the true highlight of this hotel is the staff  They are always pleasant and courteous  They go out of the way to help  The best example is the following story  I checked out of the hotel in the morning planning to have a few business meetings and go directly to the airport  Unfortunately I became sick and needed to see a doctor  I took a taxi back to the Intercontinental and explained my situation to one of the hotel pleasant staff  Within a moment he called their on call doctor   Dr  Neo  I explained my symptoms to the doctor who said he will come to see me shortly  While waiting for the doctor   the hotel staff were kind to set me up with internet access and attended to my needs  The excellent Doctor Neo met me within an hour  checked me  even brought medication with him So if you are looking for a beautiful hotel with the best staff in Singapore  I recommend the Intercontinental Singapore

We stayed in a Deluxe room on the 14th Floor  We checked out of a similar room on the 15th floor because it smelt damp and musty  This room was better but still smelt a little damp from time to time  Maybe its just a function of the humidity levels which are very very high  We stopped over for 4 nights to break up the trip from Oz to the UK We just wanted to enjoy a few days relaxation before returning to normality Singapore has changed a lot in the 10 years since we were last there  Some of the new buildings around the Marina are modern classics  Chinatown and the India quarter are still worth a visit and of course there are plenty of shops   This hotel was good but not great  We upgraded to use the Club lounge on the  th floor which is where we had breakfast  limited hot and full continental   could have had afternoon tea  and had cocktails in the early evening  The room was temporary as the proper lounge was being refurbished so it was a little cramped Staff in general were very helpful but outside porterage was pretty poor  Despite asking them to check the taxi driver knew where we were heading  we were left to try to negotiate our destination with drivers who spoke broken english  at best   We did a little sightseeing in the early morning and then returned to the roof pool to chill out  This is a functional area  with very limited sunbeds none under cover  except umbrellas  and no pool bar  There is nothing glamorous about chilling out here  If we went back to Singapore we would stay around the Marina  The Fullerton  Marina Sands or Ritz Carlton look like much better locations

We stayed in the KING BUSINESS Room for 5 nights in April  we loved the majestic charm of the Hotel  staff is very friendly and always willing to help  we especially like the selection of Fresh fruits which would be freshly squeezed to order at breakfast everyday rather than just canned juices served in other hotels  It has a Mall  amp  Bugis Station attached to the Hotel   excellent location to get around Singapore   We would definitely stay there on our next visit   We dined at the Man Fu Yuan in house Chinese Restaurant and the food was absolutely delicious  Highly recommend it

Having stayed in about ten hotels in Singapore now the InterContinental is my favourite  The lobby and lounge have old world charm and elegance while the guest rooms are spacious and comfortable   the beds particularly which are not rock hard like many Asian hotel beds  The marble bathrooms are large and have a separate shower and a big bath with hand held shower option  I have previously stayed here with my family for a week and we found the location very convenient  There is the Bugis Junction shopping centre  food court and markets right next door which also includes an MRT station  It is only a short walk to Raffles Hotel and the Raffles City Shopping Centre  I found the service to be impeccable Room Tip  I prefer a higher room facing the pool in case of traffic noiseSee more room tips

Don t get me wrong   in most cities around the world  this place would earn an excellent rating  The reason for the average rating is that for the amount of money you spend here you can stay in a better location  with better views  better service  larger rooms  and nicer beds   try the Ritz  if you can  The gym also needs a face lift  It s a perfectly good hotel  just not as nice as the other high end hotels in town

As a Platinum Ambassador member I chose this hotel for the last 3 nights of our family trip including 2 children to Singapore to gain the benefits of my member status We had stayed earlier at Shangrila on Sentosa Island and came directly from the Ritz Carlton hotel in the city       maybe this was my mistake       Arrived by taxi and valet both were more interested in getting bags out from the car than greet us  I opened the door myself and found my way to checkin      after realising I had a club room booked we were taken upstairs to the Club Lounge for checkin  Drinks offered whilst I checked in at the club desk  Welcome gift received and a thankyou for being an Ambassador member  Our room was not yet ready so we were told to wait in the Club lounge for an hour or so       staff member came and asked I tell the children to move from the lounge to a chair seeing their shorts legs didn t reach the floor and their shoes were against the lounge       the lounge was very wide so of course their little legs didn t reach over  Very taken back I asked we move to the pool area for a swim instead       it was at this stage I should have cancelled and moved back to the Ritz Cartlon When room day we were told we were upgraded from shophouse room to a Premier room which was bigger       on level 5 directly opposite the lift  Fruit basket and mineral water given as per Ambassador benefits and 4pm checkout offered which was useful given a late evening flight on departure  Room was a great size  good bathroom with big seperate bathtub  but overall abit dated and in need of a freshen up  Every night I lay awake listening to the droning size of those damn lifts      this ruined my hotel stay  and felt like I received a downgrade nor given appreciation of my Platinum Ambassador stay due to low floor offered Club breakfast was lovely with eggs to order but we chose to dine downstairs as not the deadly silent atmosphere as the Club Lounge  No children after 5 30pm in the Club so canap? s and cocktails served downstairs in the lobby lounge which I think was a lovelier more grander lounge and atmosphere with a piano player  Huge offering of food brought in elegant stands beautifully presented  with a great cocktail list  The lovely beautiful ladies serving made the experience a delight Pool was a good size and not many people using whilst we visited with a shallow pool for toddlers available  Bathrooms in the pool area seemed 3 star and I thought were terrible The hotel is in a good location with the Bugis Shopping Mall adjoining it with a huge offering of high quality shops and food outlets  A 5 10 minute taxi to Orchard Rd costing under  10 a trip  and easy to catch the express tourist bus to the zoo 2 minute walk away outside Shaw Tower I tried to like this hotel  but it was difficult to do given the absolute amazing stay we had at the Ritz Carlton a few days prior  The Intercontinental is a lovely building with a cultural history about it  but I feel it needs a good makeover too make it appear more grander for a 5 stay hotel  Overall  this hotel stay could have been more enjoyable if not for the negatives mentioned  It is definitely not anywhere close near the same league as the Ritz Carlton  which was disappointing for me considering it cost a lot more per night than our stay at the Ritz     would I stay again  NO  I would defiantly chose the Ritz again despite my IHG loyalty programme status Room Tip  Chose a nonsmoking floor  and worth the extra for Club evening canap? s and cocktails See more room tips

I ve stayed at The Ritz Carlton  The Four Seasons  both Mandarin Hotels and countless other hotels around Singapore over the past 20 years and this remains one of my favorite hotels on the island  If you can spring for the shophouses row rooms  even better  The rooms are spacious and comfortable  It is located in the center of Bugis  which is slightly off the main drag of Orchard Road  but I like the old school charm of Bugis over the uber modern  quot Rodeo Drive quot  of Singapore  It is still possible to get a decent cup of local kopi and other local favorites around Bugis  This hotel offers corporate comforts in a slightly less frenzied area of town Room Tip  Splurge for one of the shophouse rooms See more room tips

We ve stayed at this property several times over the past 15 years  The location is ideal   right on top of Bugis  around the corner from Raffles  City Hall  museums  across the street from the Library  Lots of action nearby without the crazy crowds of Orchard Road  While the hotel is starting to show it s age  the facilities and services  biz center  gym  etc   all work well  The service is lovely  much more consistent and competent than in years past  The service and location of this high quality hotel have firmly established it as our favorite place to stay in Singapore Room Tip  The  quot shophouses rooms quot  are a special treat  Styled in a classic colonial motif  they  39 r   See more room tips

I really enjoyed this hotel  It had a certain charm to it  The staff were very helpful and friendly  and helped make quality suggestions for things to see  I also had some time to just walk around one morning  and I thought that this hotel was a great location to do so  walked to a park  down to the riverfront  etc  the Chinese restaurant was also very good

Stayed at the Intercontinental hotel for 4 nights  in conjunction with attending a Convention  Whilst it has all the amenities expected of a 5 star Hotel  as well as convenient access to the restaurants and shops in the adjacent complex  it s decor and furniture looks somewhat tired  Have heard they will embark on major Rooms Upgrade next year  Nevertheless there is a certain old world elegance  and I find the public areas on the ground floor in particular the lobby lounge spacious with a certain  quot oasis quot  feel  Its a good place to chill catching up on emails  reading or meeting up with friends  Free wifi was included in our room rate For breakfast this morning we were seated in the lobby lounge as the ADD Olive restaurant had limited seating  We found the service patchy and slow  Overall recommendedRoom Tip  Ask for rooms facing the internal courtyard which is less noisySee more room tips

I stayed at this hotel in April   May 2013  I must mention that this is a class property and a place to relax after some hectic work  The location is simply excellent     just next door is Bugis Mall  Lots of food junctions in the vicinity  Overall the service staff is excellent  amp  willing to help  Where my first stay was very good  I confronted a little moody staff the reception during my 2nd check in  It was raised to duty manager  amp  must say that it was very efficiently resolved  I would like to appreciate duty manager for being very thoughtful  amp  comforting me  Overall an excellent experience Room Tip  If possible look for a corner roomSee more room tips

We stayed at the Interconinental for one night en route to Sri Lanka and two nights on retrun  The hotel and staff are excellent  The first stay was in a shop house room on level two  Large  very clean and very comforatable bed  The second stay was on level three slightly smaller room but again excellent  The cleanlines of the hotel is 5 star and the staff very friendly and go out of their way to help  The club rooms are definatley worth it as the club lounge is relaxing when you have a late flight  Also the  quot happy hour quot  is excellent  The standards and friendliness of the hotel and the staff would make me return

The Intercontinental was our first stop for our Asian vacation that included Singapore  Phuket  Bangkok and Hong Kong  We arrived late at night and had arranged transportation from the airport  Yet  we were surprised to be met just outside the airplane bridge and were escorted through passport control and customs before boarding a car to the hotel  bypassing the long line of people waiting for a taxi despite it being after 12 30 AM  We booked a room on the club floor but were upgraded to a nice sized suite  The room was fantastic as was the great breakfast awaiting us just down the hallway each morning The hotel is in a perfect location and the conciege was helpful in providing assistance and recommendations We definitely will stay here again

We stayed at the InterContinental for four nights at the end of our trip to Phuket  We were upgraded to the club level that provided a modern  elegant king room in the Shophouse section of the hotel  The room was very quiet for only being on the second floor  Best of all  the room was spotlessly cleaned  The room had dark hardwood floors  louver blinds with heavy drapes  a cove ceiling  and a variety of light buttons bedside to change the mood  Free WiFi was a plus in our room and the club  The bed was extremely comfortable as were the pillows  We both slept very well The club level provides a hot breakfast every morning as part of the package as well as high tea in the afternoon and cocktails every evening  The food in the club was fabulous  We checked out at 1 pm for a midnight flight  The concierge stowed our luggage for the entire day while we shopped around town  When we got back  we were able to shower at the health fitness center  change clothes  then go for cocktails in the club before we had to head to the airport As everyone else has said  this hotel is located in the heart of the city and the Bugis SMRT  mass transit subway  station  We were able to take the subway everywhere using the three day tourist pass  We even went to the Night Safari by subway and bus  Staying in Singapore was the best part of our trip  especailly staying at the InterContinental  The hotel staff couldn t do enough for us or any of the other guest we encountered  Highly  highly recommend  When we got back to Singapore next year on our way to another southeast Asia destination  we will definitely stay at the InterContinental again

We have nothing to pick on this property  From check in to check out we loved everything about this hotel   our first experience with the Intercontinental brand  The room was spacious and extremely well appointed  The pool area and gym were perfect and well equipped  The buffet breakfast was to die for and the property location was central and safe enough to walk to Little India and Clarke Quay for dinner  Our experience was so positive I signed up for the IHG rewards program as soon as we returned home

Location for this hotel is simply the best  It located in down town  The service perfect  For breakfast menu its not many choises compare to other hotels  And the waiter in this olive tree restaurant was rude too  One guess cannot enter the resturant because the using sandals fro  Hotel  The waiter simy said you cannot enter you need change your shoes

The hotelis right at Bugis junction   connected to a small shopping mall and the MRT which is extremely convenient  Definitely location location location Otherwise hotel is nice  rooms are getting a bit dated by now but still very nice  Room was on the 4th floor which is where the pool is  unfortunately for some reason it also means that the whole corridor also smells like the pool and our room smells very  tropical   imagine the smell that you get when you are in Cairns   or any extremely humid places  in doors Overall I loved e hotel and hope to return next time when I am in Singapore

If you want old fashioned Singaporean service and class  the Intercontinental is the choice  This Hotel started in 1995 and it show in places  but in a good way  Some things just remain stylish with the passage of time  Being greeted by name at the front desk on morning 2 is fairly impressive in a hotel of this size  It s large  but they make it feel like a small boutique hotel The location is wonderful  I love being able to walk out the back door straight into a shopping complex and be plunged into the hustle and buzz of SIngaporean life  then step back over the threshold of the hotel  back into serenity I ve stayed elsewhere  but this is my Singapore hotel of choice  The buffet breakfast is what you d expect of a 5 star hotel  extensive range  omelettes made to order etc   but grab a seat in the first area which is flooded with light and so peaceful  If you want new shiny and impersonal  by all means head to Marina Bay Sands and join the line of 50 waiting for  quot express checkout quot  and forget about walking to any shops that aren t aimed at oligarchs  If you want to be surrounded by tourists  head to Raffles but as a guest it isn t relaxing being an exhibit and constantly having people asking for directions to the Long Bar for a Singapore Sling Go for the Intercontinental  You won t regret it Room Tip  Ask for late checkout and they  39 ll try to let you stay until 2pmSee more room tips

I stayed at the InteContinental Singapore for a couple of weeks back in November 2012  The hotel is connected to a mall and subway station   making it super convenient to travel to work  dine  and shop  The room  though outdated  was spacious  The bed was very comfy  The staff were professional  I loved the lobby bar with live piano  The drinks were also reasonable  I used the gym several times  The equipments were a little outdated  but gave me all I needed  They had free weights  treadmills  and some weight machines  There was also a dry sauna in the locker room  Overall  it is a good hotel to stay in Singapore

Recently my wife and I stayed at this hotel and couldn t fault it  The attention to detail  ambiance and customer service were excellent  As Ambassador members were made feel very welcomed from the moment we arrived to the moment we departed  no request was ever too much bother  questioned or hesitated on  All the staff were very friendly and extremely helpful  We will definitely be coming back and certainly be recommending this hotel to others Room Tip  Lower level rooms have street mall noise during the day See more room tips

I stayed at the Intercontinental Singapore for 3 nights  The Hotel is perfectly located next to the MRT Stations Bugis and City Hall  depending on which way you re going you can choose the station   Before even arrival to the hotel I received an Email from the Reservations Department regarding my room preference  higher of lower floor and smoking or not smoking  and that I should choose between the options of a room upgrade or Club Lounge upgrade  since I am a Royal Ambassador   I chose to have a non smoking room on the upper floors and the Club Lounge upgrade  Upon arrival I got a room on the 13th floor  the hotel has 16 floors  with a nice view  could even see Marina Bays Sands   and although I haven t received a room upgrade  the room I got was superb and more than enough for me Choosing the Club Lounge upgrade ment that I got complementary breakfast  with a wide selection of both eating and drinking possibilities  and I was able to enroll in the evening Cocktail Hour  The staff was always polite and very helpful and on the second day they already knew what cocktails I drink and in which order  first Singapore Sling and then Tiger Beer  and asked if they can serve it  quot as usual quot  I also have to mention  that as a Royal Ambassador you get late checkout  4 pm  but the staff at the hotel was kind and allowed me to stay at the Club Lounge since my plane left at 11 pm All in all I can recommend this Hotel to everyone who would like to stay in a really nice and luxurious environment

Just love Singapore  Was an easy MRT trip from the international airport to Bugis and just a short stroll to the hotel  Our flight arrived early 6am and we were at the hotel by 8 am  The check in staff were fantastic and made our room available within an hour and a half  Peter the Valet was awsome and if you need anything he is your man  Couldn t fault anything  the staff are all fantastic  We were able to leave our luggage until late in the day after we checked out and were able to freshen up before leaving later in the evening for our flight home Well worth buying a tourist pass for the transport system  just so very easy to get around  Love Marina Sands highly recommend a trip to view the gardens and enjoy a cool drink on the 57th floor to enjoy the fantastic views

To me this is a preferable area to stay in Singapore  A bit further away from Orchard Road  walking distance to Raffles Chimes Stamford shopping centre Quays  and to the park  Busy hotel  but not as busy as MBS Stamford  Easily accessible by taxi from airport  Good quick check in   able to help on breakfast times  gym  pool  internet Pool   great for a cool down   not very big   open until 2200  looked at gym only   good gear   up to date Had a lower level room   was there overnight so was adequate  Bathroom adequate   walk in shower  my preference   Room service fast reasonable good service  I liked the trolley arrangement Bed good   comfortable  Breakfast   arrived   06 30 was already open       good layout well priced buffet Checkout quick   could have been quicker  company requirement to itemised billing threw them a bit  Cash change was a bit slow  could have been faster Taxi ordered while at checkout   bag in taxi and on way with minimum of fuss Good hotel to stay

This is a strong service high quality property in a great locationLove the shop front rooms and love the club lounge  not having it on the top floor is kinda interesting but this did not detract from the lounge experienceOnly issue was screaming kids everywhere during my stay but this is not the hotels fault  but maybe a child policy for the club lounge would be a good idea  as it did feel like a kids club when I was thereAll in all a great property and I do love the corner room i was in and the shop front

I can t speak highly enough about this hotel and in particular all the staff  The hotel itself is quite magnificant   and right in the middle of the CBD  Its charming  elegant yet very personable and the staff make it one of the best hotels I ve ever stayed in  They cannot do enough for you  They know everything to see and do in Singapore and find you the best ways to get around  They will put themselves out every time  Whether its attractions  food  entertainment  whatever  I recommend this hotel very highly  and I m hard to please  and when returning to Singapore  will be staying here again

This hotel is the best hotel I have ever stayed at  The service is second to none in every respect  The great experience here starts at the front desk where they great you very friendly and process you quickly  The restaurants are great and plentiful  There is a huge food court located in the lower lever as well as a large grocery store  Below that is the train which easily takes you anywhere in Singapore  The rooms are extremely clean and the cleaning staff is fast and friendly  The location is also perfect because it is close to so much of what Singapore has to offer

There s nothing special about the hotel and the in room dining is ridiculously expensive   We were charged  65 SGD for two bowls of cornflakes with the accompanying two glasses of milk    The rooms are a bit dated and the hallway on the fourth floor  where our room was and also the floor for the pool  smelled but we couldn t determine what the odor was or where it came from  The hotel is within walking distance of a subway stop and connected to a mall  The free Internet in the room was very very slow  Given how many other hotels there are in Singapore  I would recommend looking for another in the same price range  I would certainly not stay here again

Stayed in the Intercontiental hotel for one night in early June for a meeting  Check in was quick and the staff courteous  The room was very clean and quiet  although it was located on the 4th floor  The pool was also located on the same floor  almost at my doorstep  The hotel is located just behind Bugis area  good for shopping for local stuff and street food  There is a street market which is open all day until late night a stone s throw away

Nice spacious rooms  located in a strategic part of town  Easy access to the Subway with the subway station located right beneath the Bugis Junction mall which is adjacent to the Intercontinetal Singapore Rooms were sufficient and functional with ample working desk The only downside though will be the appearance seems to be dated comparing to the others  Loved the firm luxurious feel of their beds  mine came with 2 queen beds which is their standard twin room  Spotting a single Sofa with a small coffee table in the room  The armrests of the sofa is sunken though Room Tip  Rooms on higher floor will afford better views  the rooms facing the street side will be a tad littl   See more room tips

Stayed for a week due to my husband being here on businessOk room  showing signs that refurbishment needs to startBreakfast ok  we had the buffet dinner a couple of nights  plenty of shell fish  sushi to have as a starter  desserts were fantastic  but main course not so good  There was a curry each night but the meat left a lot to be desired  it appeared to be a small joint of beef one night  from memory pork the other  both around 6 quot  x 4 quot  that looked as though they had been under the lamp to keep them warm for some days Staff all friendly

A short trip this time  made shorter by a long flight delay So instead of checking in about 8pm  it was 1am when we arrived We were greeted well with personalized service  and presented with a nice silver bookmark  as a Thank you gift  Upgraded to a great room   L shaped with lots of room   separate alcove for the king sized bed  a nice lounge area with a lounge and a couple of armchairs   coffee table  great magazines Nice dinning nook   with a great fruit bowl  Bathroom was outstanding   bath and a seperate walk in shower Had room service which was well presented   roll away table set up in the room Late check out which meant we were able to shower before heading back to the airport for our next adventure This hotel seems to be well located   as we were able to wander around Bugis Junction shopping centre and grab some breakfast  while mixing with the locasl

The service overall is 5 star and the Club is spacious and decorated more like an elegant home than a hotel  Definitely worth the extra cost  The reason I can t give the overall hotel a 5 star rating is because of the noise issues  The hotel s back door goes out to the Bugis mall   shopping center  which is convenient if you need to purchase almost anything  The downside is the  quot noise quot  from  10 AM to  10 PM if your room faces that side  Unfortunately  many of the newly redecorated  beautiful  quot Shop House quot  rooms and suites face that direction  That said  I have stayed here many times over the past 18 months Room Tip  Shop House rooms  amp  suites are very tastefully decorated  Higher noise level on the rooms which f   See more room tips

Above average for a 5 star  This hotel is very well located with great helpful staff  Lovely lobby  good gym and wifi throughout the building  It would have been first rate but for two things  the food is really average  I ll admit the desserts were very good    and  the rooms need an upgrade  in particular  the doors to the rooms are too old   they have big gaps and are very noisy  I worked out that you can put pillows against the door and block out the noise but without that I was frequently woken up by people coming back   leaving throughout the night as the closing doors make quite a racket  The a c was also noisy Room Tip  Putting pillows against the door blocks out the excessive noise from the corridor See more room tips

I stayed here for 5 nights recently  The hotel is easily accessible from any part of the city thanks to its proximity to the MRT stations There was absolutely no delay with check in and the service in general was exceptionally good   They offered me free internet connection which was not actual part of the package  The buffet breakfast was included in the price and I really enjoyed it  If you are not very particular about the five star restaurant ambience there are some very good budjet Chinese and Thai restaurants in the adjacent street which is definitely worth a try  Overall I would rate this hotel high from a value for money perspective

It is not often that I disagree with the majority of other Tripadvisors but to me this is just an average hotel in comparison to its Singapore peers  It is dated  but not in the grand sense like Raffles  2 blocks away  rather the fading olive green wallpaper sense  The food is bland and the drinks excessively overpriced  but not as bad as Raffles   The rooms are spacious and comfy but that should be a given in a 5 star hotel and I am sitting here at a desk looking at chipped paintwork and dull furniture  In my opinion this place does not deserve its ranking Except       for the staff  and here I do concur with my fellow bloggers Service everywhere in Singapore is excellent but here they are in a league of their own  and if anyone in corporate ever reads these posts then please award Jana in Front Office a bonus for going above and beyond the call of duty   finding me a fancy dress bee costume in under 2 hours and having it delivered to my room   total respect An average building made good by its people

Arriving at 9 45 am my wife and I were greeted by Peter and taken to reception    check in was quick and we were taken to our clubroom    we were very pleased with the room and staff    the club lounge was very comfortable and we enjoyed the buffet breakfast each morning and the complimentary drinks and finger food in the evening   Raj gets a special mention due to his sense of humour and also advising me on having hot brandy to help me recover from my cold  location is great walking distance to Chimes Raffles Hotel and Suntek shopping centre    Even on a busy road and on the second floor the room was quite with the most comfortable hotel bed we have ever slept in  we will be backRoom Tip  Club rooms as you get extra  39 s such as complimentary afternoon high tea and canapes in evening i   See more room tips

We used Singapore as our base while traveling through Asia this Spring  The Singapore Intercontinental was our go  to hotel  and we stayed three times within a period of six weeks Overall  the service was excellent  especially in the Club lounge  The first visit we got upgraded to a Junior suite   which is nothing special    inspite of the fact that my husband is ambassador level in their priority club However  for the second stay we were upgraded to a huge and posh suite containing a dining area and living room and two bathrooms  amp  we had club floor privileges  On the third visit we had a regular junior suite  amp  access to the club floor  So we never knew what to expect at this hotel   standard upgrades or over the top luxury upgrades  The people at the front desk were the least friendly and welcoming of any of the IC hotels we stayed at on this trip   Bali  Hanoi were fabulous   However  the priority club staff was helpful and tried their best to make us feel welcome  The location of this hotel is fantastic  and we shopped and ate and did a lot of sightseeing without the aid of taxis  The shopping mall adjacent to the hotel  the food courts and the proximity of the metro in Bugis station made our stay a pleasant one  But what gives this hotel a high rating is the comfort of the Club lounge and the excellent and plentiful food and drinks which are served there  The array of choices for breakfast  tea and cocktails hors d oevres are fantastic  They served wonderful dim sum treats and Singaporean desserts as well as European style pastries  The breakfast choices were also a mix of Asian and Western cuisines  and the all the servers in the lounge were extremely well trained and professional  We first came to this hotel when it first opened  and we are happy to see that it is still one of the best places to stay in Singapore Room Tip  Try to get Club Floor privileges  if possible  The larger suites are fantastic and will make you wan   See more room tips

I stayed from 10 24th Jun in Intercontinental  I am a Ambassador member and hence usually stay at IHG Brands  The Hotel is located at Bugis MRT  green line  which is very convienient for travelling across the Island City with abundant of shopping  expensive and Cheaper ones   transportation  movies and eating option  Great Place to stay for families as the standard rooms and the bathrooms are large  Since its not a very large hotel and 400rooms  it still maintains a very personal touch  Its an old property but maintained and very nice and helpful staff trying to take care of all your need  The Club Lounge is pretty much like any other lounge  but its a refurbished lounge and feels great  I like that they dont charge for computers in lounge and for wifi in common area  but they charge for printing in lounge which is never heard of The overall ambience of the hotel is good  breakfast is suffucient for NON Vegetarians  but for Vegetarians like me  very little to eat in hot section Decent selection of snacks  bread  but overall need more selection in cheese  fruits and vegetarian snacks  Nothing much to eat in room service menu as well  but hotel staff is helpful to get you something out of the menu   The hotel MENU definately needs an upgarde for VEGETARIANSRoom Tip  Look for rooms which are refurbished if your are staying at Shophouse floor  but these rooms are far   See more room tips

Traveled to Singapore with my teenage son for a vacation in April 2013  I had booked the room well in advance  of course with help and guidance from fellow trip advisor members  The hotel is located right in the middle of Bugis junction and is connected to the Bugis junction mall  So location wise this is perfect  A short walk to Raffles and other malls is all it takes  The staff were somewhat stiff but courteous  The rooms are clean and tidy  Well appointed rooms with comfortable beds and spacious bathrooms  My only grouse with this hotel is that they give you absolutely no lee way with check out time  We spent 7 days at this hotel and enjoyed it thoroughly  The pool is small but maintained well  The view of the national library from the pool is amazing  Our flight was at 9 PM the day we checked out and I myself was feeling a little under weather  I did not want to land up at the airport 5 hours prior to departure  so I requested the reception to provide me with an additional 2 hour limit  The lady was very very rude  This is not my first time at a 5 star hotel  I know they are pretty strict on the check out times  but many a time and in many places the staff have been very very helpful in providing additional 1 2 hours plus suggesting alternate solutions to make it easy  That apart  the hotel is perfect  Give it a try if you want a nice hotel when you stay in Singapore  Business or pleasure  I m sure you won t end up disappointed

I came to Singapore together with my family for a short vacation  At the beginning everything seemed to work fine and the first impression of the hotel was excellent until the next day when we came back from shopping  The cleaning staff prepared only one set of slippers  even though there were 2 adults and a child in the room   did not clean the trash bin and left the door of the cabinet bellow the TV slightly opened  In Addition  the shower bulb was blinking and needed replacement  This was not the handling you might expect from a professional hotel  as IC should be  We called the duty manager and fortunately he took care of everything  handling it really nicely  so at the end it was still a good stay  The location of the hotel and breakfast were very good

I visit Singapore often  and have been wanting to stay in this hotel for years but have been beaten by circumstances until now  If location is your main criterion for selecting a place to stay in Singapore  you cannot do any better than this   a short walk to Bugis  a short walk to Raffles  a short taxi ride to downtown  a short walk to the MRT  across the road from the National Library  next door to the art gallery  and a stone s throw from an entrance on to the East Coast airport freeway  Apart from location  positives include a lovely lobby with great feng shui  great beds  a choice of modern versus Peranakan shophouse rooms  go for the latter   very good club lounge and a half decent Japanese restaurant  The downside        if you like Asian style service  this will not be to your taste at all   here there is an unapologetic US style service proposition all the way ie  not much service at all  For example  our room was not ready when we arrived after nineteen hours of flying  so we were sent off to a hot  smelly and crowded gym change room to  quot freshen up quot   To be fair  we were given a room upgrade to compensate   unfortunately that meant that we missed out on our coveted shophouse suite  More telling was that the bell people forgot to deliver our bags when we finally did get into our room three hours later  and on departure took so long to collect the bags from our room that we came within an ace of missing our flight  Carry them yourself you say  Couldn t   back was shot and I couldn t lift anything heavier than a tissue  I was a hostage to the hotel s service ethic  and it didn t deliverRoom Tip  Go shophouse for the atmosphereSee more room tips

Stayed in the Club Intercontinental for the first time   room was very spacious and beautifully furnished with complimentary internet connection which was very efficient   Bed was very comfortable  We really enjoyed the Club beautiful breakfast  great afternoon tea  and equally wonderful pre dinner drinks  Wonderful service provided by Anna and her team  We loved the elegant furniture and private alcoves in the Club The hotel is well positioned and close to MRT a quick walk to Raffles and shopping  All the staff throughout the hotel were very attentive and really made our stay Room Tip  Club Intercontinental worth the extraSee more room tips

I flew in from Phuket  after spending 4 miserable wet days and could not wait to get home to my wife and daughterUnfortunately for me  I missed my connecting flight to Sydney  As a result  I had to stay the night in Singapore  NOT AT ALL HAPPY Booked the Intercontinental at the airport hotel counter  operated by the Singapore Government for SGD198 00 including taxes for the nightWhat a great choice  especially seeing as I could not wait to get home to my family  I arrived and felt like I was home  ALL the staff were very helpful and nothing was a inconvenience for them and would refer to me as Mr Smith  not real name  at all times  Pleasant  friendly  happy yet professional  especially Timothy Tan  He checked me in and was full of useful advise and suggestions and could not do enough for meThe room was very spacious  especially seeing as I had 2 queen beds in it  It was very clean and the bed was like sleeping in a firm cloud  Very comfortableLocation wise  just a 350 walk to the MRT  Orchard Road is no more than a 10 minute MRT ride and for under SGD5  u get a taxi to the Marina areaAs much as I wanted to get home  I almost wanted to stay longer  thanks to the professionalism of the staff  I am very happy I stayed at the Intercontinental and cannot wait to return  For a great experience  you cannot pass on the Intercontinental  as this hotel was a godsent for me  Cant wait to return

We spent a long weekend in Singapore and we were based at the Intercontinental Hotel  Fantastic location and we loved the simple  but tastefully decorated room  The staff members were friendly and obliging from things such as room service to getting us a taxi to go somewhere  Close to the Chimes and Chinatown  However  we only discovered the latter and plethora of eating places in Bugis  minutes away from the hotel  on our last night and regretted we had not tried it out  Close access to the MRT and there is a shopping centre adjoining the hotel  Would definitely stay here again  No complaints

This hotel has character and charm with nice rooms  lobby and other redeeming features I enjoyed my stay there and my only issue is the room service  ordered 3 meals and all were wrong  the only reason I order room service is to catch up on work but this was a problem as it took so long to correct  On the last occasion I said they could collect outside my door and went around the corner to get fast food  Other than that is was a good stay but could have been much better

I always stay in this hotel when i go to Singapore i visit twice a year ever thing is excellent they always give nice rooms and club access with great breakfast buffet and afternoon tea being in the Bugis junction shopping center and next to the subwayArab street no far also were i used to buy several thing like  Bakhoor  also the is opposite to the national library the is quiet which makes it better than Orchard st

Spent three nights during business trip in June at Intercontinental Singapore  A nice hotel in a convenient location  Staff is cordial and helpful  Hotel offers many options for dining to include a comfortable open area lounge  breakfast area  and a bar lounge area  Overall the hotel offers plenty of options within  although enjoying the surrounding area as time permits is encouraged  The room was clean and offered a spacious sitting and work area along with a nice bath area  Only drawback  for me  was the A C in the room  The setting is limited to 20 celsius  68 fahrenheit   which in most instances is  quot pretty darn good quot   however it seemed less than optimal efficient  particularly given the humidity level  They did accomodate my request and made a minor adjustment that was to cool it a bit more  That worked towards the late evenings  but otherwise the room remained somewhat stuffy  Excellent breakfast buffett with options for the fruit lover  the meat lover  the pastry lover and the egg lover  The bar lounge opens at 5 and offers a discounted  quot 1 for 1 quot  special from 6 to 8 pm   Their version of Happy Hour   I was very pleased to see German HefeWeisse served by the bottle   Although not on the  quot 1 for 1 quot  list   For those in need of an early morning or late evening reminder of home   there is a small 7 11 across the street on the corner where an ATM is located  Other more  quot grand quot  shopping is located adjacent to the hotel in the form of a plaza mall area   Bugis Shopping area  Travel time by taxi to and from the hotel is about 20 to 30 minutes depending on traffic and ranged from 19 SGD to 27 SGD  again based on time of day  passengers  bags and traffic  From a business perspective  the internet access  once connected  worked fine  From the hotel room a LAN is available  from various parts of the hotel  wireless is available  It can be a bit confusing as various locations gain access to different connections and via different password options  It would be nice if that were streamlined a bit  I would likely stay here again   although it is not a hotel I am  quot married to quot  at this point

Not so much to mention  I know this hotel is very popular as it s located at the heart of Singapore  But I think  as we have many choices of hotel at this area  there should be something more to attract more guests  Anyway  I like to stay here cause it s close to almost everywhere  my meeting venue at suntec  Bugis junction mall  MRT station  and mosque is also nearby

Have stayed at this property 4 times now and each time the service is excellent  I can honestly not find fault with any aspect of my stays here  The staff is nice   the service nice   the breakfast layout is very well done  The location next to Bugis junction   full of restaurants  public transport and the proximity to the financial district makes this an ideal choice for work and holiday

Singapore is a funny place with respect to hotel prices and will keep surprising you  I had stayed here on a business trip  This hotel is near Bugis Shopping area  We chose this hotel over Hotels at Raffles due to the trip which was planned at a short notice  The walk from the reception till the business suites were almost seeming endless but they give a chance to give the guest a complete view of the hotel  The rooms were a little smaller but were very cosy and comfortable  The best part of this hotel is the proximity to shopping places and clarke quay and boat quay and after a good evening if you go to a hotel at Raffles you feel you are in a business district but this place is chilled out There was a private area for the business suites for the breakfast and the spread was good and the bakery items were out of the world Overall a very nice and comfortable place and in Singapore you should never complain about the cost of the hotel  Just be there and enjoy

Stayed for 2 nights in a Club Room  The check in was effortless  the staff were efficient  attentive and knowledgeable  The room was clean and luxurious  as are most Intercon s  The reception lobby was basic but the main lounge on the ground floor was where the old world charm of the building was evident  This is a great space for a drink after a hot day travelling around the city  listening to the live music  The exec lounge was the highlight as it was so comfortable and well furnished that it felt like someone s home  The breakfast in the exec lounge was first class  The Intercon is attached to the Bugis shopping complex  handy for any essentials  Overall a great hotel  in a great location  Local tip  there is a brilliant massage place around the corner called Zufu and right next door is the best  local  coffee in town  Ask the concierge for directions

I am very disappointed that we only stayed 2 nights in this Hotel as I would have loved to have stayed a week at least Our standard room was upgraded upon arrival to a larger refurbished room and we had 2 adults and 1 7 yo daughter in the one large bed which was manageable The outdoor swimming pool was great even in the drizzling rain and all enjoyed a daily swim Breakfast was excellent and a good variety Although we stayed over the Chinese New Year period staffing levels were good and staff excellent This Hotel was great and had an old English Colonial feel about it all We would stay again   for a longer period of time Room Tip  Maybe go for a club level room with use of the lounge  having said this our refurbished room was exc   See more room tips

This hotel has been my favourite in Singapore for the past 4 years Located right in the middle of the action  in Bugis  it offers you the world class comforts of the Intercontinental brand along with straight access in to market space Luxurious rooms  great hospitality  good food and remarkable upkeep   makes it all in all a worthwhile hotel to stay in

My Sister and I stayed at the Intercontinental Singapore for a total of 5 nights in a Shop House Club Room which was very spacious  The bed was very conformable and the bathroom was large and had plenty of room  The room had a large television which was great to watch the AFL football on  The hotel is next the the Bugis Shopping Mall which has a lot of shops and across the road is the Bugis Street Markets which had plenty of Food stalls and general Stalls  The staff where all fantastic they looked after us like we where VIP guests  In the intercontinental club room they served a great breakfast and afternoon tea  The drinks from 5 30pm where great too they served Mocktails  Cocktails and Spirits and wine and soft drinks which were very good  Our check in was very smooth and the checkout was the same  I would recommend this hotel to stay while in Singapore Room Tip  Rooms are quieter facing the road and the Shop House Suites face the shopping centreSee more room tips

We had a fantastic stay at the intercontinental in Singapore and definitely worthy of the 5 star tag  All the staff we had contact with were helpful  friendly and professional  The club lounge was definitely worth the extra money  it was like the Emirates   Qantas club with extra personalised service  We were offered a late check out  2pm  and access to the lounge until our plane flight out  Being very close to the Bugis street MRT it also adjoins an undercover market which contains many different specialty kiosks and shops and 2 levels of local eating houses  This then is attached to a state of the art multilevel mall where you can literally purchase anything you desire The club room was spacious and the King size bed was luxurious  All in all a great hotel  perfect location and first class staff    Room Tip  Upgrading to the club rooms are good valueSee more room tips

What to say  This is outstanding in all regards   rooms  food  staff  so nice and so polite    The bed quality is fantastic  The only thing I deplore is the quality of the gym men s locker room  It was not clean  So surprising in such a nice hotel  Yet  overall it is an excellent and luxurious hotel  Would come back any time

I have stayed at this place a couple of times during business trip  The location is pretty good  next to Bugis MRT  and Bugis Mall  The hotel has an old British colonial feel  The rooms are spacious and comfortable  Victoria Bar serves nice mocktails   cocktails and is a great place to unwind  Staff is courteous and service is excellent Arab street is walking distance from the hotel which has a lot of eating joints  City Hall Mall is also not far off

We stayed here for a night on a stopover in Singapore  Hotel was nice and is connected to a shopping center as well as being close to the MRT  Price was also reasonable especially when compared with the Holiday Inn Orchard Road Check in was disappointing with issues on our reservation and required some explanation  Also  one of the 2 rooms was not ready despite it being around 5pm when we checked in  Otherwise  the service and staff were good Upon entering the room  there was a mouldy smell which I understand that it s not uncommon due to the humidity in Singapore  Room was spacious and with a classic decor  However  the TV was unexpectedly small

I have faced this choice numerous times when I visit Singapore  once every 2 3 months   Usually there is a small price difference so I will choose the Holiday  However  this time there was low availability at the Holiday and weekend special at the InterC  so I tried the later The Hotel is absolutly stunning  Service at the front dest was speedy despite the high amount of incoming guests  Friday evening   I got ugraded to a junior suite which is much more than the upgrade I get at the Holiday Location wise both are excellent  the InterC is at the Bugis shopping Complex  entrance to the Street Mall is through the lobby  The InterC is a bit closer to Changi Airport  There is a MRT below too  Notable locations are less than 5 min away by taxi  a less than 10 SGD trip radius  My room was immaculate  The king size bed had a very high quality mattress and selection of pillows and a blanket which assured me a delicious nights sleep  Standing shower in addition to the bathtub is a added bonus on the Holiday  Breakfast was excellent  can t compare to the Holiday  since I never dinned there  An advantage in favor of the Holiday is the closeness to the massage parlors at Cuppage and Orchard Plaza Pool and Fitness Centre at the InterC are much of the same compared to the Holiday  nice  but not too exciting   but less than other 5 s around the city When asked to extend my stay  Holiday has always allowed me till 6pm  I am a Platinum card holder   InterC only let me stay till 3pm In summary  The InterC is tops in overall experience and indulgence but not in service  I will not justify choosing over the Holiday at Orchard Park if priced at a margin of over 25 SGD night

We stayed here for five nights in bustling Singapore  Location is great and the hotel itself had an old English Colonial feel about it all  Our room was both spacious and tastefully decorated  had been refurbished rather recently   The bathroom offered both a bath tub and a shower  Our rate included wifi and breakfast  Breakfast was to die for offering a wide range of food  Staff was excellent and very friendly  The hotel has and outdoor swimming pool offering some sun beds and free towels  There is also a fitness center in the hotel  however we felt this was a bit too crowded to our taste

I really can¡¯t remember when was my last time I need to take my own luggage from the taxi to the hotel room myself  this is my very first impression to this hotel  Even though there were 2 bellboys when i step down from taxi Check in is fast  upgraded to business room as ambassador  The receptionist offer to take my luggage to my room but I turn it down as it is not her job Avoid the breakfast  limited choice

Really well presented hotel  The exterior is very grand and pretty and lobby is welcoming and warm A comfortable and clean room  The staff were all really friendly and pleasant  We enjoyed the daily breakfast  where a good fresh selection was available  The area that the hotel is in is very convenient  The hotel is attached to a shopping centre and is located in a busy shopping area  We had to buy a new suitcase and found one in the department store nearby  Lots of restaurants and things to see  Felt quite studenty No complaints from us  All round an excellent stay at a very reasonable price

It really is a great place to stay   the things that keep it from excellent are small Location is outstanding   you are on top of a shopping mall   transportation hub  there is a wonderful pool   with a few too few staff to manage clearing the chairs   not a huge issue for me as my son never came out of the pool for a rest I joined the ambassador club prior to my arrival   which included breakfast and wireless for you and your guest   it also includes a room upgrade  and a two for one coupon for a IC hotel as well  so hear are the rubs    Coming from the US you land in the middle of the night   we arrived at the hotel at 3am   and even though the hotel called us twice and emailed us asking about our arrival time and confirming our time and status    there was no one there to take our bags when we showed up   after a few minutes I got a luggage cart myself and took our bags in  After a few more minutes someone was at the desk to check us in   and it was not till I reminded him that I should get a room upgrade that he processed a new room for us That being said   the new room was huge   and wonderful   and we had a great stay  Also watch when you go down for breakfast   going down in prime time can be crowded as it is a big hotel  we were there at 6 30 most morning was fine  All and all a wonderful time and just a few things that held back the 5 star

I frequently travel to Singapore on business and have tried several hotels  I haven t found a hotel that beats it for location  service  and value  The hotel is a great place to stay either for a vacation  as I have recently  or on business  as I do regularly  The hotel is located adjacent to Bugis Junction with easy access to the MRT  shopping  and restaurants  The restaurants and facilities in the hotel are also excellent Room Tip  Join the Intercontinental Ambassador program  The free one night weekend stay will pay for the memb   See more room tips

I usually stay in the Traders but decided to try somewhere else for a change  On arrival I was very surprised that for a hotel of this class  free wifi was not included and disappointedly  I ended up upgrading to a club room for an additional  100 per day  as when considering a charge of  30 per day for Internet and  38 per day for breakfast  it seemed worth it with the additional extras  I stayed in shophouse room  which was very nicely furnished with a comfortable bed  separate shower and bath  The position of the hotel was a positive   very central  making most places easily accessible  The club room was very spacious and comfortable with a good choice of snacks and beverages  Not sure that it was worth the additional cost but would probably consider it again

We stopped at the intercontinental for 2 nights on the way back from Europe to Australia  We booked into a club room because we knew we might have wait around for a room on arrival or for our flight  As it was  the stay at the hotel and the club lounge was a highlight of our trip  On our arrival we were greeted and escorted to the lounge and offered tea while they looked after our booking  We felt like royalty  Thank you

Had a great one day layover  They even had a B Day cake waiting for me cause they knew it was my B Day  The only issues was noise if you stay in the center rooms from the elevators  The mall access of on one side of hotel which makes it easy access for shopping and dining  I would recommend this hotel to anyone traveling in the areaRoom Tip  Dont stay in the center suites elevator noise is loudSee more room tips

Stayed 4 nights at this hotel and never regretted the choice  We were booked into a Club room and were upgraded to a shophouse room on arrival  After spending the first night there  arrived very late at night  we realized that this was not our type of room in that although newly refurbished and with a nice bathroom  it felt cramped by all the furniture it contained  it had lots of lights that one did not know how to operate swiftly  Most of all  being it on the second floor  first by european standard  and having the window looking directly on the indoor market  the curtains had to be kept closed at all times to have some privacy  this in turn made the room very dark  For all these reasons we asked to change it with another on a higher floor This request generated some surprise since in fact we were refusing the upgrade  but after explaining our reasons  we were moved on the 11th floor and although this other room was not newly refurbished  it was perfectly functional  We had been staying at this hotel previously in the past and always in a Club room when the Club lounge was much smaller  had not been renovated and was managed on a much lesser scale than it is now  The location in Bugis  away from the crowds of Orchard road and connected to a large mall  makes it one of the best hotel choices in Singapore  also if you can treat yourself to a Club level room you will enjoy a wealth of priviledges from breakfast to afternoon tea to evening cocktails served in a really beautiful environment  Room Tip  Choose to stay on a high floorSee more room tips

 King size bed is very comfortable  Rooms are sound proof  Plasma or LCD TV is in the room  Airconditioing system is very good  Guests can increase or decrease the temperature settings to their Another intercontinental brand  Smack bang in the centre of Singapore  Right next to Bugis Junction mall and underground metro  this hotel boasts a vast array of fun and travelling opporutnities  A grade service and amazing spacous rooms  Bathrooms are huge as well  Very close to the airport and traffic wise  you seem to be against the flow of traffic always  I have probably stayed here 4 times already  Even though Orchard road boasts numerous other well known establishments  I still keep coming back to this hotel

We spent 2 nights here on our return from Indonesia and were very impressed  We had booked a standard room but my daughter had emailed the hotel telling them about an illness I have  the operations and treatment I have recently have had and which will start again very soon so they had upgraded us to a club room  gave us a fruit basket and flowers  It is lovely to have someone give something to you when things are pretty low in your life The room was lovely and the club lounge was a little oasis away from the noise and heat of Singapore  We had breakfast there each morning and cocktails each evening  The service was superb whenever we were there  attention to detail was amazing  The one little quirk was that I was asked to wear closed in shoes rather than  what I thought were  my classy sandals  These shoes were not strappy and very dressy  Whilst I was being asked to wear closed in shoes men we allowed in dagged jogging tennis shoes   strange The location of the hotel was great   2 minute undercover walk to MRT and the Bugis Street shopping  Big department store next door  movie theatres and 3 stories of food court close by Other reviewers have said that the rooms were a bit dated but I disagree   our room was in excellent condition  bathroom was luxurious and all the public areas were great Overall a fabulous hotel

Stayed in a beautiful King Shophouse corner room  250   The room was large and beautifully decorated with traditional Peranakan pieces  It was blissfully quiet as the shops below close by 10pm and don t open until 10am  I m not a large hotel type person and the Shophouse room felt Singaporean rather than bland international although I think that the rooms in the high rise building might be pretty much stock standard but not having seen one  I can t say for sure  The only suggestion I could make is that the doorways could do with a coat of paint  but otherwise the hotel is well maintained The Shophouse room gave us access to the Club Lounge  The staff there were excellent and did so much to help us  such as finding websites for booking bus tickets and contacting the airline for us when we had trouble  They even arranged to let our teenage son stay in the room for 1 night  normally max 2 person capacity in Shophouse rooms  to save us from having to change rooms after he left the following day for Europe  as had been booked Really loved that breakfast  afternoon tea and cocktails are included at no extra cost  Started breakfast in the Olive Tree Restaurant one morning but abandoned it in favour of the much smaller atmospheric Club Lounge The location is great for exploring Little India and Kampong Glam districts  both about a 10 minute walk away  Singapore doesn t have just one downtown area so being at Bugis MRT station was great for getting all over the city and is on the main line from the airport  We stayed at another hotel in Chinatown a few days later  which was also Shophouse style  but the room was tiny  the bathroom flooded every time we showered and was the same price as the InterContinental but didn t include breakfast or have a pool Would definitely stay at the InterContinental again next time Room Tip  Stay in a corner Shophouse room for space  atmosphere and access to the Club Lounge See more room tips

We returned to the Intercontinental Singapore to find just a bit less than the same general standard of service and facilities that we found last year  the refrigerator in room 1410 was not very cold and we would pick it up later at 3 30 pm  The young man at the concierge desk who wrote the receipt tag didn t give us much confidence that he knew what an ice pack was  I brought the receipt tag to another young man at the concierge at 3 15 pm  and he said he would have the frozen ice pack brought to our room  Despite the efforts of the lady using a radio telephone at the concierge desk and the active concern of about three staff stationed at the lobby  neither the ice pack nor the person with the receipt tag could be located  We left for the airport at 3 45 pm without the ice pack  We haven t waited more than 5 minutes for an ice pack in any of about 60 hotels around the world  30 minutes is a new record That was unexpected considering the excellent standard of service at the Olive Tree coffee shop buffet breakfast  the laundry pick up and delivery  the suitcases delivered to our room  and the well appointed room on the club floor  The Intercontinental Singapore still has unique advantages such as  Very pleasing architecture and open spaces A lovely lobby lounge with quiet surroundings Availability of several excellent in house restaurants Covered access to MRT and shops in pillows Reliable and strong in room wi fi Good TV and cable stations Excellent buffet breakfast at Olive Tree We would have rated our overall experience very good without the ice pack tension  but we are human  and memory of our very last experience before leaving the hotel overshadows all the others

I have stayed in a number of hotels in Singapore  I was attracted to the Intercontinental when I saw pictures of their shophouse rooms  I thoroughly enjoyed my stay and I would go back anytime  The hotel is in the heart of Bugis  an area known until the late 70s for the nightly gathering of Singapore s trans women  Today it is a shopping area with access to the MRT system  Bugis Junction   The hotel consists of a large tower which looks like lots of other hotel buildings in Singapore   and the addition of shop houses  These houses were merchant houses in the 1920s  If you want a room with a view  book the tower  I liked my shophouse room  room 343   It was spacious  the bathroom had a bath and a shower  the wooden floor in the bedroom  the large settee and the furnishings created a comfortable environment  Breakfast was varied and plentiful  I had one meal in the hotel  in the lounge  not in the restaurant  which was enjoyable  The staff were attentive and efficient  The hotel has a central location  close to the MRT if you want to use public transport  Taxis are not expensive in Singapore  as long as you make sure that you do not use a hotel limo which is about 3 times the price of a standard taxi   The hotel will book a standard taxi for you  the booking fare  which is paid to the driver in 8 S    There are lots of restaurants in the vicinity   from Raffles to small eateries  The shophouse part of the hotel is large   if you have mobility problems  ask for a room close to the lift

You are made to feel welcomed upon arrival  It is my 3rd time staying here  the experience is still great  Courteous staff  clean  and i adore the shower facilities in my room  and of course nothing to complain  Of course  to quote the Chinese proverb  picking a bone out from the egg   and really being picky  the swimming pool is bit too tiny

Lovely visit to this InterContinental property with a lovely open lounge which beckoned at the end of a long day  Restaurant offered a vast array of buffet delicacies that are sure to please  Breakfast was delicious and well served  Located next to a shopping plaza made evening walks a pleasure  The room  however  could have been more gracious and was not up to the par of other hotels of this stature

Just back from 4 days at the Singapore Intercontinental A great hotel staffed with great people who are attentive and knowledgeable  The hotel is designed to look and feel like one built 80 100 years ago  but is nearly brand new  Definitely a better mix than the standard modern hotel or boutique We were lucky enough to be upgraded to one of their  Shop House  rooms  The room looked great and the old style  but modern  bathroom was a nice touch  I was extremely worried about street noise  we were on the 2nd floor looking over the corner 4 way traffic lights  and was going to ask for a room swap until I stood next to the window and couldn t hear anything   amazing  They must use airport hotel grade window glazing    couldn t hear a thing    3 very peaceful nights  sleep A dessert one evening in the main lounge was really good  They look like they do a good afternoon tea  although we only saw it   didn t try it The Bugis Junction mall behind the hotel is modern  full of interesting stores and GREAT food options We were very sorry to leave and would recommend the Intercontinental to anyone Room Tip  Get the Shop House rooms if you can See more room tips

I ve stayed in Clarke Quay and the Marina but this location was by far the best as the hotel opens out to Bugis Street Shopping Mall and markets and the MRT  There was a food hall in the mall with very cheap food The twin room had two big queen size beds and the bed felt like I was couched on a marshmallow cloud   I didn t even want to get up in the morning  it was the most comfortable bed ever  amp  included a pillow menu  The toiletries provided were top quality and I usually don t use the hotel toiletries but in this hotel  they were so nice that I did  The wifi is fast and fabulous  The rooms very spacious  amp  clean and the shower was great water pressure and temperature and plenty of room  The shower is separate to the bath and easily accessible for the elderly  The pool is excellent too The service was amazing and the housemaid was like my personal concierge  He gave me his personal telephone number in case I ran into any difficulty when I was out and about but I didn t need to use it  He gave me a map of the MRT transport system and advised me exactly where to go for all my shopping needs  Nothing was too much trouble for him and he did everything with a smile  It was so comforting to know that even though I was out and about alone in Singapore  there was somebody who would come to my rescue should I need it  Reception service at checkout was just amazing and if not for the checkout procedure where they ask if you have collected all your belongings from the safe including your passport I would ve been in real strife at the airport as I had forgotten my passport and had to venture on back to the room to collect it There was nothing I could fault  not one thing  Next time I m in Singapore  I will definitely stay again

My wife and I stayed at InterContinental Hotel Singapore for 4 nights in October  2013  This is an excellent hotel  and we highly recommend it  Some of the highlights are   Efficient and pleasant welcome at the checkin  We arrived at this hotel around 2 am after long flights  The checkin was smooth and fast  We couldn t handle anything less   We stayed at a regular room in the tower  while the size of the room and the view from the room are ordinary  we especially loved the very comfortable bed  helped to get rid of our jetlag and travel fatigue   the nice shower  and the well chosen ammenities   Breakfast  one of the best buffet breakfast  Both variety and quality were excellent    Western  Chinese  Indian  Peranakan  along with lots of fresh tropical fruits  Just beware of eating way too much  as it is so easy to do here  Singapore offers so many excellent restaurants to enjoy  and you don t want to be too full after breakfast   Polite and capable hotel staff  Everyone was very helpful  There are always one or two in the lobby who helped us to get a taxi right away  And the Concierge helped us to book good seats at a popular restaurant   Great location  This hotel is adjacent to the Bugis MTR station and the shopping malls  It s also very close to the City Hall area  Arab Street and even Little India  Of course  most everything is a short taxi ride away Overall  we were very satisfied  and we will use this hotel again when we visit Singapore next time
