You will note from my previous reviews that this property is on high rotation in my hotel playlist  20 stays this year and goodness knows how many nights  I have honestly forgotten   I am the one who declines the upgrades at check in and opts for a standard room with more light  I am the one who is given access to the Club InterContinental Lounge but never uses it  I am the one who is offered a free welcome drink each time I stay but never drinks it  This time however was my final stay for the year and at check in I politely asked if something different might be available for me  The offer itself was generous but when I was escorted to the Ambassador Suite I was blown away  One of the reasons I love this hotel is the extremely high ceilings  bonus points  but the suites on the 16th floor have ceiling that go on for days  The views over Singapore are stunning  rain  hail or shine and the expansive space evokes such a luxurious feeling that I would stretch out on one of the many sofas and just say  wow   Truly remarkable rooms with a layout that makes sense  A full size dining table makes room service meals feel like you re eating in a palace  A separate office means you can leave your work and relax  eat  dance  whatever you please  and not have any reminders that there might still be work to be done   out of mind  out of sight  I had 8 guests over for drinks one evening and even with 9 of us all spread out on sofas and the various room service carts and ice buckets  and later  empty champagne bottles   it still felt palatial The staff really did go out of their way to give me a WOW room and I am eternally grateful  If you have something to celebrate  want to treat your friends to one of the best glasses of champagne they have ever had  or really are from royalty then the Ambassador Suite is for you

Prior to arrival I booked a Club room on IHG com while chatting to one of their sales agents  Before traveling i printed the hotel confirmation  On arrival I was told that I had a deluxe room with breakfast  I showed the front desk my printed confirmations on which he promised to double check with their international office and return back to me  Approximately half an hour later Raj Peralta from the front desk came up to our room and apologized the misunderstanding  For some reason something had went wrong  but the solved the problem by giving us a Club advantages  I would say  that the club is not the best I have tried and does not compare to intercontinental citystars in Cairo for example  The snacks served in club lounge was tiny sandwiches and a couple of desserts  Nothing much that you can enjoy if you are looking for halal food  As we were travelling with to kids we were not allowed to the club lounge during the evening cocktails  But we were more than welcome to enjoy our drinks and food in the lobby lounge which was much much much better than the club lounge  I must admit that the service we received in lobby lounge was second none  Jovin and her colleague took very good care of us and we were good on understanding our dietary needs  Raj in the front desk  Jovin and the guy in lobby lounge made our stay outstanding  These people are for sure the best people a hotel could wish to have  We had a wonderful stay at intercontinental for a week with excellent food served in restaurant with fresh juices  It would be nice is the restaurant could specify which food is halal and non halal  Will definitely return again

I arrived much later than I hoped to  To Singapore  The staff is really nice and very courteous  I stayed for 6 nights there  The location is great  It s right near bugis street  The metro is 20 meters away  There is a mall right underneath The brunch is one of the best I ve had in Singapore as well  Singapore is really small and you can easily get everywhere by MRT  You are literally 20 minutes away from everything  Was a great stay and a great hotel The pool is on the 4th floor and it is a beautiful outdoor pool Definitely coming here again if I ever go back to Singapore Room Tip  Queen size bed is bigger than the kingSee more room tips

Last month again I chose this hotel for my 02 stays in one month  First I stayed for 4 nights  amp  then for 03 nights and I must tell    this place never disappoints me  I always feel very comfortable and relaxed  The location is very good  breakfast superb and some good dining options  The staff is very helpful  amp  courteous  Overall a very good stay Room Tip  Always look for a room away from liftSee more room tips

Undeniably good  but not awesome  The biggest plus is the location  walking distance to a lot of places you will want to visit  if you can stand the heat  and  more importantly   particularly if you  cannot  stand the heat   next to the MRT  Bugis Station   Our deluxe room was nicely sized and classically appointed  on the inconspicuous side   but was showing signs of fatigue  the wallpaper starting to peel off here and there  some chips on the furniture  the occasional carpet stain?    Details  really  that I guess many people would not even notice or dismiss as slight  Not that it is shabby  by no means  Maybe my expectations were set too high  given the excellent reviews  not to mention the rates ?  it is not a particularly cheap hotel   Very comfortable bed  nice coffee making amenities  good storage  excellent bathroom  Polite and attentive staff ?  very accommodating  The swimming pool is wonderful  particularly at the end of the day  All things considered  I would probably stay there again

We joined the intercontinental ambassador club which meant we had an upgraded room and Also had the club added in  We arrived in Singapore with colds and feeling jet lagged so spent a lot of time in the hotel and felt thoroughly looked after  The service is second to none the staff are really friendly and make every effort to help

Got a deluxe room on a high floor  This was the first time I got a high floor room  Always got the shop house type  And I was so wrong to get this high floor  The rooms look tired and old  Sheets were stained  Lights not working  The key card slot looks like its gonna fall off anytime and needs a big effort to push all the way down  Really I would go for a shop house next time  Probably need some revamping and touching up  It s really convenient though  Thanks to Kelvin at the front desk who was friendly and helpful

Just checked out today from a 3 night stay  Overall the hotel was excellent and staff very attentive  We arrived early and they checked us in no problem and even phoned to see if the room was all okay Hotel location is great being right next door to the Bugis Junction mall  and walking distance to Raffles City square and little India  The pool was great as was the gym The only minor negative was the coffee at breakfast took a long time to come every day and the walls were a little thin with us hearing noise from the room next door regularly Overall a great hotel and we will be back

As an SPG Platinum customer it was interesting for me to see what other brands are offering  And  honestly  IHG doesn t perform with the Intercontinental Singapore  not at all The hotel is in urgent need of renovation  The carpets on the corridors are in process of disintegration  the doors show major dents  the TV is one of this 1st generation LCD  maybe 27 quot    the elevators are run down etc  The complete style is very  very old school  The positive point I ve to mention is the Concierge  They re very knowledgeable  have guided us to the right places Singapore offers so many good hotels  brand and no brand  that there s no need to stay at a run down IHG hotel  SPG isn t better in Singapore  too

One of the things I enjoy about travelling in Asia is the way the airports are organized  Europeans and Americans have a lot to learn about getting people in and out with the least amount of queingand hassles  And Singapore  like everything else there  works and works well  When you finallyget into the main hall  take a taxi  They are relatively cheap and you dont save anything by taking some shuttle bus which stops at every hotel The Intercontinental is in the Burgis district  Plenty of good shopping and restaurants  It was one of the old British Empire locations and the lobby reflects the old world charm  The staff was very friendly and efficient and our two rooms were spacious  with big bathrooms completewith a bath tub and enclosed shower  The bed was enormous  with lovely sheets and pillowcases and we slept like bears We didnt take breakfast because we were travelling with our kids and breakfast was 36 dollarsper person  which we thought a bit on the high side  We arrived on the 24th so I understand thewhole Christmas thing  But right around the corner is a food court with every conceivable kindof fare  from McDonalds to noodles  So we had Egg McMuffins and were just as happy  Oneday we thought we would try one of the hotel restaurants  the Olive Tree  It was having abuffet lunch  for 100 dollars per person  So we opted out and found the Grand Asia restaurant a short walk from the hotel  Im a bit of a Chinese food afficionado and this place is one greatChinese restaurant  We had Peking Duck which was on special offer at 38 dollars and ate likekings for under 100  for the four of us  The hotel has a lovely outdoor pool on the 4th floor and an exercise room with all the apparatus you need  On Christmas Day we took this tour to theSingapore Zoo which we heard both good and bad things about  If you are pressed for time I wouldnt do it  Its a physically beautiful place  very lush  nice lake  But not particularly interesting as far as animal exhibits go  Im not sorry we went but I wouldnt go out of my wayfor it  We all wanted to see this Marina Sands hotel with its famous rooftop pool  Personally I cant see why anyone would want to spend their time there  I mean the place is enormousand you even have to wait in line for an elevator  They dont allow non guests to go to the poolbut for 20 dollars per you can go to the observation deck  But not the pool  so we passed Since our daughter is 14 and shopping her great past time in this part of her life  Singaporewas heaven  For my wife and I  it gets a little wearying  Along the way we stopped at several other hotels  just to comparison shop  There are several more glitzy than the Intercontinentalbut I prefer the quiet reserve of the place  We took a cab to the airport which took 20 minuteson a Monday during the morning rush  No problem Room Tip  5th floor corner roomSee more room tips

Stayed 4 nights at this great property  I had booked my room from hotels com and there were some misunderstanding about the rooms on check in  I booked a club room with club benefits but there were wrong pictures of the room on hotels com website so I was a bit disappointed at first when I got the Business room  It did get compensated well because they gave us those Shophouse rooms from the renovated part of the hotel and they were amazing  Especially the bed is propably the best I ever slept in a hotel  Beautiful bathrooms and furnitures  Service was excellent  breakfast and evening cocktails at the lounge were very nice Room Tip  Shophouse rooms See more room tips

In the 90 s this was our favorite hotel  we used to stay here about 4 times a year until newer hotels came up and we just had to book to find out how nice and how the service is  Well  anyway  it s really good to be back  They still have the grandeur of the lobby  their coffee shop is still one of the best and the services is excellent  Though the room furnitures are a bit old  the bed is still the best bed for us  My husband love their bed  One thing good about the room is  it smells good and it s very clean  We still enjoyed our 2 nights stay  We had high tea at the lobby  still good We will again patronize this lovely hotel Room Tip  Get a room with a view of the poolSee more room tips

This is a nice hotel with vantage location  However  it seems to me that the front of house  FOH  are just bent on getting guests to subscribe to more non value added services rather than enhancing the guest experience  I booked an executive room for a 5 night stay business trip in December 2013 but was not allowed to have a late check out unless I subscribe to additional non value added services  Meanwhile  all the usual pegs like one business newspaper and 2 laundries were offered  I must have been screaming of so much cash that they wanted to bleed me dry

Good start to a seven day break here when upgraded to a suite on arrival  Service  as usual in Singapore  was excellent throughout  Location is excellent  being close to places like Raffles and with a metro almost underneath  Lounge is very impressive  especially when compared with some of its more contemporary neighbours  Suite was very well laid out in a traditional style but with plenty of space and good fittings  Free wifi is always a bonus  The one downside that prevented it from being excellent was the congestion at breakfast  One morning an extra area in the Chinese restaurant had to be utilised  We used the lounge area for breakfast  This had a good ambience but a poor selection of foods  etc  Only one chef was there and he did not know how to make scrambled eggs  It was not until the last day that we realised we should have gone from the lounge into the main breakfast area for the selection there  That choice was excellent  A little extra treat was a complementary glass of champagne on New Year s Day morning Room Tip  If you use the lounge for breakfast still get your choice of foods from the main breakfast area adja   See more room tips

Just spent 8 days at the Intercontinental with an extended family of 11  We were guests of the  quot Club quot  and this is worth every cent  We were greeted by name every time we entered  nothing was too much trouble and the children were spoilt  Special mention to Jana who was a delight  LOVED the magic box  and Jovin and WaiKi who all were exemplary in their service  All the staff that we had contact with were a credit to the hotel  The room was spacious enough for our family of 4 and was neat and cleaned well every day  We loved the small touches that housekeeping did like arranging the children s stuffed toys in different poses every day   they adored this We loved the pool area and the evening cocktail hours were excellent  Not often that you are offered Verve Cliquot champagne for free   and we weren t about to say no Will not hesitate to recommend this hotel   just remember to take the Club experience Room Tip  Ask for a high floor if possible to maximise views See more room tips

Stayed here for 3 nights  what i can say more       IMPRESSED   Nice Victorian building  polite and warm staffs  nice room and all the ammenities  also the Christmass decoration are awesome 1 things that this hotel should improve a little bit is the breakfast  i am not so happy with their breakfast  The rest are PERFECT   Hotel facility and also the location in Bugis Junction with a lot of variant restaurant  shopping center  and also metro

Stayed there for a week  Very convenient location  next to Bugis Junction mall and metro  Rooms are nice and quiet  Other 5 star hotels are nicer  but would cost more  Had free Wifi  which is rare in Singapore  Small issues though  Doorman not there at 2am arrival  Pre requested rollaway bed was not there  and had to be requested  Power outlets weren t working  due to tripped circuit breaker  All issues were promptly addressed  but not fun to deal with in the middle of the night after 20 hour flight  Buffet breakfast was ok  Intercontinental Hong Kong breakfast is still the best

I stayed here with a colleague for a business meeting Sep 13  We were both impressed by the standards here  with only a couple of disappointments which were more likely related to the external event management company  Friendly helpful staff  clean and well appointed rooms  Very fast and friendly dry cleaning pressing  Pool area lovely  Food at our 2 day meeting was a bit ordinary  however I think they were trying to please delegates from numerous countries so it just seemed a bit of a mush mash  Hotel breakfast was excellent though  Great location and the concierge arranged all our private dinner reservations efficiently  Walking distance to Raffles and Luke Mangan s Salt Tapas Bar and shopping  I know it s not customary to tip in Singapore but I always slip the cleaners  porters  concierges and waiters a few bucks

The Intercontinental was the first of 7 hotels that we stayed at during our 21 day trip thru Singapore  Thailand and Malaysia  It was an excellent way to start  The hotel is very well situated   close to shops and transport  We received a really good welcome  The room was comfortable for the 2 of us and we were most surprised to find bathroom scales supplied  Just as well those weren t in the hotel we stayed in 3 weeks later We would definitely stay at this hotel again  Value for money   and that s hard to find in Singapore

Staid only for one night  A classic Intercon in a good location  Staff was friendly and helpful  Room was good and meals were great  breakfast at Olive Tree and lunch at Man Fu Yuan   The room was nice but could use a bit of update  On the way of price  airport transfer   110 SGD  Internet 30 SGD  bottle of water   beer 12 SGD  All things considered  we would probably try somewhere else on our next visit

We went back and once again it felt like home  We love it whether we are in the club rooms or ordinary rooms  Staff are just amazing  The hotel has a feeling of nostalgic magic coupled with slick attention to detail for business people  Nothing is too much trouble for the staff  the rooms are extremely varied in styles so once you get the hang of what you like it is easy to book the kind of room you want  Their shophouse rooms are not my cup of tea but somepeople love them  The pool is just right for a quick swim and relaxing looking out over a busy city  Trains are so close and so is the best shopping in Singapore  Uncle Pete in the foyer is wonderful and Robert the doorman cant do enough to make sure you are happy  safe and well looked after  The staff upstairs in the club are amazing  I think there has been a bit of a shake up there which it needed  I would prefer it if they enforced their dress code more  some people dressed as if they were about to go swimming in what is supposed to be a trousers and shoes only area  there are heaps of casual areas if you don t want that  Please send people who don t like to dress down to the Olive tree  Food is top notch  we ll be back Room Tip  ask lots of questions about what you get in one type of room as apposed to another See more room tips

First of all  I reserved for one king size bed room but they ended up giving me two double beds  The person who checked me in wasn t even apologetic  They had massive construction noise going on  Inside hotel is like a maze and very difficult to figure out way around  I am a member of ambassador club and I got not recognition for it and they didn t even give me the room I reserved

Adding to previous comments  it certainly is all a bit rough around the edges  carpets are getting old  the gym is on the edge of being filthy  uninviting to say the least  and their is a distinct smell around the place  a bit mouldy   We had a nice room but it looked into the shopping mall  which was odd  but strangely alluring when standing on the balcony people watching Went to breakfast very early every morning in the Olive Tree Restaurant  Good quality and choice  our Breakfast was included but I understand it is rather pricey when booking separately One last point  Avoid the SPA  It is not a SPA 3 5 5 that s it

This is the third time I have stayed at this hotel and I always have had great stays  I really like the ambiance  feels very colonial  The location is near a MRT Subway and the hotel is attached to a great mall which is really convenient  Their breakfast was one of the best I have had and the lounge area is really nice  Rooms have are large and well appointed  The staff is also very friendly and helpful  It s one of few hotels I really enjoy going back to  Definitely a five star hotel

We stayed at the InterContinental Singapore for the first time on our way to Bali  December 15th   19th  We were delighted by the property  It is well located  and has a boutique feeling despite being rather big  The lobby is astonishing  Certainly one of the best ICs we ve stayed at so far  around 10   To us  IC Los Angeles Concierge had been the best  but we must put IC Singapore Concierge team up there with them  A special tip of the hat to Swathi who made sure all our requests were met and some more  thanks to her great professionalism and warm personality  Overall  all staff was extremely professional and efficient The room was very nice  and yes  the TV could have been bigger  not to mention the weird absence of a decent On Demand movie selection  Breakfast was fantastic  with a variety of Western and local cuisines  Make sure you have coffee or tea at the spectacular lobby  On our first night  we had dinner at Man Fu Yan  and I must say it was maybe the best Chinese cuisine meal I had ever had  With IC Los Angeles Century City  our beloved The Clement Monterey  and IC Magnificent Mile in Chicago  The InterContinental Singapore is most certainly one of the best properties we have stayed at

On my family trip to Singapore  we stayed in 3 different hotels   one being the InterContinental  any I must say  we wished we never had to leave  The staff are fantastic and very accommodating  The rooms are lovely  and executive club sets the bar for all others like it  The  quot snacks quot  weren t just snacks  they were beautifully cooked inventive appetisers  and the staff paid attention to your every need  Very close to everything around Singapore  including shops and restaurants  A must stay in Singapore

I know this place very well having lived here for about 6 years in the late 90s early 2000s  The last time I visited was 2011 but during my visit this year over the Christmas period I was delighted and surprised to be still remembered by the longer serving members of the Concierge  For me the service is personal and consistently good despite the fact the the place is far from small and staff turnover must be considerableI love the decor of the public areas that have had a recent facelift  but this has not changed the overall hotel image which projects a presence of more genteel times       the rooms project this same feeling of comfort and peace and the staff are well trained and highly efficient whatever their role or their responsibilities Perhaps the place is a little more Touristy that it used to be and there seems to be an in creasing number of mainland Chinese faces around the place but this does not seem to have had any negative impact to date  The inter is well located with Raffles Hotel very close by as Bugis which means along with the also nearby Raffles City shopping centre very convenient MRT accesswhich provides a very easy access gateway to the rest of City  I have always stayed here on my visits to Singapore  which are quite regular and highly recommend you place this excellent hotel at the top of you accommodation list

We stayed at the Intercontinental for 4 nights in January  We took the option to upgrade to the Club lounge which was well worth it  S  100 per night which gave us breakfast  afternoon tea and happy hour drinks from 5 30 to 7 30  Given the cost of drinks in Singapore  this alone made it worthwhile  The room was great with one of the most comfortable beds I have ever slept in  The service in the club lounge was fantastic and the breakfasts were superb  The only downside was on checkout when we found that the rate was subject to 10  service and 7  tax thereby adding around 20  to the bill  this had not been mentioned when we checked in and were sold the deal

I loved this hotel  It is a beautiful hotel which gives you a taste of the history of the area  We had interconnecting rooms to fit a family of 5  The rooms are very large and the beds are large and very comfortable  The single beds are huge and fit 2 of my children easily in 1 of them  Breakfast was amazing  especially the fresh juice bar  gluten free muffins and real coffee   Shopping nearby is great and very reasonably priced shops

Stayed here for 3 nights and have no regrets  Everything about this hotel is wonderful  We arrived at 530am after a long flight and were in our room within 10 mins  As we re ambassador members  we had the usual complimentary upgrade  The staff at the front desk were very welcoming  The room was magnificent with a huge foyer  large sleep space and stunning bathroom  The service was exemplary  We probably had the best breakfast in Asia at this hotel  This is the place to stay in singapore in my opinion

My family stayed Xmas days at the Intercontinental hotel We had a great time  especially staffs  hospitality is excellent  We stayed three hotels in Singapore during this trip  I think this hotel is the best hospitality in these hotels  We really enjoyed morning buffet with Santa Claus  it was a great present for my children  Morning buffet is good value for choice  every one should choose morning buffet   Location is also very interesting area for looking around

A modern hotel located in a Peranakan heritage shophouse style setting  conveniently close to the Bugis precinct area  We took the option to reserve a Club room which turned out to be a very good move  Our package included a superior room which was located on a separate floor with its own dedicated check in  It also allowed us access to the Club lounge which given the extortionate prices in Singapore turned out to be very cost effective  We could pop in and out of the lounge all day starting with a fantastic full breakfast  Unlimited tea  coffee  soft drinks  amp  water plus a few snacks were always available  In the afternoon they served a proper English tea and then at 5 30pm offered unlimited canapes and alcohol until 7 30pm  Service was fantastic and we easily offset the extra ? 35 per night it cost us for the Club room against going out and buying the same in restaurants and bars  Our room was spotlessly clean  excellent wi fi  very spacious and comfortable  And if you want to know Anything go talk to the concierge Arnie Rivera   he know Everything   and gave us some great tips for getting round the city  Highly recommended   definitely worth 5 stars

Me and family checked into Intercontinental Spore on Xmas Day 2013  The whole hotel had a very colonial feel to it  And we were pleasantly surprised at how lovely the room was  Everything was spick and span  exactly like a 5 star hotel  Checking in was easy and fast  Location was next to Bugis Street  hence it was very convenient for food and shopping  The coffee house where we have our morning breakfast was lovely  Highly recommended for anyone looking for a gem of a stay in Singapore

From check in to departure our experience was above and beyond our expectations the personalised check in was very well done and it was such a relief to go straight to our room after a long flight Our room looked over the pool and was spacious and comfortable  The hotel is traditional and majestic Located close to transport and shops with a mall and street market close by the hotel is well located  The are also some great streets close by haji st full of caf? s an d fashion This is one hotel that I will stay at again and I highly recommendedRoom Tip  Ask for a room over the poolSee more room tips

In the past 2 years  I stay at this hotel when I visit to Singapore  This time  they upgraded me to a Junior Suite room  The room is spacious and bright  the typical hotel room that I like  The sofa fabric maybe needs to be replaced because a bit rundown and dull color  The bathroom is also nice and bright but the shower is a bit awkward with a small swing glass door  too small for some people   The flat TV is a bit old  the brand is Philips and was made in 2006  I checked the back of the TV because it could be swiveled  Usually  the new rooms will have new Samsung flat TVs in this hotel Overall  this hotel is nice and I still recommend this hotel  It is attached to a shopping mall called Bugis Junction  Plenty of restaurants  little shops  supermarket  etc Room Tip  Shophouse Rooms  Peranakan Style Design See more room tips

Months ago I reserved a deluxe  club level room here  On check in  I was pleasantly surprised to be upgraded  Instead of a tower room  they put us in one of the shophouse rooms on the second floor  While the furnishings are lovely and the bathroom is great  the space is dark and gloomy  looking over an alley  I think it feels smaller than it is due to the complete absence of natural light  I wonder if the rooms that look over the arcade might be more vibrant  Asking to move  the only choice available was a non renovated  standard room  While the Conrad where I ordinarily stay has less character in its public rooms  its guest rooms are more spacious and convey the sense you re in a high rise city  I don t think I would come back to this place

Just spent 3 nights here and have been very comfortable  Upgraded to a club room and the extra cost was very good value  Breakfast was included whether we had their fabulous buffet on the ground floor  or a freshly cooked choice in the club lounge  Free  and very efficient wifi  and a host of other freebies  Good bathroom with a large separate shower and good toileteries  Room serviced twice a day  Service always charming Room Tip  Pay for the club roomesSee more room tips

One of the best hotels in Singapore with excellent location as you are in Bugis  next to a shopping mall  then on walking distance you can get to Raffles Hotel and Suntec City  I was using the Club facilities and service there was outstanding and food and drinks served in breakfast  afternoon and evening were of good quality  Even the Club is rather big for this property  it was very crowded in the evening  but being spacious you still feel comfortable  A taxi to airport in non peak hours will take you just 20 minutes and you can move around the island by subway  entrance very close to the hotel back door  or even by bus Probably they should consider to upgrade the TV in the regular floors as the size is smaller than you may get in similar properties and the gym equipment looks old and tired  but still on good working condition

Check in was excellent pleasant experience and bags brought up to your room  At the time of check in afternoon tea was being served a large club lounge and first class service enjoyable The Room was spacious with a large king size bed   plenty of room in the bathroom as well  Did not try the restaurant as there was plenty of food and wine in the club lounge The hotel is surrounded by large shopping malls and covered walkways a pleasing when it was raining overall the 2 night stay was excellent  no hesitation to stay here again to the hotel well done

We had not stayed at this hotel since the 90 s when I remember that it was very good  We were very happy with it this time and will be returning on our next trip to Singapore  We stayed in a recently renovated and very nice 3rd floor Shophouse room with access to the Executive Lounge on the first floor  We arrived at 7 30 am following a long flight from Paris and although not due to check in until our room was made available immediately  free of charge  The room was large and roomy with a high ceiling and very quiet with attractive period decor Service was impeccable through our 3 night stay and breakfast in the lounge was excellent as were drinks and canapes in the evening  The location on an MTR station above a shopping centre and a block from Raffles could not be better  particularly given the wide range of restaurants and cafes in the immediate area Room Tip  I would have preferred a room closer to the elevators and would ask for it in future  However given   See more room tips

We returned to the this hotel after visiting it many years ago and was pleasantly surprised to see how well the hotel had maintained its standards   The staff were amazingly courteous helpful and friendly and went out of their way to make you feel special The rooms were very clean and well presented  The hotel is ideally situated in Middle road making it a good central position to explore the city  We would recommend paying the extra and book  club  rooms allowing access to the club lounge where you can enjoy the  club benefits  of breakfast  afternoon tea and evening cocktails   between 5 30   amp 7 30pm  where the staff really excel at taking care of its visitors Whilst difficult to single out a member of staff Fiona in the club lounge certainly deserves a mention  Room Tip  Book a club roomSee more room tips

We decided to spend Christmas in Singapore at the last minute and the Inter Continental was the ideal place to stay  The hotel is very clean  the staff friendly  the breakfast was great and covered any option you wanted  The pool area was lovely and we spent many an hour lazing by it  The bed had to be one of the most comfortable I have every slept in and the room was quite spacious  Located a short walk between City Hall and Bugis stations  the hotel is ideally located for using the MRT  Bugis MRT station is also on the line to Changi airport  providing an easy and cheap option for getting to from the airport Overall a great place to stay for location and that bit of indulgence that we all deserve now and again

Stayed for 8 nights recently  I have to say that this is the best hotel that I have stayed at in Singapore  Service was fantastic  room service  dry cleaning  cleanliness of the rooms  buffet breakfast etc  the hotel is in a great location  attached to Bugis Junction shopping mall and the Bugis MRT station  Also within walking distance to Arab street  Raffles hospital and Raffles City  Taxis are also easy to get from the hotel lobby  While I didn t have time to use it  the pool looks amazing  Would highly recommend

We stayed 2 nights in a Club room before going on a cruise  Arriving midmorning for check in we were taken to a special lounge area where we were offered breakfast while our room was readied  It is in a wonderful quiet space that is for the Club room guests  They also have snacks during the day  tea in the afternoon and a lovely cocktail and heavy canapes session each evening  The staff is welcoming  soft spoken and extremely pleasant  What a joy after a hot day of sightseeing  Our room was large  well furnished and very comfortable  Bath was granite and marble with separate tub and shower  The bath amenities were top notch We did not use the regular restaurants or pool as we were trying to do as much as we could in a short period  We felt very well cared for and would highly recommend this hotel Room Tip  Club Room was worth the money for usSee more room tips

First step out of the taxi into the main entrance  there was a garbage stench in the air  Then we checked in and was offered to upgrade for  100 Sing per person per night  And with that  we would receive access to the gym  amp  free breakfast  No thanks  Could not justify the extra fees  Room was fine  clean  But the sink was not draining at all  So within 30 min of being here  the maintenance crew was in our room fixing it  No apologies  Good impression  No lah

Good level of service as expected from Intercontinental hotels and ease of check in  Comfortable rooms with high level of amenities  Club lounge services good  consistency with evening dress code would prevent upset from guests   asked to change footwear after wearing same for 2 previous nights and other guests not receiving same request  Disappointing gym and spa facilities but good pool area  although noise levels high from surrounding streets  Great location for transport and shopping and access to attractions  Staff helpful and attentive

My wife and I are travelling round the World  and currently the service in this hotel is the finest we have had anywhere  I strongly recommend you book a Club room  These are newly re furbished and well equipt for a comfortable stay  This also gives you access to the excellent  Club Lounge   which provides a welcome retreat from the city  with free tea and coffee all day  and also complimentary buffet food all day  Breakfast is an imaginative mix of traditional Western fare  mixed with more local offerings  We also enjoyed the complimentary  Singapore Sling  cocktail in the evening  The hotel has some useful other features  including a small but adequate swimming pool on a roof terrace and several restaurants  We tried the buffet restaurant which was fine  but I think better fare can be had elsewhere  Evening in the main foyer had a pleasant atmosphere  with piano and light meals being served  The staff were wonderful and for a large hotel very very friendly and helpful  Full marks from us   thank you

Another 2 wonderful short breaks at this elegant hotel  As An Ambassador upgrades were much appreciated to the club level and more recently to a shop house club room  Such a great location only a few minutes walk to Raffles city  Next to Bugis junction  Rooms elegant  clean  super comfortable with the best curtains in any hotel we have stayed in and great pillow menu  Only comment would be to supply a door draught light roll as there was rather a lot of light coming under our door from the hallway  We improvised  Staff at all levels are friendly  welcoming and attentive  Lobby Veuve Cliquot brunch on Sunday magnificent  Lounge is impressive but relaxing a wonderful afternoon to laze away with music  good food and drinks  Our grateful thanks to the personal attention from all the club level staff it really is becoming a home away from home  Thank you to Jana for her personal attention and all her staff for making our stay so relaxing  To the lobby lounge staff thank you for making our afternoon memorable  Sophia  Bill  Shelley  Houssein and Ain for her Berry Love Cocktail    delicious

we stayed there for a couple of nights on the way from Australia to the UK just to see Singapore and have some break during our long journey  The hotel was recommended by our friends and we loved the choice  We stayed on business 2nd floor and got access to the business lounge and its advantages for excellent breakfast  absolutely enjoyed breakfast there with a big choice of fresh fruits and dishes in buffet and freshly cooked meal by the chief in front of us  perfect and very friendly service   There were as well several offer for meals during a day  but it was so popular that we hardly used it and once after not finding a chars to sit we were offered to go to hotel s lobby on the ground floor and we were looked after very well there and served with the best champagne and big choice of snacks that actually made us to cancel dinner as we were full by the time of the dinner    The room itself was specious and comfortable  on arrival we got a plate of complimentary fresh fruits and water  The bathroom was big and comfortable  I don t give the highest mark only because the room was without balcony and our windows looked at the road that was quite busy  The hotel is located quite well  so we enjoyed to walk around  The staff of the hotel is very friendly and helpful and left warm feeling and desire to come back to the hotel again  On the negative side was only their very expensive bar that we visited only once and noticed that it was empty  but after seeing our bill we realised why it was not popular  Anyway  we would recommend this hotel to our friends Room Tip  our room on business floor was very nice See more room tips

We had such a bad experience during our last stay in Singapore at our usual hotel that we decided to try the Intercontinental  We wanted to get this trip right as we had some overseas guests joining us Well did we ever make the right choice  Stayed in the Shophouse rooms and loved every minute of our stay  The rooms were clean  quiet and comfortable  Having Club rooms made it even better  the level of service at this hotel is equal to any Intercontinental Hotel and better than most  We will be staying here again on our next trip

Very comfortable hotel  extremely friendly and helpful staff   cannot fault it at all  Everything was as it should be   and more  Would definitely stay there again  On our arrival  it transpired that our travel agent had forgotten to book us in for the first night  but the lady behind the desk made every effort to find us a room  she did   even thought the hotel was full  Very comfortable beds  very clean rooms and everywhere  Very soft pillows  which could be changed on request  Ample cupboard space  Large  fluffy towels  Good shower and toiletries  Good buffet breakfast  with staff who would get whatever you wanted   if they could  finding my husband a Financial Times  for instance and making his special tea mixture  We also were offered 2 free pieces of laundry a day  shoes could be cleaned  Location was pretty good  near shopping centre and Raffles Hotel  not too far from places like Boat Quai and China Town  we took buses as there was a bus stop right outside  Also MRT right next door  Swimming pool very nice  with sun most of the day  good beds and light snacks and drinks available  Good gym also available   essential for my husband  Only slight problem sometimes was availability of taxis   twice had to wait for as much as 10 minutes  but that is the only niggle  Did not eat in the restaurant except breakfast  so cannot comment on that  nor did we use the Spa  though my husband was very happy with the Jacuzzi by the gym  Wifi free Room Tip  Higher rooms have better views See more room tips

This hotel is in a great location  just a quick walk through the attached Bugis Junction shopping center to the convenient Bugis MRT station  Lobby is nice  restaurants and bars generally good  and staff very attentive  My only complaint is that our room  which was in the shophouse section of the hotel  was quite run down and clearly had not yet been renovated  in particular  the furnishings were obviously tired  and the bathroom was embarassing  dirty grout  broken tiles in shower  parts of ceiling crumbling   Very unlike the other Intercontinental properties I ve visited in the past  Luckily the bed was very comfortable  with excellent linens  and allowed for very restful nights  On the whole a pleasant stay  and I d be likely to reserve at this property again as long as I could be guaranteed one of the renovated rooms

We stayed here in November 2013 Very clean every where  Friendly staff  We upgraded to a club room  This was worth every penny It gave you access to the club lounge at any time  snacks  tea coffee etc 17 00 to 19 00 was free cocktails and spirits  There was great food for 2 hours  Enough to get you through to breakfast if you wanted  Good breakfast  English  continental  Asian and more The hotel has a side door leading through to a indoor shopping area  Out and about we either walked or used public transport  Its in a good position to explore Room Tip  If you can upgrade to clubSee more room tips

This beautiful old hotel was a luxurious plus to our Singapore vacation  It is clean and very well kept with marble and beautiful decor  The bed was cosy and comfortable  The staff was extremely helpful and friendly  They even know our name when we arrived  The location was connecting to a lovely mall with lots of food choices and a grocery store  There was more shopping all around and the location was nice  We had a beautiful room  high up on the 13th floor with a fantastic view  We would stay there again Room Tip  We enjoyed being on one of the upper floors with a view of the city See more room tips

This hotel is in the Bugis area of Singapore  I love the fact that it is not a high rise   no views  but there are no great views from building rooms in Singapore anyway  The reception area is unpretentious and cosy which is lovely  There is a vast expanse of a seating area with very comfortable seating removed from the check in area  The service is just right and the breakfast is more than adequate  The room  corner room for me  was bit quirky in layout but spacious and well appointed  Toiletries were first rate  There is a mall adjoining the hotel   and the distance from Orchard Road means that the place is not jam packed with shoppers All in all  a great hotel if you are OK staying away from the Orchard Road shopping district  The plus point here is that it is a short walk from the Marina Bay area with its cornucopia of restaurants

We travel the world and can always count on the InterContinental experience  Not the case at this hotel  I booked the Upgraded Shophouse room and was shocked when they opened the door to our room  The wood floor was all scratched up and the room smelled of mildew  We even questioned if this was the right room  As we were being escorted to our room I was surprised to see the condition of the worn hall carpet and the walls are in desperate need of paint  They called it old world charm I call it in desperate need of some TLC  On the good side the staff was very pleasant and eager to please

Spent a weekend in Singapore at the InterContinental and was impressed  The staff were very courteous and unlike other reviewers we were staying in a room that had been recently refurbished  so no complaints about decor  Things I loved about the hotel 1  Underground parking 2  Outdoor swimming pool  amp  jacuzzi on 4th floor 3  Excellent gym on 3rd floor 4  Beautiful large hotel lounge with pianist providing background music 5  Good sized double bedroom with large bathroom  including bath  amp  walk in shower 6  Proximity to Bugis Junction mall  Very happy with my stay in Singapore

Hotel was very good and the mooncakes upon checkin was a delight We ended up getting upgraded to a shophouse room which was very nice  in comparison to your average hotel room  The hotel itself might be starting to showing its age a bit   definitely some wear and tear on it  Regardless  the staff was very friendly and the breakfast and Club Intercontinental was very good  everything you could possibly want   Location of hotel is also good   underground station right around the corner

The hotel is in a good location and the public spaces are elegant The Club facilities are excellent and the service is good  As Ambassador members  we regularly stay at Intercontinental hotels   our room at the Intercontinental Singapore was comfortable  but a little run down in comparison with others we have visited  If the Hotel has any plans to refurbish  we would advise management to consider placing power points next to the bed There did also seem to be some minor service issues  in particular staff communication  however we were there at a very busy time  on the eve of Chinese New Year  Nonetheless  we will be back

We have spent around 42 nights at this hotel over the last year as Royal Ambassador members   and have been visiting the hotel for many years  This stay was for a three week leisure stay in a Shophouse Club Suite  A hotel is more than just a building     it is the people that make your stay perfect   and the staff at this IC are perfect and welcoming  Jana manages a wonderful Club Lounge and it is worth the extra cash to ensure you can use the lounge  The hotel is perfectly located and I d say is particularly good for business people who visit often because the hotel notes what you like and what your preferences are and ensure that everything is always perfect for your stays  We will be returning soon

We loved this charming elegant hotel  Yes it is older but well preserved and has so much character  You definitely feel you are getting a taste of old Singapore  The room was newly refurbished and huge  Clean  comfy beds  great bathroom facilities and products  Staff friendly and very helpful  The club room was perfect for breakfast  nice and quiet and not as busy as the buffet downstairs  A quiet retreat  Location was perfect  Would stay here again Room Tip  Club Intercontinental RoomSee more room tips

It was Valentines Day 14 2 14  checking in as an ambassador member is always a wow at intercontinental  We were escorted to the higher level floor for a private check in  The staff at the counter on was very courteous and knowledgeable and professional  Even though it was only 11am the room was ready for us  In the evening we since it was Valentines day the club lounge was buzzing and the hotel had flowers for every lady in the house Location of the hotel is very central  Actually one of the doors opens into the Bugis Junction shopping mall and the rail station  Breakfast wasnt very good but then I probably got them on a busy day where the waiter who sat us down forgot to take our drinks order  Food wasnt of a very high quality but it wasnt bad either  Range was definitely not there Room service was aweful  dinner was late plus the food quality was shocking  We complained about this to the ambassador lounge staff and they reversed the charge Staff are very helpful and friendly Building is old and ancient looking but the top floor rooms seems quite modern  Location is very central that is the biggest plus for this hotel  Heaps of local food outlets at the door step  The Victoria bar is a good place to relax and unwind  It has sports channel Overall I was very disappointed that the premises was part of the INTERCONTINENTAL brand  Since I have stayed at the other Intercontinental s  this is miles behind the likes of Bangkok  Sydney  Melbourne Room Tip    Bugis Junction Train station and shopping centre is at the door step  Room service is aweful   See more room tips

Only a one night stay but would return  Good location   easy to walk to Raffles  City Hall  20 minutes to Orchard Road  Helpful and friendly staff on reception  concierge  bar and lobby lounge  Upgraded to a ShopHouse room which was huge  well appointed  luxury bathroom and quiet  Breakfast was marred by losing my table  drinks and newspaper when I went to get food from the buffet   there should be a system for solo travellers to prevent this happening as this is not an uncommon occurrence around the world  Asian hotels are for me generally better than European and North American and this one didn t change my view

Lovely room  great staff  Amazing breakfast  Well located This hotel was perfect for us  It connected to a mall and mass transit without going out in the rain  The room was renovated and we had a good view from the 13th floor  The breakfast buffet was outstanding and catered to all breakfast food cultures  a bit of sushi  dim sum  Chinese soups  great bread and cheeses  pastry  Indonesian noodles  fresh tropical juices  and of course eggs  bacon cereal etc

Me and my family stayed at this hotel a few weeks ago and was greatly pleased with their impeccable service and efficient staff  We booked 2 rooms and was given an interconnecting room free of additional charge at the front desk  i was requesting for connecting rooms weeks before our stay but was told that I d have to pay extra for a room upgrade   The whole hotel from the lobby  lounge and rooms were very charming with it s unique Perenakan     design  The staff were all very nice and would go the extra mile just to help us out with our queries  Location was great as well  with shops and restaurants and the MRT station right at the back  I would definitely stay at this hotel again when in Singapore

We stayed at this hotel from 6th Jan to 9th January 2014  it was a great location as you could easily walk to lots of different places  It was linked to two shopping centres and a minute walk from a great market which is in door with air conditioning great place to buy little gifts  The hotel was a great  we experienced a lovely welcome  very helpful staff and great rooms very clean too  The rooms were modern  We arrived around about 2pm and our room was ready  even though there were lots of people checking in at the same time  more staff attended the desk to ensure no one was waiting around  The breakfast was great you had lots of choice and a table always available  This hotel was only  20  Singapore  from the Airport by taxi and the taxi drivers are very nice  once you arrive to the airport you have a guide of how much it will cost you before you get in to the taxi and all taxi¡¯s are run by the meter  Would definitely go back and stay there

The intercontinental is in a very central location and is actually connected to a lovely shopping centre  the Bugis junction and not to far from the railway station  The hotel was beautiful and the service in the hotel was impeccable  The staff were always attentive to our needs and were very friendly  we could certainly recommend this hotel and would love to go back again

I have stayed at the Singapore intercontinental several times now and the service has always been impeccable  From the moment of arrival to the time of departure  I could not find fault with anything whatsoever  As a loyal customer of IHG I have travelled the world and stayed in over 60 of the intercontinental Hotels and there are few that match up to the quality that you staff delivered to me as a customer Several of the staff went the extra mile  Zing who greeted me at reception and took me through to the upgraded suite and Anne from the club lounge who surpassed a service I have rarely seen  My flight with Cathay Pacific was on hold due to the recent weather and she spent several hours trying to contact them for me  When this was not possible she kindly walked me downstairs to point me in the direction of their offices  Helped me rebook my reservations in Berlin and was incredibly helpful in general I checked out of the hotel and departed at 05 00am and went to the airport only to find my flight had been cancelled so I rang back to the hotel to see if I could still use the room I had checked out of  I spoke to Kelvin who assured me that I was welcome to return to the hotel and re use the room if I could not get on a flight Fortunately I was rebooked on a flight shortly after and rang Kelvin back to thank him for holding the room for me On my next visit I was greeted by the front of house manager Matthew who added an even more personal touch to the stay  There is now a champagne brunch on a sunday with Veuve cliquot champagne and everything from fresh sashimi to traditional roast and everything in between  I can whole heartedly recommend the brunch and indeed the hotel My only observation is to some people the rooms may seem a little dated but I have always been given a fantastic upgrade so I cannot complain about if the decor is to my personal taste Room Tip  Always get a club room the lounge is one of the best in the intercontinental groupSee more room tips

Very good location  Huge Bugis Junction shopping mall is right there  connected to the hotel  No need to travel for any shopping needs  good prices  Funai digital Mall is walking distance Good size hotel  especially comparing to Marina Bay Sands what is way too big to get any good service Buffet breakfast and dinner are super  If you like oysters  etc  this is the place I experienced fastest room service in my life  The guy was probably standing behind my door while I was ordering

Great location and we ll deserved recommendation from my colleague who has stayed here for around 2 of the last 4 years  I joined the Ambassador plan for  200 which just for this stay of 20 nights have me  25 value of laundry and fruit per day on top of the upgrade to a fabulous junior suite  Breakfast is lovely setting and standard  my only wish is they would not cover the hash browns sometimes which makes them soggy   The room service is prompt  Staff are attentive  polite and happy  Beds are divine with fine Egyptian cotton  TV has been upgraded to a good standard and the bathroom products aren t going to make you break out in hives like some hotels  Even the 18 bucks for a Chilean sav blanc was fine considering it was from a fresh bottle and perfect temperature from the Victoria Bar So why not five stars Its the points for Intercontinental outside the USA  2 000 per STAY  Three weeks here gives me the same as two nights in a Holiday Inn So I can spend  30 000 here over the next 4 months in 4 stays and not have enough points for a free night That is astonishing for such a vast international 5 star hotel group to be so lacking in loyalty measures So if you stay here for short trips or frequently it is brilliant  Five stars plus frankly  Just not for longer as you get the feeling you out stay the welcome

Mostly a great hotel  Staff are attentive  check in is quick  rooms clean  and quite large with all amenities to hand  Breakfast very good and well managed  My only complaint is the internet  I was here for business and needed a reliable internet connection  It was quite clunky  dropped out a lot  was not sufficient to use for even audio FaceTime or Skype calls reliably  I have previously stayed here for business  and didn t have this problem  so I m not sure why it is an issue now  I think maybe there s been a change to their in house wireless network

I was looking for a good deal with a quality hotel and i certainly found one here  Website easy to manage  and book  They followed up offering the upgrade to a club room for just S 50 per day  worth it as the breakfast and evening drinks with snacks were good quality  Room was well appointed and my only problem was the chair at the desk  and sadly I did need to work at the desk was not good  Just a hardback chair  which for desk work was not good enough considering everything else was so good  Lovely bed and linen  Very helpful staff  and lovely lobby and lobby lounge  very good for meetings  They are  quot plus selling quot  hard  but it was OK and have agreed a corporate rate for next visit Apart from the Club lounge I cannot comment on any other of their food outlets as not used I have stayed in several Singapore hotels and would be happy to return to this one any time

My visit was with my husband  our two young children and my mother in law  I did the reservation directly to the hotel and told them I needed a connecting room  Upon arrival  we found out that we were upgraded to the shophouse rooms  we booked two standard rooms  since there was no more connecting rooms in standard  It was a great gesture from the hotel The rooms were great  too  We were given a double king size bed and twin beds  Although the room size was a bit small for a five star hotel  approx  less than 40 sqm   having connecting rooms made it up  The breakfast at Olive Tree was also excellent  plenty of choice for kids  The hotel was adjacent to Bugis Junction  which meant great food on the doorsteps and MRT station was just 5 minutes walk from the hotel  However  getting a taxi from the hotel was rather difficult  especially during rush hour  Although the rate was not as high as other five star hotels  especially in Orchard area  it is still a pricey hotel  but it was worth the price

3 night stay breaking journey between Sydney and London Stayed on a club floor which is good value with excellent breakfast afternoon tea and cocktails and canapes etc as well as own reception Staff there particularly helpful Fiona and Jovin were charming Location very good to access Raffles Bugis Street  hop on hop off bus tours and the Metro Arnie the concierge a mine of information as was Uncle Pete  good size rooms and bathroom Would definitely stay again MynwyRoom Tip  club floorSee more room tips

This was our second time of visiting this hotel As a Gold Ambassador we were automatically upgraded and in this instance to a Shop Room which was across a small bridge within Bugis Mall  At first I was slightly concerned about the possible noise from the shopping mall but this proved not to be a problem The whole experience from the room itself  the club floor  the staff and location again were all first class I would thoroughly recommend this hotel as a stopover to Australia or as a base for visiting Singapore

I had a good stay at the InterContinental Singapore during a business trip in February As an Ambassador member  I was upgraded to a junior suite  The room was quite spacious with nice views of the city  I appreciated the fresh fruit every day  The bathroom was also large with a separate shower stall and bathtub  Water pressure was great  The only downsides to the room were curtains that let in the light in the mornings and the lack of electrical outlets near the bed The location was quite convenient  The Bugis Junction mall is attached  and the Bugis Plus mall is across the street  The MRT is only steps away  However  there did not appear to be that many bars open late in the immediate vicinity

We were early arrivals after debarking the Regent Voyager cruise ship and were greeted at the front steps by Jess  a very friendly staff member and escorted directly to our room for a private check in  As platinum members there were special benefits available  This was our first trip to Singapore and Arnie  the chief concierge  and his staff were exceptionally helpful in many ways  The hotel is directly connected to many shops and small food vendors adjacent to the premises  It is also directly connected to the Bugis MRT Station which gives access to the whole city  The bed was extremely comfortable and the room was impeccably maintained  Every time you turned around in the public area there was staff inquiring if they could help with anything  We looked at the very pleasant outdoor pool area but did not use that amenity  I would recommend this hotel to anyone  Try the Sankai Japanese Restaurant on nearby Liang Seah Street  There were so many small restaurants nearby that it was hard too choose one but Sankai was excellent with authentic Japanese dishes offered at reasonable prices  I would return to the Singapore Intercontinental anytime

Excellent experience  On the recommendation of others here we booked a  quot Club quot  room  A bit more expensive but worth every penny  Not only do you get preferred check in  but full access to the Club room  Free  full  breakfast in a relaxed  uncrowded  and comfortable environment  free snacks  and unlimited drinks  at  quot high tea quot   and a great meeting area in between  Our room was spectacular   Don t know if it was an  quot upgrade quot  from a standard room or not    nor do I care  and included some of the more luxurious and comfortable bedding I have ever experienced  The location was perfect  right in the heart of the city  within walking distance to the HoHo buses  Raffles hotel  malls  and subway   PS  even traveling novices and trepid travelers should consider the subway  clean  easy to navigate  and friendly   A shout out to the concierge who was happy to help us plan our time in the city

Having booked two rooms for two nights we were pleased with the efficient and personalised pre arrival emails but on the ground there were several poor features of this stay  First the reception clerk was very cold  unwelcoming  slow and seemed more concerned at trying to sell me up to the next class of room  Club Level   Secondly  the rooms were ok but showing signs of wear  desks  room items such as trays  wardrobes  and incompletely kitted out with amenities  Thirdly the pool area was slightly scruffy and it was hard to find a pool towel that was not torn I was most surprised  Finally  being off season there was no pool bar but a telephone service  the problem was the phone worked once then went dead  So the negatives out of the way  the location is good and main lounge area has a sense of gravitas  The breakfasts were fine I will not be going back  Verdict  Must do better

Took my time deciding on where to stay and it was worth it  It is situated in a prime location by Bugis Street  Raffles is not too far away  the DHL balloon gave fab views of hotel  I travelled with my two sons aged 8 and 5 and my 17 year old daughter and was advised to stay in the premier rooms  It was an excellent size for us  spotless and the benefit of L occitane toiletries  Believe me it isn t fun travelling with the kids but the hotel made up for all that  The pool was spotless and quiet  and the staff were fantastic  Will be visiting again when in Singapore  Breakfast was fine a variety of tastes  the kids loved it  The lounge is spacious and welcoming  singapore slings and nibbles yum  Reception were very accomodating  taking no time to arrange extra towels and toiletries and an extra bed  We had extended check out time as we were being picked up late afternoon at no extra cost

Great location  charm  comfort and staff Haven t tried the restaurants as we ate out  even for breakfast  but the drinks in the tasteful lobby were really good The IPod connection could not work properly in our room  and the spa was just OK  but our expectations were high considering the other amenities We had a very pleasant stay  and would come back

Just returned from a lovely stay at this hotel  Got a very warm welcome and was escorted to the Club lounge for a quick check in  We were upgraded to an ambassador suite rooms which was marvelous  a large living room with a dining and work area and guest toilet and a large separate bedroom with excellent bathroom  Service was exemplary in every aspect and the staff were fantastic  The lounge is newly located on the second floor and is a huge one which is tastefully decorated  The only let down is the breakfast which is very frugal in comparison to other 5 star hotels in Singapore  I tried for the paid breakfast in the Olive Tree restaurant downstairs but that too was a disappointment  Wonder why the hotel does not give importance to its issue  Went to the Mandarin Oriental for breakfast and I have never seen such a spread in my life  Otherwise the hotel and staff at IC are fantastic in every sense  The location is unbeatable too   attached to the Bugis Street shopping mall and with everything under its roof including a massive food court and supermarket

We enjoyed five days at this hotel while touring the city  Our room was on the same floor as the Club Lounge and we often used this room for  chill out  time while enjoying breakfasts and afternoon tea with a limited view  The room was well furnished and clean while the king size bed was an absolute treat  The service staff were very prompt as we would sometimes leave the room and return after only a short time to find the room had already been tidied I would recomend that you bring a copy of your booking agreement  We had booked a good deal on the hotel web site before we came over but when we arrived  we were quoted a higher price as the standard rate  The concierge handled the matter very professionally  while taking a copy of our paperwork to the manager for verification  and we were soon assigned to a room The staff were very friendly and helpful and the hotel was positioned nearby to shops and the Bugis Street Train Station We loved our stay here

Although the Intercon is now getting on to 13 years old  it continues to be one of the prime hotels in the area  With its excellent location next to Bugis Junction and its great range of services  this is one of the area s best properties  Treat yourself to the club floor and let Saliporn and Peter pamper you  Can t say enough good about this hotel  highly recommended

We stayed at the Intercontinental for 3 nights  We reached Singapore at 6 am and called the hotel from the airport  amp  was told that they do have an available room so we were able to check in early that morning  The check in was quick  amp  easy  amp  the staff were very friendly  amp  helpful The shop house room was spacious and clean  The bed was just right  We didn t use the swimming pool or the gym  amp  didn t eat at any of the restaurants there  There are simply too many food outlet around the hotel for authentic local food at a much lower price The location of the hotel is excellent  it is just next to shopping centre  amp  MRT station Overall it was a great stay at Intercontinental  amp  the friendliness and helpfulness of the staff just beyond my expectation

I asked our daughter s advice for the booking of a good hotel in Singapore  As she and her partner were working there  they took the trouble to go and visit several hotels and warmly recommended the Intercontinental  The best choice I agree   The hotel was lovely  elegantly decorated  conveniently situated and spotless  The staff was helpful  polite and professional  I very much liked the added  personal  touch of beautiful flowers in the main halls I would recommend the Intercontinental anytime    In fact the best recommendation is     to go again   which I am doing in a few days time Francoise

Everything about this hotel is superb  The location central for everything that Singapore has to offer  we walked to all the main tourist areas day and night  The staff are fantastic  nothing too much trouble  the breakfast selection was the best we have had anywhere in the world  Our room was extremely comfortable  our bed and especially the pillows one of the best we have ever had  We would definitely stay here again when in Singapore

From the moment you walk into the Intercontinental Singapore  you re welcomed by efficient staff and immaculate presentation I used this hotel as a connection for a couple days however instead of holidaying in Thailand as planned I returned here with my friend after just four days because I loved it so much  I am a InterContinental Ambassador member  which allows you access to a variety of benefits I was a bit apprehensive about joining this club back in Australia however this has made my visit completely worth it  Rooms are old world five star  clean and very comfortable beds  Staff are quick to rectify issues should you encounter any problems its fixed without question This hotel is similarly priced to the big name hotels in town  however the service  comfort and location of the hotel is far more superior  Pool is massive on level 4 however spa is not heated  Food at breakfast is plentiful  tastefully presented  and once again attention to detail is seen throughout  Coffee not so good Club lounge comfortable  spacious and once again excellent bar service If you want to have the famous  Singapore sling  simply get the Lounge access you will save lots of money compared to buying them else where at  25 a drink   and have the bonus of elegant and tasteful canap? s Thanks to all the staff at InterContinental Singapore you made my holiday that much better  Special thanks to Kelvin at Front desk for your kind assistance with my room move to a quieter room  and Faiza at Club InterContinental for ensuring the internet was fixed Its the excellent service culture and  can do  attitude this hotel adopts that makes me love the InterContinental Brand Room Tip  Get a room that faces the front of the building e g   pool side or entrance side as its quieter Ai   See more room tips

This was our second stay at Intercontinental Singapore and both stays have been fantastic  We booked a Shophouse room and received a pleasant surprise when we were upgraded to a fantastic room on the 16th floor  Room was great with a separate bedroom and large lounge family room  The best thing about this hotel is the staff  They are very friendly and provide fantastic service  except for a grumpy doorman who greeted us when we arrived  We don t usually complain  but the guy was obviously having a bad day and the experience made us think twice about this hotel  We mentioned this gentleman to the manager in the Executive Club when we checked in and they couldn t do enough to apologise   including sending a complimentary bottle of wine to our room  Now thats customer service  From that point on  the staff were simply fantastic  Its well worth upgrading to the Club rooms as access to the executive lounge is great value  Given the price of alcohol in Singapore free cocktails  wines  beer etc from 5 50 7 30pm is well worth the cost of the club room  So  if you want to receive great service in a lovely hotel  this is the place to stay in Singapore  Oh  and go for the club room Room Tip  Book a club room to get the club benefits including free drinks from 5 30 7 30 every night See more room tips

This hotel is by far my favourite in Singapore  Old World Charm not just in the rooms but the attention to detail by the staff  I was upgraded to a shophouse room around the side toward Middle Road  above the little laneway  and it was quite a large room with quiet ambience  This is a hotel that prides itself on service  My room was always remade early  Club Access was a definite plus and this is where you do really see the difference from other hotel experiences  Checkin is always a breeze and Jana is always there to welcome you with a smile and remembering your name from previous visits  A personable young lady called Wai Kit will provide you with great service in the lounge from coffee  to apertiffs in the afternoon or a drink during the day and then keeps making sure that my coffee or tea was fresh whilst working  A big thanks to Vivian to for the quick checkout she was on her way home but took it upon herself to sort me out first  Well done ladies and well done Intercon Singapore  I will be back

One of the old classics with a wonderful lobby lounge where you can disappear into deep sofas  Rooms are nice but lack artwork on the walls  I stayed on the 4th floor which is the pool level and it suffers from horrendous humidity issues  The corridor smells nasty and leaves you wondering if it s not suffering from some serious fungus issues from the humidity  The room was okay except for the wardrobes   clothes smelt awful when I took them out  Otherwise it s a very nice hotel  service is patchy but the Front Desk staff are excellent and most others are willing and efficient  Good shopping is attached to the hotel and it s really well placed to head out to Marina Bay Sands or to Orchard in the other direction Room Tip  Not on the 4th floor See more room tips

Fabulous old style colonial charm  Good location  right next to a mall with interesting shops food  Convenient to other tourist and non tourist locations  Rooms were clean and well prepared  Pool was simple but lovely  Service was outstanding  I have to make special mention of the amazing service we received during our stay  My 6 year old son got very sick whilst on holiday  The staff went out of their way to check we were ok  organised a dr to come out  phoned every so often to check my child and I were ok while we waited for the dr and afterwards to check my son was improving and if there was anything they could do  They had to do a lot of additional cleaning and did so without complaint  even with a smile at 2 am in the morning  They were accommodating and concerned for our well being and I appreciated the extra care they gave us during a stressful and scary situation  The whole staff from concierge  to reception  to cleaners  to room service waitress  to restaurant staff were friendly and highly professional  Would not hesitate to stay here again

My husband and I stayed here for 7 nights on our honeymoon  Words cannot explain how amazing this hotel and its staff are  From the moment we arrived at the door we were treated like royalty Check in and checkout  as we booked a club room we were brought straight up to the breath taking club lounge and were swiftly checked in with our bags being brought straight up to our roomRoom  we stayed in one of the club rooms  which gave us access to the club lounge   On arrival we were welcomed with mini chocolate truffles  fresh fruit and love heart biscuits   such a sweet touch for our honeymoon  The room was very large  clean  had a gorgeous charm and very well stocked with amenities  toothbrush and toothpaste  comb  makeup removal pads and cotton buds among the many things Room Service  prompt and polite  We ordered room service on a number of occasions and the staff were very friendly without being obtrusive Staff  every single staff member without fail was polite  helpful and friendly  I haven t got a bad word to say about any of those lovely people  From the concierge staff who went out of their way to give your directions and tips about your stay and where to go  to the staff who would ensure you got a taxi quickly and would welcome you back with a big smile and open the door for you to the amazing people in the club lounge who cater promptly for all your requests and the staff that would come around at night for  turn down service    close your curtains  put a fresh bottle of water on your bedside table  neaten up your shoes  place down a towel on the floor and lay out your slippers  Club lounge  if you can afford it  don t miss this   This is an exclusive section of the hotel only for club lounge members  mostly business people   You can have your buffet breakfast here or down in the main dining area  there is then afternoon tea  so many delicious morsels   cocktail hour  delicious cocktails and also food served  and throughout the day until about 10pm you can pop in and help yourself to water  softdrinks or get served coffee or tea with some biscuits  There is so much food and drink offered through the club lounge that on many nights I skipped lunch and dinner  Location  The location is fantastic   So many shops in walking distance   the hotel is actually connected to a shopping centre which opened until about 10pm   needless to say we were never bored  It was great to be able to pop out and have a browse  be able to buy gifts at ease  pop into the foodcourt for a bite to eat and pick up any snacks from the grocery store close by Other  The pool and outdoor bar area is also amazing  beautiful views up many stories high  spas   all very clean  The olive tree restaurant is also nice for buffet but I would highly recommend the MuFan restaurant   so soo tasty authentic chinese dishes  They even come and replace your tea during dinner for a fresh hot pot  The hotel has the most beautiful decor   you really get a sense of history and character without it being old and dated  It was lovely to get some of this culture rather than just stay in a hotel that was sleek and modern    this hotel was charming I hope to one day return and without doubt will definitely choose to stay here again  Thank you so much for the team at the Intercontinental  you truly made our honeymoon unforgettable  we have so many fond memories Room Tip  Choose a room with access to the club lounge  Our room also overlooked the shopping centre   I enjoy   See more room tips

When checking in they tried to give us a different room to the one we had booked and paid for  When we insisted  it was sorted reasonably quickly  The room was clean and well appointed though for a lengthy stay  there wasn t a lot of drawers  The breakfast buffet catered for all tastes and the amenities were great  The real treasure of this hotel though were the staff  The concierge  Mohamed  was extremely helpful  He regaled us with stories of the history of Singapore and recommended tours we may find interesting  He even advised us against one which he said we could do ourselves I would definitely stay here again
