The hotel is in a great location and easy to get to from the airport by MRT  My wife had stayed at the hotel previously and had really sung it s praises so the expectations were high and we stayed here on a stop off  The hotel was perfect and lived up to expectation  The welcome and service is second to none  The rooms are luxurious  spacious and perfect to relax in the comfy beds and having pillow menu was an extra bonus  The pool and facilities are fantastic  great views from the rooftop pool and the best breakfast we have ever had  The concierge also kindly organised a taxi back to the airport for us  Will definitely stay here again due to its great location when we next visit Singapore

We stayed for a long weekend before I had to work in Singapore and then Hong Kong for a week  We found the service exceptional and friendly across all staff  The room was good  very comfortable bed and bathroom   Loved the high power hair dryer  Internet access reliable and fast  Well positioned for exploring  Enjoyed the Olive Tree for the buffet dinner

This is hands down the best business class stay I ve ever had  From the moment I arrived to the moment I left the service was above and beyond  Nothing too much trouble  the staff were always delighted to be of service  I can t quite put my finger on what it is  but it was great and I d stay again without question  Great shopping next door at Bugis Junction and a brilliant central location  Pool is a little overlooked by taller buildings  but hey  its Singapore

A hotel I will consider returning to if in Singapore  The location was great  very close to a MRT station giving us access to the city  Lots of cheap shopping close by and plenty of places to eat The benefit of a club room was great  it gave us access to the lounge which was a great place to relax with very attentive staff  The room was comfortable and clean with a very powerful shower

This hotel simply has one of the best locations in Singapore   Bugis Junction  Being able to step out of the lobby into the Junction mall  then catch the MRT was a godsend As for the hotel itself  room was slightly aged but very comfortable  In fact  I had the best sleep that I ve ever had in this hotel room  The bed was amazing  As a Platinum Ambassador I was given a room with a very good view of the city  very quiet  no noise and absolutely perfect  Room service was simply amazing  laundry and dry cleaning was picked up in under 3 minutes and neatly folded and placed on my desk the next day  The breakfast in the hotel restaurant was good  very good spread  but the restaurant gets crazy busy after 8am  maybe keep that in mind if you re a lone traveler  The attached gym  which I m not sure is actually part of the IC  was also great  a bit small  but definitely serves the purpose  One suggestion though  maybe get some rowing machines Service wise  I found staff to be attentive and willing to help out if you had any questions Overall  absolutely perfect hotel for business or leisure travelers  I stayed at the Conrad Centennial a few nights too  and although the Conrad is a larger hotel  with slightly more grand designs  I felt that the IC Singapore trumped it overall Will be back in 3 weeks for another stay Room Tip  Make sure you are an Ambassador before staying here  and always get a room facing the city AWAY from   See more room tips

Intercon at bugis jucntion Singapore is very nice hotel which is away from the hustle  amp  bustle of Orchard road yet has is closer to other great attractions  Getting taxi is quite easy at this hotel which is an issue at most of them near Orchard  The room was excellent  amp  service is prompt with smile  I would stay here gain

This is a great hotel in a great location and often with prices much the same as the Holiday Inns in Singapore  The rooms are lovely  big comfy beds and typical slightly fru fru Interconti furnishings  All in good condition and well maintained if showing its age slightly  Staff are generally very good and helpful  I was upgraded at check in  Saying that  they are a little lacking in knowledge  I asked them about getting to Batam and they told me most ferries leave from Tanah Merah and very few go from Harbourfront  In fact it is the other way round  They also gave me poor walking directions to Suntec city  I may sound picky  I am   but I do expect that Interconti staff should know more or at least admit to when they dont know stuff  Anyway  don t let this put you off  On the whole a great stay in a great hotel

We had the pleasure of staying 4 nights at this wonderful hotel  and thoroughly enjoyed the experience  The room was elegant and comfortable  and the hotel location is absolutely outstanding The staff is incredible with a pronounced  quot can do quot  attitude  Always smiling and friendly  this facility soon felt like home  Michael Belanger was particularly helpful in our anniversary celebration  and Jovin in the Club Lounge essentially  adopted  us and took excellent care of our every need and desire And the Club Lounge is definitely worth the premium  their breakfasts were great and the variety and quality outstanding  Cocktails and pupus were enjoyed every evening  and sometimes we even skipped dinner as a result of their tasty treats I just can t say enough about this hotel  and on a scale of 1 to 10  we d rate it a solid 12    Doc  amp  Lin Weston

The situation is very good  next to Bugis Mall and with the stop for the open top tour bus across the road It was the usual Intercontinental standard  large bedrooms and bathrooms  excellent service  There is an outdoor pool on the 4th floor as well as a fitness centre  The breakfast was excellent  but we didn t eat any other meals there Interesting experience  we had had a note about a full fire drill  but then of course forgot about it  We left our room at precisely this started  the fire doors shut  amp  the lifts were out of action  Very soon one if the maids came to  rescue  us  amp  took us down the back stairs  whereupon we were met by on the the managers expressing profuse apologies  No need  as it was totally our fault  When we returned there was a bottle if wine  amp  a bowl if fruit in the room Room Tip  The higher floors have a god viewSee more room tips

While a beautiful hotel the room was somewhat dated and we needed to walk up stairs to get to the room   Made a mistake eating one night in the hotels Buffet very overpriced at over sixty dollars a person and despite being told that coffee and tea was include received a bill for  32 for my wifes and my ice teas with one refill each and was told then that only hot tea was included  Did decrease the bill to  16 for the tea when I complained but still

Positive points  Great location   walking distance from MTR  Shops  restaurants  museums  parcs and to the Raffles Hotel where i had attended to some conferences  Beautiful room  lovely bathroom  super comfortable bed  linnen and pillows      stayed at Fullerton before and the room was terrible       Pool is only small but quiet and pleasant  had a swim everyday   Breakfast buffet is good  nothing exeptionnal  good capuccino     Attention to details  house keeping  room service  reception  concierge  staff   all        What i love the most   quiet hotel  not as crowded as Fullerton or swiss Hotel  Very good WifiNegative points   The entrance of the Hotel seemed small at first but that doesn t really matter  Lobby is beautiful  Dinning menu lacking of healthy food    since i m a nutritionist    A small detail   Cutleries are not replaced at breakfast when you change plate No spa  very small fitness room but open 24h Overall   I would stay there again and again   Best pied ¨¤ Terre in Singapore

I just stayed there this week for two nights  After going to and from Singapore for over 20 years  I have been here for the very first time  And was bowled over  It is a range of lovely old shophouse which have been renovated and converted to a wonderful hotel  Great colonial style interiors without being too fussy   very elegant  Great location as wellWonderful room and bathrooms  Courteous staff and first class food and drinks  What more is there to say                expensive but then this is Singapore

This dependable up market business hotel is all that you expect from the intercon chain  though the quirky layout can be frustrating and the location is not prime  The rooms and service are all fine with the breakfast and other food options above average but not outstanding  The gym is fine as is the pool with only real irritation being the layout of the hotel can see you spending time getting from and to your room from the reception and other public areas  Nothing stood out and nothing was overtly detractive either Room Tip  Gt a tower roomSee more room tips

On our return from Europe in September we decided to stay a few days in Singapore at the Intercontinental and with having a fantastic family holiday it was a great way to finish a holiday  The service was without doubt exceptional  the room grand and the beds very comfortable  As we arrived early they had one of the rooms ready for us which they allowed us to have as our daughter was not feeling well from the long flight  The food at breakfast was fantastic the staff helped us in booking day trips and directions around this great city  My favorite was the cocktails we had in the evening to relax and unwind  Great place  Will defiantly return even if is just to have one more cocktail

We booked a room on promotion but what we got was beyond our expectations  We thought the cheap rate would only put us in a small  basic room but we got a big  clean  beautiful room  Of course we expect the room to be clean and well maintained despite the promo rate but our previous stays in other hotels have left us with a  quot pay less  expect less quot  impression   but not this one  We were welcomed with a nice fresh fruit plate  a bright room  clean toilet and bath  oh that s so important  and a big comfy bed  The carpet is clean  without any smell  and furnitures are well kept  not dusty Upon coming back after a day trip to Sentosa  we found our room serviced and even nicer and fresher than it was when we first came The hotel is also in a good location  i e  Bugis Junction Mall is just downstairs  the MRT station is right below it and a number of bus stops are scattered outside  I m trying to think of some negative points to keep a balanced review but those that I could think of are not so significant  at least for me  and I would just probably mention just for the sake of those who might want to know  e g  small tv  Oh  and our room doesn t have a nice view from the window Anyway  I am quite sure that my our next hotel stay will be in an IHG group hotel

Ok I get it  Singapore is the most expensive place to live according to BBC  It is now more expensive to live in Singapore than Zurich  can you believe that  Wow So anyway  where was I  Oh yea  the review  Here it is Pros  Location is superb  bugis lrt is just right under the hotel  The bugis mall is next to the hotel  Decent service  it IS a 5 star hotel  so service MUST be decent right   The National Library is next the the hotel  I didn t had time to venture but that must be a Pro right   The house cleaning folks were nice and friendly  I have a weird habit of chatting with house cleaning folks  You must be nice to those that clean up after you  I believe in this Cons  Beds are so so soft  I like my bed hard  please refer to my other reviews   I have a bad back and I cant sleep well on soft beds    For the price  the breakfast is so MEH  I expected more and so much more    My room was okay  I dunno for the price I expected more   It was so MEH  shrugs

The IHG mobile application allowed me to export my reservation confirmation into Passbook  This in reality serves minimal purpose since they can easily look up my reservation using my name on the credit card  Whilst the official check in and check out times are 3pm and 12pm respectively  rooms may be available earlier  or later  if you email in advance to ask  Correspondence between the InterContinental Singapore team was professional and timely   something you would expect from a leader in hospitality  For this stay  I stayed in a non smoking Club InterContinental Room with Club InterContinental Lounge access and benefits  I arrived at the main lobby area to check in but was met with a large crowd  I then approached the concierge who showed me to the InterContinental Club for an expedited check in  I was offered a drink while I waited for the staff to verify whether my room was ready  The friendly staff then ran through all club benefits  including but not limited to Afternoon Tea  Cocktail Hour  Breakfast  with me  As a Platinum IHG member I was also given two free drinks at the Victoria Bar downstairs  a 3pm late check out and some dining benefits  It is worth noting that InterContinental Hotels have a separate  paid  loyalty program that complements the IHG program   InterContinental Ambassador  Full Review with Photos  http   www theshutterwhale com blog 2014 4 1 intercontinental singapore staycationRoom Tip  Corner rooms are definitely bigger See more room tips

We stayed here for 3 nights and it was just excellent  The front office manager Ms Jing Feng Loh was very nice  We had booked a twin bed and she suggested a bigger room for us in the corner and it was a beautiful one facing the streets  Queen size bed and separate shower and bath tub  But we didn t find it noisy at all  The hotel is in perfect location and attached to the mall  The metro station is in the mall as well and very convenient  They cleaned the room twice in a day  On check out Ms Jing helped us through and waved us good bye as if she was a friend  All in all perfect stay  Would stay again for sure

Numerous staff all eager to please  English ranged from minimal to fluent  there was always somebody in range who could help with communications  Olive Tree restaurant is vey good quality with a wide variety of cuisine  IN room dining also very good  King room was comfortable size  very clean and modern  with an excellent bathroom and other amenities  The hotel itself has an attractive colonial era themed decor  Wide selection of English language television  In room wireless  Lots of shopping within a couple of blocks  easy access to subway

I didn t stay at the hotel  but came with another 2 friends to the lobby lounge to wait for a friend  who s staying at the hotel   The minute we sat down  a waiter came to present the menu  We said we re here to wait for a friend only  The waiter said we couldn t sit here because we weren t ordering drinks and food  We were very surprised for such bad service in a five star hotel  Never before was I rejected to sit at the lobby lounge  we didn t even enter the lobby bar area  we were sitting outside near the walkway   I could understand the rationale if the lobby lounge is packed and there were people queuing for seats  hence priority should be given to those who would order food  The lobby lounge was empty  There was hardly anyone drinking or eating  There were 3 of us and there weren t enough seats at the check in area either  I have stayed in many hotels and this is the first time I received such bad service at the lobby lounge  I find that the management is unreasonable and unprofessional  I will think twice before staying here next time

Arriving at the intercontinental after a 24 hour flight  we were told we had been given an upgrade  After a prolonged check in procedure  we were taken to the room  miles away from the elevator  and half a fllight down  It overlooked an air shaft  was small and worn  We complained until we were shown an  quot older quot   but brighter   room which we took  After that  everything went uphill  The Club was great and handy  the restaurants in the hotel were terrific and the location is ideal  Our room had a view of the city and a sumptuous bathroom  We were VERY happy Room Tip  They are renovating the special  quot upgrade quot  rooms which means lots of noise  Be sure to ask   See more room tips

Beautifully appointed rooms  lovely bathrooms  huge comfortable beds and elegant decor  We were put on a smoking floor despite requesting non smoking which did smell a little but it wasn¡¯t a huge problem and we were offered a free breakfast as compensation which was delicious  There was also a power cut in the middle of the night which meant the emergency lights in the room came on and we could not turn them off which made it difficult to sleep for an hour or so  we had a long letter under the door apologising for the inconvenience the next day  The staff were friendly  helpful and informative  Overall a very good stay Room Tip  Request non smoking and try and go for a higher level to get a better viewSee more room tips

The location of the hotel is excellant  It is located in centre of city and close to the MRT  Many convenient stores are nearby and a McDonald is closed to it so that my kids can have McDonald breakfast in the morning  The staff was courteous and you always see them  quot smile quot  everytime when you met with them  I requested for two beds in my booking at Easter holiday  Because of the late flight  I checked in at 1 00 am  There was no double beds for non smoking room  They arranged a room with King size bed and set up another bed for me within 5 mins  We slept for two nights and there was a temporary suspension of electricity at the last night  maybe for a hour because I felt asleep finally  When I got up in the morning and checked out for going to Legoland  They apologized for that and paid for the taxi for my family to Singapore Flyer  waiting coach to Legoland   It was unexpected and I did think that suspension of electricity was not a big problem for me  Although the taxi fee was not too much  I was pleased that hotel had tried effort to compensate for the inconvenience caused  That s why I wrote this comment for the hotel and recommended it to those who has not booked it for accommodation before

We stayed 2 nights in Singapore on our way to Bali and decided to try the Interconti as it was centrally located and was less modern than all those new Hotels in Singapore  The Hotel offers a bit of a colonial feeling   The service was very good  the rooms were big enough for 2 adults and a child  I would recommend staying in a club room  as it comes with access to the club lounge  including breakfast  tea and aperitif time Room Tip  Club room are best See more room tips

From check in to leaving we were impressed by the hotel and it s staff  The little additions from being members of the loyalty club were also a nice bonus   including a complimentary drink at the bar and 2 for 1 at the hotels buffet  A shopping mall is conveniently next door to the hotel  The hotel itself is convenient for Singapore s attractions and it s air conditioned grandeur was a welcome relief from the sometimes overwhelming heat and humidity  Will definitely return

This hotel was perfect for us as a short stopover to break up the trip from Australia to London  Check in was fast and friendly  the Bellman Peter was so lovely  an asset for the Hotel  I liked the decor as it was a mix of old British Colonial style with luxurious modern comfort  I really can t comment on the location as we just needed to eat and sleep before heading back to the airport  so we didn t get to see any of the usual Singapore attractions  The room service was great  the room quiet and the bed was SUPER comfy  just what we needed I would definitely recommend this hotel  and more towards the business traveller

I have stayed at many hotels in Singapore over the years but have settled on the Intercon for at least the past 5  As a business hotel  it is well located with the MTR at Bugis within the attached Mall  easy to forget if you are struggling waiting for taxis in the rain The hotel is centrally located a short distance from CBD  Clarke and Boat Quays with Orchard Road the same distance in the opposite direction  Airport transfers by usual methods including the MTR The hotel has a gentle ambience that I find relaxing at the end of a busy business day  It has a blend of styles which is traditional and comforting  There is a good business lounge providing a wide range of amenities Sometimes the evening life can be quiet but there is Raffles  and usually Chimes presently undergoing refurbishment  within 5 minutes walk  The team are very helpful and efficientRoom Tip  If you are a light sleeper  do check that your room is not exposed to the Mall at lower levels  Ther   See more room tips

I have stayed in few Intercontinentals and the properties are always great with a good service  but they all seem to have a problem with not being able to handle providing breakfast and the service up to the hotel s standards  I wonder whether it has something to do with their training because usually other parts of the hotel deliver everything well  Especially the breakfast in Koh Samui and now in Singapore  where I am staying  Everything I order seems to come wrong or not come at all  Especially eggs  Then if you ask for an oatmeal which is a part of a western breakfast all around the world  here the buffet does not include it  which is quite surprising   It would be easy just to say yes and make it for me  rather than having 3 staff members coming to me to give me stories before they bring the oatmeal  They could have skipped the hassle  Some servers do not even understand English well  which adds to the overall frustration  The only good thing here is the coffee  so at least the most important thing seems to be done well

My wife and I have stayed here a number of times and I have submitted reviews previously  however  an incident occurred this time that demonstrated the professionalism and empathy of hotel management and staff On this occasion my son and daughter in law were with us and an accident involving them occurred in the hotel  There was no way the hotel could have have predicted or prevented what happened  When it did happen  the staff took charge immediately and did everything possible to ameliorate the problem and make sure my son and daughter in law were safe and compensated Management and staff are to be congratulated on the way the problem was handled and demonstrated why staying at a top hotel is worth every cent you pay Thank you

Beautiful  great service  fabulous Martini in the beautiful lobby lounge  attached to Bugis Mall  cinema  shops  restaurants  room service was fab  the Yum Cha mmmmmmm  what else can I say  There was a power failure due to supply issues  not the hotel  after midnight that we did not notice  got a lovely apology from management and extra membership points for the inconvenience  Nice touch

We stayed here for 3 nights and we loved every minute of our stay here  Check in and check out was quick  The room was very spacious for 2 adults and 2 kids even with all our big luggages  All the staffs are very helpful and nice  The best part is the location  very close to MRT and lots of eatery  Very convenient because you can get all you need just by quick walk outside the hotel  We ll certainly stay here another time we visit Singapore

We always stay in this hotel when in Singapore  and usually book a room with Club access  On this occasion we had one night   and we re back for two nights before returning home  My wife had some recent surgery which has impacted her mobility and I must say the attentiveness was beyond what we would expect  The staff looked after her needs without making a fuss over it  and made us feel very welcome  In particular  Fiona in the lounge was exceptional  It is easier to overlook whatever shortcomings the building may have when being looked after so well We will continue to support this hotel whenever in Singapore due in no small part to the efforts of the people working there

One of my favorite hotels in Singapore  However  the hotel really needs a bit upgrading on some facilities in the rooms  The bathroom amenities need something different  the TV  sound system  some furniture pieces could really use a makeover   replacement   upgrading  The hotel still has after all these years the same old same old everything  On little things they could significantly improve the quality of the rooms  For example my matrass  I think all guests sleep on the same side of the bed  because sometimes i almost rolled out of bed if I didn t really position myself in the middle  matrasses should regularly be flipped over so the surface stays firm  That did not happen  Mine was sagging on one side  my side of the bed  BUT don t get me wrong  I still love staying here in this Colonial building in the Bugis area  very close to the Metro which takes us very fast to EXPO and Airport  The restaurants are great  buffets fantastic  no doubt about that  Location wise super   But I secretly hope that when I go there next time  that they have taken the time to make some changes to the hotel       as mentioned above  Signed  a Priority Royal Ambassador Member

We have high expectations from InterContinental Hotels wherever they are located   however  this Singapore property fell short of our previous great experiences and expectation  The one good thing is it s location but then most hotels are very central in Singapore  It is dated  Colonial building is fine but screams renovation from the inside  Dirty and stained carpet in room  basic and old furniture with night stands and desk protected by thick glass tabletops  small TV which malfunctioned and an extremely modest lobby  And please do not ask for a margarita pizza from room service which is the worst pizza we have ever had anywhere  Were promised the Herald Tribune as complimentary but did not get even a single morning from a total 4  And power went out in the midle of the night without switching to generator for at least an hour  I think the highlight was the generous sized bathroom

I m not sure this should be a five star hotel    Compared to others I have stayed at  this was disappointing  Bathroom and linen were fine but the room looked tired  maybe it was just the one they gave me    I got woken up at 1am by the noise coming from the room next door  not sure if it was the tv or the guests talking  Went for dinner at the Olive and there were no chefs at the buffet  same thing at breakfast  where I had to order coffee three times before getting it and the waiter at my table hardly seemed to understand me  The food was not bad  but not 5 star  There were no staff at the pool and I had to look for towels  Staff in general were friendly and helpful at the lobby  Not a bad hotel  but not luxurious

This is a good solid business hotel  good location  though the lobby is cramped and usually overrun by people and baggage strewn about  The staff is ok  not quite up to the top standards of Singapore s 5 star hotels  The breakfast buffet is quite varied  a decent spread but not the jaw dropping buffets that other top hotels in Singapore offer  All in all a decent product but with prices at 5  level  one can find better value for money  The internet is painfully slow

My husband and I spent six nights at InterContinental Singapore and absolutely loved it  The staff were more incredibly helpful and friendly  making us feel welcome from the moment we arrived  The rooms are spacious and the hotel has great facilities  It s very well located with a direct connection to Bugis Junction and the Bugis MRT  all of which is undercover   handy for Singapore s unpredictable weather  Within the room itself  the bed was very comfortable and there was a writing desk  dresser and full closet plus arm chair too   plenty of space  The room was well equipped and  as odd as it might seem to point these out  the iron and hair dryer were fantastic  Both were new and powerful  unlike the lesser equivalents you typically find in many hotels  We had daily buffet breakfast included and I would recommend anyone else to do the same  The selection was wide and delicious  including both Western and Eastern dishes  The live cooking station allows you to order eggs exactly how you like them  Something I would strongly consider next time would be to book a Club Room which gives access to drinks and tapas each evening  Drinking in Singapore is expensive  so it would be well worth the additional cost  InterContinental Singapore offers great value and a lovely place to stay and I would definitely visit again next time I m in Singapore Room Tip  Book the club room for drink and tapas each evening included in your rates See more room tips

Stayed 6 nights in a Shophouse Suite with Club access Suite was good but a bit small by IHG standardsService everywhere was exceptionalRooftop  L4  Pool was good with excellent sunloungesOne thing to keep in mind if you intend to stay on the  quot Shophouse quot  side of the hotel  It is adjacent and under the same roof as the shopping complex so it can be noisy upto 9 10 pm each night  and on weekends there was a very loud PA system advertising some sort of promotion which was unbearable on Sat afternoon   so perhaps other rooms may be a better choice if you re looking for some peace  amp  quietRoom Tip  Shophouse rooms can be noisySee more room tips

I stayed at this glorious hotel with a friend whilst I was in Singapore for a conference  The service was absolutely amazing  The rooms are roomy  beautiful big plush bath towels and a beautiful bathroom  The location is central to most things with a MRT station right next door  The only criticism I have is the tv is so small  I would absolutely recommend this hotel

We absolutely loved our stay at the Intercontinental  It s neo colonial architecture made it stand out to us when booking in comparison to the other modern  five star properties in Singapore  and it didn t disappoint  In an overpriced city like Singapore  the value for money at the Intercontinental was exceptional Our room was much larger than expected and very well appointed  We thoroughly enjoyed the pool facilities and lobby areas of the hotel  The direct connection to the Bugis Junction mall and Bugis MRT station was also much appreciated  as we could connect to the subway in the comfort of the air conditioned mall  I think Bugis is a great neighbourhood to stay  given its proximity to the financial district  Little India  and the local area  which was full of great places to eat and wander to get the flavours of the city The only thing keeping the hotel from a five point review was that there was an extended power outage to the entire property during one night of our stay  Unfortunately  their emergency lighting system turns on the overhead lights in the room and there is no way to override this  Ironically  we were kept up in a fully lit room for over an hour at 2AM until the power was restored and the lights turned back off  Given the inconvenience cause by this  I expected some sort of goodwill gesture from the hotel  which never happened  However  our overall stay was so good otherwise  that I would definitely choose the Intercontinental again  in Singapore and elsewhere

We arrived very late  midnight  Staff took us straight to our spacious room and completed the signing in quickly for us instead of on the desk in the lobby  They knew it was our wedding anniversary  had left a plate of chocolates and fruit dipped in chocolate with message written in chocolate  Classy touch  Room was on 13th floor  quiet and comfortable  Staff attentive  helpful and friendly  We stayed for 8 nights and just totally enjoyed our time there

My husband and I got married at this hotel in 2012 and decided to celebrate our wedding anniversary there too  We used our IHG rewards points to book a one night stay in a King Deluxe room and were upgraded to a very spacious junior suite by the reservation staff  We were also given free buffet breakfast at Olive Tree  As I am an InterCon Ambassador member  we received free fruit  chocolates  mineral water and an umbrella  On top of that  we got a plate of delectable chocolate with the words  quot Happy Anniversary quot  written in chocolate too   The junior suite was very comfortable and cosy  We had a wonderful stay  Thank you very much to all the staff who made it possible

We stayed at that hotel on 3 4 days in the end of 2013  just before South Asia cruise by Royal Caribbean  Singapore is not cheapest place in the world  so that was one of  quot reasonable price 5 star hotel quot  at that period of time   quot reasonable price quot  as if its possible to say about Singapore prices   Well  location really not bad  very close to famous Raffles hotel  just walking distance   Pool on the roof is not something special short and not deep   My room was average enough  Breakfast was a little crowded and food choices were not bad and expensive   5 star hotel    but  there was a row of small chinese style eateries outside of the hotel  just 20 30 metres of the hotel  so that is a great choice if u want to save some of your money and enjoy local style chinese cuisine  roast chinese duck  stewed fish  rice and so on   Work of front desk and consierge was effectiveness and helpful  I reccomend it to friends   Yeah  they have a good bar on the first floor  where u can drink some good beer and watch EPL in the evening

We did a family stay here for 2 nights over the weekend  Even with Ambassador membership  the hotel gave me a super upgrade to their top floor suites  which became an amazing experience for the children   space  and lots of it    The overall set up at this hotel is so good  that one doesn t really want to venture out of the premises as it was so comfortable and pleasant to stay around  The only real entertainment for children would be the pool  but that s not a complaint  Check in and staff attention was exacting  Service standards was nothing less than excellent  There is a lot of shopping activity and restaurants in the vicinity to really keep you busy if you want

This is a beautiful hotel right in the middle of everything you could need in Singapore  Our holiday was delayed by a day due to a late flight so we missed a night where which was really disappointing as we loved the 2 we had  The only reason I have not given it 5 is that the room   a club room   was a tad dated but spotlessly clean and maybe I am spoilt with more modern fittings etc  The club lounge was great   excellent staff  delicious afternoon tea and canap? s   no supper required    and free flowing drinks  Given how expensive alcohol in Singapore is it is well worth an upgrade  We would stay here again if ever lucky enough to come back to again

The service at the reception area was excellent  I appreciated that Peter  hard to miss this elegant elderly man  accompanied me to the reception and explained to me all the amenities available in the hotel and the nearby places that would be of interest for my family when we checked in  Three nights in this hotel proved to be too short  From check in to check out  everything was flawless  We got 2 executive rooms for my entire family  I only wished our rooms were on the same floor since we belonged to one party  The rooms given to us were on the 12th and 14th floor which proved to be a bit inconvenient  My children enjoyed the snacks during afternoon tea and the early evening cocktails  I liked the fact that they had a separate area in the lobby for the children during happy hour   The rooms were very clean and adequately stocked with the essential toiletries  The pool was quite small but still okay for children who just want to swim  The only thing that sorely needs to be improved is the gym  The machines there are quite old but still functional  An upgrade for the gym might be a good idea  The location was central to a lot of things  From malls to street markets  they were all within walking distance  There were a lot of restaurants around  Loved that the malls closed at 10pm and even wished they closed later   My only regret was that we didn t stay here longer  We will definitely be back Room Tip  Book the executive room See more room tips

Actually I was here for business trip for 3 nights  The hotel is very well located  Just few steps to the malls and other food stalls in Bugis area  The MRT was near by  The room and bathroom are a bit smaller  The bed are very comfy  I love it   The wifi was working great  The breakfast was great which many option of the food  The restaurant downstair always very busy in the afternoon  I think they served English tea and some cakes  Too bad I didn t try it   It should be great   Overall this hotel is very nice and great for traveller who want comfortable room and easy access to mall and local foods

Have reviewed this hotel before and I reiterate my sentiments again  From check in all the way through the staff are thorough and graceful  Leaving here tomorrow  Monday  but couldn t be happier  Any minor problems are sorted immediately with little fuss  The food and beverages  plus presentation are exemplary and the staff in all areas helpful and efficient The fact that the place is close to shops etc really is a side issue  Taxis in this wonderful City are cheap and plentiful All in all a wonderful experience  which I m sure my son and daughter in law will concur with Be glad to come back after two months OS as it feels like home returning to the Intercontinental Singapore Room Tip  Any room  39 s a good room  although Shop House rooms looking on to nothing much take a little away   See more room tips

Bit late with this review but we stayed for 2 nights in March before a cruise through to Dubai and although we really enjoyed the cruise  we didn t want to leave Singapore  or the Intercontinental We asked for a quiet room and got one and we upgraded to Club as have many others and it really was worth it  The room is exactly the same but the use of the lounge makes the difference  Breakfast in the lounge was a calm  quiet delight afternoon tea was very welcome after a long day sightseeing and the Singapore slings were yummy  All the staff we encountered were professional and really pleasant  The location of the hotel is fantastic for walking out to sights and for evening drinks  dinner  as long as you walk in the right direction    We thought the atmosphere here was much better than Raffles which to me felt a bit like a shopping mall  Importantly  the beds are like big cosy marshmallows and almost  but only almost  kept us from the sights and there is a really nice pool area which we didn t get have time to use Singapore is amazing and I m sure we ll be back Room Tip  Upgrade to club See more room tips

Hotel is in a good location  close to the subway and with several shopping options around  Lobby is beautiful  Staff is polite but in some cases not as polished or attentive as you would expect in a 5 star hotel  but then service in Singapore seems to be in general worse than in other Asian countries  Room was a good size and bed was comfortable  Washroom was also pretty large  We had what was supposed to be the  afternoon high tea  at the Olive Tree restaurant and it was terrible  Very limited options and nothing was good  The high tea portion was a couple of desserts and scones  If they only advertised it as a regular buffet it would be more honest  We were very disappointed

Very convenient for the MRT from the airport as we only had a hand luggage each  The other  quot Downtown quot  line also took us straight to Marina Bay Sands and the Gardens by the Bay when we did some sightseeing The hotel has a neo colonial style with a Peranakan theme too  There is a display of paintings  embroidery and nyonya ware which add to the ambience  Found it a bit strange crossing the Bugis Junction mall on a bridge to get to room but it adds to the experience  I guess  The mall is integrated with the hotel As my friend has ambassador membership  we were taken to the Club lounge for the check in and were given a shophouse room with a view of the street outside  We made use of the complimentary tea and internet while we were there  Enjoyed the mini scones and macaroons  Tried breakfast at the ground floor Olive Tree one morning  Although the setting may be nicer  we found breakfast at the club lounge better and less crowded  Room was comfortable with some swanky looking furniture  only the space in front of the wardrobe was rather tight  The bed and pillows were too soft for my liking but slept quite well nevertheless  Bathroom shower was good and I liked the toiletries  Everything worked Room Tip  Stay in a shophouse room if budget allows See more room tips

InterContinental Singapore Hotel was located on Middle Str   near Bugis shopping mall  It took me about 15 minutes to Orchard rd  by cab  I suggested using bus  it was much cheaper and still convenient  no crowded  The hotel chain is perfect as always  I have nothing to complain  I ve stayed at InterCon hotel in many countries  they were all truly great  However  I especially love InterCon Singapore hotel lobby lounge  it was luxury  cozy and a little historic  so royal   like  The staffs were pleasant and professional  The room was spacious  comfortable and well decor  The outdoor swimming pool was large and clean  Everything in the hotel was absolutely amazing

u get all the convenience from staying here  the room works  location is good  convenient for food and everything  but that s about it  i didn t feel that this was a special place  the pool is ok  no nice view there  it s an average stay  so stay there if u need to be in the area or using it as a base  but if u r looking for something special  look elsewhere  breakfast was rather ordinary

We stayed at this hotel for a month  The location is fab with the train station  shopping and the national library just next door  and loads of good food at Albert Food Centre and Liang Seah Street just opposite  It s in the arts and culture district  so you are never short of places to visit  The Singapore Art Museum and Lasalle School of the Arts is just nearby

Like most Intercontinental hotels  the building and communal areas are well presented and well maintained For those who are light sleepers  avoid rooms ending 02 as they back onto the elevators and the noise kept us awake all night  The next morning the hotel moved us to another room xx14  which was much quieter although some might find the road noise irritating if they are not used to it The breakfast buffet is alright  but I struggled to find any meat on the  bacon  which seemed mostly fat  and the staff had an annoying habit of clearing your plate the moment you have finished the last mouthful  When my wife and I both got up for drinks  when we came back the table had been cleared completely  The hotel is handy for Bugis MRT which gives you access to the whole island  A taxi from the airport cost us 16 20 Singapore dollars It would have been nice if the rooms had a touch of Singapore to them  as it stands  it could have been any hotel room in any country in the world  I think Intercontinental Hotels could do better

I arrived at 1 30am at Changi and caught a taxi to the hotel  When I arrived I discovered the taxis no longer accepted VISA card due to a dispute with the merchant fees  As usual I had not had time to withdraw cash from the ATM The desk staff of the hotel paid the taxi fare and added it to my account  with no extra charges   I count that as the first of many surprising and pleasant experiences in the hotel  My second surprise occurred shortly after when I was asked if I needed anything pressed for the morning  by now it was 2 30am  I gave them my suit which I needed for a business meeting  It was returned at 7am   I have been travelling in Asia on business for the past 20 years and I had never had this service before My third pleasant encounter was when I took my colleagues to the Victoria Bar lounge  The boasted the longest Happy Hour in Asia  it was 5pm to 12 am  I am ready to say it may even be the longest happy hour globally  If anyone knows a longer one I would appreciate feed back  Not only is it S 3 for a beer but you get a serving of chicken wings for every drinker with the first drink The snacks kept coming with each round  The staff were amazingly friendly   always smiling and nothing was too much trouble  It came across as very natural and not forced The fourth pleaeant experience came when we were looking for a local restaurant and local cuisine  Friday and Saturday nights are when every Singaporean is out to dinner with their families and unless you have booked it is extremely hard to get into a restaurant  We had walked around 2 kilometres and could not find a restaurant  So we went back to the Victoria Bar recounting our inability to find a restaurant  One of the staff in the bar  Salilporn  asked us what we wanted to eat   seafood  beef  vegetarian  then promptly left  20 minutes later she returned  She had booked a table for us at a local restaurant not far from the hotel  Lei Garden  subject of another review   She insisted on accompanying us to find it as it was in a small alley way a few blocks away  Once she saw we were settled she went back to the hotel  Again I have never had this service from a hotel ROOMS   Overall the rooms were very comfortable  spacious with double queen and king size beds  Free WiFI if you are a club member  The decor was English colonial which reminded me very much of the Old Raffles hotel  FOOD   Very generous food  amp  lunch buffets with plenty of variety with local cuisine which is a mixture of Indian and Chinese foods  Still plenty of Western choices if you prefer I rate my experience at this hotel as one of the best in the last 20 years of Global travel

The hotel is clean and the service is excellent As a ambassador member  they upgrade me to business room that included daily buffet breakfast and allow check out time to 4pm  The room is big and they have many electrical plug that allow charging electronic devices  Most hotels have travel adaptor in room  But I need to ask one That s not a big issues  The hotel also provide unlimited supply of bottle water  That s very convenient  The bathroom is clean The only thing I don t like is the bathrobe feels like sandpaper  The breakfast buffet was great with lots of food option  I feel like I m having brunch daily instead of breakfast  The staff is a little slow in the restaurant  Even I sit next to the coffee stand  They only busy with chit chat and delay to collect the dishes and refill the coffee  But that doesn t really border me Overall  the hotel is excellent and I will go back to this hotel

This hotel is in a great location downtown  and also within walking distance of many places we wanted to see  The hotel is older  but very well maintained  The rooms are large  and the beds are very comfortable  The bathroom was large and the shower had power  The staff are all fantastic  and very accomidating  The concierge was very knowledgeable and very patient with our requests I would highly recommend this hotel

Stayed here for two nights and didn t want to leave  Got a great deal on their website for a two night stay  My large twin room was on a high floor so fabulous views of the city and surroundings  Its clear the hotel has been around for a while so things are looking just a bit dated now  but still in good shape  The shower area in the bathroom leaked a little but nothing that a well placed towel wouldn t take care off Breakfast buffet was fantastic  every imaginable breakfast food available All in all a great stay  staff very good although some of the staff from mainland China have some difficulty with English  and it is a heritage styled hotel so don t expect the super new mod con designs  Will come back Room Tip  Get a high floor if you canSee more room tips

Stayed at Intercontinental Singapore for 2 nights  It is very Well located and close to MRT station surrounded by shops and restaurants and very close to the Arab and Indian Quarters  In general the hotel is very good  it has an Outstanding Breakfast buffet  one of the best in SE Asia   The pool is outdoors and the changing rooms are not up to rest of the hotel standard

this is the most amazing hotel  the staff are incredible  standards never drop and it is such a great location  With the opening of the Blue Downtown MRT you are not far away from some of the popular tourist attractions  Nothing is too much trouble for the staff  Just let them know you have allergies and they will try to do everything they can to accommodate your needs  I have never stayed anywhere more restful  nothing is too much trouble for the staff  They are outstanding Room Tip  Shop house rooms are great if you want to experience part of the history of Singapore but the Suites   See more room tips

If you re not in Singapore just to shop along Orchard St   or if you don t want to get stuck indoors at the Marina Bay Sands  a stay at the colonial area of Singapore might just be for you too like it is for me  I loved the usual amenities and impeccable service of the 5 star hotel  It s also conveniently connected to the Bugis junction mall with its many shops and restaurants  Great local food is just across the street too  Experience the best of Singapore in this hotel   my favourite hotel in Singapore

Warning  the hotel is closer to 3 stars than 5  I think it says a lot that when we wrote to explain all the shortcomings  we didn t even receive a reply  In brief  rooms were old and run down  slight smell inside  cleaning service left standing water in the tub and didn t fully clean the bathroom  room service was slow  power went out and with that no A C  In Singapore no less  Amazingly when we told the hotel management  they simply offered a free coffee  What good is that When we told them a second time  they said we know  Rooms will be renovated next year  As if that does anyone a lot of good now We made the reservation for our family plus friends  We were embarrassed

Me  my bro  mom and 2 kids stayed at this hotel last week   great hotel   room was spacious   location of hotel was perfect for us   it had the MRT  metro station  right outside  it was located right next to a huge mall and lots of shops  supermarkets  booths etc and best of all the Hippo hop on hop off bus that we took had the intercom as one of its stops so was super convenient for us  the taxi ride was about 25sgd from the airport to hotel  all in all very happy with our stay

I had a great stay with my partner at the Intercontinental  Great location  comfortable room and some of the staff were lovely    We loved the bell boy and the Arab interns in the lounge   so friendly  We would definitely come back  It would have been lovely if more of the staff were just a little bit more social and friendly

Like another one of my reviews  this is a late entry I stayed at the InterContinental Hotel in Singapore sometime in 2007 when I was there for a business meeting  don t mind the date indicated in the  quot When I traveled portion  like I said  this is a late entry   Having said that  I am sure they have improved to become even better now I stayed all of three days at the InterCon  and my stay was    as it has been even in the InterCon here in Manila    a great delight I had a room on an upper floor  so I managed to get a modern room  my colleague got a room on the 2nd floor I think  and it was obviously in an older part of the hotel  His room was basically set up similar to mine  but you could feel the age  though you could feel the old world charm  I do suggest getting a room on an upper floor if possible  I had a great view of the National Library and the surrounding city  InterCon is so strategically located  it is right across Bugis Street and is walking distance to many other attractions in the City  well  this is relative depending on what you would consider walking distance   It is easy to get public transport from here  so travelling around is a breeze The staff were all very efficient and respectful  and of course the food in the restaurant was wonderfully gastronomic  with enough variety to keep you coming back In my next visit to Singapore  with my family for vacation I hope  the InterContinental Singapore will be a hotel I will return to Room Tip  Rooms on the upper floors are more modern and provide a great view of the city See more room tips

This hotel is in an excellent location to get around Singapore  Connected to the Burgis mall and MRT station you can get anywhere in Singapore  The hotel is in need of a renovation  which I have been told will start in November 2014  The rooms are large and clean  The thing that makes this hotel great is it s staff  They are exceptional  From the front desk to the staff of the Olive Street restaurant  They are so helpful that it makes up for the age of the hotel  I would recommend this hotel if you are visiting Singapore and want a great place to stay Room Tip  as for a high floor or if they have any renovated rooms See more room tips

Stayed for the first time for almost a week  amp  on the business room package included breakfast  amp  2 pieces of laundry daily  The hotel itself  amp  the service standards cannot be faulted anywhere  The breakfast buffet was an absolute feast  amp  included every imaginable food item from all over the world  Centrally located just above the Bugis station  amp  hence easily accessible  The twin room beds were bigger than single beds but smaller than double beds  2 adults  amp  2 small children can fit in easily  My only complaint is that they wanted to charge an extra S 100 per night for the third person after I had booked  amp  prepaid for my entire stay  They waived it after I complained  I notice that this charge now appears when making the booking which was not the case for me  Still I think S 100 per night as extra charge for each guest from the 3rd guest onwards is very excessive even without the extra bed  In a highly competitive market like Singapore with so much choice  I  amp  most other guests will book elsewhere the next time unless the hotel takes another look at this unreasonable policy

Intercontinental hotel is definitely one of the nicest hotels to stay in Singapore we have tried many others but always return here  Nice decor  very elegant  Very friendly staff  also many older staff are employed which is nice to see   We had a lovely corner room  wonderfully quiet  did not even need ear plugs  which is normal with most hotels with noisy Aircon   This was our 1st return in 3 years  The hotel is so close to everything and exceptionally well served by the under ground and shopping centre under the hotel For our 2nd return stay we also up graded to the club floor and which was nice but we prefer the normal rooms as they are more homely  But the club rooms have twin sink and nice showers and are recently renovated  The afternoon tea at the club floor is not great but the cocktails and snacks were better Just can t wait to be able to go back again  just feels like homeRoom Tip  Corner rooms are very nice See more room tips

I was recognized as an IHG member during checkin and was presented with a gift  a small umbrella  good for singapore tropical weather with occassional showers   I was upgraded to a business room  This hotel was built like 20 yrs ago  so expect the room to be a tad traditional oldish look  However it is well maintained with good service all around  Breakfast spread was great

We had 3 nights here in April  We were fortunate to get a great room  nice and high with a river view The bed was very comfortable and the room felt spacious The location is excellent  easy to get to everywhere and the concierge was extremely helpful in and friendly  One of the cleaning ladies was especially good to us  making sure we had all we needed when one of us started with a cold  aeroplanes are flying germ havens We hope to return to Singapore  we loved it  and would certainly choose this hotel again

This IS an Intercontinental  isn t it  The hotel is nice enough though the room looked a little tired  Staff generally very nice  but overall I would not stay here again   There s got to be an easier way for a guest to get lunch at the pool than to be told to go back to the room and to order room service to deliver it there   yes  that really was what we were told by the staff Room Tip  There plenty of good alternative hotels here  go somewhere else See more room tips

The hotel is located at Bugis in Singapore  which offers a large amount of shops and restaurant  It has a certain charm with is classic decoration  compared to more modern designed hotels  The lobby is rather small  but the caf?  area for sitting is grand  The service is excellent  The rooms are relatively large and the beds are very comfortable  The hotel definitely has a character that you will remember  compared to many other Singapore hotels which are rather blend Room Tip  Ask for a room on the high floors to avoid the traffic noise and shopping crowdSee more room tips

Great location attached to a mall and MRT station in Bugis Very helpful and friendly staff from before the get go Room requests were accommodated  Room was spacious and clean  Bathroom was nice and clean  Room service was excellent I will definitely come back here again  Perhaps I will also consider Intercontinental Hotels in other countries and see if they will be at par

I stayed here 5 nights during my business in Singapore and found this is a best luxury hotel in city  My room was larger with a balcony  comfy bed  especially very comfortable bathroom that made me did not want to go out my room  The buffet breakfast was so great and wished to eat all   I would stay here again for next my business  Room Tip  Luxury roomsSee more room tips

I decided to stay in this Hotel for 6 days as I was on a business trip  The location  very close to Bugis and a walking distance to Raffles  to Esplanade and to Clark Quay make this hotel extremely convinient  The room looked very good and always confortable  The bathtube looked to much used  Maybe time for a new one  The breakfast area is very pleasant and the breakfast is extremely complete  Disappointing was the laundry service  It was extremely expensive and once I got the laundry back I could observe that it was not at all washed although invoiced  So I complained to the hotel and after two hours I got the laundry back and washed  Anyway  it shouldn t happen at all even if the price was a bit more reasonable  Anyway and overall the Hotel offers an ideal stay in the heart of Singapore

Always love staying here when in Singapore The welcome by the doormen  the beautiful lobby  the location  the breakfast bar  the lounge area at night  the pool and pool bar and most importantly the incredibly comfortable luxiurious beds Just a note from this trip   I had my phone stolen unfortunately when out shopping and it was very stressful  I had to make calls from my room phone to Australia  Reception generously deleted the price of these calls from my bill because of the sad story That s the type of service that sets this wonderful hotel aside from others Also want to make special note of the security team   I can t remember the man s name but he welcomes you when you come in the back entrance  He helped with my shopping bags and generally can t do enough for you Superb all round

I stayed here on a stopover from the uk to Australia for two nights  This was my first visit to Singapore and the hotel was a great spot to stay to do a bit of exploring of local areas  It is close to the wonderful Singapore art gallery  well worth a visit  and close to the MRT station at Bras Bashah road  The hotel itself is beautiful and retains a colonial ambience  The room was clean and very comfortable  Beautiful bathroom and great facilities  The hotel has a nice pool area to enjoy some sun and cool down with a swim and a lime juice in the humidity of the city  I would definitely stay here again  Also a great breakfast buffet

We just stayed two nights in the Intercontinental Singapore  The location is excellent  with adjacent shopping mall  Bugis Junction and Bugis   and access to the MRT without having to go out  This is important because of the frequent heavy shower in Singapore during the summer season  The hotel staffs are helpful  The bed is good and what surprised me is a pillow menu  you can choose 4 5 different types of pillow to find the best one for you  We went with the kids  so naturally we tried out the pool  It was a bit small  but I suppose you can t ask for more in that location  The hotel is right opposite to the National Library also

There is a lot to like about this hotel  We arrived early in the morning and were warmly greeted by the front of house staff  Upon check in  our standard room wasn t available  understandable as we arrived ex an early morning flight   so we upgraded as we were feeling a bit jet lagged and wanted to get some sleep  For an extra  120 per night we were given a superior room with club lounge access  The concierge escorted us to our room and showed us around the hotel  Nice touch Our room was clean and spacious and the bed was one of the most comfortable beds I have ever slept in  However  our room did have a very unpleasant musty smell  I guess if I d complained  the hotel would have addressed it  but I was just too tired to deal with it at the time  I think the bathroom may have flooded at some point and the smell is a hangover from this  Given that we paid over  600 per night for the room  this was a little disappointing  The club lounge was excellent and the staff were extremely attentive and professional The only thing that really let the hotel down was the Chinese restaurant  It was really bad  We had an 8 00 pm reservation and it was completely dead  There was only one other table of diners  but there were loads of staff  They all stood around watching our every move  It was really uncomfortable and the food was really average  The lunch we had at the Bugis Mall food court was superior in every way and this really shouldn t have been the case  I would definitely return to the hotel but recommend you give the restaurant a swerve

I stayed at Intercontinental Singapore on a Two Day Stopover from Sydney to Europe 22nd May   My daughter  who had visited here with her family last year had recommended the hotel and joined me for our special Mother Daughter break  From the moment we stepped out of the Taxi and was greeted by a kind doorman  and entered the lobby where two friendly Receptionists checked us in   I knew this was going to be a great start to my Overseas Trip  As I was an IHG member  my daughter and I had both our rooms upgraded to the top floor Wow what a view  Large King Bed  very comfortable   and room very spacious  perhaps my only negative gripe was the Shower Room  needing updating  Breakfast Buffet  just perfect  with vast International options  Particularly enjoyed the Freshly squeezed Juice with so many varieties  Before my long haul flight swam and relaxed by the pool  where we had ordered Cocktails and Satay   didn t really want to leave I

My wife and I used Priority Points to stay for 3 nights in this hotel  We were given a room upgrade to a Junior Suite which was very nice  The Afternoon Tea in the main lounge was also very pleasant although they were a bit light on the tea  The hotel itself is very nice and well located near Bugis Metro station We dined in the Chinese Restaurant in the hotel for what we hoped was a special dinner  Unfortunately it was not a good experience  There was only one other couple in the restaurant and while we dined at 9pm  we were rushed through and made to feel as though we were keeping the staff from closing  I complained when I checked out and the Front Office Manager  Loh Jing Feng  took control and handled the situation extremely well  My wife and I were taken to the Olive Restaurant  also in the hotel  and given 5  treatment with a complimentary breakfast  Jing made sure that we were given everything we needed and came back at the end to make sure we were satisfied While I was not impressed with the Chinese restaurant at all  avoid it would be my recommendation  the way Jing handled the complaint was first rate  I liked this hotel generally and would certainly use it again but without Jing s professionalism this may not have ended up such a good review Room Tip  If you can stretch to it  take a Junior Suite  Plenty of space and very comfortable See more room tips

Always a pleasure to return to the Intercontinental Singapore  The hotel is beautiful and immaculately maintained  The location cannot be beaten for access to MRT and shopping at Bugis  The staff is extremely attentive and very detailed orientated  they even remembered us from our last two visits  As always we began our day with a wonderful breakfast buffet in the Olive Tree Restaurant  there are selections to satisfy every appetite  We also enjoyed the daily tea  and evening drinks in the Lobby Lounge  During this stay we choose one of the beautifully renovated Shop House Rooms  These rooms maintain an authentic Peranakan ambiance with plush carpets  wood floors and lovely furnishings  while offering every modern amenity I have stayed at Intercontinental Hotels from Delhi to Washington D C   and the Intercontinental Singapore ranks among my favorites

We used our free night certificate and requested a room with 2 beds on the high floor which were ready when we arrived  Check in at 4pm was prompt  and we were given a coupon for a free drink  platinum member  each for 2 adults at the bar lounge  When we got to our room  we were pleasantly surprised that the twin beds they mentioned were actually American full size bed  which adequately accommodated our family of 2 adults and 2 children  The kids were amused by the huge bath towels and sound system in the bathroom  Room size was reasonably large by Singapore standard  2 complimentary bottles of water were included in the room Gym equipment seems adequate  The pool area was locked after 10 30pm so we did not get to see it after a long day out and about the area  Lots of shopping within walking distance in the area  including a night bazaar  I believe the building across from our room facing the front of the hotel is the Singapore National Library We had breakfast at the Olive Tree Restaurant in the hotel  which has unique d? cor and we enjoyed the variety of food   curry chicken  prawn noodles  dim sum  yogurt  cereal  fresh fruits  local tea w milk  juice  etc  The kids went down in their room slippers but was politely asked to change by the host  which we obliged  and when we came back down  he remembered us and promptly seated us  which we appreciated Check out was just as non eventful  and I must say that our family have totally enjoyed our stay

Traveled to Singapore on business  I have stayed here before  The location is great as it is attached to the Bugis shopping center which is a 3 level outdoor mall which is enclosed and air conditioned  The service was exellent  I arrived at 9am  6 hours before check in time   They gave me a room at no charge  The only down side was it was on a smoking floor  They offered to move me to a non smoking floor the next day if I wanted but I declined The hotel is very clean  The buffet breakfast is great with Indian  Asian and American choices  I used room service for several dinners  The food was always good but portions were a little small  I forgot my iPhone adapter and they lent me one free of charge  Not many American TV channels however  A very good choice

If I could I would rate this hotel 3 5  The first thing you notice on checking in are the dirty handprints and cracks on the walls in reception  There is a general air of fading grandeur  We are Intercontinental Ambassador members  you pay for the privilege  and on check in at 5pm   having flown all day and told the hotel in advance that we would be arriving around 4pm   we were told our rooms were unavailable  Not a great start with two tired children  And this is the service you get as a preferred member  It took an inordinate amount of time to check in because  despite a request with booking and follow up email   they couldn t seem to locate interconnecting rooms  Anyway  eventually we checked in and were shown up to our rooms  Adequate size but not particularly large  and the interconnecting doors were blocked which furniture which necessitated another call to sort out  The rooms are looking shabby  My 7 year old pointed out a hole in the bedlinen in one room  There were marks on the walls and it all looks just a little bit dated  The pool area is smaller than it looks in the photos   but there are staff available and it wasn t overly crowded either time we used it  Fine for our needs The breakfast was good   what you expect from hotels of this level   but again the decor in the Olive Tree restaurant is dated  the floor tiles cracked  Room service was fine  The staff were responsive and keen to help  I must also say that the location is excellent   right around corner from Raffles and attached to a mall with lots of eating options downstairs The only reason we chose the intercontinental over others was the ambassador membership  Don t bother with it  The supposed free night   if you lose your one voucher they refuse to issue another  We then found that it was cheaper to book via expedia than to use the free night voucher because they charge a higher base rate for members using the voucher anyway  The supposed upgrade   because we booked two rooms they wanted to upgrade only one and ask us to pay to upgrade the other and then tried again to get us to upgrade after our intial refusal  When we checked in no one mentioned the benefits available for members      We had to request these separately  We have also used the Ambassador club in other countries and found that the guaranteed room upgrade is not so guaranteed  Really  don t waste your money on this  Overall  an adequate stay  We won t be back until there has been a serious and thorough renovation  No way is it 5 stars  maybe 4 at a pinch  Try the Shangri la  the Marina Bay Sands or the Pan Pacific for a family  All give you more bang for your buck

This rating is given in the context of the InterContinental brand  which is usually outstanding  This reviewer travels diplomatically and is comparing this hotel based on that level of service  Singapore Intercontinental really seemed to  quot phone it in quot   The hotel very clearly relies heavily on the fact that it is immediately adjacent to the Bugis Shopping Mall  an extensive shopping mall  and it s in room material consistently refers guests to go looking in the mall for services rather than expecting the hotel to provide  This might be acceptable if the hotel had arrangements with a business to provide in house services when needed  however it was disconcerting to call the concierge and be told to  quot go looking for myself quot  The presentation of lobby and rooms is elegant  but lacking in any ambience to speak of  While clearly limited by heritage architecture there are limited places to sit  insufficient staff man reception desks  and it is hard to get the attention of reception staff  They retain  quot premium quot  as well as normal check in areas  but only have enough staff to man one of those two desks at a time  The  quot lobby lounge quot  is often consumed with buffet events which look nice but consume the seating area  There are few restaurants  and while the InterCon pushes the Chinese style restaurant as their 5 star option  their remaining options are incredibly low rent American chain style   the Olive Grove Garden    serves a very limited selection of unimaginative chain style western dishes and a very basic western breakfast  while the Irish    bar adds nothing to the overall food selection Room service reflects this   the most basic selection this reviewer has ever seen   the classic  quot club sandwich or steak or local noodle dish quot  with very little variation Television channels yielded countless sports channels and only 2 entertainment channels Connectivity is excellent   both a free normal wifi and the option to pay for  quot movie streaming quality quot  wifi  Rooms offer powerpoints with international charging points  and the ability to project computer screen onto main TV  which is an innovation Ordering a hotel car for a special occasion was translated to  ordering a taxi  The heritage nature of the hotel renders the access to some rooms a very long walk   which seems like a small issue but adds 5 10 minutes to wherever you are going each morning  Staff endeavour to mitigate this on check in by escorting and carrying bags  which is excellent  however it wears after several days of stay  Surely there must be an alternative way of exiting the hotel    Business centre is a tiny cubbyhole  where simple access to the computer and printing of a page was charged at a substantial premium   not an issue if this is a company expense  but demonstrative of the hotel s theme of charging a premium for what was quite limited service Laundry service was fast and responsive

Arrived late at the hotel to be swiftly checked in and upgraded to a club room as part of the Ambassador program  Other benefits include free wifi and a 4pm check out which we needed this time As club room guests  we have access to the peranakan themed lounge for breakfast  afternoon tea and drinks at other times  The lounge was truly impressive  with traditional dining tables on one side  and a living room style formation of sofas on the other  Service in the lounge was impeccable and all requests were handled in a professional manner The location of the hotel is a big winner  It is right above the Bugis Junction shopping mall which is also connected to the cheap and efficient MRT system  With the recently finished Downtown Line  you can travel to Marina Bay Sands in a couple of stops without changing trains  Unlike the shops at Orchard Road  Bugis Junction is nowhere near high end The room was a little disappointing though  It was cramped by Asian standards and it really showed its age  Water coming out of the bathtub had an identity crisis  randomly turning hot and cold probably due to the ageing infrastructure  The bed was impressively comfortable though which made for a wonderful sleep every night The rates for the hotel are pretty high even for Singapore and I can certainly see the value in the price with the flawless service of the staff members and the location of the hotel  But the quality of the room was a major letdown and truly a mismatch with everything else in the hotel  In a competitive hotel market like Singapore with hotels that offer so much more for less  it would be difficult for me to be drawn back to this hotel
