The Inter Continental was my home for a week  I thoroughly enjoyed my stay Firstly  the location of this hotel was ideal  It was opposite Bugis Markets and within a mall  There was an MRT station about 200m away  airconditioned and undercover walk way   I caught the MRT whenever I could   even to the airport  It was very convenient  I never ate any meals in the hotel as I wanted to try all the local food  My breakfasts every morning were at the Kaya Toast restaurant on the way to Bugis station  If I ran late for dinner  I grabbed something from one of the outlets in the mall  There was a grocery store  department store and even a movie theatre within the precicnt  There was also an FX dealer near the movie theatre which exchanged money without transaction fees  Therefore  this hotel was extremely convenient and central to anything that I may want or need My room was immaculate  Not much of a view  but I guess I can t have it all  Whoever cleaned my room  even lined my shoes and belongings in order  maybe even used a ruler to ensure things were perfect  It seemed that they had a staff member everywhere you looked  to greet you and answer any questions you may have  Their concierge was most patient at explaining things to me and making bookings for me  My trip in Singapore was hassle free because of their help

I chose the Intercontinental for a last minute 2 day trip to Singapore in early November  and I m very glad I did  I ve stayed in some of Singapore s top hotels  including Raffles  Ritz Carlton  and Mandarin Oriental  and I was a bit concerned that the Intercon would suffer in comparison  Happily  it did not The only minor sour note occured when I was checking in and I asked the clerk about the 4 p m  late checkout   quot subject to availability quot   mentioned as part of the weekend rate I d booked  The clerk said there was nothing in the  quot system quot  about this  and a second staffer  who d come to take me up to my room  reiterated the  quot availability quot  line  of which I was already aware  and said she d let me know later  I politely but firmly asked her to check and let me know before heading up to my room  as my return flight was not until after midnight on my checkout day  She quickly confirmed the late checkout availability  and all went very well from that point on Hotel  The Intercon is a 13 year old midrise located in Bugis very near Raffles and a short walk or taxi ride to most of the city s attractions and interesting neighborhoods  All the public areas are attractive and spotless  and the hotel s decor is very smart if rather generic  The Intercon eschews the grandeur of the Ritz Carlton and Oriental and is more reminiscent of the simple luxury of the Four Seasons Room  I had a standard   quot Deluxe quot   room on the 6th floor  and while I thought that that might be a bit lacking  I was again pleasantly surprised  While not huge  at about 35 sq  meters  my room was just right  very comfortable  spotless  and more understated luxury    in short  the Intercontinental mien at its best  The large bathroom was done in marble  with a big  separate tub and walk in shower  The room had a large  triple bay window  and the view of the surrouding buildings in Bugis was quite nice  The bed was very comfortable  as one expects in Intercons  The hotel had even provided a small bowl of complimentary fruit and a bottle of Evian  The only drawback to the room was the internet service  wired  no wifi  at least from the hotel  broadband with adequate speed but an annoying feature  having to reopen the startup pay as you go page with each new session  even after paying for a 24 hour block of time  Nor was this cheap  SGD 30  about US  21  for the 24 hours  But the Intercon s not alone in charging high ratees for internet access  I m hopeful that five star chains will follow the Peninsula s lead in providing complimentary internet service in all rooms  But this was a minor quibble  and overall  I was very satisfied with my  quot basic quot  Intercon room  My rate of SGD 220 included breakfast and the aforementioned late checkout  and it was actually cheaper than the cheapest room only rate at the time I booked Staff and service  With the small exception of my initial checkin query  all of the Intercon s staff were very pleasant  friendly  and helpful  The concierge recommended an excellent seafood speciality Chinese restaurant  Jumbo  on the waterfront for chili crab  out of this world  and I highly recommend it  The staff at Olive Tree  where I took breakfast  were equally helpful  and the food there was excellent  with a wide choice of fresh western and Asian dishes Bottom line  I d recommend the Intercon to anyone visiting Singapore  It s a true five star  maybe even plus  hotel that  at least at promotional or weekend rates  is a real value compared to more famous Singapore properties that may or may not warrant their higher prices  The Intercon feels smaller than it is  I think it has close to 500 rooms   and the staff make guests feel welcome and special  Well done  Intercontinental Singapore

We decided not to give presents for our twenty fifth wedding anniversary  but rather have a first class week overseas   and that s what we experienced at the Intercontinental Singapore  This review might seem a bit long   but we were really impressed with the service and food and felt that the hotel deserved a more comprehensive review  Room We booked a club deluxe room that was large  well furnished with a very big comfortable bed  It was quiet and we weren t woken during the night by any extraneous noise  The shower and bath facilities were great  with good water pressure  The added benefit of this room was the complimentary use of the club lounge facilities When they found out it was our anniversary  among other things  they decorated the bath with rose petals  Club Lounge This is a fantastic facility  Breakfasts are very good  with a chef ready to cook your eggs  benedict  or whatever  with a nice selection of different international meal options  We re bacon lovers and their take on it was sensational  extra crisp and tasty  but not burnt  My wife is gluten intolerant and loved the gluten free bread they had At night  there s the happy hour selection of different dishes  During the week we had prawn dumplings and other Chinese delicacies  along with pate  pappadums  cheeses  olives  turkey  cakes  dessert bites and I forget the rest   except for the drinks Wine is particularly expensive in Singapore everywhere  at around  100 a bottle for something we would pay  20 for in Australia  The club lounge had a selection of international wines  including a fantastic Australian riesling  They also had cocktails  Singapore slings  mojitos  margaritas etc  Me  I drank the Tiger  Heineken and Chang beers and longed for a Crown lager  but can t complain about the price Service is great in the club and they remembered our names after a few days  Special thanks to Suriyana  who went out of her way to look after us really well  We had a business meeting in the club lounge   our guest was extra impressed  Man Fu Yuan restaurant Before we arrived in Singapore we chose a restaurant for our anniversary  but after having scoped it out  decided that it was not quite right  This left us in a bit of a dilemma  but through a twist of fate we met the food and beverage manager  Thomas   who convinced us to try the signature steamboat dish at the Man Fu Yuan  It sounded good so we googled it to find rave reviews I could write a thousand words on how fantastic the steamboat was and another thousand on how fantastic the table chef staff  Kris and Shirlee  were  you don t have to cook it yourself  There was lobster  crab claws  chicken  wagyu beef  dumplings  crab balls  a couple of types of fish etc  This is a unique experience that we will never forget   our twenty fifth wedding anniversary  Location It s central  with walks to local museums  restaurants and the very trendy Haji Lane  a mixture of local boutiques  not the usual brands you see on Orchard Road or Collins Street  Melbourne   Taxis are cheap in Singapore  so visiting all the sights is not a hassle from the hotel The big plus is that the Bugis Junction shopping centre backs on to the hotel  with its BHG department store  fashion chains  supermarket  specialty stores and chemist It s also a short walk to Raffles where you have to tick the bucket list box  Singapore sling  throw peanut shells on the floor  marvel at the colonial decor  and imagine Somerset Maugham writing We walked back from Little India one day  but it was a bit of a trek   should have spent the six or so bucks on the cab  Not so good The wireless internet speed was not as good as we would have liked  Summary If you re after a great hotel with exceptional service  that s what you ll get at the Intercontinental Singapore  It made out anniversary something we ll never forget Special thanks also to Peter in concierge and Yvonne in the lobby Bill KernoczyPS If you want to verify this  find me and call Room Tip  The south east is good  overlooking the entranceSee more room tips

I stayed here in December while in Singapore for business  I would haved stayed down the road at the Fairmont  but colleagues were staying at the Intercontinental and recommended it  I am happy they did  Overall it was a good stay at a hotel which was a refuge away from the pre Christmas bustle that is Singapore in December  Very friendly and helpful staff from front of house through to the restaurant  The room was a good size with a very comfortable bed  I was staying in a twin room which was fine with me  Plenty if room to get about as well as a good space to work  The bathroom was good and spacious as well As far as eating is concerned  I only ate breakfast there which was good  though a little on the pricey side  There are some cafes nearby if you want some good local food at a reasonable price It was the service that I liked here most of all  Very helpful  The bane of my life travelling  wifi access was included in my rate  though only a slow access pack  I could have paid for better access but since I was working I did most of my online work while at work  It would be nice if full access wifi were available without additional charges  Amazing how you can get it in tiny third world hotels  but in more up market places you pay through the nose I would stay again if it was an option on a trip up to Singapore  Though I still do a favourite Singapore hotel that the Intercontinental is not quite the same as

My wife and I stayed at the Intercontinental  Singapore for two nights during a stopover on our way to New Zealand  We stayed here previously in November 2013 and we re delighted with the hotel and we enjoyed our second stay in January 2015 just as much  We arrived early after a very long flight and had previously asked the hotel for an early check in and we re very pleasantly surprised to be in our room by 10 00 am  The standard room was large  with a very comfortable bed and a luxurious bathroom with very large  fluffy towels and plenty of hot water  These are some of the basics which I think are important  In addition the staff are impeccably well mannered and very helpful and the choice of food at breakfast would suit most tastes  I thoroughly recommend this hotel  It is located in the business  shopping district but the marina and Gardens by the Bay are within walking distance

Stayed here for about a week in 2011  amp  2014  Very comfortable and all meals supplied  Friendly staff and a short walk to china town and some great Hawker halls for the BEST food ever  Has a gym and pool  Reasonably central to all you need   but then what is not central in Singapore      Would happily stay here again for business but with the amount of transitional FIFO oil rig workers who are put up there by their employers I would probably go somewhere else for pleasure

I have stayed here a few times and enjoyed myself  i have stayed with family   friends and alone   I always enjoy my stay here   some might say it needs a refurb and perhaps it could do with a touch up   but i quite like the older style   Its still classy and elegant   its well located and has a charm of its own

This was a work trip for my husband  We stayed here for 2 weeks in August and because we loved the hotel and location so much we stayed again  The were some problems in our bathroom so after a few days I emailed the gentleman who responds to all these reviews  He was out of town so my email went to someone else  We went out to dinner and when we returned they were trying to contact us to move us to a new room  They moved us to a much nicer room  brought new bouquets of roses the times  fresh fruit often  and more water than we could possibly drink  I couldn t believe their kindness  Yes  the carpets need to be replaced but the bathrooms are so nice  Huge tubs that we never used  They have the largest towels I have ever seen    They also provide every toiletry you can imagine  If we ever get to come to Singapore again we OF COURSE will stay here  A tip about breakfast food  we bought food at Cold Storage  the grocery store in the basement of Bugis Station  5 minutes or less from your room  I boiled eggs in the hot pot in our room  bought orange juice  etc  and drank lots of tea and coffee and fruit provided in our room  I love Singapore

I stayed at the Intercontinental Singapore as a stopover on a return journey from Australia  It is an excellent hotel with an impressive interior and a great location  The hotel staff couldn t be more helpful  As a few of the other reviewers have pointed out the rooms could be updated but this didn t detract from the luxurious feel of staying here  I would definitely go again  I would recommend booking early as the price goes up steeply if you book close to the date of your stay

Yes the building is old but that s the characteristic I love about it  It shows history and lots of great craftsmanship from the old days Will I come back  Yes  But purely because of the amazing customer service from this resort I ve stayed a numerous other Int resort but this is by far the best when it comes to Customer Service The other thing I really like of this resort is how they hire staffs which i normally wouldn t find in other 5stars places  I have seen a senior aged man acting as the Porter and an intellectually disabled young lady as a housekeeper  I praise Intercontinental Singapore for having a more diverse workforce and let s hope we see more high end resort supporting this approach Thank you for making our trip so much more memorable and comfortable Btw the breakfast at Olive Tree was fantastic  Everything was fresh and well thought through

Haven t stayed here for a while and don t think I will come back  Building still has a lot of traditional charm but rooms and amenities are all very tired and in need of an uplift  Gym is very basic and really not up to scratch  Staff very friendly but they just need to spend a bit of money as the fixtures are shabby  floors in bedrooms scratched etc

This is the 2nd time we have stayed here during business trips  once in April 2014 and again in November 14  and on both occasions it has been outstanding We actually checked out of another hotel we were booked into because it was dreadful and managed to book a room with lounge access through our rewards program at super short notice Room Spacious  tastefully decorated in the Chop House style  comfortable bed with very good quality bedding and well appointed good sized bathroom Pool area is good with plenty of sunbeds and lobby bar is very pleasant   despite the high prices The club lounge This really is the pi? ce de r? sistance and is exceptional value for money  as it costs only whatever deal you have secured for your  club room   nothing extra to pay  It is a little sanctuary after a days work and so elegantly finished in a colonial style you feel like you have been transported back in time  Plenty of sofas and comfy seats to relax with a glass of champagne    or 3Lounge access includes a civilised breakfast in peace and quiet   away from the rest of the hotel   within the lounge where you can select from practically anything you want  Proper afternoon tea daily  should you want it  sandwiches cakes scones etc  and from 5 30pm it s cocktail time  When they say cocktail hour  not only do they mean complimentary free flowing alcoholic drinks including beer  wines  champagnes etc  they do mean cocktails too and it s not just for an hour  Top that with delicious canapes and snacks and it has to be one of the best club lounges we have had the pleasure of visiting The staff are first class  they are polite  courteous  have remarkable memories and will go above and beyond to make your stay as smooth as possible  Annoyingly I lost the piece of paper on our travels with the two lovely ladies names on it that looked after us in the lounge  but their service and attention to detail was outstanding We should have gone with our instinct and not faffed around wasting our time and effort at Marina Mandarin and just booked this from the start The intercontinental is our preferred choice in Singapore without question  Keep up the good work Room Tip  Get a club room the benefits are well worth the extra See more room tips

Second great location besides Orchard  Different atmosphere compares with Orchard  The staf are so helpfull and friendly  The room is clean and cozy  bathroom is nice The Bugis junction behind the hotel is interesting for walking around  eating and shopping  Unique merchandize are selling during the chinese new year times  And we can just cross the road to get to Bugis Street  the old market which was there for decades  It is not difficult to get a taxi from the hotel to go somewhere  The food is average as 5 stars hotel  the lobby lounge is spacious and nice Overall is ok  I will come back for another stayRoom Tip  Higher level will be better to have the city view  4th floor is not nice  the view is facing wall See more room tips

Firstly  let me start by saying that this is the 4th and last time I stay at this hotel  This hotel is on our corporate list and not sure how it has survived but I will be definitely giving them my feedback as well  When checking in I was offered a twin Queen room which is in reality a room with two single beds  The decor is from the 90 s and hasn t been refurbished or repaired for quite some time  The wallpaper was peeling in the corners and dirty and scuffed near common areas  The amenities in the room were poor and bathroom was in need of repair  There was odd door handles throughout the room and in general the place needed a refresh When I was checking out they tried to charge me in excess of SGD 100 for 3 local conference calls I made  After disputing the charges they were dropped off the bill  I told them they need to warn customers that local calls were charged in timed blocks and at least advertise it somewhere in the room  Very tired  poor product for the price you pay especially when there are so many new hotels in Singapore at much more competitive price I won t be staying here again Room Tip  Don  39 t get a room near the service entry as the door bangs all night and stay away from room 1412See more room tips

Firstly this hotel is in a great location  and secondly it is a great hotel  Nothing proved to be too much trouble for any of the staff  My room was very large and the king sized bed was very comfortable  The stand alone shower had heaps of pressure and the towels were huge  My room was clean and turned down every night  Room service was super quick  The club lounge is the best I have visited with the cocktail hour  2 hours  was great with exceptional table service  The pool looked good but I didn t have a chance to use it  I will definitely be back Room Tip  I had room 516 and couldn  39 t fault it See more room tips

Nothing is ever too much for the staff and service provided by Intercontinental  Starting with the daily breakfast  I was welcomed and quickly escorted to my table where my order of freshly brewed coffee was delivered  Oh the coffee is the best  My room was immaculate and well stocked in the bathroom and tea areas  Although I had tried to maintain a green image by only placing the dirty towels in the bathtub I had new linen neatly placed in my bathroom  I must admit entering my room at the end of the working day felt like the first day I checked in  Everything looked  felt and smelt fresh  The staff in the lobby look are quick to make you feel comfortable by offering reading materials  drinks and food  Free Wi Fi at the hotel is a great bonus

this is a lovely hotel   the decor brings together a bit of old world charm and modern amenities  The rooms are just perfect  comfortable beds and very nice bathroom with separate soaking tub and shower  The service is fri madly and efficient  Hotel breakfast has lots of options and the bar area is very pretty  Intercon is attached to a shopping center where you can find lots of food choices and buy just about anything  I d happily return to this hotel

i would say this is one of the nicest hotels I have ever stayed  Excellent service while check in out  door boys great  clean  well kept rooms  luxurious bedding  linen  excellent toiletries  a great lobby lounge  excellent access to shopping mall and the road side shops  near to Bugis MRT  an ok executive lounge  not so bad sound proofing of rooms from the din below  a very questionable staff attitude on guiding  good choice of food  but  but  but       yes  a Greaaaaaaaaaat hiked price  I would say that with a little better pricing this hotel could move to the top as it deserves  Okay for a short stay  very good for families and with kids  they would enjoy the location  I need to be back at the hotel to analyse some other points as I was disappointed of a visibly absent managerial staff for guidance and which I know for this type of a hotel is for sure not the norm  Something is amiss  But for these small gaps  an excellent choice for a luxurious stay

We have just spent the last 4 days based at the Intercontinental in Singapore  We can t fault the service or the quality of the establishment  We were upgraded to a Chophouse suite including the club lounge access The staff are attentive and professional as would be expected in a quality hotel We were also impressed with the attention to detail in the quality of fittings throughout the hotel and in particular in the rooms  The actual hotel is in the Bugis precinct and is a low set Peranakan style building with high celings and wide hallways  The art and fittings are tasteful and very interesting If you like shopping just walk out the side door and you can shop all day without hitting the street A special mention for the club lounge staff  It s worth the extra to have access to such a great service

I ve been staying at the Intercontinental Singapore a few times and always stay at their Shophouse Club room suite  The Club lounge ladies are indeed wonderful  they go out of their way to please you  Breakfast and Cocktails at the Club lounge always great  My number one dislike of the property is the staircase that connects the Club lounge on the 2nd floor to the Shophouse suite on the 3rd floor is simply dated and simply unattractive  For me personally this is an issue because my favourite place to enter the hotel is actually from Bugis Junction mall instead of the main entrance  as the staircase mentioned above is the fastest way to reach my  favorite  Shophouse suite  As the shophouse club rooms suites considered to be their premium rooms  they really need to consider to make the stair case to be more upscale  I know it s a minor thing but as a regular client of the hotel that is my number one gripe about staying at their Shophouse suite Room Tip  Shophouse club room suiteSee more room tips

If you are staying in this lovely hotel I highly recommend the club lounge  Could not fault it  the staff were amazing especially the girls that were on for cocktail hour I can not remember both the names but one was Aun  They really knew what the word service is all about  Very well trained and many hotel staff could do with learning a thing or two from these girls  The room was very comfortable  bed was divine and room very clean  Location  location  Bugus Junction shopping centre is right at your door step very convenient for a bit of a shop and not to far to carry your shopping back to your room  Well worth having an afternoon by the pool is very comfortable with great views across the city  With Singapore being a bit pricey the extra cost for the club room is well worth it  Breakfast was nice and high tea was great  Cocktail hour food was different every night  We will be back Thank you to the Intercontinental for a gorgeous stay Room Tip  No real views but club rooms would be my choiceSee more room tips

It took me a long time to decide which hotel to stay at Singapore  with all the research and reading reviews  I was glad I have chosen to stay at Intercon Singapore  from the minute we walk in to the last minute we left  everything was perfect  Hotel staff are so gracious and accommodating  special mention to Ummar Noor  who went out of his way  by arranging a surprise for my daughter s graduation and upgrading our room  Wen Long from Housekeeping  who looks after us really well and always has a smile every morning and Peter who welcomed us soon as we arrived  I would definitely come back to this hotel and recommend them to my friends

If you are looking for somewhere central then Intercontinental Singpore is the best location  Not only is it conveniently situated above the MRT but the staff are outstanding  This is a hotel that understands service  They remember guest requests and everything is done with a genuine smile and ease  If you are fortunate to upgrade yourself to the club level it is well worth it  Again the staff make the experience all the more special  The hotel has a lovely feel for singles couples and families alike  Well done to all of them for making my stay so enjoyable Room Tip  If background noise is a problem ask for a room that isn  39 t shop facingSee more room tips

Great stay here  Staff and service crews are friendly  considerate  gentle and professional  Room is clean and neat  Full temperature control  Great breakfast with so many choices ?  Chinese  Japaness  Malay India  and American  Freshly made fruit juices and mixed vegetable juice  Close to the MRT and easy to get to downtown  bay area  and orchard I forgot my mouse pad  Staff noticed that and provide one without my asking  I also lost my phone in the hotel  Next day  hotel found it and returned to me    I have sensitive information in the phone so what a relief  though I locked the phone through google service and where is my droid app  Great experience and definitely will stay here again

I booked this Hotel by mistake as a two night stop over on the way back to the UK from Perth WA  It must be the best mistake I have ever made in my whole life  What a fantastic place pure class in every way including all of the staff  When we go next to Perth we definitely stay in this hotel I cannot describe in words how good it is  Just go there and you will see it is also close to everything you could wish to see in the Center of the City Room Tip  Just book itSee more room tips

I was upgraded to a Junior Suite as an IHG Platinum Ambassador Room was spacious with a colonial feel look  unfortunately I was not in the room enough to make the most of it  Hotel lobby coffee shop is a great place to wind down with high ceilings  natural light and comfortable seating Room was clean with expected amenities I had breakfast included  it was at Olive Garden with a great spread  Continental and Asian   great breads I was there for 7 nights and had requested a late check out when I checked in on Sunday  Nobody had got back to me to confirm and I had to chase Saturday night and question why nobody got back to me if they could not confirm it  Thankfully the staff managed to deliver and extend this until 4pm  I had a 7pm flight out  I requested bath salt  my only request from housekeeping during my stay there  and had to chase again half an hour later All in all a good stay  only need to look into improving the responsiveness on guest s requests

I was lucky to spent one night at this hotel early in February 2015  The check in process was seamless  They acknowledged my IHG Gold Elite and gave me a complimentary upgrade to a better view on the 10th floor  I had their breakfast buffet  not included  and enjoyed both the variety and the quality of the food  I did get a fruit plate in the evening as well  The hotel itself is very old but they have done a great job keeping the facilities current  Both tub and shower options were available and the beds were extremely comfortable  Service was very efficient An interesting option they have is access to showers in the gym after check out for guests that have late flights  I actually got to check this out  This was not well advertised but more importantly there was no on around after 8 pm to even provide directions  I would recommend the hotel has some printed instructions made available  I ended up helping a couple of other guests on where the facilities are   etc  This is a very useful option and the hotel should streamline its operations The best part of the stay was the location of the hotel  It is within walking distance of the Raffles  So I could visit it for a couple of hours and walk back to my room  The hotel is also connected to the quirky a c Burgis Junction Mall that has glass roofs  It is also just a block away from Burgis street market   which is a night market  This market has some of the very best deals for shopping souvenirs in all of Singapore  think SG 3 t shirts  and excellent food shops and a hawker center  I had char siew from one of the popular stores and a memorable spicy rojak  This is the hotel you want to stay with your family  have the kids go swimming with husband while the wife goes shopping and the wife makes the kids sleep while the husband goes out for a good meal  You will not be disappointed with the Intercontinental Room Tip  The lower floors are loud and busy    ask for the highest possible floor See more room tips

We stayed in the intercontinental with our daughter and son in law pre cruise and it was superb we had Club rooms and it was worth every penny extra as the food  service and staff were just so friendly and helpful On check in we were upgraded to Shop house rooms  don t know why  which were just as I imagined they would be in this colonial type hotel  rich old world charm  but modern comfort in every department The executive club lounge was brilliant and the array of food and drinks were out of this world Breakfast was also served in the club lounge and we could not have had a better choice of food anywhere in the world from oriental to full English Our room was very very comfortable especially after a 13hour flight we just melted into the beautiful super kingsized bed I would recommend this hotel to anyone  possibly the top 3 I ve stayed in Room Tip  Go for a shophouse room  they are great See more room tips

I would consider this hotel as a standard 4 star hotel The rooms are large and clean  separate bath and shower  free wifi throughout the hotel The fitness room was a little small  only 1 functioning bike  The pool was small and I did not see a jacuzzi  The main lobby has couches  chairs with tables and you have the ability to have a business meeting without being disturbed The hotel is in the Bugis area which has a variety of shopping options  From the mid to high end malls as well as the Bugis street which is market style shopping The hotel is close to the Marina and Singapore flyer

Having visited Singapore on numerous occasions and tried a few of the better hotels we concluded that the clear winner for us is the Intercontinental Hotel  The location is perfect with immediate access to shops and malls and a wide range of restaurants  The hotel itself is beautifully maintained and the general facilities are excellent  We opt to stay in the Club Rooms with access to the Club Lounge in the evenings   a very relaxing atmosphere pertains  Breakfast is also available in the Lounge as is afternoon tea

My husband and I spent five nights here in January  prior to boarding the Crystal Symphony for a 2 week cruise through SE Asia  There were so many positives that I tended to overlook a few negatives  like the need to refurbish the rooms  We booked a Club Floor room which included a plentiful breakfast buffet with a short menu for ordering specialty breakfast items  afternoon tea and canapes and evening cocktails and interesting appetizers  The appetizers were different every evening and I especially liked the baby octopus and sea urchins  We thoroughly enjoyed the professional attitudes and service throughout our stay  especially in the Club Lounge which was a more intimate gathering place and where we spent several hours  Very comfortable  Great value  Great location Room Tip  Ask about Club Floor rooms when booking a room or check out the their IHG Rewards Program for benefi   See more room tips

This is our fourth visit to this particular hotel and the reasons are many The location in our opinion is superb  there is a nice mixture of local residents around the hotel  whilst some other hotels are grouped together  meaning you only seem to see hotel guests milling around the local streets and restaurants  What is the point of visiting a foreign country if you only want to see people the same as yourself  Secondly the staff are extremely professional  friendly and helpful  We were upgraded to a Shophouse room and we had access to the wonderful Club Lounge  Breakfasts  afternoon teas and cocktails in the evening are all wonderfully presented by again caring staff who seem to want to help you I am writing this from the Club Lounge as we are waiting to fly out tonight back to London  The hotel offered us a late check out until 5 pm and access to the club until we are are ready to leave for our taxi  This is what I call excellent service We visit Singapore every year on our way to Australia and New Zealand and were considering trying another hotel but now we will definitely return to the Intercontinental

I am a return visitor to this hotel and the staff are always friendly and very helpful but as a Platinum Ambassador I was disappointed with my usual suite not being available  When you are pay around  450 a night and as part of the program you get an upgrade  it was a let down  The suite we had at an Accor property in Bangkok was far better and half the price  Disappointed with the room but not with the service Room Tip  Get the shophouse rooms much nicer than the standard rooms suitesSee more room tips

Staying here for 5nights Central position  short taxi ride cost  20 in peak traffic  easy to walk about mall next door very handy also train station  opposite hotel hop on off bus which we got for 2days easy way to see city and surrounds   pool nice  food service good but eaten out more than in as easier when out every day  room big clean comfy beds  quiet room except for noisy child next door but that s not the hotels problem   had a drink in Victoria bar was nice but expensive but drinks in all the bars are  would stay again as so central  walk to raffles hotel closeby and orchard road if you don t mind a 20 min walk we did it easy

Stayed here for 16 nights during Feb 15   My stay was comfortable  decent beds  hot and powerful showers  good breakfast  great speciality bread with beetroot    can t comment on the rest of the dining as ate elsewhere for other meals  You had everything you needed in the room and aircon was effective and quiet  though cleanliness was a little haphazard  Gym was adequate ?  some of the machines could do with replacing as were damaged  Staff were friendly  except for the porters whom I felt came across as everything being a little too much effort and not very friendly at all   Drinks in the bar were very expensive   ? 7 50 for a diet coke    Ideally located in the centre of town and connected to a shopping mall  Overall the hotel was good though a little dated in parts I thought  I would stay again however there is better in Singapore

Stayed for 4 nights in a deluxe room on the 11th floor  The door staff were very efficient in dealing with our bags straight from the car  Check in  however  was slow  20 minutes just to get to the reception desk   perhaps with our misfortune to follow a number of taxis bringing other guests at that moment  but the arrangement of arches and desks doesn t help visibility or queuing efficiency and no one seemed particularly concerned that we were waiting for so long  Once checked in  however  we had a great stay  They room was a nice size and well appointed  including the bathroom  There were a few signs of wear and tear like peeling wallpaper behind the curtains and the shaving mirror pulling out of the wall  but generally it was in a very good state and housekeeping did a fantastic job of cleaning  bed making and turning down  The lifts are really quick and we were surprised how fast we got up to the 11th floor  Our room backed on to the lift shaft  but despite other comments on TripAdvisor  this was not a noticeable issue  with only barely perceptible noise from the lifts  The swimming pool was not huge  but equally not that busy  especially before breakfast and late evening and was open from 7am until late  It made a nice refreshing dip after the unrelenting heat of Singapore The hotel location is not only handy for the Bugis MRT  but also backs on to a shopping mall  Bugis Junction  meaning that it is entirely possible to use that as an air conditioned route  halving the time outside en route to the metro  when it is particularly hot  That said  we did walk a lot too  and the hotel s location on North Bridge Road makes it very simple to follow in order to get in to the very centre  going past Raffles and Parliament House  We didn t eat in the hotel  but then Singapore is replete with every conceivable type of food establishment and there is plenty of choice in the immediate neighbourhood  Overall a very pleasant stay and only very minor issues

We opted for a slight splurge and stayed in one of the shophouse club rooms  When we entered  everything seemed impressive but we soon had to ring for help  the electric kettle didn t work  the overhead lights in the shower didn t work and there was a drainage problem with the shower with water banking up  Everything was fixed in fairly good time but I would have thought that room cleaning staff would check these things daily  Everything else was really very enjoyable   quiet room  comfort  club facilities  including the club staff and one with some great jokes   Great location for us as well

We really liked this place  It s not the swankiest or the hippest place to stay in Singapore  But it has a lot going for it  In no particular order  Position   close to Bugis MRT  and only a short cab ride from most of the sights   and sufficiently far away from the depressing realities of Orchard Rd and Clarke Quay that they don t intrude  Our room was excellent   spacious  quiet  comfortable  thoughtfully arranged and well equipped and housekeepered  Breakfast is magnificent  Staff are keen and polite  Negatives  Newspaper delivery was erratic  the shaver socket was faulty  and we were given duff information about the time of breakfast  The pool is small  20 sunbeds   But these didn t detract much from the favourable impression created by our five night stay   We would certainly return

We stayed 3 nights in a  Shop House  suite  based on the traditional shop houses of Singapore  We arranged to be collected from the airport in a hotel car so were met from the door of the aircraft and assisted through all the immigration and customs formalities  We were then met at the hotel entrance by the Club Lounge manager who escorted us to our room where we completed registration with the minimum of fuss  During our stay we enjoyed the complimentary breakfasts  afternoon teas and food drinks served early evening  The food  drink and service were always of the highest order with the club lounge team working seamlessly together to make it a really relaxing experience Room Tip  Choose a   39 shop house  39  option as this is unique to this hotelSee more room tips

The Intercontinental is well positioned in Singapore  within walking distance of many sites  Rooms are standard  and the amenities are good  with the exception of the wireless which is quite slow Breakfast is a buffet for  30  which is expensive  However  the non buffet option is just as expensive  So  it you re eating in the hotel  take the buffet The hotel itself is not cheap    but neither is anything in Singapore

We stayed the previous night at marina bay sands before we came to intercontinental  I really love this hotel more than MBS  Although the place was not as spacious as MBS  but you just had the feeling that you were welcomed by this hotel  The lobby quiet  no need to wait for checkin checkout  the lady in front office  sorry that I can t recall her name   she was cute and always had the smile on her face  Even the hotel room was a little bit old  I still liked the design  it s way better than MBS in room design  The location is good  easy to go to many places  for food or shopping

I have stayed at many intercontinental hotels in the world this one is the worst The only good thing is the location but their are lots of hotels in the same area The rooms are old and mouldy Outside our room there was water on the carpet for a week then decided to dry it with a dryer at night time The concierge and staff at the front of house lacked the service you would expect at a 4 5 star hotel not much attention to detail or service Not a very warm and welcoming environment Lastly booked to go for a meal at the olive tree the hotel had a 1 for 1 deal for the buffet went in to see the offer which was totally limiting went to the carousel buffet on Scott s road which was a real treat During my entire stay I did not see any management around I think maybe they should review what is going on in the hotel I feel disappointed that I choose this hotel to stay at and it ruined my holiday

We are currently staying at this hotel on a three night stop over after travelling around New Zealand  The hotel arranged our pick up from the airport  at our request  110 Singapore  and from the moment we were met by a customer service rep at the airport we could not have been looked after better  We opted for the Club upgrade as we are IHG members and what excellent service and food options we have received in the Club lounge  the afternoon tea is a lovely treat after spending time exploring hot and steamy Singapore  Location is good for seeing what Singapore has to offer  you can go shopping in the adjoining Malls  if that is what takes your fancy  without having to leave an air conditioned environment which currently with temperatures 34  degrees and high humidity is a definite bonus  The tourist sight seeing bus stops opposite the hotel and Raffles is one block away  All the staff have been fantastic and really know what service is  The housekeeping staff have replenished water and towels  when they do the turn down service early evening and all staff are very friendly and helpful so a big thank you to them all  PS The Singapore Sling cocktails are worth a try too Room Tip  The rooms at the front overlook the pool areaSee more room tips

Stayed there February 2015 with my family Very large rooms   40sq m which is very big for SingaporeUpgraded to Club because you get breakfast included and light snacks and drinks in the eveningIf you are planning on having a few drinks it works out better value to upgradeYou cannot access the lounge at night with children but they will accommodate you in the barGreat location 2 mis MRT walking1 mins Bugis shopping mall walkingRoom Tip  Club room is bestSee more room tips

Was not a satisfied guest on my prior visit 8 months ago  but this visit was a total recovery  As someone who spends 100  nights in hotels annually  I recognize quality service   amp  when it is not delivered by a property claiming to be 4 5 stars  I am not satisfied  Service is equally as important as the property itself for frequent travelers   amp  the hotel lived up to its 5 start status on this visit  Top flight Club Room which is staffed by very experienced professionals  All employees from the outstanding housekeeping staff  to the bars  amp  restaurants  to front desk  amp  bellmen  exhibited professionalism   amp  an effort to anticipate a guest s needs   amp  were ever eager to assist with courtesy  Time to focus on cleaning the hallway carpets Management  but other than this criticism  it was truly a 5 star visit this time  amp  I will return again happily later in the year  Thank you to the Management  amp  Staff for a flawless visit

We travelled to Singapore on our way to Thailand and stayed at the Intercontinental for three days and one day on our way back to the UK The hotel is around 20 minutes by taxi from the airport and there were plenty available at the airport and the cost was around 20 Singapore dollars The check in at the hotel was very efficient and welcoming  The staff were aware that we were IHG members and we treated accordingly as we had booked the club facilities The room we were allocated was very spacious and extremely comfortable  The bed was large and comfortable and the tv had numerous channels and film offerings if you wanted them We used the club room every day of our stay and the drinks and food on offer were very good indeed  The staff here were very attentive and professional as well as friendly  They are a credit to the hotel We also found all other staff here extremely friendly and all had a very customer focused attitude The hotel is quite well placed for sightseeing and is only a short walk away from the famous Raffles Hotel All in all we had an excellent stay at this hotel and would definitely recommend it and would stay here again if we visit Singapore Room Tip  Upgrade if you canSee more room tips

Our first visit to Singapore and the Intercontinental Shophouse suite does not disappoint  Although the front desk service was not up to par  the club lounge and general feeling of the hotel was good  Located next to the Bugis Mall  we were able to shop in comfort and stay cool  Centrally located I was able to navigate an easy route on my morning walk and take in a number of sites

I stayed at Intercontinental Singapore in January 2015 for 3 days I must say it was by far the best hotel I ve stayed at  Everything from the employees at the reception to the lavish breakfast served  was 5 star  Extremely friendly staff  excellent rooms  tidy clean and up to date  breakfast was lavish with lots of dishes to choose from  Overall it was just amazing and a definite recommended hotel if ure going to Singapore for holidays

After 1 month abroad   the service and comfort level of this hotel was welcoming as a stopover for my midnight flight home the following day The bed was so soft it enveloped me  Great location for shopping as it is connected to shopping centre and short distance from night market and SAM  Singapore Art Museum  which is definitely worth a visit as a nice change from eating and shopping  The concierge  manager   was particularly helpful and even helped me plastic wrap and tape up my luggage as I concerned about it bulging  from the shopping  and breaking open

I stayed at the Intercontinental for five nights on a recent business trip to Singapore  It has a colonial air  the staff are first class and very polite and helpful  The staff in the Victoria Bar were particularly good  Rooms were spacious and beds very comfortable  My only criticism was the quality of food in the buffet restaurant on one evening  when it tasted as if it had been around for a few hours and kept warm  This was my only disappointment in an otherwise excellent stay  The Japanese a la carte restaurant was excellent  An excellent central location with access to good shopping and some of the sights  particularly Marina Bay and Clarke Quay

Just returned from Singapore where we have been several times before having stayed in top hotels and this time we choose the intercontinental and I m so glad we did the hotel has a shopping male attached to it which pleased my wife it s a short walk to the raffles hotel and orchard road but the staff at the hotel are second to none nothing is to much trouble and they go that extra mile to ensure that all their guest are happy so may I thank all the staff that looked after us on the 10th February and please be sure that the next time were in Singapore it will be the intercontinental hotel for us Room Tip  We stayed on the forth floor which is where you will fined the lovely swimming pool area but higher   See more room tips

Booked a room for my boyfriend s birthday and was delighted when i arrived at the front counter to have the staff give me complimentary breakfast for two just for his birthday  Room service was even amazing  the staff was attentive and gave in to our needs when we needed a ice bucket to chill our wine  Food was even better  Definitely coming back

I have been to Singapore many times over a 35 year period  but never stayed at the Intercontinental   from now on  I ll stay nowhere else  A very British colonial feel to it  with public areas right out of Kipling  I first visited Raffles Hotel in 1980  just had Singapore slings in the Long Bar  never slept there  and this was before the refurbishment and still affordable  The Intercontinental felt a little like that  not noveau riche luxurious  but a Somerset Maugham  pit helmet feel to it I had a  chop room   I think  and was upgraded to a junior suite which was spacious  on the 5th floor  always elevator at hand and with a nice view over the pool They gave me a  business  package with breakfast and high speed internet included  and the breakfast was great    all in all  next time in Singapore I ll head for 80 Middle Road Am now on my way to London  and have had great stays at Intercontinental hotels in amiami  Hong Kong and Singapore   I have booked room at Intercontinental Hyde Park and am hopeful that they will try to compete with their US and Asian brethren   on occasion the London hotel has been a great disappointment  but I maintain the faith

This is one of our favourite hotels in the world  It has impeccable service and an atmosphere that recalls colonial times  for better or worse   We had access to the club lounge which is a great boon  including an upgrade  There you can drop in at all reasonable times  have a fine breakfast  high tea or just an afternoon drink  Ask for a room in the old wing  The Chinese restaurant is expensive but fantastic quality Room Tip  Ask for the old wingSee more room tips

My first experience of staying in an InterContinental for some time  The hotel itself is nice enough and the room was large  It was also well sound insulated given that it faced on to a busy road  The location is also good  My only complaint about the hotel was that the service during my stay was very slow  I noticed this in the first day in restaurant  I asked for some clothes to be pressed overnight and asked for them to be returned by a certain time on the form but had to chase when they were late  On checking out  I asked for a bell boy to come and collect my luggage and was told so done would come immediately   it took 25 minutes and needed me to chase 3 times  In the meantime  I had gone down to reception to check out myself and there was no one else checking out at the time  Whether it is poor staff or poor management  I really don t know

We did stay three nights with club lounge access  The club lounge staff provided an impeccable service  They solved a late check out issue to our complete satisfaction and recommended and booked a great restaurant within 3 minutes walking distance from the hotel   Garibaldi  In the club lounge you get a good breakfast  afternoon tea and evening snacks and drinks  The porter and concierge were very helpful arranging our arrival and departure  The location of the hotel is great and we really enjoyed our stay meanly thanks to the excellent staff  After a while the staff knows you and you fell home  how different from the impersonal service at some of the larger 5 star hotels in Singapore

We have just spent a week here after an absence of some years  and it is still a great hotel This is not as glitzy and glamorous as some  but has style  comfort and some of the best staff anywhere We stayed is a shophouse room in the club level  and it was superb  The room was a decent size  very quiet  comfortable  had all the conveniences and everything worked  Aircon  needed in Singapore  was very good The bed and pillows were very comfortable  with excellent sleep factor The bathroom was large  with a large walk in shower  plus full size tub  Twin vanities and wash bowls  Excellent water pressure  instant hot water The club lounge is excellent  with really professional staff  Staff at all levels were excellent Very close to Bugis MRT so transport is a dream The in house Chinese and Japanese restaurants are well worth a visit too Sure there are bigger and newer hotels  but for comfort  convenience and style  this si a great hotel Highly recommended Room Tip  Upgrade to the club level if you can See more room tips

We stayed for IFFS 2015  this time I stayed 6 days only  but it is always like coming home in Singapore at the Intercontinental  Ok  in all honesty  some features of the rooms or the hotel could be upgraded   modernized a bit  but for me the overall atmosphere of the hotel is still very pleasant and comfortable  When we come it is always Seafood Week in the buffet restaurant and that usually means  wow  good seafood    We ate way too much again   I had an upgrade to Club facilities  and the Lounge on the 2nd is very nice for cocktails etc  One staff member went out of her way to prepare a very pleasant surprise for me  because I told her I was really craving for chocolates and could not find any in my mini bar he he he  I guess it was pretty special even for a royal ambassador  great selection of treats wow  Thank you sooooo very much      The staff was amazing and very accommodating  cheers and congratulations to you all  you made our stay a very memorable one again   We will be back again soon Room Tip  best a bit away from the Elevators         See more room tips
