We arrived late at night at the Intercontinental  to discover our pre booked room wasn t available as there had been a plumbing mishap on that floor and there d been a minor flood  The hotel was full and there was no alternative room available  Disaster for tired travellers  Well  not really  as they whisked us away by taxi to an associated hotel Holiday Inn Singapore Atrium  which was 10 15 min away  We had a very comfortable night s sleep there  and after breakfast they transferred our luggage back to the Intercontinental while we started our sightseeing in Singapore On finally arriving at the Intercontinental  the staff could not have been more apologetic or accommodating  We received a room upgrade and free breakfasts  and the offer of a free transfer to the airport at the end of our stay  The room  I think it was a King Business  was lovely   spacious  a wonderfully comfortable bed  beautifully decorated  The hotel itself is all cool white tiles  spacious public areas  refined and comfortable lounges  interesting old pieces of furniture and art works  Breakfast in The Olive Tree Restaurant was fabulous  and waiters would come around with little interesting morsels of local specialties  The location was central to just about anything you would want to do   but Singapore is very easy to get around  with cheap taxis and the MRT All through our stay  managers would come up to us  proffer their business cards  we ended up with 6    and ask if there was anything we needed  I assumed this was because of the rocky start  but we were made to feel very welcome and comfortable indeed  The concierge was great with advice for dining out Overall a great stay in a great city  Highly recommended

The InterContinental hotels are always luxurious to varying degrees  with varying styles according to the towns they are located in  We have just returned from a three night stay at this one in Singapore on Middle Road  As Ambassador Club Members  pay  200 a year  we get an automatic upgrade on arrival and a free night in any IC hotel in the world so used our voucher on this stay  We booked a Deluxe room but were delighted with our automatic upgrade to a Shophouse Suite on arrival  Three nights would have cost us  1500 but this was reduced to  1000  so well worth having  The food was generally of a very high standard although we weren t keen on the ambiance in the Chinese restaurant so left before ordering  We did have a problem with the shower flooding our bathroom on the first night and reported it to the Club Lounge Receptionist who got maintenance to check it out  Although no fault was found and it didn t occur again they gave us a lovely bottle of red wine and a written card from the Assistant Manager as an apology for our inconvenience  We couldn t fault the service and the room  although quite traditional  was very comfortable  with a huge bed and bathroom and separate lounge with two TVs  All in all  a very nice place to stay and very well located in the centre of town  Taxis generally cost about  6    10 to go anywhere in town  which we thought was really good value Room Tip  Rooms tend to overlook either the mall or the street  but the air conditioning is very efficient so   See more room tips

I stayed in this hotel for 6 days in March  The staff were very courteous and went out of there way to make sure that everything was perfect  The room was very comfortable  clean and always very well looked after by the housekeeping dept The hotels club lounge was fabulous with great furnishings  food and cocktails  not to mention the staff who make the place extra special Singapore has a lot to offer  one night I exited the hotel onto the main road and turned left walked for about ten minutes  turned right and ended finding a lovely little street with some very small bars with live music  no idea where but you just need to go and explore Room Tip  Take a room with the club lounge access See more room tips

I stayed for a couple of days for my family trip  and it was nice to have a club room   I enjoyed the club room setup  cozy atmosphere at night  and a variety of selection at breakfast  amd which made me be enjoyable to stay in Singapore do use aroom with a club room entry which is much better than ordinary room  The hotel is on the above of the Bugis station  and you can travel around easily in the city and to Changi  so you do not need to take taxi to most of the location  and buses are also plenty  Hope this review will be helpful

I can always expect a great stay at any intercontinental  As soon as I walked in  I was greater with a smiling staff ready to help with what ever you need  carrying your luggage  checking you in  or giving you advice on local hot spots  I was given a complimentary drink coupon for their bar  always a great touch  The decor is outstanding  decadence and class all the way The room was large and clean  The bead was so comfortable  made it easy to fall asleep  Room cones with iron  ironing board  electric water kettle  complimentary coffee  tea  sugar  carton of creamer  large safe and a huge soaker tub  free wifi in the room available The gym was large and we ll ventilated  The pool looked amazing  too bad I didn t get a chance to jump in The hotel is connected to mall with countless food places including a Starbucks  I swear I gained a ton due to all the different food options  There is aslo train connection here and super market  Such an amazing location  only a short distance from where ever you need to be

this hotel is great  location is in the centre so we were always within 10 mins of anywhere  The hotel was clean and rooms great size  I was in club and automatically upgraded which was a lovely surprise  The lounge was well late out but with a lot of mirrors which was disorientating sometimes  the staff were great  offered us advise on where to go and when Great experience

Had read good reviews on the Intercontinental Singapore and I am pleased to say that they are true Spent 5 enjoyable days over a extended weekend in this wonderful hotel  Arriving in the hotel early afternoon we were greeted at the door by one of the friendly staff  our bags were collected without having to blink and we were checked in to our room We stayed in a king bed shophouse room  the king bed is comfortable  room well furnished and sized with lots of storage so you don t end up living out of an open suitcase  The bathroom is modern  clean and the towels toiletries are high quality The shophouse room also gave us to the executive lounge  The complimentary breakfast  high tea and evening cocktail drinks were top quality and enjoyed  Service was warm and friendly  adding to the appeal of the lounge Hotel is perfectly located above Bugis MRT  from which you can get almost anywhere in Singapore  Shops and markets are all located within short walking distance and the Raffles is just around the corner  If your more outgoing the walk to Marina bay Sands and CBD is just under an hour  Taxi rank out the front was also handy Great hotel  will definitely return Room Tip  Make sure to mention your special event or celebration  The hotel provided the most amazing cake for   See more room tips

In a family group we stayed for 6 nights  Given that the hotel predominantly caters for business customers we were delighted at the attention we received as a family  especially towards our 3 year old grandson  The hotel is impeccably maintained and staff are all friendly and helpful  I was also impressed that one of the house staff was a Down Syndrome girl  The rooms are large and well appointed and public areas are beautiful  Overall I cannot think of anything that would have made our stay more pleasant

I have been staying at Intercontinental Singapore regularly since it first opened in 1995 apart from a few stays at other 5 star properties for comparison sake For me its truly like coming home and my last stay was no exception  The location is excellent for coming from the airport   no need to brave the Orchard Road traffic chaos Located above Bugis MRT   now with the Downtown line its a very easy trip to Chinatown  and a much improved shopping complex you could conceivably need not venture near Orchard Road For a hotel of 18 years it is in remarkably good condition although I understand renovation has already started of the rooms with public areas to follow Food and beverage is good especially breakfast in the Olive Tree and the Chinese restaurant however for me an ongoing issue is the lobby lounge which could be so so much better and is sorely in need of a makeover The bones are good   soaring ceilings  cornices and open space What is not good is the decor and atmosphere   a curious mishmash of peranakan and modern   circa late 90 s   Ditch the modern especially the hideous sculpture and artwork and concentrate on the peranakan The upholstery needs to be replaced as does the carpet Even more pressing is service and F amp B   the lounge is very open with multiple entry points and there are not enough staff positioned to see who has entered it s not acceptable in a 5 star property to have to go and ask for a drinks menu after sitting for 10 minutes  The high tea is just trying too hard   whatever happened to straight finger sandwiches and scones   I don t need sandwiches masquerading as canapes nor tortured cakes Take a leaf out of Peninsula Hong Kong when the traditional high tea has barely changed over the years and is always busy Aside from the lounge it is still a great property and I will continue to stay there if not drink or take afternoon tea there

Singapore is an expensive  but also vibrant and exciting city to visit  The Intercontinental is as good a place as any as a base for 3 or 4 days  It s location is excellent and it has every comfort and amenity one could wish for  Their buffet breakfast is simply awesome  the level of service impeccable  The hotel is starting to get a slightly faded feel and could do with some renovations  but overall it is good  quot value for money quot

Arrived here reasonably late after a flight from KL  Check in was seamless and my room was very nice  lovely furnishings and a comfortable bed  I tried breakfast in the club lounge and in the restaurant and found them both to be fine  Obviously more selection in the restaurant  with a great range of asian and indian dishes  The hotel is in a perfect place for walking around the Arab Street area with lots of great places to eat  Close to my office too which is a bonus Generally service standards are high but I felt a little let down by the cleaning standard in the room which left a bit to be desired  However  the hotel is worth considering given its location and rooms

Intercontinental Singapore is in one of the best locations in Singapore  In the heart of the blossoming Bugis neighborhood  it is walking distance to many sights and attractions  Also  it is conveniently attached through the side door to the fun Bugis mall  which means the hotel is also right at the Bugis Metro stop  It cannot get more perfect than that  We walked a lot of places from the hotel  including little India and the Arabian neighborhood  But we went farther afield by metro  We spent 3 nights in a deluxe club king room  Amenities are outstanding  luxurious bathroom  super comfy bed  nice seating area  plenty of closet space  simply super luxurious  With a Club room  A full buffet breakfast was included  including daily tea  which is equivalent to a light lunch  and canap? s and cocktails every evening  which equates to a relaxing light dinner  We walked a lot after these cocktail hours  but we never actually ate more dinner  The canap? s were sufficient  And delicious  While this may seem super pricey upon first glance  what we usually do  and did indeed do this trip  was prepay our hotels  club rooms and get the nightly rate much  much lower  We negate the risk of loosing everything due to an emergency that might keep us from going by buying an inexpensive travel cancellation policy and go with peace of mind and get to stay in the rooms we want at a more affordable rate  When you do the Intercontinental Singapore Club  you can eat breakfast in the club room or have more choices in the full restaurant  We chose the full restaurant every morning and did not regret it  although the Club room itself is beautiful and afternoon tea and evening canap? s  cocktails were always well presented and delicious  They even have dessert items in the club  Another amenity we used daily was the swimming pool  Beautiful  nice size  and lots of comfy chaise lounges  It was located on the 4th floor as was our room  so very easy access  But no room was too far from it  The lobby at the hotel was one of the prettiest we have seen with food service and cocktail service as well  The grounds are compact but well designed and full of nice landscaping  In summary  we can highly recommend this hotel  Service is wonderful  rooms are luxurious and nice size and sleep quality was 10 10 for us  We hope you enjoy your stay as much as we did

From the moment we pulled up in the taxi  the staff at this hotel treated us like royalty  Every single one of them was friendly  polite   incredible service We had a club room which was huge   huge bed  huge bathroom  fantastic view  The club lounge was fantastic  a nice quiet place to take a few minute rest before heading back out The location makes it easy to walk everywhere  but public transport is on the doorstep if needed  The room and the public areas were all spotless and well maintained  Would love to return

I stayed with my wife for two nights in late February  the room was lovely and very large and aside from having to move from a smoking room to a non smoking room  as per our booking request  everything was in order  The bathroom is large and the shower is great  the bathroom has both a bath  a separate shower and lots of bench space   There were plenty of food options within the hotel with many more in the shopping centre right next to the hotel  The hotel food is of very good quality and presentation but typically pricey  for light meals or snacks go to  Aromas  which sells coffee  muffins  pastries  bread etc and they have lots of deals which work out very cost effective  The train system can be accessed from the shopping centre next door and the hotel is very convenient to the freeway system making transport to the airport or Sentosa very easy  The only real negative is that service varied from great to average with this lack of consistency a minor detraction from our otherwise great stay

Heading says it all  we were lucky to spend 4 nights at this hotel in a club room  The service was terrific and all at a great rate  I received a quote direct from the hotel which was better than anything online  When we arrived everything was terriffic from our luggage being delivered to the room without asking our name to our check in at the club lounge  then once we had a drink they took us to a room  and what a bed  Towels changed 3 tiimes a day  great food in the lounge all the staff were great  only down side is the drinks in the Victoria bar were a bit expensive  but I think that goes for all hotels in Singapore  Would deffinately stay there again

We arrived from the Uk at 07 00am Singapore time tired and a little weary  The staff on the reception were pleasant and efficient and within 10 minutes we were escorted to our room which was a bonus at that time of day  We had booked a Shophouse room which was well appointed and very spacious and comfortable  It had everything we needed for our stay  The only slight downside was that the tiles in the bathroom were a little tired and detracted from the overall ambience of the room  This was a minor point and one that didn t trouble us to much  The hotel itself was well placed and right on top of Bugis junction shopping mall which made access to the MRT a breeze  This made navigating around the city simple  The breakfast at the hotel was excellent with a huge choice to eat and excellent service  there could simply be no complaints on that score  We did not eat in the hotel or enjoy drinks there as we wanted to experience the city and to be fair the hotel is not the best cost effective option for food and drink  If I was returning to Singapore I would have no hesitation in returning to the Intercontinental and I would be happy to recommend the hotel to others

I stayed at Intercotinental Singapore for 1nights on 1st of this month It was wonderful and memorable stay for me I reserved a shophouse suite room on Priority Club Rewards PCR  website As I m ambassdor member of PCR  the room I stayed was upgraded to ambassdor suite room It was very big  129? ?  and clean King size bed was really comfortable It looked out of Merlion and skyscraper in Sigapore  It was very nice view Club lounge was renovatied last year  It is located on 2nd floor It was very big   It s maybe more than three times club lounge of Intercontinental hotel in Japan Two computers English version  were equipped at club lounge Location is very good  I went to Long Bar at Ruffles hotel  It was cloth to Intercotinental Hotel is connected with MRT Bugis station directly What made me impressed was helpful staff When I went sightseeing they gave a good advise Especially  chef concierge Al and Anita staff at club lounge took good care of me My return flight to Japan was very late I was at a loss what to do after checking out the hotel Anita suggested me I go shopping cloth to hotel and enjoy tea time and evening cocktail though I had already checked out  That was good help for me I  ve stayed at several Intercotinental hotels   for example New york  Boston  Toronto  Hong kong  Japan Singapore I like the best  I m looking forward to staying again

I sometimes get a choice of hotels when I go to Singapore and my first pick is always the Intercontinental because of my priority club privileges  The location is very convenient for everything  but then again Singapore is not so big so everything is convenient really       There is an  quot old style colonial quot  feel to the hotel and the rooms  The standard rooms are quite spacious but recently I have been staying in the  quot shop house quot  rooms which are very big but off in that they are within a shopping mall so you see into the shopping mall and the people shopping can see you  Also  the shop house rooms are somewhat far away to walk with luggage particularly due to some stairs The food is excellent but overpriced  The location is very convenient for shopping  dining and various other entertainment  sim lim is 10 minutes walk  raffles and chijmes is 5 minutes away  food court and movie theatre in the shopping mall etc etc  The rooms are great but the value is relative  I have paid more when staying near the convention centre for an equally good room and I have paid less when staying further away from the hub bub in a similarly good room

We haven t quite got to the point of deliberately flying through Singapore on our way to NZ just to use the Intercontinental  but we definitely bear it in mind  A super hotel   service is second to none  decor charming and ethnic  in fact  it hardly looks like a hotel at all   and it is spotlessly clean  We stayed in a  shophouse  room on the way out  and the Intercontinental Club floor on the way back  and both rooms  although different sizes  had the same standard of decor and facility The concierge and team are excellent   over the years they have found me suitable places to buy a cheongsam  kimono and diamond   and all members of staff are geared to make your stay the best experience possible Breakfast is the  Olive Tree  restaurant  and served until late  with a variety of dishes  On our return visit  they were in the middle of a customer satisfaction survey   the service was exemplary  We were allowed  on checking out  to leave our bags with the concierge until 8pm that evening  when he then organised us a taxi to the airport  Similarly  they are very responsive to a request for early check in  We like the proximity to Bugis Junction  and to the markets at the rear  The MRT station is a short distance from the hotel  which means exploration of Singapore is very easy  The Intercontinental is one of the best things about Singapore   I look forward to my next visit

Had a stay here over Christmas and thoroughly enjoyed myself  The new club lounge on the second floor is one of the largest and nicest of the Intercontinentals I have stayed at recently As an Ambassador member  I booked a club room and got upgraded to a suite and no problem was too small  Food was excellent and the location and proximity to restaurants and MRT was great  recommended

Arrived at 3am for a 2 night stay  Flight out of Sydney delayed 4 hours  Arrived zombie like to be greeted with a big smile at reception which was seamless  Booked a Club Shopfront room  Was upgraded to a Suite which was a welcome surprise at check in  All staff were wonderful  friendly  amp  helpful  Lobby is beautiful and the breakfast and cocktails in the Club lounge were excellent  yes  cocktails not simply beer  wine and other spirits served in other Club lounges   The 3rd floor is undergoing Renos and was closed  Clearly any issues in relation to rooms being tired have been addressed  Location is great  I don t think I would stay elsewhere on my return  It was faultless

stayed there for 2 weeks as IHG ambassador member  excellent location downtown  subway station half a block away underneath  not cheap  but none of the top hotels in Singapore are and comparing it to the Conrad Centennial  def more value and charm at the IC  Love the architecture and deco too  bit colonial yet very chique  Room deco could use a slight update with a modern touch  Staff was with one minor exception excellent Will stay there again if back in Singapore

We have just returned from 6 nights at this hotel as a 40th wedding anniversary trip  amp  was very impressed with the hotel  The staff are all excellent  informative  amp  welcoming We used rewards points for 3 nights  amp  paid for 3  amp  were a little disappointed that we weren t upgraded to a club room as my husband is a platinum cardholder of their IHG group  however we were given use of the club lounge  amp  I must say it is the best I have stayed in  in the Asia Pacific area  The colonial atmosphere  breakfast afternoon high tea  amp  evening cocktails make this place quite special The hotel is located in a fantastic position with most attractions within walking distance or a short cab ride away  The bathrooms are in need of an update but the rooms are very clean  amp  serviced promptly daily  would definitely stay here again All the staff from the doorman to those in the club room were excellent  amp  it was lovely to see the 2 special needs girls who wielded the vacuum cleaners with skill in the hallway of our 8th floor with their lovely smiles each afternoon  well done management Room Tip  we had a corner room overlooking the pool on the 8th floor  No issues with noise  A bonus was that t   See more room tips

Recently stayed here for 4 days  Even though we were upgraded to a room above the  basic   the room felt a little dated and not to the high standard of Intercontinental hotels in other parts of the world  Nevertheless the room was still nice and our friends were in a very nice room on another floor  Not sure if the hotel is undergoing a general upgrade of rooms However  what is fantastic is the lobby  It is huge and really well appointed  with big comfy chairs etc  The breakfast buffet is also great and worth adding to your room  The hotel pool is also really nice and a welcome relief given Singapore s humid weather  The hotel is located just around the corner from Raffles and is also reasonably close to other attractions  but then again everything is in Singapore  Overall  this was a great hotel  although dropped 1 start  as I ve had  quot nicer quot  rooms in other Intercons around the world

Our second stay at this Intercontinental and we were even more wowed than last time Located beside the Bugis Junction shopping centre it is well placed for dining  sight seeing  shopping in the Marina Bay Area  Although an older hotel it is still kept in pristine order and all the staff go out of their way to acknowledge you no matter what there position We had a  shophouse  suite which is a charming annex to the hotel representing a slice of Peranekan culture  looking into the shopping centre  We also enjoyed access to the executive lounge staffed by a team of genuinely lovely people who went above and beyond to ensure you were not only looked after but happy that you chose this hotel over the numerous others in Singapore The lounge breakfast is as detailed as the restaurant with eggs made to order etc and everything you d expect from a full buffet  The English breakfast tea is a must  TWG brand The evening cocktails is also a highlight in the lounge  with constant table service and substantial food offerings  There is never a feeling that time is up and you have to go This hotels location is one where you can walk to many surrounding shops and attractions  but being beside the Bugis shopping centre and MRT station is so convenient This hotel made our holiday even more special  and for that I say thank you Intercontinental Singapore

We usually stay at the airport hotel when we transit in Singapore  but this time we wanted to take a few days and let our toddler see some of the sights  We chose the intercontinental almost at random and boy did we get it right Firstly the staff were brilliant  Our check in clerk even came with us to our room to see if we wanted to get a rollaway bed or whether the cot would be big enough for our two and a half year old  it was   The room was clean and a nice size   even with a cot there was plenty of space  The shower was hit and powerful and there was both a shower cubicle and bath tub which is always nice My only gripe was that the coffee I got when we checked in ended Yip costing me over  14sg  over ? 7   Still I have no doubt that s just par for the course in a Singapore hotel sOverall we ll certainly go again and wouldn t hesitate to recommend it to any friends or family who visit Singapore

I travel with my 2 kids  The room was nice  amp  clean  Once my son got into the room  he requested to take a bath  The bathroom is big which has a tub  amp  shower place  Single Bed is big enough for an adult   a kid  Which is so comfortable  The swimming pool is not so big  is enough  Staff is nice The best is the location  amp  the hotel attached with a mall  so that even is raining you are still dry  The mall has so many variety of food  amp  shops  Wish we can stay longer

This is a beautiful IHG property with character and excellent service  The rooms were spacious and comfortably appointed  The staff super friendly  the lobby lounge was an idyllic place to relax after a busy day out  and the club lounge was very posh  especially for afternoon tea and cocktail hour   Numerous shopping malls  bustling  in the evening  Clark Quay  and many other attractions are all within short walking distance The only thing that almost ruined our experience of this beautiful hotel was noise from the attached Bugis shopping centre  On the first day  the non stop mall chatter and pipped music were tolerable  the non stop  pop  live music on the second day was wearing on the nerves  then to top it off  a contractor decided he had to do some work with power tools well after mall hours  Complaints to hotel management eventually quieted things down after midnight  There was a nice personal note of apology from the hotel management the next day  I appreciate business must go on and we can t have everything our way all the time  Unless you are totally unbothered by noise  I recommend asking for rooms NOT facing the shopping centre Bottom line  with the right room  this is one very nice hotel for the money in Singapore Room Tip  Don  39 t get a room facing the shopping centre See more room tips

We came directly from InterContinental Jakarta  It was a huge change  We had booked a Club room  and therefore should check in at the Club Lounge  A lady from the front reception asked us to follow her to the Club Lounge  As we rounded a corner  she said that the door about 40 meter down the hallway is the door to the Club Lounge  and then she disappeared  When we reached  the door  it was locked  We knocked on the door and after a few minutes the door was open  The lady who opened the door said disparagingly  that this was only for guests with a club member keycard  The whole check in took place unprofessional and superficial The superficial and sometimes arrogant performances from employees characterize InterContinental Singapore Our welcome gift as Ambassador members was an advertising paper bookmark  I would suggest better not give anything When we checked out an Arabic Ambassdor member checking in  He got a tiger doll as a gift  It is not because of the doll  we can live without the doll  but I do not like the different way to treat guests The fitness center is the hotel s biggest minus  It is the most unhygienic gym I ve seen at any hotel  Some treadmills   machines have defects Treadmills and other machines are not cleaned after use  The sweat just dry the naturally way  On most machines you can smell old sweat and and you see a thick layer of dust around  Fitness room has only beach towels available  During exercise  your only option is to put the big towels in unhygienic machines The hotel is generally okay  but without impress and below average for InterContinentals

We have stayed in the Intercontinental in San Francisco and liked it  so decided to try Singapore  Before we went  we joined the Ambassador Club   so worth it  It s  200 per year and has many benefits   be sure to check that option out before you book  We stayed 6 nights  so the room upgrade we received easily paid for the  200 fee  We arrived without Singapore dollars  and only Visa which taxiis in Singapore don t accept FYI  The door man paid the cab   no fuss no muss   the cab fare went on our hotel bill  We were greeted by a smiling young lady by the name of Claire   She was awesome  We were immediately given a room upgrade from a regular room to a suite or we had the option of a  quot Shop Room quot  for VERY little extra  I had read about these on Tripadvisor and several people found them superior to the rooms in the main hotel  So I looked at it and decided that our 7th floor suite was much nicer and had a great view  I would advise you to check out the shop rooms as I think it s a personal preference  Of course the views are better the higher you go  the rooms look out over the pool  towards the front courtyard of the hotel or over the back to the Bugis Mall All of the views are interesting  We arrived early and our room wasn t ready  no problem  they kept our luggage and it was in our room by the time we returned to the hotel We had access to the Club Room   a lovely relaxing spot for tea and goodies in the afternoon  hors d ourves and cocktails in the evening  In fact  there was so much delicious food that a couple of times we didn t need to go out to dinner  They also had breakfast available  probably quieter than in the main dining room  We chose the full breakfast option  and glad we did    the selection and quality of food in the main dining room was unbelievable so we always ate there  The hotel rooms were old world charming not glass chrome  modern so it that s what your re looking for this hotel is not for you  The rooms had huge windows with lots of light pouring in  there were black out curtains if you preferred it dark   The furniture was traditional and the beds were comfortable  Every evening when we came in  our bed was turned down  there was water on the bedside table and the lamps were turned on   how welcoming The concierge was extremely helpful with maps and hints on what to do  The location of the hotel was in an area called Bugis  it was very close to all the sights Chinatown  Little India  Arab Street  the hop on hop off bus and the metro station  easy to get to the airport   Everything was within walking distance  The pool was great  not too busy and big enough to have a decent swim with lots of comfortable loungers around to relax and soak up the sun  There is also a work out room  which we didn t use   It looked like there was a good selection of equipment and someone in there to help you if you needed it  There was also a sauna  male and female  which we did use  We loved everything about this hotel and would highly recommend it to other travelers Room Tip  I would always tell people to ask to see their room before accepting it  I find hotels are general   See more room tips

This was my third stay at the InterContinental and I have to say it continues to impress  Service is impeccable  The furnishings are comfortable and elegant  The club lounge is great   certainly one of the best  if not the best  that I ve encountered in a hotel anywhere in the world The Bugis location is very convenient and centrally located within Singapore  This is a solid choice   you won t go wrong staying at the InterContinental

We spent one day in Singapore and were thankfully choose the InterContinental Singapore  We arrived at 8am and upgraded to the Shop House room for immediate check in  The Shop House room came with all day lounge access  breakfast  tea time  and happy happy hour  which ended up being well worth the extra cost of the room The newly renovated room itself was spacious and very well appointed  It balanced the historic nature of the shop houses and the luxury of a modern hotel The concierge  Arnie Rivera  helped us pick out and reserved a table for us at dinner  The rest of the hotel staff was very attentive to our needs and helped us make the most of our short time in Singapore Room Tip  Upgrade to the Shop House rooms  The club access makes it worth the additional cost See more room tips

A short mid week break took us to this hotel  we would normally choose the Holiday Inn on Orchard but price took us here for a change We booked a shop lot room with the lounge access for breakfast and evening cocktails The room was just a nice comfortable size with a comfortable king size bed  The wifi in the room was fairly fast although it did seem to drop out now and again  The tv is huge with plenty channels but this also seemed to stop working now and again  this may be due to the signal rather than the tv The lounge is a nice relaxed area  and the one thing we enjoyed was the lack of children in the evening  compared to Holiday Inn   The staff are very attentive and deliver a real quick service  The breakfast is limited but this is down to space  and if you require more choice you are free to eat in the main area downstairs  My wife used the lounge all day to do some work  and the staff could not have been more helpful  providing her with extension leads and other cables to make life easier  The evening cocktail session provides plenty of choice  although the choice of snacks is limited compared to the Holiday Inn The location on the edge of the shopping mall is great and only a 5 minute walk to the MRT station and all in AC  Parking is provided and free of charge although it seemed a bit of a saga to get out trying to present tickets in the right order etc with out any instruction or person to help The only down side I would say was the current refurbishment going on  it did not create much noise  but did make for a long winded route from the entrance to the room  this is only temporary and we will consider staying again Room Tip  Pay for the best you can affordSee more room tips

We came to Singapore as a weekend stop over before heading on to Bali  I tend to stay in IHG hotels around the world on business  so this was a logical choice in terms of a known product  They were doing some renovation whilst we were there  but it didn t really impact out stay  we just couldn t use one of the lifts to our room The hotel is really nice and comfortable  but the only downside was the shop house room we were given  which looked in on the shopping mall below  This seem kind of quaint to start with  but it wasn t when we were looking for an early night  as they stay open quite late and then crash crockery around until about 1 00am getting ready for the next day Nursing jet lag and crashing crockery do not go well together  Otherwise  fully met our expectations and the staff were fabulous

Over the years I have occasionally stayed in this great hotel in Singapore  The experience last week topped it all  An extremely friendly  knowledgeable and charming lady received me during check in and that made my day  The positive experience continued throughout the stay while interacting with other staff of the hotel  Congratulations to this great team  The location is central and lots of shopping and dining in walking distance from the hotel  Gain the ambassador status at ICH group  if it makes sense for you

I have personally visited lots of hotels in lots of different cities around the world This time i was with my family and it just so happened to by my baby s 6th birthday and to my surprise we received a beautiful birthday cake  card and a present    I was also impressed by the standard of the food and the professional attitude of all the staff    Thank you intercontinental singapore for the lovely 4 nights we spent I highly recommend this hotel

Good value for a 5 star hotel in Singapore  Using one of the hotel booking sites we got a good deal for a deluxe king room with breakfast included   At check in we were allocated a corner room which was a little more spacious  The colonial inspired decor may not appeal to those seeking a more 21 century styled hotel but we found it comfortable and relaxing  The hotel is undergoing renovation updating but we were not effected by any noise or inconvenience  The breakfast buffet was good but if you are on a budget there are less expensive breakfast alternatives  Asian and western  to be had in the many eateries nearby The location is excellent being next to Bugis St and the MRT station is only a few steps away  From there it is possible to reach many parts of the island with ease  We were highly satisfied with our 5 night stay Room Tip  Ask for a corner room ie at end of corridorSee more room tips

I stayed two nights with a friend at this wonderful hotel  Upon arriving we were greeted by the best and the most kind receptionist  We got upgraded  I m a Platinum Ambassador  to a Shophouse Club Room which is a very nice room  The Intercontinental Club is huge and the breakfast is extensive  Make sure you make time for the afternoon tea and the cocktail hour Location is perfect and pool is alright  I m definitely coming back  best IHG experience so far

well where do you start   i stay at Intercontinental s in Australia and whilst they have great service the Singapore intercontinental is just a level above it is an old hotel but all round very clean and well maintained serviced we stayed in the shophouse club suite and would highly recommend this level for a few extra dollars  breakfast  high tea and afternoon canapes where all of a very high standard with a great selection of food and drinks the level of attention to detail from all the staff we had the privilege to meet from the guys replacing the light bulb in the hallway near our room  the valet guys  reception  cleaners and the waiting staff was absolutely top of the game everyone of them contributed to our very memorable stay  the ladies at the club lounge are an asset to this hotel thankyou all for our very memorable experience  we will choose this hotel again on our next visit Room Tip  club shophouse suites we found a great choice and would not choose anything else next timeSee more room tips

The intercontinental is a great hotel for either business or pleasure  I stayed in the low wing  not the tower  and the rooms were beautiful with the traditional wood plantation decor yet fully modern and comfortable  The breakfast buffet was top notch and plentiful and the service was excellent  The bar area downstairs was never over crowded  and had excellent service  But to me what made this hotel especially unique and enjoyable was that it directly connects to the Bugis Junction Mall   a large  indoor  glass roofed shopping Mecca for locals and tourists alike that winds through for seemingly miles  All the modern shops you would be familiar with but also local ones as well  As I was there on business  having this convenience was particularly convenient  And the food court is a bazar of local cuisine to delight the senses  It s in a great neighborhood  the same one and just a short walk from the overpriced raffles hotel but close enough that you can still visit there for their famous Singapore Sling cocktail if you choose for a evening  You are however  quite a way from the marina area and the river walk quay but a short affordable taxi can take you here in minutes  I highly recommend the Intercontinental   it mixes modern comforts with the traditional colonial history and still has a local flair

The hotel is located in a very convenient part of Singapore and the staff is wonderful  The breakfast in the morning was very good  with pretty much everything you could fancy  The renovated rooms are nice and well maintained  the older rooms in the wing which has not been renovated could do with some refurbishment  Would definitely return if I was in Singapore for work again Room Tip  New rooms in the renovated wingSee more room tips

From the moment I arrived  I feel welcomed  there was this one nice lady that helped bring my bag to the receptionist  the receptionist was also friendly  The room was big and spacious  especially the bathroom  Their bed was one of the most comfiest bed I ve ever slept in  I had a very good night sleep  The location was perfect  connected to Bugis Junction and just across from Bugis  and Bugis Street  where they have 24 hr Mcdonald s if you re hungry late night  They also have pool and jacuzzi  wish I could try have some lunch at Olive Tree where they have 1 for 1 promotion  Overall  one of the best hotel I ve ever stayed in  top notch  Room Tip  Higher floors offers great view of BugisSee more room tips

I came back again and it is as wonderful as ever  I stay every year at least once  The service and the staff are great  The rooms are so spacious and well appointed  I got a great upgrade for my Platinum membership  All in all it was just so nice to be back  I am looking forward to returning and finding out what they are doing to the Olive Tree restaurant Room Tip  Shop house rooms are quaint but not really my cup of tea  All the rooms are lovely See more room tips

I took my family to Intercon for my birthday weekend  This hotel is great  It is beautiful  luxurious and the staff is excellent  My wife and kids loved it  The loved the breakfast the shopping next to the hotel and the restaurants around it  We spent one afternoon by the pool and we really had a great time  They gave us a room upgrade and because I have a Intercontinental Ambassador card we got a 4pm late check out and our flight was at 8pm  So everything was just perfect  Awesome job Intercon

Enjoyed our stay as a family at the IC  The staff were very helpful  provided an extra bed for our children without cost  The breakfast was fantastic every morning and the kids ate for free  6yo   Rooms were clean  lobby beautiful  shopping very close by  We stayed our subsequent nights as the Marina Bay Sands but honestly wished we were back at the IC  Thanks for a great stay

A beautiful old world hotel right in the heart of a shopping districtRooms are very well appointed and large as you would expect from any intercontinental hotel with all the the added touches to ensure your stay is comfortableThe quality of the bed and bedding was fantastic complete with a pillow menuMRT is close and convenient Would stay at any Intercontinental and know they will be of a high standardHighly recommended

I was in this Hotel for just one day  short trip  The hotel staff is very good  amp  co operative  I did an early check In morning 8 30 AM  amp  they really made it possible by 9 30AM which is appreciated  The breakfast was really good  amp  the room service was also prompt  Good internet speed  overall though a single day stay but was comfortable  The location of the hotel is also very good  amp  lot of places are easily accessible with in the vicinity

Amazing stay in Singapore  The hotel did not disappoint  My hubby and I went for the club lounge and enjoyed multiple cocktails in the evening  This is in the Top 5 hotels we have ever stayed  The rooms were spacious  Lots of varieties at the brekkie buffet  I only ever review places that have made a great impression or was horrendous  none so far   and I will go back to this Intercontinental in a heart beat Room Tip  Upgrade to club lounge See more room tips

We stayed 8 nights and loved every minute of it The rooms are comfortable and spacious  it is a beautiful property in a great location We paid extra to upgrade to the Club Lounge  the best thing we could have done I can say this is one of the best hotels we have ever stayed in and the reason I say this isTHE STAFF      the staff are the best  Excellent all of them  good old  fashioned service and so friendly

This hotel is superb   was recognised for my IHG membership status and received attentive service following an overnight flight from Paris  Our room was prepared early and we were given access to the Club lounge for a small additional fee  We thoroughly enjoyed our stay and would stay again  Our room was spacious with a very comfortable bed and we could simply not fault the service The hotel is next to the Bugis shopping mall which can be accessed directly from the hotel it is also close to MRT station

Stayed 9 nights 3 weeks ago and loved every minute  Great character to this beautiful property in a superb location  Excellent staff and service  MRT steps away which provides easy access to entire city and beyond  Walking distance to lots of interesting areas like Haiji Lane  Bugis area  Singapore is a great  safe city to walk around  Make the most of it  Nice spacious room  Tasty multicultural breakfast  Not the cheapest hotel but this is Singapore so spoil yourself  Stayed in Singapore many times and this is the best location so far  Special thanks to duty manager Gisella

We arrived here on our honeymoon having reserved many months in advanced and were given an awful room  bottom floors with an awful view  We asked for another room but we re not given a semi adequate room until the third room we were shown  The hotel is somewhat old and could use some remodeling  Service was bad as they had one concierge for the entire hotel which meant long waits and not much help  Overall I think there are better hotels for the same price range in Singapore
