I ve stayed at this property on multiple occasions since it opened

Our stay at The Intercontinental in Singapore was a real delight  The hotel was undergoing refurbishment at the time but that didn t detract in any way at all from the quality of service  the attractive luxury of the rooms and the appreciated quiet  Add to that the hotel s proximity to one of Singapore s main shopping hubs  Bugis Junction   not that shopping interested us in the slightest  and the MRT which makes access to virtually the whole of Singapore an absolute breeze  and you have a hotel which has a considerable attraction for the discerning tourist  We are regular visitors to Singapore staying at different hotels each occasion and I would rate The Intercontinental as one of the best I have stayed in    arguably  it has the very best shower I have experienced with excellent bathroom amenities and cleanliness  The rooms are large and inviting  the bed was very comfortable and room service was on the ball  We didn t eat in the hotel because we prefer the local restaurants whether expensive or basic both of which abound in the area but I m sure the hotel fare would have been quite tasty if a little expensive  My only gripe was that the hotel did not have any decent live entertainment like a piano player or a small combo  However  I was assured that at the end of the refurbishments which are due to finish shortly  live music would be brought back to the Lobby Lounge which would make having drinks there very enjoyable  As it was we were able to have a leisurely 10 minute stroll to the Blu Jazz Cafe round the corner in Bali Lane  which provided excellent jazz music I will certainly be staying at the Intercontinental again and recommend it highly Room Tip  Choose a high floor room  above level 6 See more room tips

I have stayed at this hotel on numerous occasions and  although it s not the most modern  it has a nice charm about it and it s in a very convenient location However  on this occasions  the hotel was under substantial renovations and chose not to advise before made my booking  To get to my room  I had to walk through a rabbit warren of corridors and cart my luggage up stairs  After arriving into Singapore at midnight  this was not an expected or pleasant experience  especially as an IHG member I will give it a go again but will absolutely confirm there are no renovations

Do check with the hotel is it s still under renovation  I booked the hotel to stay in late April  has checked from Tripadvisor that it s under renovation since 2014 so I thought it could have been finished but the fact is no   our room still has drilling sound during day time and the smell of toxic painting that came through air con in the morning  Of the price we paid for  we could have stayed at other properties with better conditions  A few good things about the hotel is 1  location   just next to Bugis station and shopping complex 2  Service of all hotel staff was very impressive 3  Breakfast    they have very extensive breakfast buffet with freshly squeezed juice  and international food styles  very satisfied with breakfast quality Room Tip  Ask if they are still under renovation  If so  suggest you choose other hotelsSee more room tips

My husband and I recently had a three night staycation at InterContinental Singapore to celebrate our wedding anniversary  We had our wedding at the same hotel three years ago  When I made my reservation  I indicated that we were going to celebrate our anniversary When we entered the room  we were greeted with rose petals lining the path from the front door to the bed  On the bed was a lovely  quot swan quot  made of towels and a plate of chocolates with the words  Happy Anniversary Mr  and Mrs    quot  written on it  Also placed on the bed was a card with a lovely message written by a Guest Relations Officer Alicia Ho Mei Hui  We would like to thank Alicia and her team for arranging such a lovely surprise  Unbeknownst to me  my husband had also ordered a bouquet of flowers to be delivered to the room  which was placed on the bed together with the swan  As I am an Ambassador member  we were upgraded to a King Business deluxe room and enjoyed two pieces of laundry done for free each day  Fruits and mineral water were also provided each day  The room was spacious and the bed was very comfortable  The room had an old world charm but it is in need of renewal  Our room 1303 had a connecting door to the next room so we could hear quite clearly which television programme the next door occupant was watching  which fortunately didn t go too late into the night   The night curtain wasn t the black out type so the room wasn t very dark after the curtain was drawn  The air vent in the bathroom looked a little dusty  The lamp and the television in the room were slightly lopsided and the wallpaper looked rather dull  Also  the ledge in the shower stall was too small so we had to place our bottles of shampoo on the floor  I read from some other reviews that the hotel will be undergoing renovation this year  We look forward to staying in a refreshed room during our next wedding anniversary

Location is superb  easy access to shopping malls  heritage and local sites  Well connected with local transport  Good location for shopping  Building is very beautiful with British colony feel  Fall asllep at the lobby because it is so comfortable  Breakfast is every extensive and delicious despite how tired I am  I will made a effort to wake up early to eat  The hotel and surrounding offers many culinary options to you which give u a headache what to eat  Very prompt check in  porter and concierge are extremely helpful  Hotel guest have free parking service  Being a IHG member  I was spoilt with many benefits and one of them is I m given a room upgraded and it is amazing  The limited edition soft toy really made my family crazy  Room and beds are comfortable  I was given late check out too  How thoughtful they are  WI FI is well connected  Only disappointment is the room is painted recently and the paint smell is still very strong and was not informed beforehand  Lucky I bring my mask  Compliment to FO Darren    he is very caring and thoughtful  Those ladies is grey uniform can be more proactive and real   701

Asked to moved as bed was shocking  sunk in the middle and toilet didn t flush  got moved  the room was in the same state as the last one  at least the bed was better  Fridge was not really cold  couldn t adjust  Booked for an extra night by mistake  would not refund  again disappointing was a genuine mistake  said I had a discounted rate  I don t think it was worth  20 a night savings Location was great  handy to everything

I stay at Intercontinental every time I am in Singapore  The hotel is conveniently located in Bugis Junction  close to MRT  shops and walking distance to Chinatown  raffles City and Clarke Quay  Service is always great at the hotel  Sadly on this visit there were a number of things that were quite iritating 1 Extremely slow internet connection  often unable to stay connected 2  Beds really need to be replaced in the hotel  they sink down in the middle  The first time I experienced this I thought it would be an isolated incident  however after many stays I realise that the majority of the beds are like this  Not good for someone with back and neck pain 3  Television signal kept freezingOverall I would still recommend the hotel to others because the pros do far outweigh the cons

First time I have stayed at the Intercontinental Singapore  nice hotel  very charming and currently under some renovation work  although I didn t hear any noise once during my stay  5 nights  The executive lounge was good although I didn t really make full use of it  the usual mix of business people and holiday makers wanting to take as much advantage of the food and drink on free availability as possible   Was given a fantastic upgrade room on the 16th floor  way too big for one person but most welcome  I will be back next year to see the finished upgrade project

My wife and I spent 7 nights at the Intercontinental Singapore the last week of April  This is a hotel we have visited almost every year for the past twenty years There is something  actually many things  that keep us coming back  From check in to check out  every part of the hotel experience is exceptional  We booked a Club room and on arrival  late at night  the staff was waiting to escort us to our in room check in  The whole process took less than 10 minutes  The room was beautiful  We request a similar room every year and they always have one ready for us  The hotel staff are well trained  helpful and professional  The staff in the Club deserve special recognition  They provide a great experience during their cocktail hour every evening  Ana Lau was a very special part of our stay  We were fortunate to know her from last year and she provided excellent advice and suggestions about interesting places to see in Singapore  She also made sure every aspect of our stay was perfect  which included a birthday party  Nice  She is truly an asset to the hotel and we looked forward to seeing her in the Club  We were also very happy to see Peter Kan is still working as Lobby Ambassador  We met him on our first stay at the hotel when he was in Club Manager  He is a wonderful man with a wealth or knowledge about the hotel and about Singapore  He always remembers us and before he left for some time off he stopped by our room with a gift  We think of him often and wish him well The hotel has one of the best locations in Singapore  There is a lot to see  do  eat and shop within walking distance  If you choose to go further  there is direct access to an MRT station without going outside  If you don t know about Singapore s MRT you should be aware that it is inexpensive  fast  clean  safe  very easy to navigate  and about everything most subways are not  We love it and never take taxis  However  if taxis are your thing  they are reasonably priced  honest polite drivers and again  everything most taxis are not  The InterContinental Singapore is as good as it gets in a city that has so much to see and do we never get tired of it  We look forward to our next stay and we send our congratulations to General Manager Tash Tobias for maintaining high standards and providing an excellent guest experience Room Tip  I enjoy a pool view See more room tips

It is absurd that they advertise this hotel as 5 stars given how run down and dirty it is  On arrival  it looked fine  but on getting to our room their  quot signature quot  room as they called it  we were appalled at the level of filth and general decay in our room  Tons of mold in the bathroom  wallpaper peeling back  unidentified sticky  stuff  on the floor of the bathroom  the wooden floors incredibly damaged  etc  It was like staying in a subpar guesthouse in or something  not a five star  four star  or even three star hotel I immediately went downstairs to complain and to their credit  they gave us a new room  The new room was better but still not even on the same planet as a five star room  See the photos I attached to this review  There is no five or even four star hotel in the world that has conditions like this in their rooms  And please keep in mind that this was the room they switched us to by way of apology for the first room  which I didn t take pics of unfortunately   This is the room they viewed as good enough to mollify guests upset about the level of dirt in another room  What the heck We encountered similar levels of gross dirt throughout the hotel  including  most offensively of all  in the breakfast area  where the base of the walls were literally almost black with dirt in places  The wallpaper is dirty  The door to our room was dirty  Everywhere you look it s dirty  scraped up  dented  and shameful  I ve got nothing else to say about this hotel because all we could think of was trying to avoid touching things  and that completely ruined any positives it may possess  It s outright fraud to advertise this hotel as a five star hotel and it s clear there is essentially zero quality control from either local management or oversight from InterContinental brand management

What a disappointment in Singapore  I arrived in Singapore after 20 hours of travel  While I requested an early check in  the reception could not secure a room and offered me to take a shower at the SPA  The SPA was dirty and untidy  so I requested a room to be made available  I got a smoking one  only ones left   The room was smelly and not terribly clean  The breakfast was good and the hotel is very well centered  As renovation were going on  the gym was not accessible and the hotel was relatively noisy

Checked in this hotel with my family for a staycation and we were impressed with the excellent service right from check in reception  Had requested for early check in while making reservation though we understand it was subject to availability  Was thankful to be given free upgrade to junior suite  The room was spacious and clean  We also checked out the swimming pool at Level 4  Though not big but was ok  Overall stay was great especially the location  It is linked to the shopping mall so after our swim we just went down to do some shopping  Would definitely recommend this hotel

We chose this hotel because of it s proximity to lots of places we wanted to visit on our 11 night holiday in Singapore  We are first time visitors  We also booked to have the Hotel Intercontinental Club Lounge facilities included in our booking  Wonderful staff looked after our every request  we had full breakfasts  high tea each afternoon and evening drinks and canap? s  which were more than enough to feed us  included every day of our stay  The food is beautifully presented  you have so much choice and the staff looking after us were meticulous in their service  so welcoming  helpful  and thoughtful without being intrusive  We loved every minute of our stay and can t speak highly enough of our accommodation  Singapore is a fabulous destination  There is an incredible array of retail shopping at our door  Bugis shopping centre  plus the MRT is very close by  and under cover all the way to the trains  so you can go anywhere in Singapore very easily  We each bought a 3 day pass to travel on the MRT and buses for  20 plus a  10 refundable deposit  It made going anywhere so easy Our room  341  was quiet  The KS bed   oh so comfortable  Our room was serviced twice daily  we had endless bottled water provided by the hotel  Really  we could not think of one bad thing to say about the hotel and it s staff  The pool facilities are lovely  although there is only room for 22 people to have a lounge to lie on and some more chairs around tables   However there was never a day where we didn t have a lounge to lie on when we went for a swim in the afternoon The bathroom facilities there are very clean  they provide as many towels as you need for the pool near the pool and the pool was so clean  We will tell everyone to stay here as we loved it

The location near Bugis Junction is absolutely perfect    not too far from the tourist mecca of the Bay  but not too far from all of the city centre activities and museums  offices etc  Check in was fast and Kelvin was so kind in escorting me to the elevator  and personally dealing with my IHG requests  He also called once I had got settled to make sure everything in the room was too my liking   Great service tip   My bags were promptly delivered to the room  which had plenty of space  was very clean  except the concierge   hotel manual    which had pen marks  scribbles and grubby finger prints  and the office chair  which seemed to have bodily fluid stains      and comfortable  The bed  as others have noted  needs a good mattress flip every few weeks as it seems to have dips on either side  But linen is comfortable and there is a great smart TV Bose sound system  the first Bose system I have experienced in a hotel which actually has radio presets that work  Beat that  Sofitel    The telephone system is new and very helpful  except that operator calls can sometimes take quite a while to answer    Internet was fast and I had no problems whatsoever  Housekeeping worked hard to replenish everything and change towels  turndown etc  Although there were no turndown chocolates  or even putting a sheet on the floor with slippers etc  Bottled water was moved and extra brought in though  So  yes    room was very good and had everything I needed Because I had plenty of meetings in the hotel the next day  Kelvin and Alicia on reception worked hard to create a custom pricing package to facilitate bringing extra guests into the ClubInterContinental lounge  which was really appreciated as it made my life a lot easier  These two are utterly fabulous  On the few times I had problems at reception    generally from other  less experienced  staff  Alicia or Kelvin swooped in  remembering my name  room number etc   and facilitated my request within seconds  They are the dream team  And  on the rare occasion I needed the concierge  the guys on the desk there were also very helpful    even if one kept playing on his smartphone  One quick thing  much of the time the concierge desk was vacant  so try to catch them when they are actually available rather than hiding  I had a few meetings where I didn t want to use the club  so tried the Lobby Lounge and Victoria Bar  Olive Tree was closed for renovations   Lobby Lounge service is pretty patchy and can be really shoddy  As a very sizeable IHG shareholder  I felt embarrassed to have my guests experience some of the staff during breakfast one morning  No one seated us  or even greeted us   and I had to manually get someone over to serve us and take our order  They didn t understand what a  pain aux chocolat  was  and even when I said  chocolate croissant  they still looked confused  Our drinks came 20 mins after we ordered  only two coffees and a diet coke  and no pastries    After 40 mins  my guest had to bring someone over to ask and they said that they only had chocolate danishes  which are  of course  pain aux chocolats    in fact  there is technically so such thing as a chocolate danish   So 50 minutes after ordering  the darn things finally arrived    but they weren t warmed or anything  Just bog standard  cheapo pastries  No gesture to remove it from our bill Anyway  we then wanted some water and again had to catch someone s eye  They seemed confused when we asked for the black label IC bottled water  and I had to explain about three times what we wanted  Pretty ridiculous  They delivered the water but only two bottles  not the three we asked for  They came back with an extra one  but no glass  Christ    How hard is it to bring three water bottles and three glasses  Doesn t exactly require an MBA  Anyway  once my guests had left  and who themselves commented on how poor the service was  I approached the manager  Henrik  and sternly told him off about this  It s seriously embarrassing for me to have guests disappointed in the venue that I invite them to  Henrik was apologetic and sent a fruit basket up  also removing the items from my bill  He handled it well and was very polite and enjoyable to talk with on my future visits to the Lobby Lounge  a nice guy  I guess it s waiter tress training that needs to be improved Victoria Bar was better    The greeter welcomed me but when I asked for a newspaper  she just pointed towards the rack rather than going to get the New York Times for me  as I asked about  The waiter also said the bar bites were very small and that I should order multiples  which turned out to be unnecessary  Food was good  however  Club area had a few scuffs and tears on the furniture  though overall a very nice atmosphere and design with attentive team members  but the cocktail range could really be improved  They should definitely have a full bar  rather than a small number of premixed cocktails    especially if one of their events is billed as  cocktail hour   Other comparable hotels in Singapore  e g  MBS  Shangri La  Ritz Carlton etc   have a full bar with professional tenders Anyway  rooms and food were both good    as were some members of the hotel team  Location is fantastic and the pricing is pretty good  Sometimes the hotel is more expensive than other  more high end  hotels such as the Mandarin Oriental  but it s still in my top three for Singapore  I ll be returning again soon   Room Tip  Opt for club  or choose a renovated room grade See more room tips

We had a few days before leaving on a month long Asian cruise and were extremely pleased with the InterContinental  It was convenient to many nice restaurants   as well as the lovely restaurants and lounge in the hotel itself  Also great for shopping with a huge mall just outside the hotel  Our room was very comfortable and the concierge was very accommodating in supplying us with a electrical converter  Overall an enjoyable stay in beautiful Singapore

Intercontinental Singapore is located very conveniently at Bugis junction and the hotel has access to a mall from inside  Staff is very courteous and helpful  I was given an early check in without any hassle  Overall a pleasant and comfortable stay  Two things that might be a problem and the management may consider for improvement   there are no electric sockets near the bed head  Very inconvenient if you want to put your phone on charge on the nightstand  Second current renovations could use some sound proofing However  the second  I was given to understand would be over very soon  And as i said earlier  the entire experience was comfortable and smooth  Will definitely consider staying here again Room Tip  please check if renovations are still on and if they will disturb youSee more room tips

The hotel is old and is now being refurbished  so its a noisy place to stay  but worth the money due to its excellent location and availbility of everything around 10mins walk from the hotel  The elevators are half shut and it takes some time to go up and down during peak mrng hours The Club Lounge is a very good place to hang and have your drinks and good value for money  The Breakfast resturant and Gym is under revovation and has been relocated  Gym is not so nice for now but new one should be up and running soon  Breakfast was a little dissapointing as being a strict vegetarian by religion  i could find just 2 or 3 things from the hot food menu  The selection of cheese is limited  more food choice is needed  Also the Chef should be requested to keep the vegetarian items separately so that people dont use the same tongs for picking up veg and non veg items  The rooms are pretty run down due to the age  but are in good condition  The bed have to be changed as they have become uneven and cause you backache  the pillows and duets  sheets are excellent  Shower area needs through cleaning as some place its black and mouldy If you want to avoid construction noise during the day comming to your room  then its the place to avoid Room Tip  Choose rooms on higher floor for now to avoid construction noice  Try and get a renovated floor roomSee more room tips

A short staycation to celebrate my birthday with my love one  However the stay was not very pleasant due to the renovation going on  Renovation was said to start at 9am to 6pm  drilling continue even at 6 30pm   Couldn t take our afternoon nap and have to get up early the next day because of all the knocking and drilling  Shall say its not a very peaceful stay

I found my stay here thoroughly relaxing  Stunning building  very clean room with lots of useful amenities  club lounge was a nice was to spend the evenings before we left the hotel for some pre dinner cocktails  Lovely designed rooms  amp  comfy big bed  Service was quick  pool area was great for an inner city hotel  Well connected to transport and shopping malls  Only downside was the long walk from the lift to our shophouse suite  In the club lounge after ordering a glass of Malbec wine when we arrived  the lady remembered this the following day along with all my other preferences for food and drink  every need was attended to and the service was so quick and efficient  Thoroughly enjoyed my stay here and would recommend Room Tip  Shophouse Rooms are coolSee more room tips

Service  breakfast and rooms were all very good  Seems to be cheaper than some of the other 5 star places in this area  Would recommend the club room deal  Great decor in the lobby and live piano music in the evening If you re going to splurge  this is a good choice  The only thing you may may want to consider the views  It s not quite as impressive as staying some way at Marina Bay  for example

I booked this hotel because I m platinum member for club reward My room upgraded to junior suite  which I feel fairly huge and comfortable   Although the agraria toileteries is not premium size as what I use to get in other intercontinental hotel  Overall room presentation good  comfy bed  shopping mall n street view  For club lounge  breakfast selection is good  yummy  come with mixture of Malay  chinese  western foodI particularly love the fresh green saladI get to enjoy fabulous afternoon tea in clubounge as wellMost of the staff are nice  approachable Good  Sure will return

I ve stayed at the InterCon Sing before and it has a great location right in the middle of town  But what I really love is the service  All the staff from the Front Desk onwards are great  I managed to leave a small laptop in my room when I checked out and in just a few very polite and helpful emails  it was back with me in Hong Kong by courier  The hotel doesn t get my five stars right now because it is being renovated  although it didn t affect our stay  but I am sure it will get all five again when it is finished  Its also reasonably priced for a downtown Singapore luxury hotel  I ll be back Room Tip  High floor for peace and quietSee more room tips

We arrived at the Intercontinental the posh way by being picked up at the airport and met at the arrivals even before customs  The journey was very pleasant and upon arrival was met by guest services and taken straight to our room  I was pleasantly surprised by the large comfortable bed and room which allowed us to sleep very well  On finding that Bugis Junction is now under cover and air conditioned  we were even happier of our choice of hotels  The night market of Bugis Street continues to delight I can safely report  Hotel services were impeccable and the concierge services were top notch  They even help me print my boarding passes  Will return to this hotel next time I am back in Singapore

Stayed there for 4 night for a business conference  The location was quite convenient  I actually quite like the style of the hotel i e old fashion and local  I stayed at the floor 12 and the room has whatever you can expect but you can feel the wear and tear The breakfast was not to bad but the food from room service was quite mediocre Also I came across the problem with WIFI  It has a nice Gym as well I was originally checked into a corner room at the 8th floor however I asked for the change of room immediately moving in as the room is filled with strong chemical smell  I then moved to 1224 which is much better however I started smelling the same after the 3rd night   I would assume that it would come from refurbishment  So better not stay there until the renovation is finished Last the turn down service in this hotel is not up for the 5 star levelOverall it was not too bad but I am not sure whether I will return to not

I stayed at Intercon Singapore for one night during a quick trip to look at suitable conference hotels  Intercon Singapore is a quaint  colonial style hotel with lots of history and in a fantastic location  providing excellent service  I stayed in a  quot shop house quot  room which was large and beautiful colonial style with opening doors onto the shopping street below  The hotel and location offers plenty of character and colonial history  lots of eateries and shopping on the doorstep  The bed was heaven  and room extremely well appointed  with large and beautifully appointed bathroom  fast internet  Staff were at hand on every turn to offer their service  I love this hotel  it on my list of favourites and I hope to return for a leisure visit

Great hotel  Location is very central  and if you brave the humidity you can walk to many of the landmarks But what makes this hotel superlative is the staff All are good  but the team in the Club Lounge  and their manager are exemplary  A class above Nothing is too much trouble  and every little detail exceeds your expectation When we return  we will be staying here Excellent

We were in Singapore for 5 days and loved our stay at the Intercontinental  We arrived at 6 30 am and were not sure if we would be able to check in  Mr  Craig Hodgson welcomed us to the Intercontinental and he made sure we were able to get a room before the regular check in time  Mr  Hodgson also greeted us several days later by our names and he gave a departing gift to my daughter  He was very helpful with all the questions we were asking him  Mr  Hodgson made a difference during our stay in Singapore  Thank you Mr  Hodgson  We loved the location of this hotel  It s walking distance to many locations in Singapore  The rooms are a little dated  but the hotel is in the process of renovation  Breakfast was well done  It s a good mix of Western and Eastern foods  Thank you to the lovely lady who makes the Chai for breakfast  Can t remember her name  but a lovely addition to the staff  She was always smiling and very polite We look forward to our next stay at the Intercontinental

From the moment we made our entrance to the hotel superb hospitality was rendered to my husband  amp  myself  Despite refurbishment in progress it did not dampen not impede our stay at the hotel  Partaking of drinks at the Victoria Bar was a highlight of our stay  Excellent service all round by the most experienced  amp  friendly staff  Rooms were most comfortable  amp  clean  Also very well serviced by friendly staff  The location in the Bugis area was an added bonus  with the most punctual taxi service  I would highly recommend this hotel in all aspects

I just finished a trip to Singapore  during which I stayed in this hotel  but only for one night The hotel is conveniently located within the city  not too far from the business district  but also close to the Marina Bay area and the old city  5 minutes walk from Raffles  The welcome in the hotel was very warm and friendly  I got my usual upgrade and the room was quite spacious  Not much of a view  but that s because it s a relative low building between high rises  Ready for a beer I went to the Victoria bar  This was slight disappointment  Other than the rest of the hotel  was this a quite dark and boring place  Then you better stick to the grand lobby bar  with its high ceilings and plush sofas  This is also where breakfast is served  which was excellent  I had dinner in their Chinese restaurant  Quality of the food was fine  but the atmosphere was cold  as was the temperature   and both my starter and main dish came at the same time  The staff here was also not the best in the hotel Over all a pleasant experience  hotel wise  For dinner and drinks  excl  breakfast  I would go outside next time

I booked this hotel for my mum and my daughter for a staycation on 30th May 2015  I had my wedding dinner here 10 years ago and it was a wonderful experience so I wanted my daughter to experience this hotel too  However  it turned out to be a total waste of money as it was such a disappointment  what s worse is that my daughter was really looking forward to a great experience in the hotel as I had been telling her many good things when I stayed here 10 years ago The check in staff told us that he would give us the Heritage Room and assured us that my mum would like it a lot Who knew that the Heritage room would be  quot  heritage quot  in all sense of the word Pros   friendly and polite staff  comfortable bedCons  very old room with extremely scruffy floorboards  Almost every inch of the floorboards were badly scratched up  Really in need of new floorboards   toilet tiles were stained with a weird red stain   toilet bowl was really dirty  unless you are very tall  you couldn t reach the shower head to turn it the right direction as the shower head was pointed to such an angle that we had to stand really close to the wall in order to shower air con was making weird loud noises at night  room faced the main road and my mum and daughter were kept up at night with the traffic sounds  did I mention the very scruffy floorboardsTotal waste of my money booking this room  Wonder if all the rooms are like this now far cry from when we stayed here Will not recommend this type of room to anyone  would be too embarrassed to Room Tip  Definitely don  39 t choose the heritage rooms if scruffy floorboards are not your type of decoSee more room tips

This is a great hotel though undergoing renovations  These are noisy but timed to avoid peak morning and afternoon periods  The work is being done in Tower 1 and our Club room was in Tower 2  somewhat away from the jack hammering  The room itself was extremely comfortable  though there was no exterior view worth commenting on  as it was situated on the 2nd floor  Combined with a very comfortable bed and pillows  big classic bathroom with separate shower  the  necessary  very quiet and effective air conditioning and the staff throughout the hotel were universally considerate and always willing to help  The hotel is well located next to Bugis Junction  which provides relatively straightforward access to the mrt and buses Would definitely return  especially if in a Club floor with access to the Club lounge Good balance of amenities  comfort and location  Highly recommended

Stayed at the intercontinental in an executive club room for 3 nights on returning from Gallipoli cruise  The rooms are very spacious and well appointed The club is well worth the additional cost  With breakfast included and high tea served in afternoon each day followed by canap? s and drinks in the evening  The staff in the club are of exceptional standard as is the entire staff throughout the hotel  Close to shops and market places ideal location

My family enjoyed our stay at this hotel  The food was great  staff were friendly and can t beat this location  It s close to the trainstation and on the way to it  to many food choices too   We had also use the hotel service to pick us up and drop us to the airport  We have free wifi because we have membership

I was fortunate enough to stay in this hotel as we had several events in their ballrooms  All transactions over email went smoothly  The marketing events department were very accommodating  Thus  all events we held in this hotel went smoothly and was quite a success The hotel room I stayed at was big and the bed were comfortable  The best part was the option of what kind of pillows you would like to have on your bed  I stayed here more than once  and there was one incident wherein there were noises above our floor  The staff took action immediately trying to figure out where it came from and solved the issue The afternoon tea high tea period were always great to relax a little in between meetings  They served a great spread of appetizers and beverages Now  I m a breakfast person     and their breakfast buffet spread is AMAZING  There are enough choices but not too many  I was always satisfied every morning after eating at the breakfast buffet Overall  I HIGHLY RECOMMEND this hotel for any kind of traveling in general  even for solo travelers if you want to take a break from the backpacking experience  They have excellent service  great location  and good amenities Disclaimer  I stayed here several times in 2012 2013  but it s not in the list of  quot when did you travel quot  Room Tip  Do ask to be placed at the new wing or the renovated rooms See more room tips

Stayed for two nights with my family at the InterContinental Singapore Hotel  The hotel is very well positioned in the heart of Singapore  linked to the Bugis Mall  a fantastic place to shop and the hotel is also amidst the shopping streets  The hotel is an old colonial mansion designed in a romantic architecture to give you a feel of elegance  The hotel was under renovation and you could  if you are unfortunate and placed in the wrong room  hear loud construction noises between 9 30 a m  to 18 30 every day  I hope the renovation finishes soon    Despite the above  the Customer Service of the Hotel was excellent     the Check In  amp  Check Out Process was efficient and quick I was particularly impressed with Mr Ummar  who despite he was not feeling well the day we checked in  he gave the best ever service and I could only remember rare matches to him  The other staff are all excellent and they exceeded way far my expectations when it comes to the Service Excellence  there are those who aged 70 years old and above and still give you the impression of excellence which appealed my family even more    The complimentary breakfast was below my expectation though for an InterContinental Standard while it is currently being served in the cafe temporarily  well set up   The Cafe is excellent area to have a sip of Tea or Coffee  Finally  the concierge were excellent and could advise me to every single matter I needed about Singapore and I salute the hotel for having such great people working with them   I would definitely stay at this hotel when I come back to Singapore  after the renovation work is over ofcourse  Room Tip  Try to avoid the staying at this hotel during renovation time  otherwise the Hotel should be your fi   See more room tips

Stayed last week  and we were put in a room similar to the one last year   2 single beds on the higher floor  room 1212 this time  facing Swissotel Stamford Hotel and we were also able to get a glimpse of the Marina Bay Sands Hotel from our room  Everything was perfect and we have enjoyed our stay  although the radio in the bathroom was faulty Staff were all very friendly and helpful  especially the ladies at check in out and we were also given complimentary parking  2 complimentary bottles of water  and a plate of fruits were provided in our room this time  We were informed that they were having some construction work in the hotel from 9am to 6 30pm each day  but we did not experience any issue during our stay  Our room has both a bathtub and walk in shower stall  with modern amenities Pool and Fitness Center were newly renovated since our visit last year and look nice  Even though it rained on and off during our stay  the shopping area and restaurants were all within covered walking distance so it was all good  We will definitely stay here again for the service  value and location

We spent two nights at this hotel in transit  The hotel is central to several iconic locations  e g  Bugis Street  Raffles Hotel  and Marina Bay Sands  The hotel was good enough  The rooms were spacious and the bed comfortable   I slept like a log and hardly ever do on a new bed  The staff are generally attentive  although curiously when I asked the concierge for directions to the nearest  night market  to try some local cuisine  I was sent to a little local restaurant  Given the  we discovered after the fact  that Bugis Night market was literally around the corner  I was somewhat baffled by this advice  The buffet breakfast is very nice with a good selection of hot food  continental  and fruits etc
