Being an ambassador member has its advantages when booking into an Intercontinental hotel  We were upgraded to a large room on the second floor not far from the lounge and also had late check out until 4pm  The hotel is going under some renovations but we didn t experience any noise nor funny smells  The gym is finished and it looks very nice  Breakfast was quite varied and good quality  Professional and attentive service from all staff  The hotel is very well located just a few meters from Bugis  The only thing I noticed was the lack of lifts on the second building  which may be an inconvenient for some    I would definitely return to this hotel  Renovations are estimated to be finished mid next year

I have stayed at this hotel several times This hotel is very well located and just a few meters from the buggies mrt station where you can connect easily with other metro lines  The beautiful building provides a romantic caribbean ambiance not comparable with the new high rise building where other hotels are located  The service quality is surreal making you feel like in a palace Room Tip  Request the room type and add special request at the time of making your reservation  They will the   See more room tips

Stayed for 3 nights on a holiday  Quite conveniently located with shops and restaurants nearby  The hospitality was great  The staff were very friendly  Taxi service is easily accessible and the bell boys are prompt in calling a taxi  It is also very close to Mustafa   Little India if that is where you want to do all the shopping  The hotel itself is quite well maintained but probably needs renovation since the look and feel is a bit old  which may be intentional   The views from the room windows may nor be all that great  depending on where you get a room  Besides  it is a a bit far away from Sentosa if that is where you want to spend most of your time  But we stayed there with our three year old and overall  were very satisfied with the stay

We stayed for a 3 day stop over on our way to Europe and return  We chose to stay at club level and we were allocated a shop house room  The hotel is absolutely delightful The service is friendly and extremely efficient  The club lounge is elegant and relaxing My wife had her birthday on our return and she will always remember the wonderful way she was treated The rooms are comfortable and spacious  There is excellent shopping nearby and a short walk to raffles place I do not hesitate in recommending the hotel Room Tip  shop house room  absolutely delightfulSee more room tips

We stayed here for about one week at approximately  200 ni  Guest services was top notch  Room was clean  decorated nicely  spacious bathroom w  separate tub and shower  great toilettries   Elemis   Location couldn t have been better with Bugis MRT AND shopping mall right there  Loved that the Bugis Junction had a small grocery store in the basement level   we got lots of snacks and drinks there  Loved the complimentary pillow menu service  Professional babysitting service was fantastic at  10 hr   15 hr after 11pm  20 transportation   Felt no worries whatsoever when babysitter arrived  so glad husband and I were able to have a date night out in town  Pool was great w  fresh towels always available  Fitness room was ok  machines weren t being wiped down after each use and there was nothing there  spray bottle  towels  to do it yourself Other than that  highly recommend for families w  children  Would go back there again

I stayed here towards the end of March 2009 for two nights  able to get a special weekend deal through the Intercontinental website for about S 245 nett per night for a deluxe room including buffet breakfast and a late 4pm checkout subject to availability The hotel rates in Singapore have come down a lot recently and for a hotel like this  it represented a good deal Service at this hotel was great from start to finish  The room was very well appointed and comfortable  Even though the hotel opened in the mid 1990s  my deluxe room was still in very good condition  The room itself was quite spacious but I had a twin bed room because the king size requested was said to be unavailable and my room was probably a little less spacious than might have been the case  The rooms were definitely highly soundproof The lobby and lounge area were very spacious and relaxing  very nicely done  Best to look at pictures rather than read descriptions The breakfast selection at the Olive Tree was varied and the food tasted good  I quite liked the sense of spaciousness in the Olive Tree and as a result  it felt quite private I tried the swimming pool  it was nice and also had a bubble bath spa area The hotel is located directly above Bugis Junction and can be accessed from the shopping centre  The centre caters for all the shopping needs a person could probably want and includes a supermarket and bookstore  The shopping centre itself has a great range of eateries and across the road  there are even more  Also  the MRT station is directly next to the shopping centre and so is very close to the Intercontinental  There s also a taxi stand just outside the shopping centre  Overall  I couldn t fault the hotel location The only complaints I d note were that my king bed choice of room was not available and I was given twin beds  which I d imagine would be slightly less roomy  Also  the 4pm checkout was subject to availability and I was given a 3pm checkout  Lastly  I guess my room view wasn t that good  being obstructed by a few columns that prevented any clear views Overall  I thought it was a good deal staying here over the weekend

I stayed at the Intercontinental Hotel in Singapore for one night on 18 January 2009  This turned out to be one of the best hotel stays I have had  Check in was exceptional  Fast  efficient and most importantly friendly  The check in staff have small talk down to a fine art  with the ability to make the guest feel  well  at home  From reception I was escorted to my room by a customer relations officer who introduced me to many of the hotels facilities on the way  Customer service second to none The room itself was very comfortable  Size wise one of the largest single rooms  L shaped  I have stayed in with dining table and a comfortable lounge area  Spotlessly clean with welcome fruit and the usual letter from management  My favourite feature remains the  quot pillow menu quot  from which I selected the lavender infused pillows    I should also mention that sound proofing between rooms and between the room and passage was excellent  Bathroom was well equipped with Elemis products  which were replenished after my shower on arrival  The hotel itself is located at an indoor outdoor  covered  shopping complex and was close to the subway   a couple of stops from Orchard Road  I would highly recommend this hotel to anyone traveling to Singapore and will stay here again myself whenever possible

We recently stayed at the Intercontinental Singapore for 3 nights  We were hesitating to book this hotel because of its location  On previous trips we had always stayed at hotels near Orchard Road  But I can assure you  after staying at this hotel  it is a better location to be  There is a small shopping mall with a large food court and an MRT station just next to the hotel  The backdoor of the hotel opens directly into the shopping arcade which means that even if it rains you can get food or do some shopping without getting wet  We had booked a standard room at the 7 day advance rate without breakfast  The difference between the room only and breakfast rate was nearly USD 100 00 so that we decided to get breakfast locally in the morning  But as a surprise the hotel offered us an upgrade package on arrival  USD 55 00 per room per night  which gave us a room on the Club floor with access to the Club lounge  which offers a full breakfast buffet in the morning  very good selection  and drinks and snacks throughout the day  The package also includes free internet  via cable  in the room and wireless internet in the lounge  My favourite hotel in Singapore always used to be the Grand Hyatt Hotel  but I would certainly go back to the Intercontinental again  The price difference between the two hotels is usually around USD 200 00 per night  which is definitely not worth paying  If you are able to get the Intercontinental at the same rate as us with the upgrade  it¡¯s fantastic value for money

We could not fault the Intercontinental during our 5 day stay  Our room was overlooking the Bugis Junction and was top quality and very spacious  The service was outstanding and the concierge were very helpful in giving directions  The pool was excellent and towels were laid out daily  The location was very good with easy access to the MRT just a few minutes away

Location  It s connected to a Bugis station with has all the food and shopping right out side your door steps  The metro is also stops at the is location too so it s an easy and direct transport from the airport Hotel  Grand and elegant  First class all the way  Staff  Very friendly and helpful  No one was snoody to us  Rooom  Victorian design with comfortable bed and updated bathroom Value  As expensive as Singapore is  this is really a true bargain Overall  We had a great visit and would love to back here again anytime

Rooms are excellent and of the highest quality  The service is extremely attentive  The pool is open air and first class  The gym is a little small for such a large hotel  I had access to the executive lounge  This is well worth doing as it includes breakfast in this exclusive lounge and there is top quality snacks and free drinks in the early evening  Drinks are expensive in Singapore and so this is well worth the modesst extra charge for the upgrade The hotel joins the Bugis Junction Mall which has mostly teen orientated shops  It is also a main metro station  Across the road are some great local and other Asian restaurants  Cheap and very good  You will get a good inexpensive meal there

Stayed here a couple of times a few years back  I m glad to know that they are doing some major renovations so I cannot wait to go back I loved the location and Shophouse room  Club Intencontinental lounge was very good and food offerings were plentiful  Would definitely return when I m in Singapore again in a couple of years  Cannot wait to see the improvements

I have stayed at the Intercon in Singapore quite a few times and it s not a bad hotel  Fortunately it is undergoing a very much needed massive renovation project  But like many hotels they have decided to keep doing business as usual  This is a mistake  You will be greeted in your room by hammering and drilling noises from 9 6pm  and that s 7 days a week   so no respite even at the weekend  And don t be fooled when they try to tell you that the noise is less when you get to higher floors at the moment they are working on the 7th floor and my room was on the 14th and you can hear everything that is happening all day long  Incessant noise and I m sure if you are closer   there will be dust and smells coming through as well  The restaurant is closed down as well  Lobby   Reception space has been reduced so if it is busy you are practically standing outside the door trying to get in  Overall it is just a pain to be in this hotel at the moment  Best to give it a miss  Don t get me wrong   it is long overdue for a refurbishment as the rooms were falling apart  Let s hope they do a decent job  Including updating their wifi system which is rubbish  I am an Platinum IHG member and have stayed here many times  But I will avoid until at least mid 2016

The Intercontinental Singapore is not only one of my favourite hotels in Singapore  but in the whole of Asia  While the Disney fication of the surrounding Bugis Street area in the 90s was nothing short of a tragedy  this hotel  which sprung out of that project is a brilliant success  It mixes colonial charm with modern facilities  incorporating some of the old shophouses that were prevalent in the area before it was redeveloped  It s attached to the Bugis Junction Mall and metro station  which makes it all the more convenient  As I am an Intercontinental Royal Ambassador I always get upgraded  so I can t speak for the standard rooms  but the suites are lovely  The shophouse suites are in the older part of the building and are furnished in the traditional Peranakan  Straits Chinese  style  What they lack in size they more than make up for in atmosphere  The suites in the main tower  on the other hand  are absolutely enormous  though unlike the shophouse suites  most of the tower suites allow smoking  which may be off putting for some guests  Perhaps the highlight of this hotel is the Club Intercontinental which is in the heritage part of the building and has an elegant colonial era ambiance  Both the breakfast and the Happy Hour are lavish with food of the highest standard   no sense of eating at a buffet that s been mauled by hundreds of other guests here  For those who don t have Club Intercontinental access  the main lobby lounge is similar though on a larger less intimate scale  It serves a reasonable though not particularly cheap a la carte menu  Immediately around the hotel there are numerous dining options both in the mall and across the street so there s no need to starve whatever your budget  I really couldn t recommend this hotel too highly Room Tip  For maximum ambiance select the shophouse suites See more room tips

This is my third trip to this hotel in as many years and it keeps on getting better  The hotel is centrally located and has easy access to all that Singapore has to offer either by getting to the transit  metro  or by grabbing a taxi as there is usually one in waiting  I decided to go to the pool yesterday as I had free time available and I was kicking myself for not going sooner  It is simply beautiful  clean  and well appointed with plenty of chairs  umbrellas  and towels  The area is also serviced ny hotel employees meaning that they do circulate through from time to time to ensure that all towels are fresh  I don t know where to begin with comments about the breakfast buffet other than to say we ve been lucky enough to stay in some excellent hotels  but they ve got nothing on the InterContinental s breakfast buffet  There is variety from around the globe for  mains   superb pastries which could rival a French pastry shop  a juice bar that s to die for  and impeccable service  No sooner are you finished with a plate than it s removed and your glasses  coffe  tea  fresh juice  are topped off The rooms are also top notch  After spending two weeks in Japan  we couldn t wAit to get to the comfortable beds with the blackout curtains for a dark room  The bathrooms are excellent and our upgraded room has both a shower and a soaking tub which are spotless  The closet is large enough and contains a modest sized safe  which I enjoy for passports  extra cash  etc  I would say that there could be a little more drawer space for those of us who thoroughly unpack for ease in transitioning from one activity to another  pool side to getting ready for a night out   The service couldn t be better or more attentive  We ve never had any sort of issue  but rather have felt pampered and well cared for  There are certainly other fantastic hotels in Singapore  but this one has won us over and we will be back when in town  For us  there isn t another place in Singapore offering this much for the price  You can t go wrong here

This hotel is really conveniently located near Raffles and a couple of shopping malls and very close to MRT connections  Dim sum at the nearby Carlton to be recommended The refurbed club house rooms are lovely   although inevitably given the city centre location  views are not great  There is work being done at the hotel so some building noise after 10am in some of the rooms Cocktail hour in the clubhouse is lovely and a good spread for breakfast Beautiful towelling robes  Only 1 gripe  the bar at the pool area was never open and service by phone was slow and rather inefficient All in all a great place to stay

First  the showers are great   I have long  thick hair and was concerned that any hotel I chose in Singapore may not have great water pressure  This shower did not disappoint   The staff are friendly and the public areas pretty  The hotel is attached to a shopping area which is really convenient  There s also huge food courts next to the property  I wish the hotel would have more details about the Bugis in the room as there were parts I was still finding on my last day  I would stay here again

I stayed here for the first time and the experience could not have been any better  From pick up at the airport to the super efficient check in the whole experience was fantastic  The staff are very friendly and knowledgable about all events in and out of the hotel  Concierge staff were amazing  Nothing was a problem and all advise was spot on  Some parts of the hotel are a little dated  but I noticed renovations and painting happening on different floors  but that s being picky  Overall a brilliant experience  will be staying here again for sure

We had a truly excellent stay here  we were lucky enough to be upgraded to a small suite with club access  and the stay was really memorable  The hotel is really comfortable  but the setting is also a very good one  it is close to the Bugis Junction facilities  and to Bugis MRT station  we d come back here whenever we could afford it Room Tip  A suite with club access is really super  but we have enjoyed it when we have stayed just in regular   See more room tips

Stayed at this hotel for 2 nights on business  The service at this hotel is what is expected of an intercontinental hotel  The only let down is that the hotel is getting abit old and the corridors are definitely showing their age  I stayed at a renovated club room and the interior was fully refurbished however the hallways leading up to the room were definitely not the best and what you would expect from a 5 star hotel  To be fair they did seem to be doing some refurbishments so hopefully this issue would be resolved soon The club food and beverage service was fantastic and the breakfast was great too  Was surprised to find that the hotel did not have a Spa service

First of all  we chose this hotel because people said great things about this hotel  But we were really upset during the check in process  we have booked a room with twin sized bed and high level floor  Unfortunately they didn t give the desired room to us at first so we decided to wait for our room  The receptionist  Ms  FG  were being disrespectful and unfriendly  She also didn t gave us the exact time to come back for our room or information about the maximum check out time  she told us after we asked for it   I mean she should have explain it to us  She didn t greet us like the receptionist beside her did to other guest which irritate us  When we got our room  we were lucky to get the new room on the 4th floor even though we wished for higher floor  The room was very nice and i love the classic style  But we had a problem with the bathroom doorhandle  it was broken and they haven t fixed it until we checked out  I don t know either they don t know about it or they pretend to not know because the handle keep falling apart when i open the door and also the door was so hard to be opened  After all  they have really nice mini bar but i don t think the staffs  hospitality is good comparing to other 5 stars or even 4 stars hotel  I d love to if they pay more attention to it

We were booked into this hotel by a cruise company as there was a night between our flight arriving and cruise departing  so we didn t really do any research to compare the InterContinental with any other hotels  That being said  the service was impeccable  the room clean and beautifully decorated  It is in a great location near shops and restaurants and the train station

I have just stayed at the intercontinental with my family for 4 daysBefore we went  I went on trip advisor and there were some negative comments about the hotel in regards to service and also a current renovation I cannot speak highly enough of the intercontinental s customer service and as a hotel in general they looked after us from start to finish  you would never have know that they were doing renovationsI would stay with them again in the future  Great hotel and perfect location to go to everything in singapore

I live in Bangkok and  for the last 15 years or so  I ve been traveling to Singapore two or three times a year  I ve stayed in many of Singapore s best hotels  but after finding the InterContinental about five years ago  I ve made it my home base in Singapore  I ve written several reviews detailing exactly why I like the InterContinental so much  This trip confirms that everything is still super  I find the Club InterContinental worth the tariff  The staff is not only efficient and highly competent  but very friendly and eager to please  Can t wait to return

We recently spent 2 nights in Singapore  I decided to come to a part of Singapore that I had not stayed in for a while  so I returned to The Intercontinental  Good decision The hotel is currently being refurbished so it was slightly disrupted but nonetheless  we were given a very nice room  not much of a view  with a comfortable bed and lots of space for our ever expanding luggage   Singapore was the last stop for us before heading home  The pool area was quite relaxing  but poolside food was not very good   the concierge and reception staff were excellent and the main lobby lounge dining area was OK  nothing special  The Chinese restaurant upstairs was very good Overall  a good hotel

I had a confirmed booking for a non smoking floor but was told at check in that unfortunately  due to high occupancy  they had to put me into a smoking floor albeit with the room refreshed  That wasn t so nice at all as the corridor still had a musty smell No complaints with the room furnishing and amenities and is something expected out of a 5  hotel  A good selection of television channels available  Housekeeping was good The bedding is plush but the mattress is on the soft side  much too soft for my liking Hotel service factor deserves a 5  from check in till check out  Would I come back  I would say that the soft mattress is something that I would seriously consider against  I would rather have a firmer mattress sleeping experience than having to toss and turn due to body   neck ache  Those who have backaches might want to seriously reconsider

We are staying for 4 nights in this hotel and are being looked after superbly  I love the tastefully traditional Peranakan decor in the hotel and the staff cannot do enough for us  I happened to mention that we were celebrating my husband s birthday during our stay and a beautiful  personalised cake arrived in our room  The hotel is adjoining the Bugis Junction shopping Mall  and although Singapore has become a very expensive city this was a great place to shop and just wander  We would definitely stay here again  And although some elements of the hotel are getting a little tired they are currently undertaking renovations

We are currently staying at the Intercontinental in Singapore  On arrival we had no problems and were quickly directed to our room  The hotel currently does have some refurbishment in the works  Unfortunately it was more than obvious that the noise level made our room unacceptable  After contacting front desk we were moved very quickly to a very nice room  The senior manager Chan Teck Heng  Kelvin  is a valuable asset to the establishment he represents  I thank him wholeheartedly for understanding our problem and resolving it as swift as it came  Breakfast is wonderful and the room was cleaned to a high standard

We have just returned from another visit to the lovely Intercontinental Singapore for my birthday  After reading some recent reviewers issues with the current renovations we emailed the hotel with a few questions about this and they answered promptly  When we arrived  we upgraded to club access again its amazing  we were given one of the newly renovated rooms  wow they are beautiful  and I was sent a lovely birthday cake   The Club lounge is just great with the best staff who remembered our breakfast choices and evening drink choices each day and the complimentary afternoon tea is a wonderful bonus especially after a few hours shopping in Bugis  There was the sound of works going on but it didnt effect our stay and the hotel is doing its best to limit any disruption and noise  The pool area is relaxing and quite a few families seemed to be enjoying it we tend to spend a few hours there in the morning before going out and about  The MRT is a very short walk and the newly opened downtown line makes other parts of Singapore even more accessable and Bugis is a great place for shopping and food so the location of this hotel is perfect  Again all I can say is another wonderful stay and I would definitely recommend the Intercontinental for a stay in Singapore one of our favorite cities and favorite hotels will be back again next year Room Tip  Renovated rooms were beautiful See more room tips

I only stayed at the Intercontinental SG for one night and a day  in a meeting   but based on that experience the hotel delivers its 5  experience fully  Location is great  and the hotel has a feel of a smaller boutique than it actually is The room was spacious  clean  well equipped and quiet  The bed and the pillows were perfect  Newspaper was delivered to the doorknob  and the calls to concierge answered promptly The breakfast covered a wide selection of dishes  and I especially liked the wide selection of fresh fruit and dim sum  Service was very friendly  Buffet lunch was adequate if not with quite as wide a selection as breakfast The gym and the pool area seemed really nice  although I didn t have a chance to use them  All in all  a great experience although not a cheap one  Highly recommended

We spent our first two nights in Singapore at the Intercontinental  We stayed in a King Room with an extra bed added for our daughter  The Upside The customer service provided by the staff at the hotel was wonderful  The concierge helped us with various things such as  helping to locate luggage lost by the airline  booking transportation that could hold 5 of us  locating yogurt for our daughter  etc  These things really helped get our vacation off on the right note  We appreciated these extra steps they took to help us The Downside The room size was great  even with the added bed  but the room was definitely in need of an update  I believe the hotel is in the process of updating the rooms but we were not lucky enough to stay in an updated room  The room was comfortable but is reflecting some wear and tear  This was especially evident in the bathroom where there was some issues with mildew  The room also overall had a very strong smell    not sure exactly what that was I would consider staying here again because the customer service was great but only if I was in a room that had been upgraded Tip  There is a Baker  amp  Cook just outside the hotel where you can get a light breakfast and coffee tea for a reasonable price

Stayed here for 2 nights First impressions were of a very friendly and efficient check in  great after a late evening arrival  We were upgraded to a higher floor corner room due to some renovation work going on   we were told there might be some noise between 2 and 6pm but didn t hear or see any  Quick and easy to get to the room  fast elevators  all important with a 3 month old in tow  Lovely room  more of a classic style of decor rather than the more minimalist modern styles you see these days but all mod cons nonetheless Breakfast was great  with the sun streaming in from the skylights in a large airy lounge and a very decent choice of food  Very nice to linger there a while  Gym was perhaps slightly underequipped for this level of hotel but this point might only apply to hardcore gym users  A few treadmills  one bike  one elliptical and some weights machines  Nice pool area on the 4th floor  uses the space very well though not for lap swimmers Another nice aspect is the direct access to the adjoining Bugis Junction Mall  Very convenient to stroll direct from the lounge and into the mall  It s also only 5 mins walk to Raffles Hospital  the reason for our visit  Service was a delight  unfailingly friendly and engaging  Was also very impressed with the doormen for being able to get all our luggage into a normal sized taxi when we failed at the airport on arrival and needed a larger one Hotel may not be slap bang in the middle of the shopping and entertainment but nothing is far in Singapore   would certainly stay here again

We booked a Singapore stopover at the end of a cheap and cheerful beach resort holiday in Thailand  Since it was our 25th wedding anniversary we decided to lash out and spend a bit more than our usual Holiday Inn budget  We have prev stayed at the Holiday Inn Orchard Road and it was really nice but what a step up the Intercon was  We booked a long way in advance and took a punt on a no cancel offer for a club room  It was nothing short of fabulous and worth every cent  The club lounge is quiet  serves a near full buffet breakfast  high tea and cocktails with snacks  The staff were amazing  Professional  friendly  courteous and accomodating  They were very down to earth and made sure our young son had an enjoyable experience  The room was nicely decorated and so quiet  The mattress was comfortable with huge feather down pillows  It has to be said the hotel is not really set up for families in terms of facilities  There is an adequate pool on the roof of one wing but it s no match for the pool and tropical surrounds at the Shangri La or the spectacular Marina Bay Sands  That said  we wouldn t swap  We could not have been happier with the way every staff member treated us  The hotel is a short walk to the Raffles  if you really want to do High Tea in style  and it was a comfortable 1km walk to Singapore Flyer  It cost us  10 to catch a cab to Sentosa Island  There are street markets adjacent to the hotel but if you re going to Singapore to shop then you re probably better off staying near Orchard Rd which is also close to the Botanic Gardens  We wanted one day of sightseeing and one day to relax and be treated like royalty   and so the Intercon was perfect

We stayed at the Intercontinental Hotel from 13th June to 17th June 2015  We arrived at midnight on 13th June and we were welcomed by very friendly staff  Rooms were spacious  amp  clean  Breakfast was fantastic  so much choice  The hotel is adjacent to the Bugis shopping mall which is so convenient and also the MRT line is in the shopping mall  A lovely swimming pool  amp  jacuzzi to relax in after a day s exploring  We took the hop on hop off bus and the bus stop is within 5 mins walk of the hotel  Really do recommend this hotel in Singapore Room Tip  We had a room on 13th floor which had good views of the city overlooking the swimming poolSee more room tips

The selling point of this hotel is the location   ideal for sight seeing  shopping  eating etc  I was able to visit a few places by foot from the hotel  and everywhere else was a short taxi ride  My room was spacious and clean  but very cold   I did adjust the temperature but it didn t warm up  even after nearly 24 hours  My only other disappointment was that I was not given a room with a king bed  which I had booked   and instead was given a room with two double beds

I stayed here for two weekend nights after a business trip at another hotel in Singapore  I was extremely impressed with the quality of the room and service  Upon arriving around 10 AM  we were told our room was not ready yet  but that the room had been vacated and they would rush the cleaning  Not a problem for us as we were heading out for some sightseeing  They immediately offered us some water bottles to take on our tour  They also asked if we wanted to take a shower before heading out  As the hotel was being renovated  they indicated the working hours  apologized and gave us a little stuffed mascot wearing a construction outfit  cute   They also asked about our departure details  We indicated that we were leaving very early and they offered us a take away breakfast bag  The room was very recently renovated  spacious  well lit and equipped with modern amenities  e g   recharging plugs  large flat screen   It had very fluffy pillows and bedding which I found extremely comfortable  It was dark and quiet at night  The windows were not large  and as it was a lower floor  the view was not much to look at  Bathroom was large with rain shower and a separate tub  Single sink  They dried it all off at turn down Breakfast was a large buffet including just about any option you might want  I was impressed that they had actual maple syrup for the waffles  Check out was fast and efficient  and a cab was ordered right away as we were checking out

First time in Singapore and picked the Intercontinental because of location and the fact that I am Ambassador  Was given a lovely updated room  but club entry was an additional  100 per night  which we decided was not necessary  since our room included breakfast  In fact  breakfast was a highlight  Amazing selection  all carefully prepared  Mr  Shuren Ulaganathan  the restaurant manager was especially helpful and informed as we discussed various coffee beans  He even offered to make french press coffee  Staff was very courteous and aimed to please  I highly recommend this hotel  although the lack of upgrade was puzzling

It s an excellent hotel with charming staff  We stayed 4 different hotels in 15 days  This hotel has been exceptionally good  Staff have been very friendly and helpful you feel unique  I loved the breakfast  lots of delicious menu to choose from  Rooms have a high ceilings  nice decor  comfortable beds  Also has a great location  Definitely will visit again  when I m next in Singapore

expectations are always high when you go away  right  we went for a 4 days tripp after visiting Australia and booked InterContinental for grades other travelers had left  We certainly we really got what we expected and will return to the hotel without a doubt    If we look at the whole thing with the staff 5      hotel location with shops train all You need   and that it is quiet in the hotel and outside the 5        large rooms  clean  wonderful beds  great city views stylish staff with the best service You Can get  breakfast        it is even possible to serve such a breakfast    Yes    juices  food  variations  flavors  choices   hahaha we spent over an hour every morning at breakfast and ate lots     GREATEST Absolutely a very good choice for both shorter and longer trips  Do not hesitate to book

First time staying and at the start  suffice to say there was a small mishap when checking in  Duty manager Kelvin Chan took it into his hands to restore our faith in the hotel  and i can say he surpassed our expectations with great professionalism and attitude  Because of this  i not only have renewed faith in IHG but i am very confident i will be back  Once again  my sincere thanks to the staff and Kelvin Chan for one of my best hospitality experiences ever

Visited for a four day business trip which started on a Sunday so managed to attempt some sunbathing by the pool  Lobby  bedrooms and service levels all good  Pool area is a bit lacklustre  with woefully overpriced drinks and a real lack of wow factor  Had a corner room which was large by Singapore standards and amenities more than adequate  Location is pretty good and service is welcoming  A slightly dated hotel but none the worse for it Room Tip  Try for a corner room  pretty large and quite brightSee more room tips

Had great room in the Ambassador section of the hotel and so enjoyed the benefitsof the lounge The hotel is attached to the Bugis Junction shopping complex where there is the local MRT station Centrally located this hotel is a good choice for first time Singapore tourists you can easily walk or get a taxi to all areas taxis are safe clean airconditioned  amp  cheap  Hotel staff know their job and there to please Room Tip  Join the Ambassadors Club and enjoy the benefits as Club members get Club roomsSee more room tips

An excellent hotel in central Singapore  I was treated to one of the recently refurbished rooms and could not fault it  well done Intercontinental  Great to see an older hotel that has figured out how to make the most of its history while providing the best modern amenities  But without question the best thing about the hotel was the attitude of the staff  friendly and efficient  nothing was a problem

This is a really great hotel  Its been recently refurbished  actually still being refurbished but a very good choice for those who are looking for the perfect hotel location  Its in the middle of all the major attractions and attached to a shopping mall and the MTR station as well  The rooms are excellent and spacious  As an ambassador member I was upgraded to the next tier of rooms and it sure feels good  The staff  especially the front desk staff are very friendly and helpful and almost all of the staff remember you by name giving it a personal touch  My only recommendation would be for the breakfast  which was the same every day and I got bored since I stayed there for 6 nights  It lacked vegetarian options apart from the choice of breads and fruits  With that being said  surely my pick if I were to stay again in Singapore

My husband and I stayed at the intercontinental about 2 years ago and we loved it so much that we decided to come back for the first part of our honeymoon  I wasn t disappointed  The staff as always were wonderful  They were helpful and professional in all areas of the hotel  The gym has been renovated since my last visit and I was really impressed with the quality of the equipment  possibly the best hotel gym i ve ever seen  We made use of the club lounge for a very nice  relaxing afternoon tea  I shall definitely stay here on my next visit to Singapore

Intercontinental Singapore preserves the building structure of the old times that gives hotel guests a flashback to the colonial era  Don t worry about the hotel looking shabby because it is recently renovated and it is a luxurious hotel I stayed in the suite and the room is very spacious  The service is great and I enjoyed my stay here I m familiar with Singapore as I used to live there for a few years  However  if you are a tourist and would like to shop till you drop  I think staying in Orchard or Marina Bay Sands  MBS  area would be a better option  The location of this hotel is still at the center of Singapore but it is not walking distant to either Orchard or MBS

We had stayed here about 2 years ago and returned due to our satisfaction last time  We stayed on Club Floor and once again enjoyed friendly  efficient service  The Club Lounge has great selection of food and drink served by attentive delightful staff Hotel is located on Airport side of town at Bugis Junction  It is above the MRT and adjacent to bustling Bugis street market as well as restaurants and shopping centres Room was very good and quite even tho on 2 nd floor  Special mention must be made of staff on Concierge desk On departure we needed to retrieve luggage from storage and asked the lady to arrange this  Instead of waiting for the porter she went to luggage room and retrieved our   heavy  bags and bought them to front entrance  She stayed and made polite conversation until our cab arrived  Very impressive and typifies why this hotel is one of the best in which we have stayed  I might also add that the hotel is undergoing some renovations including the entrance area  You would never know   Room Tip  We have found rooms to be good on each stay See more room tips

I love intercontinental hotels  have stayed here a few times before  Just stayed in it again in July  Intercontinental you still got it  Bed is super comfortable  shower temperature and water pressure is perfect  shower gel  shampoo and conditioners are all great After a long day I just wanted to take a long shower with good shower temperature n good water pressure and some nice product then rest on the comfortable bed Thats what I like about intercom the most i n SingaporeWill def come back at this hote lagain

This was an amazing stay in a refurbished room  The service from all the staff at Intercontinental was incredible  Every little detail thought out and carried out  from the daily room cleaning  to the door staff  to the little things requested from the front desk  Even the Fitness room was great  The refurbished room was one of the basic rooms but it was gorgeous from the lighting to the decor  and the tech stuff  The location next to Bugis Junction and MRT was handy  Also try Little Arab and Haji Lane around the corner

Wonderful  delightful and romantic IHG property here in Singapore  Management and staff are very attentive and caring about all the guests  I have been coming here for 13 years and staff remember me and my wife every time we come  Restaurants are terrific  rooms are cozy and clean and the location is great given shopping and tourist things are so easily reached by foot or by an inexpensive taxi ride  Renovations are underway to replace the beloved Olive Tree restaurant  the lobby and guest rooms  Get ready for even better As a Spire Royal Ambassador  the benefits here are excellent  The club lounge is very nice and the gym is recently redesigned  Special shout out to Hotel mgr Michael Kim  concierge Hock Kim  Peter on bell staff and Heinrik  restaurant manager  And everyone else on staff  Thank you for your continuing kindness over the years  Enjoy

Initially i thought i would want to stay at orchard street  in the big wig hotels around orchard street  but intercontinental surprised me with the peaceful yet conveniently located bugis junction as its location  The hotel is impeccable and quite different from the regular business hotels that you stay in  It s traditional structure  take you back in time with all the modern amenities of today s 5 star hotel  The staff is very polite and prompt  The breakfast was sumptuous and highlight of our stay here  Would recommend this place for any tourist for a peaceful luxury stay  Do shop at the famous bugis street and put on your haggling cap   Room Tip  Away from lift area and on the higher floors   non smoking roomsSee more room tips

I had stayed at the Intercon Bugis in 2012 and loved my stay then  The food  comfort and location were very ideal  It was then a no brainer where to stay when the whole family   all 38 of us  28 adults and 10 children   decided to take a holiday in Singapore  Management did not disappoint in servicing our requirements what with a baby  a PWD  senior citizens with health concerns  and toddlers as part of our party  Staff were attentive and engaging  Shout out to Pamela and Joyce who handled our group  I look forward to going back

I went to Singapore several times and this is the first time I stayed at the Intercontinental Singapore  I find the hotel is more quiet than I expected  The location is very convenient because you can move around with many types of public transportation like bus and train  The Hotel is connected to the Bugis junction and you can go down for shopping and meals  Room is nice and clean but I may expect a bit more on the night bed service  The breakfast is something I like as well by providing local drinks and foods  On the night of National Day  the room I stayed this time can see the firework even though it was only partially  I will go back there again and recommend for people who like happening location

Booked two rooms on the 12th floor  interconnecting  for 7 nights on business leisure trip  Check in was efficient  and guess we were checked in before the official time  The rooms were spacious and so were the bathrooms  Staff were very friendly and helpful  Breakfast at the lobby had a very good spread  we had the city view for both rooms Elevators were very efficient and fast  the wait time was very short  Location of hotel is very central  and in fact you have direct access to Bugis mall  Taxis are easy to get from and to this location and the Bugis MRT is beneath the mall We were given rooms on the 12th floor because renovation was underway in lower floors  towards the end of our stay the noise from the renovation drew nearer to our floor and got loud at times  however work stopped at 5 pm everyday Used the swimming pool once  nice pool good size nothing spectacular Wifi was excellent and TV had a host of satellite channels Room service meals were very good overall a very good hotel Room Tip  Hotel is under renovation  lower floors are renovated  Also choose a floor far from the noiseSee more room tips

I was in Singapore for a little break of 4 nights from Sydney in mid season because of the heat  amp  humidity What can I say on arrival we were so well greeted  The room was upgraded to a deluxe room and what we thought to understand inclusive of the  club access  The room was stunning large with the old fashion feature wow so classy the bedding well ever ever so comfortable with a pillow menu and quite The club well  the food all day from breakfast to pre diner cocktail hour was sublimed Internet could have been better  Once we departed we discover that the offer to the club was supposed to be a package for four nights but not complimentary  we did clearly explained that the way it was presented to us with no amount ever mentioned and with the language factor was removed from the account with an apologies I so loved this hotel  food  location and staff that I cannot wait to return  PS  taske on any type of room of your choice andpurchase the club access for sure  such great value considering you get breakfast  afternoon tea and pre diner drinks and canap?  that is diner by itself Room Tip  have dine rat the different restaurants they ten out of tenSee more room tips

Upgraded on arrival to junior suite with lots of space and extremely well appointed with everything you would expect from 5 star  Offered free laundry on 2 items per day and any other requirements such as fresh milk for tea were supplied promptly without question Breakfast was first class and the staff attitude was first class ReceptIon were extremely helpful with local knowledge and general attention to detail We will choose Intercontinental again as they attain consistently high levels of service Room Tip  Non smoking and higher floors for viewsSee more room tips

A great 5  hotel that is truly luxurious  friendly and stylish  We will be back We spend three days at the hotel on our return from Europe in a King Club room  Definitely the way to go  Superb high tea and afternoon cocktails  Breakfast in Club  as usual  somewhat less exuberant than the main lounge but somewhat quieter  Swimming pool is perfect for little children  but a little small if you need to do laps in the morning  Room on the 12th floor was perfect for us and two small kids  Staff were excellent  Hard to fault anything other than having to pay an extra day for our 7am arrival   paid for 4 nights for  lt 72 hour stay  Would be nice if they could cater for people arriving from Europe  Contacted IHG multiple times w o success so booked the extra day

We recently spent a week in Singapore  and stayed at the Intercontinental  We last stayed 9 years ago  and the Reception staff knew this  and welcomed us as returning guests  This small detail instantly made us feel welcome  especially as we were arriving very late in the day  and were all tired  It was our anniversary  and we were welcomed with chocolates and a message in our room  another nice touch  We stayed in  and can recommend  the refurbished rooms  We stayed as a family  and had interconnecting rooms  which worked very well  Breakfast was very good  with a wide range of choices  The location is excellent  with an air conditioned walk to the MRT  The best recommendation is that  when we return to Singapore  it will definitely be to the Intercontinental Room Tip  The refurbished rooms are highly recommended See more room tips

Unfortunately the hotel was having some major renovation works ongoing so there were a few inconveniences like noise and smell of paint around  The professional staff tries to manage that as good as possible but there is only so much you can do  Having said that we really enjoyed the great hospitality of the breakfast team and the reception team  Housekeeping and the staff on the phone however have room for improvement  Best keep in mind that English is not their native language and have some patience  Once the renovation will be over and the house returns to normal I hope to be able to come back again

I upgraded to the exec club for the week  The exec lounge was amongst the best I ve seen for quality and choice for breakfast  Afternoon tea is good  Staff couldn t do more for you  The gym was decent but pool area could do with a bit of a revamp  Rooms in the exec area were of a decent standard but space for clothes was limited  I ended up keeping my clothes in my bag due to lack of space in the wardrobes

This place easily has the best hotel breakfast I have ever had in the world  I stayed in the hotel for 3 weeks and still didn t manage to get bored of it during my stay The service in the hotel is fantastic  with everyone from the front desk to housekeeping being extremely friendly and courteous  I was staying in one of the refurbished rooms on the 3rd floor which was very large  clean and with great amenities  The hotel pool is fantastic and there is a spa too The only reason the hotel gets a 4 and not a 5 is due to the construction that was going on during my entire stay which happened seemingly at odd hours  evenings and early in the morning some days  with loud hammering and drilling  I imagine this is difficult to avoid when undergoing as much work as they were  but still was a nuisance occasionally

I have stayed at this wonderful hotel many times now and every one of these stays have been a great experience  they just never let you down  The rooms are large and very comfortable and hey have so many different room types that everybody will be able to find a suitable room  I always stay in the Club Rooms which means you can access the lounge for breakfast  afternoon tea and evening snacks  The staff there is super helpful and sort you out whatever your request is  Furthermore the lounge has great meeting facilities  It ca be difficult to decide whether to go to the Club lounge or the Lobby lounge as that is lovely as well  The hotels has several good restaurants and connected to the hotel lobby there is a shopping mall   what more can you ask for     Just wonderfulRoom Tip  Rooms with a view to the swimming pool are nice and bright  but actually I have never a bad roomSee more room tips

I checked in the Intercontinental Singapore late at night after an 8 hour flight  Check in was efficient and I was pleasantly surprised by the renovated rooms  The Club Intercontinental is outstanding with a great breakfast in a quiet atmosphere  Renovations are still occurring so I think because I am a Gold Ambassador I received the gift of a teddy bear which my 3 year old will love  I highly recommend this hotel for business  It wipes the floor with the likes of Marina Bay Sands which is poorly finished  overrated and overpriced

The airport pickup that the hotel provided was phenomenal as we were picked up right at the gate before immigration and escorted quickly and efficiently through luggage claim  Our driver was friendly taking us to the hotel early in the morning   where we were cordially greeted well by the front desk staff  They immediately helped us to our room where the check in was done  Staff was always pleasant and nice with us  When I was wondering the lobby after check in looking for currency exchange  a staff member approached me before I could ask him  and he asked if I required help  The rooms and the lobby are clean  powered well with air conditioning  and has powerful wifi in the rooms  The location is an excellent one in Singapore  with many shopping centers and restaurants beings within walking distance  as well the reliable SMRT  Breakfast was one of the best breakfasts I had in the many hotels I stayed in  I highly recommend this hotel

Booked two rooms here for a family holiday  Received a one level upgrade on one room to the Shophouse suite as an IHG Ambassador  The suite was excellent and the balcony opened out into the shops below  just like the old shophouses used to  All Ambassador amenities were provided and the staff were very quick to respond to any requests  no matter how small  The deluxe room was one of the newly renovated ones  It has been finished to a very high standard although the sound proofing to the adjoining room wasn t ideal and I could hear the couple next door going at it for a few minutes  The club lounge as many have noted was a highlight  Breakfast was excellent  Good spread and quality   however I only ate there once  as there are many local places to eat outside in the Albert Centre  The afternoon tea was also of a very high standard  I will definitely stay here on my next visit to Singapore Room Tip  Lower floors are newer renovated rooms  Higher floors have better views  I would pick the newer room   See more room tips

The check in was somehow polite but very long  20 minutes to get our keys and sign the registration form   The room was ok but not clean by international standards  long black hair on the floor in the bathroom 2 old plastic bags in one drawer   Not that i am checking all drawers and cupboards in a hotel room  but i was after the hairdryer Breakfast food is abundent and ok  and the service courteous but a bit slow We did not want to try the food for lunch or dinner as honestly the image of that hotel had been so damaged to us after the check in experience and the room A very high price in comparison to what you can get elsewhere in Singapore

Reading the reviews for the Intercon there have clearly been a lot of happy clients recently  My overall experience was a little different I used to stay at this property quite a lot  and always liked the Shophouse rooms in particular  I ve considered over the years the property to often be overlooked when people have booked accomodation in Singapore and have  through this forum  recommended that people consider the Intercontinental  With a week to spend in Singapore  and some excellent web rates through Intercontinental Hotels it was time to retest my impressions of the property The hotel makes a good first impression although as in the past the public room layout always seems a little odd to me  In the past I ve noticed that I ve used less of the hotel facilities  bars  eating places  than I do in other Singapore hotels  Oriental  Ritz Carlton  Regent  Fullerton  and I d guess it s because they re rather less obvious and I d argue rather undersold by the hotel My original booking for a shophouse room was extended by one day on the day before my arrival  However when I arrived I was told that the Shophouse rooms  although some were available  were undergoing construction work and therefore would be noisy  I could have one   but I certainly wasn t encouraged to take one  Instead I was offered a move to a Deluxe room  that s a downgrade from the Shophouse  and instead was offered Club access for SGD 80 per day  I coughed and pointed out that this was not a very compelling deal  I d asked about Club access when I d made my original booking and had been quoted that rate  what was the offset for the downgrade  The price was lowered to SGD 50 a day  and quickly to SGD 40 a day  I agreed  although on reflection   and checking the room rates  this wasn t a great decision on my part  I see that other people recommend the upsell to the Club  I found the Club very busy and the afternoon tea having been seemingly descended on by locusts and little space even in the afternoon  I did speak to the Duty Manager and ask them how many upsells they d made and he agreed that the Club was busy  but should improve during the week as the overall hotel occupancy was so low  around 25  he suggested   It did improve over the week a little  but on at least one morning I found myself waiting for a breakfast table and the Club was generally busy  It certainly did not feel exclusive  Personally I think that the hotel  in reaching for revenue is selling the Club access a little too widely and rather destroying the concept Overall the hotel rooms are very pleasant  and the beds in particular excellent  It did seem that staffing was thin  and the room would often not be made up until mid afternoon  and did on more than one occassion need my prompting  Beyond the front desk staff the english language skills weren t strong  unusual in Singapore  which led to more than one protracted conversation with the laundry staff  My recollection of the hotel was of better service and staff  again I suspect that staffing levels may have been reduced given poor occupancy but that s just a guess I found the front desk excellent  but had issues with the Concierge Desk  Again I had a conversation with the Duty Manager  and he clearly showed interest and did follow up  One benefit to the traveller of the Singapore economic issues is that taxis are more plentiful now and the hotel had a good supply on hand  Easy access to taxis is important and difficult at some other Singapore hotels  The Fullerton   The location of the hotel is quite good and the MRT not too far  although it s a little longer walk than a first view of a map would suggest  and certainly better than many other hotels Overall I still would recommend the hotel  although I did miss the Shophouse room and the extra space it provides over the Deluxe  In terms of standards against other major Singapore properties I d suggrest it s near the top of the second tier  e g  Hilton  Hyatt  but a long way short of the more upscale  and expensive  propoerties like the Oriental or the Ritz  If you can get a good deal here I d book it  but I d think carefully about that Club upgrade

I travel to Singapore often and have stayed at the InterContinental several times With the exception of the front desk who always attempt to give me a room with twin beds rather than a single king bed as booked  the stay has always been excellent The rooms are decent sized  clean and comfortable  There is a good pillow menu and the only irritation is the card you need place on the bed asking them to change the linen  Bathrooms are spacious and the water pressure is fairly good  Some rooms do have clogged sinks Food options are limited and are so so  but there are a lot of options nearby  The breakfast buffet is fairly heavy on choice What really puts this hotel on top of my list is the quality of service  with the exception of the front desk   The concierage  the restaurant lounnge staff  room service etc is excellent and always delivered with a big smile  Even a late night request for hot chocolate is attended to immediately and delivered with a warm smile Now if only they could retrain the front desk

Stayed for 2 nights after a two week stay in Malaysia and got a good deal on the internet  Booked a club room which gave us access to the club lounge which was quiet and relaxing  The check in was conducted in the club lounge and we were then shown to our room on the 12th floor  The room was spotlessly clean and looked over the shopping mall  They have a pillow menu so if you are not happy with the pillows on the bed you can choose another type and they will send it to your room The location is great as you can get on the MRT located right next to the hotel and travel to the airport  good if you have suitcases to carry The breakfast in the club lounge is great as are the cocktails and canapes  The service from all the staff in the club lounge is friendly and personal especially from Jane the duty manager  I was so impressed with the hotel I joined the Intercontinental Ambassodor Club  I would thoroughly recommend this hotel

Located 10 mins walk from the Convention Centre Suntec City  head straight down Middle Road and the pedestrian bridge over Nicoll Highway   Arab Street area is around 10mins walk  20mins walk will get you to the river  and 35mins walk to Chinatown and 25mins in the opposite direction to Little India  So not that bad a location  if you don t mind the walking  Taxi fares are reasonable if you don t want to walk  and watch the weather as rain is common in the afternoon  I was upgraded to a shop house room  Whilst nice  with the historic touch   they are in dire need of a bit of TLC  Plaster and paintwork are showing a lack of attention  and not quite what I expect out of an InterContinental property  The shop house rooms are also a bit of a walk from the lobby  and parts of it are not wheelchair  or baby stroller  accessible  if that is a factor for you  Best to clarify when you check in The housekeeping staff are courteous  but for some reason very miserly with bathing soap   I had to ask on two occasions for bathing soap   The front door staff porters are friendly and helpful  Some of the concierge and front desk staff are a bit indifferent The Club Lounge is nice  and well laid out with a lot of Perankan woodwork furniture  Nice ambience  The lounge staff are a bit of a hit and miss  Some are very good  some have probably lost the plot on what their job is  The snacks area during the designated times are usually poorly looked after  so you may need to ask them to bring out more if the plates are empty  rather than the staff reacting themselves to empty plates  Bugis junction and Bugis street are right next door  as is a newly opened shopping centre  as of April 2009   Shopping and eating options in most directions  Suntec city and its shopping area are a short walk away for a range of options  as well as Arab Street and the Raffles City Shopping Centre

We stayed for 4 night at this hotel with our son  The room was nice and the bed was comfy and soft  My husband and son liked the tub very much although I thought it was too high for me to get into  The room was nice and clean and I liked the energy saving feature they had  You needed to put your room card into the slot by the door for the electricity to turn on  So if you are not in your room the electricity is off which I though was so cool  The hotel lobby is beautiful and clean  Taxi service is quick and the concierge was very helpful  Located close to lots of shops  internet cafe couple of blocks down  Mcdonalds  It is connected to a mall which makes it so convenient to get some shopping done and some food although I noticed Singapore has lots of bakeries or pastry stores which is ironic because I heard pastries are expensive there so go figure  I like the clean room  comfy bed and nice bathroom  Least thing that I like is that they had nowhere for me to plug anything in the bathroom  none which I though was odd  They had a weird plug for a shaver but none for hairdryer or hair flat iron  The power is 220V and I needed a converter to get all my electrical hair items to work  No laundry facilities in the hotel and the laundry service cost a fortune  Singapore does not have laundrymats so be prepared to either pay big bucks for the laundry service or go home with your dirty laundry which I did  I was not prepared to pay  4 a shirt for laundry  BTW Singapore dollar is almost the same value as the US

Every member of staff  and I do mean EVERY  you come across in this hotel has a discreet smile for you   eerie but pleasant surprise Hotel has a clean  crisp and elegant feel to it once you step foot through one of the numerous entrances  i e  one going directly into a shopping mall  a main entrance facing the front desk  etc   Pleasant smell to it too The room   standard deluxe with twin bed  single bed big enough to hold two average sized people   In excellent condition  furniture in top condition  very clean  no dust  floor spotless  bathroom too      aircon filter clean  for people with  heard nothing of outside street and neighbouring rooms Last but not least  amazing beds  Choice of pillows  great mattress and duvet Staff was also great    turn down service  room clean up  etc I
