I have stay in this hotel last weekend  From the moment we pulled up in the taxi   car  the staff at this hotel treated us like royalty  Every single one of them was friendly  polite   incredible service  The room is elegant  The bathroom is huge  Don t have anything more to say  you are paying for all of it  Over all it awesome  Will want to stay here again soon

Stayed there for a week in Nov 08  After comparing fairmont and IC  wanted to try IC and was happy  Location   Right above Bugis MRT  Its a 7 min  airconditioned  walk  to the train     Its like the center of SingaporeRooms   Clean  comfortable      Great   Don t have anything more to say  you are paying for all of it Club   Great breakfast  expensive if not included in the club  with a made to order omlette and a lot of variety  Evening   Hors D Oeuvres and drinks with variety  Awesome  Service   Everyone smiles  greets every time you see them  A little too much    Quick to respond and act  Concierge is VERY helpful to provide some insider information   Food   Tried Olive Tree and the Chinese restaurants  Food is good  Food is good all over Singapore

Unfortunately we only spent one night here en route from Phuket to London  You walk into an oasis of calm  speedy check in and whisked up to our room on the 12th floor  Very lovely and spacious  Traditional in design but with all modern touches  We were looking towards the Marina area and could just about glimpse the sea Very well located at Bugis Junction and an internal door with access  Helpful concierge and lovely young men who seemed at every corner to help We had breakfast included and whilst very nice was not spectacular  Stunning cafes etc with beautiful art works  We would not hesitate to stay here again Our only criticism was the lack of a top sheet on the bed  the duvet was just too much for us  However they do offer a pillow menu with a huge variety to choose from There was no complimentary bottled water but actually is is safe to drink tap water in Singapore

I stay in many Singspore hotels but have never stayed in the Bugis area  However I will return to the Intercontinental  My corner room was pure luxury  The reception was undergoing renovation and so first impressions were not that great  However  staff were friendly and accommodating  The location is excellent I really love IHG hotels  Holiday Inn  Crowne Plaza  Intercontinental   This hotel ticks all the boxes  I didn t get to use any of the facilities so can t comment on the pool etc Room Tip  A corner room is much bigger See more room tips

Just finished 9 nights here and it was a quality experience  The Club Intercontinental is worth every dollar  the evening drinks were a great way to finish a busy  and hot  day  Staff service was exemplary  nothing was a problem and everything completed with the minimum of fuss I highly recommend paying to join the Ambassador Club  if only for the 4pm checkout on the last day  It makes the last day a real relax This is a truly great hotel  They are doing renovations but a striving to minimise the disruption  My congratulations to all staff for a true quality experience Room Tip  The separate shophouse wing rooms are quiet and very relaxing    see if a corner one is available fo   See more room tips

We stayed here for 4 nights and had a great experience  The service was very good and all my requests prior to booking such as connecting rooms had been taken care of  As an intercontinental ambassador one of our rooms was upgraded to business  This room was fabulous  recently refurbished with all modern amenities such as computer ports and a very generous sized bathroom  The standard room was also very good  Breakfast was included and was good but nothing special  The hotel location is good and close to all attractions and areas such as Chinatown  Little India  Orchard Road and the Arab district  The hotel is connected to a mall which is pretty average  We had a meal in the Chinese restaurant and it was good but expensive  The hotel has a lot of charm about it and it is for this reason and the good service that I would happily recommend it for a great stay in Singapore

Have stayed in this hotel a few years ago and the hotel is extremely well maintained  The hotel has a wonderful heritage feel to it and is attached to a shopping mall and has many shopping malls and restaurants within walking distance  The reception was warm  friendly and efficient  We love the whole ambience  We had a beautiful shoplot room and we loved the windows with old style shutters that looked out onto the street  The room and bathroom were of good size and the amenities were good and everything worked well  We enjoyed the rain shower which had ample water rushing down  The breakfast and high tea were delicious and of good selection and quality  It is not cheap  but it is well worth the price

I stayed at this hotel for 3 nights 15th 16th 17th August 2015  We had stayed in this hotel last year and it was very nice however this year we were really disappointed  We stayed in a room which gave us access to the club room and its privileges   The staff in the area were great and they made us feel very special  The accommodation on the other hand was appalling  I have never written a bad review as I have always stayed in hotels that I have enjoyed but feel the need to share my experience to warn others I was unaware that there were renovations in the hotel so after travelling too and from airports arrived at the hotel after being awake for 20hrs  We got into the room at 11am which was good however there was drilling including hammer drills which seemed to be coming above our room  We were in room 237 I think  I completely understand that renovations provide us with a better hotel however the purpose of staying was to find a comfortable bed to get some sleep and whilst the bed was fantastic the noise was unbearable  They did say they would be working from 8am to 6pm  That night we got a good night sleep which was much needed  The 2nd and 3rd nights however were the worst I have spent in any hotel  and I have stayed in a few  We were put in a room that was in between other rooms that had children  These children were running up the hall screaming  and I don t mean making light noise  they were SCREAMING  They knew others in our section and there was a constant sound of the doors to these rooms opening and closing and they are quite loud  This went on from 9 30pm till 11 30pm I spoke to the girl in the club room and said that we were not happy with the noise and thought we were in a playground  She told us to ring the duty manager if this continued the next night  She confirmed that there were rooms that had children in near us  which of course I didn t need to be told as I had spent 2 hours listening to them  The third night the same thing  I wasn t sure of the number to ring and didn t want to enter into another conversation about the noise level and where it was coming from and how long it had been going on for ect ect so I went outside my room and asked them to be quiet  The screaming and crying and banging of doors started at 9 30pm and finished after midnight  I think staying in a brothel would have been quieteri m not sure why you would put a 74 year old mother and 45 year old daughter in this position where we were required to get out of bed and ask other guests to be quiet Why not send the duty manager to check as I had already raised the noise issue the night before  I shouldn t have a  quot job quot  to report unruly behaviour when I stay in a hotel For the price of the accommodation at AUD  420 00 per night I could not believe they would allow this to happen or continue The breakfast and afternoon tea as well as drinks in the afternoon were all lovely and as I said the staff in the club lounge were delightful  but not helpful when we reported the noise the hotel is right next to a shopping centre and market place and there are plenty of places is eat in theregreat food  but if you are looking for somewhere to sleep  try elsewhere Room Tip  ask for a room away from the renovationsSee more room tips

I understand the hotel is under renovation but giving a room key to a guest at check in that is already occupied should not happen  Then hanging around waiting for an available room is also unacceptable  I believed Intercon Singapore would be a step from its other IHG brands but evidently  on this occasion it was not  No plans to hurry back

We spent 2 nights at the Interconti in SIN  The location is OK  it lays next to a shopping mall center  About 20 25min away from changi airport  The check in progress was quick and it had a seperate check in counter for ambassador members  although I would ve liked to check in in the lounge  I couldn t because there was apperently no one available   I was given a small gift at check in  Pros  Lounge  big Plus   great breakfast  great afternoon tea  great happy hour Staff  very friendly and helpful amenities check in Cons  facilities  they really need renovation  A towel Holder fell down on my girlfriend  Signs of age are visible throughout the hotel  Neutral  location  there is no view and next to connected to the shopping centre Conclusion  I believe I would chose another hotel at this price range over the Interconti the next time I visit this is because it is not  quot up to date quot  anymore

Been staying here for a few times now  The hotel is under renovation and I have stayed in many room types beside the shophouse  they are all beautiful  renovated or non renovated One time there was a glitch about My two room booking  and they couldnt find me room next to each other on that that  the next day the guy try to contact me and told me there is room next to each other by letter  We were lazy to pack and move  so we just ignore it  He get back to me again the next day  I appreciate his gesture and think they do remember their guests request  Housekeeping is clean and friendly  Apples on the corner of everyfloor  water is just a phone away  Coming to singapore weekly  and staying in intercontinental  makes me feel im on holiday and not in stressful unhappy singapore Breakfast was amazing  Not much hotel offer cappuccino  beet juices  carrot juices included  teh tarik etc  the staffs are polite  and this hotel meant what hospitality is for them Not like many hotels have 5star tag  expensive rates but treat their guests like a homeless waiting for a free bed and hot soup  Intercontinental is amazing  None expect  quot coins quot  here  FromTaxi guy  concierge  housekeeping Waitress  mooncake guy  noodle guy at restaurant  everyone is top notch and happy  i think their GM do a great job and so all the staff here  they should be proud with their hard work

I go to Singapore often  amp  have stayed at a number of the hotels  Ritz Carlton  St  Regis  Fullerton  Fullerton Bay  Marriott  Shangri la  Shangri la Sentosa  etc  I would characterise the hotel as a good option depending on one s objective  Hotels are pretty expensive  amp  in short supply in Singapore  InterCon is good location  good rooms  nothing really stands out though   and there s good size pool so it s a good base but if you spend a lot of time in the hotel room there are better options  St  Regis   For swimming pool Marina Bay Sands is definitely the best now  For historical atmosphere maybe Fullerton  but rooms are nothing to write home about   or there are a host of boutique hotels that have sprang up  I stayed at one but forgot the name

Stayed for a short overnight business trip  The staff were fantastic and warm from my late night check in after midnight  to check out the next morning  The check in staff walked me to my room  which was nice so late at night  Stayed in the Shophouse Wing  which crosses over into the adjacent mall  Didn t feel like its location made much of an impact on the quality comfort of the room    in fact  at the moment  was told by staff that it is quieter as there is some renovation ongoing in the  quot main quot  wing  Cupboard is in a slightly awkward nook in the room  but still accessible and functional  Desk comes with full range of electricity  HDMI  iPhone  etc plugs  Lots of lighting options which are fun to play with  but also could be a bit confusing  Bathroom is great with bathtub and shower Key were the staff were super nice and helpful  which offset a few housekeeping errors  Room was comfortable  but lacking complimentary water  Staff brought it up immediately after a quick call  but not something nice to wait for at 1am  Asked for the New York Times and was instead delivered a Japanese language newspaper in the morning  Again  check out staff   the front desk replaced it for me immediately when pointed out Didn t have time to check out the hotel dining gym facilities this stay  Despite the incidents mentioned above  given the service  I d come back again

An elegant and charming hotel  Stayed for 3 nights  enjoyed the upgrade to a suite  spacious room which was very comfy  Great city views from the room  could also see the hotel s pool  Staff was spot on  friendly front desk and concierge staff housekeeping was a bit slow when we requested for a few things  e g  Requested for a Turndown service and had to wait about 30 40mins for the staff to come  Breakfast was nice and there was a wide variety  the renovations actually didn t bother us thankfully  The Club Lounge staff I must say was very courteous  friendly and helpful   that was one of the highlights of our stay Pool was nice and fresh  loved swimming in it every morning  also appreciated that the pool depth of 1 4m was for the whole pool  great for me as I m not a great swimmer  Hotel is conveniently located with a mall attached to it  few minutes from the Bugis street and the MRT  Will definitely stay here again when I come back to Singapore

Just stayed 3 nights here  Good standard hotel  conveniently located to a lot of sights and close by to Bugis MRT station  We walked to Gardens by the Bay  it took about 30 minutes I think our room had been recently renovated  it was spacious enough  comfy bed  large tv etc  Bathroom was clean and spacious although not particularly modern    not sure if the bathrooms were included in the recent refurb Refurb work is still going on at the hotel  we didnt see this just heard it on a morning We took a taxi from the airport  around 20 minutes and 15 SGD We didnt have breakfast at the hotel as there are lots of places nearby to eat Used the pool a few times  nice pool area and lounges   although only about 20 lounges so can get busy Overall a good standard hotel  conveniently located  would recommend

Stayed two nights at shophouse room  The room is luxurious and elegance decor with huge and comfy bed and equipped with smart TV  Staff is very friendly and helpful  Location is unbeatable as in the Bugis Junction shopping area  Breakfast is in lobby lounge with choices from peranakan food  Chinese  Japanese  Indian and western food  Juice is also fresh juice not concentrate  Would recommend if looking for excellent and luxurious stay in Singapore

I don t like when we make a reservation and we are not told that renovations are ongoing  I don t like when the web site doesn t mention anything about renovations  More transparency is appreciated As many hotels in Singapore also the Intercon is feeling the pinch of staff shortage  It started with problems with the reservation which were later taken care off  The lobby is a construction area  small and packed with impatient travelers  not a good start to arrive in a hotel  The valet parking guy still doesn t know how to behave  We were upgraded to a huge 160m2 suite  we were thankful but frankly I was not impressed  the metal chairs in the dining area look cheap  all furniture outdated  the view is nice  Not really a  quot romantic quot  room  more the type of suite you rent to run a business meeting with 4 8 people  The lounge is alright  service is good but the smoke from the smoking rooms penetrates in the lounge and that s really bad  Time to go smoke free  this is 2015 and this is Singapore  The regular breakfast restaurant is also closed for renovation  All by all I was disappointed because this hotel could do much better but somehow doesn t seem to be able to deliver anymore that extra quality Room Tip  try to ask for the renovated ones   I anySee more room tips

We stayed here on the last night of our trip on the way home to Sydney  By the time we arrived my pregnant partner was very travel weary  The staff were just fantastic   they let us have a late check out  we had a really late flight  and they couldn t do enough for us  We couldn t ask for more  The bed was the most comfortable of our trip and again exactly what we needed  Everything about the hotel is clean  bright  quiet and inviting  The hotel is in a great location   a couple of minutes walk from Bugis train station and the bustling Bugis market  You won t be disappointed with your stay here  A night here was the perfect way to finish our holiday

This was my 1st stay in this hotel even though I travel very frequently to Singapore  The hotel exterior and interior is nice and has a modern look and are brightly lighted  The room was spacious and the bed was heavenly  The room itself is also brightly lighted and clean  The toilet is spacious as well and very clean  You can feel the room is very comfy once you walked in  However the arrangement of the working desk and the lazy chair and tv can be better position  The table was facing the window rather than the tv  Its a personal preference whereby I like to do my work and at same time watching tv  It comes with a dvd player and a bose iphone docking player  The pillow and the bed is what I love the most  Its so comfortable that you can fall asleep right away  The buffet breakfast was okay with lots of spread but main dishes were missing such as nasi lemak  All the staffs there were very friendly and always have a smile for you  They make you feel right at home  The location is great and walking distance to bugis MRT and plenty of food around that area  Its a good hotel to stay for both business and leisure

Given multiple  less than satisfactory stays in the past  just completed a very nice one night stay at IC Singapore  Lobby and reception renovations have been completed and good to see none of the historical charm of the original fit out has been lost  Renovated rooms are very pleasant although I was a little surprised to see that some of the original fixtures have not been ¡°refreshed¡±  Given the noise  it¡¯s obvious that room renovations are continuing at a rapid rate however that all stopped by 6pm  Apparently the new Grill restaurant will open by end of September when breakfast will move from the temporary and ramshackle set up in the Lounge  I really do like IC Singapore when things go as they should and I¡¯m hoping this experience is the new norm and not the exception to my recent lackluster experiences Room Tip  Make sure you ask for a renovated roomSee more room tips

I stay at the Intercontinental  Bugis  Singapore every few months when I get into Lion city  it is easily the best located  luxury hotel in Singapore  Service is par excellence from the taxi ushers  the very old pleasant man from the concierge desk who walks up to receive you  the receptionist at the IHG desk and at the various restaurants  The hotel leads into the Bugis Junction market that has some amazing restaurants and very close to the train station  The restaurants are good as are the club floors  The bar is wonderful even as the breakfast restaurant is under renovation just now Love the gym there and the swimming pool  I greatly enjoy the run from there to the marina and back  Will keep coming back again and again

We stayed on Club Floor and enjoyed friendly  efficient service as we heard it from friends who were telling us about it  The Club Lounge has great selection of food and drinks  served by attentive delightful staff Hotel is located on Airport side of town  It is above the MRT and close to bustling Bugis street market as well as restaurants and shopping centres The staff is extraordinary friendly  talks to you and it feels like they really care without beeing fake  It is a great feeling  Rooms are tremendous including the bathroom  Cleanliness stands very high and u can see and feel it  Restaurant is super delicious and the service was great

I stayed the hotel for my anniversary trip  I had great time with warm hospitality of the hotel staff One of the things that I appreciated is kind help from a concierge  She gave me an alternative suggestion for the reservation of the dinner  I d say the dinner is the best meal I had during my stay in Singapore The refurbished room is very clean and comfortable I will go back to the hotel upon my next visit to Singapore

Stayed twice this month  Two different experiences  Lot of working going on  but just after our departure the refurbished lobby opened up as part of a long anticipated and needed total refurbishment  Building activities did not disturb our stay  In the past  the hotel location felt a bit out of centre  But with the now popular Arab Street and Little India  within walking distance   the InterContinental is again right in the city centre  As an Ambassador member we were guaranteed a shophouse deluxe room  But the staff decided to surprise us with a newly renovated room on the fourth floor  Not a good decision  the smell of paint and glue was still too strong and these rooms have no view since this is where the basin of the pool is situated  It is also directly above the function room  A wedding party with extremely loud house music till 02 30 kept us awake But the overall renovation is successful  The classic design has been respected and it feels like the old InterContinental  just fresh again for the next few years  Rooms with character  almost like the shophouse rooms  although they offer wooden floors   In the past it was difficult to find a place to hang your hand washed clothes  Uh  it still is  A pity  especially since laundry prices are beyond any reasonable prices  Same with the minibar and drinks from the pool  Euro 14 00 for a softdrink    The 7 11 store is just opposite the hotel  Good free WIFI for IHG members  membership is free   Rooms can be nicely quiet  well isolated and silent AC   In the past members would get a nice welcome present  Not anymore  They gave us a bookmarker with the ambassador program rules  It is just better to leave it than giving this as a present  Poor gesture  We enjoyed the service and the design of the club lounge  Upon departure we complained about the noise and the fact we did not get our guaranteed room  Two weeks later  during our second stay all was put right again  We were upgraded to a very nice shophouse suite  These rooms feel like a cozy Parisian old style city centre appartement  Very well appointed  full of character  Classic  but all in very good condition  Great beds  large bathroom  To be honest  rooms are a bit like at the Raffles  but without the lack of maintenance  If you have the money to spent and want something else than a modern business hotel  you might prefer these rooms  Overall  the InterContinental is  back again  with successfully renovated rooms and hight standard service as expected  Many thanks to Duty Manager Chang Teck Heng  Kelvin   Swift  friendly  knowledgeable  effective  Always Room Tip  Avoid Flour 4   ask for a renovated room   shophouse rooms for extra characterSee more room tips

We stayed at the intercontinental for 5 nights in a club room  Great location and absolutely impeccable service  Definitely worth paying for the club rooms with access to the Club Lounge   great breakfasts  afternoon tea and pre dinner snacks and drinks  We had a couple of issues while there  however  Lucinda in the club handled these promptly and efficiently   going above and beyond to make our stay comfortable  We were very grateful for the early access to our room after arriving on an early morning flight  and the assistance provided for our day trips  Would recommend as a great place to stay in Singapore   which will be even better when the current refurbishment program is completed Room Tip  Pay extra for the club roomsSee more room tips

This is our go to hotel in Singapore  Great location with elegant decor  Close to Raffles and Raffles city and a large shopping center with plenty of food outlets  Rooms are spacious and comfortable and a stay in a club room a must  Staff are attentive and respond quickly to any problems  There are some renovations in the hotel which they are trying to minimize the impact on guests  We unfortunately were placed in a room over some renovations on an adjacent property but staff did their best to help us and offered a move which we did not take advantage of as we were only in Singapore for a short anniversary celebration however they provided us with a room during the day to avoid the noise if needed and wine  chocolates which we very much appreciated Thank you Lucinda from the club for your assistance  Despite all this a great hotel

We decided to stay at The Intercontinental for our two nights in Singapore  and while we knew the property is not comparable to 5 star hotels in the city we did expect a certain level of detail and comfort  We had been offered to be upgraded to a Business Room for a fee  this included breakfast and some other perks we did not use   but honestly I could not imagine how the room is any better than the standard one  The rooms are dated and on the small side  Service is not really so attentive  i e  at our arrival and departure no help was available with our bags to from the taxi  At our arrival there were some misshaps assigning our room  we ended up at a room that already had been given to another guest  not exactly what you d expect for a hotel of this category   we felt service was not truly caring and attentive to detail  My family and I tend to look to stay at Intercontinental hotels as we usually we know what to expect  nothing else  nothing more  and these tend to be  solid  stays  not this time

I used to stay at the hotels on the Boulevard strip  but this one caught my attention after some of my colleagues recommended it  I believe the biggest plus with the hotel is that it is situated in the city and opposite to Singapore library  You can walk to the market and even walk down to the boulevard strip which is just 1km  Rooms are spacious and in good condition  Food is nice  Hotel staff is decently hospitable  Leaving aside the reception area  I found the hotel a worth selection  Wi fi was very slow  I hope the renovation work gets over soon Room Tip  Good choice if you wish to stay closer to the citySee more room tips

This is a spectacular hotel which we highly recommend  It started with a perfect and welcoming check in by Anne  where she offered us a room in the morning after our long flight from Europe  to the on going service throughout our stay  The rooms are immaculate with a great range of facilities  and the bathroom is spacious   it looks like it has recently been refurbished  The location is fantastic  a short walk to Orchard Road and next to an MRT station  There is even a direct door entry to the Bugis Junction shopping centre  We had a fabulous stay  thank you   just not long enough Room Tip  One of the higher floors will offer a good view of Singapore citySee more room tips

Being an IHG Platinum Ambassador  I was not pleased that i had to ask for a room upgrade after check in  instead of being offered one automatically  felt very different from the rest of the several InterContinental that i had stayed  perhaps i m being local Singaporean thus the less than preferential treatment  Was given a Premium Room with a view of Bugis Junction  the room is quite big with a separate sitting area  the bed is quite comfy but bit too soft for my liking  The bathroom is large with all the necessary amenities  Overall  clean and comfortable  Highlight of our stay was dinner at Ash  amp  Elm  the service staff are wonderful and helpful  attention to detail right down to the type of knife for male and female which we were amazed  Recommended wine is excellent and the food are tasty  we love the desserts too  Overall it was a great stay but with mixed feelings  some staff are really sincere and excellent in interacting with the guests  while some though efficient but are rather cold  Will i come back to InterContinental Singapore for staycation   Maybe  if the staff service improves

My partner and I stayed here for 3 nights over the F1 weekend and absolutely loved it  Everything about this hotel is fantastic  the staff  the rooms  the decor  the gym  the pool  the breakfast  everything   Loved the live pianist and singer in the hotel lobby each evening  would recommend this hotel to anyone  Thank you intercontinental for a fabulous stay

A small  recently renovated hotel in the centre of Singapore  Close to major attractions  with MRT next to the hotel  The hotel is connected to a shopping centre  which has a good range of shops and large food court with a good variety of different food  Good size  clean pool for a refreshing dip after a day out We were upgraded and given a newly renovated as Ambassador member  The rooms are reasonable size being in busy city  Would definitely stay again Room Tip  Ask for a recently renovated room See more room tips

We stayed here for the Singapore Grand prix and are happy to say this hotel does not disappoint  one niggle which is for later The staff are some of the best I have come across they are very attentive and will go out of their way to make your stay their main priority We had a Club room which was a good size with desk two seater settee and large bathroom with separate walk in shower  fabulous bed and all your normal things including a Nespresso machine  now for the only niggle  there is no dedicated dressing table  and I am reliably informed by my wife this is very annoying  please Management take note The Club lounge is very good and you can eat for most of the day if you need to  from Breakfast to Afternoon tea and Evening SnacksWe only had a proper meal in the Main Lounge area but the food was very good Main praise goes to the concierge team who without them it would have been a nightmare travelling to and from the Singapore Grand Prix  special mention to Joyce Chua amazing service Overall this hotel is a marker for quality and service that other hotels can only dream of

This was my first time at this hotel and I was completely blown away by the outstanding hospitality of the team  The room was well appointed but did not have a good view  So try for a room on any upper floor  The room was really clean and smelled fresh  The banquets were also very well maintained and we were well looked after  Food was delicious and fresh  Breakfast at the restaurant was sumptuous but was a bit disappointed with the spread at lunch   there was very little local cuisine which would have been a nice touch  But the staff were just wonderful and cheerful always Room Tip  Ask for rooms on the top floor for a better view than that of mine which was on the 3rd floorSee more room tips

Very nicely appointed hotel  I had one of the recently refurbished rooms which helped  excellent service as you d expect from a good Asian hotel  and great location amongst very safe but bustling markets  malls and restaurants  The breakfast of course puts European hotels to shame  with a huge international choice of food  The only thing I didn t like was the Muzak played at breakfast  consisting of the worst cover versions I ve ever heard played at a volume that was intrusive  Why not just buy a classical DVD to fit the ambience  I will be going back  nonetheless

This intercontinental is what you can  and should  expect from this brand  You should definitely be asking for the refurbished rooms that make a real difference  The bar lobby area could be a bit warmer and welcoming and so should be the breakfast area that is served a bit in the middle of nowhere  That would make the  quot 5 quot  in my view

We stayed here for 2 nights en route to Australia and cannot praise it enough   the service we received was fantastic  We stayed in a shop house room with club access which we would highly recommend  The room was comfortable and amazingly quiet for being on a main road  What made our stay special was the amazing choice of food and drinks in the club lounge  served by such professional and charming staff   nothing was too much trouble and we were made to feel very relaxed there  Thanks to all staff for a lovely stay

Travelled to Singapore in August and spent 5 wonderful nights at Intercontinental  Room and service was the standard I have come to expect of Intercontinental and is why I keep booking them when possible  Check in as a club member was relaxed and comfortable  All staff are amazing in the level of service that they provide  Two members that need special mention are Joyce at Concierge who booked all of the tours I was interested in and was more than happy to answer any questions I asked via email for several months before we travelled  Peter Kan  Lobby Ambassador is a wonderful man who always greeted us with a smile and made us always feel special  5 year old still talks about him  thank you Peter The quality of the breakfast was wonderful and the club surroundings are very comfortable  Cocktails in the afternoon make the club booking well worth it The only disappointing thing of the whole stay was that I received a bottle of welcome wine on the last night  I had returned to the room late and wasn t able to drink it so the bottle remained unopened  I would have enjoyed it if it had have been received earlier Location was great with shopping straight out the door  transport at the door and taxis readily available Luxury that I look forward to visiting again in the future

We stayed there on the front end and back end of a trip to Bali  The hotel is centrally located   attached to a high end shopping mall and walking distance to many restaurants  It is very stylish and chic  Our rooms were very nice  We had a room on the club level on the first part of our trip and although it was a bit small  it was very nice and had many amenities  The beds were very comfortable  The pool is a great oasis in the midst of a busy city  Perfect for swimming laps or relaxing in a chair with a book  The club level food is very good  Service was excellent  Good value in expensive Singapore  We would definitely stay here again

My family stayed two nights at InterCon Singapore over a September weekend  It was a year since we last stayed there  Our room was a newly refurbished room  nicely decorated and comfortable  We enjoyed our coffee from the Nespresso machine With Club Lounge access  we enjoyed drinks and afternoon tea at the Lounge  In the evening  we were treated to evening cocktails at the Lobby Lounge When we were there  it was the first day for Ash  amp  Elm  The breakfast s at Ash  amp  Elm were excellent  The buffet spread is good and we get to try a bit of everything We were very welcomed at the hotel and the InterCon team made us feel at home  It was a pleasure to stay at the hotel

Perfectly attached to Bugis Junction shopping  amp  MRT station  so you can go anywhere easily  and restaurants  amp  cafes just a few steps of front door  Perfectly clean hotel  nice pool  amp  gym I stayed here for a conference at Marina Bay Sands  just less then 20 minutes by MRT  Bugis is place for all that you want in Singapore  coffee  night life  shopping  here you can find cheap  amp  luxuries items   some cultures spot  Kwan Im Temple just in walking distance

Okay so I stayed here before in October 2013 and loved it for it s location  style  comfy bed and service  It was so good  I decided to return and this time I found the rooms had been updated and were even better than before This time I had the breakfast included and wow wow wow  it was amazing with so much choice and again the service incredible  Beautiful big comfy lounge chairs and high ceiling in the dining area Now that I have found this hotel  I doubt I will go anywhere else  It s just so good  Shower has great water pressure and set at the right temperature so no fiddling about getting the temperature right each time and easy access for the disabled  no step just walk straight in  Expect the best because that is what you will get  Staff are very attentive and cannot do enough for you

My family of four stayed at the Intercontinental for one night on the way from Sydney to Phuket in August this year  I booked the room on IHG points  so I can t really comment on the value  but I can say that we had a great stay  Firstly the hotel is a great looking French colonial building with a great feeling of history  it s worth taking it in before rushing through to reception  Check in was straightforward  though a little slow  it was very busy even though it was quite late at night   The room was great  quite large and with a big and well appointed bathroom  quite interesting to from an architectural point of view  One disappointment   the roll out bed I requested  and re requested by email directly  was not yet set up  After getting to the hotel after midnight Sydney time  I just wanted to get my 4 year old straight to bed  but had to wait for the bed to be set up  Rant   this is not unique to this property   one of my biggest issues when travelling with my kids is that I request roll out beds to be ready on arrival  but they never are  Why can t five star hotels get this right  it s really frustrating  That aside  we were very happy and settled in for a very comfortable nights sleep Breakfast in the morning was outstanding  A vast amount of choice in a high quality buffet  If it wasn t for the kids getting itchy feet  I would have spent much longer eating Post breakfast we spent the morning in the pool  The kids loved it and the  rents loved relaxing on the lounges with their books  It s a great pool with lots of seating  a kiddy pool  main pool and jacuzzi In the afternoon  late check out  we left the bags and booked a mini van pick up with the concierge and went for a stroll  All super easy and when we got back the van was waiting and ready to go   the staff were very helpful loading the van  assisting with car seats and keeping an eye on the boys Highly recommended  especially if you can land a free stay

We had a fabulous 5 day stay at the Intercontinental  Singapore  We arrived on a very early flight from Rome  We were greeted warmly  asked if we would like breakfast and then checked into our room which was very much appreciated after our long flight  The room was glorious and included a spacious bedroom with a sumptuous bed  lounge room  and a wonderful bathroom with both a shower and bath  House keeping was meticulius and the laundry service was extremely efficient  The hotel staff were always friendly and helpful  Service in the Club Lounge was outstanding  The hotel has a lovely outdoor pool and gym  I love the hotel s location  with ease of access to the Bugis shopping centre  It is also close to attractions either by foot or the MRT  The hotel is a calm oasis in the heart of a busy international city  At the end of our stay we felt refreshed and relaxed  This is our second visit and we can t wait to the next time  Thank you Room Tip  Shop front rooms are a bonusSee more room tips

Stayed at the hotel in August with my family and for the most part the service was exemplary except for an incident at the club lounge  The check in was very smooth and the team at the concierge and check in counter were very friendly and helpful  As a platinum member was upgraded and provide complementary breakfast and club access which was a very touch and good recognition of member status  The hotel is charming and the rooms were large for normal Singapore size hotels  The breakfast area was quite large and good selection of options for breakfast  As mentioned earlier we were provided club access and we went to the lounge around 5 40 in the evening  My daughter proceeded to pick up the food but was stopped by the hostess and host saying that food service will start only from 6 00  As she was moving away after she as told this  two other  western  gentlemen started picking up the food and the staff did not stop them  When I questioned the staff on this differential behavior I was told that the gentlemen were waiting for waiting for quite some time which does not make any sense  Either everybody had access or all have to wait for 6 00 PM  It appeared to be a clear case of wrong skin color which I did not expect from a hotel of this stature  I stopped using the lounge and was happy to  spend  money outside where the respect was available  Except for this incident the stay was very pleasant and I need to commend the staff at the entrance who were very helpful in getting us taxis whenever we went out  I forgot to get their names which is my mistake

My friend and I visited for the Grand Prix weekend but this time I extended our stay to a week  Craig welcomed us as we arrived courtesy of the limo service  and his task  which he performed with a whimsical and effortless charm  was to ensure that our stay was both enjoyable and memorable   thanks Craig  you succeeded  We were in the older colonial style rooms  and despite being recently refurbished they really lacked a lot of natural light due to their location on the lower floors and because of the gap at the bottom of the door was quite large thee noise penetrated the room while trying to sleep off jet lag   I prefer the rooms in the tower  That point aside  the bed was supremely comfortable and the rain shower effect shower was out of this world after coming inside from the sticky heat of the city  All of the team  and I mean each and every one of them  in the Club Lounge were professional to the point of perfection   nothing could be too much effort for them  and despite the hotel being extremely busy they always remembered your name and preferred beverage and made a point to chat with you  we couldn t ask for more  One other positive was the standard of catering in the lounge   from a comprehensive array of items for breakfast to a delicate afternoon tea and delicious evening canap?  selection  it was all thoroughly delicious We dined downstairs in the newly created Ash  amp  Elm restaurant which replaces the tired but quite nice Olive Tree  Executive Sous Chef Philippe is working extremely hard with his team to provide a modern dining experience with a varied selection of dishes that should appeal to just about everyone  freshly prepared in a kitchen open to view   very enjoyable Room Tip  Go for a room on a higher floor in the Tower facing towards the bay if possibleSee more room tips

Overall  a wonderful fantastic stay again  I stayed there for a whole week  end of July 2015  Thanks to Matthew and his team  Rachel and Felicia  for arranging for a room away from the renovation which wasn t an issue at all  The beds are amazing  the pillows are soft and fluffy  and I feel like I m living in luxury with all the amenities and excellent service by their staff  Being asian  I ve been to other hotels and I ve written a review about another which treated asians differently  Thankfully  intercontinental didn t do that to me  My mom who was travelling with me also enjoyed the service and wonderful selection during the breakfast buffet too  I super duper love intercontinental and would recommend anyone to at least try it once  If you re not happy for any reason  don t worry  just call their staff and they will try to fix any issue at once  They do really genuinely care about customer service Location wise  Fantastic location  next to the MRT  just a short walk  which will take you to many places easily  Also  its next to a nice mall  you can get the pharmacy  supermarket and nice restaurants  AND a short walk to more local eateries so you get a flavour of the old and the new The staff are polite and knowledgable so you can easily ask for directions too Room Tip  You can always contact the hotel in advance and tell them your preferences   See more room tips

Check in could not have been more pleasant  Three immaculately uniformed  groomed and very polite associates attended to me  They went out of their way to answer all my questions  Later 2 stopped my room to update on some special research they undertook in response to two of my questionsClub Intercontinental   Outstanding food and service  Managing associate and entire staff  including chefs  continually checked on the guests needs  These lovely ladies were extremely responsive to all our inquiries  The food was delicious and highest quality   Do not miss this featureAccommodation   Upgraded to a lovely beautifully designed and furnished shoptop suite  It was meticulously maintained if a bit small for a Suite  More like a large very satisfactory room  Beautiful crown moldings SERVICEStay five days  Do not think I passed one associate from management to housekeeping that did not greet me and engage me in pleasant conversation  If you notice an elderly asian gentleman it the lobby wearing traditional Chinese garb be certain to speak to him  He is very knowledgeable and you will appreciate the interaction  Summary   World class property that doesn t miss a  quot trick quot  without overcharging gimmicks and unnecessary patronizing You will love it here Room Tip  Corner rooms have good views but weak wi fi  Stay close to center of property if wifi reception is   See more room tips

The front desk was amazingly helpful and even walked us to the elevator  We didn t have a room with a view but the room was generous in size and the bathroom was spacious too  The breakfast buffet was excellent and the coffee was very good  The pool on the 4th floor was lovely  The hotel is walking distance to the Raffles precinct and also to Clarke Quay  The shopping centre next door has many food outlets with lots of different options

We stayed in this hotel for two nights earlier this month  They were terrific  We had club access  which made it even better  Lucinda checked us in and it seemed to be her mission to figure out what we should do in the time that we had available  The rooms were beautiful and the food in the club was delicious  The hotel is not far from a stop on the MRT  but it s not a fun walk with heavy bags  We took a cab when we returned to the airport  and it was less than  20 US  There s construction going on now  but it didn t bother us Room Tip  The blackberry cocktail at the Victoria bar is delicious See more room tips

It was a spur of the moment decision to stay at InterContinental Singapore as my friends and I were deciding for a staycation  We were glad to chose this hotel Service was fast  Upon seeing that it was friend s birthday the next day  we were given a free access to the club lounge access which offers free cocktails at night and high tea the next day  Our late check out request was also granted Since it was a spur of the moment staycation  we didnt have phone chargers with us  We have requested it from the guest services which they promptly delivered  Rooms are spacious and we were given the room with a pool view We had our buffet breakfast the next morning and one of our friends came over to join  We were supposed to pay for her and the hotel offered a discounted rate as an in house guest  However  as were seated  the staff accidentally hit the drinking glass and it broke  They apologised and we were shifted on the next table  Breakfast buffet spread was amazing  After getting her food  my friend was about to start her breakfast  However  the staff accidentally spilled milk  was supposed to be for the tea she ordered  and she had to get a new set of food  We didnt say anything as we know it was an accident which they quickly apologised and cleaned our table After a couple of minutes  the staff came over to our table and again apologised for the misshaps  They offered to waive the bill for our 3rd guest We went back to the room to catch more sleep  Eventually  one of the staff came over to the room and sent my friend a lovely birthday cake Even after we checked out  we still was given access to the club lounge and had a very enjoyable afternoon high tea

The new rooms are now ready from lower floors with everything changed from the old rooms except that the bathrooms are still the same with old fittings  Although good but they could have done with complete renovated bathrooms as well The hotel is noisy due to renovation of the Lobby as well which will continue for another 1 month and the upper floors are still being redone  so this may be a little noisy for people who stay in the hotel whole day The new resturant Ash  amp  Elm  or something like that  which is a reincarnated version of Old Prego is Chic and nice  the food menu remains the same  but the looks have improved considerably The Front Lobby and Gym has also been renovated now  so its absolutely spic and span Room Tip  Choose Lower Floors now as upper ones will be a little noisy See more room tips

The location is good  The service is pretty terrible  We were checked in from our suite  probably because we got an airport transfer   After a long flight  we slept immediately after check in to be awoken 3 4 hours later with the check in staffer calling to say she forgot to leave us room keys  Pretty frustrating as we would have worked this out ourselves in due course The suite was very dated  while having a bath the taps fell off  TV reception lousy  bed uncomfortableThe breakfast was overcrowded and we had to sit outside  What the

Stayed one night at intercon  check in was perfect  staff was patient and explained everything clearly  The corridors were brightly lit and decorated with some peranakan displays  I love the very spacious room with very comfortable bed and huge washroom  However  the pillow is a bit too soft for my preference  I was given a pool view room  so I don t have much to complain here  StaffI must say the stewards are really generous and helpful to attending guests needs  My friend walked past them and they asked if we need anything extra  The next morning when we went down for breakfast  the Lobby Restaurant staff didn t bother greeting us  Perhaps because we re locals  the very same staff greeted another Caucasian guest in front of us  I believe intercon could do better than this  overall  nice staycation

This hotel truly cares  My family were NOT even guests but they saw my family waiting for some time already for the tour pick who was late and the bellboy and manager on duty extended help approaching us and by calling the agency and offering drinks  They were on duty this morning around 10AM  And they deserve the best commendation any guest non guest could give  Kudos  You guys are a true example of what legit customer service is  Doing more from what is expected from you  No one can ever surpass that  Thank you so much

First thing about the Intercon is that you know it won t be cheap  especially breakfast Once you get past that    the Hotel is awesome The rooms are slightly larger than typical in Singapore Giant TV  reasonably good gym  good but not great   frankly the Holiday Inn Express in Orchard Road has a better gym  I only ate breakfast  which was really good Location is awesome as it surrounded by a shopping centre     so plenty of choices of places to eat and shop

Hotel located in Bugis  walking distance to Arab town  and 5 mns ride to little India  its only 300 meters from the Raffles arcade  The hotel is ongoing a quite renovation I got a regular room on a renovated floor  quite large with a seating area  and a nice bathroom with a walking shower cabin and a bath tube  After my 2nd night  upon returning in the evneign there was a strange smell of chemical or cleaning product in the room  I just had to mention it and the staff immediately asked me if I wanted to move to another room  without having to ask for it  I was within 1 hour set in an identical room  on the 2nd floor This one had a Nepresso machine and a handful of capsules with it Brilliant service  Upon check out  the duty manager not only presented her apologies but offered me a late evening check out for free  and without any issue authorized me to keep the room until 21 30hrs  again i didnt had to ask for this  they simply offered  Amazing customer attitude  I have seen very few places like that around the world even at ICBreakfast is large and varied and of good quality  They are a little slow to prepare you a coffeem sometime took up to 8 to 10mns so the 3 rd day I simply told them to rush it as i had to leave within 10 mns  and it was on the table in less than 3 mns  The venue has an exterior pool and a nice interior gym with the latest treadmill equipments The only con I have experienced  strangely the big closet in the room entrance have no shelves or compartment where to unpack your suitcase  only hanging space  and some narrow open shelves under the TV  Not expected in a renovated room  Makes a long stay like I had a bit complicate  but thats a small issue seeing the rest  Internet worked pretty well all across the venue and the hotel is directly connected to the Bugis Junction mall and across the Bugis Street shopping area Location  service  quality of the sleep and quietness of the room  everything makes it deserve 5  rating

Stopped off in Singapore to ease the jet lag pain on our return to Australia  We have before  amp  will always stay at this homely hotel  the staff are amazing  so helpful  polite  amp  friendly  they are a credit to the hotel management  We stayed 2 nights in a newly refurbished Deluxe room which has come up a treat  The room had two large flat screen TVs in a back to back configuration  one facing into the room whilst the other into the bedroom  The room was tastefully decorated with all new electrics including USB charging facilities in the walls  The bathroom had new shower heads  one overhead and the other moveable  also a large bath  We enjoyed the Club facilities that included breakfast  afternoon tea  evening drinks  amp  canap? s and all day refreshments  The standard of the  Club  is very high where service is impeccable  it is well worth the additional expense  Can t wait to return next time to see the newly refurbished lobby where work is currently in progress  noise was kept to minimum  I have enjoyed being an IC Ambassador for many years  I would have no hesitation in recommending IC Singapore to anyone  you will not be disappointed

Stayed recently on a business trip and as usual the helpful and friendly staff were at hand to assist at all times  The new restaurant serves a great buffet breakfast with a wide variety of different dishes  There is refurbishment work taking place which can be a little distracting but it did not affect my stay  When it is finished the result I am sure will be stunning  I was lucky to be in one of the refurbished rooms which was wonderful  Only small gripe was that the snack menu at the Victoria bar was not that enticing and the price of drinks seem to be higher than the last time I visited  However there are many good local places to eat and drink

I have stayed in many great hotels round the world  but this ranks as one of my favourites  It is comfortable stylish and although they are apparently at the moment going through a refit I was not aware of this and it did not spoil my stay at all My room was beautifully very comfortable and the bathroom was one of the best and spacious ones I have encountered  As a woman staying on her own I am used to eating solo  and I have to complement the staff in the restaurant as they made me feel special without over fussing   The new Ash and Elm restaurant is a gem  Superb breakfast  excellent dinner either solo or with family  you have commendable chefs and I couldn t fault any of the staff and look forward to staying with you again  Thank you Room Tip  They are all comfortableSee more room tips

This is easily one of our favorite hotels in the world  I ve even considered staying in house for months at a time if work required it  Our most recent stay however was a really mixed bag  The room they provided us with was an upgraded one and it was again  outstanding  Simply a great room  However  I was so disappointed in what happened to the restaurant  The Olive Tree was easily one of my favorite buffet breakfasts in the world  It was light colored  airy  bustling and just wonderful  In an attempt to make it more trendy or something  it s morphed into Ash and Elm and I found it to be a mere shadow of its former glory  It now has a dark claustrophobic feel to it  The food choices seem much more limited  When I asked about an Eggs Benedict from the chef  he said  quot we don t do those quot   There used to be a wonderful mix of Asian  Western  and Eastern foods  Now it seems uninspiring  When we were there  instead of queues to get in  most of the restaurant was empty  No doubt that s largely due to the renovation work going on but I think it s much more than that  I really think the hotel has made a major misstep with the restaurant changes At present  there is renovation going on constantly Sitting in the restaurant  the noise levels were similar to eating breakfast in the middle of a construction site with constant power tools running  It was seriously unpleasant  If I had been aware of that  and of the restaurant changes   I would not have booked into the restaurant for breakfast each day  The grand lobby area of the hotel was again a favorite area but it s now all boarded off during the renovations I really hope this all changes soon  and I really hope they decide that the restaurant changes were a mistake  because we ve always loved this hotel

Stayed at this property and was quite happy with the hotel  The rooms are spacious and the property is located within 10 15 mins from CBD and Orchard  The only issue I had was with the ongoing renovation works due to which one can smell turpentine most of the evenings  atleast on the 2 days I stayed   I had a splitting headache due to this rather strong smell  Staff were super helpful  especially Joyce in the concierge team and another gentleman who checked me in  I forget his name   The hotel has a good spread for breakfast catering to most palates  The beds are soft  so one might need to request for harder beds  great views from higher floors as well  I will stay again in this property when I go back in about 3 weeks  Wifi in rooms needs upgrading as the connection is very bad most of the times and hence I have not given 5 star rating to my review

I stayed here for a week  a couple of weeks ago  and had a great time  The staff were excellent and the food there was also really good  The pool area is tidy and well maintained and the location by the MLT means that it provides a good base to travel around there  There is work ongoing at the moment but that really didn t detract from the stay and I d certainly come back

We are a family of four and this is our 3rd stay at the Intercontinental Singapore  We arrived on 17th October and leave tomorrow the 26th October  Our stay has been a very pleasant and memorable one  The breakfast is superb with a variety of choices and the dishes are delicious  What makes this hotel special is the staff  The crew at breakfast are very friendly and very accommodating  The concierge service goes beyond expectations  Thank you for making our stay here so special every single time we have been here  We are already looking forward to our next holiday here      and we haven t even left Singapore yet  Thank you very much from the Wijayaratne family

This is becoming my home in Singapore  I have reviewed it before but this stay was worthy of a review At the usual warm and welcoming check in I was kindly upgraded to a newly refurbished suite  which of course set the week off to a great start The room was large  lovely and well appointed the refurb hasn t completely changed the rooms but has given them a great facelift  The bed was as comfy as ever The restaurant has had an upgrade too and it looks great  the food is still the same  which is fine    it s slightly more confusing to find everything but that makes it a bit of a breakfast adventure Everywhere in the hotel the staff were super friendly  I even had an email during the week checking that I was enjoying my stay  Fantastic service Was sadder than usual to leave this time

I was told by sales staff that the difference between deluxe and business rooms are that the latter are on higher floors  On that basis I picked business rooms  but on the day on checkin I was told that the higher floors were undergoing renovation and was given a low floor  It would have been appreciated if they had been more honest about the renovation works and not trick me into making the booking of the business room  Expect drilling noises in the daytime  Bad for families with babies who need some naptime in the day

This is located at a very convenient place  well connected    Since it is attached to a Mall  it provides good shopping opportunities even if you are on a business trip and one hasnt planned to do shopping Service is good and though not out of the way  it keeps upto one s expectations  The room is pretty comfortable with good beds It s also got a lovely lounge restaurant  made sense to me to meet up with some clients   had a good ambience

It is time that some of the Intercontinental properties are renamed as Inter confusional as in the case of IC Singapore  It was my trip with my parents to east and not a very exciting one  Though I enjoy a Priority club Gold status it did no magic with this hotel Due to age of parents I had to share the room with them and specific bookings were made with additional bed in the room  All well so far we land in the hotel and after some long hours I was attended to and told flat on my face that there would be an additional charge than those mentioned in my reservation confirmation  It took them a quite a while for them to sort with guests loitering around the lobby  To me it was not matter of money  it was matter of confirmation and services to be provided for guests  The stay was comfortable and good view in the room but waiting at the lobby left me with a bitter taste of IC Bugis

We had stayed at this hotel a few years ago and since we had a very comfortable stay then  we chose to stay here this time too  As expected  we had a comfortable and relaxed stay here  The rooms were clean and comfortable  The staff was friendly  We woke up just on time to make it down to the coffee shop for a sumptuous breakfast  Relaxed in our room till noon and went to the nearby shops for a couple of hours  Back at the hotel  we would go to the pool in the late evening after which we went to the nearby restaurants for our dinner  Both restaurants and shops were just a short walk away  and so was the MRT  Our one week stay there  was very comfortable and interesting  and we sure look forward to go there again

Located right in the middle of a busy shopping area  the Intercontinental surprises you with the levels of efficiency and courtesy extended by the staff  The gym is pretty well equipped and the swimming pool quite decent for a regular traveller to get their daily fill of exercise  The queen sized beds are the most comfortable  with the special cushions ensuring that you get more than a good nights sleep  Though I m not extra finnicky on the room size  the toilet and the bath area really do justice to the reputation of the hotel In room dining choices are plentiful and for a little extra money  the 24 7 wi fi service and the complimentary breakfast and bar usage make sure that the value for money proposition gets further strengthened  From the front office to the room service to the bell desk  a customer feels like a king in the various touch points within the hotel  Proximity to the CBD also makes it a great value proposition for the business traveller

this was my 3rd visit at this hotel  after a not so good 1st one  where we got changed rooms twice  all too noisy  they gave us a free upgrade to a clubroom  which was excellent  pillow menu  huge bathrooms  beautiful decorated location is quite okay  next to bugis shopping area  i dont take my breakfast in the hotel but right outside there are plenty of options to get the best rate  book when you arrive in singapore airport at hotel reservations desk I have managed to always not pay more than 200 SGD

Off on my first trip to Australia I though I would break the Journey with a couple of nights in Singapore   again a first time trip  Arrived on a Friday PM but was told it was a public holiday so the quick taxi ride from the Airport was exceptionaly fast  From arrival the service was excellent   as with other guests I was offerred the up sell of Club Access for Sin 80   but as only staying a short time decided to decline  Was provided with a  quot Deluxe quot  room on the 10th floor with a King Bed  This is probably the most comfortable bed I have ever slept in at a hotel that did not cost the earth  c ? 100 per night including breakfast and 4pm check out   The Bathroom was exceptional with separate shower and bath  Other recent posters have talked about the excellent location which I can only endorse  I was not there to go shopping so did not miss the  quot Orchard Road quot  experience but the link to the MRT would have made travel here very easy  Also the shopping around Bugis  both international stores and local markets at Bugis Street  was enough for a jet lagged tourist  The only complaint   the cost of the high speed internet in the room   although this is not unique in the hotels I have stayed at outside the USA

I ve stayed at this hotel at least 10 times now with mixed levels of service quality  generally all on the higher end  On the one hand the hotel is not in the ideal location for business as it s a little ways away from the main business district and it s noisy during the day and early evenings with a market right next to the hotel and night clubs down the street  On the other hand  the rooms are very clean and nice and the renovated rooms  don t know if they re finished renovating  are nicer for sure  I ve stayed in the shop suites several times and they are very cool  albeit kind of out of the way  The shop suites have windows that open up directly overlooking the inside of bugis market next door but seemed cool to people watch and see all the hustle and bustle straight from your room  AS an IHG Ambassador oftentimes you can get upgraded to these rooms or pay just a little more to get in there  There is also a separate club area with great food and service right next to these rooms so you can have easy access for breakfast etc Breakfast downstairs offers more variety of food and the food is top notch with a good selection of food from around the world  I really enjoy eating here each morning It s somewhat difficult to catch a cab here  especially during peak hours  and there s usually a cue but that s to be expected in almost all hotels in Singapore  especially
