I was quite surprised that this hotel was just ok  I have stayed in many Intercontinentals before and they are always impressive spaces This was just OK  They were also renovating in the entrance area The room was nice and big with a separate lounge area The pool area was quite nice We were only here 2 nights and twice we had no hot water in the room

Stayed here 6 nights and had overalla a very pleasant stay  Excellent staff that was friendly  helpful and skilled  Great room  I had a junior suite that was comfortable and beautiful  Had access to the Club lounge which I really enjoyed  Breakfast has everything you need  There was on ongoing renovation but that did not disturb much  The location i convenient and streets in the neighbourhood is not so crowded as on Orchard Road  I will definately stay here again if visiting Singapore in the future

What a way to end our Asian dream vacation  The service is impeccable  Be sure to add on the concierge room  It is  quot spendy quot  but worth every penny  Breakfast  tea time and cocktail hour with a concierge on duty to make all ones arrangements  Loved it  really loved it  Our room was one of their newly remodeled and they allowed us into our room early  It is said that if there were an Olympic medal for service  Singapore would win hands down  This hotel  centrally located is a prime example of this impeccable service  For example  since we had to check out of our hotel at 4 00 AM to catch an early flight  the front desk had coffee  a bagged breakfast  no egg  amp  no dairy for me  and a taxi waiting  The flight attendants just looked at me cross eyed when I told them of my allergies  In Singapore  nothing seemed too much of a bother especially at the Intercontinental  Btw  centrally located means only a few steps to the MRT subway system  walking distance to China town  a door to a huge mall and very close to Raffles  I was not impressed after the concierge treatment I was getting  Lastly  don t forget to have at least one foot massage which is right across the street and unbelievably inexpensive  It is popular in Singapore and may be the reason these friendly people are always in such a good mood

The hotel is part of a shopping mall with access to a subway station that goes to the airport  The surronding area is pretty much a shopping heaven with lots of shops and restaurants The hotel lobby is kind of small for a 5 star hotel  The lobby lounge is being rennovated We stayed at the 10th floor  the room is not big but it had just been rennovated  The swimming pool is on the 5th floor overlooking an office building  We had fun in the pool around 2PM in the afternoon with almost nobody Overall  I would pick this hotel for its location and service

After a long flight from the UK we arrived at the hotel at 9 00am  check in was not until 3 00pm but we were happily given our room at 9 15  We had booked a club room and were in fact given one of the newly renovated rooms   very spacious and comfortable  The staff have all been amazingly helpful and always a smile  Would thoroughly recommend this hotel as also close to all amenities  Will come back again Room Tip  Vclub roomsSee more room tips

Excellent service by all staff members  A fantastic breakfast to start the day to cater for all different tastes  Centrally located with an easy 2 minute walk to the MRT  train station   Fabulous shopping area and many different places to eat nearby  Great hotel and having an upgrade as well  Can t wait to visit this hotel again  Top class with service you couldn t fault  Highly recommend

This hotel has got it all pitch perfect  Splendid and delightful staff  a facility which is out of the box with charm and grace   and not your usual cookie cutter type of hotel which you could find anywhere in the world   rooms which lack ticks all boxes  a first class restaurant and a Club Floor which is simply top notch in every respect  There is nothing not to like

I have stayed at the Intercontinental before  Being and Ambassador Club member for IHG pays off because room is automatically upgraded and in Singapore it gives access to the InterContinental Club Lounge where food and service is great  The hotel is currently being refurbished but they are keeping the great colonial come eastern blend  Hotel staff are fantastic  location is great and I love being able to make an espresso coffee in my own room

It has been many years since I visited and I am delighted to see the level of service remains high in almost all areas Currently walled off on the ground floor as they continue to upgrade the hotel and its rooms My half suite 715 was nicely appointed and cosy pastel shades of various whites just simply bordered in pale blue this appears throughout and appears to be the chosen colors I would describe my room as welcoming and homely very comfortable overall The club floor is staffed by helpful ladies offering a warm welcome and attentive breakfast afternoon tea and evening cocktail services Many current guests seem to be senior in years and mode is very quite and respectful there is a dress code of smart casual as this is Singapore Concierge went the extra mile changing a flight for me under difficult circumstances as the airline office are open weekdays only A lovely place to stay but the lobby does become a little noise when children particularly infants are allowed to run wild and scream enjoy your visit as I highly recommend the property and its location Room Tip  I have tried many rooms and suites all are excellent               See more room tips

What a fantastic hotel  From the moment we arrived we were made to feel special and were even accompanied to our room  We had booked an executive room which gave us access to the fantastic executive lounge  This saved us a lot of money on drinks which are very expensive in Singapore  We were also upgraded to a shophouseRoom which was fab and really quaint  This was one of the biggest Exec lounges I have been in and the range of drinks and snacks was exceptional  The breakfast the next morning was also great  we only wish we had had the opportunity to sample the Afternoon Tea which was also included  We were only there one night and wish we had had longer as everything we experienced was superb  The hotel is conveniently located by Bugis MRT station and is within walking distance of the Raffles Hotel

An older property in a great location  with consistently professional service levels  Especially in the Club Lounge  Currently undergoing extensive public area renovations  which should be completed in early 2016  Seasoned 5 star staff seems to have little turnover  so your needs  amp  prior requests are remembered  Not the newest or flashiest Singapore 5 star hotel  but it is an established  amp  proven quality property with consistently professional service  which makes it a winner for frequent visitors  Look forward to returning

Just returned home from a long weekend in Singapore and could not be more complimentary of the staff of this hotel  First off  hastily put together trip so we didn t have a lot of  quot details quot  when we hit the ground  No worries  the staff were as helpful as one could ask for in giving us suggestions for food  where to go to see things  and how to make the best of our time  MANY recommendations and help with booking tours and such and all done with smiles  Next  the hotel itself is apparently going through some updating  No matter   we never noticed  The hotel was spotless  Our room was spotless  Hallways   spotless  You get the idea Location   ideal  We were attached to the mall  short walk to a hop on hop off stop  bus stop  MTR station  mosque  etc   it is a busy area  but we never heard it in the room  yet could walk out the front door and be in the middle of the action  GREAT choice for location for those who don t want to pay crazy rates in Singapore  Food was excellent on site  though we only ate the breakfast twice  lots of options both Western and Asian  and room service a couple of times late night  You are so close to countless food options  why stay in the hotel  Get out   walk  It is Singapore  GREAT food was literally in every direction you walked  Check out the map of the hotel and then look in any direction and you find an attraction  a restaurant  a mall  something you went to Singapore to see Staff   I truly cannot compliment the staff enough  From middle of the night check in to room service to housekeeping to concierge and everyone in the lobby ready to assist   EVERYONE had a smile and a willingness to offer their assistance  I have zero negatives  Great experience  Will be back soon Room Tip  Higher floor the better since the area is mostly low riseSee more room tips

I stayed 4 nights here in Oct   it was very nice  Well  it was nice to be in Singapore to begin with  what can go wrong when staying in Bugis area  Bugis is busy for shopping and that s what I did  Many American fast food in the area  nice view  Quite at night  The front desk staff are very nice  A big shopping mall is connected to the hotel so you can walk to the mall for food and shop without worrying about the traffic or weather  Underground parking  if you park in building garage the front desk will validate the parking tickets for you   Free  I highly recommend this hotel and I will defn  stay here again if I do go to Singapore

Stayed here for two nights and found the hotel to be at an very convenient location  Walk out of the  quot front quot  and you get the city at your disposal  walk out in the  quot back quot  and you are waling right into a shopping mall  Very convenient Our room was beautiful  They have the whole colonial style set up  Room was big  bathroom was nicely decorated  Bed was very comfortable  Nothing to complain here Breakfast was excellent  A lot of variations for all kinds of tastes  I especially liked the dedicated cheese and bread section  Bread and pastries in general are all made by their chefs and tasted deliciously  There are only two things I didn t like 1  During our stay the hotel underwent some constructions  While we were assured that we don t hear it during the day  and we were put on a higher floor  the noise was unbearable  So much so  that we couldn t take a nap  we were very jet lagged   Upon complaining  all we got is a  quot we upgrade your room on the next stay quot   That doesn t help much    If we would have known that constructions are underway we would have booked somewhere else 2  Price  While I understand that Singapore is a expensive place  I found the hotel to be too expensive  Yes  it is nice  but the price for two nights was too high  Especially given the construction mentioned above  A major discount would have been appropriate

Spent 9 nights here in November and this hotel ticks all the boxes  From checking in to checking out the team at this hotel know how to treat customers and customer service is a good as I ve had anywhere in the world  Centrally located in Bugis and only 2 minutes to the metro and on the main line for buses   Good pool and gym and the breakfast was fantastic  Enjoy

The hotel is very well located  Shopping is near by  food is around the corner  the metro is walking distance  you have a path in the mall for guest to use  The staff are EXCELLENT   Josiah  Denise  just ask them anything  it will be done  Plus more  Laundry is super fast  and all hour service  we sent suits and shirts to be washed and iron in the evening  done by the morning 0800  The breakfast is to die for  fresh juices  waffles  you got to have the waffles  ok i know not very local  but it was too good   a little note they serve it every other day  the pratha was cute and crispy  there is cheeses and dry meat  fresh fruits  Its a good spread  The hotel has gym  pool  sauna  All well equipped  the bar to the pool was not open during the day  not sure if it was intentional  anyway there is a minibar in the room  or a convenient store across the street  The room it self   they do a morning tidy and a turn down service  the bed is like sleeping on a could  it could be hard to get out of bed  you have a choice of pillows that you can choose from  well there is a menu and you have to ask room service for it  the existing pillows were already amazingly soft  and there was too many for just one head     you have any variety of tea  if its not in the room just have to ask for it  so i said and more for what you ask for  they decorated  and placed a cake in our room for a birthday celebration  Which was a pleasant surprise

Efficient check in  Courteous staff  Great location behind Bugis Junction with lots of restaurants  supermarket and shops  Room is clean and sizable with bath tub and shower  Sufficient amenities provided  Room service is efficient and food is good  Room has expresso machine and tea pot  Fitness center a bit small  Only thing is we ordered taxi the night before  the lady took all my information but we found no order was placed and we have to que up for a taxi next morning  This is VERY BAD

I would say the venue was great and accessible  Great hotel to hold events and dinner and dance  Liaised with Kathy for my company Dinner and Dance held last night  Kathy provides prompt response and great suggestions The ballroom was really nice and grand and It s foyer was exclusively in a corner  I must compliment that the service extended was amazing  Through a simple passing comment i made by telling my friend that i m allergic to prawn the staff remembers the dietary preference of mine  I was truly amazed Accommodation  was excellent  They have classic room  executive room and suite to choose from  We checked into a deluxe room was sparkling clean and with a very comfy bed   It will definitely one of the best places for staycation Room Tip  Generally  their rooms are quiet and no A C noise See more room tips

There is nothing to fault about this hotel  staff were friendly and rather apologetic about the ongoing renovations  but I got the 16th floor  furthest away from the noise   The room itself is rather dated but full of luxury that one would expect from Intercontinental  comfy bed and pillows  spacious bathroom  the water pressure is excellent    Conveniently located right smack in town next to a mall with plenty of eateries All in all  would love to be back again

Given spectre is all the rage I thought I d have have dirty martini at the Victoria bar  It was perfect  Staff are very professional with just the right amount of personality to make things fun  Hotel is a mix of old and new   some of its a little tired but the character makes up for it  My room was in the old   large  light  clean with wooden floors  Breakfast was great and the renovations didn t effect my stay  Wifi is a bit patchy  Location next to the shopping mall is great and it s a short walk to the marina  I d stay again

We stayed here in October as a family  The hotel is nicely located in the old part of the island within walking distance of several attractions  although walking in Singapore heat is not fun  and with a subway stop an air conditioned 10 minute walk away Rooms were recently refurbished and were pleasantly decorated  Staff were friendly in a perfunctory manner  The pool was outdoors  small but pleasant enough Unfortunately  we didn t dine in the restaurants since Singapore has so many options to explore All in all  a very good hotel  but missing some of the  quot extra quot  touches that some other ICs have which make for a truly memorable stay

For my second stay in Singapore  I booked a five night stay at the InterContinental as I enjoyed my last stay there I arrived late in the evening and checked in  Proces took a while but I received a one category upgrade to an Executive Room  A large corner room with some extras like local calls  free two pieces laundry and free breakfast  I have heard other people who are Platinum Ambassador get better upgrades but this was already very nice for my stay The hotel is an Icon in Singapore and had a decent view over the shopping mall next doors  The room itself was a corner room with large bedroom and excellent bathroom with separate bathtub and rain shower  All amenities and many towels were present My biggest issue with my room were the neighbors  There was an interconnecting door which was very thin between my room and my neighboring room  Their baby prevented me to sleep for three nights and when complaining at the front desk they always say that they can t change rooms due some weddings  In fact  online  multiple rooms were available to book Breakfast was a disaster  I had to queue every single day for at least 10 minutes before being send to the lobby bar to use a rather small buffet  To sit in the main restaurant  I had to wait even longer  This disgusting practice repeated itself every day without any apologie  Once seated  the service was very weak and slow  Frequent Taxi queues in front of the hotel were present but overall the hotel has a great location and many restaurants in the neighborhood

Stayed here last Sunday night in one of the newly renovated and spacious rooms  just loved it  D? cor was gorgeous with Asian accents  the bed  linen and pillows was perfect and the service from check in  in room dining through to check out was flawless and they even provided additional services after my late check out for showing early evening ready for my long flight home  Being able to choose bath or separate shower room was also another lovely feature  Location was excellent too for shopping or accessing Marina Bay area  Certainly would be happy to stay here again

Great location  the front desk team kindly accommodated an early check in and while we waited for our room  we were invited for buffet breakfast and given towels and access to the pool  Room was clean and generously sized  Lobby bar was lovely and a great place to wind down after a big day  Excellent location  close to MRT  Will stay here for future trips

Location is very good  close to the heart of the city and Orchid Road  Easy taxi rides everywhere  Singapore lives up to its reputation as a garden city although October was quite humid and the visibility not great due to a neighbour  Indonesia  burning forest The hotel itself is undergoing extensive renovations  We were put in a newly decorated wing and the new decor is lovely The service was quite good and the staff accomodating as we had my mother with us  Because it was undergoing renovations  it felt a bit like a building site in parts of the hotel  However  once complete this will improve  It is close to the airport and loads of restaurants  malls and shops if this is your thing

This is a 5 star hotel where everything is the way you expect it  Very nice  clean  comfortable room  great service  fantastic breakfast  beautiful decoration all around the hotel  It was the last stop in our honeymoon and definitely it was a great ending to it  We were awarded an upgrade to a suite to make it even more perfect  We stayed there for only one night  The hotel is not on the most convenient location  and you need a taxi or a long walk to get to the Marina Bay  but other than that there s nothing bad to say about this luxury hotel Room Tip  Rooms in higher floors have nicer viewsSee more room tips

Stayed at the ic Singapore for 2 nights as a couple  Check it went smoothly and was given a renovated room on a high floor as requested  Hotel has one of the best locations for shopping and eating locally in Singapore  It forms part of the bugles shopping centre  making it very convenient to shop and meet friends Staff were very courteous and were eager to help  Only issue is a smelly air humidifier was present in my hallway at night  Not quite sure what it was for

I m back again in this hotel because of good previous experience  I like the new restaurant which serves buffet breakfast  and the renovated room we stayed was beautiful and comfortable  Hope they will finish the renovation soon  Just the following complains 1  Bad reservation staff caused confusion and irritation to Ambassador platinum member   the quick resolution by another staff and the subsequent acknowledgement by the hotel GM saved the day 2  Breakfast queue management need to be resolved 3  At breakfast  the hotel serves kaya in a plastic packet manufactured in a factory   for a 5 star hotel which prides itself in nonya culture  this is an important food item you can make  quot fresh quot   KAYA is very easy to make fresh  and uses very few ingredients  If your chefs can t make fresh kaya  then you can t call yourselves a  quot peranakan quot  hotel  Hope your hotel chefs will make FRESH kaya for breakfast in future and stop serving kaya full of preservatives packed in a plastic packaging  In fact I d like to suggest you present a variety of KAYAs as a highlight of your breakfast buffet

I have stayed in this hotel the last three times I visited Singapore  and I ll certainly stay there on my next visit  The executive lounge is one of the best of the various hotels I ve stayed in Europe  North America and Asia  The staff are outstanding  knowledgeable and always helpful  I especially like the heritage Shophouse Room  It is like stepping back in time to be in one of these  A friend  who had to move back to Singapore from Sydney to help a family member  came with me to the executive lounge twice for cocktail time  He was equally impressed by the lounge and service there and said he certainly could understand why I now pick this hotel when I m in the city  I certainly recommend this hotel to all people who visit Singapore Room Tip  Definitely book an executive floor room See more room tips

We stayed in IC Singapores recently renovated business rooms and couldn t be more happy  Rooms were light and bright and with a lovely view to the pool  Hotel is going through renovations and I expect all the rooms to be renovated within few months  We had breakfast at the hotel and on hubby s opinion this was one of the best breakfasts he s had   this being someone who s not into breakfasts to start with    Hotel is located in Bugis next to 2 connected malls  Bugis Junction and Bugis   and MRT station  Excellent location with plenty of local and chain restaurants and easily connected to rest of the city  Service was amazing  of course something you expect in IC hotels   I had some dry cleaning done and they were so kind to ring me and inform that one of my cashmere cardigans had a small tear before the cleaning so I could withdraw it and have it fixed  Gym was large with cardio machines  free small weights and new techno gym kinetic machines  Easy to get a nice workout done  but if your looking for an extensive gym  this is more on the standard  although brand new  hotel one  However this was more than fine for us  To summarize our experience in this hotel  I would not consider staying in anywhere else in Singapore    Room Tip  Ask for a renovated room  there amazing    See more room tips

Back again to the intercontinental hotel and it has not failed to deliver great service from the room to the lounge  My friends wanted smoking which was not available so they were upgraded to a court yard room to accommodate their requirements  Bar is great and lounge is great The only bit that disappointed me was the snacks in the lounge bar being a bit obscure but don t let it out you off Thanks again to the hotel staff who checked daily on my hurt foot when I fell over

The Intercontinental is in one of the best central locations in Singapore  situated attached to a small mall and over a subway stop  It is walking distance to Kampong Glam and Little India  and a bit longer walk to other locations such as Orchard Road  Clarke Quay  and the Marina Bay Sands Hotel  There is a very nice outdoor pool  The breakfast buffet is exceptional  albeit a little pricey  but so is the hotel  I ve stayed here three times and would make an effort to stay here again in the future

This hotel continues to impress with fine service and a good atmosphere We stayed in a refurbished tower room and thoroughly approved of the new decor which is a vast improvement on the rather tired looking room of a year ago  Everywhere seemed lighter and brighter and the colour scheme is restful and attractive  Same goes for the lobby lounge  though I do rather miss the Chinese antiques that used to feature there  The new Ash and Elm restaurant is a complete transformation from the rather dingy Olive Tree Always good too to see Peter  a long standing staff member  who meets and greets guests on arrival  Club staff are a fairly long established group now and work together as an efficient and friendly team for whom nothing seems to be too much trouble Hotel location is excellent with so many attractions within easy walking distance and the ever expanding MRT system is very useful  Great too to be able to move between MRT and hotel without getting wet

I stayed in this lovely hotel about 2 years ago and loved it so much I have just booked again for February 2016 I spent several hours at the fantastic Asian Civilisations Museum  the park like setting is wonderful for shopping and people watching  don t miss the wonderful bronze statues  We ended our afternoon with a visit to Raffles long bar and all within walking distance of the hotel

I was very impressed by this stay  I was in a refurbished room which although next to the lifts was very quiet  The levels of service were exceptional  and the breakfast buffet was one of the best I ve had I particularly liked the little touches in the bedroom like the nightlight  I haven t seen that before It s in a good part of town with many restaurants and shops nearby and a quick taxi or MRT ride into the business districtThe only negative I can express is that the coffee served is not great   fairly weak by European standards  But that is being really picky Room Tip  Ask for refurbished if possibleSee more room tips

Stayed here for 2 nights after a cruise late October  We were on the same floor as the swimming pool which was convenient  Great location  next to Bugus Mall  which is where we had breakfast each day  The most comfortable bed I have ever slept in with fantastic pillows  Room was large in size and had a huge ensuite  Singapore was getting into Christmas mode  with all the decorations throughout the city  Just a bummer that all the smoke had drifted over from the forest s in Indonesia

Stayed here for 3 nights after a long absence  They ve beautifully renovated the rooms  at least the one I stayed in  and the pubic places  notebly the restaurant on the ground floor  I have zero negative to say  The room was perfect  Breakfast was excellent  The surroundings where wonderful  And the location of the hotel is ideal for business  This is truely a 5 star hotel  I will endeavor to stay here whenever I find myself in Sjngapore  Well done Intercontinental Singapore

This was the first hotel in which we stayed in this wonderful city and the InterContinental exceeded my expectations  Right from check in to check out our stay here was faultless  Breakfast was quite a treat due to the wide selection and quality of both Eastern and Western cuisine  We were lucky enough to enjoy a room with a scenic city view over Bugis  Speaking of which  the location is very good  And even when it was too humid to walk  nowhere was more than a short cab ride away  As one might expect from an InterContinental hotel  the staff were very pleasant and were even kind enough to introduce us to a few local Singaporean customs  We enjoyed our stay here indeed

3rd trip in 3 years and probably the last time I ll stay there  Truthfully I m a little conflicted about it  On the one hand  the lobby and general aesthetics are beautiful  But the rooms are showing their age and the noise from slamming doors at all hours of the night was just too much  It could have been the  quot special guests quot  from a large Asian country during Chinese New Year   they also made the pool area unbearably loud  That aside  the breakfast is hands down the best  or at least compared to be Grand Hyatt  Fairmont  and Sheraton    wide choice of fresh local selections  revolving specials like teh tarik or dimsum served tableside  and the Intercontinental special of house made yogurt in little jars

I had a one night stay here on my recent trip to Singapore  Coming from Conrad  where I stayed the previous day  this property felt refreshing Entering into the lobby  you are brought into a different space given the decor  I m an UX designer  and understands the importance of telling a story with a design  I felt that IC Singapore had told a tale about their Malay Chinese  Peranakan  story with their interior The service was great upon arrival  from bellman to the check in counter The room was very memorable  and not at all business like  It sort of reminded me of Kimpton hotels  or some boutique hotels  I felt that there are a lot of attention paid to the details  Rather than a traditional air vent near the ceiling  the vent has a cut out design that is consistent with the interior of the room  The wallpaper has the same effect as well  There is also a Chinese cabinet where the fridge is  which sets a appropriate contrast to the rest of the Malaysian esque decor in the room I chose to get a lower floor room at check in because I was told that they were doing renovation near the floor that I was previously assigned to  and I needed a quieter room to sleep through my jetlag Size wise  it s a tad smaller than the Conrad  But its also about how you utilize the space  With the cabinet in the entry hallway  the room is freed up of cabinets  and has room for a generous sitting area besides the bed  and near the window They also have a really nice lounge area when you turn left from the elevator  It looks like its freshly renovated  and feels that way too  It s a lovely space  and offers live music sometimes  was jazz blue that day I was there   quot A good design is pleasurable  thoughtfully crafted  makes you happy  and gets you immersed  quot    UX Myth  27Other than Park Hyatt Dubai  this is one of the few hotels that is not just about luxury  but also creates a design that brings pleasure to its patrons The only downside    no breakfast for IHG Platinum  I guess you can always get breakfast from a food court   hawker center nearby    Room Tip  To have a quieter stay  make sure you check with the front desk that there  39 s no renovation on yo   See more room tips

We will be staying at InterContinental Singapore during the first week of January  2016  I called the hotel to ask about getting us upgraded because I am its elite member  Front desk staff IE was very friendly and took my phone number and said that front desk manager would call me  I was like  sure  and did not really believe that I would get a call back  10 minutes later  Mr  Calvin did call me back  and answered every question I have  I am really impressed with Mr  Calvin for his professionalism and kept his promise to call me even if I am located in USA  I look forward to staying at the hotel  J Wu

Stayed at The Intercontinental hotel for three nights in October  This was a return visit to the hotel after 7 years but it still retains all of it s charm and character  Stayed in a Shophouse room as this gives all of the benefits of access to the Club Lounge which is one of the best Club lounges I have ever visited Hotel is very conveniently placed in Singapore   a great hotel a which will always be my first choice when visiting Singapore Room Tip  Choose a room with Club Lounge accessSee more room tips

It was after a break of more than 10 months  I went back to Intercontinental Singapore  During my last visit in April   they could not provide me the type of suite room I usually stay  This time with family members   took two suite rooms   From the time of Checking in at the Club lounge and during our 5 days of stay   we enjoyed the stay   especially the courtesy of the Club lounge staff and staff from Concierge  All of us enjoyed the stay  Room Tip  The rooms are generally big  however the best are the suites  See more room tips

One of the best hotels I have ever stayed in and I stay in lots  The hotel staff were very polite  attentive without being intrusive  the location is great for the Metro  Marina Bay Area  The newly renovated rooms are cry comfortable  great breakfast and finally a big thank you for the birthday cake in my room was a very nice gesture too  great place

Our stay at the Intercontinental Hotel  Bugis Junction  Great Location  was a great one  We had an early checked in at 10 30 am   I would like to extend our Appreciation to the Duty Manager  Mr  Ismail  for the upgrades we received  Suite room  Buffet breakfast for 2  2 pieces of laundry daily and access to the Club lounge during our entire stay for 6 nights  The staff we met from the front Desk  Concierge  Bell man  Housekeeping  Dining most of all the servers at the buffet breakfast were extensively helpful and courteous  The suite room is very spacious and lots of amenities

My husband had some points to spend and added another night to our Singapore stay  When we arrived  we had to wait to be attended to at the reception    When they did attend to us  we were offered the InterContinental clud lounge package which my husband gladly accepted  It included a free breakfast at the club  high tea and also cocktail  free wi fi and a room upgrade    Our room was located at the tenth floor and overlooked the courtyard  To our right  we could see the lovely pool The hotel is situated close to Bugis Junction where one can shop  shop  shop and shop  But most of all  the hotel itself is to die for if you are not on a budget travel  Its building has the Straits Chinese  Baba Nyonya  theme and layout which is very much a classic Singapore trait  The lounge has tall pillars with a clear ceiling which allows for some sunlight  It gives the lounge a sense of an outdoorsy courtyard minus the heat of the sun or being drench by rain  This hotel has character Our room was clean with hints of Baba Nyonya characters in the form of some furniture  It has a separate shower room and a tub  TV channels are plenty    and the programmes are clear too  All fixtures working  I would say the hotel is well maintained Breakfast at the club wasn t huge but of good proportion  The same can be said of the high tea  If one wants to venture out for food  restaurants are within walking distance  Or just go to the food court at level two at the Bugis Junction shopping centre  Otherwise  the hotel has a selection of great dishes Room Tip  The hotel offers a  quot InterContinental club lounge package quot   If you  39 re not on a budget   See more room tips

I have stayed at this hotel many times over the years and mainly had a good stay with them  This time I booked this hotel on points as the prices of hotels in Singapore are quite expensive compared to other Asian cities as I was in transit to BKK  I used to be royal status with IHG but don t anymore as they don t have a property in the city I now do most of my business in and I now have the highest status with another hotel chain I was pleasantly surprised that they had given me a newly refurbished room on a low floor but it was really nice  I like what they have done kept the traditional feel but with a modern twist  The main restaurant has also had a facelift and although I didn t try it also looked good A couple of negatives the new bespoke TV system was a bit hard to navigate but the real bit of feedback I would like to give here is the lengthy time it took to check in  It must have taken 15 20 minutes and given it was midnight and I was the only one there it was really annoying  I was told twice that I didn t have breakfast booked in my room and I d need to make a reservation when all I wanted to do was go to sleep as it was 3am in the time zone I had just come from  Other than that it was a great couple of night there btw I did have low expectations but they were far exceeded

Checked in to InterContinental Hotel for a night in one of their very newly renovated Premier Room  Who would have imagine  set in the midst of the local busy shopping street lies a colonial hotel with lots of character  It has an old school charm with a contemporary feel  It s decor smells of luxury intertwined with Peranakan woodwork and arts  This particular room is spacious  it has a separate lounge area for your guests and a work desk  Every detail in the room  seems to have been thought of  It s furniture designs  it s wall panels  it s lamp shades  the colours used definitely made you feel warm at heart and cozy  Location is faultless  Everything you need is within walking distance including train station  I had a great stay here  a true luxury encounter  I would recommend this hotel to any jet set traveler who wants a unique feel of experience

I am usually inclined to root for the underdog and love both an overcomer and an overachiever  This is why I had come to like the Intercontinental Brand  Many of their properties are unsung heroes  They excel in service but I am coming to realize that they often need work on the physical plant  I am a bit disappointed with the Intercontinental Singapore  Not because it was bad but rather that they have the bones of EVERYTHING they need to be truly stellar  The staff is great and get the concept of service  the location is prime  attached to a convenient shopping mall and right across from the light rail  They have all the ancillary services in check  and clearly Management is engaged The club lounge had ample presentations at breakfast and at the cocktail hour  I was really prepared to love this hotel but I couldn t  Here s why  It really is time for a complete renovation  The carpet in the halls are soiled and threadbare  the walls are sorely in need of a coat of paint and there should be a general spit shine through the entire property  We stayed in a shophouse suite which was beautiful and a perfect reminder of Singapore s history which may be overshadowed by the relentless march to modernization  The downside of that suite is there were small but persistent maintenance issues with the room along with the smell of mildew  Overall  this beautiful property put me in the mind of an aging rockstar who continues to tour  There are all the signs of a history of greatness but the definite knowledge that there are a few missed notes  Does this mean that I wouldn t go to see the show  Of course not  but as the Beatles sing  quot I long for yesterday quot   In much the same way  I will be back to this fine hotel but will long for what it really could be with a few tweaks

Stayed here for a weekend in January  Following observations Lobby  Elegant with old house kind of feel Check in  Not as fast as I had experienced in other hotels  I had to wait for a good 20 minutes while they find a room for me  Weird  because they sent an email before my trip for my ETA so that they have a room prepared already  We were given a room on the 3rd floor Room  No view on the 3rd floor room  Our windows was facing a mall dining area so you can see people eating  Disappointed  Yes  Why  Because I carry a Spire Ambassador membership at IHG  Ambassador status is something you pay for to get an automatic room upgrade  I know that Spire status doesn t really carry that much weight in Intercon hotels because of their separate Ambassador program  but being both and then being given a room on the 3rd floor was disappointing The room itself was good  but pretty standard  You have a pillow menu which you can order from their smart TV  There aren t as many power outlets as I d like them to have  Buffet  The buffet was good  Compared to other hotel buffet breakfasts  they have more options and service was good  The buffet saved this hotel from me giving them 2 stars

This hotel combines the old with the new Singapore architecture with stunning results  This is a beautiful hotel near shopping  restaurants  and Raffles Hotel  The Intercontinental VIP Lounge is the most beautiful and spacious as any that I have had the privilege to experience in any hotel  The food  service  and atmosphere in the lounge is outstanding  The Hop On Hop Off bus stops just across the street

Lovely hotel  tastefully decorated  good location  Only reason did not give it a 5 was because there seems to be a little bit of disorganisation  at check in  we were told that our room would be ready at 3pm  we had arrived at 1pm  but when we came at 3pm  they could not find our room and again we had to wait for about 20minutes while they checked on the computer for an available room and also on our last day when there seem to be some confusion in the dining area at breakfast and the food was not replenished   not sure what happened evenso the breakfast was delicious

The hotel is very nice  the staff from check in counter is quite helpful  location is close to all major business area and near the metro  They have a very good quality bed mattress and you can select different types of pillow  The price is quite costly and not sure worth spending this amount as you would not stay in hotel for a long time while you are travel

Even though I have stayed in thousands of hotels and I am an IHG member for some unexplained reason I seemed to have never stayed in an iner continental hotel beforeRight from the second we pulled into the drive the first class service beganVERY helpful check in lady   Alexis I think Super helpful concierge who was just brilliantRestuarant ash was really good food and serviceAfternoon tea was classy with nice live band  I had broken my right wrist and the waitress offered to cut up my food for me which was very thoughtfulThe pillows were so comfortable it would be hard to find betterA perfect stay in a classy well run hotel were all the staff knew how to make you feel good10 out of 10 fantastic I will return for sure

This hotel has become my absolute must stay place in Singapore  It is so perfectly located right behind Bugis Street with fabulous markets and cafes  and above the MRT where you can easily get to anywhere else  as its one of the friendliest and easiest undergrounds I have ever used   You could even go straight there from the airport via MRT if you wanted The hotel itself is all you expect of an Intercontinental and more  Divine service as only Asian countries seem to be able to achieve  a great club  I always get a club floor room   fabulous pool area and beautiful spacious rooms which are impeccably clean It also has that beautiful  raffles  feel to all the public places and a couple of great restaurants  and is linked to a mall with a giant food hall and dozens of other restaurants for those not game enough to venture into the smaller street stall for food Room Tip  Club accessSee more room tips

I have stayed at the Intercontinental in Singapore a number of times  amp  its always my first choice of hotel to stay in when in Singapore  I hadn t stayed here for about 3 4yrs and I found the rooms even more luxurious and lovely then my prior stays  They are sumptiously  amp  tastefully decorated whilst not being too over the top  The rooms are extremely quiet and spacious  The bathroom is also spacious and more then adequate  Housekeeping is prompt and nothing was missed  Whilst public areas of the hotel were undergoing major renovation we found the noise and closed off areas didnt really have a great affect on our stay  The location whilst not being close to Orchard Road is still good with easy access to a number of decent shopping centres and the MTR all within easy walking distance

We visited the Singapore IC at the end of October  and despite the construction that was still ongoing at that time  we had a very nice visit  We had a great room on the Club lounge floor  The room was impeccably clean and the bed was very comfortable  The construction noise did intrude at times but overall wasn t that bothersome  The Club lounge in Singapore is very nice and has a tremendous selection of food and beverages  I like that they have a terrific afternoon tea with several delicious little things because it is a perfect way to relax after you ve been out in the hot Singapore weather for a bit  At breakfast and in the evening  they probably have the best selection of dishes available out of just about any Club lounge we ve visited  The staff in the Club are so great and always welcome you warmly  often by name  and are very eager  though not overly  to help or get you anything to make your visit more pleasant I was also really impressed with the concierge desk supplying us with decent quality masks as we got directions to walk to a museum  this was at a time when they were having lots of air quality issues from burning in Indonesia  so not a regular thing We have really enjoyed the Singapore IC on previous visits and I would certainly recommend it  We look forward to our next trip there Room Tip  Get a room with Club Lounge AccessSee more room tips

Central but quiet location  Reception was efficient and welcoming  Rooms are large and beautifully decorated with a super comfy bed  Bathroom is huge and well equipped with a great dual shower set up  The hairdryer has too short a cable or the mirror power socket needs a bit of a rethink and a set of drawers would be nice but minor things  Breakfast had a wide choice of both local Asian and western food and is well labelled for allergies  Coffee very good but can be a bit slow arriving  Tried both bars and reasonably priced and excellent service  The Citytours hop on hop off busses stop right outside and are a great way of getting about the city  The pool area is lovely and just the ticket after a busy day sightseeing  Would definitely stay here again

I m going to jump straight in      The beds are the most comfortable things in the world  I thought I was in a big pillowy cloud of softness  I loved it so much I would have stayed there all afternoon if I could  But I have a life  so I couldn t  The bathroom was spacious with both a big bath and a separate shower  Good selection of toiletries  Fluffy towels which were big  I don t enjoy drying myself with something the size of a face cloth   The breakfast was very delicious  A lot of variety   Western  Chinese  Indian  sweet  savoury  hot  cold  You get the picture  Very friendly staff

This is undoubtedly a 5 star hotel in terms of accommodation  facilities and amenities  Our spacious executive room had been freshly refurbished and everything was beautifully styled and in pristine condition  The blend of heritage and modern designs throughout the hotel was charming It is Chinese New Year so we expected    busy    but we were not  however  prepared for the huge numbers of families with young  excited  children  at breakfast who appeared be to be overwhelming for the staff and the areas set up to accommodate everyone  We opted for what we thought would be a quiet area in the lobby lounge   which had been set up for breakfast but this ended up being equally as challenging    as the buffet was set upon by guests pushing shoving and grabbing what they could as quickly as they could  This undoubtably had an impact on the enjoyment of those of us who are used to the usual pleasant InterContinental breakfast ambience and experience  staff came across as being more task orientated in their efforts to clear empty plates and replenish and rebuild the buffet presentation to keep up with it all I don t know if the cool corporate  non smiling  approach to these situations is helpful  as your guests will pick up on this   but I for one would have preferred a warm smile and that little bit of friendly interaction that I expect from an InterContinental 5  hotel     as for a large crowd of pushy clientele   that s a difficult one and I suspect more of  seasonal  one off  As IHG Ambassador members we remain loyal to the brand but on this occasion we did not feel particularly valued or individual    benefit of the doubt leads me to think and hope that this was just  holiday  blip

Very comfortable stay at Intercontinental in Singapore  Suites are spacious with antique style decor  Smart TVs in both rooms  Office desk  Free hi speed wi fi  Stayed on the 14th floor with a view of the bay in one corner  Plush towels  Great location  Hotel side door opens up into the Bugis Junction Mall which gives you plenty opportunity for shopping  splurging on different cuisines and also connects to the metro  The taxi stand is also close to the Bugis Junction Mall  But I thought the daily room cleaning could have been better  Huge lobby with wonderful pictures  The staff are courteous  The building architecture is interesting   marriage of old style and modern architecture Room Tip  above the pool  top floor with a marina viewSee more room tips

The Intercontinental Singapore is a classy five star hotel in a perfect location in the heart on Singapore  With attentive service and beautiful rooms this hotel exceeded my expectations Upon check in I was given a smoking deluxe room that smelled horrible  not recommended for a non smoker   Saathwin at the front desk went out of his way to make sure we would be happy even as the hotel was pretty full as it was during Chinese New Year and upgraded us into a gorgeous room I highly recommend this hotel and would stay here again if I would return to Singapore

This hotel has been completely renovated and has a great staff  We stayed in an executive suite with the executive benefits  i e  free breakfast  high tea and a cocktail hour in the evening Let s tart with the room  clean quiet and spacious The staff were very accommodating and would go out of their way to make you happy The service and food in the executive lounge were great I would reccommend this hotel to anyone Room Tip  The up charge for the executive benefits is well worth the price See more room tips

This hotel is absolutely a 5 star place  We stayed at the Heritage Room and the room is spacious and well designed with separate shower tub and double sink  The room is next to the road but the windows are quite sound proof  The only noise comes from the big opening under the main door  but we sealed that using floor towels Maybe because we visited Bali before this and were so pampered with resort style service  we felt that the Club Lounge and the hotel in a whole didn t pay enough attention to us during the stay  But come to think about it  the hotel did really great using a business hotel s standards Will definitely return

Club room was great having two queen sized beds to fit our family of 2 adults  and our 8 and 5 yr olds who shared a bed  Bathroom was spacious and had a bath and separate shower  Missed having a line over the bath to dry bathers on  My only negative about the room being that there was very little drawer space for clothes  wardrobe was fine for hanging clothes though  We had 4 suitcases with us so some of our floor space was taken up with these   Note to self  pack less Club lounge was beautiful  very peaceful  Main lobby lounge that we used in the evening was also beautiful  special mention to Rainey  Meijen and Murni who really made an effort with the guests  Unfortunately one of the managers  Linda was not so friendly and made it very obvious to her staff and to us as guests that she did not appreciate them spending anytime engaging with us By the 6th night the food in the lounges although beautiful did become a bit mundane and predictable  Great choice of drinks and cocktails though On the whole I loved this hotel and would stay again  but would have to say that in general the staff were not as friendly as some of the other hotels we ve stay in Singapore such as the Valley Wing Shangri la Room Tip  Club rooms are great value See more room tips

I stayed at this hotel with my wife and two daughters  I have to say that it was a perfect experience  The facilities are in pristine condition and the hotel is located in the Bugis district  very close to the Marina Bay and with a good offer of stores and restaurants in the surrounding area  Within walking distance you have access to a mall and to the MRT so it is very easy to visit Singapore without the need of taking taxis I booked our rooms with access to the Intercontinental Club and I highly recommend it  we had breakfast  tea and snacks in the afternoon and drinks and snacks later and the quality and the atmosphere is great The only detail we had is that I booked in advance a transfer from the airport to the hotel as we arrived late at night and nobody was there when we came out from customs  in the end it was not a major issue because we were able to take a taxi  What really impressed me is that when I explained the situation during check in they told me they were sorry and would contact the concierge to check what went wrong  The next day I received an e mail from Mr  Craig Hodgson  Concierge Manager  apologizing for the inconvenience and also a couple of tea tins as a gift along with a written card from Mr  Hodgson  We know all hotels make minor mistakes sometimes but it is how they handle them which makes a difference  I would like to mention that Mr  Hodgson knows very well how to treat a customer and provides an outstanding service Overall the whole staff is committed to provide an excellent customer experience I highly recommend this hotel for business or leisure

Quite a impressive colonial building and located on top of a busy train station and in a main road  Service is good  food is decent though not very exciting given the alternatives in the city  Room view was quite poor and quite akin some of the old intercontinentals  Would have been great in the days of the Raj  though in these days would prefer a more modern technology

Stayed in the Heritage Room with 2 large super single room which was adequate for our family of 4 with 2 young kids  Room is well appointed even though it was not the latest renovated ones  Check In was pleasant  efficient and staff are very warm Breakfast was good and since we had the family weekend get away package  the kids ate for free  Service was warm and helpful  Latte s are good and the kids love the hot chocolate Receptionist warned us that the heritage rooms are a long walk  however  we found the walk to the room pleasant and filled with nice aesthetics Keep up the good work of having a bit of Peranakan in the stay experience Room Tip  Heritage Room for that nostalgic feel See more room tips

Great location right next to a mall  Plenty of dining options  The entire hotel has a classy decor mixing old and modern elements seamlessly  Room is very tastefully furnished  Shower area is slightly small for rooms in the price range  Ask for higher floors  mine was at 3rd floor which has practically no view at all  Nespresso machine in the room is an excellent touch  Breakfast was crowded due to the holidays  I ordered coffee which never came  Decent choices at breakfast  but nothing fantastic  Friendly concierge and reception

This hotel was quite unique because they re having a historical touch on the building  It s also located on strategist area  You could just walked out from the back door and voila  You re at a mall already  And to make it even better  the MRT station was only 5 mins walk from the back door without walking out of the mall  Across the back door  you ll find the traditional market and the famous Si Be Lo temple

We stayed here on the way to KL  we had a room in the part of the hotel designed to represent traditional Singapore  based on the chop house design  A lovely spacious room decorated in a traditional style  Lovely comfortable bed  The bathroom was large encorporating a bath and wet room  The hotel is well situated and you can access shops without going outside  Near to Bugis street and lots of restaurants  We were welcomed and treated very courteously by hotel staff  Breakfasts are delicious with English and traditional options  A very comfortable stay indeed Room Tip  Ask for a traditional style roomSee more room tips

This is a really nice hotel and being familiar with Singapore  wife is Singaporean  we chose to stay here in part because of central location in Bugis Junction Hotel has been recently renovated and has a strong Peranakan feel  Some of the rooms near to the club facility have also been renovated in this style and we were upgraded to this style of room  Room was well appointed and comfortable with god facilities We had also booked a club room which came with use of intercontinental club room which can be used for breakfast   to avoid the masses  afternoon tea and for cocktails in evening  It is worthwhile getting entrance to this Breakfast buffet is decent with large range for all   western and European  Service was alround excellent The only disappointments with the hotel are the pool which is unimaginative and not very warming and the gym which despite having new equipment is under equipped Anyway well located and great hotel in general however please please please equip the gym properly

Being invited by my friend who is an ambassador member  I simply stay at this property for one night  The stay was beyond my expectation  and I will definitely return  From the entrance door to check in at Club reception  the experience was flawless  The club staff are really attentive to my preference and needs  I simply mentioned about interest of shopping  and the Club manager immediately suggested the shopping areas that are most convenient yet with good discount  The free flow of alcoholics worths booking a club room  comparing to the alcoholics price at major bars outside  The club staff are performing beyond my expectation

We chose to  return  to Intercontinental for our very first family staycation in Singapore    It was nostalgic and definitely more relaxing now that we are not travelling for work  We loved the refurbished common area and hotel rooms  and how its blue and gold hues  and new furniture pay homage to the property  area s Peranakan roots  Definitely great that the other equipment  fridge  toilet unit etc  got an upgrade too  We interacted mostly with the front desk and housekeeping staff  and both teams did their best to serve us in the quickest time  The only blemish to our otherwise perfect stay would have been our tea at the lobby  The area was only half packed  but service was slow  We were quite confused to be served our tea before our welcome cocktails  While we appreciate the waitress taking time to explain each dessert  snack  the scones took a long time to arrive  we had to ask   and the crepes never made it  we only remembered the day after   Not sure if the music was meant to appeal to the older crowd with some cheesy  quot classics quot   but I thought the music could be classier  maybe Jazz    Kudos to Intercontinental Singapore for keeping one of its pioneer staff  Peter Kan  I remember him for our last stay 3 years ago  and though he has aged visibly  he retains his megawatt smile and enthusiasm  We are so happy that in fast paced Singapore  Intercontinental has kept him as part if its front lobby crew  Really touched when he helped carry our bags down to the carpark

My wife and me spent one week here last summer  it was a fantstic week in luxury and with exellent service from all staff members  We stayed in a Club room  which I will reccomend as the alcohol prices are quite stiff in Singapore  The room was very large and comfortable  Had the breakfast every morning and the buffet was extensive with high quality local and western food

The room is of a decent size and the beds are extremely comfy  There s a bath tub as well as a shower area which is a plus  Bugis Junction is situated next to the hotel which makes it really convenient if needed to do some shopping  Didn t use any of the hotel amenities but trust the hotel offers optimal service standards  The only negative thing about the room is that it doesn t have any bidet in the toilet

My colleagues have been traveling for a couple of weeks  amp  been staying at the Intercontinental in Jakarta  KL  amp  Singapore  They booked online via the respective intercontinental sites  Upon check in at Jakarta they were informed that the rate they are paying was not in line with intercontinental best price practice by the hotel  amp  the hotel immediately adjusted the rates  When they arrived in intercontinental KL  intercontinental KL adjusted the rates once it was brought to their attention  Intercontinental KL called ahead  amp  explained the situation to their counterpart in Singapore  amp  the duty manage in charge said it was fine  amp  will pass on the message to the next duty manager I joined my colleagues on the Singapore leg but when we checked in in intercontinental Singapore we received a totally different reception  We tried to explain the situation to the duty manager but instead of listening she just snapped at us  amp  resulted in a heated exchange between her  amp  my colleague  No where on the intercontinental site does it say click for terms  amp  conditions for best price guarantee  All it says is   Book With Us AdvantageBest Price GuaranteeWe promise you access to the guaranteed best available prices  or your first night is free Nowhere does it says to click on the link for terms  amp  conditions  The issue isn t the money but the principal of the matter  We booked 4 rooms  1of us is an ambassador royal member  2 of us are gold elite members  This is not the way to treat your customers Then to insult us further intercontinental Singapore wanted to make things right but only to the ambassador royal member  I rejected their suggestion  amp  they then offer 15 000 points each  Which was also rejected  Come on  stop insulting us  Money isn t the issue  it is a matter if principal  If your website doesn t convey your intentions  do not take it out on the guest  My colleagues paid USD400  a night for their rooms  mine was usd500  a night  And we found 5 different sites at a much lower price usd340 a night  At the end we settled for SGD100 credit per room  Our issue isn t the money  We travel almost every other week  amp  usually stay at intercontinental as its our preferred chain  But to have 2 different policies across the chain isn t acceptable but what was more unacceptable was the rude  amp  obnoxious behaviour of a front office senior staff who made our stay unpleasant  And we waited over an hour to check in  amp  to be snapped at  We will definitely not return to Intercontinental Singapore the next time we are in Singapore

I had high expectations for this hotel based on other reviews  and it is true that the rooms are very nice and the location cannot be beat However  I would like to share that I made a reservation for two rooms six months in advance of my stay  When I arrived  the front desk agent could only find one of my reservations  Luckily  I had the confirmation emails and confirmation numbers to give her  It took around two hours  which included a break for me to go get dinner while she sorted it out  She required me to email her the confirmation emails  and even after receiving and reviewing them  she insisted that I only had one reservation  I finally was allowed to speak to the front desk manager  who after a long discussion  finally admitted that even though I had clearly made two reservations that somehow Intercontinental had made a mistake and they had lost one To make it worse  at first he was willing to give me another room  but at a HIGHER RATE than the reservation I had booked  He kept saying that this was out of his control  When I finally asked to speak to somebody whose control it was within  he said he could override the system and give me the second room at the rate I had booked it for By this time  it was late at night and I had traveled to Singapore with three small children  There was never an apology for the inconvenience nor an offer to compensate  If this had been a Starwood or Marriott  they would have immediately acknowledged their mistake and upgraded my rooms to compensate  If no upgrades available  they would have offered me reward points for my inconvenience The Front Desk Manager said he would research why they lost my reservation and would reach out to me with an explanation  That was two weeks ago  and I have received no communication  no apology and no offer to compensate me for the inconvenience I will not stay in this hotel again  and I will not recommend it to my friends

I had an excellent 3 night stay at the IC Singapore as the final leg of a long business trip  I found the service from the exceptionally warm check in  very late   around midnight  where I was presented with a complimentary TWG tea box in the shape of the hotel  through to the very rapid pressing service and the selection of chilled towels in the gym  made the stay quite exceptional even for someone used to staying in InterContinental properties Singapore hotel prices are generally on the high side  so I was very pleased to find that my room was actually very good value   while the price is similar to other space constrained cities like Tokyo and Seoul  the rooms here are much larger for a similar spend  I had a separate living room and bedroom  with a large entrance hall  where the wardrobe and bathroom entrance are located   the good size was complemented by good amenities including a Nespresso machine  with premium pods  like Rosabaya de Colombia   high end linens and fast wifi The gym is somewhat unusual  It is large and spacious  with lots of light and plants  but would perhaps benefit from more equipment for those who like to lift weights  There is a very small selection of TechnoGym machines and a rack of dumbbells  but there are no barbells and most of the common machines   leg press  etc    that are challenging to replicate with only dumbbells were missing  As mentioned earlier  there is a fridge of cool towels  which is a nice touch Overall  with a good location  friendly service and excellent rooms  I will certainly return on my next visit to Singapore

During my recent stay in Singapore  I chose InterContinental Staff service  They all seem to enjoy their job  by extension  guests do enjoy their stay  They do their job very efficiently  respond to our requests in a timely manner and with a smile  Keep it up Room and public area  since my last stay here in 2009  rooms are refurbished and there s a lot of changes too  The hotel looked grander this time  The bathroom has complete amenities  but bidet is something that we can add  Nonetheless  the bathroom was spotless  TV channels also need some addition  TFC for example Wifi  free wifi for IHG members  The connection is good at least during our stay Dining  We re not able to try but Ash  amp  Elm seemed nice Location  One more factor I like with this hotel   proximity to Bugis MRT  there s a lot of shopping and dining outlets just outside the hotel  Also  there are a lot of museum and places of interests nearby given the hotel location being in the Bras Basah Bugis area  SG s vibrant art and cultural enclave   to name a few  National Library just adjacent to the hotel  CHIJMES  and more    The Civic District is also walking distance  Natl Gallery  Raffles Landing Site  and Marina Bay area My relatives were also impressed and I am sure they only have good memories and stories to tell their families and friends  including myself  I will always be a fan of InterContinental  Surely  I will stay at this hotel again in my future visit s  if I have a chance  in SG  GreatHotelsGuestsLove   Room Tip  upgrade to a club room heritage room to experience more Luxury and access club lounge See more room tips

I booked this stay in July 2015  One week before arrival I emailed the hotel to inform them I would arrive late evening  I was amazed to receive a reply saying i had no booking and they had checked my royal ambassador account and there were no bookings on that  Sending a copy of my booking i was then told there was a international computer glitch for two days but they had suddenly found it  I booked 7 other intercontinental hotels the same day  with no problems  and nobody else seemed to be aware of this  I was then informed that as it was an advanced booking  the payment was required before arrival  The whole attitude was poor and due to the reservation department incompetence  the exchange rate of my currency dropped greatly costing me a lot more money for the stay The hotel was excellent  as usual and very clean  and well run  The staff member who met the car from the airport could not manage a hello  The staff seemed professional but no smiles or acknowledgement  The exception to this were the club staff  who were exceptional

Central location and with excellent service  We crashed here for 2 nights after some spending the last week in more economical hotels The pool ain t fantastic and the gym is a little small  But the rooms are one of the best we have tried  Beautiful decoration and fine details  We were very impressed  We also had club privileges  the happy hour spread has to be one of the best in town The hotel restaurants are very expensive  but the hotel is connected to a mall with a ton of options  And we had one of our best meals of the trip at a place called Platypus which was a min walk away and just round the corner The service is also to be commended  We were promptly served by Alice and she was crazy nice  Good vibes everywhere with this hotel

I had not stayed in Hotel Intercontinental in Singapore before as I used to stay in Ritz Carlton Millenia before  but when I had to pay extra for having access to their swimming pool despite a very high price for my room  I decided that it was time to try something new  Intercontinental was a good choice  The hotel is located just two blocks from Raffles  It is in a way a bit old fashioned  but in a cozy way and the whole staff  and especially in the Club Lounge  is friendly and really nice  And no  I did not have to pay extra for access to the swimming pool Room Tip  If you can affort it  you will have an excellent service in the Club LoungeSee more room tips

Very nice rooms  just next to mall  close to many metros and many Indian Restaurants BF spread is very elaborate  good gym with personal video and you can use internet and see any video of your choice  your morning thread mill can be with MS Subrabhatam very close to Krishna temple   lt  5 minutes by walk   one of the great temple one must visit in SingaporeRoom Tip  top floor rooms gets you great view of SIngaporeSee more room tips

We were very happy with the newly refurbished Heritage room and the service was excellent  Every staff  from the front desk to restaurant to staff at the swimming pool  is friendly  I also noticed an elderly staff at the lobby  He was very helpful and offered to help me with my luggage  It is good to see that there is no age discrimination by the hotel management  We will definitely be back again  Just want to point out that the coordination between your hotel and Agoda could be better I was asked to pay for the room when checking in  I was also told that my room did not include breakfast  Luckily  the Agoda confirmation email clearly stated that the room has been fully paid and the room rate includes breakfast  These issues were resolved on the spot

Really impressed with this hotel  We arrived into Singapore early on an overnight flight from London and took a taxi straight to the hotel   arriving at about 7 00am  We were fully expecting to have to leave our luggage and return later in the afternoon but the check in staff were delightful and to our relief  told us that our room would be available within an hour or so  We had booked an Executive Room with Club Lounge access and so were able to go to the lounge and enjoy coffee  juice and pastries in comfort until our room was ready  Definitely worth going for Club Lounge access   one of the best in our experience  Roomy  excellent breakfasts  brilliant afternoon tea  delicious canap? s in the evening  Friendly staff   good choice of drinks and cocktails in the evening  Location was marvellous for both tourism and business  Within a few blocks you can be in the ultra modern business district  visit the Raffles Hotel or the fascinating hubbub of areas like Little India  We are travelling on a 7 week holiday to Australia and NZ routing out and back through Singapore   we are staying in a different hotel on our way back in a couple of weeks but rather wish that we were returning to the Intercontinental

I have stayed at Intercontinental Singapore countless number of times for short trips in and out of Singapore and have been to perhaps every Intercon hotel in South East Asia  But whenever I come back to Singapore and stay at this hotel  it always feels like home  The renovated rooms are splendid and very luxurious  I love the shop house rooms  now known as heritage rooms  and their sound bar features  I also love how they have provide Nespresso machines in every one of these rooms The club lounge staff and Vivian of the club lounge has consistently provided me with the most personalized and highest level of service throughout the months of me being there  so if you have the opportunity I highly recommend upgrading to club access rooms The breakfast buffet can get a little hectic and on my most recent stay  it is getting more and more crowded  But it is surprising that they have managed to maintain the high quality of the restaurant s breakfast offerings and its one of the best in town  The new addition of tasteful live music to the lobby lounge is very nice  unfortunately  with club lounge privileges I never get the opportunity to enjoy drinks there  maybe a welcome drink for ambassadors next time    You have to order the waffles when you are at breakfast  they are AMAZING order them directly with the pancake guy as they no longer display the waffles on the buffet spread  Check in has always been a breeze with fast and efficient staff  In particular  Alice  who has always been more than accommodating throughout the months with my random requests  she s amazingly professional and efficient at her job and I must say she pulls off the new corporate uniforms  prenakan kerbayas  very nicely with amazing style and grace A stay at Intercontinental Singapore always reaffirms why IHG is my hotel group of choice  with uncompromising service standards and amazing accommodations Room Tip  Heritage suites 354  358  360 are the largestSee more room tips

This is a classic Singapore  Raffles  style hotel  It s a little tired in places and some of the rooms could do with an update  or just a good redecoration  and the bathroom in my room was showing it s age  Having said that  it is a very pleasant place to spend a few nights Every single member of staff I encountered during my stay could not have been more friendly or professional  In fact  possibly the finest hospitality experience I have had from a hotel in my twenty years on the road  They cannot do enough for you  and they do it with a minimum of fuss and maximum efficiency  Many other fine hotels should be sending their guest service managers to stay for a few nights to see what the competition is achieving Highly recommended

A very good spread  The egg section was very helpful  The selection was wide from a cheese section  bakery section with fresh bread and pastries  There was also Western  Chinese and Japanese food and a full cereal and pancake station  Overall it is a bit pricey but is well worth it if you can part with the money  I would recommend not planning to eat until dinner to do just to the buffet and get the most of it

Return guests of this hotel for several times for staycation This is a return visit for the 1st time this year after a lull of a couple of months since our last visit to their chain at Changi airport As it is March school holidays we utilise and celebrate our 3 year old s birthday this round  Being a club member  we get a complimentary upgrade to a heritage room and a small chocolate birthday cake  Parking and wifi is free 18 3 Club lounge The service level upon arrival at the club lounge slightly differs  The staff at the desk are occupied with other check in guests so it feels slightly less welcoming  We find our way to an unoccupied sofa  Kudos to another lady staff who approaches us to promptly check us in and details of our past requests are verified  with some quick review on the overall club lounge services  We are served with beverages of our choice  water  coffee  twg  wine  etc   Cookies and biscuits  as well as fruits are self service Our club membership consists of Various plug ins  A nespresso machine for coffee lovers  Request for additional towels  etc is delivered within 5 minutes or less  Thumbs up efficiency  The windows can open up for a view of within
