The Lobby and Public Rooms are spacious with lots of light and are great for visiting and relaxing  The back door opens onto Bugis Junction with lots of shops and restaurants  The Raffles Hospital is also very close by  Our room on the 14th floor was a good size king facing east  We arrived just after midnight after a long flight and had booked the room for the previous day to be sure of getting to bed quickly  It all went smoothly  The Colonial Chinese room decor was fresh and relaxing  The public areas were elegant and inviting  The location is perfect for exploring the different cultural centers of Singapore  It is within walking distance of the Malay Heritage Centre  Little India around Serangoon Road and Raffles Place  The National Library is right across the street  The MRT station is nearby  We stayed at the Intercontinental for six nights Room Tip  Room 1403 is near the elevators and housekeeping but we were not disturbed by noise See more room tips

Booked thru Dwidaya Aeon   I was so thrilled when they put us in their heritage rooms  Though quite far from the elevator but the room was so big  We had 2 rooms  1 king and 1 double beds  with very comfy pillows i ve been slept with    been wondering where they bought that pillows   i would like to say thank you to Joy their concierge staff who had been so helpfull for taking cared my dad  Since he had a back ache so i asked to have room closer to the elevator  The process was so fast  Thanks to their reception  unfortunately i didnt get his name  I was checked in march 15 around 4 pm  Really loved this hotel   breakfast was good   service was excellent    The hotel is just next to bugis junction  So easy to find food  The Bugis Station MRT jus below the Bugis Junction    Highly recommended

Great hotel with a good location but a bit expensive Deluxe rooms look new and fresh  and are of good size and standard  Big comfortable beds  good desk for office work  big TV with a good selection of channels and a big bathroom with both a tub and shower  Cleaning service is good and room service quick Hotel got a spa in addition to a small outdoor pool  Pool is big enough and got a nice view from the 4th floor  Hotel also got a gym with several exercise machines in addition to a sauna and refreshments of cold water and fruit The hotel is situated only a 10 15min walk from Clarke Quay which is a good place for dinners or evening drinks  The hotel is also situated next door to the closest mall  Bugis junction  or just across the stress from a bigger shopping centre called Bugis  and the local market Princess street  Lots of stores  restaurants and supermarket is therefore only a short stroll from your room Breakfast has a huge selection compared to most hotels of both fruits  pastry  hot and cold foods  Wide variety of juices and a separate coffee bar is also serving fresh coffee delivered at your table all in all a great hotel  although a bit up the expensive range

it s our first time staying at this hotel and we were impressed with the room service received  Our requests were quickly addressed each time and we were delighted to receive a free room upgrade too  I really like the heritage feel of the hotel and not forgetting the live music played at the lounge in the afternoons and evenings  My 6 year old daughter was greatly inspired to practise hard on her piano because she wants to play just like the pianist  All in all  we thought the only improvement to this hotel would be its food quality  The breakfast buffet was mediocre with limited selection  However  the afternoon tea set was okay  Then again  the hotel is connected to Bugis Junction and the mall is a food paradise  In summary  it has been a pleasant stay

As Intercon Platinum ambassadors  we managed to check in early and get a room upgrade to a heritage room  I loved the nice welcome gift  of intercontinental tea specially mixed for the hotel  It was a wonderful touch The rooms were excellent  it was superbly clean and the linens are one of the best we have tried during our other stays in Asia  The double TVs in the room made it easy for us to watch movies and to just relax We also loved the lounge  it was spacious and the hightea sets looked tremendous  We would surely make it a point to try them the next time we are around Intercon SingaporeGreat location too  connected to a youthful mall and great affordable restaurants

Did a two nights stay at this hotel for the first time  The entire experience was wonderful right from check in to check out  The staff were all very friendly from the receptionist to the doorman to the housekeeper  The good size pool is inviting  while the nearby jacuzzi and sun bed  literally a bed size pool side chair  are equally pampering To top off the experience  they even sent over a nice cake for my wife birthday which is very thoughtful  I would recommend this hotel to all locals and tourists alike as this hotel is right in the midst of shopping centers  restaurants  and public transport MRT

Have stayed several times over last 2 years   amp  have never been disappointed with service levels  One of the best Club Lounges of all IC properties  Greatly appreciate that they now direct families with children to the Lobby Lounge area during evening cocktail hour  Too bad it is necessary  but many parents seem absolutely oblivious to the bad behavior of their children  or the disturbance to other guests  The property focuses on top quality service  amp  delivers  which is why I continue to return

This was our first time visiting this hotel and we loved it from the minute we walked in  We got upgraded to the heritage wing where the rooms felt warm and homely  The facilities within the room were modern with a variety of features including the Nespresso coffee maker  The hotel is located next to the Bugis shopping center so there are options for shopping and a movie theater  There is also a spa nearby for reasonable massages  Other attractions are nearby as well as long as you don t mind walking  Staff were incredibly friendly and helpful  My only comment for feedback is that their bathroom did not have the hand shower  used primarily by Muslim guest for personal hygiene   Other than this issue overall I would highly recommend this hotel

I spent one night on business at the Intercontinental Hotel in Singapore and it was good value for money  Our check in was quickly done and our rooms were comfortable and clean  The room had an impressive sized LCD TV and extra large bath towels which were soft and fluffy  The hotel is an old colonial building so it doesn t have a modern decor but it still looks good  I don t think the carpet upstairs in the guest rooms has stood the test of time   if they changed this it would be an improvement  The staff were friendly and it is rare to find a hotel that doesn t charge for printing  a big tick for business travelers  You have major shopping precincts right outside your door  I didn t get to see the pool but another hotel guest raved about it at breakfast on Sunday morning  The gym is small but all you probably need for a short stay  A hiccup on Sunday morning with only one lift working but this was rectified in a few hours  All in all it is worth considering a stay here if you want a comfortable place to stay in the heart of Singapore

Stayed here for a single night in April 2015 during the final leg of a SE Asia architecture roadshow including Jakarta  Penang and Kuala Lumpur  Hotel was selected by the local regional office and came highly recommended  It is very conveniently located   adjacent to Parco Bugis Junction   and I was able to meet up with an old university friend at a local jazz bar The public areas   ornate and highly decorative   are well presented  especially within the colonnaded lobby lounge The hotel room was a little tired in decor but I understand that the hotel was undergoing a partial refurbishment at the time  In room WIFI was intermittent and whilst staff endeavoured to improve connection  it was still insufficient to undertake computerised work Recommend to anyone requiring accommodation in Singapore

This hotel is centrally located and was an awesome pick for us  You can be on Sentosa in 15 mins  China town in 10 and Shops by the bay in 15  High tea is wonderful here and evening cocktails with amazing pianist cannot be beat  The breakfast  ours was included  covered many nations  but the Noodle Bowl was my favorite  Everyone helps you  just pure pleasure

Our only disappointment was that we only had one night  The room was very well laid out  spacious  comfortable and will nice modern features like multiple USB outlets to charge mobile devices and multi fit power outlets  Service at the hotel was very good   as you would expect from the Intercontinental Hotel  The location is very convenient to the Bugis Junction shops and MRT  and taxis   now becoming hard to get in Singapore   seemed to always be available at the door

We had a lovely time at the Intercontinental mainly because of it s efficient and friendly staff  From the moment we checked in to the time we left  we were treated like VIPs  There are plenty of shops and eateries next to the hotel so  you don t have to walk too far for a local meal     or  if you wanted to chill and relax at the pool  that s excellent too  We only had a short three night visit but  what a wonderful experience it was

The nature of our business implies much overseas traveling and staying in foreign environments  One gets pretty skilled in deciding quite quickly whether you will return or not to a place  restaurant or accommodation  This hotel ticked all the boxes we rate as essentials  Brilliant pick up at airport   quick check in  flexible and friendly but not in your face staff  super efficient to meet your requests  Soft and sublime bedding   Oh my kingdom for a decent pillow and mattress and a shower head that really works and a table to work at and and and  This hotel gets it right   Great breakfast  Great lunch   great meeting areas for fun and business  Great room service  Someone has actually considered the needs of guests here   Will be back for sure   Perhaps an in hotel shop selling the linen  towels  pillows and great gowns   Also to top it  value for money

Spent three nights here in March 2016 prior to a cruise  We had done so two years previously and so enjoyed the hotel we decided to return and we were not disappointed  We had booked an advance rate for a club room and could recommend doing this  The hotel has been refurbished since our last visit and has a pleasant and more modern  brighter look  On check in we were advised that the club lounge was serving afternoon tea and were whisked there to enjoy this whilst staff checked us in which was a lovely way to arrive  We also took advantage of the club lounge for breakfast which was a lovely little haven of calm and offered a full selection of items  We also took advantage of the happy hour cocktails  Love this hotel and the staff are friendly and efficient  The hotel has a lovely pool area and we enjoyed relaxing here  Attentive staff offering water and fruit was also welcomed

Under the IHG Brand  the Intercontinental Singapore does not disappoint Checking in is a breeze and If you are an Intercontinental Ambassador  you are greeted as such  complete with a momento gift on check in  2months ago  it was a soft toy of a Lion dressed in the Singapore flag  This month it was a Colorful Tin depicting the Heritage facade of the hotel with IWG Tea The rooms located at the new building are great but we always choose to stay at the heritage wing which are rooms on the 2nd and 3rd floors of the heritage shops that make up Bugis Junction Shopping Centre  The rooms there are a bit dated with some noise being right above the shopping area but we love the blend of modern amenities and heritage architecture For those who love 5 star modern quiet rooms  take the rooms at the main building but do request for rooms near the lift Buffet Breakfast at the Ash  amp  Elm is great  A wide spread of food to cater for all tastes  The atmosphere is relaxed as the tables are more spread out and it is a great way to start your day  If you are an Ambassador  Breakfast is included  If not  I would recommend that you book with a breakfast package  It is well worth the additional cost The Executive Lounge located on the 2nd floor is one of the best hotel lounges  the Service staff are great and attentive  Afternoon Tea and Evening Cocktails served everyday The hotel is located right on the Bugis Junction Shopping Mall which is a bustling mall with additional malls connected by Skywalk to Bugis Plus etc  You enter the mall from the back entrance of the Hotel and you are right in the mall The Bugis MRT station is located at the Bugis Junction and that brings you everywhere you need to go in Singapore My only complaint is that Taxis are sometimes hard to get during the busy hours due to the hotel entrance being located off a side road from Middle Road  But that said the doormen are always working hard to make sure that the taxis do turn into the hotel when there is a queue Love this hotel

An exclusive hotel  one of the best in Singapore  Spacious rooms  nicely equipped and comfortable  The room mate shows up at least twice per day to replace towels  close the curtains  to bring fresh complimentary water The staff is super friendly and helpful  The breakfast is awesome  I have to admit  one of the best I ever had  Fresh squeezed juices  home made various type of foods  Chinese  Japanese  Indian   It is just a  quot Wow quot

We arrived into Singapore on a Saturday morning  1 00 a m   from Washington after two flights totaling 21 hours  When we ultimately rolled into the InterContinental at 2 00 a m   we were thankfully met by a cheerful front desk clerk who  noting our mere 8 hour stay at the hotel  upgraded us to a beautifully appointed corner room in their renovated wing  After escorting us from the front desk to the elevators  a nice touch when you re tired and can t see straight    we found a very large room that was nicely broken up in the middle by a floor to ceiling TV stand   with one side having a little living room area with a couch  coffee table  and desk area  and the other having the bedroom area  Both sides had large flat screen TVs In terms of the extra touches   there was complimentary bottled water scattered throughout the room  a great selection of magazines  and high end toiletries in the bathroom that saved us from having to dig our toiletry kits out of our luggage Breakfast was included the next morning   and while the selection of entree breakfast dishes was fine   we were surprised that there weren t additional Asian dishes included  The individually bottled fresh juices was a nice touch   one that I haven t seen in other hotels before  Finally  the hotel is well positioned at Bugis Junction  which includes a shopping street in what had been the older shop stalls   but which have been beautifully preserved and protected in what is increasingly becoming a sterile  high tech Singapore  The rapid transit is about a two minute covered walk from the hotel   which is very convenient  Overall   great location  high quality service  nice extra touches  and while a bit off the beaten path and farther away from Orchard Road and some of the other shopping areas   it s actually nice to be at the Inter Con for that reason alone   not as crowded an area that is quieter   yet still accessible to everything Singapore has to offer

We have just enjoyed 6 nights at the Intercontinental Singapore  From the moment we walked through the lobby doors until we departed the staff have been wonderful  Everybody from the housekeeping team to the front of house have made us feel most welcome  a refreshing change to many large chain hotels where your business if barely acknowledged  let alone valued  This hotel is beautifully maintained  the public areas are well presented and spotless  Our recently refurbished deluxe room  424  was not large but was well equipped and again  spotless  Overall a wonderful stay and should we return to Singapore  would certainly come back

Loved the hotel  the decor  the room  the comfy bed  The hotel is just round the corner from Raffles and right opposite the bus stop for the hop on  hop off bus  Great breakfast selection  Staff very helpful but have to give a special mention to the Lobby Ambassador   Peter  Wonderful  Had worked at the hotel since it opened and was more than helpful   a credit to the hotel  All in all a fabulous couple of days

A nice luxury hotel situated within a mall itself which means shopping and eating and more shopping and eating    You can easily find all sort of cuisines within the mall or just across the street with plenty of restaurants to choose from  Fantastic location with the subway linked to the mall  easily accessible to other parts of Singapore  Service staffs are welcoming and provide excellent service  Room was nice and cosy and very well maintained indeed   not sure if they have any revamp recently though    Overall  we had a great stay Room Tip  Higher floor with a bit better view See more room tips

My family  2 adults and 1 kid  stayed in your hotel for 4 days in end of March to earlier Apr  All the staffs are polite and helpful  My room is spacious   clean and modem  The bed is very comfortable and double bed is provided as per our requested  The breakfast is great too  We are happy to stay in the hotel for our holidays Besides  we arrived the airport and found that we left a luggage in the room   Your team Lost  amp  Found helped us to arrange to post it to us to HK  We are very appreciate about that

A quick stay in Singapore after many years  I chose the intercontinental on the brand  So glad I did  From the opening of the taxi door on arrival to departure  it was an excellent experience  After a long day travelling  the front desk welcome was perfect   professional and pleasant  Thanks Alicia   The renovated room  floor 7  was beautiful and comfortable  but it was the little things that made the difference  such as a good strong shower  a decent iron  boutique teas and an interactive HD TV with local maps  information and the like  The MRT is on the same block  and there was always a cab in the driveway  so getting around was easy  I can t speak highly enough of the overall experience  and will certainly stay there again Room Tip  It is not a high building  so views are sunny but not expansive  I was on floor 7  which was excelle   See more room tips

Just stayed 4 nights M  Friday  The hotel doesn t have much in the way of vistas  if thats what your looking for  but its whats on the inside that counts  The location is smack in the middle of Bugis shopping and MRT  This makes it really convenient for restaurants and groceries  More so the underground station is in the basement  We had booked directly for a King Buisness room  with an automatic upgrade to the Club level This is where the service is noticeable  All the waitress ladies were exceptional and too many to list by name  but from the bottom of our hearts we thank them for spoiling us   Cant pass up not to mention the quality of the food  and beverage that was readily available to us during our stay  The Lobby lounge had a nice ambience to relax to some piano and vocals for an after dinner cocktail  We did use the pool on one occasion  and found it to be very good  Also has a well stocked Gym A mention to Joanne in reception for her kind friendship  and to the rest of the crew that you dont get to meet  Have stayed in a number of IC s and this rates up there with the best of them  Definitely would not hesitate to recommend   or return Thankyou for making it such a relaxing week

We stayed in a Deluxe King room on the 7th Floor with beautiful d? cor and the renowned comfortable bed  The new furnishings suit the colonial style of the hotel but have a modern touch  including a Nespresso machine  We had no problem with Wi Fi   All the staff we interacted with we charming and efficient  nothing is too much trouble  We enjoyed the pool but on one day there were no pool attendants so it was hard to work out which sun lounges were available as the towels from previous occupants had not been removed  However on the next day we were served icy fruit drinks and water and it was a much better experience  I think there needs to be more sun lounges as there seems only to be about twenty but the pool was at just the right temperature for cooling off and enjoying With direct access to Bugis Junction Shopping Mall it was easy to eat at the many cafes  take aways and restaurants without enduring the heat We really enjoyed our stay and would highly recommend this hotel Room Tip  high floorSee more room tips

During a business trip to Singapore I had the pleasure of staying at the Intercontinental Singapore  From the reception at the help desk to the checkout it was a great experience  The rooms are very modern  in perfect shape  and decorated in a very elegant colonial style  Amenities  sheets  towels    everything perfect The staff at the hotel and at the Victoria bar was very professional and attentive  and made my stay very pleasant  Definitively it will be my preferred hotel once I am back in Singapore Room Tip  Get a room in a higher floor to take advantage of the city viewsSee more room tips

Booked club room  Had a late night issue with the toilet and room cleanliness  Anna from the lounge was fabulous  She relocated me to a suite and even helped me pack  She was helpful and cheery for the whole stay  Loved the club lounge  Wilson was a hard worker  Cocktails are a lovely touch especially for me as i dont drink beer or wine  Really enjoyed afternoon tea as well  Was very busy at times  perhaps this is due to the complimentary guest policy  The lounge manager was also lovely  One of the other ladies at the desk  less so but I have experience this before  some females are more polite to men than women in club lounges  Breakfast was amazing but staff could be a bit nicer or friendlier when taking coffee orders or guiding you to your table but I understand that it was busy  Chef Gregory was great  Staff in Bugis minding the door never greeted us and sometimes were eating or on their phone  Did the free heritage tour  Cathy was fabulous and highly recommend it  Thanks Cathy you were hilarious  All in all loved it and cant wait to go back

Stayed here for 5 nights  Am a  priority  customer and booked a  Club  room Room was adequate and superficially quite clean  Closer inspection revealed dried urine around toilet hinged and loose bath handle fixings   with a rusty fastener and dirt visible  NOT what I expect from a hotel in this price range Internet access in room is not included  not even in Club rooms and costs a hefty  30 tax a day  Hotels in this price range need to learn that internet access is an essential for both business and leisure travellers these days and include it in the room rates  I ve stayed in much cheaper hotel with included internet access On arrival the room has ONE bottle of  free  mineral water   a couple of additional bottles were available  but at a staggering  12 tax each   This has to be some of the most expensive bottled water on Earth The Club Lounge was pretty good  but I found the staff to be little cool and officious  When my card didn t work one day I was made to stand outside the Club Lounge by the door whilst the receptionist sorted it out   rather than be allowed to sit down in the entry area Overall I would rate this as an acceptable hotel within the IHG group  but they do need to try a little harder in some areas

I have spent a lot of time in the hotel  I lived here for hundreds of room nights over a two year period so I know it well  It is a nice hotel with great staff  however   I just left after 6 days at this Intercon  I have not been to the hotel in a year  The prices for F amp B and other fees have been really crazy  totally out of alignment with other nice hotels in Singapore  A cheeseburger is  29    a pizza over  30  local dishes are now over  30    buffet breakfast is  42    I found this out when they argued with me that I didn t have breakfast included  Guest relations came to my room to see my confirmation e mail after not calling me back for hour and I missed breakfast anyway   Internet charges are  30 per day   1 min up to 30 mins with  30 max    1 per minute is really a dumb pricing plan Although I have a long history with this hotel  I am not going to recommend it any more because of the price gauging  Someone should tell this hotel that there are many hotels in Singapore that are nicer

We had an excellent two night stay at InterContinental Singapore in early July of 2009  We stayed in a premium room which was very comfortable and roomy Club lounge was quite nice  food drink selection was a bit limited though compared to other Asian lounges such as in Hong Kong  Bangkok or Bali  Service was efficient  but a bit cool  I can certainly recommend this hote

Visited Singapore with hubby and son  The hotel staff were most accommodating  Bought some food that needed to be frozen  Hotel staff most readily offered to freeze the food item for us  Room was clean  amenites well stocked daily  Check in was a breeze  front desk staff guided us to our rooms even though we arrived at the hotel early 10am  Late check out was given too  Would recommend the Inter Continental Hotel to all my friends for their wonderful service

Stayed here in a club room  and both my teenage daughter and I really loved this hotel  Quick check in on the club floor  and after dumping our luggage in the palatial room  we were in the club lounge within 10 mins of entering the hotel  After staying in the Ibis on the way to Europe  we quickly worked out that the Inter actually offers much better value     for an extra S 60  booked on the Inter site   I drank my fill of Long Island Teas  munched on beautiful Camembert  and woke to a truly wonderful buffet breakfast     thoroughly recommend this place

I booked my parents at this hotel for their 40th wedding anniversary  Soon after booking through Orbitz  I called the hotel staff to let them know of their arrival and to ask if they could help make this trip memorable for my parents  both pensioners with limited access to cash   They hotel staff  there was a new person every time I sent an email or called  courteously obliged and  quot upgraded quot  them  However  when my parents got there  the frontdesk has no idea about the  quot upgrade quot   Turns out the lady who offered us the upgrade didn t work there any more  Then  they asked my parents for a  quot security deposit quot  of 600 SGD  100 SGD per day   This came as a surprise   and embarrassment  to my parents who  as mentioned  were retirees with a small travel budget  who were on a trip that was a  quot gift quot  to them by me  There was no mention of this when booking the ticket   on Orbitz or on the Intercontinental website  Finally  the hotel staff dropped the deposit to 300 SGD and gave my parents their originally booked room  not the upgrade they had promised   After I called  from the US  and asked them about this confusion  they apologized and  quot re upgraded quot  my parents to some business class thingy  Yeah  my 70 year old retired parents were dying to use their new business meeting rooms  Despite all this  my parents have good words for the hotel staff and were very impressed with the cleanliness and quality of the housekeeping staff  Oh  by the way  we are still trying to recover the 300 SGD security deposit that the hotel claims they ve released  it s been a month since my parents  return   They re blaming my parents  bank  This begs the question   for a 5 star hotel that charges handsomely for room rates  why even bother collecting a deposit

Trying to find a decent affordable hotel in Singapore was a challenge  so we decided to opt for a recommended brand name  and the InterContinental didn t disappoint  Getting there from the Airport couldnt be easier its about a 5 min walk from the Bugis station and from the hotel it was easy to get to Singapore sights on foot  i e  Little India  Malay Quarter etc  Rooms were decent size  the beds and linen super comfy    so its a good place to recover from jetlag  Although not the cheapest hotel  I would stay here again  but only for short stays  small pool  so limited hanging out there  Service friendly and professional

I have stayed at the Inter Continental hotel many times and have always worn flip flops  I have never been treated poorly by staff and have never been met with a snobby attitude  In actual fact my husband and I will be returning to this wonderful hotel next month after a 2 week trip through Vietnam This hotel has the best location and the best rooms  The service has never been beaten by any other hotel in the world and I can honestly say I am used to all sorts of travelling  I have travelled first class and I have travelled with a backpack  In actual fact the last 2 times I have stayed at the Inter Con I have walked in carrying my trusty back pack wearing flips flops and was given the best service I have ever received  Even my back pack was carried up to my room placed nicely on the waiting luggage holder and we were told to have a great trip and enjoy our time in Singapore

We stayed for two nights in August and picked the hotel for its location and because it was attractively priced via a promotional rate  We had a king bedded Executive Club room  which was comfortably furnished though showing a little wear and tear around the corners  The bed and pillows were comfortable  the bathroom was clean with a deep  long bath and separate shower  there was no noise from adjacent rooms and everything worked just fine The ambience in the club lounge was very comfortable and relaxing with prompt  discreet and efficient staff  There were plenty of drinks and an appetising range of nibbles at afternoon tea and cocktails  We took our breakfast there on both mornings as it was included in our rate  We would like to have tried the main restaurant for breakfast as the dishes sounded delicious but the prices were rather scary even by Singapore standards  However  in the club lounge there was a surprisingly wide range of hot and cold foods that changed each day  something other club lounges could learn from and included soya milk and gluten free cereal  which showed that some thought had gone into it and was a real bonus for me So it was a pleasant and comfortable stay in a well located  good hotel with friendly  polite and efficient staff but somehow it lacked sparkle  I m not complaining and I would stay there again at the right price but it didn t deliver the five star experience that some other Singapore hotels do so well

We re just on our last day here at the Intercontinental Singapore and our stay has been fantastic  The hotel is well located for shopping eating and generally getting around town The staff are magnificent and very helpful  We ve stayed in a Club room and it s well worth the upgrade     the food and drinks are marvellous and the extra little treats as honeymooners have been great  Nothing is too hard for the team here  in fact i ll be heading back as soon as i can If you get the opportunity  book transport from the airport through the hotel  We had the best VIP experience imaginable     met at the airbridghe as we hopped off the plane  driven through the terminal on a golf buggy to a separate VIP terminal  all the while someone else was getting our bags an meeting us at the car  No lining up at all and we had our own immigration station  This whole experience took about 20 mins from leaving the plane to sitting in the back of the Mercedes    in fact the driver commented it should have been quicker   Anyway  this experience is definitely worth the S 150 and you arrive at the hotel refreshed and ready for a brilliant holiday     oops i forgot to mention the arrival greeting when we got to the hotel     concierge waiting in the driveway for us as we got out of the car and taken straight to our room Once again  the best holiday experience so far and am absolutely looking forward to the next chance i get to stay here

I stayed here for Free due to some inhouse promotion  Overall service is good  got check into the room that I can see the Fireworks without asking them to do that  Clean and luxourious hotel  but expect the service to be 5 stars but would think its at most 4  The checking out took way too long  A long queue quickly formed  would have expected it to be much faster for a 5 star hotel

Stayed for 2 nights in July  The Good  Very good location  which is 2 min walk to Bugis MRT which is attached to the Bugis Junction Mall  which is attached to the hotel itself  Very good breakfast spread although a bit on the pricey side  Rooms were clean  and very nicely furnished  Nice bathroom with separate shower and bath The Bad  Receptionist was on the phone for over a minute while i stood there staring at him  Night receptionist told me that parking was chargeable for all guests but the next morning when i asked the day receptionist  she told me it was free  On hindsight  I should have brought up the error to management but it slipped my mind  Asked for 3 electronic keycards but due to some bug  only 2 worked at any one time  Walls are rather thin  so had to keep reminding my visitors to tone down

It took 3 receptionists half an hour to check me in   even though I was the only person in the lobby  Nobody explained the facilities or even seemed like they knew what they were doing  The room I ended up with  424  had a small yard outside and then a concrete wall 6 feet away   no batural light  Whilst the staff were polite they seemd to have no comprehension about how to actually do anything  I travel a lot  IHG Priority Club Platinum card  and this is the worst IHG hotel I have ever stayed in  even worse than Holidaty Inn Express    go to the Fullerton

Stayed 2 nights recently for holiday before returning to Europe  Booked a King Club room via their own website  I m a Priority member and upon check in  we were taken to Club Lounge for a warm welcome and a drink  Excellent staff and service provided Room was on 10th floor  non smoking and king bed as requested and booked  Plenty of room for us 2  our luggages  Nice city view  facing the National Library and the Marina Room itself was nicely appointed with comfy King bed  LCD TV  too small I think      desk and chair  minibar  marble bathroom with separate Shower and Bath Free newspaper every morning in room Had breakfast in the cosy Club Lounge which was nice  We also took the opportunity to have a drink before dinner between 5 30 pm and 7 30pm with a nice buffet  Good wine and beer as well as soft drinks provided  TV in Club Lounge as well as WIFI and internet access with their computers Location is really good from airport  only 20 minutes drive by taxi  around 15 20 SGD   going for shopping or sightseeing  Hotel is adjacent to a shopping mall  Starbucks  24hour McDonalds  Bugis Street Market  7Eleven  Raffles Hotel for a drink is 10 min away and Bugis MRT  metro tube  station only 3 min walk The only complains I can make is the size of the LCD TV is too small  37 quot  or 40 quot  should be okay  for this hotel category as well as the internet access in room  I agree that internet should be free and included in the rate as a Club member or not  4 5  hotels in Asia usually includes this service complimentary  Wifi or Broadband  Anyway  a very good stay at Intercontinental Singapore  I ll be back there next time

I spent 4 night at the InterContinental in a Shop House Room  Although the room smelt musty and was quite a walk from reception  it was clean and quiet The Hotel has plenty of Restaurants on site and closeby  I would recommend The Olive Tree and Man Fu Yuan Restaurant in the hotel and there are numerous eateries restaurants in the Bugis Street Shopping Complex next to the Hotel  The Bugis Street Junction also has a Kinokuniya book shop  which has plenty of English novels literature The Intercontinental is quite central  it is close to Raffles City   10 minute walk   where you can indulge in western labels and Raffles  for a Singapore Sling The Singapore Art Museum is nearby Taxis are very reasonable and a quick and efficient way to travel  Singapore has lost a lot of its Oriental Spirit  It is like Dubai on speed  If you enjoy shopping and high rise buildings  you will enjoy Singapore  If you are a culture vulture who enjoys the real flavour of the Orient  you will be disappointed

Stayed there for 4 nights during the Singapore Night Grand Prix so paid more  maybe USD 100 more per night  than regular rates  But we got free internet which was very helpful  But this rate was still far cheaper than what the other hotels in the area were charging during the Grand Prix weekend  And I got upgraded to a better room as I am Priority Gold Card member which was a pleasant surprise  I did not eat a single meal in the hotel but it had a variety of cuisines on offer and a nice  outdoor style coffee shop for breakfast  The only downside was their in room dining  It was extremely limited and the one night that I placed an order  at 2 30am    the said it would take 45 mins due to the rush  At 2 30am  So I canceled it and went to bed hungry Otherwise  it s a charming hotel with nice rooms and bathroom  I was given a room at the very end of the hotel which was a bit of trek from the lobby  And for the first two nights there was constant banging from the adjoining building which I complained about  The Duty Manager took care of it and ensured that the work stopped till I checked out which was very helpful  It is also adjacent to a Mall so you can always go there for your morning breakfast  coffee or even lunch  It has a 24 hr McDs which also came in good use  The location is nice   next to a subway station which is useful and close to the CDB in case you need to attend a meeting there  So all in all a very comfortable stay with a very helpful and friendly staff  They even helped me get a last minute booking at a hotel in Kuala Lumpur where I was headed next

My girlfriend and I just spent a wonderful week at The Intercontinental  Check in was so fast and easy  Hotel staff were extremely friendly and helpful at all times during our stay  Nothing was ever too much bother  and EVERY staff member whether it be concierge  front desk  housemaids  wait staff at breakfast or at the business centre would always ask after us or greet us with a genuine warmth and sincerity  We really appreciated the late check out  and fresh fruit and bottled water on arrival  Best of all my girlfriend became my fiancee during our stay     Thanks to everyone at the Intercontinental  We can t wait to return to your lovely hotel and city

i stayed at the InterContinental during a business trip  It was my first time to Singapore so I cannot compare it to other hotels  But I must say  this hotel is one of the best i ve ever stayed in  The hotel itself is beautiful  decorated in an old chinese style  which I just loved  The rooms were big   two queen beds  big bathroom  shower and bath tub   My room was on the 4th floor so it had an outdoor patio  small  that led to the swimming pool  What I enjoyed most was the Club Lounge  It was included in my rate  definitely get this because the service and amenities are unbeatable  Free breakfast  large buffet including omelets made to order   Free drinks and snacks all day  After a long day of meetings it was nice to just unwind at the Club Lounge before dinner  Free internet  broadband cable  in the room  and free wifi in the lobby and club lounge  The Club Lounge benefits made all the difference  Overall  great hotel  friendly staff  luxurious hotel

Stayed for 3 nights in King Premier Room with my husband and 3 month old baby  Room good size   clean and comfortable Liked Location   Close to Marina and Raffles   Shopping centre connected to hotel   note if in Singapore to shop then would need to get taxi to Orchard RoadLounge area   Great for informal business meetings Service   We found it generally good   prompt check in and out  Room service arrived promptly Pool area   Nice and quiet  Disliked Took almost an hour for the baby cot to be delivered despite being pre ordered    and our baby was ready for bed  Internet charges   they charged for  30 plus tax EACH laptop per day    in this day and age it should be freePool area   very small

We booked into the Intercontinental for 6 nights in September 2009  We had limited expectations of the hotel and Singapore itself as the holiday was only planned to use up frequent flyer points however we were surprised by the level of service and quality of the hotel We had one slight problem  we booked into the Shophouse rooms  which are an upgrade from the standard room  We had requested interconnecting as we were travelling with children  On arrival we were told that there are no interconnecting rooms for the Shophouse rooms so it was impossible to meet our request  The receptionist offered us to look at the standard room and the shophouse rooms to decided if we wanted to drop back  We were shown the two different rooms by a very friendly concierge who was more than happy to answer any of our questions The Shophouse rooms were nice but looked tired and were some distance to walk from the lobby  The standard rooms were much nicer  had the same style of bathroom and high ceilings  The rooms we were given were at the front of the hotel and overlooked the swimming pool  Needless to say given that they were interconnecting and nicer we decided to go with them The hotel gave us free internet in one room for the inconvenience and credited us the difference in the room prices to our account to use for breakfast for the four of us for three mornings Eating at the hotel is what your would expect from a hotel of this standard with prices to match  We were caught out on the first evening with the buffet dinner as we didn t click that the price quoted did not include both the taxes  This is seen everywhere in Singapore as    after the price  There is a good shopping centre connected to the hotel which has a variety of takeaway and eat in restaurants  There is also a supermarket which is handy to buy basic items Across the road  at the far end on the shopping centre is the Bugis Street markets which are known as the largest in Singapore  You will find lots of cheap clothing and all those  tacky  and unique gifts to take home The overall feeling that we had at the hotel was friendly and welcoming  You never passed a staff member without them saying hello and there was always someone there to serve you  The hotel is located within walking distance of several shopping malls and to the Raffles hotel and shopping complex  Well worth the walk to have a Singapore Sling but be warned they are not the cheapest but it is a must do to have a Sling at Raffles

I was there for work for only one nite and didnt  get much sleep  However I was very impressed with the service at the hotel  Hotel staffs were nice and helpful  The thing is that I had to go out for dinner with my boss and colleagues and found out that I forgot my mascara  No time to go get it  though the mall was right next to the hotel  I rang up and didn t expect anyone to go get it for me but I was very impressed that the concierge  he s a guy  did do for me  He asked me nicely of which brand and model to get  he got no clue  but then when I returned it was the one I always used  Thank you Also the bed was very nice  though I didn t spend much time in the room   busy meeting

I have stayed at the Intercon four times on visits to Singapore and each time has been pleasurable and extremely comfortable  On this latest trip  I arrived after midnight following a long 18 hour trip from Honolulu via Tokyo  The room was not quite what I had booked  but when I pointed this out  it was quickly changed   even though the hotel was full  Being on a low floor and facing the pool  I thought that perhaps noise might intrude  but not at all  The room was a haven of peace and quiet  ideal for getting over jet lag and preparing for meetings  Overall  the ambience and decor is far more restful that the enormous atrium hotels around the Convention Centre  The location is ideal because it has an MRT station within two minutes walk and all under cover  The breakfast buffet is plentiful with a lot of variety  Indeed the breakfast room is more like a cosy brasserie than a hotel restaurant  If I have one small complaint it is the cost of internet use   but that is common now to a lot of hotels  unfortunately

I ve stayed at the Intercontinental Singapore twice over the past month  both times check in was fast and easy  spotlessly large clean rooms  with a little wear  amp  tear   very comfortable beds with pillow menu  huge bathroom  great pool and gym This is a very nice hotel close to the other 5 star hotels  Raffles is only two blocks away  I caught taxi s to Orchard Rd as it was a long walk at a cost of  5 Food and drinks were of a very high standard but expensive at the restaurants  Bugis Shopping  amp  Restaurtants are right next door to the hotel with Starbucks  McDonalds etcThey gave me late checkout at no additional cost  the staff were always warm and friendly  I would definitely stay again

From being greeted at our taxi door on arrival  to our early morning wake up call  repeated 5 minutes later to ensure we HAD got up  for our departure  this was a fantastic experience Not in Club or Shophouse rooms but our hotel rooms were big  all our requests provided without a problem  smiles and good service all the way  Well done to the staff   very much appreciated Would highly recommend to all

My sister and I recently stayed at this hotel and found it absolutely devine We went on a shopping trip  and were delighted to find a fantastic shopping centre   Bugis Junction  literally straight out of the rear entrance to the hotel  It also leads directly to the brilliant MRT  underground railroad system  which is the cheapest  and easiest way to get around the city We paid for Club rooms  which was a fantastic bargain as it included an amazing breakfast  delicious afternoon teas with devine cakes and sandwiches  and then drinks and canap? s in the evening  We found we didn t really need to buy any other food during the day other than a very light lunch  The club Lounge where it was all served was a large  comfortable room  with either tables and chairs  or loungesand beautifully decorated  There was also 24hr access to the room with free internet and board room available Our rooms were large  beautiful and extremely quiet with no noise to be heard from the hallway  The beds were the most comfortable hotel beds I have ever slept in  with even the pillows king size We were on the 13th floor and had amazing views of the city  especially at night The gym was accessable 24 hrs a day  and was well equipped with all the latest gear  even a personal trainer if you need one The piano lounge near the foyer was massive  with many private areas for entertaining friends The pool area outside was delightful  with a smaller shallow pool for children  and a great view of the national library accross the road All in all a very grand  majestic hotel  highly recommended  I would definitely return again

This hotel is one of the best I have ever stayed in for service and comfort We stayed for two nights  arriving at 9am without advance notice and they found us a lovely room almost immediately  The staff service was excellent and they could not do too much for us  The bed in our room was glorious and so comfortable  that I just fell asleep as soon as I laid down The location was fine  It was adjacent to a reasonable shopping centre if you wanted to eat out and was close to the BUGIS MRT station  Raffles and the river area were within reasonable walking distance

My two week stay at the Intercontinental Hotel in Singapore was truly a great experience  Location in Bugis was very convenient  with a large shopping mall and MRT underneath and the night markets close by  great for wandering around and picking up random knick knacks  The staff were wonderful  very polite and friendly  Every morning when I walked down to breakfast I was always greeted with a smile a  good morning  from every staff member I passed without fail  The buffet breakfast had a massive selection of different foods which catered for all cultures  asian  western etc The rooms are beautifully furnished  spacious and well maintained  The bed was definitely one of the most comfortable ones I have ever slept in  Large flatscreen TV  desk and armchair completed the elegant look of the room  There was a generous selection of teas coffees and the bathroom was roomy and contained both a shower and separate bath Would definitely recommend this hotel as a place to stay and would not hesitate in coming back here in the future

This hotel offers outstanding service and is in a very good location for a stopover  You can take the MRT from the airport to BUGIS in about 20 mins  Get off at BUGIS and enter the Mall there and you will pick up signs to the Intercontinental which is attached to the mall   5 mins walk We went for a higher priced room   the lowest price rooms are a bit gloomy  Our room was excellent and we couldn t have asked for better service  Very happy with it

I am a local  When the hotel had a promotion  I cannot pass it    the hotel is one of the best we had stayed  Much better than some of the 5 stars hotels our there  We loved the swimming pool  Our room had 2 queen sizes bed  We even had a pillow menu     so very nice The only question is     when can we return for another visit

Five star is how you would rate this hotel  nothing is to much trouble for the staff  essential oil burners throughout the lobby and spacious rooms upto date decor   We booked via an internet site and the rate was resonable so we expected a small room with no view for our money  Upon check in we had a lovely room overlooking the pool  2pm check out without asking and a free fruit basket and bottled water waiting for us in our room  Location is excellent with the hotel joining a mall filled with upmarket shops and cafes  We are heading back in the New year because it was so good

Very nice Hotel   great restaurants and excellent service   as should be expected by toplevel hotels in Asia  Stayed here many times and always feel good about it   Only draw back is location   a bit out of the way Rooms are of good size   even the standard room   as is the bathroom  Bed is comfortable TV channels in English   unfortunately somewhat limited

As a stopover for 3 days on our way to Thailand to visit rellies  we  self  missus and 11YO daughter  we booked this hotel on the basis of the TA results here  Exceptional service  and that  quot welcome home quot  greeting that we received every time we came through the front door  should have been enough to convince us to to stay here on our return  a week later  We left for Thailand after 3 days  and stayed at the Stamford Swissotel  see separate review   but our initial experience with the Intercontinental should have been sufficient to ensure our return visit  I m sorry to say  I paid extra money to stay at a more  quot as perceived quot  upmarket hotel  Never again The staff here are simply lovely people  every one of them We received an upgrade for no apparent reason  other than the wife has a Priority Card  that she hasn t use for donkeys years  and we received the royal treatment from day one  I ve tried previously to claim points on my Marriott Sheraton Hilton cards to no avail  but these guys are way ahead of them  They know who you are before you arrive  and treat you with the utmost respect when you get there Rooms are spacious  staff are only too helpful with directions and advice as to how to get to wherever you want to go    and if you can t get it in the hotel  then they will point you in the right direction The  air conditioned  shopping mall street adjacent to the hotel caters to every taste and whim   the downstairs lounge and Victoria Bar staff keep you well supplied with whatever you fancy after a warm days  shopping  and the front counter staff can arrange anything you desire at a moments notice  The APEC Forum was happening during our visit also  but staff were attentive to our needs as well as those more  quot demanding quot  guests If you can consider that the staff managed to still keep an 11YO happy with the service level and staff interaction despite the attendance of various members of the APEC Convention  then I think you can give this place a big tick    Thanks to you all   you made this visit a very enjoyable stay  and we ll be happy to do it again soon Ric Nol  amp  Madison

Stayed at the hotel during the 2009 APEC meetings  as a result the hotel was packed  but the service was great none the less  I booked the basic deluxe room  and it was upgraded to a primer room three days out  due to Royal Ambassador status   but all primer rooms had King beds  so I pick a Souphouse room instead  and I was granted club access as a result  The room wasn t the biggest at 38 SQMs  but the design made it feel very spacious  and the British colonial background made it feel traditional   but in a swanky way  pardon the oxymoron   The club lounge was quite spacious  compared to some other downtown intercontinental properties  but its more suited to dinning than lounging in my opinion  and the lack of power outlets could become problematic  However the excellent breakfast  evening cocktail services and fantastic staff more than made up for its shortcomings  Excellent property  although the location could be better  the hard product and the services makes you want to take a longer journey from the city center  defiantly recommend for anyone on a business or pleasure trip

I stayed at the Intercontinental Singapore for 4 nights  I stayed in a deluxe room   I did not get an upgrade with my Ambassador status as the next room category was full however I did get free access to the Club Intercontinental The hotel is lovely   really great atmosphere and very Raffles esque  The location is brilliant   a 5 min walk to the Raffles plaza and the hotel is connected to the Burgis Mall and with that an MRT station so you can get pretty much anywhere in a short space of time The room was very comfortable   great big bed and nice furniture  I did not have a great view but it was not what I was here for  The hotel has a very grand feel to it and the staff help that feeling along I used the Club Intercontinetal every day   well worth the money if you get it as part of your room rate  The breakfast is better than most hotels   with an egg station and lots of choices of breakfast items  High Tea is nice sandwiches and the like  but the evening drinks reception is superb  You can use it as your evening meal if you wanted to and free wine and beer   all of good quality  not just  house wine   I tried to leave to eat elsewhere but the food was just too delicious I also ate in the Chinese restaurant here   they had a special offer for hotel guest of a tasting menu paired with wine   extremely good value for money and totally delicious   go for it if they still have it on Bottom line   hotel has a very Colonial exotic feel   very comfortable and great staff

normally I comment first on room and location  this time our experience was like a test for the service quality caused by heavy toothache of my wife when checking in after our flight from Europe  We asked the receptionist on duty for assistance to help finding a dentist  That proved to be complicated as it was already 6 PM and dental clinics already closed or fully booked  Mrs  Satthya accomodated us first to our room and continued to phone around  After a while she had succeeded to make an appointment and suggested that she would book a taxi and explain the address to the driver  It worked out well  When we returned  my wife relieved of pain  we felt grateful and wanted to give her a gratuity  Mrs  Satthya refused insisting that what she did was just her duty We found really an outstanding service dedication that is rare Otherwise Interconti Singapore has an unbeatable location in short walking distance of Raffles City Shopping Plaza  the historical center and good restaurants  KO  the japanese restaurant in the hotel served very fresh and delicious food The Hotel is shining  has a marvelous  noble lobby lounge to sip a singapore sling with life music  Organization and orientation of staff is perfect in all areas and give you a warm hospitality feeling Rooms are in english style and have everything one needs A stay is higly recommended

We stayed in the Junior Suite under the hotel s 14 Anniversary Promo  The size of the room was really spacious for my 2 young kids to run around in the room  The hotel and room was sparkling clean  Recommend to pay for the facilities in the club lounge too  The service by the staff was truly excellent and my family was given very personal service by the staff at the club lounge  Overall experience in this hotel is excellent and will definitely stay in this hotel again

My husband and I stayed at 5 top rated hotels during our recent 24 day holiday and the IC Singapore didn t let us down  The location was great  It was walking distance to shopping  the Flyer  Little India  the underground  We upgraded to the Club lounge and were offered breakfast  all day refreshments  tea and cocktails for  90 Singapore  This was cheaper than HK  The Club was located on the second floor  The pool and spa was located on 4  The regular rooms are an average size and offered a bathroom with a single sink  separate deep tub and shower  We are Ambassador Gold  so we were upgraded to a large junior suite  Upon arrival  our suite wasn t ready  but we were immediately ushered into another room to use  without a request   The entire registration process took place in the room  which I believe is reserved for Ambassador members  and is a lovely touch  We were presented with placemats and chopsticks as a gift  Additonally  fruit and water were available free of charge  Bath amenities were Elemis and include moisturizer  shampoo  conditioner  liquid soap and nothing else  which is surprising  The concierge was excellent  Giving us superior help and providing us whatever we required in an ultra personalized approach  The hotel is attached to a mall  where discounts are available  The lobby is very large and elegantly designed  without having a business feeling  It offers a very nice high tea as well as provides a nice  welcoming sitting area for those not having club priviledges  We stayed at the Hong Kong Intercontinental  the Hilton Beijing  the Opposite House in Beijing  and the Shangri La in Bangkok during the past 24 days  It was very different from the other hotels  but overall  I preferred it to the IC Hong Kong

We stayed for seven nights at the Intercontinental as part of our two week vacation in Singapore Our first couple of nights were blighted by flashing lights in our room from a message on the telephone  amp  more annoyingly from the smoke detector above my head when laying in bed  We eventually found the hotel book hidden away at the back of the drawer  amp  managed to get rid of the message  We reported the smoke alarm but told this was normal  we have been to many hotels  amp  never had this before  Two white LED s flashing every five seconds  amp  every couple of hours on full for about a minute  This is quite disconcerting when laying awake due to jet lag etc  We did get used to it in the end mainly because of sleeping better  I did think about trying to buy some black tape to cover them over  That s the bad bit out of the way now for the many good points  On our arrival we explained that we would be going to another hotel at the end of our stay  amp  it was no trouble to extend our checkout time to 14 00 at no extra cost  The staff were all very pleasant  probably the best out of the three hotels we stayed in  Breakfast was very good  no hassle to hurry up when we turned up towards the end of the serving one morning  Items were replenished constantly  tea  amp  coffee brought promptly For evening meals the hotel is adjoined to the Bugis Mall which provides many eating places both upstairs  amp  in the basement  If you don t want to walk too far then we found the Japanese Coffee shop right opposite the hotel doors provided very good meals  They mix Japanese with western  I had chicken balls with pasta one evening which was very tasty  Should you wish to stretch your legs then the Foodcourt in Raffles City Mall  10 mins walk  is very good value for money  We had a three course meal for under S 10  which saves a lot of money over a two week period  Great atmosphere as many people use this on their way home from work  I couldn t quite bring myself to try the Pigs innards soup though  We liked the Intercontinental  yes it could do with a coat of emulsion in various areas of the hotel but it is clean  amp  tidy  The location is one of the best  great for Little India  Malay Quarters  City Hall  Museums  Marina  amp  Orchard Road all within walking distance We would definitely stay here again  amp  easily recommend it to others

Stayed here towards the end of September after spotting their  14th birthday promotion  on their official website  Stay on a Friday and Saturday is free  We paid a total of SGD295 for both nights  all taxes incl     which is quite a steal for a hotel of this standard  The hotel is conveniently located at  adjoined to  Bugis Junction which is one of the busier shopping malls in the area  with the train reaching the basement of the mall  Bugis Station   which is a direct line from the Airport taking about 20 25mins   Across the road from Bugis Junction is another newly opened mall iluma  Tired of malls  restaurants and prefer to experience the real Singapore  You can find some pretty good local food in the Bugis area from Chicken rice to Dim sum and Fried Wanton noodles   Sunshine Plaza  which are all within a 5min walk  Venturing further out      City Hall mrt station  1 station away from Bugis   More shopping malls like Raffles City  Suntec City  Duck tours   Esplanade Concert Hall  Chijmes  a nice place to head to for dinner and or live football action   Raffles Hotel  for a Singapore Sling  a very touristy thing to do  hint   etc We stayed in a Deluxe room and as expected it was clean and had 2 floor to ceiling balcony like french windows with views of the interior of the mall  The location of our room faced the 2nd level restaurants of the mall  a stone s throw literally  which can be quite noisy in the daytime and you ll need to draw the drapes for privacy  Not too much of a problem as we were not in the hotel during the day  The room was spacious enough with a large King bed and comfortable soft lighting and decor  refer to pics   We did not try the hotel restaurants as there were so many other eateries just around the corner that we wanted to try  The service  as noted by most of the other reviewers  was impeccable from the moment we checked in and that played a big part in making our stay a really pleasant one

My friend and I stayed at the Intercontinental for 3 nights on our outward journey to Austrailia and found it a delightfull place to stay  We arrived at about 9 am and were quickly checked in and shown to our room immediately with no extra charge  much appreciated after a 14 hour journey from England   The hotel feels very homely because the foyer is not huge and impersonal  and it never felt busy at any time during our stay  The staff were friendly and efficient and always had a smile and a hello for us  The feel of the hotel is old world charm with lots of wood   flowers and antiques  and felt luxourious without being intimidating or too glitzy  Our room on the 15th floor had a great view towards the Marina and over the roof tops of Raffles and was charming and well appointed  with really comfortable large twin beds with space in between and all around  The bathroom was marble with a great mirror and separate shower cubicle  Breakfast was very good in a light filled atriium   a lovely way to start the day  Pool area is a little small and is shaded by the building untill about 11 30am so no sunbathing in the morning which was a problem on the days we were there as it was only sunny until the daily heavy showers about 3pm  Only gripe    late checkout as promised in the luxury weekend deal we had was not   as we thought  automatically included  we had to wait untill the day of departure to have it confirmed   and only got till 2pm when we begged   Raffles plaza gave us till 3pm on an ordinary week nite without quibble or charge  immediately on check in   But all in a great comfortable hotel with the added attraction of a lively shopping area attached and colourfull Bugis St market just across the road for a less sanitised shoppping experience if you want it  Would stay again if I could get the same advance room rate  which was very cheap at ? 72 00 a night booked direct through the Intercontinental web site

The hotel was 1st class   great location  nice friendly staff  good breakfast  very luxurious bedroom and bathroom  We stayed in a club intercontinental room and i would advise anyone else to do the same   breakfast is served in the club lounge and is fantastic  a whole range of fresh and exotic frutis and juices   staff greeting you each morning by name and a free bar between 5 7pm every night   We would definately stay here again

Check in handled well   allocated 5th floor rooms Connecting doors not opened due to spring closure   soon rectified by 2 door stops though Little view from room  just the roof of adjacent shopping centre Comfortable beds  seperate step in shower cubicle  very well appointed Small pool  amp  kids pool   only 18 sun beds but usually some available Good location with small shopping centre  good food court  amp  MRT linked to hotel Thought the restaurants were expensive compared to the local outlets Staff friendly  amp  helpful although failed to advise an attraction was closed when ordering a cab for us Definately recommended though

I booked this hotel for one night  1 April   following the recommendations from the Trip Advisor forums  I had an early flight from Mumbai and I got to the hotel at 7 30 AM  I was expecting to use their left luggage service until I could check in  but they gave me a room that early  which was fantastic  They apologised because it had 2 single beds instead of one  but they were big enough  The room was spacious  clean and looked great  just like the hotel as a whole  Their gym is open 24 hours a day  which is something I ve never seen anywhere else As a footnote  I pre paid the room  and discovered that for some reason they had charged 6 nights instead of one  But I told them and they immediately debited my card  I paid 95 Euro  which I think is a reasonable price for such a hotel I really enjoyed my stay in Singapore  and I ll certainly return to this hotel as soon as I have a chance to come back to this beautiful city country

I stayed at this hotel twice during a recent overseas trip  I found the reception area very intimate and well manned  Upon asking to check in I was met by a guest relations employee who took me up to my room straight away and performed in room check in  part of being a Platinum member  it was a nice touch  This same employee recognized me a month later when I returned and enquired about my holidays  The room was well appointed  not my favorite d? cor but nonetheless nice   I was upgraded to a club room with no access to the club  although this didn¡¯t bother me it would have been nice to have been informed   The cleanliness and maintenance of the room were just ok ?  some dust and surfaces scratched  nothing that a quick preventative maintenance couldn¡¯t fix  The staff was very helpful and pleasant  Had cocktails in the lobby bar  which to me was one of the highlight of my stay  The staff was efficient and yet invisible   giving me enough room to just sit there and read a book  The business center was well equipped and staffed  Had breakfast one morning  It was a little overpriced but a good selection for all tastes  The hotel is convenient

We took up a great package for 3 days and 2 nights  The service was excellent   great  friendly and proactive staff  Even before stepping into the hotel  the  quot reservations quot  personnel at the hotel were very helpful when my wife called to enquire about room rates  The price and selection for the breakfast was very good and value for money  as was dinner when we decided to eat in one night after a long day of shopping  The location was good with loads of things to do at night   shopping and food    and connected to the MRT station  It has been about 15 years since the last time I stepped into the hotel  and I was pleasantly surprised to find that there was no evident wear and tear  and the room did not look outdated  It was cosy  comfortable and well appointed  Bathroom was tastefully decorated with a bathtub There was also a nice pool   although a little small   One tip   It is best to call the hotel directly instead of the toll free line when checking out promotions

We booked at the airport  We special ask if there was a balcony  There was he said  When we arrevid at the hotel  the room didn? t have a balcony  When we arrived to the hotel we feel very welcom  We went to the front desk and told them we booked with balcony They were very kind and tryed to phone the office where we have booked  They don? t picked up the phone  The reception told us we get an another room  Well this is it  The best ever in Singapore  We where upgrated to an suite with an inside balcony  We stayed in many tophotels in Singapore  but we didn? t have got more service and attention then in this hotel  We come to Singapore every year and now we know which hotel we want to booked We will recommend this hotel to our family  friends and business partners

I have stayed at the Intercontinental Singapore three times  always whilst passing through from Australia to Europe  Every time  I look forward to my stopover thanks to this hotel  it is an absolute delight  Staff are courteous  friendly and always available  The rooms are spacious  soundproof  stylish and impeccably clean and the bars and restaurants are first class  Buffet breakfast was high quality and impressive  I would not stay anywhere else

Usual solid IC standard  Top service as usual  If you pay the 40 euros for the airport pick up things are as fast as 35 minutes from airplane door to hotelroom   all seamless as they will wait for you right as you step off the plane and when the Merccedes pulls over at the hotel lobby  you are greeted and ushered to your room for check in formalities  Top  Just the room is not spectaculor and a bit dated  Internet connection was not very fast

We stayed one night on 3rd Dec 2009  We arrived very late in the evening after a couple of long flights from New Zealand  Check in was a bit slow  but we were offered a ?  price upgrade to the club which we accepted  The room was comfortably furnished with lots of chairs  The view from the window was lousy  overlooking the roof of Bugis Junction Shopping centre  The beds were very comfortable and I slept well  The bathroom was marble and had lots of room with separate bath and shower  The shower wasn t as powerful as I would have hoped  The club lounge was nice  Large with plenty of room  Quite a choice for breakfast with a dedicated egg chef  The evening drinks and canapes were a bit odd as they only laid out wines and beers and gave no indication of any other drinks available  We only found out the full range when we asked  We had been granted a late checkout until 3pm  I m a Priority Club member   but the upgrade meant we could use the club facilities even after we d checked out The lobby was large and very busy with lots of people going to and from Bugis Junction  The staff were very attentive

My wife and I spent several hours on _x001C_Travel Advisor_x001D_ to decide on a location to stay in Singapore   I had travelled to Singapore previously for work and resided in a serviced apartment in the outer suburbs  however  as this trip was a holiday I wanted it to be just right for an _x001C_Adults_x001D_ get away  My wife fell in love with the pictures of the hotel because she likened the lounge bar area as a scene from an Agatha Christie novel  On arrival we were in awe and indeed I fell in love with the hotel too  From the moment we arrived we were made to feel special and that we were indeed staying in 5 star accommodation  The hotel has buckets of charm and the staff are all pleasant  helpful and willing to assist in any way possible  We had a deluxe room which overlooked the Bugis Junction mall  The room  for a bottom of the price list  was very pleasant  roomy and it was also a joy to take a shower and or bath in the more than ample bathroom  A quick lift ride to level 4 brought us to the pool which is very much worth a look as the gardeners have paid fastidious attention to maintaining the tropical plants that curb the crystal clear waters We had breakfast included in our package and I was more than pleased that we took this option as the spread was not only spectacular but delicious  Again  the waiting staff were great  The lounge bar is a little pricier than an alcoholic beverage purchased in the hawker markets but well worth it to soak up the ambiance  not to mention the magnificent voice of Kathleen who tinkled the ivories on the grand piano in the evening  Directly attached to the hotel is the Bugis Junction shopping mall which is an air conditioned pleasure  There are plenty of shops and stalls with many items at fair prices  On the second level is an eatery that closes at 2200h and has plenty of foods to choose from at very reasonable prices if you can not afford the luxury of eating at the hotel restaurant each night  On the other side of the Bugis Junction is the MRT rail system that will take you pretty much anywhere you wish to go in Singapore  We were able to shoot of to Orchard Road  China Town and many other destinations in under 20mins  If you are a tourist  ask in the MRT station about the tourist multi trip

The hotel was having a good deal of 2nd night being free so we had a 3d2n staycation over the Hari Raya long weekend  Check in was 2pm but was informed at 3pm that the room was not ready  I had the choice of waiting or  upgraded  to a shophouse room which was on the 2nd floor  I picked the latter  It was highlighted that the room was in another wing would be quite a walk  but it turned out to be out on  The rest of the room was just that  and to be honest  I felt the room was not deserving of 5 star rating at all  even though it is quite spacious  it had plenty of space even after adding 2 anything  I was given no answer because  quot  the technician usually doesn t tell us or report to us after checking quot   So erm  what was the purpose of the visit then   We decided to freeze our brains for the rest of the stay since the hotel couldnt do anything about it Didnt have the chance to try the breakfast  but the high tea at the lobby lounge was pricey at  40 per person but little
