pictures when I get them from my friends

After reading previous reviews i was very dissapointed  Ive stayed at the st regis  mandarin oriental  and the conrad all in singapore and have to say the Intercontinental singapore is not in the same league or even close to these other hotels  I cant think where all these previous good reviews have come from  I stayed on business for 3 nights in a club room  the club lounge was a joke  staff rude  and on your case for the littlelist charge that went over your allowance  the rooms are old  dirty  and with no great views at all unless you like like looking over shopping malls  Had a meal in the chinease in the hotel very poor  cold   boring no wonder there was no one ever in there  I travel on business from the uk most months and have to say this is one of my worst experiences and would never stay here again a massive let down

This was my first time at the InterContinental Hotel Singapore  and I was very positively surprised  It is in fact located next to the Bugis Junction Shopping Centre  which offers a variety of cheap  but delicious restaurants The hotel and interior design is colonial  and very stylish  Most impressive is the lobby  I had shophouse room  which was nice  cozy  although I don t consider it worthwhile paying extra for this  I had paid for breakfast  but only had it once  It was ok  but frankly  considering there is a large shopping centre right next door  it is no problem to get breakfast at a fraction of the cost  Same goes for the restaurants  which were almost 10 times the price of the average Singaporean restaurants  This I thought was a little arrogant This said  the hotel was confortable  the service excellent  and I would consider staying there again  but  and especially in Singapore  it is worthwhile shopping around for great deals  rather than booking the rack rate at priorityclub com

We chose to stay at the Intercontinental Hotel when we went to Singapore on Dec 28  2009 to Jan 01  2010 because of the good reviews that we read from Tripadvisor  We were truly not disappointed as to its location  A few step away from the MRT and it s adjoining Bugis Junction  Lots of restaurants to choose from and lots of boutiques that sells different stuff  You even get discounts from some stores at Bugis Junction if you are staying at the Intercon  Just present to them your hotel card key  We got an SGD 100 discount when we bought an Apple notebook The room is very spacious considering Singapore is a small place with a very high standard of living  The twin beds are big  It can fit in two Asian size adults in one bed  The bathroom has separate shower and bathtub  Nonetheless  we were greatly disappointed in two areas  1  When we entered the room after we check in  the whole room  including the bathroom smells of fresh cigarette smoke  We assumed that the guest before us smoke inside the bedroom and the bathroom even though it s a non smoking room  Yes  we requested for a non smoking room and we were indeed given one  However  it was like we were in a smoking room  Yes  we complained and requested if we can change our room but we were denied a change of room  They just sent someone to spray air freshener in our room  Sad to say  the freshener didn t work a bit  We were content to sleep with smoke scent in our room  We didn t make a big fuss of it since we were truly tired from our travel  Additionally  we even have to request for the bathrobes to be changed since they smell of cigarette smoke too  We have to use the bathrobe since our luggage was erroneously taken by another passenger  they were delivered to our room the next day   2  The pillows stink  Maybe because of constant use by some guests with peculiar smell  their pillows emit a certain smell  Since we are not used to the smell  we had a hard time tolerating it  Yes  we left a note to the housekeeping for our pillow to be changed  since we have to hurry and go out to maximize our time in Singapore  hence no time to personally talk with the housekeeping about it   but guess they just changed the pillow case but not the pillow  Unless  all their pillows really smell that way If not for the above 2 concerns  our stay at the Intercon could have been perfect

Impressed with other travellers¡¯ reviews of the InterContinental  I thought I¡¯d give it a try  I usually like staying at Swiss? tel the Stamford in Singapore  but their prices are climbing higher every year  I¡¯m glad I tried somewhere else as the Intercontinental was great  Fantastically located in Singapore  this hotel is attached to Bugis Junction shopping centre and to Bugis MRT station  It¡¯s a stone¡¯s throw to Bugis Market  Singapore¡¯s largest covered market and a short walk to Sim Lim Square  the electronics mall  Easy access to the MRT will get you everywhere else in Singapore  Location wise  this hotel is spot on The service is

We spent 10 nights at the Intercontinental in Singapore  We had only booked five initially so that we could look around and move during our visit if we found something we liked better  We didn t  and we did look at several other hotels From the moment you enter the lobby everybody is so charming and smiling  whether you have just come down from your room or have entered from the oppressive heat outside The man who gets you a taxi at the front door is helpful and knowledeable and this attitude carries throughout the entire hotel  We definitely had no complaints Our room was spacious and comfortable and well maintained  It was our anniversary and apart from chocolates and a card awaiting our arrival sent from a friend in Canada  the Hotel had picked up on our celebration and sent their own note and fruit Breakfast  every morning  was an experience in itself  There is absolutely everything you could possibly want at different food stations and fresh pancakes made in front of you  We put on weight on this trip The Chinese Restaurant in the hotel is excellent and dim sum worth trying  as is the evening meal  The staff in the restaurant were delightful to deal with and we ate there several times A truly great hotel experience  Next stop is the Intercontinental Grand Stanford in Hong Kong   we hope the atmosphere is similar

This was our 2nd visit to the hotel  During our 1st visit  we were upset with the service and the long waiting time of an hour to retrieve our reservations that we immediately cancelled the stay  It had been a year and we presumed the service standards would have been raised so we decided to stay at the hotel for the christmas weekend given the good promotional rates  We arrived at 3pm which is the official check in time and yet  we were asked to wait for another 45 mins because the room was not ready     This explained the unusually large crowd at the hotel lobby with many guests hanging around with their bags  The guest relations officer offered his apology  half heartedly  and promised to extend our check out time to 3pm  which was not arranged  The bottomline is very poor service and it is extremely disappointing

Booked a 5 night stay here en route to Oz  very impressive entrabce and efficient check in  Room was lovely  good size  very comfortable  lovely marble bathroom and good storage  We opted for the executive club package which included free internet  breakfast  tea and cocktails etc  in the exec lounge where the service was excellent  We found all the staff very helpful and pleasant  The pool area was lovely despite being overlooked by other buildings  The location was great as it is adjoining a large shopping mall  Bugis junction  which has a great selection of shops and food outlets as well as a metro station  It is also opposite a large night market and more shops  Raffles is just round the corner and you can walk to other large malls  All in all a great stay  The only thing not too good was the concierge s knowledge and lack of info leaflets

We had a terrible experience at this hotel   Concierge booked wrong car from the airport to the hotel  not big enough for the family No extra bed available despite our booking Club IC lounge very busy  always wait for the breakfast table Club IC lounge staff rude  arrogant  unhelpful  unfriendly Rooms bit dated No pool bar service No free bottle of drinking water even in Club IC roomsThe location is good Last year we stayed at the Conrad  much better

I like this chain of hotels and have had great stays in Interconti s  The hotel in Singapore is stunning to look at with gorgeous communal areas and good food so far so good  I loved the live music in the lounge and the location is grand too However it does have a few shortfalls in the guest rooms walls are paper thin so you can hear everything and I mean everything coming from next door which is annoying however the staff relocated me straight away so that was appreciated  I also had a faulty shower and a faulty air con system which was not ideal but atleast the hotel sorted each issue   The clun lounge is fantastic although the staff are so attentive they are almost too attentive and you occassionally feel like they are clearing you away along with the plates and cups Overall a lovely hotel with a nice feel  however not quite as smoothly run as the Sydney inticonti and you do notice that when you go from one to the other

stepping into the intercontinental is like walking into a sepia toned picture of the classic  colonial era hotel  from the cobbled drive way to the green marble and red wood trimmed bathroom fixtures  and the acrylic still life painting of orchids and china cups in my room  it seemed a proper slice of old world grandeur  the wonderful bit is that this old world classiness comes matched with the modern comforts expected of a up market hotel  and the intercontinental did not disappoint  with it s flat screen telly which cleverly integrated a 24hour clock onto one of the speakers  and hidden speakers in the bathroom so you could follow the audio of your television programme even if you had to go wash your hands during the show  and the beds were so comfy  there s something about the multiple layers of sheets and those pillows that really make you feel like you re on holiday  the only slightly disappointing thing about the room i had on the 4th floor was that even though there was an outdoorsy pebbled garden area and a back gate to the room  which could have led us straight to the pool which was also located on the 4th floor  guests are obviously not encouraged to use this back door access  besides the chair placed in front of the door and the full length day curtains  so you wouldn t think there was a door there at all  there s a very sturdy metal security plate that blocks the sliding door  and when we lifted this metal plate to try the doors  which didn t work anyway   we found ancient cigarette butts and other nastiness underneath it  i suppose we must have been the first itchy fingered guests in a long while who tried to use the short cut to the pool  so they didn t think to clean underneath    but no loss  it really wasn t any trouble to walk to the lift lobby and access the pool through the main door the pool isn t huge  and people from the neighbouring national library and iluma shopping mall can sort of look in on the sunbathing going on on the 4th floor  but that didn t stop anyone from having fun  there s a separate shallow pool for the kiddies  and a shaded jacuzzi  the two large divan type sunbeds were hugely in demand breakfast was a treat  perhaps because it s not holiday peak season  it wasn t too crowded  there was an egg station  and a lovely selection from muesli  fruit  nuts and yogurt  to congee  breads  smoked salmon to go with your salad  and your usual fry up  tea and coffee served to the table as soon as you sit down  which was really nice  the staff is warm and discreet  the young man who checked us in who forgot to tell us where we should go for breakfast  but he was obviously so new and nervous  his hands shook a little as he wrote down our details upon check in so that can t be held against him  i had a sore throat on the first day  and asked for hot water and honey    it was delivered to the room with a warm smile  sliced lemons on the side  and sunny  quot i hope you feel better soon  quot  and after the wonderful stay in the beautiful intercontinental with its attentive staff  i did

This was our first visit to Singapore and we were very impressed with the Intercontinental  The hotel was very well appointed  the rooms luxurious with bathrooms to match  The staff were absolutely first class very courteous and attentative  making us feel as though they were genuinely pleased to serve us  such a contrast from the UK   Breakfast was very good  if a little over priced  the best coffee I tasted in 4 weeks away  The hotel is attached to the Bugis Junction mall and MRT station is a 5 minute walk throught the mall  Will deifinitely stay here next time we are passing through Singapore

All round this is an excellent hotel in a good location with good size rooms and high service levels We used the hotel limo airport collection service which was well worthwhile  Met at aircraft gate helped with baggage and car directly to hotel and our room where we were checked in  brilliant service after a long flight   Very good breakfast and nice outdoor pool

I booked 2 nts at this hotel as a mystery deal on Wotif com au for about Aust 160 nt including breakfast  It was a special weekend  Fri Sat  price and is usually twice this amount  Check in was swift  but very welcoming  My deluxe room on the 4th floor was very quiet  large  comfortable and elegantly furnished  Traditional decor style  The bed was huge and extremely comfortable  The bathroom had bath and separate shower  Nice toiletries and bathrobe  Unfortunately the curtains didn¡¯t block out light while sleeping   the room was light even i

Spent one week at this hotel and we really enjoyed our stay  I am quite fussy when it comes to hotels so this one met my criteria Rooms   We were upgraded to a shop house suite which was really lovley   very spacious and very clean  It had all the amenties such as pillow menu  in room safe  bathroom scales  tea making facilities etc  The room was serviced daily and even the bed linen could be changed daily  There is a card system to prevent daily linen change if you are environmentally concious as we are  The suite had two plasma screen TV s  if you are into TV watching on holiday  plus a music centre  If you have a club  room  suite fresh fruit and mineral water is supplied daily which was a real bonus  Shower   The shower was efficient and easy to operate and had plenty of water pressure and the water was always hot  Noise  we were concerned that the room would be noisy as we overlooked Bugis Shopping Mall  However by 10pm the noise has debated and we had a perfect nights sleep  This was also faciliated by a very comfortable king size bed We had club access and I have visted plenty of club floors but the Intercontinentla club is one of the most elegant I have visited  The choice of wine and refreshments was excellent and the service a little too efficient  Breakfast was described as continental but did include eggs  bacon etc  In addition there was free access to the Internet which was helpful for checking of emails etc  The pool area was also great however I am not convinced it is the best pool for children as ther did not appear to be a  quot shallow end quot  There is however a very small pool that could be used for paddling  The spa was also very good with appointments readily available  The pricing was also reasonable We dined at the Olive Tree and whilst the meal was fine the staff did not appear to understand the menu  Perhaps more training is needed in the area  However the menu is very comprehensive so maybe it was just a lot to learn for the staff  The wine list included champagne but when we ordered they said they had run out  We were able to walk next door to the lobby bar and order the same champagne so not sure why the resteraunt staff were not able to do this  The lobby lounge is a great place to sit and unwind and the staff very attentive  The concierge staff are very helpful and manged to get tickets for the air show for us which was great as we had left things to the last minute and were not able to book them ourselves I would stay at this hotel again  Finally I am a priority rewards member and I have found that the hotels seem to leave nice extras for members so I am satisfied with the programme benefits

We stayed at the Intercontinental for 3 nights to visit some friends in Singapore  We stayed in a club premier room  When we arrived we were directed to the club lounge where we were welcomed to the hotel and allowed to complete the check in process over drinks in the lounge  While I would still have enjoyed my stay without lounge access it really was the highlight of the trip for us  We only had the breakfast but it was a proper buffet breakfast  There was a wide variety of hot and cold items including eggs to order  Tea and coffee are brought to your table  When they clear your plates and cutlery they immediately replace the cutlery  I have been to some buffets where once you lose your cutlery you re on your own  Apart from the food the decor was very well executed and it was a comfortable place to sit and relax  I particularly enjoyed being able to check out while eating breakfast and without having to go near the desk  Our room was an L shaped premier room of 52 sqm  The colonial theme continued in the room together with some peranakan details to reflect the local culture  The room was well designed and very comfortable  There was a couch  wing chair and a dining table  The bed was an excellent blend of comfort and support so we always slept well  They have a pillow menu and we were able to order our prefered pillow The room was serviced twice a day  Turn down was provided as a matter of course and if you were around at about 9 30am they called in to see if you had any laundry  The hotel was well located as it was adjacent to a good shopping mall and an MRT station  We did end up getting taxis to most places as they were quite cheap but the MRT was very handy and fairly easy to use I would definitely recommend staying at the intercontinental and opting for the club lounge  The staff are very obliging and really want you to enjoy your stay

We stayed here on our way to and from Malaysia with our children  The rooms are not particularly big but quite nice all the same The mini bar is outrageous with  12 SGD being asked for a med size bottle of water    Anyway  the hotel staff are very friendly and do whatever they can to assist  I never thought anyone was rude or dismissive I find that claim hard to believe The location is great as it is right onto a large shopping area which has EVERYTHING and is also a short stroll from Bugis street and a walk to little India The only reason I wouldn t stay here in future is the price is probably a little excessive and maybe if it included breakfast it would offset it a bit but you dont   so it makes for a very exxxy stay

This was our second stay at the IC in Singapore and once again it was a good choice  IC is attached to the Bugis shopping precinct and MRT Station  which makes it easy to shop for fruit etc and easy to get around  The service is friendly and efficient  housekeeping is quick and thorough  Food is good but expensive in the in house eateries  Beds are great  shower is superb     and the rooms are quiet  Being the IC you pay for the quality of the place but we don t think you get much value below  AUS250 per night in Singapore and for that extra money you get a very good hotel

The Inter  Continental wins on location   it is on MRT line from airport and right above station  Conrad is at least a 15 min walk    and it wins on personality   you have a feeling of place   the Conrad could be anywhere   Rooms quiter and nicer at Conrad  Service a bit better there   pools the same  breakfast Conrad wins  Conrad Exec lounge on high floor wins but again the IC is more elegant  Is it bad  in any way  no

I stayed at this hotel over the weekend for work and are generally impressed by the level of service at the hotel  The girls at the Club lounge are ever friendly and the High Tea at the lobby lounge is of very good standards  Love the poached pear While this is not the most modern hotel  it is spotless and has a distinctive and pleasant colonial character  And everywhere you turn you see smiles from the staff Only annoyance is the seemingly endless stream of shoppers from the adjacent mall  which incidentally has a large selection of shops  restaurant and supermarket  as well as the MRT station as mentioned by the other reviewers

This is my first time in Singapore and I was amazed with the Hotel  The hotel is in middle of a shopping centre  All the essentials are just a few minutes walk away  There is even a ceinema theatre too  The rooms are very classic and the wood work in the rooms gives it a very unique ambiance  I highly recommend this hotel for family and buisness visits  Although i had a few technical issues with my access room card  I had to change my card almost everyday I return to the hotel  Its a lovely Hotel and I would love to stay again in the same hotel

My wife and I had researched via TripAdvisor as well as my wife having stayed at Intercon Singapore many times for business although hadn t been back to Singapore for 7 years  Overall  our experience was close to excellent  and I will get back to that The one weak point was the check in  We had booked via Intercon website which   as promised  had given best rate we could find  We arrived in Singapore and stayed with a friend for a couple of days and during this time we walked up to the Intercon one day and just decided to check we were booked in okay for our stay starting in a couple of days The reception girl had one of those blank faces no matter what you said and how much you smiled and she appeared pretty young  She couldn t find our booking so went to another than another before finally finding it We rang again on the morning of check in and found we were missing again  This time I decided to speak to reception on Club Incontinental floors where we were staying and I got a much smarter  older  more helpful staff member who said she would ring back  She did  problem solved  there had been a typo with our surname and a new system introduced at the same time so double trouble  There was even a letter apologising re any check in problems due to system change when we did get into our room on the day Having said that  the rest of our stay was a dream come true  Every staff member always had a smile for us  the taxi doormen and door lady were always friendly  efficient and happy to offer advice on other matters as well as the helpful concierges near front desk Club Incontinental lounge with great breakfast  all day coffee tea and soft drinks and 5 30pm to 7 30pm free beer  wine  champagne and canapes was an absolute must  even if we were going out for dinner later Also had desk in one of the two connected lounge rooms to check mail etc via broadband connection so we didn t bother with taking our laptop or internet cafes Pool was great while acknowledging previously mentioned problem from other reviews of no sun until mid morning because of position of main hotel building Room was great  king size bed  fresh local fruits and 2 x mineral spring waters every day and l occitane toiletries  very nice Big bath  temp setting controlled shower and largish bathroom plus bathrobes  slippers made for a nice stay The staff in the Club Lounge were especially nice and we let the hotel know in feedback forms when we left We planned to stay 5 nights and added one more before we flew home No real complaints only compliments for a great stay at one of Singapore s older hotels   1995   that still carries it with class  style and lots of staff smiles

I ve stayed at the Intercontinental several times over the past few years  amp  can highly recommend this gem of a hotel The standards of accomodation  service  amp  food are always well ahead of the pack  The attention to detail given by the friendly staff is quite remarkable Whenever a trip to Singapore is on the cards  I always make sure that the Intercontintal has accomodation available

I stayed at the hotel for 4 nights with my husband and our 3 children who are all under 5 years of age  It was perfect   close to great shopping  including handy supermarket style shops  The staff were wonderful  kind to my children and very uninstrusive  We had interconnecting rooms  one with king size  other with 2 doubles  very confortable  baby cot for my little one  and they even placed us at the end of the corridor  I am sure much to the pleasure of other people staying at the hotel  3 children under 5 tend to be noisy   I would definitely stay here again

My wife  2 young kids and I stayed at the Intercontinental for 3 nights recently  Our stay got off to a great start when the hotel upgraded us to a peranakan wing room  which was huge with 2 queen size beds  a big bathroom and tastefully decorated  I would strongly recommend the peranakan wing rooms for a different experience  particularly since they are accessible by a discreet walkway through the Bugis Junction mall which is intertwined  to an extent  with the hotel  Breakfast was great  and the public areas of the hotel were beautifully decorated and maintained  Breakfast for children under 6 was free  which was unusual and greatly appreciated  Now for the downside  The airconditioning in our room did not work properly the first night  and we had to switch rooms at midnight to get a good night s sleep  The problem was however solved the next day  Nevertheless  other maintenance problems surfaced during our stay eg the room was not cleaned after the aircon repair work  a handle on the cabinet was missing  the bulb for the stand lamp was fused  and some corridor doors could use a coat of paint  Having said all that the hotel is good value for money  and I would definitely stay there again  If only more attention was paid to maintenance  the hotel could go shoulder to shoulder with the big boys

Having spent the summer in Australia  I was due to fly directly back from Brisbane to Norway  but decided at the last minute to stop in Singapore  I have stayed in so many hotels in Singapore over the years that I have lost count  My last stay was at the Oriental and I was more than pleased  This time I booked  quot last minute quot  and there didn t seem to be too much available  but being a memeber of Priority Club  I decided to give the Intercontinental a go  WOW  Just as good as the Oriental  and for my liking  a fine location  The hotel is situated in Bugis  about 5 mintues walk from Raffles Hotel and major shopping centres  Orchard Road is 15 minutes walk in the opposite direction  and the Boat Quay  prepare to be slightly  quot hassled quot  by throwers in   Robertson Quay  nearly finished  impressive  slightly more expensive  restaurant areas took me around 20 minutes to walk to  Singapore is renowned for being conducive to those who like eating and whichever direction you go from the hotel  there is a plethora of diverse eateries The hotel itself was spick and span  the staff welcoming  I managed to book a room with one bed instead of two beds  but they changed my reservation on the spot within seconds   and the facilities great  The rooms are large  especially if you are used to European hotel rooms    the furnishings seemed new  the bathrooms large with a good range of cosmetics and a deep soaker tub  and the rooms have flat screen TVs I m going back to Singapore in April 2007  and I feel that I am spoiled for choice as far as hotels are concerned  but the Intercontinental is definately worth the price you pay  and I will return

The hotel is nice and the staff are very friendly  but there were 3 mistakes made with my trip  I had Mr  Jo on my booking form   even though they could see I was a married lady  and my passport had Joan on it   they did not change it  I was given a smoking room when I had booked a non smoking and I was not warned at check in that they were full  The club floor was good and breakfast was very nice  I returned to my room on the last evening to discover that a letter had been left in  I had hoped it was to address my complaints about the smoking room and the error with my name No it was a fax relating to a tender that some other guest in the hotel had asked to be sent  I hand it in to the club loung and the staff did not apologise for their mistake in leaving sensitive information in the wrong guest room  They just said  quot Oh thank you quot My colleague who was also at the hotel encountered errors with her name   although her booking was in her name   they changed the name to her boyfriends name and started to refer to her as her boyfriends sirname and Mrs too Two men also arrived at her room mid afternoon 2 days before she was due to check out asking why she had not vacated her room  The hotel will need to tighten up on these things it does not create a good image

We have just returned from a short two night stay at the superb Singapore Intercontinental  Whislt we were the there  the local media had news on the fact that the hotel could be sold but the staff said that Intercontonental will still run it  We had a club room which gave us access to the lounge on the 11th floor  The club lounge staff were fantastic and even remembered the drinks that you like  The room itself was great and I loved the Philps LCD TV in the room  Pity I spent so little time in the hotel as with 48 hours in the Lion City  there is a lot to do  Shopping is a local favourite pastime and the busy Bugis mall is adjacent to the hotel  Entrance is from the hotel lobby  The hotel is situated in town  close to Raffles  Suntec and the Esplanade  It s a short taxi ride to orchard Road and if you want tog et away from the hectic Orchard Rd area  then this hotel is a must  The pool is nice but it s the quality of accommodation  location  service and excellent price that makes this hotel the best in Singapore  Raj  the concierge was amazing  and the front office staff were also more than helpful  Once again  I have to mention the rooms   they were big  comfortable and bright  The bed was to die for  the bathroom fantastic and did I menion that LCD TV

We stayed at the Intercontinental for 3 days on our way back to Australia and it has to be one of the best hotels we have ever stayed in  We were upgraded to a Club room and they were very large and spacious and well presented  The beds  linen and pillows were the most comfortable I have slept on   I nearly spent most of my stopover asleep  The added touches of fluffy bathrobes  slippers  fabulous toiletries and that fabulous shower   which someone else commented on  really does make this a great place to want to come back to  So much so  we even extended our room booking and were happy to pay extra for a 7pm check out  as our flight was at 10pm  just so we could stay in the room

We booked here on the advice on trip advisor and for the price  It is an excellent hotel for the money  Starting with the assistant helping you out of the cab and taking your luggage and then onto the assistant who registers you in your own room  having escorted you there  The lounge bar is glorious with the exorbitant prices that  unfortunately  I expect from a five star hotel  We didn t have time for the pool but  it looked good from our bedroom  The location is perfect for Bugis Street and only a five minute walk to Raffles and Raffles City The only two slight reservations are the charges for internet access S 0 25 per minute and the long wait for taxis in the early evening  The latter is a problem of the city  the former is just a con on the hotel s part  Many other locations offer this service for free so the Itercontinenral Group need to review their policies We didn t let this dampen our stay and ww would gladly come again

We stayed for 3 nights as a stopover on our way to Australia  We got a good rate as shareholders in IHG and paid the extra to upgrade to a Club Room which was well worth the money  The Club Lounge upgrade included an excellent breakfast  wifi access  afternoon tea and a cocktail hour with nibbles substantial enough to be an evening meal The room was a good size with well fitted bathroom and a very comfortable bed  What made this the best for us was the polite and attentive staff  who all gave the impression that nothing was too much trouble for them

First class amenities with a highly qualified and devoted staff   with the exception of front desk that appeared to lack organization and efficiency when we checked in  Spacious rooms with thick  amp  comfy pillows  Too bad it took a while to get hot water in the shower Service is also efficient and friendly in the various restaurants and bars  The evenings in the main lounge listening to the jazzy piano was probably the highlight of my stay Rate SGD265 including internet  amp  breakfast

I have stayed at this hotel 3 weeks a month now since December and I cannot say enough good things about it  I do a lot of travel for my job and this is by far the best hotel I have been to worldwide  I am a dedicated Marriott guy but when I come to Singapore I would only think of staying at the Intercontinental  The hotel is always clean and the staff is amazing and always greeting you with smiles  They have a great lobby bar that I went to on day 1 to try and stay away and adjust to the 13 hour time change  I came back to the lobby bar 5 days later for a beer and the waitress remembered my name and greeted me properly  It¡¯s little things like that make the experience at the hotel above others  The rooms are very big and they are always clean and

This was our fourth stay at the InterContinental and we found it to be as good as ever   if a lot more expensive these days when paying in British pounds  It was our first visit since the new Club floor opened   very impressive  but much more impersonal than before in our opinion anyway  we missed the previously much friendlier atmosphere and former Club staff very much  not to mention the Champagne and superior wine choices  However  it was good to see that the afternoon tea has been re instated  especially after arriving on an overnight flight from Europe and longing for a cup of tea  Clientele seemed to be more leisure and fewer business travellers than on our previous visits  Our room and bathroom were very comfortable  clean and well equipped  One nice touch was that on receiving our  very  early morning call on our last day a complementry tray of tea coffee was left outside the door for us to have before checking out We are always sad to leave this excellently situated hotel and hope it won t be too long before our next visit

We thoroughly enjoyed our stay at the Intercontinental Hotel  It s not the first time for us and we are very likely to stay again  It s one of a handful hotels in Singapore that sits atop an MRT station making it very convenient  Located between Orchard and the business district in Bugis  it s close to so many attractions   Boat Quay  Clarke Quay  Robertson Quay  the Raffles Hotel  CHIJMES to name a few  What we love about this hotel   it s classy  the lobby lounge is exquisite  we had a night cap there every night   the fitness centre is very well equipped and staffed  the food is delicious  the rooms are spacious as are the bathrooms  There is nothing is dislike about this hotel  nothing even annoying

This is a great hotel you can easily walk to the arab quarter little India China town and Raffles  The buffet breakfast is amazing with the biggest choice I have ever seen and very attentive but not in your face staff  The concierge was very helpfull answering all our questions  We also went to the Olive tree for dinner we had the buffet and it matched Raffles Billiard room buffet for us   The bed was huge and very comfortable and the room was clean and well decorated

Got an even better deal than the last time I stayed here  This time  I spotted a very good rate 2 months before my 2 night stay at S 163  As I got closer to my stay  I noticed the rate had jumped to S 220  so it pays to book early  I knew it was a good deal since I paid more last time  which I thought then was a good deal  And you definitely get your money s worth  The room I got was as big as last time  and much bigger than most hotels I ve stayed  Everyone at the hotel greeted me

I ll be honest  I d looked at the photos of the rooms and wasn t 100  sure about staying here  Well I changed my mind the minute I walked into the hotel  The rooms have more of an old world charm rather than modern decor  the bed was just fabulous  Having just come from Pan Pacific and their hard beds this was pure heaven  Although I prefer a more modern decor it worked for this hotel We had club access and the service there was outstanding  tips and hints on what to see and what you could give a miss  where to shop for what  It was really great  It wasn t the best IC club lounge we ve been to but it s up there  Dubai is the best in my opinion Pool was smallish and had full sun all day  only downside there  Gym was ok  Room service was very efficient and food quality very good  Hotel is connected to Bugis Village shopping centre and that takes you to the MRT  There s lots of restaurants and food places in this shopping centre Highly recommend a Singapore Sling at Raffles  walking distance  and dinner at Clarke Quay  Overall an excellent stay and I would not hesitate to stay again

We stayed here for 3 nights over Chinese New Year  The room and hotel facilities were very good  but the quality of the service we received was impeccable  I proposed to my girlfriend during our stay  and the staff went to great lengths to make our stay extra special  We experienced truly exceptional service from every single member of the hotel staff we encountered during our stay  Highly recommended

Just back home after my fourth stay at this hotel  The staff are amazing as always and the location can t be beaten  You can walk to Little India  Arab Street  Raffles and down to the river easily from the hotel  This time we paid the extra SIN 100 per room per night for Club privileges which meant that the two of us had breakfast in the Club lounge  so much you didn t need to eat lunch   tea in the afternoon with more little cakes etc   lovely cocktails and canapes in the evening and free internet  It was great value and added a lot to our stay this time  I would certainly recommend it for an extra holiday treat  The only downside to this hotel as with most buildings in Singapore is that the air conditioning is unpleasantly cold  A polar bear would feel at home in the room when we checked in  If this will be a problem for you too  ask for the air conditioning to be turned off before you check in  When you are there  leave a keycard in the slot just inside the door so that the air conditioning doesn t automatically reset itself and turn back on while you are out of the room  By doing this the temperature increased from 19 degrees when we checked in to a comfortable 23 degrees two days later  Its easy then to turn the air conditioning on occasionally just to get some air circulating without the room getting colder  Now that this problem isn t an issue any more we will definitely be back

Stayed here many times its always good  amp  consistent  Rooms very modern  amp  very comfortable  Check in very easy  especially if Priority Gold  and staff always great  Location not the best for me but still quiet convenient  Unfortunately wont be staying here again due to a bad Intercont billing experience  Bangkok  but looking forward to finding a new place to stay in Singapore  Last stay was bit pricey    500 nite  due to the Airshow and rooms in short supply

I stayed here during a recent business trip  the staff was extremely friendly  courteous and helpful  I was ill during my stay and they went out of there way to be sure I was comfortable  I stayed in a club level room and the club staff brought tea and toast to my room after learning I was ill  Very good customer service  The room was very well appointed with all the latest amenities  It was very comfortable and the very large bathroom was just gorgeous  The hotel is in a great location with lots of shopping nearby at Bugis Street

My husband and I and our friends recently staying in the Intercontinental Hotel Bugis Junction Singapore  The rooms  service and location was excellent  It was our second time there and wouldn t go anywhere else  We booked the club room which gave you additional priviledges such as a club lounge to relax in  nice breakfast  free internet  evening cocktails and much more  which are worth the little bit extra  The location of the hotel for sightseeing and shopping is great

We stayed a couple of days at the hotel  it was our second time there and it was very pleasant The room was very big and very confortable  It could fit 2 adults and 2 children without any problem  The bed was incredibly nice The service was excellent  especially at breakfast   the staff is very warm and welcoming The only down side was the pool  it would need some renovation works  titles  and the furnitures too  But still we enjoyed it very much The location is excellent  you can reach any place very easily BTW  there is no spa     maybe they should think about it   just now you can get massages at the fitness center though but we didn t try it  went outside  And there is no free internet in the rooms

We stayed at the Intercontinental on our way home to Australia from a holiday in Europe  As a Platinum Elite Priority Club member I was able to book our stay on points accumulated during the last year s business travel  We arrived at 5 00 am on our overnight from Europe  I had expected to sit in the lobby for a while before a room was ready but they were able to accommodate us immediately I paid the SD80   per night to upgrade to the Club floor  always a good move in Singapore  which includes great breakfast  afternoon tea and cocktails The location is excellent in Bugis Junction on top of MRT and with 20 bus routes  including the one to Changi Beach  outside the door Very quiet comfortable room on secure Club Floor contributed to our stay but the highlight was the Club itself   we ended up spending a fair amount of time here as the atmosphere and service were outstanding I thoroughly recommend this hotel to anyone coming to Singapore

We stayed in the Intercontinental Singapore for 3 nights  The check in was perfect  they guided us to our shop house room  Surprisingly the room was not really clean  we saw a lot of nails on the floor and the bathroom  especially the shower needs a renovation  After complaining we got a nice renovated room on the 15th floor The location is good  close to the centre  The pool is pretty small There was some construction work  renovating or maintenance during night time  After complaining they stopped the noise

Stayed for a night on two occasions en route Australia and UK Well situated  being 20 minutes by taxi from Changi Airport  and just a short walk to the metro and a bit further to Raffles Check in was quick and reception staff were friendly and welcoming  In fact staff throughout the hotel were the same   helpful  efficient and eager to please  I could not fault them  We pre paid a de luxe twin queen bedded room with breakfast  Room was extremely comfortable and quiet and breakfast was magnificent  Everything you could want   and more We took dinner one night   advertised as a seafood buffet  but it included beef  chicken  pasta  asian dishes etc  It was truly delicious  and the staff  again so pleasant Used the business centre a couple of times  Not expensive and helpful staff here too The large lounge was comfortable  but drinks were expensive Our flight home was just before midnight  so we were happy to be offered a 5 00 pm ckeckout   at no charge  All in all  a top class hotel

I returned for the second time to this great hotel  this time for my Mum s 60th Birthday trip As usual  the customer service was impeccable  I have a Platinum Royal Ambassador Status with Six Continents Hotels and the staff were outstanding  We booked a limo pick up at the airport and our driver was waiting for us on arrival  As we appraoched the hotel  the guest manager met us at the door and took us straight to our upgraded rooms with no fuss Albert the concierge deserevs a special mention as he had arranged flowers and champagne for my mum as well as making all of our bookings for dibber and travel we asked for The Gym was great  breakfasts are superb and the attention to detail is great Tremendous service  wouldn t hesitate to recommend it

This is a nice hotel  upon i arrived by taxi someone open the door for me  help me with the luggages and straight away show me to the reception to check in  the room is nice  clean and tidy  Service was fine  staff is friendly and always show me with a smile  Just the problem during my stay is need to wait very long for the taxi  other then that everything is ok

I stayed there for five nights recently on business  I have got a very good impression of the hotel breakfast buffet restaurant  The waitress putting on smile greeting me every morning at the entrance of the Olive Tree restaurant The chefs and waiters were friendly and pleasant  Fresh juice was great Lady concierge was reliable and thoughtful  Front desk ladies were efficient  Housekeeping staff were attentitive Only one downside was the front desk forgot to ask if a non smoking room needed and the hotel allows people to smoke in the corridors and do not have enough ventilation  therefore  the corridor stank of smoke which permeated into my room  Without luck  people in the next room were celebrating birthday  a crowd of people inside and outside their room were producing heavy smoke and annoying noise all night As an extremely tired light sleeper  I was in bed around 11 00  I thought the noisy crowd would finished their party in a short time so I did not make a compliant  However  I did not expect I had to stand the noise until 3 30 in the morning and the smoke permeated into my room was strong enough to choke me under my quilt Fortunately the front desk switched me to a non smoking room the next morning after my whole night torture

Me and my wife stayed in the Intercontinental in Singapore for 2 nights in our Honeymoon Trip around Asia and Pacific  The Staff is excellent as well as the service and the Breakfest Buffet  fantastic     The room is large with all new and modern amenities  Marble Bathroom is with a separate Walk in Shower and Bath Tub  Air conditioning was a little too cold for us but was ok  We enjoyed very much our stay and we highly recommend this top class hotel  close to Underground Station and Market and Food court

I decided to take a break from work and stayed at the Hotel Intercontinental  Singapore from 11   12 Nov 06  I chose the hotel because it had an old world charm to it The check in was smooth though mechanical  The front counter staff didn t seem to like to smile I requested for a king  non smoking deluxe room on a high floor and was allocated one on the 13th storey  The room was clean and adequately sized  The plus points of the room were 1  The furniture and lamps had oriental designs which was unique compared to the standard chain hotel rooms 2  The LCD TV gave the room a modern look  I think the hotel upgraded the TVs recently 3  The air conditioning  Hotel Intercon is one of the few hotels that had a working thermostat which shows the desired and actual room temperatures  The most impressive item in the room is the toiletries  The hotel provides shower gel  soap  conditioner and shampoo supplied by L OCCITANE en Provence  which provided a refreshing shower and bath A peculiar point about the room  Most hotels have this energy saving gadget that requires guests to slot their key cards in to activate the room s power supply  Hotel Intercon has this plastic card that s permanently affixed to the gadget by a chain  The guest is requested to take the card out of the slot when leaving the room  I am not sure if the guests really do remember to remove the card  esp if the card is not their room key  The initiative to save energy might not be effective in this case  On the other hand  perhaps too many guests lock themselves out of the room when they leave their keycard in the energy saving gadget  which could be the reason for such an arrangement The room service was prompt when I requested for an additional towel though I was amused to be given 6 new sets of towels when the room service staff turned up at my door I tried the gym on the 3rd floor  It was adequately equipped and well serviced  The lockers in the gym s change rooms required guests to bring along their personal locks  The first time I used the gym  I forgot to bring a lock  The gym trainer suggested that I could leave my clothing at a corner of the gym and do my workout  I thought it was a weird suggestion but I did it anyways since I did not have any valuables with me The gym had a jacuzzi  The jacuzzi was ok though a bit small  Could fit max 4 persons  The jacuzzi usage for males and females are split into different time periods i e  at any one time  either males OR females are permited to use the jacuzzi  not both  For future guests  do check the timings for gents and ladies cause you won t want to be changed out to use the jacuzzi and realise that it s not the right time The swimming pool on the 4th floor is equipped with a cold spa pool at the side  The lockers in the change room  a different room from the 3rd floor gym s  requires you to bring along a lock as well  Strangely  there was a sign in the change room indicating that locks were available upon request at the gym  Since I used the pool after the gym  I didn t bother to verify whether this was true  The bottomline is to make sure you bring along a lock before you use the change rooms Food wise  breakfast is served at the Olive Tree  The breakfast buffet had a good spread of food  I liked the bacon  sausages  omelette and chocolate muffins  One problem that I had was with the signage that indicated the type of food at the buffet table  There were insufficient and confusing signages so one had to guess what was served  One sign read  quot Peanut butter  butter  jam      quot  and there were 6 saucers below the sign  You have to guess what s in each saucer and link it back to one of the items listed on the sign  Nevertheless  the breakfast was delicious so a room plus breakfast package at the hotel would be a good choice Finally  the checkout was smooth  This time  a different front counter staff served me and was much more friendlier  She asked about my stay and recommended their restaurants for future patronage Overall  my stay at the Hotel Intercon has achieved my objective to rejuvenate over the weekend  I would recommend it to tourists and locals alike  Would stay at the Hotel Intercon because of the room and the food served

Wether you have freshly flown in  or like me just transferred from an atrocious hotel namely The Garden  currently rightly ranked  75 in tripadvisor  your in for a real comfy treat at this hotel  At first  my expextations were not top  as it was the few hotels on the first page under  200  let alone it was  3  Well  be surprised  A pleasant one Upon entering the front lobby  porters were quick enough to help with the luggage  amp  from then on you dont have to lift a finger  Check in was was no problem although the room was only ready in 1 2 hours  fair enough  it was 11am  Just perfect  we left the bags there  amp  got onto shopping  amp  lunch  Returning at 3pm with aching feet  grabbed the room cards   amp  voila  Luxurious  Immediately you would know the price is worth it  We got the standard room  but was big enough  38sm   huge comfy bed  large work desk  amp  unbelievable bathroom  Enough for 2 to take a shower  amp  bubble bath  separately  To top it off  there was a beasutiful big flat sceen tv Need I say more  Well definitely deserves the a try  No regrets

A really stunning hotel  beautifully maintained  I love the way the floor rugs are fitted into the floor  so that you don t trip over them  This is where I go for a  quot splurge quot   and I book a shop house room which has all the lovely antique fittings  My husband loved the big spacious desk  Close enough to Bugis Junction and the Seiyu Department Store with its fabulous basement foodhall  great if you like Japanese food at reasonable prices   but also quite central for the historic  colonial district  It is within walking distance of the old churches and Raffles hotel  and close to the Kampong Glam and the Mosque area  There are many cheaper hotels  but this is the place for glamour

Stayed at the Intercontinental Singapore at the beginning of a tour of Asia  Received a status upgrade to a suite  This is a very nice hotel all around with a lot of class and it also happens to be reasonably priced The hotel is located in the Bugis area  which is walking distance to the Raffles hotel  Orchard Road  15 minutes  and Little India  There s a MTR station nearby  I preferred getting around by taxi which is easy  safe and cheap  The hotel is also connected to a mall with a grocery store in the basement The small suite was of very good standard and had more character than your usual Intercontinental Marriott Hilton  which is a welcome change from the rather uniform feel of most 4  business hotels  Two TVs  small dining table  desk  coffee table  sofa  comfortable king bed  two bay floor to ceiling windows  The bathroom was upscale and spacious  with separate shower Service was extremely professional  helpful and friendly and could not be faulted  The lobby is a very pleasant place to hang out and serves nice cocktails  Breakfast and snacks served in the executive lounge were just okay Would definitely want to stay here again during my next visit

We have just returned from a Far East tour  We booked the hotel Intercontinental in Singapore for 3 nights and it was a great hotel The location was 4 mins from the Bugis MTR station   so very handy for getting about The hotel room was like a small suite   6  bed  writing cabinet  easy chairs and a coffee table with lots of space in the room  Separate shower and bath  toilet  sink etc There was a safe in the room Service and friendliness of staff was excellent   fixtures and fittings were all of a high standard The hotel links onto a small Mall and across the road is more of a local market area I would not hesitate to recommend this hotelAs 1st time visitors to Singapore we found the MTR very easy and cheap to use and get about

This is a fanatasic hotel if you have very deep pockets  I only stayed here for 1 night so the financial pain was bearable  The rooms are large  luxurious and super clean   i note joking to mate that i could eat my dinner off the floor  The concierge was very helpful directing us to great eateries and finding me a public golf course on short notice  esp given it was Chinese New Year which is equal to xmas for Singaporeans    The only negative i have was its location  Its a good 20 min walk to Orchard Road which can be uncomfortable in the heat

We just stayed in Singapore for 3 nights at intercontinental on our way back from the Maldives The location of the hotel is fantastic as it is attached to the Bugis junction shopping mall and has acccess to Bugis MRT station  We booked a kingsize shophouse room and were allocated a room on level 3  The shophouse room cost more than some and we expected it to be a good standard We found the room size to be adequate  The bed was extremely comfortable and we had great nights sleep  On the down side the Shophouse room was very noisy  Every morning there was drilling noise from 0900 1100 from the shopping centre  One night there was hammering and construction noise well after midnight  People noise is also very evident until about 2300 every night  there is a cafe restaurant directly below rooms   On the first day we rang down to reception to express concern about the noise and asked whether they had a quieter room on a higher level  We were told that someone would ring back in 5 min  40 min later we had not received a call so went down to reception to speak with them in person  We said that we were happy to pay to upgrade to another room  The woman at front reception was quite indifferent and offered a room on higher level which would have been equal to downgrade  Since we had prepaid for accomodation we decided that this was not an acceptable option and stayed where we were  We understand that the hotel has no control over upgrades construction work carried out by the shopping centre but believe that guests should be informed that this can occur at any time  We dealt with Eugene at concierge almost every morning and he was very helpful in tips for getting around and restaurant recommendations   We thought that he offered exceptional service as compared to front desk  We enjoyed buffet breakfast every morning and found the staff in restaurant very efficient  There was a wide variety of food to enjoy and the coffee was good  Overall   hotel great location  Service was a bit hit and miss  If you stay I don t recommend shophouse rooms  We would definitely try another hotel next time

We stayed here with our 2yo son and parents in a separate room directly accross the hall  Plenty of space for roll out bed and was able to be a bit separate from the King bed  We stayed in a club room which enabled us plenty of space  The staff were excellent and very very friendly  Nothing was too much trouble  Thanks Anna and Emmanuel  Everyone loved our son and spent time talking to him  Plastic cutlery was arranged as well as a highchair  The lounge was great for relaxing in and spending time together outside our room s   It More comfortable than 5 of us in a room and wonderful food  I highly reccommend this hotel for families  Especially the club rooms  The MRT is close by as is a cold storage for any extra snacks  The pool area is basic but still very nice  More for lounging by than children playing but it is ok  There is a childrens pool   We will be back

We stayed here before and were excited to stay again if only for one stopover night  Location is excellent and the bedrooms are gorgeous   the beds have those undersheet duvet things that exude luxury  Buffet is full of options and the pool lovely with the most beautiful day beds to lie on  Staff friendly and helpful  Just love the guys who open the main door and call the taxis

This hotel exceeded all our expectations  The staff were so friendly and were always willing to help  The check in was a speedy process  we got the MRT from the airport   which was VERY cheap   to Bugis and the hotel was literally around the corner  and the staff were welcoming and informative  We notified the hotel in advance that we were staying as part of our honeymoon and the room was strewn with red rose petals and had complimentary chocolates with a hand messaged congratualtions note   a very nice touch The room was a good size with great city views  The bed was comfortable with a good pillow menu  The bathroom was excellent with a powerful shower All in all an excellent hotel

After reading excellent reviews about this hotel I was excited about staying here  It s a good hotel but did nt meet my expectation This was an average experience for me maybe I felt the staff could go the extra mile   We had a company meet  5 of us were staying in the hotel and had booked one of the conference rooms as well  we were going to be in meetings till 6PM on the date I was to check out I asked them if could check out after the meeting at 6 PM which would then give me a chance to freshen up they denied this request   I know it s hotel policy to not allow that late a check out without extra charge but when we had the conference last year in the  Royal Plaza on Scotts  they allowed me to stay till 630PM at no charge  I know I should nt compare but I can t help it  The meeting facilities and food  specially the buffet  were also better at the Royal Plaza The buffet at the  Olive tree  in the Intercontinental paled in comparison I felt the concierge could have helped me more when I asked directions I was shown the internet and then the map to Singapore to figure out myself when I asked about a good place to eat I was told the name and nothing other than that  while again the concierge at Raffles actually made the extra effort to make reservations for a collegue of mine who was staying with them  The best part of the Intercontinental is the location  it s in a nice part of town and well connected by all means of transport so you can get around easily

As I have said before I have stayed at most hotels in Singapore  but this one was never at the top of my list  Mainly due to its location  its not that bad just 2 blocks away from Raffles  The staff at this property cant do enough for you and they do create a really positive environment  Lobby and lounge are nice and in a colonial style  My room I booked was a Shophouse room and also in a really nice colonial style  timber floors  louvered shutters  nice size room  Great bed and pillows  I sleeps like a dream  its just a shame that i had to get up early in them morning for an appointment  Bathroom was fine  nice size  nice amenities  separate shower  I really did feel really comfortable in this room On the downside I found that the water pressure in the shower was lacking  also noticed a few cracked tiles in there  The LCD TV needs upgrading to a larger size  the swimming pool and area is very small and uninspiring  areas of the hotel do need updating  Also on check in I was asked to join there Priority Club  really annoying as I am already a member  this is a pet hate and shower that they dont really value there members  also the cost of their internet was too high and there was no wireless in rooms just cable Anyway I do think this hotel has got the price value balance correct and this makes it an attractive place to stay when other hotels are charging  400   for an inferior product  Check it out for yourself if you can get a good rate

Stayed at the Intercontinental Singapore for a 5 day business conference with 70 other colleagues  Excellent service levels from the doorman through to receptionist and room maids  Breakfast and lunch buffets very good with wide range of both Western and Eastern dishes although set Singapore evening dinner served in the Ballroom could have been better quality  Our corporate room rate enabled free breakfast and internet access   apparently normal rates charge you by the minute for internet access so one to watch out for if paying yourself  Good sized outdoor pool but ho health spa  Very good central location about a 10 minute walk from the Raffles Hotel where you can sample the famous Singapore Sling cocktail

We stayed at Intercontinetal SIN in december 2008 for 4 nights  The room was nice and clean  The bed was comfortable  We had to pay for internet in the room  My wife received a birthday cake which was a nice gesture  The bathroom was clean with a bathtub and a separate shower  The toiletries were from Elemis  bigger sizes than one usually gets in a hotel  I ve seen some stains on a towel  I complained about it and the manager personally apologised  The breakfast was good  Lots of choices  also dimsum  The MRT is 5 minutes from the hotel  There are restaurants in the area of the hotel  including some  chinese  dessert restaurants If I know that I will not spend many hours in a hotel in SIN  than this hotel is a good choice in SIN JC

We took a 3 night stay at Intercontinental Singapore   This is our second stay there as they Intercontinental hotels are always our top of choice when travelling  The Intercon Singapore hotel is very centrally located  only take a few minutes by taxi major spots in Singapore such as Orchard roads  Clarke Quay or Marina Bays etc  We really loved the interior decor in white color and highly appreciate warmly and friendly service  Buffet breakfast was sumptuous  Enjoyed swimming at the hotel pool though it is small but acceptable

This is the second time I ve stayed at the Intercontinental Singapore  And although overall it s still a great hotel  I m beginning to think it s looking a little tired Being a heavy Priority Club user and Ambassador member when I checked in i was  quot upgraded quot  to a suit  Unfortunately the suit overlooked the attached shopping centre and so if you opened a window you were confronted by noise and fast food smells  So I asked to be moved to the main Hotel and was given an ordinary room  which was fine  just like I say beginning to look a little tired Two things I would recommend however are the staff and the buffet restaurant  both are excellant Overall this is still a great Hotel  but if they offer to upgrade you make sure it s in the main Hotel and try to avoid the area that s attached to the shopping centre

Stayed for five nights with wife and two children aged 4 and 6  Took a  quot King Premier quot  room with room for a roll away bed for the kids  Despite email confirmation and me phoning day before arrival  the room was not set up with the extra bed  Two visits to reception later    Hotel was a bit of a mixed bag   very tired in places for a higher end property  but you kind of expect that in Singapore  Strips of paint coming off the plaster in the breakfast room atrium    Room was nice and pool was nice  but no where near as nice as the Shangri La Staff were pretty friendly  but the concierge desk is a joke   don t expect any brochures  maps or helpful advice for the non business traveler INTERNET ACCESS is a total rort   over  30 singapore dollars for two hours of wireless access in the lobby lounge  Wired internet in your room is  30   day and not fast  When will these people join the 21st century   I pointed out to them the irony of paying a large sum of money to stay in a flash hotel and having to pop over to McDonalds to check your email without being ripped off Location is great  really lively and local with anything you could want or need within easy walk  and MRT station 5 minutes away Would go back if got a really good rate

We spent 3 wonderful nights at this delightful hotel in Singapore last week  We normally stay at the Ritz Carlton but as I am an Ambassador Member of the Priority Club of Intercontinental we decided to book this hotel for a change  We usually have a stopover stay in Singapore at least once a year on our way home from Europe We were welcomed warmly by the staff after our long flight from Paris at 7am  As we had booked a Club room we were taken up to the Club Lounge for check in and within a few minutes we were taken to our room which was a pleasant surprise as we didn t expect to have a room waiting for us so early in the morning We were given a lovely suite   1001   on the 10th floor with a lovely view overlooking Singapore  The hall  bathroom and huge L shaped rom were tastefully furnished and it was great to have room to move around in after our small bedroom in our Paris hotel The shower was fantastic with good pressure and the bathroom was large with a bath  scales  separate shower and all the extras you do expect from a 5 star hotel  Our bed was fantastic and the pillows were superb and even though we could have chosen 8 or more different sorts from the pillow menu  we were happy with the ones already on the bed  The room was so peaceful and quiet  it was a great place to just relax in The Club Lounge was excellent with a good breakfast  a delicious afternoon tea and great nibbles and drinks after 5 30pm  It was well worth the small extra we paid to be part of this set up The pool area on the 4th floor looked to be ideal for those wanting to have a swim  we just didn t have enough time to take advantage of this area The hotel is in a wonderful position  handy to everything  The Bugis Station is right near the hotel  there are lots of shops and a department store within a few hundred metres of the hotel  You can reach these directly from the hotel through an air conditioned market place and it is only a block away from Raffles Hotel  Raffles City Shopping Centre  City Hall station and the underground link to the Marina Square Shopping Centre  Millenium Walk and Suntec City  We will definitely be returning to the Intercontinental on our next visit to Singapore

I ve stayed here several times in the last 12 months  The service level is always high  although they do appear understaffed during peak periods  In a great location with a mall connected to the hotel  Just a short taxi or walk away from most business centers  Rooms have and older colonial feel  A touch smaller than the average size singaporean 5 star hotel  Prob due to the old building the hotel is within  Rooms are clean with the standard 5 star amenities  some decor is getting old however the beds sleep well and are clean  The lobby lounge is very impressive  The gym is small and dated  Don t expect cutting edge equipment

I booked this hotel for 2 reasons  membership of Priority Club  and proximity to Suntec City for my conference  easy 5 minute walk   Check in was attended to with a minumum of fuss  first hotel I stayed in where elevator activated by touching of room key  after correction of initial hitch  worked smoothly for all 5 days of stay  Room is spacious and light filled  being on the northern side of the hotel  Only a small hitch  the drainage of the basin in the bathroom was slow to drain  and this was attended to by the hotel staff A quiet oasis above the bustle of the large Bugis Junction shopping centre underneath  which offers good inexpensive dining options  Also slightly disappointed that the hotel s fine dining Japanese restaurant  Ko  was closed for the weekend Will definitely return  and would like to stay in one of the  quot shophouse quot  rooms on the 2nd and 3rd floors

After a very fast twelve days moving around the middle east  arrived in Singapore late afternoon from Abu Dhabi  so by the time I checked in and had a shower I really did not have much idea about what to have for Dinner I eventually went down to The Olive Tree Restaurant   I had the best Tenderloin Steak I have had for some considerable time  and prepared exactly as I like it   medium well done   Portion sizes were perfect  and the meal was a very pleasant experience  I can certainly recommend The Olive Tree to anyone who realy enjoys their food M H Marshall   England

This hotel started off well for me  I had not requested a room for an early occupancy  but they made one available for me anyway  I really appreciated this as i had just got off a long flight from dubai and was tired and needed a shower and 40 winks  The hotel obliged with a nice cool room which was quite big  well appointed and very quiet and comfortable  The hotel is not awash with facilities but it is pleasant and was convenient for where i was going  I liked it  It is quite old now  but up to scratch in most respects  While it was probably a tall building in the 1970s  it is now diminutive compared to the glass edifices all around it  Having said that it is near shopping malls and has some nice shop houses and restaurants in the area  Not a bad spot at all

Having stayed at numerous 5   hotels in Singapore we were generally disappointed with our first impression of the hotel  The hotel looks and feels like it needs a revamp to bring it up to the standard of other 5 star hotels  Location  Again we were not happy with the location as it¡¯s too far away from Orchard Road and the shops  We took cabs everywhere as we didn¡¯t feel like catching trains  Check in  Everything went accordingly to plan and the staff were efficient and friendly  Room ?  Our room was very spacious similar size to a suite  The room had a large king size bed  lounge suite and dining table  We were highly impressed with the size of the room  The bathroom was again roomy with a separate walk in shower and bath  However

The Intercontinental is on top of the Bugis shops in Singapore   which are one of the local must do experiences  in my opinion  The hotel itself is very clean  well designed and well staffed  My room was large and had good views   on the North side  The hotel outdoor pool is great   but could do with a few extra lounges  rather than double beds   for the guests who congregate here  If you are acclimatised to the Singapore heat and humidity  the Intercontinental is only a short walk to Raffles  the colonial buildings and museums  the Suntec exhibition centre  the theatres  the river and the CBD  In other words  the location is excellent  I would highly recommend this Hotel

Stayed for two nights in this hotel travelling back from New Zealand to UK  loved the Hotel and all the staff were very helpful  it is well situated for walking to explore the city the rooms are of a high standard  the only complaint i had was we had prebooked a roll away bed  we arrived late and it was not prepared we had to call twice to get it  they resolved the problem by not charging for it if you are leaving later in the day the cost of a room to change is expensive  but the toilets in the lobby are large enough to accomodate quick changes of clothing overall a good advertisment for the high standard given by staff

This was our fourth stay at this hotel and it may have been our last  While we have always been very pleased with the lovely  serene atmosphere of the place and the convenience of its setting  right above the Bugis MRT stop  we have never been very impressed by the quality of check in  This time check in was so unprofessionally rude and slow for a five star hotel that I wrote a note to the management  After a 24 hour journey we were kept half an hour at the desk  there were no other people checking in  while the receptionist occasionally glared at us and tapped furiously on the computer  No explanation  no apologies  Five months earlier we had requested a rollaway for our four year old son on the hotel website  and sent an additional email  to which we never received a reply   The rollaway wasn t in the room  and despite the reluctant acknowledgement of the receptionist that we had requested one it wasn t there two hours later either  We had to make a special phonecall to make it clear that our young child needed to go to bed  It s a real pity that reception is so abysmal because the other staff bend over backwards to please and the overall facilities are great

Booked my stay through asiabest  I was very much looking foward to my stay at Intercontinental after reading all the reviews here but I hate to say that I was very disappointed with their service  When we arrived  my husband was greeted by the bellhop  I felt invisible  Check in was efficient although I was told that the only room they had was a twin room and that it was an upgrade  I did ask if there was any possibility that they would move us to a different room with at least a queen and I was told that they would look into it  The room was right at the far end of the hotel  It was quite
