We stayed at the Intercontinental whilst travelling from the UK to New Zealand  It was the perfect place for a 2 night stopover  Firstly  we arrived early  before 10 am  exhausted and dreading that we would not have access to a room  We needn t have worried  Even though we are a family of 5  booked into 2 rooms  we were able to move in straightaway  The 2 rooms were interconnecting  which is great when you have children  The bed was probably the most comfortable I ve ever slept in and the bathroom was HUGE

My wife  amp  I have just returned from a 5 week vacation including the last 3 days in Singapore  We made our reservation on the Hotel web site and paid around  S330 per night including taxes etc The hotel is well located and is convenient to the Bugis MRT  underground access  and the grocery store below  All staff are very friendly and helpful but there are a couple of things that for a modern  5  Star hotel should be better  We were located in the older section on the lower floors  Room size was good  as was the bathroom but things are getting  tired  and need some freshening up Breakfast is the usual  buffet  but it really was no better than a  3  Star hotel in terms of variety  imagination or  something special  Had to use the business centre briefly for internet access and was surprised to learn this is available at a cost  small but my experience is that this is usually free   Walking through the lobby indicated that porterage was often stretched            our experience particularly on checkout and later when returning to collect our luggage to go to the airport  A similar experience was found when we were seeking some pretty basic tourist information from the Concierge One evening around 8 30pm we waited in the hotel taxi queue for about 45mins  Locals around us  and behind us in the queue  began making telephone bookings and were then leaving well before us  The porters did little to explain options or arrange an improved service            there are over 22 000 taxis in Singapore For similar monies  slightly higher or lower  I suspect there may be some better options right now in Singapore

The location of this hotel is perfect  as we love the Bugis area  The staff are excellent  The meals are delicious  We stayed a week after a relaxing holidays in the Maldives and when we arrived we were shown to our corner suite and adjoining room  I couldn t fault this hotel  We are a family with four young  well travelled and well behaved  children and this hotel was just perfect

Stayed here Dec 25 Jan 2  I booked through the hotel website early and had a rate of  160 sgd night which was a great value for this caliber of hotel  The room was spacious  clean  the bathroom was excellent  Only problem was they did not have my reservation when I arrived  but the problem was resolved  The subway is very close to the hotel  you can walk directly from the hotel into the mall and into the subway without going outside  The walk to the subway is less than 5 minutes

We stayed at the Intercontinental Singapore from December 26  2006 through January 1  2007  Overall  we rate it an exceptional facility  The team is extraordinary  The facilities are quite good  and the hotel is superbly situated in this wonderful city state  Singapore is a shoppers haven  Mindful of this tradition  it is important that a visitor select a hotel that is situated conveniently to all major shopping areas    the elite ones and those that cater to non designer retailers  The Intercontinental Singapore suits all needs  It is walking distance to  quot Arab Street  quot  an area where vendors sell silk  wool and other fabrics by the meter  These merchants also peddle other clothing items and specialty pursuits  One also can walk to Little India  where many items are sold by local vendors and the food is exceptionally good and reasonable  A shopper also can walk down the street to the Raffles Hotel  and its continguous mall  for more upscale pursuits  Finally  an inexpensive cab ride will take you to retail heav en    the Orchard Road and Scotts Road  We offer this observation at the outset because we noted the relatively remote location of other five star hotels in Singapore  We also noted  by extreme contrast  the location of the Hyatt and the Marriott right in the middle of the heavy commercial foot and vehicular traffic  This hotel  and its location  offered a unique and convenient balance We start with commentary about the positive aspects of this hotel  As noted by others  the breakfast buffet was exceptional  Freshly squeezed jiuces  wonderful breads and cereals  an array of fresh fruits  specially prepared items  and other nicely presented food items made for an outstanding experience  Everything was presented wonderfully  The staff    the team    was attentive  charming and committed to customer service  We especially liked Kelly  who was a charming  efficient and attentive waitress  The dining room was bright  clean and cheerful  It was neat  and inspired a sense that the team was dedicated to maintenance of a clean and healthy dining environment The room was clean and well appointed  The best part was the predictable arrival of the housekeeper  She arrived to make the bed during the day and arranged it for the evening about the same time  Given recent experiences in the US  this is something that we should appreciate  After all  there is nothing worse than returning to a room only to discover that it has not been cleaned and made before mid afternoon  We always found our room made and arranged when we returned during the afternoon  We also were able to predict the arrival of the housekeeper in the evening to turn the bed and otherwise arrange the setting  This may seem petty but it is a very nice feature in these times The hotel staff    the desk team  the concierage  the bar   the bell men  door persons were kind  attentive and determined to make your stay a fine experience  We cannot offer a single less than positive comment about them  Actually  they were at time quite entertaining  and attuned to your needs and preferences The only negative comment I can offer is the price of the drinks at the hotel bar  They were twice the price of nearby facilities  Once I discovered this reality  I went elsewhere by foot or with dinner  Obviously  this is treated as a profit center The hotel outdoor pool and fitness facilities are basic  Nothing exceptional here  They are available if you need them  but clearly no one associated with the hotel virews them as critical or esential features The hotel offers spa and massage services  Take your time before making a commitment  There are plenty of spa and massage facilities thourghout Singapore that cost a fraction of the cost offered by the hotel team  Some are literally seconds away from the hotel property by foot Singapore is a great city  It is extrremely clean and safe  Everything is convenient  The people    the residents    are delightful and friendly  Most things are reasonbably priced  Shopping is a cultural event  The zoo is a special event If you stay at this hotel  take advantage of the package that includes the breakfast buffet  Walk down the street to Purvis Street    minutes away    for lunch or dinner at some nice  and clea  places  Survey the shops at the Raffles Hotel  an old guard British facility  for convenience   The original Singapore Sling at the Long Bar is a tourist trap   Do your real shiopping  however  on Orchard Road or Scotts Road  Be patient  survey first before you spend a dime  Be Job like  bargain and br prepared to walk away in the local retail electronics and jewelry establishments  Outside the hotel  eat like a local  We found an Indian restaurant at the Albert Court Hotel  another old guard British spot  that served outstanding food for reasonable prices  Probe  explore and examine Little India  Chinatown  Arab Street and other ethnic retail areas for bargains and for good food   The Apollo Banana Leaf restaurant is worth a visit    once  Don t worry about clothing in most of Singapore  Most upscale places permit entrance while casually dressed  Given the warm temperatures  this is quite understandable Tailors are everywhere  We found a good one at 14 Scotts Road    Intrend Fashions  Master Tailors   They promptly tailored our items from photographs we selected from magazines The Takashimaya Mall belies Short Hills  The Somerset Collection and other upscale malls in the US  And  it is a short cab ride from the Intercontinental  It is worth a visit In closing  I already plan to return to the Intercontinental Singapore  It truly is a world class hotel facility that serves the public through an experienced and focused team  We suggest that you go to this hotel once  and return often

Staff incapable of telling the truth    Despite booking and paying 6 months in advanced  we were bumped to a different room type  The check in staff member gave the expanation that the hotel was full and they were doing us a favour given we were checking in early  11 30am   When we said we would wait for our room  they said there wouldn t be one available so no point waiting  They provided no options for a late check out 2 days later  we were happy to pay extra  but they then went into sales mode to get us to buy club lounge accessLater that night enquired about getting the room we booked  Transferred to a room that became free  The 5th floor and our room had ioniser machines going  When we asked why  they refused to explain  Discovered next day as we got paint fumes from room next door as it was being refurbished Porter damaged suitcase on arrival and said nothingInternet a rip off   cost SG 13 50 for 15mins and 3 page printoutOverall not a pleasant stay given we couldn t get a straight answer from staff and felt hotel only interested in maximising revenue by managing capacity utilisation and add on charges such as internet and club lounge  A hotel is your home away from home and this hotel did not feel like home

After a long flight  I was looking forward to staying here since our 2 previous experiences had been pretty good  We checked in   2am and they said the hotel was 100  full and gave us a smoking room  I can stand the smell of smoke  but they told us the room would not be smokey but the hall will be  As it turned out  the room smelled like smoke and the hallway was even worse  I went down to ask for a room change but to no avail  I knew they had more rooms since the guy who just checked in got a room  Funny  I paid for my room months ago and asked for a non smoking room  How could they just overbook and think it is ok to stick me in any room  Not something I expect from a high end chain  What s the point of booking and paying good money in full if it s just a loose reservation  I wouldn t stay here again  I couldn t sleep all night  We got a new room the next day  The room had seen better days  but the bed was comfy  It was in worser conditions than the other Intercontinentals of other cities  No free wifi  but free newspaper  Curtains can t block any light  so you re forced to wake up at sunrise  So if you can t sleep with light  book another hotel

I stayed at the InterContinenal in October 2009 and gave it a rave review  I returned for four additional night in June 2010 and found the hotel as fabulous as before  This time  however  I was able to leave the hotel and explore and neighborhood  I liked the mall that is attached to the hotel and ate and shopped there daily  The mall houses an MRT stop  so I could get to the hotel from the MRT without going outside  which was handy when it rained  I liked the 7 11 directly across the street  The InterContinental s Internet charges are outrageous  but there is an excellent Internet cafe in the next block  This is a fabulous hotel in every respect  I will return again this year for a 3rd time

We stayed with family of 3 kids at the Intercontinental Singapore and the stay was very comfortable with very courteous staff  The rooms were well layed out with good quality furniture as well  The location was also very good right next to Bugis Junction with the MRT taking you most places in Singapore  The breakfast was also very good with a complete spread  The kids and the wife really enjoyed the stay

This was my 3rd stay at the Intercontinental and while it was Ok  I m sure it could be better  For starters  i have yet to be given a room above the 5th floor  I dont know if it is the rate I paid that only gets me a room on a low floor  this time  I paid the most  S 224 and only got a room on the 3rd floor  The room itself was ok  spacious and the bathroom was spacious  There was an annoying sound from the floor above  but I put up with it  I dont know if I ll be staying at this hotel again  since I know when I stay at other hotels in Singapore  I can get a room on a higher floor without asking  but yet this hotel keeps putting me on a low floor  I got an email a few days before my arrival  saying they were looking forward to my stay and would have a room ready for me  I thought that would meant that would prepare a good room for me  certainly not a room on the same level as the gym and meeting rooms  I don t think I ll be staying here again or recommend it to friends

We were truly impressed with the impeccable service that the hotel provided  We opted for the hotel to pick us up at the airport  To our amazement  an airport staff was already waiting for us at the gate with a sign and a golf cart to take us to a private area  We were whisked away to a secluded area for immigration clearance  and then offered coffee  tea  and or snacks  We waited for a few minutes until the hotel car picked us up  The standard car was a black E class Mercedes Benz  Our driver was very friendly and nice  That experience and concierge service alone was very much needed and appreciated after many many hours of traveling  Upon arriving at the hotel  we were immediately escorted to our hotel room  We stayed in the ShopHouse suite  The bed was comfortable and our preferred pillows were already waiting for us in the bed  The food at the lounge was good and decent  The lounge served food five times a day including afternoon tea and cordials  The service from this hotel was truly impeccable

I visited the InterContinental Singapore for one night after crossing in from Malaysia and it truly was a fantastic experience  As with all InterContinental hotels the incredible levels of service and comfort of this hotel did not disappoint  The IC Singapore is situated on Middle Road and is connected to the Bugis MRT station shopping complex  It is right in the heart of the city and its excellent transport links providing a fantastic base for a short stay or longer break alike  The hotel itself is inspired by the art and style of the  Peranakans  and is luxurious  refined and uniquely Singaporean whilst retaining the Intercontinental  feel   The entrance and lobby are stunning and certainly eye opening   even for a weary traveller like myself My room was equally brilliant  I arrived early and was checked into a ground floor room so I imagine the view wasn t as good as other parts of the hotel but I didn t care in the scheme of things  The attention to detail was sublime  the d? cor glamorous but refined and the room was bright and airy  The bathroom and shower were mind blowing and I felt like a new man ready to explore amazing Singapore  After going out for a few drinks with friends to the Long Bar and exploring Little India I returned to the hotel to the same warm welcome as I did earlier in the day  I retired to the trademark incredibly comfortable InterContinental bed   sheer bliss  I didn t try the breakfast as I was meeting with friends the following morning but checkout was as smooth as check in  The staff were also kind enough to store my luggage after check out so I could spend a few precious extra hours exploring Singapore before my next flight  This is a fantastic hotel and well worth the rates charged  Stunning architecture  d? cor  location  comfort and service all combine to create a brilliant experience  I couldn t recommend it more

Stayed here with my husband  who was out here on business  and my 14 month old son  Although the hotel is ideal for the business traveller  it was absolutely fine for us as a family  The hotel is elegant and professional and run with efficiency  We stayed in a standard room and with the cot in there was still plenty of space  The room was very comfortable and the bathroom was also fine  All the staff are very attentive and greet you which is nice  I found Fahid and Robert  taxis  very friendly and helpful  Even the housekeeping cleaning staff were very nice  Th location of the hotel is very good  You can access the Bugis junction and Bugis village shops restaurants cafes from one of the hotel exits which was great and there is a 7 eleven just outside the hotel  Also on many of the side streets outside the hotel are more eateries which many locals seem to use  We ate in one of these during our last evening In terms of facilities  I m not sure why Internet is not free or at least free for a few hours here  There is a good gym and I used the pool and took my son into the children s pool  Ideally  I would say that this pool suits kids from the age of 3 4 upwards and is simply a paddling pool  not a swimming pool  Kids are not allowed in the other pool  which is a swimming pool  The pool area does need modernising  but it is still fine and usable We used the Club lounge for afternoon tea and breakfast and did not find this as child friendly  no high chairs  as the main restaurant and the choice selection is poor for what you can get in the rest of the hotel  I didnt see the point of the expensive club lounge    Breakfast was excellent in the main restaurant and they had a high chair for our son and it was very light and airy  In terms of baby friendly things to do in Singapore  I had 3 days and I took my son to the zoo which was superb  Great value for money and the best zoo I ve been to in the world  It is located in the tropical rainforest  We took a boat trip at the zoo and if you have young children there is a kids play area park there too  You have to pay for the rides and animal feeding  We also went to the Jurong Bird park which was also pleasant  There is a tram which goes through the treetops and its worth doing a ride on that  We found the underwaterworld aquarium on Sentosa Island very disappointing  It s the smallest aquarium I ve been to in the world   We covered the aquarium in 10 minutes and it is not wheelchair pushchair stroller pram friendly  in common with many parts of Singapore   if you are in a wheelchair dont come here    A few times I had to carry my pram in one hand and baby in the other to go up and down stairs  Apart from sharks and some of the bigger fish I thought that Singapore zoo had just as much fish and water life  The only saving grace factor that the underwater world has are the pink dolphins and if you want to visit  time your visit with the dolphin shows otherwise you ll be disappointed  Overall  we enjoyed our time in Singapore and it was helped by a very comfortable stay at the Intercontinental

Shop House wing   3rd floorapparently a renovation of this wing is in the works but they should hurry up  amp  get on with it because  although the bones are there for a good hotel  5 Star rates are just not merited right nowroom needed a painting  amp  you will want to wear your slippers in the showerair conditioner condenser in the foyer ceiling made an  quot arcing quot  sound every 30 seconds all night which sounded just like someone trying to get into your room   definitely good for at least 10 startled wake ups a nightlong  long winding walk to your room  up the elevator  through the pass card key doors  down a long hall  around a corner  down steps  around another corner  over the footbridge between buildings  around yet another corner   I kid you not    if it was not  quot low crime does not mean no crime quot  Singapore you might be a little afraid but instead it just feels lonely  amp  desolate   not quite The Shining  but close   couldn t even try the pool because my beautiful but modest wife would never take that walk in her swim cover up  nor should she have to Might try again after a reno  amp  a reconfiguration but not before

A great value for money hotel for location  comfort  attention and a sense of Singapore style  We arrived on an early morning long haul flight and were immediately assigned a temporary room so we could have a shower and nap  Our room had everything we needed and the luxurious beds linen helped ease our jet lag  Staff  without exception  were friendly and helpful at all times  Being so close to the MRT made getting about easy and quick  Will definitely choose this hotel again

Hotel lobby is very beautiful  very elegant  I watched newspaper there everyday after breakfast  The designer for the lobby obviously has a very good eyes  The blending of color and the light  the space  with fountain outside  I wonder whether the designer has taken fen shei into consideration  The breakfast restaurant has a rooftop that allows natural sunlight to come in  What a nice start for a day  I came with my sister whose company has a rate that include Internet connection  But the rip off of Internet from previous review is suspicious  Singapore has free wi fi in most places  so even you don t use hotel Internet  you probably can still use another wi fi connection for free  This is my personal guess  I do suggest that the hotel simply offer free Internet to everyone this will solve the concern Very nice sleeping quality  plus a big breakfast in a nice restaurant  very pleasant stay Location is near everywhere  Walking distance to Suntec  mall and subway is next door  I gave it a four star because I like a waterfront property  I don t think it is necessary to live in the middle of malls in Orchard road area

I stayed here for 4 nights   5 days US   s 300   per night  a bit steep   I think Location is good Rooms are super   a bit old  on the bathroom front  The  look  of the Hotel  I really loved The B Fast was nice  amp  fresh  but the  same  was there everyday  No change The only drawback is the  concierge  service  Below par  they have no idea about Singapore  Poor suggestions  amp  each time a direction is asked  the standard answer is take a cab     This area needs to be worked on Overall staff is good  Well behaved  amp  well dressed also well appointed   I would recommend a stay here  if one could get a room   US   s 200   per night  Other option id Hotel Naumi  amp  new Carlton  Nice locations  amp  newer properties All the Best  MBJ

Stayed fr the first time  is nicely located to my meeting place  I was upgraded to the suite and the room was big The breakfast is a good spread  The service is good and the only points I think is the value for money as it is slightly more expensive but maybe it is because it is in Singapore The person at the business center was helpful and when we took 2 printouts  she offered them at no charge Nice touch  these small intangibles things are what converts the service levels to a exceptional one and better than the competition My next trip   will I stay here   I think so

The hotel is awesome  It is luxury  I can t say enough about the breakfast that was included with the room price  WOW  Great food  The only thing I didn t like was that the Chinese Restaurant in the hotel closes for a few hourse between lunch and dinner  That was inconvenient  Staff was helpful  rooms were large and clean  food was good  What more can you ask for  The hotel is a little far from Orchard Road  but not too bad

This hotel came highly recommended from my best friend who lives in Singapore  I figured he couldn t be wrong and he wasn t Upon arrival I humbly asked if it was possible for an upgrade  despite having no status with their membership program and booking the most inexpensive basic room  turns out they upgraded me to a  quot shop house quot  room that overlooked the interior mall courtyard area  Very nice surprise  esp  the shutters on the windows  Quite colonial  Room was very spacious  and the location of this hotel was sublime   just steps away from the Bugis MRT stop as so many have noted  Of course you walk through a mall to get there and back  but this is Singapore   shopping is a national pastime Also if you need any sundries a 7 11 is just right down the road less than a 3 minute walk The only negative is how much of a walk there is in this hotel  It can be quite confusing like you re going though a maze and don t know where you re going until you ve gone through 2 or 3 sets of double doors so just be ready for this All in all a great hotel and for the price would def  consider coming back

I don t usually write reviews of properties teeming with reviews  but after my first stay here  this hotel has jumped to  2  tied with the Yokohama Grand InterContinental  of my all time favorites This hotel was recommended by my husband  I ve stayed in the Hilton  Sheraton  Swisshotel and numerous others in Singapore  What I liked about the IC  and particularly the shophouse room   was the feeling of something with a little bit of history  while not lacking in modernity  The lobby was a nice size   not overwhelming with high ceilings or overly crowded and busy  It felt welcoming  The shophouse room was comfortable with chairs  small table as well as desk and chair  The room is tastefully decorated according to the InterContinental standard  Flat screen TV makes the room feel airier  The bathroom amenities were nice  there is a bathtub and separate shower stall with glass door  Hot water was plentiful and the shower head worked great  Bathrobes are provided The bed itself was very comfortable   not too hard and not too soft  The pillows were fluffy enough without giving me a neck ache  The only complaint is that the daily refreshing of the room was erratic  Upon arrival  fruit and mineral water were provided  The second day  nothing  But  provided again on the third and fourth day  Similar situation with the newspaper   first and second day  The Straits Times  third day  nothing  and I departed too early on the final day for paper delivery  they were just being delivered to the bellman as I was leaving  The odd thing about a wake up call is that you get one 5 minutes in advance from a machine  the second call  on time  is from a person Bugis Junction is attached to the hotel  There is a largish Cold Storage supermarket  larger than some of the other locations in Singaporean malls   this one has a deli and hot foods to go  As Singapore is well connected by MRT throughout the shopping   hotel areas  this hotel is convenient to just about everything  Service is not as good as my  1 favorite  ICC BKK  but adequate  I didn t have time to check out the gym  as I took a couple of long walks to Chinatown to do some great shopping for souvenirs  probably a bit better than Orchard Road shopping due to the concentration and close proximity of all of the vendors

I love the Intercontinental  The purpose of my visits there are in transit between the long journey from Aus to Europe and vice versa  The hotel rooms are really nice  comfortable beds  decent room service  beautiful bathrooms and a nice deep bath  tub  to soak in after a long haul flight If you feel like venturing out shopping then Bugis Junction is at the door and Raffles City mall is a 5 min walk from the hotel  and from there you can explore the City Link Mall etc Great hotel

Arrived morning time in Singapore but the staff were so friendly and had no bother checking us in early  The hotel was immaculately clean  The rooms were luxurious and the attention to detail made this hotel very high quality  Had a buffet breakfast in the hotel  great choice and the quality was excellent  Staff were so attentive and could not do enough to help Singapore is a great place to visit and our stay here made it special

Singaporean staying in a Singapore hotel for a weekend getaway purpose in late March 2007  Just for relaxation  Pool was nice Jucuzzi  amp  Gym was nice for a workout  Rooms were huge and clean  Bedswere very comfortable and nice pillows  Toilet huge as well with bathtub and standing shower  Flat screen tv with many cable tv channels  Location is very good just at Bugis Junction  Bugis street shopping is just 1 road away  Bugis Junction shopping center is just quot downstairs quot   Extremely enjoyable

Great Hotel at a lovely location  Just walk out the  quot back door quot  and you ll be at the shopping heaven   with a supermarket  pharmacy  restaurants  and a departmental store all nearby  Walk a little further and you can also find an MRT station Food is excellent   Try to get your stay with breakfast as they offer a simple and lovely breakfast buffet  They go for quality  rather than just quantity which many other hotels do  Staff are all friendly and helpful  Hotel is clean  which is really important to me   Also stayed there once during christmas season  Hotel was tastefully decorated with christmas decor which puts the hotel guest in a happy and festive mood This hotel is a little pricey  but if you can afford this  I would recommend that you try this place  I ve stayed there 3 times and each stay was wonderful  Also had a training conference there  Facilities are good for such events too

Stayed in December as part of our honeymoon  We loved the Intercontinental  Shophouse room was spacious and comfortable  Check in was excellent  Rained the whole time we were in Singapore  but Intercontinental made it a great 3 days If travelling with Singapore Airlines en route to somewhere else  check out the Singapore Stopover Deals  Really good rates in all stars of hotels

Don t get me wrong  this is a really nice hotel  Clean  good position  reasonably priced and staffed for the most part by willing  decent people who want to make sure you have a good stay  Unfortunately when we checked in and went to our room we caught one of the porters red handed rifling our luggage  Fortunately we got there just in time and he didn t take anything  Unfortunately the duty manager and the parent company have so far not responded positively to the incident  To an extent I can understand  If stuff has been taken then of course it would be a completely different matter  I d like to think   Our discomfort at this unfortunate introduction to Singapore is that the guilty party remained on duty for the remainder of the two days we were there and we saw him around all of the time and really it s the laissez faire attitude of the hotel management that has got my goat  By all means stay there but keep your eyes on your bags

We booked our hotel via the Singapore Stopover brochure and after reading up about it on the internet  The hotel has a great first impression  the men at the door are friendly and the hotel is clean  However  we travel quite a bit and I can honestly say that I have never experienced a check in like we did at the Intercontinental  The lady behind the desk greated us with a strained smile and then said that  quot you want a kingsize bed in a non smoking room quot  we replied  quot yes that is what we booked quot   She then told us that there were no rooms available and we could ever go into a smoking room or have two single beds in a non smoking room  I informed her that that was not ideal and we had booked a kingsize bed in a non smoking room  She continued to look at us as if we were to except what she was telling us but we did not  After she spent another 5 minutes searching the computer she then told us that she had a room available    To me that was absurbed and I felt like they were trying to put us in a cheaper room so they could either put someone who was more distinguised in there or someone who would pay more money  Anyhow our room was beautiful  everything was so new and tidy  They had free grapes and bottles of water on arrival  a comfortable bed  new TV with good channels and everything else you would expect  The hotel itself was in a brilliant location  so central with a mall outside one of the entrance s  The check out was the opposite to our check in and very easy  the man behind the counter was friendly Overall would we come back to this hotel again  NO  I have stayed in Singapore before and we last stayed in a 4 star hotel which was much more enjoyable and friendly

Stayed over 4 days during the recent Singapore Grand Prix  Was somewhat apprehensive about paying for a standard room but was given a room on the high floors  facing Bugis junction shops  Room was spacious  clean  had a Bose Wave radio  Elemis toiletries  Staff were courteous and always on hand to help   especially good considering how busy the hotel was during the F1 weekend  Nice to see some top end Porsche s on display during the race weekend as the Porsche Cup team were also staying here  will definitely return for next years Grand Prix

Stayed here with my husband and our young disabled nephew  Staff couldn t have done more for us  The hotel was wonderfully accessible for the wheelchair  all entrances and exits  Staff got taxis for us and sorted out the wheelchair  The concierge even got us a bicycle pump when we needed it to pump up tyres  We went back again and would return on any future visit

My husband and I spent five nights at the Intercontinental in late September 2010  We chose the hotel on the basis of its excellent location and positive reviews on Trip Advisor  Right from check in the service was attentive and all personnel were eager to assist  We pre paid for a Deluxe Room but were delighted to find we had been upgraded to a Shophouse Room  which was tastefully furnished with a colonial ambience and ample room for a longer stay The bathroom was well appointed and we especially enjoyed the high pressure shower head instead of those dreadful water saving heads where you almost have to walk around to get wet The first morning we had breakfast in the Olive Tree Restaurant  The ambience was lovely but the food was standard fare  the usual high fat  luke warm western breakfast buffet choices   Another morning I didn t feel well enought to eat so we were served toast and tea in the lobby lounge Requests were dealt with quickly  such as a mattress topper  Asian beds are often too hard by Western standards   although we did need to ask twice for a replacement mini bar as the first one was not cooling correctly  We used in room dining frequently and the presentatin and standard of food was excellent The rooms were serviced twice daily  including turn down service  Overall  I would highly recommend the Intercontinental for location  comfort  service  ambiance and facilities  I would definitely stay there again

I loved this hotel  despite the price  Unfortunately  it was Formula 1 weekend in Singapore and the room rates seemed to have doubled The location and quality are what you d expect from this hotel  The room  beds and facilities are second to noen  It was a very quite room   staff were up to the usual great standard I do object being charged for internet access  It s better to head out to Bugis Street and grab the readily available Singapore WiFi internet

From the moment you arrive  the Intercon shows its true colours   brilliant  attentive service  wonderful rooms and facilities  24 hour fully equiped gym is a real plus when you re another time zone   close to shopping  resturants  culture centres  MTR  what more could you want If you can  upgrade to a  quot Club Room quot  you get free internet and access to the lounge with free cocktails and drinks in the evening   given the price of alcohol in Singapore  this is priceless  They will also press your shirts for free   fantastic after a long flight  As is the swmming pool   well worth unwinding there too

The hotel facade is very  old style  Singapore   magnificent   not some generic concrete box  The foyer and lobby areas a also stunning   this leads to concern that the rest of the experience will be a let down  Not so   We had interconnecting Club King and Twin rooms  These were well appointed with everything you could possibly need  It is a true 5 star hotel and the staff and service support this  The executive club is simply one of the best I have encountered   it makes the Grand Hyatt Singapore s look like a shoebox  It is huge  with the interior design done in the Peranakan style  Great breakfast buffet with eggs pancakes etc made to order  afternoon tea and drinks and nibbles in the evening The hotel is in a fantastic position   you can walk out a door straight into the Bugis Shopping Village  my teenagers loved this   There is also a Cold Storage supermarket  food hall and MRT Station in the complex  Bugis Street market is across the road  lots of cheap pap   Raffles is just up the road for the obligatory Singapore Sling  Raffles City shopping centre has some very upmarket stores and another great foodhall  I highly recommend this hotel  It is the only place we stay in Singapore PS the only problem I have is the cost of the internet   We ended up using the free wifi in the Executive Club

We stayed in the Intercontinental for 2 nights  9 11 Sept  following a visit to Malaysia in an excellent hotel  Rasa Sayang  Penang  Upon arrival  we informed reception that we had booked a club room and were advised to wait until someone could show us to the room as we would be checked in in the room itself  A lady came to collect us and took us to the room  I asked if we could possibly have a late check out due to a late night early morning flight and she said we could only have this if we became an a Priority Club member  which we were  then she said no  you need to be an Ambassador and this would cost us so much per year  We declined this option  We were then advised we would have to pay an additional half day room rate to keep the room until 6pm  I had requested 8pm  which due to our late flight  we accepted but she would not budge on the 8pm despite our paying an additional half day rate  It was 7 50pm when we checked in and I mentioned we had just missed the cocktail hour in the club lounge and was there any chance of getting a drink but she said no the lounge had finished  No niceties here  so we gave up and were just glad to get rid of her  Not the best start  We wandered to the lounge after and the ladies in there were exceptionally friendly and advised us that breakfast served in the club lounge was not hot  just a few pieces of hot bacon only  and the remainder of it was just continental  The advice was to eat at the main hotel buffet restaurant which had a huge selection and was free to club room guests  We can recommend this to anyone who stays at the hotel as the choice is excellent  lots of cold meats fruit pastries juice and also a hot selection of dim sum  noodles  rice  bacon  potatoes  fish  beef  omelettes made to order  Basically  you will not need lunch if you have a decent breakfast there  We had drinks in the lounge from 5 7 30pm which included sparkling wine and the usual spirits but I will say the selection of canapes was very poor   just a couple of items but mainly  quot chips and dips quot  with cookies available too  You can have tea coffee juice at any time of the day with cookies  The room itself overlooked the pool area at the front of the hotel and had a king bed  with workdesk  chairs  table and a flat screen TV  There wasn t really a vanity unit and the hairdryer was in a unit between the bedroom area  in a corridor by the wardrobe  making it difficult for 2 people to pass when the other was drying their hair  The bathroom was fine  with a single sink  separate shower  a large space age toilet and separate bath  The best thing about the hotel is that it adjoins a small shopping area at Bugis junction and is easily accessible to lots of places  including a short walk to Raffles Hotel and the Swissotel Stamford which was great as we dined at Equinox there  top floor restaurant  which had fantastic views of the quay area  It s a shame that the lady checking us was so indifferent to us at the beginning of our stay  it tainted our view of the hotel somewhat  but we did feel that tourists were more frowned upon in the club lounge than their business guests  despite having paid the same room rates  On the whole  the stay was okay but it s certainly not somewhere we would go back to again and I think next time  we ll try the Shangri La Valley Wing as we feel that the service levels for tourists will be better

This hotel was just great   We stayed in the victorian style room with my husband and it was very nice  Housekeeping made our bed in the morning and also got it ready for us to go to bed  I think they must have known when we were not in the room  They did not bother us at all  We booked our room with the hotel website and I thought we got a pretty good deal for S 225 night and it came with a great breakfast  Downstairs had a shopping center and the MRT which I thought was very convenient  We would definitely stay here again

Singapore is Expensive  Regardless of your currency  this City_x0019_s beauty comes directly from the Taxes you pay as a guest  Nothing is the price it seems  and Hotels are at least 15  more plus there is Goods and Services Tax on everything  pretty much  It is a nice and safe place but the money will start leaving your pockets as soon as you move through Customs and it won t stop until you leave The Intercontinental is in a great location but that is all it has going for it  Everything else about this Hotel is smoke and mirrors  You don t have to look too hard to see it looks ok but it being neglected and will be very ordinary in a few years  I stayed for 12 nights  pre paid through Priority Club where I am a Platinum Member  I am a simple guy  I like clean  neat and secure  I m not fussy and I don t write many reviews but I felt strongly enough about this stay to comment The driveways staff is friendly and helpful and the reception is neat but the staff are very mechanical in their approach and it wasn_x0019_t very personable  I was taken to my room but the staff member was just going through a routine and didn t seem interested The room was neat and tidy but that¡¯s where it stopped  The room service and housekeeping was terrible  They missed many things including replenishing coffee and cleaning the tiles in the entry  I had to call them back on a few occasions to do tings they had missed  Actually they didn t replenish the coffee

My husband and I stayed at the IC this August for 4 nights  Despite warnings from other fellow travellers  we booked the IC due to its reputation and our previous pleasant experience with IC in other cities  We booked in the last minute and took the only type of room that was available    the club room  at SGD 350     While our entire stay was overall pleasant  we felt the IC Singapore did not quite live up to its world wide reputation The exterior the hotel looked nice and gave an old colonial image  The lobby lounge where we had our breakfast everyday was grand and impressive looking  The daily breakfast was good with lots of selections  The Japanese restaurant was good although a bit pricy  We didn t use the pool as it looked so so and always crowed  As to the other facilities  we were pretty surprised to find that there was only a sauna and a tiny jacuzzi  and no steam room  There was a small gym  Our room included free usage of the facilities but we didn t use any of them As to our room  we have to say we were kind of disappointed when we saw our  quot club room quot  on the club floor  It was just an ordinary room  nothing special  There was some kind of smell in the room due to old age  and the walls were so thin we could hear the people next door getting up in the middle of the night using the bathroom and also in the morning taking a shower  along with their conversation  The exterior wall of the bathtub didn t close up properly and we could see the inside  We also had to call twice to request for our complimentary water bottles  The next day morning we went to the club lounge to have breakfast before heading out  It is always hot in Singapore so we were wearing shorts  We were refused entrance by a snobby employee who informed  loudly in front of other guests   quot I m afraid there is a dress code in this lounge  quot  We were not at any point informed of this and felt completely humiliated  We chose to have breakfast in the lobby lounge for the following mornings After 3 nights in the smelly club room  we moved to an ordinary room on a regular floor  at SGD 220     and were shocked to find that it looked exactly the same as the  quot club room quot  we previously stayed at   Plus  it smelled much better  We should ve moved earlier  We felt deceived  We couldn t understand why we paid SGD 130 more per night for the  quot club room  quot  The only difference we could come up with was that club room guests can go to the lobby lounge to have a drink every day  We are not sure this is worth an extra SGD 130 per day Of all the five stars hotels we stayed with around the world  the IC Singapore is probbaly the most unaccommodating and the most inflexible  There must be better hotels in the same price range  We stayed at Raffles the Plaza on our last trip and were quite satisfied  Next time we go to Singapore  we will try the Fullerton

As one would expect of a 5  luxury hotel  the InterCon is a fantastic hotel in a great location  The breakfast was vast  with Chinese  Japanese and Western options available  The coffee was actually fantastic here  Rooms are very well appointed  comfortable and quiet  We had some issues with the taxi queue  as the two concierges didnt quite communicate with each other where the line was  Expect very efficient staff  but not overly friendly  as is the luxury way  The house keeping staff were excellent and very friendly  polite and thanked us for visiting Singapore  not just the hotel  Pool is lovely  For the rates we could secure on their website  you cannot beat this hotel

My husband and I have stayed at the ICH Singapore at least half a dozen times over the past year and have nothing but good things to say about the hotel ICH s location on Bugis Junction is simply unbeatable   with great access to shops  malls  and markets as well as the metro  Service is highly reliable  Rooms are spacious  clean  and comfortable  Most importantly  it is really good value for the money We haven t spent time in the pool but it looks quite nice  As for food options  who needs to dine at the hotel when all options around Bugis  Try the underground foodcourt at the mall outside the hotel  It is cheap and selection abounds ICH has become our hotel of choice whenever we stay in Singapore

We just spent a week in one of the shophouse rooms at this hotel and found the place nearly perfect  Sure  it s not a grand luxe place with acres of marble and gardens and four swimming pools  but the public spaces are lovely  intimate  elegant  and pay attention to Singapore s history  Our shophouse room was also elegant and supremely comfortable with polished wood floors  a huge tiled bathroom with walk in shower and decent tub  biggish LCD TV with a good selection of channels  and all the other bits and pieces one expects at this level  Even better  the hotel is not on or near the hideous tourist frenzy of Orchard Road  Bugis Junction is not the raffish place it used to be  but is now a charming mix of old Singapore and new Singapore  The new National Libary is here and has free wifi if you don t wish to pay the SGD 30 a day for the hotel broadband  There s a covered shophouse street adjacent to the hotel with coffee shops and restaurants and a department store that has a nice big food court with lots of hawkers in its basement  You can eat and eat well here for very little  and that s important because the prices charged by the hotel for food and drink are pure highway robbery  and the main drawback of the place  The staff were consistently charming  friendly  and helpful  unlike the experiences of others on TripAdvisor  but we could have done without the constant knocking on our door on the morning of our checkout day to ask if we had yet gone  A great stay in a really good hotel  at a very decent price booked on the hotel s own website

This is a nice hotel in a great location  The rooms are very comfortable  the lobby and the lounge area is very spacious and opulent  and the pool area is nice though a little small Bugis Junction shopping mall adjoins the hotel and just a block away are the Bugis St markets which are bustling day and night  Just a few blocks to the north is the Arab quarter where I spent a fabulous morning shopping  It also has some interesting dining options  we dined at an atmospheric Arabic restuarant one night  We generally do not stay in 5 star hotels so the InterContinental was a bit of a splurge  The only thing that let down our stay were a couple of annoying service issues We arrived at the hotel after 8pm at night  We had no problem with the check in  although it would have been nice to have been told whether or not breakfast was included and where it was   However it took over half an hour for our bags to be delivered up to our room  and only then because I rang up to remind them  We really wanted to get changed and have a shower  but instead we had to sit around waiting for our luggage to arrive The next day we were out all morning  When we returned to the hotel at 1 30pm our room had still not been made up  We went back out again and returned at 4 30pm to find the maid only just starting to clean our room then  We were hot and tired and wanted to change into our swimmers to go to the pool  but instead we found ourselves sitting in the lobby for half an hour waiting for housekeeping to finish cleaning the room The breakfast buffet is very nice but ridiculously expensive  after taxes  84 for 2 breakfasts      Just as well it was included in our package or we would have gone outside to a cafe  The InterContinental is a very impressive hotel for a special occasion or a splurge  but for a general Singapore stopover I think there are better value hotels

Stayed 3 nights Nov  2010 excellent hotel but little bit pricey  Clean  Child friendly and club lounge fine  Compared to IC HK it is far better  Will recommend to any type of traveller as the location is near to MTR Bugis Junction walkable distance 10 minutes all the way to MTR it is covered so no direct sun or rain  Room was excellent and neat stayed in deluxe room  but breakfast not that much attractive and the staff seems not that much cooperative  rest perfect

I stayed the first time at the Intercontinental this End of Oct and it was like my best stay in a Hotel ever  About a 20min drive away from Changi Airport this Hotel is right next to the Bugis Shopping Mall   Bugis MRT Station  Check   In was fast   as of the Gold Ambassor Status we got a free Room Upgrade from Shophouse to Premier Room  Located on the 12 Floor we had an huge Room with a great View   Room Service was great  they even changed all the used Towels every Day and came twice a Day  Once in the Morning and once in the evening to make our beds again for the night  The Pool Area seems small  but actually over our Stay of 9 Days not really that much People used it  Great for relaxing and you can even see the Marina Bay Resort while ur in the Pool  We didn t use the Restaurants in the Hotel so i cannot tell something about that  They are so many little Restaurants around the Hotel   theres even a Food Junction at Bugis Mall so we ate there for less money  Bugis MRT is just a 3min walk away from the Hotel   you can be fast everywhere you want to be  Orchr Road is like 15min away with MRT   you need to change at City Hall to the other MRT Singapore is just so nice   its the nicest and cleanest city i have ever seen  There is even so much to see that 9 Days was even not enough Going to the Beach at Sentosa  going shopping in one of the Malls or seeing the beautiful gardens like chinese or japanese  There is so much to see and enjoy

The Intercontinental in Singapore has a mixture of quality  character and excellent staff  Having stayed in other hotels in Singapore and ASIA  this is the best one I have stayed in Singapore  The hotel was mostly full occupancy during this visit  yet the staff throughout the hotel performed exceptionally well  If possible  opt for the Club option as it included access to the Club Lounge  which is open from breakfast until 10 pm  The complimentary breakfast  drinks during the day  afternoon tea and evening service are amazing value for both business travellers as well as people passing though or taking a holiday  Combined with the free internet and other advantages  the Club option is recommended  Location is perfect for tourists and business users  The Bugis area provides a good mixture of local ?  good value restaurants all the way through to the higher end of the market  Access to the subway only takes minutes

We found the hotel superb in almost every way  check in was efficient although we arrived early we were immediately shown to a room  I had requested no feather bedding so beds were stripped and remade without any fuss The room was spacious and well equipped as was the bathroom We particularly liked the lobby for drinks and compared it to Peninsular in Hong Kong for the feeling of space and luxury  The only downside was the restaurant  food was ordinary  there was a shopping centre next to hotel with other dining options The concierge service was most professional and helpful in giving us ideas on transport and places to visit  My husband wanted a hair cut and he was escorted to what was the best  10 deal  The pool looked excellent but because we hit the pollution from fires in Indonesia outdoors was not a good option We plan to use hotel again for a stopover

If you plan to visit Singapore  this hotel is the place to stay  It is nice and rooms  even if not brand new  are large and comfortable  Get a drink or tea at the bar in the lobby  at night  with music from the piano   Service is nice and the staff very polite and eager to assist The location is nice  you can walk around and find nice restaurants and shops

During the past 4 years  this is where my wife and I went when visiting Singapore  And we were quite happy with it The service was good and efficient  The rooms are more than satisfying in terms of size and comfort  even if on the old side  Last time we have been there  we have tried one the _x001C_shophouse_x001D_ rooms  The room is bigger and some may appreciate that  But they are situated on the second or third floor of the _x001C_Bugis junction mall_x001D_  Therefore the you cannot open the curtain  otherwise the office or shops or whatever is in the opposite building will see everything happening in your room  But  because of this  and the fact that the opposite building is quite near  it is very dark in the room  Ok  we do not spend much time in the room  but  at least   when I wake up  I like to have some daylight in my room In addition  we found the room too cold and  because no sun ray can reach the room  it is almost impossible to warm up  even if you switch off the air con So last time I have decided that I will not take this kind of room anymore Since several weeks  even months  each time I try to book a room  they first propose the shophouse room  I guess it is because  they have some difficulty to sell them that they offer now a better price for this kind of room whereas  several months ago they were more expensive  Anyway

We are members of the Embassador Club and we were entitled to one night stay for free  When we called to reserve the room  they were told that we are getting one night for free and they said no problem  But when we checked in  they asked for a voucher which we were not aware of  They said they can verify that with headquarter  so fine  They upgraded us to an exxcutive room which one has to walk for extra long to get to  not to mention the old and smelly carpet that you have to endure each time you pass the hallway in your journeys  The room was bigger than standard rooms but the safe didn t work  the ceilings falling apart with big cracks  the shower drips and the door had a big crack so light from hall shined into our room all night  not to mention the cracking old door in the hallway which makes loud noise each time someone walked through the door  We also were told that we were not allow to use the embassador club lounge unless we pay for it  We got a note under the door next morning that were not honored with the free night we have have to pay for it  We were upset with the conditions of the room as well as they way we were rejected with the free stay and we couldn t use the club  The manager said she would do something about it  She left and went home without calling us back  Another manager said they can move us to another room on the same floor but we didn t want to deal with the smelly carpet in the hallway so we said no  we would rather go back to the main wing  So he said the price is the same and no free night and also no use of club unless we pay to get in  This conversation lasted many hours and we felt that the hotel didn t come up with any solution to make their supposedly honor member s stay more comfortable or at least solve the problem  We then called another 5 star hotel and got a cheaper deal and free breakfast and the whole bits  Honestly we were reasonable and just want to feel that intercontinental has done something for their guests but seemed like they could care less I think the managers lack problem solving ability and they don t have enough say or training to do certain things to ensure customer satisfaction  My husband travels every week and stay at 5 star hotels and this has to be our worst experience with a hotel with this rating It s a competitive business and I sure will never go back to stay there  Oh and they charged 30 sq dollars for Internet when pan pacific was free the whole time we stayed there

My family had a 4 day stay here and it was a pleasure We arrived on a late night flight after a long day and our arrival was hassle free  The rooms were spotless and the bed was a delight to sleep in  The staff at this hotel can not do enough for you and their service is outstanding  The location of the hotel is just around the corner from Raffles and the shopping complex of Orchard Road is only a  5 taxi ride away The Hippo tour buses have stops outside Raffles and also on Victoria Street  We found these a good way to get our bearings on the attractions but the underground service is also very good  Internet access was a bit expensive at the hotel but there is a very good internet cafe opposite Raffles  Singapore has a WiFi free network available in hotspots but you must obtain a Userid and it is probably easiest to do this on arrival at the airport from Information  I enjoyed Singapore and this was due in no small part to staying at the InterContinental

Stayed here one night pre and 3 nights post our Asian Cruise on board Superstar Virgo  The hotel is strategically located  Check in was pretty smooth  Rooms were spotless  The pillow menu was just awesome  I loved the pillows i requested  It was my aunt s birthday and when i told the frontdesk staff they surprised my aunt with a bottle of wine and cake  Overall  an excellent stay

There s nothing bad to be said about this hotel as it has all you can expect from a 5 star hotel The rooms are very big and clean  The bathrooms have both a shower and a bath  However you have to be careful while showering as the water filters underneath the door and the floor gets flooded all the time  There aren t any hooks to hung the towels on the sink or near it so you have to leave them on the bedroom  Those are the only 2 reasons why I won t give it 5 stars as I don t find it functional at all The location is very good as you can walk everywhere or to take the tube 5 mins away walking The swimming pool is very clean and great to relax after sightseeing

We arrived early one morning after an long  overnight plane journey  We were feeling extremely tired and jaded  and it was wonderful to be met by courteous staff at the InterContinental who arranged access to our room immediately  Our room was beautifully furnished and  most importantly  very quiet  The bed linen was crisp and of lovely quality The lobby area is extensive and has some exquisite and interesting pieces of furniture  Our breakfast was one of the best we had on our entire journey and I was delighted by the quality of the double shot cafe late  I highly recommend this hotel   it deserves its impressive rating on TripAdvisor  I would love to return one day

I stayed here for 4 nights for business and on my first night I lost my iphone in a cab  I hadn t planned on mentioning it to the staff but when the receptionist noticed I was upset I told him I had just lost my phone earlier that day  He was very apologetic  not that it was his fault at all  and asked me if I had caught the cab from the hotel  When I said yes  he told me to give all the details of the cab  pick up time  cab colour etc   to the concierge to look up the CCTV footage  Thankfully  Eugene  the concierge  was very happy to assist even though he said my chances of getting it back were pretty slim  which is what I thought too  To my surprise and his  Eugene had managed to track down my iphone   I had to pick it up from the Singapore police lost  amp  found and the hotel graciously offered to send someone to collect it for me  I thought that was really above and beyond their job so when I said I would collect it  Eugene even printed me a map of the address to give to the cab driver All in all a wonderful stay  The service was the highlight for me but the rooms were also very clean and spacious  great pool and delicious food to top it off  My only issue would be that they don t provide free wi fi in the rooms or free internet access in the business centre  besides that it was really great

I stayed here for two nights at the end of November and was very impressed by the location  the hotel was just along from Bugis MRT so it was easy to get around  Singapore is quite compact anyway so even without the MRT you can walk around easily  I arrived late  just before midnight and stil managed to find a hawker market just along the street which was still open  very good value food and drink I was in a club room which meant that afternoon tea  evening cocktails and breakfast are included  all very nice and plentiful  the lounge gets very busy weekday mornings though and the service wasn t so good on the monday morning  I didn t experience the restaurants in the hotel but the lobby lounge was very nice for a drink  I will stay again when next in Singapore

Our stay here was amazing from start to finish  We came for our 1 year anniversary and wished we had spent our honeymoon here  Staff we polite and ever attentive  Rooms were beautiful  very tastefully decorated with a lovely balance of moderness and traditional Peranakan style  All the common areas were stunning  including lobby  reception and club rooms  Club access was worth every penny  includes breakfast  afternoon tea and evening cocktails with beautiful food  My husband would have happily spent the 4 days in the club area  The thing which set this hotel apart was the service  which was personal and professional  On our honeymoon we had spent a few days at the Fullerton hotel which was much pricier and was very impersonal as well as a bit dated  We will definitely be returning to intercon  Another plus was the position  above Bugis mrt and shopping so very handy for shops and access to Orchard rd

We agree with rating this hotel relatively highly in Singapore  Definitely go for the Club level option if it works for you  The club lounge is attractive and it is a great oasis for food and drink throughout the day  The direct connection to Bugis Mall is very handy especially if you don t do club level    you can walk through the covered arcade to McDonald s for egg sandwich and Starbucks for coffee or take the escalator to the food court for Japanese breakfast breads

Stayed 7 nights at this wonderful hotel  True 5 star luxury and service  including a  pillow menu   We upgraded to the Club Intercontinental  which I would recommend  There is a lovely pool and a good fitness centre  The service from the friendly staff could not be faulted  Great location at Bugis Junction with short walk through mall to train station  Easy access to all parts of city by either train  taxi or walking  Ok  it s not cheap  But as an occasional treat it is pure luxury that I couldn t fault  For luxury and service this is the finest hotel I have stayed in

We recently stayed at the IC  using the club floor  On arrival the room allocation was not what I had requested  and even though they were full they managed to swap our rooms  The Club lounge was very nice  good breakfast  afternoon tea and cocktail hour  The staff in the club lounge were generally slow  although the manager in there was excellent and took charge  In the main part of the hotel  there are a lot of staff just walking around trying to assist you  Not a great place for families  not that they pretend to be  this is a business hotel through and through  Having said that they were able to organise babysitting and they do have a kid s menu  The pool was a good size and very clean

Every time we go to Singapore  we always stay at Intercontinental  My 5 years old son loves the restaurant  Olive Tree  We like the room  It s quite spacious to add a roll away bed for my son  My son loves taking MRT and the Bugis MRT Station is just right there  And my son loves to go to the National Library that is just across the street  So it s perfect  In early Dec 2010 we stayed at Intercontinental again with another family to watch Walking with Dinosaurs show  As usual we were happy with the service  Good breakfast  We were upgraded to the more antique room  It was nice

I happened to to get really sick from travelling in Cambodia and arrived at the hotel  They had a Doctor to my hotel room in 30 mins  The Dr was great and fixed me up  The hotel sent up a big basket of fruit and water to wish me well  They also gave us a really late checkout  The hotel is a fantastic location   right near the airport train stop and close to heaps of shops  restaurants and not far from the Raffles

We arrived at the hotel after a long flight from the UK  and were quickly checked into the room  I was pleasantly surprised to find that the room was so high up so there was no noise from traffic  Being above Bugis Junction  and all the food outlets there  we did not eat in the hotel so cannot comment on that The room was spacious  a very comfortable bed  and exceptionally large en suite which we were very impressed with  I do take the point made in an earlier review  that you do have to watch you dont trip over a couple of door frames  however  a minor point  The shower was very hot  which I enjoy  and although we had an initial problem with hot water in the taps  it was soon remedied The concierge service was excellent  extremely helpful  and when approaching them to ask about internet bookings of our onward flight  the concierge spent a fair amount of time helping me to prebook online  to the point of telephoning the airline in sydney to check the booking The concierge booked us into Raffles for afternoon tea on the afternoon of our last day  and we had the use of the Health Suite to freshen up before leaving in the evening for our onward flight to Australia  All provided with as much help that we needed  and no fuss  A great plus The only downside  and a small quible  was that there is a speaker system in the bathroom  wired to the television  On arrival  we had sound in the bathroom  and not on the television  and it took a while to sort it out  Methinks the chambermaid may have had her favourite music channel on whilst cleaning the ensuite  I would suggest that the hotel puts some sort of note in the room with directions of how to use the television  and remote controls Having said that  and after a five week trip and five different international hotels I would always loot to the Intercontinental for accomodation in the future

Pros   Exceptionally good hotel arranged airport transfers  having been collected immediately upon disembarking the aircraft  transported in a buggy to the VIP terminal  cleared immigration with no queue and after a short wait in lounge  with access to complimentary refreshments   whilst they retrieved the luggage  was escorted to the car  Upon arrival at the hotel I was escorted to my room to complete check in  I d highly recommend this for a hassle free arrival  at the time of my stay it was  150 SGD for a Mercedes E Class    The club suite was a good size  and well appointed   with separate lounge and dining area   and located on one of the highest floors of the hotel   The Club InterContinental lounge was spacious and tastefully decorated with an old world yet modern feel   Excellent check out service  request to leave luggage  as I was returning to the hotel 3 days later for another night s stay  was happily fulfilled  Upon indicating I was taking the MRT the bellman asked if I knew the way  to which I replied no  and was then escorted by him on the 5 minute walk  Cons   As a hotel brand which aims to distinguish based on their exceptional level of concierge services  I was completely underwhelmed by my experience  With only one concierge on duty and already dealing with a guest  after a few minutes waiting I was briefly asked my enquiry  checking availability for an airport transfer   and asked to take a seat and the staff member would make a call upon dealing with the guest  It took another 10 minutes for them to complete dealing with one guest  and then proceeded to SMS with their phone and tidy their desk  It took my return to the desk and prompting for their to remember my enquiry   hardly a 5 star service   Whilst the room was well appointed  a few aspects of it were showing small signs of wear   e g  the bath was marked  white cream doors had a slight unclean appearance in need of repainting including the entry door  brass handles worn  This is however a minor criticism In summary  a very good hotel in a good location close to Bugis MRT   and  with one exception  a very high level of service Postscript  My subsequent stay a week later was also good  However  I was less impressed by the Shophouse Room  As an Ambassador member this entitles a room upgrade   on the first occasion being from a Club Deluxe King to a Club Premier King  however on the second to a Shophouse Room  It was tastefully decorated with old world charm however had a non existent outlook  see photos   I personally do not believe it s worthy of being classed as a superior room merely due to its location in the hotel   given the size is comparable to the Deluxe room  and lacks a view natural light  Aside from this  an enjoyable stay

My fiance and I stayed here for four nights in December  We got a great rate for a basic room by pre paying online  The hotel itself is excellent  Our room was clean and spacious  quiet  and the bed was very comfortable  We didn t eat at the hotel very much  as there are many other food choices nearby  but we had several excellent drinks in the lobby bar   best lychee martini I ve ever had  I highly recommend this hotel for both its quality and location  It served as a great base for exploring Singapore

Hotel is located in great spot   walk to Raffles City   Chijmes   Bugis etc MRT on doorstep   as is Bugis Mall   pleanty food and shopping nearby Healh Club was good   pool popular I stayed for 5 weeks over Xmas and NY   staff very friendly Very clean   modern   yet classic Pay extra and join Club   it is worthwhile tranqility   free booze and FAST internet

Stayed 6 nights on the Club floor with two teenagers  Charged for one extra adult but my 13 yr old was considered a child under their policy and no extra charge for him  I think the Club floor check in is not very good though  Although the whole purpose of whisking you up to the Club lounge for check in is to make you feel  quot special quot   when we got there  the guy was busy and I was left to stand at his desk and watch whilst he finished some paper work he was doing  No invitation to take a seat or  quot can I offer you a drink and I will get back to you quot   It was rather awkward and I stood there with my kids for about 5 minutes before he attended to us  And even then no apology  By then I just decided I might as well sit and sat myself down in front of him uninvited  A bit like waiting at the headmaster s office When I gave my credit card for the guarantee  their machine would not accept my preferred card and I had to give my alternative card  Later I asked them to double check why the card was not accepted as my bank said there was no record of any attempt to use the card  They reluctantly did so and after a lot of to and fro they realised it was their machine that was at fault and not properly plugged in  Again no apology  Then I found out they had put my entire 6 days charge on hold on my other card so now that I wanted to use my preferred card  I had the full charge X 2 on hold  They said the first hold will reverse when I checked out and may take up to 2 weeks for that to happen  Essentially that means that cuts into my credit limit and fortunately that did not adversely impact me  but if my limit was smaller or if I am potentially going to incur further credit charges during my travel  I may find that I have max ed out my cards  I insisted they reverse the hold on my card immediately and it was returned to my credit available after 4 days  The rooms themselves are spacious and beds comfortable but there are no black out curtains and with the Ilumo building across the road having flashing lights on its facade  my room at night somewhat resembled a night club  Only thing to do was to close my eyes  Fortunately I am not epileptic and not too good if you are recovering from jet lag Local calls are charged at some ridiculous rate of 50 cents a minute and I had to call the lounge to find out the rates as it was not displayed in any of the room information  Food at the lounge  breakfast  afternnon tea and canapes  was above average and the staff friendly  Free flow of soft drinks  coffee  tea  Cannot comment on the alcohol as I did not drink there  Ambience in the lounge was also very pleasant  Two computers available with microphone and web cam for skype which I would say is something different from other hotels and very welcomed by us as we could skype home Location near MRT station and a lot of food option is definitely a plus for this hotel Overall good value for a Club room in Singapore which is incredibly expensive

This hotel is in a very central location being close to an MRT station and surrounded by shops  The staff appear very well trained and go out of their way to be friendly and provide a very personal service  The Club Lounge is very good and again the staff are very attentive and look after every need  The food and cocktails provided were of a high standard and they were always topped up or renewed as required  The room we stayed in was spacious and fully featured although the bathroom could do with some modernisation as many of the tiles were starting to crack and the ceiling was looking a little worse for wear  I suspect the bathrooms will be updated soon  The room had a lovely colonial feel and the TV and air conditioning worked well  My only criticism of the hotel is that they need to have free internet in the Club rooms as most hotels of this standard now provide this  The internet in the club lounge and lobby work well but for a business traveler the internet in your room is almost a necessity

Great location  it is connected to the Bugis Junction  Bugis MTR  just across is the Iluma Mall  and Bugis street market  It is also near City Hall and Chinatown  Yet Con Hainanese Chicken is 5 mins walk away  All the staff were very courteous  The room was spacious  large bathroom with separate shower and batch tub   We stayed in a Deluxe room  King bed  plenty of space for my kid to run around  The Hotel is secure  you need your room card to select the elevator floor

I stayed at InterContinental Singapore for 4 nights I m afraid to say  and really don t like to say it  but I felt quite let down overall Location   Can t really fault the location of the hotel  Close to everything and near to the MRT Rooms   I booked a standard room  and was upgraded to a Club Shophouse room  although was not given club access  Although the room looks quite cool at first  and quite authentic with the wooden floor  and window shutters etc  the charm soon wears off  The air conditioning in the room really struggled to keep the temperature down The bathroom has a seperate walk in shower and bath  Elemis brands are also used which is nice However  they are in real need of a good clean  The floor grouting was dirty The bedroom itself was of a good size  and the bed was nice and soft which was good There was a TV in the room  although I think it was about 27 quot   It isn t in the best location  not that there could really be a better one though    and had to be turned to view it when watching from the bed One other thing   velcro on the TV remote is tacky and there really isn t any need for it Service   Everyone appeared friendly with a smile in the hotel  However  on the first day I went for breakfast  alone  and there was a small queue waiting for tables to become free  I joined the queue  but was completely ignored  I mean ignored  A couple walked up a few moments later and were greeted  I stood there in amazement  I didn t say anything  and instead walked out into the shopping mall for a few moments and thought I d walk back and maybe get served Walked back and again  ignored  I stood there for a minute or so   no eye contact made at all  And it wasn t as if I was hiding With that  I went back to the room and went outside for breakfast  I didn t go for breakfast at the hotel at the restaurant for my stay due to this One other annoying aspect  is that I left the air con on while out of my room during the day  in the hope that it would be cool  even though it struggled   in the evening when I returned  However  be warned that when the rooms are serviced  the key card is left out of the slot so the air con turns off  Along the service front  after I checked out  I noticed 4 days worth of Internet charges on my bill  despite it saying  Complimentary  on the welcome screen  with just an  Accept  button to press   no mention of any charges anywhere I phoned the hotel to ask about this  and was told that the front desk would have to check with a Manager  I gave my cell phone number to them and they said they would call back  That was fine with me  although I never got a call back  I emailed the hotel  but still haven t got a reply Overall   with the experience I encountered  it s not on my of rated hotels  Quite the opposite actually  When compared to other InterContinental hotels in Asia  I feel this one has some work to do to bring it in line with the standard that InterContinental should offer  With a nightly
