rate that can top S 400 night  I would now actually look at the Holiday Inn on Orchard Road if I wanted to stay with the InterContinental Hotel Group I would even consider staying at the Crowne Plaza Changi Airport  and getting the MRT into Singapore everyday  Having stayed there for 1 night  it doesn t deserve the name of Crowne Plaza   it should be rebranded as an InterContinental  Think IC O Hare Chicago Airport   and you will see what I mean

from the moment we stepped out of the taxi  they welcomed us with genuine smiles and fast assistance with our luggage  I have never experience this treatment to other hotels  Honestly I worked and stayed in a 5 star hotel before  and this property is unrelenting to that one and any other  For their fast service and courteous staff  we felt like family   almost like royalty We salute the Whole IC Singapore team  Special thanks to Ivan from front desk  The engineering staff  they did a fast response although there was not really a problem in the room  we were just not aware of the master switch  haha   Three gentlemen from the concierge  I can remember Jonrex name   Again thank you so much for making our stay hassle free Such a wonderful hotel and location  Your best asset is your staff We will surely be back here

My family and I were on our way to Bali for the lunar New Year celebrations  We were supposed to stay at Intercontinental Bali resort but at the last minute  our KLM flight to Bali was cancelled with no further notice of when we would be able to take off  This cancellation was due to a volcano eruption that left ashes around the Denpasar area which prevented planes from landing  at least from Singapore  We therefore decided to sleep at Intercontinental Singapore and hope they would be able to arrange something Upon arrival  I was greeted with the usual courtesy of Intercontinental staff  very good  and proceeded to the check in counter where I would explain the situation  The staff were absolutely fantastic  First  I was able to get a room at a much lower rate than the walk in rate  I had no reservation   Second  the Singapore staff undertook all communications with the Bali people to make modifications to the reservations  without any penalties whatsoever  This shows great customer service from the Singapore staff  Thanks a lot guys Being an ambassador member that systematically stays at Intercontinental on all my business trips  I have become used to this high level of service  But on the other hand  I chose to stay at Intercontinental because of that high level of service  To make a long story short  I needed to book new flights to Bali which changed our original and newly modified travel dates  Until the end of our stay in Singapore  the staff was instrumental in providing piece of mind to my family and I  Conversations were being held behind the scenes with hotels in other countries and the conclusion was always favorable  Again  great job The hotel in itself is a very classy building that is right down town  It is linked to Bugis Junction shopping mall that offers a wide variety of options  although not the high end boutiques  Normal shopping if you want Rooms are spacious enough and well appointed  We were upgraded to a Shop house room which offers a more  quot old style quot  decor  Not my cup of tea as I prefer more modern facilities but the hotel also has more recently furnished rooms Club facilities are very well setup and the service was above what I have seen in previous Intercontinental hotels  I would recommend this hotel to anyone looking for a luxury getaway with piece of mind in case something goes against plan

Arrival   smooth  Check in   smooth  Room   spacious  Staff   very friendly  There is just nothing to say about this hotel Everything was no hazzle to anyone We didnt want to leave the hotel The club lounge was a gem  Such friendly staff The breakfast buffet was lovely and they served different dishes everyday  same with the evening canapes The location of the hotel is brilliant  Everything is within walking distance We ll come back

Located near the singapore famous Bugis street  the hotel has an amazing location  Somehow I felt   being a five star they need to upgrade themselves in terms of services provided i e I pod dock  a big screen LCD  the interconnecting rooms are too noisy  amp  and not noise proof  Our only meal in the hotel was not posted to our room  we asked for a taxi in the wee hours of the morning  not aware of the fact that we will be charged waiting charges  We had a wake up call a 2 am  the bell desk would have been proactive  amp  intimitated us that our car has come  When I called to check a 4 am  he informed that car is waiting since half an hour  Then I confirmed that i hope we are not being charged for waiting  he confirmed that No  its only 5 dollars for booking taxi  I was ripped off when i paid 80 dollars when i reached airport

staying at one of the suite  yeah definately awesome suite  big  clean and very comfotable  the room so big  but location quite noisy  because next to the shopping complex and my room only 2nd floor  having a hi tea at suite lounge was awesome  like it  staff so friendly and great service  overall worthy staying eventhought the price quite expensive  definately will come back

1  No door service in front of the hotel even though a door man is there  they have a chat themselves 2  No guide to the table at breakfast time because few staffs are there  We was waiting a long time to sit at the table 3  We did not use the mini bar but we were charged the mini bar fare when check out 4  Sluggish drainage in our room so it takes 5 minutes to discharge water

Last week we stayed at this hotel 4 nights  I like the location of the this hotel  It is very convenient for me to go to meetings of my company  Staff here are friendly and caring  I asked a bit about the room change and they agreed to the request immediately  The first time I visited the city to confront themselves and to learn various methods of life on the road  They do not have walkways for pedestrians  In short  I will stay here for business trip next time

This hotel is not what it used to be   Bugis junction is a downmarket food court w  clothing shops and the hotel is a bit of a walk from the main shopping areas and certainly not walking distance to the business areas  It is very corporate cookie cutter   and  if the tag line  living the Intercontinental life  is anything to hold a standard by   this hotel is not exactly up to scratch  The rooms are fine  but a little tired in the decor  the Baths are nice and big  and the shower stall is roomy but in my room the drain smelled and the toilet was broken when I checked in  The pool is small  can t really swim laps and it is cold  The gym is ok   and is nothing to get too excited about  The room service and housekeeping was good   and  the front desk were prompt  A good reliable hotel   but  nothing great  The Olive Tree restaurant buffet is nice for breakfast  but the whole place lacks ambience and is noisy due to the poor fixtures and fitting furnishings  The huge lobby lounge is usually empty and over air cond  If you have more work to do in Singpore which means you won t spend time in the hotel   stay here  If you are on holiday   not the best hotel by far to stay in  It is adequate  but not what you would expect of an Interconti

We loved this hotel in most ways  Since we arrived New Years Eve  it was still beautifully and tastefully decorated for the holidays  Our room was great  bed was super  and we found the location to be really convenient   Walk out into shopping mall  right there is Starbucks  Downstairs is a food hall and also metro stop  We liked their theme of  quot we help provide an authentic experience quot  borne out by their recommendations to us for dinner   Blue Ginger one night  and  when asked to recommend a not terribly expensive Indian restaurant in Little India   Kamala   which was obviously tremendously popular with locals  Our gripe was that we got inconsistent info from staff  We understood a lobby welcomer to tell us that there was free wi fi in the lobby lounge on first floor  And in fact we got a password  though with quite a bit of hassle  and used it there for some time  The next day however we found that this was not correct information   that only club members could use it for free  Forgotten what charge was now  but it was rather expensive  as was the breakfast for nonclub members  So we naturally took to going elsewhere  Can t understand why a hotel of this size and calibre and pricepoint would not offer free in room wi fi  It was the only place we stayed in two months in Southeast Asia where this was true

Having read back at some of the comments I may have chosen my hotels differently on this trip to Singapore  I have always previously stayed at the Holiday Inn Parkview but fancied a change  The check in was friendly enough  The rooms are well appointed and spotlessly clean for a hotel of its age  But considering the room rate it is dissapointing that the common areas away from the central lobby were showing some signs of wear which was apparent with worn and marked carpets and scuffed walls  The Club Louge is a nice place to spend some time but the lack of service makes it a deeply frustrating experience  I think that even Darren Brown may struggle to get somebody s eye to persuade the staff to serve  or at least to remember to serve you once they have taken your request  In the evenings there was a cocktail hour which was painful until it came to cleaaring up 15 minutes before the bar shut   this was run like a military operation akin to coming into land on an aircraft I did raise my concerns to the management and they did react the next morning with additional staffing but this also coincided with the return of the General Manager  when everybody was looking busy in her presence  I know that the management monitor these posts and now having chance to review them these seem to be common threads  I stayed there for 3 nights and eventually received some fruit in the room on my last day   this should have been there day one as an Royal Ambassador  and is a clear indication that this hotel falls well short on service expected by allegedly their top 1  of customers  I did not feel appreciated by a long shot as a guest The location of the hotel is not quite so good if you want to walk around in the hustle and bustle of Orchard Road and you can also wait some time to get a taxi  It s a beautiful hotel and on the whole has a lot going for it but unfortunately the service lets it down and I thought that I d never be saying that of a hotel in Singapore where this is normally impeccable  I think next time I m in town I ll be back at the Holiday Inn Parkview

Stayed here twice now  In Dec 2010 and Jan 2011 Both times we had access to the club lounge which is open until 22 30 and offers wi fi afternoon tea and light dinner in the evening  Also  complimentary drinks from 17 30 til 19 30  always a bonus considering how expensive drink is in Singapore   the staff are great and all very friendly Gym is fine and the pool is good and was never too busy Close to Bugis underground and shops cinema also very close The only thing that would improve this would be free wi fi internet access in the rooms

I had the chance to stay in this hotel during one the business meeting in Singapore  The rooms were nice though view from window was not exactly exciting  Staff was very helpful and prompt  I did not get to try much of the dining options but room service was quick and prompt  At the check out I forgot few of my clothes in the room which I was promptly informed of by the hotel  It was simply amazing that hotel kept my items in safe custody for more than a year  till I collected those few weeks back   I would call this quality service

Stayed 2 nights on route to NZ  including New Years Eve Hotel has an excellent location  close to everything Staff were very friendly and extreemly helpfull Room was a good size  clean  very comfortable Did not eat at the hotel  but had very good meals within walking distance at the recomendation of the concierge Would certainly repeat if I was in Singapore again Was a little pricey  but as it was New Years Eve  it would be unreaasonable to excpect heavy discount rates

Check in on the club floor was freindly and efficient  Offered a juice or coffee during this process Room was spacious  well appointed and spotless  Quality fittings throughout  Pillows and bedding just perfect  This place also has a pillow menu but we didnt require it  Room has full size bath and a separate shower Cocktail hour  drinks served to your table by freindly and efficient wait staff  Plenty of snacks available Complimentary High Speed Internet available in lounge but need to pay to use in room Very quiet in room  no street noise Concierge very knowledgeable  Excellent location away from Orchard Road but adjoining Bugis which is great for local food and shopping  Keycard worked first time everytime I wont be looking elsewhere for my next time in Singapore

The entire premise is very clean and new  Love the spacious lobby and revamped guest room However  I had left a remark under my booking at booking com that this staycation was meant to be a 40th wedding anniversary celebration for my parents and expected something extraordinary from the hotel that would have enhanced their staycation experience like some other hotels would usually do  However  to my disappointment  nothing much had been arranged  When I was checking in at the front desk  I asked the reception if there was any possibility of complimentary upgrade of room and he responded that  quot there are amenities in the room quot   I thought he would have at least accorded a complimentary minibar by making that statement so I didn t pursue further  I got turned down again when I requested for late check out until 2pm on the following day and I was told that the hotel was very full  When I stepped into the room and tried to look out for the  quot amenities quot   I saw nothing else other than 2 bottles of mineral water in the fridge and a few packets of Nescafe  I must say that was really disappointing despite my repeated requests for something extra and the hotel was informed that it was a 40th wedding anniversary celebration for my parents  I m not taking things for granted but it can be quite disappointing when not seeing the hotel make any effort in enhancing the guests  experience

Check in  amp  checkout was smooth rooms are clean towels bedsheets are clean and well maintained Very good spread of buffet breakfast in the hotel but one downpoint is I booked a room for 2 adults and 1 child they were suppose to provide me with free breakfast for 3 of us but ended up I need to pay for another adult They offer complimentary parking for inhouse guests as well and they also do provide shuttle services    And of course free wifi as well  So far so good would definetely return again

We decided to spend Christmas in Singapore to see the wonderful lighting displays  We chose this hotel for its proximity to Tanglin Mall and It s resort style swimming pool area  It was a comfortable walk to all the main shopping and lighting displays along Orchard Road and a further short stroll to Orchard station  We are in our 70 s and didn t find the distance at all prohibitive regardless of the warmth and humidity  Having just undergone extensive renovations the Hotel ambience is fabulous and rooms and facilities are top class  All the staff are welcoming  friendly and helpful  I would definitely stay here again and would highly recommend this hotel to everyone

I just checked out this morning from a wonderful one night stay at this hotel  Just one word to describe it all    WONDERFUL    From the stylish  well appointed room  to the lovely welcome at the Club Lounge  to the fantastic child friendly pool that had my boys begging to go for a swim from the day we checked in  to the day we left  Love love love   Seeing that it was Christmas day  I expected a crazy queue so I checked in at 230pm instead  There was still a queue but we were served within 7 mins  I consider it excellent  The room was great  I got a room on the 17th floor and received fantastic hospitality at the Club Lounge with cheese scones and other small nibbles  I could see the pool from my room and the pool looked absolutely inviting  Many guests brought down their bath robes but towels are available for free use at the pool side hut  Great thing about the pool is that the kids pool is just 0 35m deep and was the right temperature for the kids  The fun floats were also available for free although you are welcome to also bring your own if you like  After the afternoon swim  we came back to our room to bathe  Love the amenities and the citronella lemon grass scented bath toiletries  The hotel even provides hair bands to tie your hair with  I love this thoughtful touch  A note though  if you are thinking of enjoying the afternoon tea and the evening canapes and wine at the Club Lounge  do come early because the food items typically run out within the first hour or so  The sleep was comfortable and the sofa by the bay window doubled up as a spare bed  I slept well on it  Breakfast is available in both the Club Lounge and the Buffet spread downstairs  I had the buffet downstairs which had live kitchens for hot prata  soup or laksa noodles and chicken rice balls  The hotel is extremely thoughtful in its little touches such as providing take away bags for their buns and pastries if you are in a hurry  The rooms also come with usb wall sockets to charge your devices and wifi is fast and free  I will definitely come again and highly recommend  Don t let the location put you off  Shuttle bus is free and lets you on and off along the main Orchard Road and Suntec City shopping belt  The mall is also connected to the hotel so if you are in need of any amenities or simply craving for some affordable local delights  you can get all those at just mere steps away

My family booked two club rooms on Christmas Eve and we had a great countdown at the hotel room together  We were pleased with the newly renovated facade and rooms and the free shuttle service to Orchard Road made it really convenient for guests I would have given a better rating if the club lounge had offered a better variety of F amp B  Milk for the coffee machine was always running out and although it was supposedly 24 7  there were no food when we went to check out at about 10 plus at night  I thought it would be good to station a staff there to oversee the operations as no hotel staff was around when we were there  Other than that  it was a great time spent with our loved ones at the hotel

I d previously stayed here when it was a Traders Hotel  and was very pleasantly surprised by the improvements renovations they had made  Staff were all great  especially Maria at the front desk and the staff of the Club Lounge  Rooms are small but very thoughtfully laid out  so one never feels cramped  Bed was comfortable  wifi in room excellent  room faced the pool and was on a high floor so noise was not an issue  I d upgraded to the Club level and was happy to see some vast improvements in their lounge  previously had been dark and strangely configured   Cocktail hour in the lounge was quite busy but staff handled it well  and drinks and appetisers were replentished in a timely manner  Breakfast buffet was excellent  I was there just before they unveiled the new lobby and food area  so renovations were still in progress  The area is slightly out of the way  although within easy walking distance of the wonderful Botanic Gardens  A shuttle goes on a regular basis to the main part of Orchard Road and the SMRT  making the location less inconvenient  I thoroughly enjoyed my rather brief stay at this very comfortable and newly renovated hotel  It cannot compete with the luxury of some of the 5 star hotels of Singapore  but is well priced and one of the best 4 star hotels I ve experienced  I definitely plan to stay at this hotel again in the future

This is my second time here  1st time on business trip  amp  this time for a family holiday  Previously it was known as Traders Hotel  amp  now Jen Hotel  My family loves this place as it is conveniently connected with the Tanglin Mall  amp  the fact that they provide a free shuttle bus to Orchard MRT Station  amp  Takashimaya  The winning point during this trip is the newly renovated atmosphere  Will definitely go back to this hotel again

This is the best use of space hotel i ever set foot  The room actually quite small for 4 star but as it use space so effectively  the room actually never felt cramped  They had a sofa near window  open the sofa and you ll find iron board  open push the metal near bed and you ll find reading light  even the fridge and cup are hidden  very exciting  The bathroom is small but again never felt cramped as it used every space imagine You can also find many power outlet around room and they provide enough speed wifi  The bed seems like floating because of the design  the tv is smart tv so you can surf internet  watch tv  streaming and even phone mirroring Breakfast had many choice and a great lobby with DJ accompanying your morning delicious choice of belly fuel Location wise is great just the end of orchard road and connected with tanglin mall I really enjoy my 2 night stay here

Interestingly this hotel was chosen for us by circumstances so didn t know what to expect  What a lovely surprise  freshly renovated  formerly Traders Hotel  the hotel reeks of  new  with funky themes and clever interior design  Even the staff nameplates are original  Staff throughout were helpful and friendly  plenty of smiles which cost no one a thing  Breakfast spread was ample with good variety of food  egg and noodle stations for the freshly prepared  Breakfast restaurant is good size  ample room to move without running into others  Club lounge was good  not a large selection of food  but the selection changes daily  Staff in lounge were excellent  accommodating wants and needs and ensuring tables cleared of used items  atmosphere was relaxing  Pool area was good and gym has ample machines to bring on a sweat  Hotel not too distant from shopping etc not difficult walk to from Orchard Road  Didn t know we were going to stay here  did not select it but would have no hesitation to return

I have stayed here a few times when it was called  quot Traders quot   The location is near Orchard Road but probably too far to walk there in the heat  The hourly shuttle bus is convenient when you know the schedule  The refurb had been done well but the bathrooms are very small  A good shopping mall with supermarket and cafe adjoins the hotel Room Tip  The Executive floor is worth paying the extra   better room  breakfast  and cocktails in the evening   See more room tips

The hotel was simply brilliant  You enter and you see a very decent otherwise superb lobby with friendly front desk employees  They are very friendly and polite and towards your left  you have a nice refreshments and by that I mean drinks not food Hotel Room  This was pretty decent  comes with a nice TV and a nice comfortable bed  Refrigerator and a safe box comes with it too  The bathroom was decent  a hair dryer and replenished soap tubes  The shower was also decent  The room have USB plugs for those overseas and some multi plug adapters at the sides of the walls  The bed was comfortable and the room all come with wifi which are 2 3 bars Hotel Facility   Comes with a nice swimming pool alongside a Jacuzzi  The pool is not hot nor cold but nice to chill in Singapore on a hot day  Also the Jacuzzi comes with bubbles coming out through the sides  Furthermore it has a small bar where you can order drinks of a reasonable standard  Also comes with a small gym for those FitLADS  Has a vending machine with instant noodles and chips  They provide standard beach chairs with umbrellas on top and the whole area is cleaned Buffet Breakfast  First off  this hotel is not fully Halal since some foods contain pork such as bacon strips and condiments with the omelette  On the other hand  they do serve a decent variety of foods  They go from asian delights all the way to western  They serve Nasi Lemak  a local dish  bread  sausages  omelette  ice cream  1 scoop   candy  roti prata  local  and much more  They don t change the variety of food however it s still fresh Things to do nearby  You are currently about 10 minute walk away from the nicest street of shopping malls  If you exit the hotel and walk to you left  you are able to go shopping to one of the busiest places in Singapore  They have a variety of shops such as 5 floors of H amp M and much more Overall  This place is a really nice play to stay  Not cheap however would recommend to those coming to stay for a short time  Enjoy your stay and have a good day   Room Tip  Come with a family so that you can have sided rooms connected and attached to each other See more room tips

Our family of 2 adults and 1 child stayed here for 2 nights during the christmas weekend  We thoroughly enjoyed every minute of it  Our room was on the same floor as the lounge so it was very convenient  Pool was great  i had a great time on the floats with my 4 year old son  Breakfast wise  the long waiting time was a little unexpected but the variety of food made up for it  Lounge service was good  Appreciate your smiley staff working there  Overall an excellent stay  We ll definitely be back

The hotel is just off Orchard road and is on a quieter road for those who prefer less noise  Taxis are available just ourside the hotel and ussually waits are no longer than 10 mins for one I was truly astonished at the design from Front Office to my room  Stylishly done and I love the simple use of everyday items  The Hello rack above the luggage compartment is a brilliant yet subtle quirk  The room is clean with soft pillows and sheets  Truly comfortable  Better yet  the staff are fantastic  THey are so engaged and very motivated  I came in during peak period and yet they stayed positive and very efficient  Kudos to a wonderful team  I wish I can motivate my teams to be as good The breakfast spread is great  Asian to American  English and Continental fares  Amazing quality and quantity  I will definitely recommend this hotel and will be back

It is formerly Trader Hotel which i stayed before  The room is much newer now after the massive renovation  There was error during the booking but i ve sent email to  quot Reservation Agent quot  of the hotel to rectify it prior to the stay  To my amazed  when i checked in at the hotl front desk  the system still captured the wrong info  This has created inconveniences to me and i ve to showed to the hotel front desk on the email correspondance to ensure prior amendment has been made  The front desk lady seems a bit inpatient Generally  pleased with the stay in Hotel Jen  The  quot Happy Hour quot  or evening cocktail at the club lounge is a plus point  The breakfast spread at the club lounge is very limited Walking distance from main Orchard Road shopping area  and very near to Botanic Garden  Hotel provide free shuttle bus to Orchard MRT and Takashimaya  But the mini bus capacity is too limited  and we was turned down and have to wait for another 30 mins for the next bus The wifi speed in the room is fantastic  i have no problem for video steaming

Residing in Singapore with a busy work schedule  it s not often that we find the time to enjoy a staycation  So when we do find the time we hope that it will live up to our expectations  and with Jen Hotels it certainly did  With just two nights booked  we managed to enjoy the Christmas wonderland that was Orchard Road at night  The hotel is situated very close to many of the popular malls  but if shopping is not your cup of tea  then an evening stroll with Christmas lights will certainly fill you with cheer  As you walk through the hotel doors  you are immediately hit with the calming ambience of the hotel  with beautiful decor and dining area  The hotel staff were very accommodating  The room has many surprises  it s compact  but has all the space that you need  With high stool  bar desk area  tea and coffee stations  comfortable bed  and beautiful shower area  the entire room is well designed  and most importantly for us  clean and comfortable  The icing on the cake for our stay was the food  We had breakfast included  and a champagne brunch  During the Christmas period  the hotel offered a wide spread of food  ranging from traditional Christmas roast to local favourites  The waiting staff were ever so attentive  and didn t leave your glass half empty  The dining area had wonderful music  which contributed to the atmosphere  Overall we had a fantastic stay  so much so we wish we could do it every weekend Room Tip  Higher floorSee more room tips

Stayed during the Christmas weekend  checking in was a breeze  The rooms look exactly the same as pictured  very very cozy and just makes me feel like home  Rooms might be smaller but great use of space  Staffs were very friendly and helpful  They even left a Christmas stocking stuffed with cookies on our doorknobs  its gestures like this that made us feel very welcomed    Breakfast buffet variety is amazing  Though we had to wait and queue in a long line for a table to be seated  we only have to wait 10 minutes max  The variety of food offered is even comparable to other 5 star hotels  they even provide takeaways bags and cups for your convenience  Logistics wise  it is just a 10 minute walk to the main Orchard Road  They even provide bicycles free of charge for guests  we cycled to the Botanics Garden as it was just a 8 minutes cycle away  The hotel also provide free shuttle buses daily to Takashimaya and Orchard MRT Overall  this hotel exceeded my expectations and I enjoyed my stay thoroughly  Would recommend friends and family to stay here  Thumbs up to the Hotel Jen Tanglin team  you all are such a star in making our stay so worthwhile

Celebrated my son s 1mth old here at their Gallery function room and decided to have 2 nights stay there too from the 1st of Jan to 3rd Jan  Check in on the 1st was definitely overwhelming due to their high occupancy but front desk staff handled the situation very calmly  Stayed at the deluxe room on my first night wif my family of 4 and I requested for a baby cot and was already in the room when we walked in which was great   Moved to an executive suite the next day and was pleasantly surprised to find my favorite brand of fridge Smeg in the room  A bright yellow fridge was wat greeted us and it was nicely stocked wif drinks which was complimentary   Banquet staff were professional n frenly too during our party  Oh special mention to the Chinese staff  wish I got her name  who was stationed at our bouncy castle who looked after the kids  From carrying them in n out of the castle to putting on their shoes  We didn t request for someone to help wif the kids but props to the hotel  or whoever  that arranged it  All in all  a nicely furbished n cosy hotel wif very pleasant staff which made our stay a very pleasant one   Sharmaine Koh

I like this hotel  the room is clean and nicely decorated  but the room size is a bit small for a deluxe room The service by staff is good  Front Desk  Houskeeping  Dining Room  Transport Counter  telephone operator  or customer service  However  I don t like the location as I need to rely on shutter bus to go to Orchard Road  or walk 10 15 minutes  Or take a bus opposite the hotel

Room is nice like the seat near the window outlook the scenery of spore Breakfast taste delicious Dinner at ahoi s is delicious must tryReception check in n out was fast n friendlyAlthough is quite far from orchard road  for the lazy one to walk they have a shuttle busRight next to hotel is tanglin mall old mall but not a bad place for shopping found a couple of nice boutique

Very good hotel  nice staff and the room is clean and comfortable  I also already tried jen at the Orchard gateway but this one in tanglin have a better room decoration and bigger room also  The sofa near the window Is my favorite place to chill and relax in the afternoon  I would come back again and stay with jen tanglin in the future  Very nice hotel  Keep up the good services

Dear Jen It was just yesterday that I said goodbye yet I hope to see you again  Your very well appointed rooms are comfortable and so considered  We were well looked after by your staff  all of whom spoke excellent English and were the perfect combination of efficiency and courtesy  Special mention to your  doorman   bellhop  concierge Mr P  who singlehandedly seems to manage all transport  traffic  luggage and miscellaneous at the front  Your housekeeping is excellent  our room was spotless and well stocked  I absolutely love the large mugs and double walled glasses in which we enjoyed your small but perfect provision of tea bags  Thank you to your check in staff for accommodating my request for a quiet room away from the lifts and a slightly later check out  We will return again to visit you dear Jen  Cheers  J  amp  S

Hotel Jen Tanglin recently went through a major renovation so don t be fooled by its facade  What we have now is a chic  modern and beautiful hotel nestled in a less busy street of Singapore s shopping district   Orchard Road We checked in on New Year s Day and it was booked 100  the day before  Therefore check in was slightly delayed but the receptionist who served me was genuine and went all out to make our wait comfortable  A late check in could ve easily ruined a hotel experience but they handled the situation professionally and with sincerity  The rooms have been beautifully refurbished and everything is new and clean  We loved everything about the hotel except maybe the pillows  But all in all  a great first experience and looking forward to staying with them again

I stayed here quite unplanned as my flight was cancelled and the airline put us up in this hotel  WOW  what a beautiful hotel this is  The renovations they have recently done have given a modern  clean stylish and cool decoration giving a great atmosphere throughout the hotel The rooms are well designed and made for a really comfortable nights sleep  The restaurant served amazing quality food and gave plenty of choice and selection for all tastes The staff were extremely attentive and made our stay extremely welcoming I recommend the pool and spa area  There is amazing steam  sauna and Jacuzzi for male and female plus the lovely outdoor pool area to take in the Singapore sun I would recommend this hotel for people living in Singapore wanting a value for money staycation as well as any tourist wanting to take in orchard road and the botanic gardens

Spent New Year s Eve here and was surprised that the room was still very affordably priced    200  found through Expedia  The lobby was beautiful and visitors can easily gain access to the Orchard area  and even Shenton Way Buona Vista with the free shuttle buses  schedule attached   This makes it very useful for business tourists who will need to head to CBD for meetings  The room is small  compact and extremely comfortable  Love the sofa area just to chill while looking at the view  My only gripe is that the lifts do not require any key card to go up to the rooms   security concern maybe Nonetheless  strongly recommend Hotel Jen

My husband and I had a staycation over the new year s holidays  The refurbishment was well done and it s really good value for money  Decent size rooms if you are not planning to stay in it all day The staff were great  Special mention to Nabil  I think that s how to spell his name  at the lobby restaurant  He was really friendly and helpful despite the pressures of the very full breakfast sessions All in all  good for a quick getaway for two

My spouse and I recently completed a 10 day stay in the  quot new look quot  Jen Tanglin hotel  Not only were we impressed by the chic atmosphere  but most especially touched by the good  old fashioned  high quality courtesy shown us by everyone on the Jen team  from the director down to the cleaning personnel  Jen s lounge is tip top  and no one can beat the quality and assortment in the breakfast restaurant  You can be sure Jen will continue to be  quot Our quot  hotel in Singapore Room Tip  ask for pool side  upper floorsSee more room tips

We arrived before 10am and had prearranged to leave our luggage in safe room  Surprised to be told our room was ready for us to occupy  Staff asked when our next flight was and extended the room occupancy and facilities use for us Our room was on 18th floor  staff assisted with luggage  hardly a wait for the lift 6 to chose from  Room was spacious and well maintained  cleanliness was spot on Club Lounge provides refreshments 24 7 and covers all needs Staff were excellent and very friendly

A Hotel where I feel like home due to simplicity and efficiency of the all staff  the fully renovated rooms are convenient and the proximity of the Botanical Garden makes from this hotel a great location  may be the fact is not at full occupancy between New Year and Chinese New Year is helping and may be I should keep secret this fantastic address but they all very nice and team player between themselves  I have enjoyed the bicycle that they provide free of charge to ride up to East Coast Park

What can I say but this Hotel is fantastic  We stopped here 4 years ago and the facilities were good but with the new refurbishment in place this takes it to a new level  We stopped on floor 17 and had a great view of the city  The food is excellent with a great choice to choose from  I would also like to congratulate all the staff that made us feel so welcome on our 4 day stay at this Hotel  We will definitely be back as this is one of the best Hotels that we have stayed in

I stayed at this hotel for 3 nights  The location is near Orchard shopping road  Its also close to Botanic Garden  The hotel has very lovely decorations and the room was set up smartly  So that although the square meters are small  you can find everything handy and convenient to use It has free shuttle bus to Orchard  which is nice  There are also bikes for free rental  in case you want to bike around the neighbourhood for sight seeing  But make sure you take good care of it  because you will have to pay for lost or damage Overall  it s a nice and pleasant experience to stay at this hotel  The staffs are very helpful

I stayed here 2 nights when my flight was delayed  The rooms are spacious  very modern and clean  The food was amazing  Such a large variety for each meal  Food was very well prepared and presented  The staff were extremely friendly  I definitely recommend Hotel Jen to anyone travelling to Singapore as it s in a great location  close to bus stops and within walking distance to main shopping areas  Thank you Hotel Jen for a wonderful experience

We recently visited the newly renovated J 65 restaurant at Hotel Jen Tanglin for their Sunday champagne brunch  The spread was outstanding with a brilliant variety of food  Our glasses were topped up before they were empty  Plates cleared before we sat back after every serving  Our host Nabil was fantastic and looked after us well  Would certainly recommend it for anyone looking for good food good drinks  great service and a relaxed atmosphere

Located at the end of Orchard Road  we enjoyed the quieter  less frenetic pace whilst still in a wonderfully  central location  Room well appointed with a great bed  choice of pillows  coffee and tea facilities  pleasant toiletries and a great bay window to watch life pass by below Congratulations to the human relations training management team  For six days every employee my husband and I met was professional  personable and genuine in wanting our experience to be as best as they could make it  Multi  cultural breakfasts were brilliant  spotless sports  spa amenities well utilised and having a lifeguard at the fabulous pool on the fourth floor further enhanced our stay  The added bonus of level two connecting us to Tanglin Mall where locals enjoy a fabulous fresh market and the considerable food hall allowed us to enjoy air conditioned shopping  eating when we chose not to venture too far from the hotel  Loved the ambience of dining poolside in the evening at Ah Hoi restaurant Taxis to Little India  Mustapha Centre  and to Chinatown were less than SGD  10 00  Frequent travellers  we will eagerly return when in Singapore

First let me thank Ms Kelly Shum for really stepping up and setting the bar for customer service amidst difficult circumstances  We checked in on 1st Jan with a booking of 5 standard rooms  On checking in we found the hotel swamped with massive queues for check in  check out due to the previous day being nye  will never travel on 1st of Jan ever again    In short  we got some of our rooms pretty late and spent most of our first day in singapore hanging around waiting to check in  This is where Ms Shum saved the day for us  She offered as complimentary use of the hotel s lunch buffet service and refunded 1 night s charges for the delayed rooms mitigating some of the hardship caused to our group which had seniors and kids which were most troubled  She also prioritized rooms for seniors so that at least they could rest comfortably while others waited  Now to the actual review 1  Spanking new hotel  CLEAN FRESH TRENDY 2  The reception area  dining area  pool and fitness area are all beautiful to look at and a joy to use  lovely vibe  3  The standard rooms are fresh newly refurbished very clean  well done up with all relevant amenities  Tad small but was no issue for us  Pool facing rooms have a better view  4  Bathrooms are CLEAN NEW FRESH BUT COMPACT Space is Just enough but no more than that  5  Our rooms included breakfast which was a massive buffet but since we are vegetarian our choices were restricted  Nevertheless completely adequate and loved the hot chocolate  the coffee station  6  Location is fantastic very close to Orchard Road and offers a shuttle to the same7 In room dining offers several vegetarian options and portions were decent though would suggest they extend service hours to beyond 11pm All in all  this is my new go to hotel in singapore as long as they maintain the cleanliness  upkeep and fantastic service levelsKudos Jen Tanglin and Ms Shum great job

This was my third stay at the hotel  Excellent location  outstanding facilities and service  Every time I am impressed with the quality of the customer service at the hotel  I arrived early in the morning  Although the check in time is after 2 pm  they ensure that I got a room right away  Due to an overlook  I had paid for three nights  while I was going to stay only two  In spite of the terms and conditions that did not allow refund  once they realized that the overlook was a genuine mistake  refund was granted  Customer service at this hotel is simply outstanding

We stayed at Hotel Jen for 3 nights earlier this week   from the moment we walked through the doors this hotel impressed us from it s quirky refurbishment touches  biclycles on the wall  to the more casually dressed staff  denim jeans and shirts  such a change from the usual corporate dressed staff  We arrived at 10am expecting to leave our bags and return later to get access to our room but the room was ready and we were able to use the facilities straight away  We are a family of 2 adults and 2 children  12  amp  10 yrs  so finding somewhere to cater for all of us in the one room was limiting   we booked an executive suite which was amazing   plenty of space for all of us  comfy bed  very clean  quiet and a great view  We had access to the Club Lounge on level 17 which I didn t realize when booking so it was a surprise to see that we not only had breakfast included but afternoon tea and happy hour which was more than cheese platters and beer wine  Plenty of freshly made dishes that changed every day  This was definately a nice spot to go too after a long day exploring the city  Even though it is at the farther end of Orchard Rd it is still walking distance to many things like Botanical Gardens  Tanglin Mall and many buses go past the door down Orchard Rd if you miss the shuttle  Would highly recommend this hotel to anyone   staff were friendly and very accommodating  they were also able to give us a late checkout of 2pm  Thank you so much for a wonderful stay Hotel Jen will hopefully be back someday

The hipness factor here has been seriously post remodel  I like it  Feeds my craving for all things bicycle  amp  leather suitcase  Living in Singapore now I don t get to stay here too often but due to a mis hap at home I scored a mandatory overnight  I immediately chose Hotel Jens for it s great prices  great location and unpretentious style   Great location   Note there are TWO Hotel Jen s on either end of Orchard  This one is Tanglin  Starbucks is downstairs which is a plus because standard  deluxe rooms only stock Nescafe Instant  The Tanglin Mall is attached via indoor and outdoor hallways  A rare small mall for Singapore which makes it easy to navigate There is an excellent Marketplace grocery store in the basement that offers organic produce  Euro US brands  and a local food hall  several other cafes and wine bars in the building and all of Orchard just out your door   The Rooms  Compact  modern and efficient  O k   small   There s a fridge with stripes on it  The Deluxe view offers tree tops  sunset  and down Orchard Ave  Otherwise the room is exactly the same as Standard  The bathroom is tiny but clean and well designed with quality amenities  Also worth noting I got an amazing deal through their website when making reservations online   If you read any of my other reviews you know I stalk vegetarian foodie options with unqualified passion  So here s my take on the Jen s buffet  Overall good but room to improve  Plenty of options for veg  non veg as well as Western Asian Singaporean food  The food itself was not as hot and fresh as before or as it should be to keep up with all the amazing hotel buffet options in Singapore  LABELS identifying food name and basic ingredients  ex  Chicken Rice  would really  really help  I love to try new things and I believe it s one of the great joys of the hotel buffet  but travellers would like to know what is in their food  There old spread was smaller but clearly labeled veg non veg  Now those tags disappeared  Also  no steamed buns  red bean  lotus  and egg yoke yum    I asked if any of the various interesting toppings by the porridge were vegetarian and was told   quot Yes  all but the front 3 bowls  quot   I pointed to the Chicken Floss in back  and said   quot This  quot   quot  Um no  Chicken  Ma am  quot  You get the idea  Room to improve at the restaurant but it s fine for a quick meal  They added a take away cafe that looks good  got me on the bike decco  but no time to try  The varnish dried on my stairs and I headed home   Thanks Hotel Jens  My stay was smooth  easy  clean  fast  modern  hip  affordable and fit the bill  Sometimes that s exactly what a hotel needs to be

We came on 10 13 Jan 2016  There were 6 of us including our 83 y o  grandma on wheelchair  Our room number were 536  537 and 538  These 3 rooms are next to each other while 536 and 537 are connecting 1  The booking was easy through their site  They also responded our email for additional request of wheelchair for my grandma  We also put down a few other requests since we were travelling with our grandma 2  Check in was also easy and fairly quick  They took a copy of all our passports and we had option of no open deposit but we must pay any room service on delivery  All of our requests  The hotel even put my grandma on a wheelchair accessible room 3  The lobby was beautiful  They provides freeflow infused water and ice tea everyday  The sofas on the lobby were unique as well 4  The room was a bit smaller for the wheelchair accessible one because of the tub on the bathroom  The normal room has smaller bathroom with standing shower but bigger sleeping quarter  The size of the room is a bit bigger than budget hotel since we had space to walk around in the room  The TV channels were adequate for us  There was no mini bar items provided  The AC was cool and the water pressure was good  My husband hate the room wooden floor but I didn t have any issue with it  There is iron and ironing board on our room  and a sofa by the window  The view was okay  building at most with a bit of city view 5  Our room was in front of the lifts but there was no noise  The room was very quiet at night 6  The restaurant was near the lobby and they had ramp as well  The menu was alternating every 2 days  They provided chinese  western  indian  and a little japanese selections  You can ask for coffee or tea pot  or make your own at coffee machine or dilmah tea selections  Their dessert sections includes ice cream which selections were mango and chocolate during our stay  The best past of their breakfast is that they provide  tabao  or takeaway bags and cups  which I provided the picture as proof  This is the first hotel breakfast that doesn t fuss about their guests taking away their foods or drinks  Our family really enjoyed our daily breakfast 7  The staff were very friendly as well  They tried their best to comply with our requests 8  The hotel provides bike rental  There is also free shuttle to Orchard road and you can ask the schedule on front desk  But if you are travelling with a group  better take taxi because the shuttle is always almost full due to their not only for hotel guests  Orchard road is about 30 minutes by walking and few minutes by taxi  The closest MRT is at ION 9  Behind the hotel  there is Tanglin mall  The hotel is connected to this mall  This mall is quite small but it has pharmacy  Starbucks  Nandos  Brunetti  hobby shop  etc  There is a tourism building just front of the hotel  we didn t get to check what it was for 10  Check out was quick and without any problems as well  And we bid farewell to this lovely hotel  We will definitely recommend this hotel to our friends  Since this hotel was just finished renovating in December 2015  we hope they can maintain their service and cleanliness level so that we won t be disappointed on our next visit

The hotel has a trendy decor and the room is spacious and clean  I was there for two nights and got a good rest at night as the hotel is located away from the hustle and bustle  It takes about 10 15min to walk to Orchard MRT and the heart of town  so the location is not too bad if you are looking at a place away from the crowd  The breakfast buffet has a good selection of food choices with a focus on local delights Overall I had an enjoyable stay

My wife and I booked a 2 night stay at the hotel  The check in staff was quick to notice that we had our wedding  They offered as the use of their club lounge on L17 with cocktail reception in the evenings  drinks as the sunset over the horizon  and breakfast with coffee at the same location  The breakfast selection was really good  especially the eggs benedict  totally deadly    We were also pleased to find a sweet treat of fruits and chocolate in our fridge prepared  Hotel Jen has definitely gone over and beyond for their level of service Definitely be back for more staycations    Room Tip  Go and use the club loungeSee more room tips

Very nice newly renovated hotel super modern very good value for money  The location is good not far from the traditional Orchard road  full of restaurants and shopping malls it is a nice stroll if you like walking if not they offer a shuttle bus to the nearest metro Station  I read some reviews saying that the area is not good Singapur has many nice areas this is one of them there are many other hotels in the surroundings of the Jen  It is up to you which one are you going to chose Opposite the Hotel you have the Stop of the turistic Doble decked bus hop on  hop off system which is really convenient to visit all Singapur  You have direct connection to the Tanglin shopping mall with coffee shops   Starbucks  and restaurants  Speaking about the Hotel itself the cleaning service was erratic  One day one towel less  other day one bottle of water fewer  the next many towels  the used and new ones  The last day one very beautiful detail It was my birthday and I found a cake in the fridge with the Happy Birthday in chocolate  I shouted when I opened it  Many Thanks many made felt very happy

I had a fantastic 2 night stay at Hotel Jen Tanglin Suite Room at Lvl 18  This was a post wedding stay after holding a wedding lunch with them  It has recently undergone renovations and the rooms are refurbished with a modern rustic touch to it  Service is fantastic  all hotel staff are friendly and helpful  Kitchenette is well equipped and fridge is well stock with chocolates and soft drinks on the house  It is very accessible to town  Orchard  And there s a shopping mall next to it  Shuttle bus is provided to nearby train stations and shopping centre Highly recommended

I stayed at this hotel some years ago  but still remember it to be a very good stay  They are very well managed  professional  efficient and clean  The lobby  Interiors and rooms are completely satisfactory  room service is 24 hours  But the biggest   point for this hotel is the location  Very convenient for a first timer to Singapore  esp  if you are with family  Orchard street and all the malls are just a few mins by walk  Very lively and a great place for shopping  eating and window gazing  I used to enjoy walking up and down Orchard street even late at night  This Hotel which was previously known as Traders  caters mainly either to businessmen or families  I found it perfect value for money and was very happy with their services  esp  the Golden key concierge service who can do anything for you like arranging tours  taxis  shows  baggage storage  guides  tickets  you name it  They also have in room massage services for tired travellers upto late night  A great blessing   they bring along their oils  towels  sheets and boy  Those slim chinese girls really know their job  Their food is awesome  the breakfasts  sea food and buffet lunches  Would I go back there again  You bet I would

Stayed here for the new year  The price was so great that I expected this to be a fancy looking budget hotel  but was consistently amazed by the quality of this hotel  The hotel has been renovated and is fun  fresh  and very comfortable  really cute    The staff was all incredible and the rooms were relatively quiet and the amenities were great  The hotel breakfast by the pool was AMAZING one of the best hotel breakfasts I ve ever had  The location is good  about 10 minutes walking to MRT   and the free hotel shuttle makes it even more convenient  I plan on staying here again

The rebranded Hotel Jen Tanglin is a cozy hotel for both business and pleasure  It has free wifi  delicious breakfast buffet with many local delicacies  friendly and helpful staff  and shuttle services to business and shopping areas  There was one incident when the scheduled shuttle  to Orchard Road  was full  and I thought I had to get a ride by myself  To my surprise  the concierge summoned a cab and pay the cab fare for me to get to Orchard Road instead  What a pleasant experience indeed Room Tip  Higher floors with view of the swimming pool would be nice See more room tips

Stay with Hotel JEN for the 2nd time  The first was at Orchard Gateway  since it leaves me a good impression  decided to try this one at Tanglin  Slightly further from the town but it has shuttle bus service to and fro from Orchard  The breakfast is good and they provided takeway service which provides us takeaway cup for our LATTE  We enjoy the coffee in our room later  Service is good  we requested for a few additional amenities and it came almost within a minute or 2 Great pool area  my daughter loves the kiddy float that they provide at the pool area Wifi connection is GREAT  connection without any hassle

This hotel was Traders before but now after renovation its Hotel JEN  so much better than before Great breakfast with great staffRooms a pretty small but with a nice view and clean bathroom Pool area is very huge and the gym is well equipped with a relaxing area as well checkin was slow due to peak hour and day after New years eve but check out was smooth Free shuttle to Orchard road several times per day Next to the hotel you can find Tanglin mall with a very nice supermarket and restaurants  we loved the korean stand at the food court  had kimchi rice almost everyday for 5 dollar  I can easily return to this hotel again and I really recommend this to all types of travelers

We stayed for three nights in the Jen Tanglin hotel at the beginning of January The staff is friendly  the food quality at the breakfast buffet and at the coffe bar is superb  So is the serviceThe swimming pool is a little small though  but as it is obvious in  quot downtown Singapore quot  space is limited  A good choice for a business trip  while the restof the family can walk to the shopping district   Stayed February 2016  traveled on business LessRoom Tip  Try to book a poolside room  Very beautiful view of the pool garden abd the bustling city beyond See more room tips

My husband and I stayed 3 nights in Singapore for a work trip  and this venue was a very pleasant surprise  It is needless to say that Singapore is a westernized Asian first world country  and as such we found everything in order in Jen hotel  friendly staff  lovely decorated reception area  with a coffee bar on the right  with hipster vibe  rooms are very nice and well lit and breakfast is superb

Stayed here a couple of years ago when it was called Traders  now it looks bright and feels refreshed  The rooms are decent and comfortable  The hotel is a little distance away from the Orchard Mrt  But wait  a future station will be opened near the Botanical Gardens  Staff are friendly  The rate is attractive  given that it is in Orchard Rd Tanglin area

This is my 3rd times i stay in hotel Jen  used to be traders hotel  and just finish being total renovated  Even this is 4 stars hotel  i just feel that it is 5 star hotels  The location is so ideal  10 minutes walking to famous shopping orchard road  3 minutes to gleneagles hospital  a few steps to tanglin mall where located next to the hotel The room is chic and modern  clean and neat  everything is efficient yet comfort and feels like home The main lobby and the dining room    It is extraordinary  I love the decoration  Vibrant and eye catching  You can take pictures in every single details  And im sure it is going to be a great one The wide of breakfast selection  Singaporean cuisine  kueh  traditional cakes   indian food  even the complete western cuisine I really really love this hotel  I will stay again everytime im going to singapore

We have stayed in this hotel about 8 times since 1999 and it just gets better and better  It is ideally situated for Orchard road and the botanical gardens  We have seen 2 refurbishments to this hotel and this one has been great  we stayed in Nov Dec  14 just as they were starting and was there Nov Dec 15 when they finished  The rooms are fresh and the furniture is modern  We would recommend this hotel for short or long breaks  we stayed for 18 nights this time and we kept occupied all the time  making full use of the excellent gym and outdoor pool  We had breakfast each day and there is a wide choice of international cuisine  The staff  as always  were always helpful  friendly and knowledgeable   Although all the staff were great a special mention goes to 2 young ladies in the restaurant   Angeline and Madeline who greeted us each morning so warmly Room Tip  We always like to stay on a higher floor where you get views over the citySee more room tips

Very handy to Orchard road and rooms clean  Easy to Park car and close to Tanglin mall for a coffee of lunch  Only issue is the breakfast Que Everyday  Find a bit frustrating think area just not big enough for size of hotel  Lovely pool and bar  Overall a decent hotel but no standout features in my opinion  Mainly for business use I suggest

I was very impressed by the interior ambiance and design of the hotel from the lobby area right to the rooms  Service was great and there is a lot of attention to detail with regards to the design of the hotel  The room was comfortable and modern  geared towards the Millennial traveller  I was spoiled for choice with the variety and quality of the breakfast fare  As I am not a breakfast person  I must say that I had sacrificed my sleeping time to wake up earlier to just indulge in the breakfast fare  Would recommend anyone to stay for business or leisure

I love everything about this hotel  Stylish  modern with all the cool amenities every traveler needs  My spacious room was super chic and relaxing  I was able to sleep well  full 8 hrs   The shower experience was also very pleasant  I adore their buffet especially their wide variety of laksa offerings  I think I just didn t see enough nuts like walnuts  pecans etc which I like on salads and whenever I enjoy a plate of cheese  I m a fan of Hotel Jen back in Manila as well  Really thankful for the service and hospitality here at Tanglin  Looking forward to staying here again  Definitely recommending this to friends and readers of wheninmanila com

Situated on the fringe of the bustling Orchard Road  Hotel Jen is a quiet abode away from the crowded shopping street yet remains easily accessible  It s a comfortable 10 minute stroll to the heart of Orchard Road and there are shuttle buses to various places including Orchard  Raffles Place and Harbourfront for business travelers  I loved the modern  hipster and somewhat kitschy decor of the hotel  a refreshing contrast to its former life form as Traders Hotel  The rooms were decently sized though bathrooms small  It was a little frustrating that the hot water in the shower took an extremely long time to heat up  There was a huge spread at breakfast though taste wise left much to be desired  you could easily get better food elsewhere for a couple of dollars  Overall  taking into consideration the relatively good location and putting price into the equation  I would recommend this hotel for the budget conscious traveller that does not want to sacrifice a less ideal location  The hotels in the heart of Orchard Road are more upscale  Grand Hyatt  Hilton  Mandarin Orchard   with a similarly matching price tag
