I moved to this hotel last minute after having issues with my first hotel in Singapore  and I m so glad I did  First off  I was able to check in even though it was only 11 am  which I greatly appreciated as I wanted to freshen up before my afternoon meetings  The rooms are all recently renovated and very chic  I fell in love  It s a very fun option for the hip business traveller  The lobby was still under renovation when I visited but it was almost done  I snuck a peak and it looked amazing  Hotel Jen is part of the Shangri La group  I love the staff uniforms and new hotel look  Since I was reserving last minute  I had to book the club floor  The lounge is amazing with delicious breakfast  snacks throughout the day  and fantastic wine in the late afternoon  The view is also incredible  Not all club lounges are created equal  and this is definitely one of the nicer ones  They also had amazing themed food and drinks for Halloween  The gym is a good size  I didn t use the pool but it s also very large with plenty of lounge space  I ordered room service and the food was delicious and well presented  I especially enjoyed the warm fresh bread with my pasta  Another plus  it s a 10 minute walk to the Orchard MRT and taxis are readily available  I miss this hotel and I ll definitely be back

After a month in Nepal and delays with our flights  Silk Singapore airlines assigned us to this hotel for a day night while they rebooked our flights  at no cost to us   When we heard this I was terribly disappointed  really tired and ready to go home  and had fairly low expectations of what an airline would pay for  Well I must say  I was incredibly impressed  I can t see how this hotel isn t rated at 5 star  it just had it all  Our room was roomy enough  not incredibly spacious  but with a large bed  desk  sitting area  fridge  all the usual mod cons  and the shower was fantastic   big cubicle  no step  with lots of hot water  Everything was very new  clean and worked properly  The hotel had a gym and pool  wish I had access to my luggage   which was God knows where   so I could get my togs out and use it   The hotel is located close to Orchid Rd  shopping precinct  and has a stop for the hop on hop off bus directly across the road   And even better if you don t have any luggage  it is connected to a mall where you can get toiletries  clothes  etc   It was very quiet and the staff were incredibly helpful  particularly considering we arrived at 3 in the morning with no luggage  money  etc  and after being awake for a very long time  And there were lots of little things that made a difference  such as free wifi without passwords or limits that worked well everywhere in the hotel  and didn t drop out during video calls   and a drinks bar  water  juice  beside reception for everyone to help themselves  I think if I was going back to Singapore for an actual holiday  I d really consider staying here

The Jen is a bit over the top with so many different design elements that you almost loose the story behind Jen  which could be very intriguing  The public areas are quite interesting  and certainly have a lot of design ambition  but in my opinion over designed  The all day dining is comfortable and offers a good variety for breakfast buffet The guestrooms are very small  and the bathroom vanity feels very very tight with too little space  For the price I would expect to have an enclosed toilet stall  but as it is a renovation the bathroom still shows it used to be 3 star  My shower had on and off hot water even after the maintenance guy came to fix it after a morning shower with only cold water  Otherwise the room is fresh with some fun elements  but in my opinion it feels like it is trying too hard to be different The personnel is very friendly and the location is central to Orchard Road and Botanical Gardens

I had stayed at the hotel on my previous visit to Singapore  under the previous ownership  There was work going on in the public areas at the time of my visit  the rooms had certainly been refreshed  though not to my taste I didn t eat dinner at the hotel  but breakfast disappointed  with quite a queue to get seated  My next visit to Singapore will be to a different hotel

Stayed for the first time at Hotel Jen last month  Bright colours  cheerful staff and recent renovations means it is clean and well functional hotel for either a business or leisure traveller While it is not directly on or off Orchard  Orchard is a nice 15min walk away and there is an almost hourly shuttle bus service that makes it very convenient of you want to hit the malls of Orchard  There is also a shuttle bus service to the new business districts that one could take every morning Tanglin mall is right next door and a 7 11 round the corner  so any quick eats or things is easily available on hand The surrounding area is mostly residential which is good  because once you are back to your hotel the area around is peaceful and quiet Rooms are smallish but comfortable and practical The only negative for me is it seems in the renovation I don t think they have redone the water system and the old 1980s style hot water issue persists  I e  water suddenly gets too hot or mostly cold when someone on the same floor is using the shower perhaps  I don t think it was only my room  because it happened to 2 of my colleagues as well in their rooms Small flaw however  otherwise no complaints and a great stay Room Tip  choose a higher floorSee more room tips

I had originally booked another Hotel for my stay in Singapore  but following a disappointing experience decided to book a room at Jen Changlin for my last night  I wish I d heard of it earlier  as it was a fantastic stay  I arrived too early for check in  and approached Reception to ask whether I could drop my bags off  and then return later in the day when check in was open  I was warmly greeted by the Reception team who reviewed my booking and offered to check me in immediately so that I could rest  I mentioned my flight was not until the following evening at 8pm  and they very kindly offered me a late check out also  advising that if I wanted to leave my bags with them  they could arrange for me to have a shower prior to my flight if I would like  Top marks to the team  as they could not have done more to make me feel welcome  The room was lovely  and overlooked the Singapore skyline  I believe that the Hotel has been fairly recently upgraded  and the room  bathroom and amenities were lovely  I spent some time at the National Museum and then dined in house at the restaurant  and the food was lovely  Breakfast the next morning also had an extensive Western and Asian menu  and I did not wait any longer than 1 2 minutes for staff to sight me  and then offer me a table  Restaurant staff seemed very rushed and less engaging than Reception  but were trying to process a large volume of people which must be a fine balancing act at the best of times  Wifi signal was strong both in the public areas as well as my room  The following day when I checked out  one of the team assisted me to arrange a taxi for my return trip to the Airport  Overall  an excellent stay at a good price  and I could not be happier with the service and hope to return on my next visit to Singapore  Definitely recommended Room Tip  Ask for a high floor with a view if possibleSee more room tips

I have now stayed here a few times as this is the  former traders hotel  undergone a complete renovation re branding  As many have already stated the rooms are a bit tiny but nicely done  Not a whole lot of room for big suit cases  The bathroom is tiny but works  I love the long mirror in the shower on the wall  You can shave here as the mirror barely fogs up  I found the bed fine not soft not hard  The A C works good and will get very cold if you want it  WIFI is free and I had good speeds  The hotel has a very large pool and decent fitness center  The Men s locker has wet and dry sauna along with a Jacuzzi  The hotel bar is on the 2nd floor  More of a sports place really  On the other side of the 2nd floor you enter into the Tanglin mall  No need to get wet or hot  The mall has a good supermarket on the bottom floor  A Starbucks  A Chilies restaurant and few other places to eat  The St Regis hotel is just up the road and not far  If you pay for club lounge access or have it via Golden Circle  Shangri La group  you won t be disappointed  The food is FANTASTIC  Probably some of the best I have had anywhere in the world  My hat s off to the F B manger and club lounge manager at this hotel  Every morning the Breakfast was really really good  Eggs cooked great  Bacon not underdone or cooked to burnt  The breads fresh like they had just come out of the oven  At night each dish was very tastefully done and your taste buds will explode  Yes the food was that good  Everything was presented well  The wines were average but flowing  Good selection of cocktails and beer also I had no issues getting a taxi in the covered parkway out front  The staff were fine and friendly for the most part  Overall this is a solid 4 star hotel with a much lower price then the 5 star counterparts on the island  Location is good just a bit back off Orchard road  You can walk to it in less then 10 minutes  I highly recommend getting access to the club lounge if you can  Well worth it and enjoy the food Room Tip  Rooms were quiet  I never head anyone else from my room See more room tips

We stayed 4 days at this amazing  modern and friendly hotel  The room and other public area are so unique  Great taste of food for breakfast The swimming pool is quite bigger compare to other simillar hotels  The connection to Tanglin Plaza is very helpful and convenient for the guest  You can get to the famous Orchard Road with 15 20 minutes of walk in a pleasant sidewalk

I stayed for a few nights on business  Rooms are functional if not very big  I m not a big fan of the beach bono decor which I found a little tacky  Temperature regulation in the shower was bad  air con quite loud and pillows a bit plump and firm  Breakfast had an excellent selection and the pool area was nice  if not particularly attractive to look at from the room  Good location  Probably a bit expensive for the level of comfort and detail  but comfortable nonetheless

This place feels like home not only because of the comfort levels and great facilities but also the staff s hospitality and dedication to excellent customer service  A special thanks to Nabil for sorting us out with breakfast last week  Highly appreciated   I ve stayed here on business trips  with my daughter and recently with my partner and this hotel works well for solo travellers  families and couples A great location  Close to Orchard Road but just far away enough in a peaceful  green environment which is great for relaxing  The pool is stunning and ideally designed for when you have your kids with you  Once again  quality of customer service from the pool staff was excellent  The rooms are perfect for after a long flight  Beds  bedding and pillows are extremely comfortable and the robes just add that extra bit of luxury  Love the new window seats and the free internet is an added bonus  The bathrooms are stocked with lovely toiletries  toothbrushes etc  Loved the 2 showerheads in the shower  Very convenient Breakfast offers a huge variety of Singaporean and Western cuisine Check in and check out is efficient and fast  The supermarket and food court in the shopping centre below the hotel is very convenient  Getting around is easy  Taxis are always available from the hotel and Orchard Road is an 8 minute walk away Wouldn t stay anywhere else in Singapore

After staying at 3 YTL hotels in a row  the Jen Tanglin was quite a change  What were the interior designers on when they planned the decor  However it worked for me and as we settled in I began to appreciate its quirkiness  At first I was not impressed with the room but it did have some good features   We had to ask for water to be replenished as this was forgotten Our first outing was to Orchard Road which was a bit overwhelming for a first timer in Singapore and later discovered that the Jen is connected to its own small and user friendly mall with a food court and supermarket posh  The breakfast was superb  So much choice and good quality I would like to put in a good word for the front staff who were cheerful and helpful  All were lovely but I particularly remember Kelvin  hope that s correct   who sorted us out a taxi when the shuttle was full and phoned the local travel company for us when they had not confirmed our pick up

We stayed here because it was close to an international pediatric clinic where our daughter had an appointment  We were pleasantly surprised that it s super close to the spectacular Botanical Gardens  a kind of tropical version of New York s Central Park Rooms are small but clean and cozy and recently remodelled  Oddly  the remodelling reminds me of late 60s early 70s decor  What goes around comes around I guess Great breakfast spread and attentive service  Next door to a nice mall with Western supermarket and food court  No negatives to report  Definitely would stay again

My in laws stayed here on a long visit  They have stayed here a number of times over previous visits and the staff still remember them when they return and would ask about their health and family  They really loved the feeling of  coming home  when they stay in this hotel and that is largely down to the wonderful staff  ranging from the front desk  transport desk concierge  and housekeeping staff  They were upgraded to the club lounge this time  which had a lovely view from the 17th floor  and great selection of snacks and drinks through the day  The evening drinks and snacks were particularly popular  Tanglin Mall next door provided every convenience  along with supermarket  restaurants  cafes and shopping options  There is a useful shuttle service to main parts of Orchard Road and Orchard MRT station  The shuttle service on weekdays also run to business destinations like Shenton Way  Marina Bay Financial Centre  Suntec  even the International Business Park at Jurong East  clearly still retaining their business clientele from the old Traders Hotel branding   The new branding and renovation gave the hotel a fresh and vibrant feel that will appeal to young travellers  families and holidaymakers

I have previously stayed in a few different hotels in Singapore and this is by far the best one I ve stayed   This is a brand new hotel very near to orchard shopping malls  We were impressed by the interior design the moment we stepped into the hotel lobby  The colourful and innovative design make us feel happy and relax  We booked a club room which come with the club lounge access  Hotel Jen Tanglin heard my inner thought    I always missed the chance to get a drink or relax at the club lounge in other hotels as most of the time when I m back at the hotel  the club lounge has closed  I was really impressed and excited when I saw the club lounge is 24 hours access with room key  We love our room so much as it came with SMEG fridge  Nespresso coffee machine  king size floating bed to name a few  You can tell that they really put a lot of efforts in designing the room to ensure the guests have the best stay ever  We arrived quite late on the day so we ordered room service  The food served were delicious  big portion and yet it wasn t very pricey compare to other hotels around orchard  I would highly recommend you try their Singapore Laksa The hotel also offered free shuttle bus service to send you to shopping malls around orchard  It will cost about 5 bucks to grab a taxi if that what you prefer to do  We will definitely stay here again the next time I visit Singapore as one night is not enough for me to enjoy everything in this hotel  Have to make sure I stay a few nights in my next trip

The Jen Hotel has been rebranded and upgraded from Traders Hotel to The Jen  The transformation and refurbishment is very well done  and the whole atmosphere is one of stylish comfort from the reception to the room  I asked for an upgrade for a modest fee to the Club floors and found the extra charge was well worth it  Beautifully decorated rooms with modern good quality furniture and fittings  The 17th floor club room was a very good place to take breakfast with a good variety of dishes  At 5 00 pm you could relax with colleagues with free nibbles and snacks and free alcoholic drinks I presume the JEN brand for Shangri La s trains its South East Asia staff at this venue as the Poolside restaurant staff were not up to the usual standard Room Tip  negotiate the extra cost of a Club room  and become a Golden Circle memberSee more room tips

My mom  amp  dad stayed almost 3 weeks in this hotel because of my brother surgery in nearby Gleneagles Hospital  Maria Knott  the lady in the reception was very helpful and super nice  She kindly took care of our needs perfectly every time we decide to extend the staying period with hassle free situation  She event showed her sympathy to our situation according my brother s health and recovery  What a lady with golden heart and attitude  We re so thankful for that  Another lady who cleaned up our room was also very nice  She asked if we need more bottled water and even put smile every time  We were feel so welcome and been taken care very well  The room is in new condition  very unique ambience  and super clean  Amenities are quite complete  Shower pressure and temperature was perfect  Overall it was a very pleasant stay  Thank you Jen Tangling Hotel  especially Maria Knott  for every helps in our situation  Very well recommended

The hotel room was neatly prepared and bathroom was super clean  There s a direct linkway to Tanglin Mall  from Level 2 of the hotel  and Orchard Road is a walking distance ?  approximate of 15 minutes  Front desk staffs were attentive and the young lady who assisted me upon check in was very friendly  The overall ambience of the hotel was great

From the moment we walked into this hotel we were welcomed  We   a 60 year old woman  her young friend and a baby   are not the typical clients of this hotel  judging by the people that we observed there  who were up market corporate people  our slightly  hippie  suitless appearance did not seem to phase anyone in the least  There was not one ounce of snobbery or demeaning behaviour in any of the staff at this great hotel Being a former restaurant owner  i was immensely impressed when on our 2 morning there i watched as the restaurant staff catered and cared for 600 guests for breakfast in an easy  friendly and seemingly effortless manner  Respect    I take my hat off and salute the management of this hotel    you obviously foster a happy atmosphere with your staff  Your training in team work is impeccable  Thank you   it was a pleasure to stay here The room  although not huge  was comfortable and clean  The beds were comfortable and the sheets were of a high quality  We greatly appreciated the drinking water supplied  The bathroom  was again small but perfectly adequate and with everything that we needed The wifi was easily accessible and powerful enough to make skype calls When we needed help with transport and advise on where to go and how to get there   the staff were quietly helpful without being overly solicitous  Very classy     in a way that i have often NOT experienced in more luxurious hotels Toilet Tick   the lobby toilets   110   10   impressive  clean  decorative  and i was delighted with the automatic soap dispenser followed by the automatic water tap and then the air drying facility We were gifted this hotel for the 2 days that we were in Singapore by a very dear friend What a blessing  I will be back

The location is great   the hotel is a short walk from the corner of Orchard  amp  Scotts I was blown away by the new casual look and feel  The decor is fresh  and the rooms are a fantastic modern take on traditional Asian themes  The staff are friendly   I love the new casual look  and service is what you d expect from part of the Shangri La chain The bathrooms are relatively small  but very modern  and the amenities are great  The breakfast buffet offers absolutely the best selection of food I have experienced in a hotel in this price bracket I am looking forward to my next stay

My husband and I were wrapping up a two week trip to Thailand with a few days in beautiful Singapore  Unfortunately  my husband felt ill on the flight over  and within an hour of checking into the beautiful Hotel Jen  he fell sick with stomach flu  I went down to the concierge to ask if there was a pharmacy nearby  and the duty manager  Maria Knott  was alerted to our situation  She was concerned about my husband and asked if she could accompany me to the room to check on him  Maria asked if my husband needed a doctor  but he didn t feel it was necessary  She arranged to send up an extra blanket  some ice  and extra bottles of water for him  which arrived in less than ten minutes  For the next three days of our stay at the Hotel Jen  Maria or one of her staff  called to see how we were doing  They were incredibly attentive and made us feel well cared for  The hotel itself is beautiful and in a great location  It has a direct link to the Tanglin Mall  which came in handy when we needed to visit a pharmacy or food market  and the pool was refreshing and well kept  Thank you to Maria and the staff at Hotel Jen for taking such great care of us  We highly recommend this hotel to anyone else travelling to Singapore

I love this hotel  The room was quite small for the US standards  but it was very clean and the bed was really comfortable  Just as a minor negative point  the temperature of the water in the shower was not uniform  it was changing without touching the faucet    pipes issues I guess      The hotel is a bit far from the city center  but they offer a free shuttle to Orchard Rd   the main shopping street   The breakfast buffet is amazing  Plenty of options  including local food  Finally  the staff was super friendly and helpful  Great experience

Came to Hotel Jen for a staycation experience and got quite a good stay The hotel is situated at the start of orchard road  near UNESCO heritage Singapore Botanic Gardens  The location was decently well and one of its plus point I stayed in a club room  highest floor  The view was gorgeous  with a paranoma experience of Orchard and Singapore  Room  The club room was trendy  with a nice couch by the window  The bed has a levitating effect which was quite cool  Well equip room but not very big  decent for a normal stay  Aircon of the room was slightly warm though hmmmBathroom  The toiletries was disappointing as it was house brand  I dont like house brand  hahaha  And its quite small  quite cram for 2 person to be inside at the same time  This is quite in line with the room of being slightly smaller in size despite this being the club room  Not sure about the normal rooms  Club lounge food  The club lounge was quite big relative to most lounges with the same spectacular view  The spread of food was good too with quality as well  But it was not a fair representation as I was there on a festive period  Anyway  I am glad for the good food  There were ample space and seats  The main restaurant at the lobby has one of the largest spread of food  ranging from international to eastern  Not too shabby  Service  The service was decent  expected of a hotel  Nothing beyond the expected  appreciate the high floor request received  This hotel tend to have many young couples staying as I have observed  From what i understand  its more of a business hotel during weekdays instead  Hope this helpsRoom Tip  Club rooms for the good club experience  High floors for paranoma viewSee more room tips

Just stayed here one night ?  really in transit  Nice clean  modern hotel room with everything you need for a short stay  Part of the Shangri La group but at the cheaper end  Free wifi  At one end of Orchard Road so a little walk to most places but close to the Hard Rock Caf?   There were renovating the reception area when were were there but it didn t bother us   think they are putting a restaurant in there  Would stay again

Stayed in the club room for 2 nights with family over Christmas holiday Around 15mins walk from the beginning  end  of orchard road  The hotel also offer free schedule shuttle to and form the orchard MRT station Room was ok as it was recently been renovated  Size was not big but up to a 4 stars standard Lounge offerings was limited  One plus point is we can order dishes from the 2 onsite restaurants at a discounted price  With the view and free drinks from the lounge  this becomes a pretty good feature

We had a company event in Singapore and we were placed at Hotel Jen  As ours was a large group  the check in process was smooth with all check in counters opened  Our room was rather small but this was made up with the facilities provided in the room  The bathroom had all the basic necessities  Our beds were comfortable  it s been a while since I slept like a baby at a hotel  After placing our bags in the room  we went down for lunch  It was good that there was some Indian cuisine in the lunch menu  The buffet breakfast the next day was plenty and I just loved the mango ice cream  it was so good  There was a queue at the egg station as there was only one man at the counter  I would definitely return to Hotel Jen at my next trip to Singapore

This was my first time staying at the Jen Tanglin  formerly Traders  Hotel  since the renovation  I was in town for a short trip and picked the location because of its proximity to Orchard Road and my meetings  It was somewhat cheaper than the other options I was looking at  but did not fall short in any way  I was glad to save the extra SGD50 100 per day I would pay elsewhere for the extra luxury details that I was not looking for anyway  As a traveler who spends about 100 nights a year in hotels  I like a place to get the basics well and use little of the over the top features  such as a superlative restaurant or spa  unless I am on a personal trip  The hotel has a nice hip decor and the staff were very warm  What I particularly liked was their understated attentiveness  always there when you needed them at the reception or the fitness center or lounge  I booked a room with access to the Horizon lounge   Despite being a large hotel  it felt intimate and not overwhelming The rooms are clean  well furnished and with very comfortable beds  The windows also ensure its very quiet and the airconditioning was quiet and effective  The free Wifi was excellent and it was easy to sign in from all devices  I did not hear any noises or noisy guests late at night getting back to their rooms or forgetting that just because doors are closed doesn t mean people are not resting inside  a pet peeve of mine elsewhere   The bathrooms were also well designed with high quality fittings  Hansgrohe and Toto   The fitness center was bright and overlooked the pool  and delivered what I needed was a well functioning set of treadmills and weight machines  but there was other equipment as well  The pool and spa were never crowded which was a plus The Horizon Club was small  but for the most part never full  except for evening happy hours  The breakfast spread was fine for me  though some more elaborate tropical fruit options or Asian offerings would have been a nice touch  The lounge staff were always very helpful and the coffee was excellent  I tend to stay away from snacks and happy hour offerings  but they certainly looked good and were very popular The main restaurant looked nice and lively  and the adjacent cafe was a great place to meet  though I didn t eat at the restaurant  Finally  the guests were a mix of tourists and business travelers which provided a nice mix Overall  I think it was very good value for money  at a great location  and I would happily stay there again  The staff was very accommodative  the rooms were clean and comfortable  the guests all looked happy  and the facilities were uptodate and well functioning  For a large hotel  it had a welcome intimate feel  I highly recommend it Room Tip  Rooms overlooking Cuscaden Road get nice sunshine all day See more room tips

Formerly known as Traders Hotel and now Hotel Jen Tanglin Singapore  it went through an extensive SGD45 million makeover from head to toe and we¡¯re happy to spend a short staycation over the Valentine¡¯s weekend there   The industrial modern hipster look caught my attention upon entering the hotel lobby  with the soft warm lightings and a huge green wall with plants potted on it which gives every visitor a welcoming ambient Each room includes free WiFi  a must for hotels to provide  USB charging outlets and a king size ¡°floating bed¡± with 300 thread count linens There is also a gym available in the hotel as well  All you need to do is to sign in at the gym reception counter and you will be given a electronic key tags where you can keep your belongings in the big lockers  There all also shower rooms with good water pressure and a indoor Jacuzzi  steam room and sauna available for all hotel guest to use too Room Tip  Go for the room that faces the pool   See more room tips

I was looking for a hotel room with bathtub  hubby s favourite   as a staycation treat for my hubby s birthday  Afraid of making a wrong decision  I called up the hotel s reservation hotline  number was taken from their website   to confirm which of the room types at Hotel Jen Tanglin comes with a bathtub  and was told that all their superior and deluxe rooms have bathtubs and shower in the room  That sounds perfect  I proceed to booked a room for 2 night stay from the hotel s website  the check in went on smoothly  However when I get into the room  there was no bathtub so I make a call to their guest service to request for change of room  After a good 15 mins  there was no call back from them  no response whether was it possible to arrange for another room  So    I had to make my way to the front office to repeat the same story  Maria Knott then explain that this hotel only have bathtubs at limited rooms and not sure why the reservation team told me otherwise  She and another colleague then offer me a change of room  which I will have to wait for 30 mins to 1 hour and they will ring me up once the room is ready  But it was not until I approach the front desk after 2 hours later  then I was told that the room was already ready Bad experience with all the communication breakdown  starting from reservation office  to guest service and then to front office       And now is only the 3rd hour of my 3D2N stay

Hotel Jen Tanglin is well positioned being close to the Botanical Gardens and the shopping arena of Orchard Road  Our room was remarkably small for such a prestigious hotel and the bathroom was tiny  The foyer is a vast and mostly empty space with a sort of coffee bar at one end  This adjoins the restaurant which is  once again  rather bleak  There are two places to enjoy a drink and neither is very inspiring  Rumpoles is a lofty room with little charm  good for a few lunchtime beers with the lads   but not somewhere where women would feel at home   The decoration throughout is rather odd   very modern and a bit like being in a bicycle shop  not to my taste but each to his own  The staff were excellent  they were without exception  knowledgeable courteous and well trainedOn the plus side we were members of the Club Lounge and this provided somewhere quiet to spend time  The hotel was also very helpful in allowing us to stay late in our room since we had a midnight flight More a commercial hotel than a holiday destination

Location wise  Hotel Jen Tanglin is easy to spot  From the airport  you can take the train  Orchard Station  or if you are willing to spend around 30SGD  you can take the cab in less than 30 minutes  Strategically situated near Orchard Road  shopping   embassies and other hotels  so going from one place to another is easy The hotel has daily bus trips to different destinations  business or pleasure trips  that makes it more convenient for the tourists We got a twin bed room  Spacious enough  considering hotel rooms in Singapore are really small  Bathrooms were okay  toilets were mediocre   We booked here since our venue for our event is also here  Coordination with their staff is a breeze  their staff was willing to assist us if needed Food  many choices  I only had the chance to eat breakfast and lunch during our stay  Breakfast  from cereals to sashimi  bacon to chicken rice  Every type of carbs you can imagine is there  D For lunch  you can choose from their local dishes  paired with other Asian delicacy There is a 24 hour gym if you need to workout or needed to de stress  The pool is open from 8AM 9PM  There is a restaurant beside the pool if you want to munch after dipping Everything is here  as in

I stayed here for two nights while I was in Singapore on Business  The rooms are very modern but far more interesting than the typical hotel rooms I d usually stay in  The staff were excellent throughout the stay and when I checked out and took a taxi I accidentally left my luggage in the boot  Ayu and her manager went above and beyond to assist me in tracking down the driver and reunite me with my bag which I m very grateful for

Singapore is a vibrant and busy city  there is so much to do  The Hotel Jen is a very modern and beautifully aesthetic hotel  The staff are very helpful  from the towel guys at the pool to the hotel receptionist  The rooms are fully air conditioned with tea and coffee making facilities  fresh bottled water every day  a fridge and flat screen TV  Also much more  We had a fantastic three day stay here before our long flight home Room Tip  All rooms are exceptional  it just depends on your needs See more room tips

I stayed here for a business trip and thought the room was very well planned  I loved the furniture and clever use of a small space  The sofa fitted perfectly into the window recess and the bed was really comfortable  The location is ok  but a little far from the mrt station  although there is a shuttle  Wifi was excellent throughout the hotel and being close to Tanglin mall gives some useful amenities such as the food hall  I thought it very pricey  as breakfast was not included for ? 150 a night  A smiley receptionist offered a  special deal  of only SD 50  ? 25  a day for breakfast  I found my own breakfast for a fraction of that cost

Stayed in this hotel previously when it was known as the Traders Hotel   noticed the refurbishment and update since our previous visit  Room good sized kept nice and clean with good bathroom  Plugs in room for electronic devices  free wifi  tea and coffee making  Meals are buffet style in the ground floor restaurant with good range of well cooked local and western dishes served at all meals  Plenty of variety for all tastes and appetites  Staff very helpful and friendly  Approx 10 to 15 minutes walk to Orchard MRT station for exploring further afield in Singapore  Would recommend and will return when coming back to Singapore

We recently stayed at here for 7 days and have no complaints at all  Recently refurbished  the rooms are decorated to a high standard and have everything you need  although the bathrooms are on the small side  Staff were helpful and pleasant throughout  Location wise  the hotel is based at the end of Orchard Road  Which means easy access to as many shops and eateries as you can handle within a 10 minute walk  plus it s 10 15 mins walk from the MRT   You are also a 10 minute walk from the Botanic Gardens  which is lovely  All in all  I would definitely recommend

The room is tastefully designed with travellers in mind It was very well thought with high attention to details It even has an ironing board stored  discreetly  under the sofa  brilliant   Not the best looking hotel room but it s definitely way above average The breakfast spread was pretty awesome with wide range of selections and they taste good as well Despite having breakfast on a Sunday  peak period I would say   there were plenty of seats thanks to the large dining area Overall  a great experience in Hotel Jen Tanglin for the price and will definitely recommend it to my friends and family
