I recently had the pleasure of staying at this most welcoming hotel with my family for six nights  It was  without doubt a most pleasurable experience  The facilities are excellent and the staff are very friendly and extremely professional  Food served in the restaurant was of a very high standard with lots of choice to suit everyone  Now we are planning our next holiday to Singapore for next year  and will most definitely return to Hotel Jen Tanglin once our flights sorted out

We stopped at the hotel for the last leg of our honeymoon in April last year and we were absolutely blown away  They had added so many lovely finishing touches  like wine  chocolate  fresh fruit and a welcome message in our room  The room was ample for what we needed spacious and very comfortable  The restaurants were very clean and had an array of food  The restaurant by the pool does food to die for We couldn t believe there was a full shopping mall underneath the hotel it was amazing The pool was out of this world and we really enjoyed the little bit of down time we managed there  We will deifnately return to this hotel at some point Room Tip  We had a room overlooking the pool absolutely stunningSee more room tips

We spent three nights here  room was fine  good view and overlooked the pool  Pool was great Breakfast was good with very friendly staff  During the rain  the link toTanglin Mall on hotel second floor was a a boon  as you could get to the shops and restaurants without going outside One odd thing  no ice buckets  We received a cool box with ice for our room  but I cannot imagine if you ordered champagne or wine with dinner it would not come in an ice bucket  We were told the hotel did not have any

We stayed at Hotel Jen Tanglin for 7 nights and this hotel is the best place to stay Hotel is well set out  with great fixtures and fittings  Room size was perfect for two people  we were out all day so nice to come back to a beautifully comfy bed at night to rest The restaurant and breakfast spread was amazing  so many choices and staff were friendly Close to Orchard Rd  about a 10min walk to main shopping area and MRT  loved the Tangalin Mall attached to the hotel  Handy to pick up some groceries or a snack We would definitely stay again  thank you for the amazing time

This is just a superb Hotel  Accept the offer of a  quot Club Lounge quot  upgrade  Private dining breakfast area  Happy Hours  rooms on the 17th and 18th floor  with private circular stairs to 17  Really excellent staff who are so helpful and friendly  In a quiet area o the West side of the Hotels  Superb outdoor 30metre pool  with fabulous Spa  There are x2 Hotel Jen   make sure you book the  quot Tanglin quot

We stayed here for a couple of days at the end of Feb   beginning of March 2016 on our way to Australia from the UK As others have said  the staff couldn t have been more helpful or friendlier and made every effort to help whenever they could  The hotel is well appointed and easy to get to wherever you want to go via the Hotel bus or taxis The room was small but very nice and the hotel amenities were superb   we particularly liked the club lounge for a cup of tea We would definitely stay here again

I stayed at the Jen four nights  Could easily walk to Orchard Road  to the Botanic Gardens  hop on the sightseeing bus and get a night tour from and to the hotel The room was nice and clean  The pool is excellent  breakfast is very good  nicely served and delicious The hotel staff is welcoming and the concierge is very helpful Room Tip  Higher floors have less noise from the streetSee more room tips

I stay here for business whenever I m in Singapore because it is good value and ideally located  After a long refurbishment process last year   I am now pleased to say that the place also looks and feels great All the rooms are now new and refreshed  with design touches that make the most of a small room  window seat with iron and ironing board underneath   can be a child s bed  large shower instead of bath  slim but well designed closet with safe  coffee tea amenities above the minibar  etc   The lobby is now super funky and they offer bicycles to explore the nearby areas   it feels  vibrant  fresh  and young  To top it all off   excellent staff who remember you and ever willing to offer a hand  The buffet breakfast is still excellent  with an additional coffee bar now showcasing local coffee blends An excellent  excellent  stay Room Tip  Rooms facing the pool are quieter See more room tips

Stayed here for the whole of March Service is great  Special mention to Barbara who helped out with a smile one day I was really too late for breakfast  but it worked out anyway  Receptionists and the cab hailers  sorry  don t know the proper expression  were always very pleasant I typically take my breakfasts early for workdays  and  unfortunately  during my first week or so  there was no chef available at 6 30  This got better  but occasionally there were days where I d have to wait a bit for them to show up  I especially enjoy the juice selection and occasionally indulge with an icecream after the meal I did not try dinner at the hotel  or much room service  My colleague told me the dinner is very nice and that room service is also quite good with decent portions  I ordered in once at the end of my stay  and I certainly got enough food then  Prices are surprisingly affordable for room service I tried going to the gym one of my first days  It s the first time I ve been turned away because I wanted to wear crocs on my feet while moving some steel around  I wore socks of course   I am not a barbarian    That seemed a bit snobby to me and is really the only thing that actually deducts from my overall experience  I guess I could ve should ve brought proper sport shoes    Next time I will The rooms are nice  Air condition works well  My sleep quality is always a little off when away from home  especially in air condition  but the sleeping experience here has been quite decent  Hot water was a problem for me at first  as I had to let it run for a long time to get a proper temperature going  This lasted until I changed rooms halfway through my stay  and in the new room it was much better  A colleague mentioned experiencing the same thing on his previous trip  The rooms could be sound proofed better   you can hear what s going out in the hallway and  they can hear you too  So perhaps not the most ideal romantic getaway location  hehe Laundry service was good   nice deal with a bag full of laundry for 30   SGD  Returned the next day  Express laundry available if necessary Pool area was nice  Always greeted with a smile  Perhaps a warning about the Singapore sun if you re not familiar with the heat  The pool is in no way ideal if you enjoy swimming for exercise  but nice for relaxing Location of the hotel is good   just a short walk to Orchard Road with all its shopping malls  The Tanglin shopping center connection from the hotel is handy  sporting typical places such as a market  foodcourt  some restaurants and misc  shops I will be returning  Just wish it wasn t for work

Finding good value for money in Singapore is no easy task  with our recent stay at the Park Royal on Kitchener I think we did as good as we can do  For a little more than budget prices  you get a top quality stay  at a proper hotel  located very near an MRT station The rooms are new  very clean with all the latest amenities   the staff aims to please  and while not as in love with the location as an Indian may be  it was in Little India  it was still more than adequate Do yourself a favor and stay at this hotel  you ll feel like you got your money s worth  no easy task in The Lion City

We stayed at Park Royal for 3 nights and really enjoyed the hotel  We had asked for a triple share room and got a very spacious one  The location was just perfect with a lot of Indian restaurants down the road  Mustafa for shopping and the rly stn  just across the street  The Breakfast buffet was lovely  I do so recommend this place

Stayed here coming back from a trip to Australia  Shame because it was a lovely hotel with a trendy decor  There is a shopping center opposite so it was perfect for some shopping while waiting to head back to the airport ALos the bar done some nice snacks and cocktails Would love to go back again and enjoy a longer stay

This hotel is a bit old  but the service is excellent  When we were there  this hotel was fully booked due to an international conference  I believe all the staffs are super busy  However  they are still very attentive and friendly  Due to the function  almost all of the customers having same schedule  The 3 old and small lifts in the hotel just couldn t handle the traffic  Everyone of us have bus to catch at almost same time of the day  We are running out of time  A room service helper passed by and felt our frustration  She came and offer us to use the workers lifts   quot We are forbidden to bring customers to these back lifts but I m sure you needed this very much at this moment quot   now this is REAL customer service  isn t it  On the last day of my stay  we had a half day tour so all of us leave our luggage with the concierge  When I came back to collect my luggage  the concierge apologized and brought me to the storeroom  Apparently my luggage was broken during transfer  and they have prepared 2 different sizes new luggage for me to choose as the replacement  The whole process is efficient and I m satisfied with their service

The room was a bit small for two adults and a child  no space for a roll away bed  butthe location  cleanliness  service and ambiance more than made up for it  Stone s throw from the MRT  Little India and a mall accross the street   it served our needsperfectly  Possibly a little expensive but that s Singapore for you  The only day we tried to dine there  surprised to find the restaurants closed around 1030pm  didn t bother to find out why  with little India restaurants next door   who cared

We had booked this hotel for a leisure trip in the first week of February  The hotel is situated at a very convenient location with the Ferrar Road metro just across the road  You have the Mustafa Mall   Liitle India behind the hotel with a big money exchanger and the city mall in the front of the hotel The service is great  good cleanliness and polite staff As a part of package tour we had our breakfast complimentary  The breakfast spread was great on all the days  The beds are confortable and the travel concierge at the hotel is very friendly and helpful  The hotel has a swimming pool  gymnasium  restaurant and other facilities

We stayed at The Parkroyal in Kitchener after much deliberation and trip advisor reviews The main high point of this hotel is its location and trust that may be the only reasonfor it to get a 4 star We stayed 5 nites  The rooms are just about average  The standard rooms does not have anything to give it a 4 star rating After the AC in our room did not repair for 24 hrs and adjusting the discomfort we were given a Deluxe room  I called up the reception twice to check if this INDEED was the  quot Deluxe quot  room The size of the room or the bed which were not at all any size  forget King or Queen was the same as the standard so got wondering what was Deluxe  They informed me that the toothbrush and some such packets in the bathroom was deluxe   Ofcourse there were slippers too  So the room was a disappointment and not expected Nevertheless the hotel is clean The food could do with more varieties and options for Vegetarians and the staff could do with better English The reception was the worst with the long queues Appreciate that we need to wait whilst checking in but having to wait in queue to be given the key for the new room due to mismanagement and AC not working etc was not acceptable

we chose this place as we are purely vegetarian and love indian food and this hotel is located in little india and next to mustafa shopping centre where you get everything you need to shop from electronics to clothes accessories   watches etc and you have all kinds of indian restaurants nearby from south indian to punjabi and is easily accessible from any part of singapore

I couldn t be happier with the stay my husband and I have just had at the Parkroyal Kitchener Road  We stayed for 2 nights  and found an excellent deal on the hotel s website for access to the Executive Club   what amazing value this was  Besides the added benefits  the service we received from each and every staff member we encountered was outstanding at each point  The hotel is in a good location  in Little India  and right next to access to the Farrer Road MRT station  which made getting around so easy We will definitely be back to this hotel on future visits to Singapore  we both have plans to make this our  quot Singapore regular quot

I stayed at this Hotel on a stop over from Australia back to the UK  the staff were most helpful and pleasant  my room was spotlessly clean and very large  Although breakfast was not included in my original package  I did have breakfast and I was not charged for this  the choice was vast  The Hotel has a wonderful roof top swimming pool were drinks and snacks can be purched very reasonably  The Hotel is situated in the Indian Quarter of Singapore  which is very diverse and fascinating  I recommend the city tour a tour about 3 5 hour if on a short stay in Singapore

the hotel is very well located we were early at 8 morning and room given to us by 10  good breakfast spred  best location for indian vegetarians good pool helpful receptiondisappointments were the old tele with not many choices to watchand secondly a rude call from room service that i am supposed to tip on room service  this call certainly spoilt the whole pleasent experience

service excellent even though i arrived at 1 am local time i was very well attended to the room was very well designed   decorated and comfortablei booked part of a package that had a room on the top floor for breakfast   cocktails every evening and just to chill out all inclusive and with free drinks and internet all day i ate in the resturant only once and it was lovely sumptous buffet they put fruit and flowers oin the room everyday good laundry service fantastic all round value for money all my tours where well booked for me Room Tip  book the orchid packageSee more room tips

Been going to this hotel for a few times over a few years now  It is simply the best  Good service and very clean room  Only issue I ever had was due to my early flight I had to wait a while to checkin to room  Not a problem just had bit of Jetlag and tire from over 6 hour flight wanted to rest The hotel is situated on the perfect stretch of singapore  Mustafa right a few steps away for shopping crasy people  Great staff Will keep coming back

I stayed in this hotel in Oct 2008  First time I took my mom  dad and my grand ma out of India on my own resposibility so I decided to stay a good hotel with good location  As I m from hospitality industry after doing some research work found this hotel and booked through my agent in Kolkata  Anyone book direclty through hotel would get a cheaper rate that travel agent  Now the Hotel is very well designed as far as I remember  We booked a family room  Breakfast was awesome  Staffs were very friendly  My parents were really happy  Its very close to Mustafa  Only thing is the bath tub is very high  always be very careful when you get in and out from shower  I will again go back here and always recommend others SwarnaVancouver  BC

While making our booking  the hotel looked great in the pics  it was in everything else  but the room was not quite up to the mark  The room is aging out in its style  amenities and fixtures  Also we had requested for a double bed room  but the hotel provided us with a room with two single beds  It was quite a fight to get the staff to join the two beds as we were told that double bedded rooms are not available  Also we found that the sheets were not clean and we had to get it changed Leaving the rooms aside  everything else seemed good  including the breakfast  Also the hotel being right next to Little India added to the attraction

We spent 5 nights here and found the hotel to be very nice  The location was excellent for us as we have stayed in Singapore many times  so this was a change for us  Very close to the Farrer Park MRT station  the Century Square Mall with supermarket and food hall  Mustafa Centre  Our room was very comfortable  yes the bathroom is small  but all you need really  The pool area is quite gorgeous and the gym looks well equipped  What struck us was the excellent service and friendliness of the staff  like Singapore of old  We would definitely return to the Park Royal on Kitchener

We had been upgraded prior to getting there and were booked into orchid Club rooms  This probably the best move you can make The room was great  the service was wonderful breakfast was included in the orchid club room  afternoon tea and a happy hour with free drinks and snacks  two items of laundry per person per day The manageress Denise was more than helpful  showing us how easy it was to use the MRT which is only a couple of metres away There are numerous eating places right outside the hotel which is in a really great area I really cannot rate the service and cleanliness highly enough

The great thing about this hotel is the friendly smile at the concierge that welcomes you in  It makes a huge difference to arrive into a hotel where you immediately feel welcomed and at home  The line ups at check in check out were short  The only issue was the room itself   being aged and the mattress being too solid If you re looking to stay near the Mustafa shopping complex  I d highly recommend staying at the Park Royal  If you re looking for a good night s sleep and some peace and quiet  specially on Sundays when hundreds of men appear out of nowhere all around the hotel  then look elsewhere

I had to stay in this hotel for 3 nights and to be honest it s hard to fault it because the rooms are pretty clean and comfy  there is free internet and the staff are really friendly and helpful  However you do get a feeling that you are in India whether you are inside the hotel or when you walk out  Having people eating omelet with bare hands during the breakfast can be quite off putting  The breakfasts in general are extremely crowded and there are queues to get food  You do get a bit of cultural shock when you see behavior of some guests and people outside  It has certainly shown a Singapore in a different light  I wouldn t come back there myself and wouldn t recommended to my friends  and I guess it s a pity that a good value hotel with extremely helpful staff gets such a reputation because of it s guests Room Tip  Use agodaSee more room tips

Booked through Agoda website and arrived around 7pm  Staff was very nice and helpful  Location is excellent   mall and MRT station across the road  7 Eleven around the corner and many places to eat  The Mustafa Centre is very close  anything you need could be found in there and it is open 24hrs  Ordered room service once and it was promptly delivered  Also received two free small bottles of water each day during my stay  Internet access was great   no dramas there  If I was to be picky  the only two minor things was that the room looked much more modern in the pictures and instead of one big bed  I received two twin beds which wasn t much of an issue as I had great sleeps

We got a grate rate at this hotel  This was a guaranteed rate without breakfast  Our flight got their really early but they gave us a room by 9am which was nice  We had breakfast at the Komala s restaurant a short walk away  There s also a toastbox in the City mall opp  Parkroyal  Love the toastbox breakfast The breakfast at the Parkroyal is a grand buffet for which they charge  20 if its not included in your rate  I ve eaten this before and its real nice  But this time since it wasn t in our rate we ate all our breakfast s outside My brother who was travelling with me fell sick during this trip and it was very convenient because we had a doctor who practices on the groundfloor of the hotel  There s also a 7 11 and the Mustaffa center is 1min away  All in all a great location and a great hotel

Very nice and decent hotel with very nice location  All shopping areas like Mustafa  City Mall are close by  Good Indian eateries are also close by  The ambience is very good and the staff is most helpful  I was able to get my room by 1pm though the check in time is 2pm  They did it on request and were very nice about it  The room was good though a trifle small for a family of three  Furniture and all others things were nice  the toilets were clean and everything was in place  The breakfast was superb and starts very early too at 6am  Everything was perfect about the place and it was a really pleasant experience to stay there Room Tip  No need for any tips u will get a good room anywaySee more room tips

Booking was suppose to include breakfast  but when arrived it wasnt  booking was for a queen size bed and a single bed for our son  but was given 3 single beds instead  watch out for extras when ordering room service  tax and service fees are not included in the price provived  internet connection was terrible location was not the best  unless your interested in Little india  but taxis would pull in at the front and are very cheap  Room Tip  save your pennies  singapore is a very expensive  See more room tips

We have been to Singapore a few times now and we always stay near Orchard Road or Clarke Quay area  However  this trip we chose to stay at Park Royal at Kitchener road and it was a big mistake  We are a family of four and we pre booked our accommodation through a reputable travel agent in Sydney  When we arrived at the hotel after a 8 hour flight  we were provided a room with 2 single beds even though the hotel had the booking details which confirmed 2 adults and 2 children  When questioned the response of the staff were rooms are provided subject to availability and this is the best they could provide  It was obvious that the hotel was overbooked  After having no luck with the staff at the front counter  we requested to speak to the manager  The person at the reception went to the back office to get the manager and came back and said that the manager is too busy to see us and we should settle with this room  We were really frustrated by this stage and demanded to see the manager and the manager finally came out after about 10 minutes  After a heated discussion suddenly they were able to find us a room with a king bed and a roller away bed  They then tried to charge us for the roller away bed  Overall very dissappointed with the hotel and management  Room was not clean and dusty Room Tip  Will Not recommend to familiesSee more room tips

I am from India and went to singapore for Honeymoon 1 Location  I would suggest this hotel because of its excellent location  Mustafa Centre and Little India are adjacent  There will not be any worry for Indian food as there are hundreds of Indian Restaurants at just walkable distance 2 Room Quality  All the rooms are renovated and are very modern and pretty comfortable  But the rooms are not getting ready at Checkin time hence i needed to wait atleast an hour to get a room which is very tiring job  especially after travelling many hours in a flight  Moreover i checked in two times in a weeks time and two times i got a twin bed instead of Kingsize bed  even after i requested for a kingsize bed before hand  which is frustrating  other than this the reception staff were quite friendly and handled well 3 Breakfast  Breakfast menu is very wide and good thing is that it contains lot of indian items

I stayed at this hotel for one night recently on the way back to New Zealand and chose it because of the good reviews it had received on Tripadvisor  After a 15 hour flight I was very tired when I arrived but my room was not ready  However the staff on reception were very helpful and they managed to sort a room for me within an hour and they upgraded me to a deluxe room  There was nowhere to sit in the lobby whilst I waited for my room and I did think the lobby area was a bit lacking in character  There was a basic sort of sitting room off to one side where I had to wait  Not what I would expect of a four star hotel  My room was nice and the bathroom was clean and modern however I found the beds to be very firm and not very comfortable  I thought the pool area was very nice  I ate in the restaurant in the evening and the staff were attentive and the food was pretty good although I thought the drinks were quite pricey

i was on my honeymoon from india  i had done a lot of research prior to doing my booking  as in location of the hotel  nearby places  good indian vegetarian restaurants nearby  comfort  class  amp  value for money  this hotel fulfilled all of them  reception staff were friendly  amp  gave us a complimentary room upgrade  swimming pool is located on the 6th floor of the hotel  amp  is a nice open place to relax  mustafa centre was visible from our hotel room  the hotel staff was very helpful  hotel was very clean  breakfast had a good indian touch and gave a pefect start for the day  indian vegetarian hotels like Komala villas  Anand bhavan  hotel komalas and Kailash parbat are at a walking distance  we stayed at Park Royal for 5 days  amp  was very much satisfied with everything

Me and My family checked in at this hotel on 26th May 2011 we were astonished to see the size of the Family room offered to us It is almost around 500 Sqft carper area Such a large room in Singapore is amazing It is in the close prozimity of Great 24hrs shopping centre Mustafa just walk down from the lobby you enter the mustafa shopping mall The rooms are very clear and well maintained and this hotel is up to the mark with every facilities

This hotel is situated at the edge of Little India  right next to Mustafa s  which has to be the most interesting department store experience in the world and highly recommended  perfumes are the same price or cheapor than duty free  and they stock everything from food through kitchenwares  clothing  electronics and even traditional Indian  Malay and Indonesia clothing  it is open 24 7  nothing like shopping in a crowded store at midnight and the co located restaurants  food is great The hotel staff were absolutely great  helpful and very polite  but the hotel mainly catered to coach loads of tourists from Malaysia  who were without exception pushy and rude  the whole hotel was overcrowded  with whole extended families staying in one room and one morning it took me 30 minutes to get a lift to the lobby and I ended up arriving late to my business meeting Before I stayed here  I had never heard a lift overweight buzzer before  but in the Parkroyal on Kitchener it was a regular occurance On check in  my prebooked Kingsize room was unavailable  so I was given a room with two singles and moved the second night to a kingsize room next to a noisy liftshaft  and on the 3rd night finally to a quiet kinsize room Ate in the restaurant one night  but food was pretty average  whereas outside the restaurants are much cheaper and the food is stunning

We stayed at Park Royal for two nights on our way out to New Zealand  The hotel was well situated next to a brand new shopping mall and a short walk away from the underground station  We arrived late after a long haul flight from the UK  As soon as we arrived the staff took our baggage to our room for us while we checked in and collected the key  We were very jet lagged so went to the night safari before coming back to the hotel to go to bed late at night  The room was basic but suited our needs and had a good bathroomThe next day we got up late to find that the brasserie was about to close but we still went in and had our breakfast  The staff refunded us the price of the whole meal because they felt we did not have the full breakfast selection  We were very pleased with this act of kindness of the staff and they should be recognized for this  After which we thanked the brasserie manager who was grateful for this deed  We then took the very short walk over the road to the new shopping mall which was full of great shops  We were not sure what to do for the rest of the day so we went down to the reception to talk to the trip advisor who was very helpful  We decided to go to Sentosa Island and we got back late at night and the hotel were happy to let people walk in and out at such a time Before going on back to the airport we took advantage of the swimming pool from which we ordered some Singapore snacks  At first there was no one at the service desk and we had to wait for a while  We then ordered the food and had to wait a surprisingly long time for it to come  We got the food eventually and it was very nice Whilst a member of the group was checking us out we visited the gift shop which was full of wonderful souvenirs  After buying some small things from the shop we got into the taxi which was waiting right next to the hotel All in all we had a very pleasant stay at the hotel and would recommend it to anyone visiting Singapore   unless you can afford a room in Raffles

Stayed at Executive floor with personalised check in and check out   Nice room   clean and comfortable   Staff are really friendly and helpful   The location is perfect   closed to Little India street and the mosque   A lot of place to shop ie Mustaffa Shopping complex and Square Mall   eating and drink places especially Indian cooking    very good to try  Room Tip  Stayed at executive floor    valuable for moneySee more room tips

We   2 adults and 2 children 2 years  9 months  stayed 2 nights in ParkRoyal in Singapore on our trip back from Bali  We were positively surprised as to the spacious room we had got  Friendly staff  nice bar  breakfast of everyone s choice  however like a canteen with no atmosphere   Short walking distance to metro and big shopping centre across the hotel with many restaurants  food court  shopping supermarket etc  We didn t use the hotel pool but it looked inviting

By far the biggest selling point of this hotel is the staff and the fact that they cannot do enough for you  I found the rooms to be slightly inferior  but the other public areas of the hotel were decorated with more contemporary style  The hotel was expensive  especially room service and the breakfast rate  and the food served was definitely not worth what was being paid  Overall  though  I found the staff so helpful and friendly  this tends to overshadow any slight negatives with the property  I usually find comments such as these a little  cheesy   so it does take a lot for me to make this kind of statement

We decided to stay at this hotel because it offered a family room that could accommodate all 5 of our family  We found there were very few hotels in Singapore that could accommodate more than 4 people  unless you chose to pay for 2 rooms  Even then they won t guarantee that you will have adjoining rooms The Parkroyal on Kitchener was an excellent choice because we were able to have our 3 young children sleep in one room and we had a separate king size bed in another room  There was only one bathroom The rooms themselves are a little dated but very clean and spacious  I certainly wouldn t recommend it for honeymooners but it was perfect for our family  They had flat screen TV s which included an Australian news channel The pool area was good   it had a large rectangular pool plus a large round wading pool The breakfasts were fantastic and managed to please our young fussy eaters There is a new shopping centre across the road which has a small supermarket  The supermarket stocked most western foods and I was amazed to even see Vegemite on the shelves  a god send for Aussie travellers  The MRT Farrer station was close by but we had no need to use it because the taxi s in Singapore are very cheap and plentiful

We stayed there for 4 nights and got a really good deal of  129 for deluxe room through visa card promotion at hotelclub  The deluxe room were upto the expectations  the toiletries provided were ample and the beds were very large and comfy The location was central for indian food lovers and shoppers in search of mustafa  However for western and fast food the city square mall was right opposite to the hotel along with farrer park mrt station The staff were good and polite specially the front desk and female staff  however some male staff who were roaming in the lobby looked more like secret agents looking over the facility rather then welcoming guests  That was the only thing which goes negative Room Tip  go for deluxe or club roomsSee more room tips

Everytime we visit singapore we make sure to stay at this hotel  This hotel can be reached in less than half hour from the airport  Convientnly located   They have rooms specialy designed for families Breaskfast choices are a plenty  includes authentic indian dishes as well   Customer service is good Shopping is just few steps from the hotel  Mustafa is located right on the back side of the hotel  and the MRT station can be reached by foot Rooms are well maintianed and in the event your room is not ready at the time of check in   The customer service team takes care of you  You can enjoy a welcome drink of your choice while they get your rooms ready

I stayed here for a trip with friends last year  The hotel is convineintly located in Little India  hu of Indias in Singapore  Though Little India is not the best of places in SP  we indians   But the hotel was really nice to stay  It had variety of Indian food and the breakfast buffet was really amazing I would recommend this to anyone looking for a stay for few days in SP  ps  For shooping freaks   Mustaffa was just across the street  D

We stayed on the 8th floor of the Hotel  It is very conveniently located amidst various shopping destinations as well as variety of eating outlets  The service is very good both at the front desk and the room service  The overall ambience  convenience  best price and the grand breakfast are some of the features which makes the stay at ParkRoyal very memorable to the entire family

if you like you hotel to be quite  secluded and romantic   this is NOT the place for you  The hotel is a factory where Indian guests are produced by hundreds every hour  I stayed on the club floor away from the maddening crowd  The club floor is lovely   19th floor  with a lovely view of the little india  the breakfast is simple but very well made  club rooms come with unlimited supply of cold drinks   juices etc in the dining room and unlimited booze and snacks for 2 hours in the evening  staff is friendly  rooms are simple but very clean

On our first visit to Singapore as a family  we were lucky to be get a ParkRoyal Kitchner Road as our hotel of stay  The agent promised a great stay and great it was  While the start was wobbly  a long wait for check in inspite of pre informing early arrival   post that the quality of facility and rooms was very very good  We were upgraded to a Family room and that was very convenient  The Guest Relations manager   Sally Ann personally saw to it that we were taken care of  Our trip required a 3 day break for cruise and then a return to Singapore  We came back to the hotel for the remainder of the trip  The breakfast spread is very elaborate with excellent multi cuisine choices  The swimming pool  with a separate kids pool  and gym facilities are very good  The best part of the hotel is however its location  Its close to the shopping hub that has Mustafa and City Square mall in the vicinity  The MRT stop is right opposite the Hotel  Farrer Park  which make very convenient rides to Sentosa and aroundabout  Overall a very good hotel in a fantastic location

Great staff   especially concierge staff  They went out of their way to assist and Kari  amp  Victor were incredible helpful  Alex in the bar makes a great cocktail and is a wonderful host  The rooms were clean and well maintained and cleaning staff were friendly and helpful  Great access to Little India and what a great place to visit   The hotel staff really made our holiday

We have booked the late gate away package here  Due to that  we have option to upgrade to deluxe room or 20  on F amp B or spa  We choose the room upgrade and been informed deluxe just been renovated Indeed it was and the room was spacious and clean  It s also easy exit to Farrer Park LRT  The only dwn side is it s near Little India and lotsa of Indian around the area day night   Other than that overall satisfied with it

I have stayed in this hotel many times in Singapore both for business as well as with family  amp  it was always value for money  Especially  for Indians looking to stay in Little India for reasons of getting Indian food in the vicinity  The hotel has the added advantage of being situated right behind Mustafa Shopping Centre for those who would fancy shopping there  And most Indians predictably do  The rooms are modest and if you choose to book with Breakfast  then the hotel provides a lavish breakfast spread in the morning  What is good is they provide a lot of Indian menu in the breakfast like Idli  Vara  Partha  etc   which most Indians enjoy having there  The only letdown is since the hotel is usually always full  so you have many people queueing for breakfast at the same time  The hotel is equipped with a lovely gym  amp  swimming pool  amp  has a very good business center  And if you are a GHA Member  then you get additional benefits of two bottles of mineral water each day  amp  free Internet which is always a plus  Overall  I would always recommend Indian travelers to this hotel as value for money Room Tip  Book earlySee more room tips

Let me start by saying that I have stayed at this hotel in the past and was satisfied by my stay But this experience was a sharp contrast to my previous stay  This hotel might have a nice lobby and good breakfast but the room I was given was very dirty  Carpets and bedding was stained  There was dust on all surfaces and you could hear the generator air conditioner machine in stereo surround sound  Very difficult?  to sleep   quot Non smoking quot  room smelt like smoke  Surely you can get a better hotel for the same price  The reception staff was rude and thought they were doing you a favour by letting you stay at this hotel  Obviously very popular with the Indian crowd because of the location  I stayed here for the location  Many indian restaurants in the area  Komala Villas and Anand Bhavan are just around the corner  Mustafa Centre is right behind the hotel  There s a MRT station close by too

You checked in to a room which is already occupied  Very sad start to our four day stay at this hotel They did apologize and sent us complimentary fruits and chocolates but we had a harrowing time as we didn t have a room for 2 hours Point by point analysisA  Breakfast is awesomeB  Location sucks  Too crowded and for travelers coming from India  DO NOT stay here  You are here to experience Singapore and not little India until and unless you cannot survive without Indian food and Indians around you  For non Indians  no problem C  Room service is decentD  Check in experience was horrible E

First impressions of the hotel lobby was fine and inviting but it went downhill when we saw the rooms  I had to ask my dad are you sure this is a 4 star hotel  The rooms looked drained of decoration  old looking furniture and walls  Bathrooms look old  Pool was good and has a fully equipped gym for guests  I liked it how they had a laundry room to wash and dry clothes  Location wise  its next to Little India and the Mustafa centre opens 24 7  Infront of hotel is a shopping mall and the food court is good there Tour guy man downstairs is good  Sentosa merlion day tour is good  Concierge need to be better with giving information and politeness

I chose this hotel since i was on a restricted budget  On check in at the hotel  I resented their ordinary category rooms and had upgraded to a superior category room  which are located on the higher floors  The superior category rooms are newly refurbished and very comfortable  The hotel is conveniently located opposite the train station  but i will prefer a hotel on Orchard street or in Sentosa on my next trip to Singapore  The room service is good  and plenty of eateries are located in City square mall opposite the hotel Room Tip  Take suite room if you opt to stay at this hotelSee more room tips

We were on a 2days and 2 nights stopover in Singapore last April  We find the location very convenient for transportation and shopping The food served was excellant especially the Asian breakfast and the frontline staff was very friendly and helpful We find the room quite comfortable and clean especially for a 4 star hotel in Singapore Overall we enjoy our stay and we will recommed others to stay during their visit to Singapore

We stayed there for 4 nights and got a really good deal of  129 for deluxe room through visa card promotion at hotelclub  The deluxe room were upto the expectations  the toiletries provided were ample and the beds were very large and comfy The location was central for indian food lovers and shoppers in search of mustafa  However for western and fast food the city square mall was right opposite to the hotel along with farrer park mrt station The staff were good and polite specially the front desk and female staff  however some male staff who were roaming in the lobby looked more like secret agents looking over the facility rather then welcoming guests  That was the only thing which goes negative Room Tip  go for deluxe or club roomsSee more room tips

We booked this hotel as we were members of Parkroyal Group and contacted the hotel to inform that we will be arriving early for an early check in  After a long flight from New Zealand  we arrived at 9 30am and the staff were of no help  The guy at the counter told us that we could leave our luggage there at the lounge  there were a maze of luggage piled up all over the place as the luggage room was full  and come back later  We were told to come back in a n hour and then again after another hour and finally the room was given to us only after 2pm  People had to wait in long queues for both check in and check out on weekends as the management don t seem to have any concern for customers  Althoiugh the room was on a non smoking floor  it smelt smoky and the reception staff weren t helpful  The price is higher than other hotels with similar rating in Singapore  The massage centre appears more like a brothel than genuine massage as the massueses want to offer sex or happy ending which was most disgusting to me   In all  we will not stay in this hotel again at any cost

It was the end of the tour when everyone was planning for shopping for their near and dear ones We checked in at Parkroyal and came to know that the Mustafa Shopping centre 24 hrs is next building We enjoyed the day sightseeing and latenight when we returned to the Hotel we went to the Mustafa market and enjoyed the shopping till late night and anyone from our group felt if felt sleepy was asked to go and take rest in their room the rooms were so near The hotel is good and we could do the shopping for everyone

came after staying for two nights at siloso beach resort found the rooms better than siloso where the rooms are cramped and old park royal is very nice hotel centrally located we were given complimentary upgrade to club rooms which i will highly recommend as the rooms were new and also had seperate lifts so no waiting as it is usually in large hotels  was close to many indian restaurants which we liked as being indian vegetarians food is a problem could not do breakfast as flight was early in the morning but my friend who had a late flight told me that the breakfast was very good only improvment required is at the reception as the staff was not very good in english at check inn and also at check out and check inn took a lot of time the counters for check inn was dealing check out keys to one of the room also not worked in between and had to change them booked this hotel directly through the park royal website and would recommend everyone to do so as it was a pleasure and got best rates compared to agoda bookings etcRoom Tip  club roomsSee more room tips

We have just returned from a 3 day stay at the Park Royal Hotel in Singapore   Followed by a week in Langkawi The Park Royal was just not 4 star standard  We had an upgrade to a suite on the 14th Floor  and it was of poor decor and smelled very mouldy   Curtains did not close properly  and carpets were very worn  if this was an upgrade  I dread to think what the standard rooms were like  There are only 3 lifts in the hotel  so the waiting time was at least 5 minutes if you need to use the lift      And no Staircase   One point which we thought was quite amazing    There are no seats in Reception at all  other than 2 child  like open wicker ones  Whilst waiting for our daughters to join us either at night or in the morning   we were ushered to a strange room   behind the concierge  almost like a bus station seating area The breakfast was like a bun fight every morning   There must have been at least another 200 guests all queing for food or coffee at the same time  Whilst there was a vast array of food   it felt like you were queing forever in a very noisy cafe There are so many other fantastic hotels we could have stayed in  and with competition stiff in every business  The Park Royal needs to update thier standards

I had been staying in this hotel for more then 20 years  The main reason being availability of lot of Indian restaurant within walking distance  I come to Singapore almost every two months  Gradually I noticed this hotel s service deteriorating The hotel has become a hub for group travel from India and China  who dont care about service or have no say on the service because the tour operator has booked the hotel  The hotel also does not bother about service as bulk of their business is coming from the tour operators  As long as the tour operators are happy the hotels business will be good  My last stay in this hotel was in 2009 as this hotel had increased their rate and at around this rate I could stay in 5 star hotel in Orchard or Marina Bay area  During my recent trip to Singapore I stayed in this hotel as a friend of mine was staying  I booked a Deluxe King bed room for four nights directly from the hotels web page  It was a super saver deal and I had to pay the four nights charges in advance I checked in around 11 45 pm  There was only one guest in front on me at the check in desk  When I went to the room I found it was a corner room  An odd shaped room room next to the stair  With two beds  amp  each bed less then 3 feet in width  There was no place to put the TV so it was hung to a pipe fixed to the floor and ceiling I called the Service centre but nobody replied so I called the operator and told her that I had booked a king bed and want the room to be changed  She said she will ask the front desk to call back  Nobody called back so I called again again she said she will ask somebody to call  After receiving no call at around 12 30 am I went down to the reception and told her of my problem  She said sorry we dont have any king bed rooms now we will change it tomorrow  I then said to her I called your operator twice and you people even didnt have the courtesy to call back  She just kept quite I then came back to my room and sent an email to the reservation to either change my room tomorrow or else refund my money so that I can go to some other hote  I did receive any email or any message from them  I find the the General Manager of this hotel is always responding to the bad reviews of this hotel but did not feel necessary to respond to my email as the world is not seeing my email The best thing about this hotel is the Bell boys and the door man who helps you in getting a taxi for you  If the front desk personnel or even the duty manager were half as courteous or customer friendly it would be a good hotel to stay Would discourage business and family guest from staying as they give more importance to Tour operators

I was all prepared to write a reasonable review of this hotel  but not now  I ll start with the good stuff   all the staff with the exception of administration staff are lovely and helpful  very polite and happy to please  Breakfasts great and the rooms were reasonably well kept  though a little old   No bed bugs  a plus   One warning though  the edge to the baths are very high and as a person on the short side I found them very hard to get in and out of  Something to think about if you happen to be disabled in anyway  Close to MRT and fantastic shopping mall across the road  Had a great stay   until we went to check out      We were told that our accomodation bill was outstanding despite being fully paid to the travel agent back in Feb  The admin staff at the time promised to get it sorted out and get back to us via email as soon as possible and that nothing would be charged to our credit card as the number had been  dumped  from the system  That was a lie  After two days waiting for some type of communication regarding the investigation of where our money went I checked my credit card statement  Low and behold they had charged us over  4000   It is several days later and still no response from the hotel even after sending them an email requesting some correspondence regarding the mix up  They had no authorisation to make this deduction and have so far still not answered my email seeking to resolve this problem  Luckily the travel agent we dealt with is helping and the bank is lodging a dispute against them  Why didn t they alert us to the problem as we checked in  In our 10 days in Singapore we could have had it sorted before we left  This has been extremely stressful for our family  We had a great time in Singapore but this has definitely soured our experience  Stay there again     Never again

I stayed at Park Royal  during end of March  Positives  the hotel rooms are neat clean  well maintained  next door is Mustafa  and all the indian restaurants   Komalas Anandha Bhavan  Hot Chips  as we are from south India  it was very helpful   and there is a mall bang opposite to the hotel  The room service restaurant staff are nice  and help you with any suggestion on shopping navigation around Singapore  Negatives of the hotel  the front desk reception personnel are too busy  we had to wait for about 2 hours to get a room  I was dozing off at one of the 2 small sofas available at the lobby  There are nearly no furniture at the lobby for you to sit  therefore  cant wait for your bus ptour pick up at the lobby  I dont know why the hotel couldn t think of better seating arrangement  The food  is not good  I d say not worth the money  They do not bother to clean the spill overs quickly  and it becomes a mess soon  as people walk by In total  it is a good hotel to stay at if you are going to eat outside  if you would write off the check in delay

We stayed for a week  After a long flight we arrived at 10 30 the front desk asked us to leave our bags and offered to use the pool area to freshup  after which they had the room ready The room decor is little old but it is at a very convenient location and has a great Pool  steam room and concierge

We stayed in the ParkRoyal back in mid January 2011  on our way back to Northern Ireland  it was our choice of stoppover  recommended by our travel agent  after a long flight from New Zealand        on arrival  first impressions were  wow  what a stunning hotel     and that opinion remained the same       when we were there  all the beautiful decorations were being put up for the New Year celebrations      simply incredible  a huge effort goes into this  no expense spared to have the hotel looking amazing for this celebratory time of year       a definate must see            The entrance porch and lobby  were imaculate  so many wonderfull floral displays of Orchids     have since bought these on arrival home too           we arrived late evening and the staff were so so helpful  polite and courteous        nothing was a problem      our family party consisted of 5  so we had 2 rooms  both very spacious  spotlessly clean  really lovely  As our next flight was late the This hotel had a record of our booking through Travelmood  but did not have a room available for us  We waited nearly 2 hours in a tiny lobby after an 11 hour flight with 3 children  The family room was clearly already booked and eventually we were given interconnecting rooms with a double bed in each  I still had to contact reception to get them to bring another bed for my youngest daughter After complaining to the duty manager  I was offered a late check out as compensation and then complimentary breakfasts for the 2 days we were there Generally the service was poor and the welfare of guests does not figure highly in this hotel Would not stay here again

We booked the Park Royal for our family stay in Singapore  We chose this hotel based on the recommendation of a friend W staed therer for 5 nights and overall we were satisfied with the hotel and it met our expectations and requirementsLocation   The Hotel is located bang in Little India and perhaps the only decent one there depends on our definition i suppose  It is surrounded by a host of India restaurants which open early and close late  So food was no problem for our kiddo who is rather finicky  Recommended especially for people with specific veg requirements  though we are not   Komala s restaurant is just a few metres away The metro station is just opposite the hotel  Mustafa is just behind if one wants to shop buy anything  Most cabs stop in front of the lobby and that is convenient too Check in process was quick and smooth  given that we had pre booked and paid in advance Room   We paid a very slight premium and got a room on the 18th floor  The advantage we found out later  is that there are2 separate lifts which service 18th and above floors which is a distinct advantage The room was comfortable  compact and clean  The view was good and not facing another building it was overlooking serangoon road and an open ground behind it Service   was prompt and polite  When we speid a nail that had come loose on the floor  it was immediately attended to  No other reason to ask for housekeeping Food   we never had to eat in the hotel  given the location  But the impression high level  of was leaning towards chinese cuisine  not the type served in India  and a bit expensive  We also booked a sentosa tour through the hotel  but it was just a generic tour which we were part of Never got a chance to check out any other faciities This hotel for Indians atleast is about good rooms  decent service and location  location  location

Good Hotel and in a good position very close to Little India some good bargains and nice Temples where you are very welcome  nice people also just around the corner is the underground where you are whisked away to the city center take  20 10 Dollar bills for the ticket machine then you will get change very easy to use  also the breakfast was excellent there is a swimming pool on one of the floors

We stayed a weekend at the Park Royal Kitchener and really enjoyed the experience  The check in staff were friendly and helpful  and the room was great  Perhaps they had upgraded us  but no one mentioned it The internet was fast  free and reliable The location was fun   in buzzing Little India with great Indian food nearby  Really close to the MRT which makes Singapore easy to explore The housekeeping was excellent  A charming Chinese lady who cleaned our room greeted us with a huge smile and friendly hello every time we met her in the corridor We had NO PROBLEM with crowded lifts or long waits at check in  Thank you everyone at the Park Royal Kitchener  We will be back Room Tip  Check out special offers on the hotels own webpage See more room tips

This was our 2nd stay at Park Royal   Kitchener Road and we booked  again  the family room which was convenient to accommodate us  We re a family of 5 with 1 teenager and 2 young children   but an extra bed will still be required The hotel is located in Little India area  and MRT Farrer Park is just accross the street  which is very very convenient to explore Singapore  City Square shopping mall is just next to the MRT station  it has a supermarket and a number of places to eat Room was clean and has the basic ammenities  Our request for extra bed  room service  etc  were entertained in a timely manner  Service in the front desk during check in and check out was reasonably fast  Staff at the concierge were very helpful in answering any queries you may have

Location of hotel is just opposite a shopping mall and MRT station  Lots of food choices available within walking distance too  Coffee house served pretty good buffets with lots of choices Only drawback is on Sunday where groups of people tend to hang out around the main road of the hotel  If you don t mind that  everything else is fine There are some nice chinese restaurants within walking distance

It was a wonderful stay at ParkRoyal hotel  the hotel is near to Indian shopping and eating outlets  you can enjoy very nice stay  Eating joints are large in number and one can go on a walk to visit near by Mustafa Mall Hotel is good with nice service staff  Breakfast is enjoyable too Stayed in July 2010  a little late to write review

Awesome location   if you are a die hard shopper or a vegetarian looking for Indian food  The rooms are pretty cool and functional  The bath tub is of slightly less height  One significant improvement that they have made is that the internet is now part of the room tariff Couple of irritating experiences   They charged me around 3 SGD against the mini bar  This was wrong  However  when I objected  they immediately corrected it  Similarly  while checking in they asked for room type preference  After I asked for single king size bed  they said they had only twin bed rooms  If a particular type of bed is not available why ask for options  However  they promised to change the room the next day and also followed it up through  I did not opt for the change though Overall great stay

I was there in 2009 during F1 weekend  It s near MRT station so going places is easy  If you like Indian food  there are many small Indian restaurants that will suit your appetite and budget  From the cheap to the more expensive  Right across the street there s a mall that has Sushi Tei  my favorite sushi place   For Singapore  the hotel is not too pricey  as everything else is in S pore  but it s always fun to visit as you have lots of things to do and places to see  I was alone but they mistakenly put me in a 2 beds room  but moved me the next day as soon as one available  so it was very nice of the staff  Just a tip  please allow enough time to check out as the line tends to be long and it s a bit time consuming  Just to make sure you have plenty of time to get to the airport or wherever your next destination may be

The Hotel and some of its staff are there without doubt to show what customer satisfaction is all about     one in particular Ms  Radha at the Orchid Club Floor  I found her level of providing service on par with the likes of the Ritz and others    so watch out Parkroyal she might get poached    Some of the fallbacks of the Hotel is the location of the Orchid Lounge if you are not lucky enough to be in the rooms that take you to the Orchid Club Clounge you have to change lifts The biggest challenge I feel that Management has to address immediately is that of the Housekeeping Department    it NEEDS WORK lots of it    could be that the person on the 14th floor did not have her bearings right     but a lot of shody housekeeping on her part   lack of floor cleaning  lack of cleaning in GENERAL   Coffee mugs should be cleaned on a daily basis but afraid that was not the case in our one bedroom suite   The Breakfast Buffet had a healthy spread but for people with special requirements or diets the F amp B department need to seperate the meets from the vegan dishes  For instance the Pork sausage was in the same area as hash browns and other foods that could have been consumed by vegans or indviduals with speacial diets    however due to the fact that the meats were placed in an open offering area it is very likely that the tongs used to pick up the meat dishes were being contaiminated with the veg dishes    as such for strict purity reasons this was not feasible for some The Flat screen offered in the room was a bit small I think around 30 quot  but was sufficient for viewing     had NO ISSUES whatsoever with the NET it worked well and gave great broadband speed    The pool is not temprature controlled but was clean  there is a small kids pool which does not light up in the evenings  the GYM had upto date equipmentOverall I would like to stay here again but Management need to take some indviduals on a customer service crash course

Spent 4 nights at this hotel  woudlnt hesitate to recommend this if you are indian or are wanting to eat lots of indian food  However it felt like we were in India and not in Singapore  The concierge at the hotel were fantastic  Very helpful and knowledgable always smiling saying hello and willing to help you  We arrived at around 5am and had prebooked the night before so we could settle in our room and have a few hours sleep before heading out for the day  Check in was a quick process and front desk staff very professional  Our room was a decent size  a tad bit out dated  but beds were comfortable and room was clean  We ordered roomservice  breakfast on the first morning  which was ok  but expensive  as usual lol  wouldnt really recommend room service  Had drinks at the hotel bar one night was very nice there  Some downsides about the area were unless you were willing to pay a lot for breakfast there werent really any other options  There were 7 11 around but they didnt really have cereal or yoghurt or fruit  there is a breadtalk accross the road in the shopping mall  but mainly that has sweet things  At the MRT there is a coffee bean and tea leaf  i think thats the name   and also a subway  We often ate there  Loved how close the hotel was to the MRT   There also arent any restuarants apart from Indian ones  you will have to go to clarke quay for more western style places  short ride away on the MRT If I came back I wouldnt stay at the hotel  basically due to the location not suiting my needs  If the hotel was in another area I wouldnt hesitate to go back  My recommendation for people stuck on where to stay in Singapore would be either along Orchard Road or Clarke Quay  Also as far as safety goes  I was travelling with my friend both of us are young girls and we felt safe  only time we didnt feel that safe was on Sunday night when there were hundreds of indian men EVERYWHERE    i didnt think it was possible to have soooo many people in one place at This hotel is well decorated  We had a 3 nights stay here  Support stuffs are helpful  Though some people have problem understanding   speaking English  still they are very welcoming and cooperating  I got early check in this hotel after landing Singapore by the early morning flight of Singapore Airlines  with my wife and kid Foods are too authentic Singapore food  Still you will love the taste and quantity is more than enough We took the deluxe room in 17th Floor  The room is mid sized  Clean and well maintained  Bathroom and wardrobe is also well maintained and clean  Room service  cleaning are in time  They are reliable Good and clean swimming pool Gym and Restaurant  The breakfast is a feast of foods ranging from south Indian to continental and Chinese and many more Cab booking facility from hotel is also good  Mustafa shopping plaza is almost behind the hotel  Location of this hotel is fantastic  if you have your family particularly with kid Room Tip  After chineese holday  the room are not in so much demand hence you could get upgrade offer if you a   See more room tips

Located in Little India  A must to walk down the Serangoon Road and checkout the colours and aroma  those with sensitive nose might need to take caution   Conveniently next to the Mustafa Centre where you can shop 24 hour  More shopping with the City Square Mall  which is also right next to the hotel  Jump in a cab and ask for Bugis Village  Here  the sells practically everything  A nice place to shop  less crowd compare to Orchard Road The nearest MRT station is less than 500m away  Booked a Deluxe room for 190SGD  with breakfast   The room were equipped with internet access  Appreciate the complimentary fruit  chocolate and drinking water

I apologise for the late review but heh  better late than never   Park Hotel on Kitchener Road is a solid choice  Hotel has been renovated and rooms are good  Only thing I noticed that could be improved was the lack of sitting space in the lobby  Pool area was pretty much empty so we had the place to oursleves everytime we went  There are rooms to change into which was very convinient  What makes this hotel so worth the money is the location  It can t be beat  I ate breakfast the first day and it was very adequate  The usual egg stations where you can get eggs any way you liked  good choice of breads  cereal  juices  several hot dishes  However  i noiced after several outings that the immediate neigbnorhoold was dotted with little eateries and cafe shops  As a result  I started skipping breakfast and instead frequented these local eating spots  You always know its a good thing when the locals are filling up the place  One place comes to mind is the small kopitiam on the right side of the hotel on the main street which eventually leads to Mustafa  the 24 hour department store  I ate breakfast and lunch there for like 5 7 SIN dollars and it was great  Great Keema and naan fresh off the tandoor  There is a new chic mall right across the street  Those of you who want to stick to the traditional Western fare  are going to love the choice of all the fast food joints  But if you feel a little more bold then there is a great food court serving local cuisines   I can t remeber the exact floor but its the top most   just go up the escalators till you are hit by all that fantastic aroma  And if you need to get on the MRT than Ferrer Park station is on your left just past a big Vegetarian Chain restaurant  Very close

I stayed in this hotel for three nights from 29th sep to 1st oct checking out on 2 nd oct   and since my flight was at 4 pm I requested for a half hour late check out  instead of 12 noon 1230 noon and I was refused saying that they are fully booked  Their check in time is 2 pm and I am sure that they could have accommodated half hour   I asked the reception lady what will happen if I check out thirty min late and she said that they will charge one more night fee  Highly recommended to stay away from this hotel  I will never stay here againRoom Tip  Totally unfriendly staff   You stay at your own riskSee more room tips

Stayed here during the Singapore Grand Prix  so no discounts  but we did get a free buffet breakfast  Staff are very friendly and very helpful  Housekeeping staff do a good job cleaning the room  Breakfast was included and was great  lots of variety  Hotel lobby is updated  however  the rooms are looking a bit tired  Rooms are clean  For a couple of days the free wifi dropped out in our room  but worked in the hallway  Internet download speeds were very good  Airconditioning was very effective  but thermostat didn t work  so the room got very cold  Easy to switch the A C off  Location is amazing  very short walk   lt 5mins  to Farrer Park MRT  across the road from a good shopping centre and 5 mins from Mustafa s 24 Hr shops  Lots of food locations around  from restaurants to Hawker stalls  The gym is extremely well equipped with lots of cardio gear  Although this hotel is looking a bit tired  it is in a great location and good for families We had a family room  which consisted of 2 rooms  1 with King bed and other room with 2 singles   TV in each room with 1 bathroom off the king bedroom

We have just returned from a 1 night stay  thankfully  at this hotel  We arrived around midnight and to be honest were not expecting much as the hotel wasn t as pricey as some of the others considering it was Grand Prix weekend  We realised that a twin single room had been booked in error and the staff did try to change it but were not able to  We were shown to the 8th floor and when we got to the room I was horrified with what I saw as I still did not expect it to be quite so run down  The furnishings  carpet etc looked like they had not been touched since the 70s  The linen was stained and although the bathroom had been done up it was obvioulsy done on an extreme budget as it was a substandard job  Our best surprise was still to come   I was so exhausted I thought just close you eyes forget the decor and go to sleep  The bed was the worst I have ever had the experience in sleeping on  or rather not sleeping on   it was like sleeping on a concrete slab  I ended up trying to tuck the duvet under me to at least try to soften it a little  I am apalled that a hotel would let rooms out in this state Room Tip  Don  39 t get a twin single on the 8th floorSee more room tips
