Hotel looks great as you pull up outside and enter the lobby  But once we got into our room everything looked dated  furniture  decor and beds  Room wise it does the absolute bare minimum to provide 3 4 star facilities  The location is good  very close to Farrar Park MRT and lots of good value food options in the vicinity  Personally wouldn t stay here again unless they revamped the rooms

The place is really nice  but April June July is not a great time to be there cos its filled with Indian families with a lotttt of children and makes the entire place extremely noisy   Great breakfast spread    5 mins walk to the MRT  2mins walk to Mustafa Shopping centre  24 hrs  and a whole lot of other Indian food joints   Check in Check out takes a bit of a time and the hotel needs to have more elevators  cos the waiting time for an elevator can go as high as upto 20 mins during their peak season   Room Tip  If you need a smoking room  pls make sure you very clearly mention it at the time of booking    We a   See more room tips

Booked a double room  on arrival was informed that they did not have one but we could change rooms in the morning when one became available  Spent terrible night in room with some loud machine emmitting a loud pitch sound all night   hair dryer and various other bits and bobs did not work  In the morning male staff member extremely rude and stated that moving rooms was not an option as the hotel can never guarantee that you get what you book for       For 3 days I begged to be moved to no avail  On checking out after another conversation with the manager I was given a complimentary lunch in lieu of double room  room with things the worked  room without noise  That was a disaster   first time after 25 years of annual vists to Singapore I got really bad food poisoning  NEVER AGAIN

It was a nice hotel  with good staff and service  However I was not happy with the way front desk worked  No smiling people there and always busy and making people wait  Rest was best  Restaurants and food was great  In the heart of city so connectivity was also not a problem  Will stay in park royal if given a chance again

Park ROYAL is located in little India  In fact the so called Mustafa shopping center is right next door to the hotel  It is also very close to the metro   Farrer Park station  You can take this line to go to Changi airport or Vivo city mall  from where you can go to Sentosa island   I stayed in the hotel for 5 nights front desk staff is nice  I wanted a single queen size bed and it was not available on the first day  They took my request to transfer me the next day to the room with queen size bed  which they did  Room was of decent size  not too small and not too large  Somehow I did not like the bathrooms and interiors  It was not upto the 4 star rating  If you sign up for their membership program  you get two complimentary bottles of water per day  You can ask for it while checking in  There is TV will many channels  a kettle with sachets to make coffe  tea  if you want to browse internet  it is available at a small charge Breakfast is available in the ground floor and it is really really really big spread  You can get anything from south indian Idli  vada  dosa to sausages  baked beans  hash browns  noodles  dumplings etc    Breakfast was my biggest meal when i stayed at this hotel  If you want to try any other Indian restaurants then every thing is at stones throw  there is Komalas  saravan bhavan  sangeethas  etc   There concierge service to hail the taxis etc   There is a travel desk  if you are interested in organizing a tour of singapore  You can use their laundromat for about  14  In fact the washing machine is so big that I could fit in my weeks cloth with one load You can use swimming pool and gym  Swimming pool is also decent size  If you are interested in message and reflexology  the services are available at a cost  They also organised to keep the luggage and send it directly to Airport since we were checking out and going Star Cruise for 2 nights before flying back to India  Therefore  we did not have the headache of carrying the bulky suitcases on the cruise  Off course this service comes at a cost Finally  my recommendation is that if you like to stay closer to little India and do shopping leisurely at Mustafa this is the place  But as you know  since little India is not so happening place and is bit crowded  if you like to stay in posh area get yourself booked in better hotel at Clark quay area Room Tip  Ask for a pool facing room and if you are family book for room with queen size bed See more room tips

We stayed at this hotel for 3 nights  The room was spacious and clean with decent size bathroom  The swimming pool was great too for those hot  humid days  The fitness centre was well equiped with nice stations with guide on how to use each machine  The shower in the changing room has rainfall showerhead which I really like  The location is great  right across the street from the mall and the metro station  It is in Little India and apparently every Saturday and Sunday night  tons of male Indian workers like to hang out by the Mustafa Centre  It is safe but I was surprised by the sheer amount of men just hanging out there  At first I thought there was a concert or some sort of demonstation going on but my local friend told me there is nothing to worry about One critique I have is the small elevator  Otherwise  everything was great

Upgraded to this from a very seedy hotel a block away and were delighted with the improvement  Located in the bustling Little India area  opposite the City Square Mall  the Park Royal is an oasis of calm in a mad  jostling part of town  Cool  spacious lobby  helpful staff  nice clean rooms and a lovely pool  The room rates were not cheap  but it was worth the extra money for a clean  modern room with all mod cons  The aircon was a real necessity in a steaming city like Singapore and in fact it was so good I had to put on an extra layer one night Would definitely recommend  but worth chasing down a deal on the price

This was our first trip to Singapore  We found the hotel to be quite spacious and comfortable  The room fit out was a bit tired to be honest but it was spacious and the linen was good  The pool is really nice  the staff were always friendly and helpful  It s well located  Suggest you book directly through the hotel for a much better room rate

This was a good experience for our family as the rooms were spacious and divided into two sleeping areas  two adults and two teenage boys  This hotel was superbly located close to the MRT and Mustafa Centre  The breakfast was a good start to the day and had everything we needed  We appreciated the colourful diversity of Little India and enjoyed the vibrant nature of the Hotel as a choice destination for Indian Travellers  even though we are not Indian  The rooms were a quiet haven at the end of each day of exploration and the pool was a lovely place to unwind and cool down  The staff were efficient and helpful and at all times provided us with a welcoming atmosphere  We recommend this hotel to fellow Australian travellers

We stayed at the Parkroyal on Kitchener for 6 nights at the Orchid Club room  We were on vacation with a 3 year old  The hotel is conveniently located and has easy access to the MRT  2 mins walk to the ferrer park station   Right behind the hotel are a variety of Indian eateries  Anand Bhavan  Saravana Bhavan and a number of other indian restaurants  all withing 2 4 mins of walking distance  Shoppers will have a field day with Mustafa center  the 24 hour center is right behind the hotel The hotel was clean and comfortable  the staff were above average  The buffet breakfast had a lot of variety  Vegetarians have options as they make good Pratas  similar to the Kerala Parota  but smaller and much nicer  and Stew and some south Indian breakfast items apart from the continental breakfast options  fruit  juices  cereal etc I must say that the Orchid club was convenient with Coffee  Tea  juices and cookies available through the day  It also includes hot snacks and alcoholic beverages from 6 in the evening for a couple of hours Room Tip  Go for an Orchid Club room  which comes with complementary breakfast and high speed internet access See more room tips

This was the only hotel we could find in Singapore to accommodate a family of four  There are two separate sleeping areas in the family rooms  so plenty big enough for a short stay  The MRT across the road is very close and gives easy  wonderful access to all parts of the city  The rooms are in need of a coat of paint but other than that  clean and tidy  Worst part was the buffet breakfast in the downstairs lobby   very little Western food and of pretty poor quality  Being in Little India  the majority of hotel occupants were Indian  so the food was pretty much catered to their needs and not westerners  Our booking through Qantas included a 20  voucher off a la carte food purchased  however they would not accept this for breakfast  We would not have paid full price for the dreadful food if we had known this  Go across the road to the shopping mall for breakfast and you will find better quality and cheaper food

We stayed at the Parkroyal on Kitchener as part of an SIA stopover  It is at the top edge of Little India  in the thick of it really  and most of the customers seem to be Indian package tours and some Australians  If you like Little India it is the place to stay  but if you want Orchard Road shopping it rather too far away   As the guide books recommend  you need to use taxis to get around if you are on a short stay  so this need not matter much   Little India is a strongly mono ethnic zone  with mainly men visible  and is not very tourist friendly for visitors with different background  The hotel is showing its age a bit  but is comfortable enough  Like many such hotels it is hard to get double rooms  as opposed to twins with a fixed console between the beds  The beds were soft enough and the airconditioning unobtrusive  Wifi was free and available without password or registration  which is a big plus  given the number of hotels that see this as an opportunity to charge extra  There was a lot of fussing over bags which may be fine if you have a lot and need help  but if you are an independent minded traveller travelling you would rather take them to your rooms themselves  and not have to wait for your post 12 hour flight shower  Breakfast at Sing 24 for continental breakfast and  28 for a full one is bad value in our book  so we did not try it  Staff were fine  The lounge had a good singer and accompanist in the evening as we were waiting for our transfer  which made it well worth the price of the drink

I stayed at Parkroyal at Kitchener Road for my honeymoon in Singapore  The hotel s is quite good with very co operative staff  One staff member on getting to know that we were Indians guided us that there were Indian restaurants behind the hotel  Mustafa Center and City Square malls at just at a stone s throw from the hotel  Rooms were nice and cosy and room service was prompt  But the view from the room wasn t a pleasant one  Although the hotel s a little far from the Changi airport  the location is quite central  Orchard road  Little India  SMU  temples  etc  are easily reachable  Farrer Park MRT is just across the road  The staff speak English with a prominent Chinese accent  which becomes a little difficult to comprehend at times    but were warm  I had breakfast at the restaurant  and was decent Room Tip  Ask for a room with a better view See more room tips

Park Royal is a nice hotel located near Farrer Park MRT Station  It is also very near to Mustafa Center and City Square Mall  I stayed in November and faced only a few problems  Firstly  the Chinese guy in the frontdesk was dumb  He spoke poor English and had bad communication skills  I later came after 4 hours and spoke with another Front desk guy who was Indian and very helpful  Secondly  the mattress was not comfortable at all  Thirdly  the TV channels in the hotel were bogus  Instead of showing good news channels like Al Jazeera  C N N   good movie and entertainment channels they showed the hopeless and boring ones The swimming pool in the hotel was good  Mostly I liked the location of this 4 star hotel  It is close to Farrer Park MRT Station and also near Mustafa and City Square mall  Actually Farrer park MRT is located under the City Square Mall  There are lots of places to eat withing the walking distance of the Hotel   The Hotel was crowded with tourists

We stayed here with our friends and family  Very nice property  centrally located  The Farrer park MRT access is across the road  we arrived around 9 am and they allowed us to check in early which is excellent service  The rooms are clean and quiet  This is more than adequate for the tourists or business people alike who are out the entire day The travel desk is well informed and helpful  We wanted to explore on our own and they guided us well knowing fully well that we may not book the tours etc through them  Good professional approach Proximity to eating joints  city mall  across the road  and Mustafa on the other side is an added advantage  Little India is walking distance which has many vegetarian joints We wanted but couldn t manage to try the hotel restaurants  Will keep that for the next visit Free Wi Fi was available throughout the hotel though the connectivity speed was not that great  but useable We found the place good and value for money Room Tip  Higher floor room gives better view See more room tips

I only stayed here because the places I would have preferred to have stayed at were sold out over the F1 Grand Prix  so no  of course it is not as good as the Fullerton or the Marina Bay Sands  but at these prices  neither should it be expected to be I could complain about the rooms are looking a bit tired  or the no mans land location  but this Park Royal is perfect example of  quot you get what you pay for quot    and as this is a mid price property  that is exactly what you get  a mid level hotel The bathrooms have been refurbished recently and look pretty good for a 3  4  hotel in this bracket  The pool and fitness centre were pretty good  the public areas smart and the service was OK   and that is all the hotel claims to offer  So there is nothing to complain about All the negative reviews I see here would be justified if you were paying US 400 a night  but you are not even paying US 100  If you want 5  then this is not the place for you  but if you are after a comfortable  safe and well equipped 3 4  property then you could do a lot worse

We stayed here for a 3 night stopover in Singapore  It was great  We arrived at 8am and had emailed in advance   they allowed us to check in early which was brilliant service  The staff were superb throughout The hotel isn t 5 star luxury but that is reflected in the price  It offers exactly what you need for a city break  We were on the 19th floor and the room was really spacious  good views of Singapore  The breakfast was excellent  So much choice  Location on the edge of Little India was great  and near MRT stop  but taxis are cheap in Singapore so it is easy to get around

PARK Royal on Kitchener road is one of the most amazing properties in Singapore for travellers who need luxury as well as comfort and privacy at an amazing prices also if you book your room well in advance  you get an amazing discounts as well on parkroyal website  best for Indians who want to live in a nearby or where community persists  very near to little india  Mustafa market and even convenient with local transportation Room Tip  choose an Executive Suite if you need a water bed   and an amazing viewSee more room tips

I stayed here for a week and found it very comfortable  The room was spacious enough  very clean and well maintained  The staff was very courteous and helpful The hotel is just perfectly located   Mustafa is right at the back  Little India and many Indian restaurants in the vicinity  walking distance  and MRT station also just 3 4 minutes walk away There is a mall right opposite to the hotel so all shopaholics can spend time there Hotel offers a nice buffet breakfast with many choices  Overall  a very good stay and I would recommend this to others

I travelled with my wife for her 6 days clinical attachment and masters exam to Singapore  As we have 18month old infant  and i had to be baby sitting I choose the hotel after lots of search considering tariff location etc  The Hotel is very well located by all means  It took us S 15 to reach the airport on sunday and 25 to reach the hotel on a busy Monday morning  It is 2 min walk to farrer park MRT station  It is right next to Mustafa shopping center and many Indian eating places It is in a great location for Indians travelling as food is always a big concern for them  Going to Orchard  Bus no 65  and going to Marina Bus no 857  Clarke Quay is 2 stops by MRT So it is great location for those who want too party till late and also for those who like it laid back Check in and check out was very nice  The reception staff was very courteous  They let us check in early The concierge was prompt and very helpful  i could leave the luggage with them at check in and check out The rooms are spacious  neat and clean  All rooms have a small fridge  coffee maker and cable TV   The bathrooms are spacious and have bath tubs  he toileteries suppiled are good  My room had an ironing board and an iron The hotel has very nice restaurant serving great sea food Spice   The hotel has a nice Swimming pool and Gym  There is kids pool and my son enjoyed it to fullest  The steam room is decent but does not have eucalyptus spray for aroma  Cabs are available all the times In short a very very value for money hotel for business trip  family vacation or young couples Room Tip  Hogher floor with Bettter view See more room tips

We had a 5 night stay in Hotel Parkroyal on Kitchener Road in Singapore  We were on a family sightseeing trip to Singapore  The one and only unpleasant thing that we faced in this hotel was on the very first day when we checked in  We had a confirmed reservation and we reached hotel by 11 AM after a long journey from Mumbai via Kualalumpur  We were very tired and sleepy  The reception staff told that we had to wait a couple of hours as the room was not ready  It was so painful for us as our 4 year old child desperately wanted to sleep  At one moment we felt regret booking at this hotel  Finally we got the room key at about 2 PM  Our all uncomfortable feeling vanished when we entered the room  The superior room we booked was very spacious with king size bed and a large drawing area to move around  Room was extremely clean and the toilets 100  hygenic  The staff were very courteous and guiding  Hotel serves buffet breakfast in which a lot of indian vegetarian dishes were available  The negative point was that everyday the items were same  But the dishes were tasty and hygenic  One of the most important plus points of this hotel is its proximity to Little India  Since we are south Indian vegetarians  the location proved good for us due to its closeness to some of the most famous south indian veg restaurants in Singapore such as Komala Vilas  Ananda Bhawan etc  Just behind the hotel is Singapore s famous super market Mustafa Centre where you will get each and everything  In totality the stay in Park Royal was very pleasant and comfortable which is still being cherished by us Room Tip  No idea  Superior Room we selected was pretty good and the view was facing Little IndiaSee more room tips

First thing which comes to mind is   Nice  clean  amp  awesome location  It is a good hotel situated in the heart of little india  Rooms are quite decent  neat  amp  clean with bath tubs     Checking in could take quite some time as lot of people book this hotel  I got a shock when during check in they asked for 600 SGD for two rooms as deposit  refundable    I had comeonly for 4 days  amp  all my tours were prepaid  so i was carrying only 800 SGD  But they agreed to take only 200 SGD after some talking  Buffet breakfast on this hotel is quite goood but personally i did not like the indian food they served in the breakfast  Things like vada  sambhar  idli did not taste that good but i guess i was not in india  D   Hotel being in little india has lot of eating options near by  esp  for vegetarians lot of options are there like sarvana bhawan  sagar ratna etc etc   lot of indian joints giving indian food at reasonable rates  But personally i did not like the food at sagar ratna     I would recommend sarvana bhawan as food was really good  amp  tasty  Travelling is also not a problem as the nearest MRT Farrer station is quite nearby  actually just opp the hotel  Avoid taking taxi s as these will cost you a lot  amp  travelling is easier  amp  cheap with MRT Overall it was a nice place to stay  comfortable  amp  good location but opt for a room other than the base   standard one  Room Tip  Get your own water bottles  refreshments as they cost a bomb in the hotel    See more room tips

The hotel location is very near to the most happening place for tourists in singapore for shopping Mustafa 24 hours shopping center  Musthafa center is in the backside of the hotel and people actually see the tourist spots in the day and do shopping in the night staying in Park royal  The morning buffet is the best buffet food i have tasted abroad  lots of indian cuisine foods  and plenty of continental varieties only regret was the restaurant is too crowded in the morning hours and seat availability is sometimes a problem  Also the tables and floors were not clean because of too much rush in the morning hours  the hotel ground floor had some shopping and travel agent which was helpful in my further travel to indonesia Room Tip  Choose rooms as high as possible to get good view of the citySee more room tips

My husband and I stayed for four nights  Since we were on a flight that arrived after midnight  I emailed the hotel a week in advance to let them know of our late arrival and to request a non smoking room with a king bed  I received a response that my requests would be honored When we arrived they only had a room with 2 twin beds  I informed them that I had requested a king bed room in advance and that I had received a response from the hotel that they were aware of the request  but it fell on deaf ears   The people checking in next to us were given a king bed room   The check in person informed us that we would have to take the twin room and then he could move us to a king bed room for the other three days of our stay  Our first room was adequate but tattered with scuffs on the walls  scratched furniture  an old fashioned TV  and well worn carpet  The room needed a serious renovation  The next day we called the front desk after 12 00 to request our king bed room  She said she d call us back  After 20 minutes we called back and again she said she d call us back  We waited another ten minutes and were told that we could leave our bags in our room and they would assign us a king bed room when one became available  We went out for a while and when we returned we were given the keys to our new room and they had transferred our bags to that room The new room on the 6th floor was much more modern with a flat screen TV  a bit newer furniture   however  the table had a chunk missing   and comfortable bed  We didn t have much of a view  but the room itself was more important to us  The rooms have a mini fridge with room for guests to add their own snacks and drinks   7 11 located right downstairs in the same building  and a kettle to heat water with tea furnished each day  The free internet worked well in our room  On the 6th floor we noticed that there was a decent gym and also a guest laundry room As so many other reviewers have noted  the hotel is in an excellent location  Mustafa Center is a must see  City Square Mall is right across the street with lots of shops and eating places  The MRT station is also right across the street  Bottom line  we really liked the location  The hotel was a bit iffy  If we had to return to our first room  even with a king bed  we would not return  However  we were very comfortable in the second room  Would we stay at this hotel again  I hesitate to say yes unless they overhauled the shabby rooms  But the location was outstanding  With a few tweaks  I think this hotel could be great

I visited Singapore sometime back  There I stayed at the Park Royal  It s a good budget hotel located right in front of the little India and the Mustafa Mall  Rooms were clean and spacious  Breakfast buffet was also good with decent spread  However  the staff was not very co operative  Our flight was scheduled to land after mid night and therefore requested my travel agent for an early check in  He told me that he had done so and the Hotel has agreed for the same  We reached hotel at around 5 30 in the morning and requested for early check in  but got our room by 11 only  I asked my travel agent to contact the hotel but he told me that they don t have rooms and will be available only after normal check in time  So just advice others to confirm there room etc   beforehand Apart from this I did not face any other major problem and had enjoyed my stay there

First of all the hotel is overpriced  but I conclude that all hotels in Singapore are pricey  The hotel is located near Mustafa Center which is very vibrant part of town  It is also situated near a MRT to station  5 minutes walk   Check in is fair  however  we paid almost  200 US for a room that was pretty small  Mind you  we spent lots of time on various sites trying to get the lowest price  There is no direction arrow for the kiblat in the room  Luckily  there is a masjid in walking distance which is a big plus in my book  There are many tasty halal restaurants near by  Wifi was free  which I enjoy  but the breakfast was not included  We had an early morning fairy to catch  so the MRT station was only about 5 stops to the Harbourfront  I was turned off that they did not have a water hose next to the toilet which is common in most Asian hotels  Orchard street was about 20 minutes away by MRT  The money changers were open 24 hours in the vicinity and gave good rates  I would not recommend a long term stay here  It served its purpose for a one night stay  To recap  overpriced for a small room  but good location I suggest  if you are sightseeing in Singapore  stay in Johor Bahru and get a bigger and better room for your money and just cross over for the day on public transportation  significant savings  That is what I usually do  but due to an early fairy departure I had to stay here

Great location  but clearly the staff culture is not to go the extra mile with guests  As other reviewers have mentioned the location is good  opposite a new small shopping mall and a MRT station  Head the other way and you can experience Little India and lots of great smells and little shops and restaurants However the hotel is way off the mark in terms of it s brand  We stayed in Parkroyal Malaysia prior to this stay and we were extremely let down  We opted for Orchid Club level  and this was a waste of time  We were put in a room that looked like the decor hadn t been upgraded since the 80 s  Shower over a high bathtub anyone  Bathroom that was tinier than those you see in European cities  The mattress on the bed was like wood   I love hard mattresses but this was ridiculous  The Orchid Club lounge was like a small function room  again with peeling carpet and dated furniture  The food selection was average and the staff really couldn t be bothered with us  Clearly management hasn t empowered the staff to go the extra mile or use their initiative  In the four days we were there we never saw any staff member at the gym and a number of pieces of equipment weren t working  but we had no one to tell  We were supposed to get a paper  and we got one on one out of the four days we were there  No big things on their own  but they all added up to a lack of interest in guest wellbeing  For a 5 star brand this is unacceptable  they are certainly more of 3 star level  As part of the Parkroyal brand  the level of furnishings and staff helpfulness is at odds with other hotels we have stayed in from the same chain  You chose a chain based on the expectation that the management have built a similar culture in each property which will pass through to the staff and in turn they way they treat the guest  Not sure if I will chose Parkroyal again based on this experience  To their credit the manager contacted me immediately after I completed their survey  however that is the only follow up I ve received i e  the usual standard we are sorry for your experience speil  When will we start to see real results i e  if you pay for a product and the product doesn t do what it s supposed to  like a computer or similar  then you get a refund  Hotels get to keep the revenue you provide them  even if they don t provide you with the type of service they market themselves to deliver Anyway Singapore is a great place to spend a few days  lots to do   the Flyer is fun  and the Zoo is amazing  The little restaurants around Little India are a wonderful surprise

Stayed here for 4 nights while on a business trip  First the positives   Large and clean hotel   Excellent gym and equipment  Steam bath is good too  5 minute stroll to Farrer Park MRT station  Close proximity to Little India  which is a pro and con in itself   Very convenient 7 Eleven store just down stairs  24 hour Money Changer nearby  Free WiFi   Well appointed rooms with amenities  stocked bar fridge  working desk  in room safe  iron  amp  board Now come the areas where they can definitely improve on   Breakfast was less than inspiring  Definitely not worth the extra S 20  While the spread is not too bad  the food just lacked flavour and oomph  Was quite disappointed   On some nights  there are express tour busses waiting for passengers in the area which meant plenty of people walking around the sides of the hotel  Was extremely crowded during that time   I had a room right at the edge  Deluxe   on the 18th floor and the WiFi signal was kinda weak   Checkout staff was robotic  A smile and friendly remark would go a long way in the hospitality industry   One evening  i walk down to the gym area in search of the steam bath  I went down wearing the hotel provided in room slippers  those white cotton ones   Just at the door of the gym  I asked a staff member where the steam bath was  She just motioned at my slippers and said  quot Not allow quot   Not an acceptable response  even if I was going to the gym in those slippers  which I was not I would stay here again  but would try to negotiate for a room only rate without breakfast

If you don t want to pay too much during the peak season but want to hold on to your standards  you might chose this hotel  Let me start by saying that I spent 4 nights in this hotel and christmas  The good thing about this hotel is the location  Apart from Mustafa being on the rear side  2 mins walk   the place is centrally located and also well connected by bus  tube and taxis  Most of the hot spots would be 5 10 mins by Taxi and so you shell out less I arrived at the hotel at 8 am while the hotel had its standard checkin time at 2 pm  Despite being a GHA member and requesting an early checkin 3 months prior to arrival  I had to go through the usual dance and fish of the reception staff to get 1 room  By the way I took my family so had 2 rooms booked  It was certainly not a welcome gesture that I had  The reception staff kept fooling me by asking more and more time in units of an hour every hour till 2 pm when they finally gave the 2nd room  I had booked a tour to Sentosa from the same hotel and that departed at 2 pm and hence requested that I need to freshen up before going out  No rationale or logic seemed to dawn on the reception staff  Besides there are a few guys on were nothing great  Old furnitures  old carpet  old 1980 type television set  no phone in the bathroom and avoid looking at the curtains carefully   for you might see blood stains and other dirty stuff  Walls were more or less clean for my room  Bathroom was redone and hence wasn t that bad  Lighting was appropriate but quality of toileteries was sub standard Breakfast was good  They have a Overall Singapore is a good place to visit especially your kids would love them  If you can spend a little more than Park Royal  you can choose from Pan Pacific or some other hotels on the Orchard road may be preferrable but season time things could be very different   Room Tip  Ask for higher floors See more room tips

We stayed at this hotel from 29th December to 2nd January and is the 2nd time that we ve stayed here  We took advantage of their festive deal and got a superior King room with free sparkling wine  breakfast and complimentary biscuits  The room itself was large and airy with plenty of storage areas  This hotel is located in the Little India area of Singapore  It s right next door to the Mustafa Centre  which is a 24 hour shopping centre  The area itself can get a big crowded  especially on Sundays as this is when the migrant workers get their day off  Being 6ft tall and blonde  I certainly got a few stares whilst walking around Little India  after a while it didnt bother me as I did stick out like a sore thumb   There is an MRT station across from the hotel and this allows easy access to the major tourist areas of Singapore  ie Orchard Road  Clarke Quay  Marina Bay  It s a very cheap and quick way of travelling round Singapore and you get a 1 dollar refund when you hand back your ticket  which only costs around 2 dollars    During our stay we visited Marina Bay and the huge hotel with the skypark running across the top which looks like a big boat  I would recommend that you visit the skypark  it costs 20 dollars and is well worth it  the views are extraordinary  you get a 360 degree view of Singapore  beware though  if you have a drink in the bar here  they charged us 36 dollars for 2 small bottles of tiger beer  this is about ? 18  It was worth it for the view alone   Talking of alcohol  Singapore can be very expensive if you want to go out for a drink  especially the more upmarket areas such as Clarke Quay and Orchard Road  Right next door to the hotel is a food court area  which has seating outside and this is where the locals drink  You can get a large bottle of Tiger beer for under 6 dollars  which is around ? 3  we drank here all the time and on talking terms with the staff  Across from the hotel is a shopping mall which has a fantastic food court  I had the most amazing bento box with terriyaki chicken  miso soup  jasmine rice  salad and tempura prawns for 5 dollars    I ve eaten the same thing in Glasgow and paid over ? 10 for it  It was amazing  There are also some fantastic Indian restaurants in this area which are great value for money  When I return to Singapore in the future  I ll definately stay in this hotel again

Have stayed two weeks in a Orchid Club room at Parkroyal at Kitchener Road  and is leaving with mixed feelings  The hotel itself is excellent with a fresh and modern feeling  Staying in a Orchid Club room was a good experience  nice furnishing  large flat screen TV  good work area with good office chair and complementary broadband access  The club room also includes a decent breakfast and a evening lounge with drinks and snacks finger food  There is also an express elevator to the club floors which is very convenient As I checked in coming from a very early flight I had requested an early check in  Upon arrrival  check in was fast and easy on the special club reception on the 19h floor  but there were only twin bed rooms available  However  it was claimed to be a small thing to switch to a king size bed later in the day  Fair enough  I had a few hours sleep before going to the office  When returning in the evening and requesting a new room  much confusion ensued  After a long search it was claimed that there were none no smoking king size beds available until the day after and hey would hold one for me  Fair enough  The following evening after work I tried again  This time there were a room but it was not cleaned  The reception was to call my room when the room was ready for the change  Apparently it never became ready as noone called and I fell asleep  Then gave up  However a few days later my room key did not work  When going to the reception I was notified that my new king size bed room now was available  The surroundings of the hotel is fine if you like Indian food as this is what most of the local restaurants cater for  Non Indian food is a bit more hard to get but possible with a little exploring and walking  And the subway station is very near the hotel  Taxis were no problem to get in the morning The hotel has a few restaurants  I only tried the Spice Basserie on the reception floor  That restaurant has a number of different styles as well as an international buffet  Food was quite ok  but service was very poor  A tip is not to sit in any far away corner in the big dining room as you likely never will get any attention no matter how hard trying  Being Singapore  hotel restaurants is a destination only for the tired or the stressed  There is excellent street food available almost everywhere for a fraction of the price of a hotel buffet Then on to the final and strangest experience of the stay  One day I forgot to turn off the do not disturb sign when going out in the morning  When coming back I turned it off and went out to dinner  When back in the room I switched it on again and went to bed  Then I hear a knock on the door  a key in the lock and 2 hotel employees comes barging in  After the initial confusion they backed out saying that they wanted to check that everything was ok  In my opinion  for a hotel employee to enter a room with a do not disturb sign is a big no no and the last resort to take when noone answers the phone and repeated knocks fail to get a response Would I stay here again  I dont think so  It is a good hotel  but so are most hotels in Singapore

ready  I m not complaining as this is still earlier that the published standard checkin time  but it would have been nice to have a consistent time estimate  Our room   a family suite with two actual bedrooms   was very spacious and comfortable  Bottled water was supplied   as well as Wifi internet   at no extra charge  No complaints there  The hotel is right at the edge of  quot Little India quot  part of Singapore so perfectly situated to go explore that part of town which gets VERY busy in the evenings  We did not eat at the hotel once since there were so many other local food stops to enjoy   Indian and Singaporean  and Western in the more clinical atmosphere of the shopping arcade opposite the hotel  Location wise  you can use taxis or the underground mass rapid transport system near the hotel to take you to all the key attractions  or can you walk down the main streets to places like Raffles and even further on to China Town if you have the legs for it  A tip   if you flew in with Singapore Airlines you get a great discount on the Singapore Airlines hop on hop off sight seeing bus  There s also an amphibian vehicle tour   we used all of the above and they were all good  If I were going this trip again  now that I know Singapore a little better  I would look more closely at the hotels nearer to Raffles of the Singapore Flyer   however I may not wish to pay their prices    All in all I was very happy with this stop over stay

Stayed for a night on 1st November as had a night stop over  This hotel is in an excellent location close proximity to Ferrar Park MRT from where you can go anywhere in Singapore  Adjacent to Mustafa 24 hour shopping Mall and also innumerable Indian restaurants where you can choose from South Indian  North Indian  Mugulai to chettinad  As for the hotel is a bit dated and is not value for money  Had made the booking thru Booking com and when I arrived at the hotel they struggled to find my booking even though I had it telephonically confirmed both with the Booking com as well as the hotel booking supervisor Otherwise a very good location and taxis available 24 hrs  I saw some guests pushing their shopping carts upto their rooms from Mustafa shopping Mall

Hi I stayed here for a week in october 2012  my room ws on the 16th floor and was clean  comfortable  Check in was efficient as was check out I did find the food in the restaurnant was quite expensive and given the array of local food shops outside the hotel i would recommend these over the main restaurant in the hotel  On a negative point I found this hotel was little outside the main action in Singapore  We did use the subway system quite a bit but staying in Clark Quay would have been better Room Tip  Get an upgrade to the higher floorsSee more room tips

We had never been to Singapore before and found it very difficult to find hotels online that also had room for a couple of kids to sleep  I came across Parkroyal on Kitchener and was pleased to see that they had a family room available  Even though it cost us a fortune  over  400 a night not counting breakfast or taxes   the room was huge and a lot larger and nicer than it looked on the website  Service at the hotel was consistently outstanding   all the staff that we dealt with had excellent customer service skills The pool was fantastic and the area surrounding it was kept meticulously clean  Our only gripe was with the snooty english couple reading by the pool who requested that our 2 kids refrain from splashing in the pool  There was also a small shopfront by the pool where you could order drinks  expensive   and basic foods The hotel staff at the front are incredibly efficient at getting you a taxi whenever you need one   even in the middle of peak hour and we never had to wait We used the restaurant a couple of times for breakfast   an impressive range of food to cater for a wide range of nationalities and preferences  It is quite expensive though   especially for your children to eat there given that they don t eat much at all  Having said that  the lovely staff recognised this and let us only pay for one child each time  this was their suggestion  Wireless internet was free for the whole week that we stayed there The area of little India is full of character and the hotel is well serviced by surrounding shops  7 elevens  24 hour Mustafa Centre  and a supermarket across the road at the newly opened mall We enjoyed our stay here and one day when we can afford it  we will definately be back  thanks for a terrific time
