This hotel is excellent  In the centre of Little India  In easy reach of the airport and very cheap taxi ride to and from airport  Staff at the hotel are friendly and speak excellent English  Hotel is opposite a great shopping mall and close to a fab market  Surrounded by top banana curry houses  Very humid all year round in Singapore and every where you go is air conditioned  Try a Singapore Sling    they make them well    Breakfast at this hotel is also fab  an array of food from every corner of the globeRoom Tip  Sees a decent hotel all round  we were on the 7th floor on the front of the hotel and had no complai   See more room tips

My first stay at Park Royal was for a night  I got an amazing room on the 13th floor   perfect view of a city and most of it all the bed was comfortable  Soft pillows and soft mattress made the night after a long haul comfortable   and perfect  My second stay at Park Royal was short  I was arriving after a long haul and was in transit for 10 hours  I needed a comfortable room just for a few hours before catching another flight  I was arriving around 10 am in the morning and was leaving at 7 pm in the evening to catch a flight  On checking in I was told aggressively that I had to pay about SGD 100 if I was to be checked in to a room  I was taken aback by her raised voice and hostile attitude  I tried explaining to the reception staff that I couldn t wait till 2 pm as I was there only for a few hours to shower and get some shut eye and also showed my flight itinerary  Then the receptionist spoke to her manager and then allocated me a room My pleasant stay on the first night was completely shattered by the hostile attitude of the receptionist

I like this 4 star Delux hotel very much  It is located bang on little India and just beside Mustafa Shopping mall which is 24 hour open biggest shopping mall in Singapore Its heaven for Indian family who like shopping abroad The only drawback is this hotel is far from the entertainment areas like Clarkey bay and Orchid street  For that you can take MRT which is a short walk of 2 3 minutes away  You get plenty of Indian dishes in breakfast and for dinner there are 5 6 good Indian restaurants on same street one in the same building basement   But the best Indian food we get was at Riverwalk Tandoor at Clarkey Bay Area  In Singapore you must do three things Universal Studio Sentosa island and Clarkey bay with Evening River Cruise

My experience with this hotel was excellent  Rooms are neat and clean  Staff persons are always smiling and ready to help you  Its location is great for Indians  As i am a vegetarian  i found hotel food satisfactory than other places  Hotel is very near to Mustafa Centre   24 hours open shopping destination where you can find every damn thing  Many Indian restaurants are nearby Kailash Parbat is the best one   If you are an Indian specially vegetarian  i strongly recommend this hotel because of its location as well as my hotel experience  Its great for non Indian also Room Tip  Ask for pool view room if available See more room tips

We stayed here in for 4 nights and found the staff to be very helpful and friendly  Our bags were sent to our room promptly and an extra bed was set up in our room very quickly Our room was clean and had all the necessary items  We did not have breakfast here and just crossed the road to the  quot City Square mall quot   which is 2 minutes away  There is also a supermarket at the City Mall and the Farrar train station is there also  The hotel is in a great location close to most things  There are many other shopping malls nearby too The pool was set in a nice area and a welcome break from the heat I would recommend this hotel for its location and is a very good property

We stayed here on our honeymoon  The hotel staff sent flowers and chocolates on coming to know that we re on honeymoon  which was a nice gesture  We were attended by Mew at front desk who was very polite and friendly Rooms were good  with a good view of city from 14 th floor  However  the bath tub was a bit small  The room service and housekeeping were excellent  and free wifi was available  Breakfast was good  with Indian food as well  Location is good  walking distance from MRT  malls and mustafa  However  for my fellow Indians  the hotel is perfect but it is located right in the middle of little india neighbourhood  So  if u want a feel of  quot abroad quot  and want to avoid stepping out of a good hotel into an atmosphere which resembles delhi  stay somewhere else  I wasn t aware of it beforehand  and was surprised to see hundreds of construction workers  all Indians  flocking the streets on a Sunday morning  Definitely not the sight I d like in Singapore  Most of the Indian travel agents  though  offer you hotels in little india Overall  the hotel deserves full marks  because of its efficient and friendly staff  But next time I d stay at a place away from little india

I was in Park Royal on Kitchener Road  Singapore the past 5 days     on my family holiday  The location was great     very close to Farrer Park MRT station and the hotel is right on the Serangoon road making access to one Indian meal each day easy    But the across the board service attitude of all the staff was a matter of deep disappointment  They all ahve scripted answers and displayed very low desire to understand what the customer is saying  asking for etc   I do not believe I will go back to this property ever    The sould good experience was the willingness of a duty manager after I really protested badly No one bothers to call back when they tell you they will and no one really tries to understand what the problems are      The temperature control for the a c in teh room doesnt work      so  if you are not burried under your quilt  it can get real real coldRoom Tip  try        but there are no guarantees unless the hotel management takes a fundamentally different a   See more room tips

I stayed at this property on my honeymoon in April 2012 and i can describe my experience in one word  quot Fantastic quot  We just had a wonderful overall experience  We just breezed through the check in process and happily surprised to receive a complmentary room upgrade  Room was clean and staff had arranged for flowers and chocolates in our room  During the next 5 days while we were there  the staff was very courteous and guided us with elaborate details about places of interest to visit in Singapore Breakfast was excellent with wonderful spread of Indian and Continental food  Location is excellent  Just 5 mins walk to nearest MRT and right opposite a mall and infact walking distance from Mustafa  We had a comfortable sleep and there was no noise as we were on 11th Floor  I will definitely be coming next year  Park Royal management and staff  thank you once again for all the wonderful memories Room Tip  Choose rooms on the Higher Floors may be above 8th or 9th and facing the mall to get a good view See more room tips

Stayed there for 3 nights at the deluxe room  Good location especially for those that likes to visit Little India and Mustafa Centre and walking distance to the MRT station Farrer Park  Room was good with very comfortable bed and the shower and bathroom was nice and clean  Tv channels available was also a good variety  If you are looking for a hotel around this area  definately would recommended to stay at this hotel

We stayed in this hotel for 04 days and can tell you that have never come across such rude and unprofessional front desk staff  Initially they gave us a twin bed rom though we being a couple on putting across the compliant we were traeted to extremely rude and impolite behavior at the front desk and the sad part is that the lady duty manager was even worse than the staff  When we encountered her in the elevator later could hear her criticising all her guest in the lobby  Stayed in a room wheer two separate beds were joined togenethe with no headboard behind us  extremely uncomfortable first night and ahd to fight with the front desk taff to have us shifted to another room the second day  The staff at front desk lacks basic mannerisms

Reading a majority of opinions on this site  I did have a very positive impression of this Hotel  Definitely these expectations were met   I found the room check in  amp  check out process efficient  staff professional and helpful  The Rooms were very well appointed  amp  I was very happy to note that the  quot make my room  quot  sign was attended very promptly by the on duty housekeeper of the floor Apart from the nice rooms  I liked the waiting areas behind the lobby which offer a very nice  amp  quiet ambience to meet with other guests and visitors or to quickly catch up on mails  The Location of Little India is useful for those like me who are comfortable with South Indian food and you are spoilt for choice with a number of  quot Bhavans quot  offering Traditional Chennai food in Singapore

Broken toilet seat  cupboard coming off its hinges  worst of all having to explain to 3 different people what needs fixing rather than sending someone by to do an overall quality check  Reception seems to be a real mess  I m not even going to describe what other trouble I had The area is interesting and not far away from work  there is a free WiFi connection  and some rooms seem to have been refurbished  maybe top floors   Even so  paying that sort of price for a fairly run down and chaotic hotel is not something I m prepared to do again

I am a frequent visitor to Singapore for business and personal reasons  such as Physicians  Clinics etc I have been visiting Singapore since 1980s  during the past 23 years  I have had the opportunity of staying at various hotels in Singapore   ranging from 5 star to 3 star hotels When I  quot accidentally quot  came across Park Royal at Kitchener Road  though being skeptical  I decided to give it a try  On my very first stay  I was so impressed by the overall service provided by Park Royal that ever since I have been staying at this hotel  except on one occasion  when the hotel was fully booked  I have been recommending this hotel to my friends and business associates  Aside from being conveniently and strategically located  my major handicap to finding good  delicious vegetarian food has been permanently resolved as there are so many excellent vegetarian outlets in the vicinity that I have absolutely no problem to choose what to eat  Sometimes  when I am too tired to go out after a long day  I would just call in Room Service and they take extreme care to provide me with any dish modified to my taste and dietary preferences Kudos to all at Park Royal Kitchener Road     do keep up the good work Aside from all above  making reservations is also very easy and convenient  Thanks to Park Royal Kitchener road  I now enjoy Black GHA Membership  which entitles me to early check in and late check out facilities  free 24 hours internet service  free laundry  usage of their Orchid Club facilities at no extra cost  It is indeed a  quot value for money quot  and will be my chosen place of accommodation for as long as I am traveling to Singapore  Thank you Park Royal   N  Daryanani

Stayed with a friend for 4 nights  loved it  Right next door to the Mustafa center and a quick walk to a train station  As soon as we arrived the service was outstanding  all staff going out of their way to help us  Pool area was excellent and we really needed it with the heat when we visited  Good fast wifi too which was easy to connect to  Would happily return if I traveled back to Singapore

Located strategically in little india this hotel is a haven of comfort and peace It offers the guests easy accessibility to the hustle bustle of mustafa centre and the tranquility of city square mall opposite The staff is extremely courteous to say the least be it offering early check in or room upgrade The door man was kind enough to personally show me the nearest seven eleven On my birthday a lovely cake was delivered to my room without a request The paid self laundry is a boon too The pool and gym are well appointed and the rooms are well equipped clean and have free wifi This property is an epitome of service with a smile I have stayed here twice and am sure to do so again

Stayed here for 5 days with entire family 2 adults 2 kids  Really like the place and experience  Kids had great time at swimming pool and me with free wifi  Breakfast buffet had good variety  There are couple of restaurants in hotel we didn t try those but mostly ate at one of the plentiful eateries around Room we opted for deluxe room which we found relatively small  They had to put additional bed in room for my daughter which really took all the space  With room rate and room tag  deluxe   we were expecting better deal  Also  checkin took more than 10 mins for some reason  With reservations done in advance and with all travel documents  had never seen so much time for hotel checkin  There is chance of process improvement here  Hotel staff was helpful and smiling  Plus point of this hotel is its location mustafa mrt  mall stones throw away  Highly recommended for this point  Overall satisfying experience which made our trip memorable  Thanks

Went with our extended family and stayed there for 2 days  Rooms were clean but very small  We stayed in the delux room which were renovated so please do not stay on the lower floors  Only 5 star hotel that charges for getting ice in the room  Also they did not make our beds in the night and they said that they just make beds once a day  For the next 2 days I moved into the intercontinental hotel which is so much better and at the same price

PArk royal is situated bang Opposite Mustafa in Little India and that is only one of its plus points  It is 2 minutes walk from Ferror Park MRT    We stayed there during Dec2012  we made booking through our travel agent in Mumbai  The Hotel has all the ameneties one can ask for  It has a well equiped ZYM  2 swimming pools  SPA  Lounge Bar and Restaurant  When we landed in Singapore  we had a very good checkin experience and they did not take even 10 minutes to complete all formalities and gave us early checkin without any fuss  We were worried about getting proper Veg food in the hotel but were plesently surprised to see all Indian Veg items at the breakfast Buffett  they even had Paratha  Idli  Noodles etc and menu was changed daily  Their Egg counter is also excellent  The rooms are very neat and have Tea kettle whcih is a boon for families with children as they can just add water to make CUP O NOODLE right in the room  We even could bring outside food and they provided plate  cutlery etc without any fuss The toliets had a decent bath tub and all toiletories The location is a big advantage as all indian restaurants are just 100 meters away  So you can spend exploring teh cty till late  come back to hotel to freshen up and land at INDIAN SUMMER at 11 30 for a nice indian Dinner of Roti  Dal and Paneer Butter Masala     Overall highly recommended Hotel for Indians and BTW they give free WIFI in the room and have decent speed  Room Tip  Rooms in higher floor give a good city view   Otherwise all rooms are quiet and peacefulSee more room tips

This hotel is good value for your money  Close to the Mustafa shopping centre and mrt  But in little India a little out of the shopping districts of orchard road  But again you can catch the Mrt every 4 minutes anywhere with such efficiency  Great continental breakfast with fabulous service at reception  Great pool area and fabulous gym  I would recommend staying here as the service and facilities are a great value for money

We arrived on an early flight and asked the front desk staff to try to check us in early if anything was available  This is very common in the US  hotels don t strictly stick to check in times  Having travelled overnight I hoped they would accommodate us as and when a room becomes available  The staff were not a bit friendly or understanding  I was told there were no rooms available in the 18 storey building  So after the check out time of 12  rooms became available and they still were not ready to check us in and asked me to stay in the lobby till 2  Very disappointed  will not recommend this place

It is a 5 star hotel  with shopping and dining options within 1 minute  The new mall right opposite the hotel has great cafes  and other shops  The only minor issue is having to wait for over 10 minutes for a taxi  If you are from India  it is a great place for Indian food as the hotel is right next to Little India  The gym and pool are very good  Breakfast   included in the price  was phenomenal

Company booked this hotel at a last minute  so not aware nor did research on this hotel before going  was surprised to find this hotel next to Mustafa and in Little India  was thrilled that you are in a place where you can do lot of shopping and have lots of variety for eating and spending time  Stayed here for 3 days and had good and pleasant experience  Rooms were wonderful and comfortable for the price  front desk went out of the way to take care of my request of providing me with King size bed  even though it was full  They shifted to the new room  I saw security accompanying the room boys  Laundry service was prompt  Breakfast was excellent  as it had many south Indian variety  did not feel to go out and eat  as there were many choices in hotel itself  I had a good view of city from the room  Pool was very clean  though did not have time for a swim  Had trouble in connecting my phone  looks like the wireless internet connect one  and have to tell them for the 2nd  but it was attended very quickly and was sorted out  Taxi were quickly available just outside the main door  5 min  walk to metro station and bus stop  hence could go anywhere quickly  Even in early morning there was no issues on transportation  Other general amenities were available  but could not find shoe shine machine Room Tip  Indian travellers how want to be at home would love this hotel and its location  Other Nationalist w   See more room tips

First time staying there on business trip in May 2012  During that time  I was away to embassy in the morning to apply for visa  When I was back in the noon to the hotel there were renovations in progress with extremely noisy sounds and I needed to complain several times  at least three times  and every time they said they will get back to you very soon  Finally  they provided me an alternative to stay in different room during the day  It was very inconvenient because I needed to walked up and down from the temporary room they assigned to me in order to bring my belongings to continue working  The noise from drilling happened on a daily basis until the evening  Second trip recently  I made a last minute booking In my recent visit in January 2013  I was really disappointed because the rate was increased by 11   which was denied by the management insisting that the increase was a sheer 2   How can you continue to patronize a hotel which was untrustworthy  simply increase the room rate and lacked transparency in communicating their room rate to their customer and yet they did not want to admit their inconsistency in their room rate from year to year  I am unable to deal again with a hotel that constantly providing lies to customer with bad customer service  In view of these occurrences  I therefore  would like to give a thumb down and say Bye Bye to Park Royal Hotel at Kitchener Road and I will say Hi to other hotel in my next business trip to Singapore  Think thrice before you make any booking from this hotel Room Tip  Don  39 t stay there in any of your trip to Singapore See more room tips

We stayed at this hotel in dec 2012  It was a two night stop off  on our way to Sydney  From the airport  we caught the train to the hotel  There is a stop very near to it  It was a lovely hotel  the rooms were big  and very clean  There was the usual tv safe iron and ironing board  I had trouble connecting to the Internet  so I just phone the technical number which was in the book  And they connected me straight away  It was very busy  but that s to be expected as it was the Xmas holidays  The staff were very helpful  and very polite  I would stay there again

Stayed here with family last month  Found the staff very helpful at check in  We were on the spa level and found room access had further security on that level  which was very thoughtful  Rooms were spacious and well maintained  Didn t have much of a room view other than a car park but that was inconsequential as we spent majority the time sightseeing  Beds were big and comfortable for me  wife and our 2 5 year old son to sleep without discomfort  Pillows were a bit too firm for our taste  Breakfast buffet was very nice  Ample choice was available for variety of cuisines  Vegetarians also had an extensive choice  The best thing about the hotel though is its location  Right in the middle of little india area  Surrounded by malls  shops and restaurants     Lot of them open 24 hours  You have too much to explore and experience  Would love to go back for another visit

Finding family friendly accommodation in Asia is not easy  The Parkroyal on Kitchiner Road  Singapore  fits the bill  They have generously sized family rooms maintained to the highest standards of cleanliness  The buffet breakfast  included in the room rate  offers huge variety   something for the fussiset of eaters  Across the road there is a shopping centre with Macdonalds  a supermarket  pharmacy  toy shop etc and behind the hotel is the Mustafa Centre which seems to sell everything on the planet  cheaply   The Farrer Park tube stop is also across the road making travel around Singapore a breeze  The hotel also has a beautiful pool We have stayed here with our two children twice now and have been impressed by the friendly  efficient service  Staff make a real effort to be genuinly warm and welcoming  The abundance of cheap but fantastic Indian restaurants inthe vicinity is also a huge plus I really wouldn t stay anywhere else in Singapore and look forward to returning sometime in the future Room Tip  If you are travelling with children  be sure to ask for a family room when bookingSee more room tips

We stayed in this hotel as a part of our honeymoon for 3 nights The hotel staff was extremely helpful an quick for the checkin  The hotel was clean and well maintained  service prompt Location is great  right next to mustafa centre  little India Buffet breakfast has good indian as well as continental variety of food  Good for vegetarians as well Overall I give it a five star rating for value for money and Location

Stayed 2 nights in January 2013 and found it to be welcoming and relaxing  Rooms are very large and very clean  Train station is just a 5 minute walk around the corner  Major shopping centre directly across the street and local hawker type food available next door  Pool area lovely with plenty of lounges to relax on  2 small criticisms would be the price of drinks in the lounge with over servicing from attendants and  time it took to check in  Would definitely stay here again Room Tip  One that overlooks pool area and no higher than 6th floor See more room tips

Stayed here for a night at 20th floor  The check in experience was fast  amp  accurate  I feel welcome  I stayed in Club floor  My room has a good view  It was quite spacious for a single occupied room  I love the room  amp  setting  Love the view as well  I had a problem to connect to the free wifi  But after some call it is settled  The room does not has so many channel to turn on  No local channel as well  I had my breakfast at 19th floor  Compared to the ground floor reception its not as welcoming as the reception ground floor  Not many choice  amp  too simple  I need to make my own tea or coffee  Its not what i expect from Club floor  The breakfast area has 3 staff  Since i ve stayed at the Club floor the price for the room for me quite expensive  If i were to travel with family this might not be my choice of hotel  Or probably i m not going to stay at the Club floor compared to the service received The bathroom was simple but nice  No tooth brush but luckily i bring my own  I have been told at the reception i can check in on the 19th floor  But it is not stated in the booking receipt  The hotel should had stated in the booking so that i dont waste my time checking in at the lobby  The hotel is near to Mustafa Centre  Its just behind the hotel  This is a plus Pro s  Location  Mustafa centre Con s  Price vs service

A good centrally located hotel  First day when i arrived I could not find toothbrush anywhere within the rooms  I was searching at least a good 2 mins in toilet and inside my room  When I called at midnight they said they will deliver and they did within around 5 minutes  I thought may be they forgot to put in and that was ok  I always have a habit to change my toothbrush whenever i travel and stay in hotel  I have a fright someone will do something to it  So i threw it before I left for work the second day  But again when i came back i had to call for toothbrush and it came later and i was very frustrated this time and came to conclusion Why the hotel did not put in a simple necessity for traveller  Not everyone travels with it  This is not the first time i visited SG and all other hotels I have stayed in provide one or two in ROOM  I paid around 300 SGD and yet i had to go to all the hassle to call and waited when you wanted to sleep Other than this incident staff was very friendly and accomodative  Room is clean and looks new  Breakfast was good  But again if you want to stay here next time be ready to pack ur own toothbrush or wait till it comes and end up u might fall assleep

I stayed in this hotel for 8 nights  checked in on 24 Sep  morning next to Singapore F1   reached hotel around 9 AM and requested for an early check in and they did oblige The best part about the hotel is its location  its right next to Mustafa and has got tons of 24 7 eateries  predominantly Indian cuisine  around it  also has an MRT station right across the street  Rooms are good and well maintained  room service has been great and so was the overall experience

Left a couple of reviews in relation to hotels in Singapore on tripdvisor in the past and as a general theme I cant help but make comparisons with other Asian cities and I always struggle with whats on offer in terms of value for money  I decided to give this hotel a  quot go primarily because of some of the reviews on tripadvisor and overall I wasn t disappointed  The reception area of the hotel looks a little old and faded and my initial impression wasn t that favourable but once I got to my room  I opted for a deluxe room  I was feeling a lot happier with my choice In terms of reception there a few members of the team who need a refresher course at the local charm school  Housekeeping on the other hand was friendly and undertaken to a good standard The pool area is ok  its a bit utilitarian  but most importantly the water was clean and clear  one of my absolute hates is paying expensive hotel prices and the pool water looks a bit cloudy  Location of the hotel is excellent being opposite the MTR Overall a good choice and happy to recommend

We had a family holiday in Singapore last November  We were nine persons and booked four superior rooms for four nights  The experience was very good The rooms were quite large  the beds were comfortable  bathroom with toiletries were good and minibar was well stocked Breakfast spread was excellent  the dining room was very large but convenient The location of hotel is good as far as Asians are concerned  right in the middle of shopping areas I recommend this hotel for travelling to Singapore for any purpose Room Tip  Choose swimming pool facing rooms See more room tips

This is not a 4 star hotel and I guess it doesn t pretend to be  It is a bit out of the main tourist areas  so at first it may not be recognized as an option  I only landed here by mistake because I booked Park Royal by phone and the central customer service person failed to point out that there are I think 4 Park Royals in Singapore  And it wasn t the one I wanted  So I started with a rather negative attitude  However I soon discovered the hotel is in a pretty authentic part of old Singapore and is right across the road from Farrer Park MRT  This line just about takes you any direction  I started to get my bearings when I discovered we were right near Little India an area I frequented in my younger days  The Indian food here is tres authentique  especially the vegetarian food  You can get Iddly  a rice ball cake here  which I have not seen in years  excellent with curries  There is a very good Singapore Chinese restaurant just a block away with some very creative dishes that are every bit as good as I can get in Hong Kong  You could wander the streets here and find just great Singapore restaurants in the truly traditional style  The hotel is a bit spartan  rooms are largish and just functional  WIFI is excellent and free  The hotel is all about location and access  Just perfect for the more adventurous traveller  Room Tip  I suspect some rooms may have a limited view so ask for one looking out towards the front of the hot   See more room tips

One of the best hotels for all Indians travelling to Singapore  This hotel is conveniently located next to Little India and Mustafa Shopping Centre and it also has lot many Indian restaurants next to it The property is very good and well maintained  Boasts of high end technology including elevators which operate only on usage of your room key cards  We stayed in Sueperior rooms  which are the base category rooms  These rooms were well laid out  had beautiful clean bathrooms with a bath tub  Overall room ambience was beautiful and had road facing view  Check in   Check out was brisk and was attended by lovely helpful smiling staff  Bed linen  curtains  toilteries and all such stuff was upto the mark  neat and clean  good quality Hotek has a Wi Fi access in all rooms and the speed is also decent  Complimentary water is being provided on a daily basis  2 bottles   but throughout Singapore tap water is also drinkable  so no worries on that front  Bottled water just to mention is way too costly in Singapore Other facilities include swimming pool and restaurants which were also neat and good  My package was inclusive of morning breakfast  Being an Indian Jain Vegetarian  we had limited choice in terms of morning breakfast and the only issue was the same items kept repeatiting day on day  Perhaps this needs to be taken care of  The restaurant manager was good and while we pointed out the problem to him  he did take en effort to change the menu for a day  though not everyday Hotel proximity is close to lot many Indian restaurants  vegetarian food lovers have Kailash Parbat  Namastey India  Sarvanna Bhawan and lot many more  These 3 are mentioned as they were the best starting with KP Hotel staff is courteous and pays attention to our needs  Final words  worth staying for the property  services offered and its proximity to Little India Room Tip  Superior or Superior Deluxe  both are equally good See more room tips

Stayed at 6th floor  The room was average size  had all the basics but was quite worn and in need of a facelift  Cleaning was OK  but not more  Wireless was included  but speeds were not great On the positive side  breakfast was good  staff helpful and the hotel bar nice  But this is not enough to pull my grade above average Room Tip  Lower floors do not have much of a view  so try to get a room at the top floors See more room tips

I landed into Singapore airport and my business friend from Singapore informs me that due to Chinese New Year he couldn t book a room for my stay    So here was I   Logged on to web and started looking for a hotel for early check in as it was 6 00 am and I was in the middle of no where    Then after watching this hotel I decided to call up the reservation and check if they could help me out   I was lucky that they not only had a room also they agreed to try arranging an early check in  The hotel is located in a very accessible area right in the middle of Singapore and next to little india  It s just 10 mins walk from orcjard road and mustafa center is just like half a minute  A lot of Indian restaurants around as little INDIA shares the wall with this hotel  Overall had a pleasant stay although a bit expensive but I think it was due to Chinese New Year may be  Worth staying overall

After two weeks at this hotel  I expect I will have some issues that others will not Overall  first impressions  Very nice  classy contemporary decor  nice staff  nice room The location is slightly away from the middle of things  but the MRT and buses are right next door  so getting around is no problem  I stayed here  as I had no need to be closer into town  so was seeking better value Negatives on my trip  Housekeeping calling me on the phone  because your do not disturb sign is on   to ask if I wanted laundry delivered  Coming back one night to find Housekeeping had left the security bar flipped over on my door  and the room open  Housekeeping calling on a Sunday morning to ask if I had laundry to drop off  Checking in to realise that the room had no desk chair  and the room safe had been locked open by the previous guest  Rather a meagre breakfast for the price of hotel  In two weeks  they only went beyond melon cubes for fresh fruit on two occasions  once pineapple  the other time dragon fruit   this in a country where tropical fruit is so abundant and cheap  Enquiring if they had any cheese  I was told that it would be charged as an extra  You did get something of a feeling that they provided nothing that you could walk out with  Compare what was on offer with say the Prince Hotel in KL I was told that if I checked out early  I would pay one nights room rate as a penalty  On re checking this  I was told that this was not so  and offered the managers card in case I had further issues  I had a good stay  but not sure I d choose to spend two weeks in this location again  As others have said  I ll add that the cost of hotels in SG is now totally horrendous  After add ons I was paying over US 200 a night  which even a year ago would have got you something really special  Good luck to anyone trying to find a hotel during the Singapore grand prix p s  Mustaffa Centre is a must  ended up buying a fridge and washing machine there   definitely good value

I would not recommend this hotel to anyone  We stayed at this hotel on the way back from Australia  I am so glad it was for less than 24 hours  Immediately on arrival it became apparent that this hotel was very dated and the reception area had quite a depressing look about it with paint work chipped and tired looking  On booking in  there was confusion about whether breakfast had been paid for  for our children  which it had  and this took a while to sort out  We again had this query when we went for breakfast the following morning  but this time it was if any of us had breakfast included  The family room was two adjoining rooms and was dated and tired looking  with wood work chipped and dirty  The curtains were filthy and the sheets had a hole in  The whole presentation was dark  dingy and depressing  One of the robes provided had a stain on the back  The only ok thing about the hotel was the breakfast which the children enjoyed as they could have pancakes freshly cooked  However the ceiling of the restaurant looked like it belonged in a factory with all the pipework exposed  The pool area was ok but all the tables were full of dirty crockery when we arrived for a swim  Overall very disappointing  All of this I will be feeding back to our travel agent

I was really happy with this choice of hotel  Being located in Little India added a new dimension to my experiences of this wonderful island nation Arrived after my afternoon flight from Australia  Transfer to hotel went well  Staff were polite at check in but there was a problem  My booking for a king couldn t be filled due to the hotel being at full capacity during the expo  I was offered a twin  That suited me as I was travelling alone  The only reason I mention this is that they did explicitely state that it was a king room on the booking confirmaiton Room is very clean and comfortable  They have been renovated since some of the ealier review  Every function was in order  With the weather at the moment  the aircond is producing quite a lot of condensation which is dripping onto the carpet near the cupboard  Reported it to maintenance this morning but no action yet Yesterday morning I ordered an iron for the room  It took more than 60 minutes to arrive  Fortunately I had made the decision to go to breakfast in the meantime Breakfast was quite hearty with a range of Asian  European and Indian dishes  I ve been having the fresh cooked omelette each morning  The bacon is certainly unusal  Not sure what they do to that  It is very fatty  Brekky has been keeping me going for the day Location of the hotel is a little out of the centre  Taxi fares to most parts of the city have been in the range of S 5   S 6  Outside the hotel do try the  quot My F amp B Cafe quot   pictured  area 20 metres from the hotel on Kitchener Road  A full chinese meal will be about S 3  Fantastic Indian fare can be enjoyed for around the same price   I tried the pool on Level 6  Even though we are close to the equater  the pool water is still cool and refreshing  The pool attendants can give you a free locker key when they give you a towel Thanks Parkroyal

Booked this hotel as many other hotels downtown were fully booked or grossly overpriced I booked the club room as the SGD300 price includes breakfast and internet  Singapore hotels charge quite unreasonably for internet access This hotel is not near the other hotels  Not near Orchard Road or near City Hall Suntec Area  However  it is only about 100m to the MRT station and it will get you down to Orchard Road  at Dhoby Ghaut station  in no time This neighbourhood is alive 24 hours a day  thanks to the nearby Mustafa centre   reputed to be the bargain departmental store in Singapore     you are supposed to get great deals here if you don t mind the crowds and the congested aisles   Lots of coffee shops and stalls nearby if you are hungry in the middle of the nightThis place is called Little India     and at times  you can feel that it is more like Mumbai than Singapore The hotel is clean The club floor is opened till 11pm   you can get drinks but I could not find any food   Breakfast was at the club floor    nice view but limited selection of food  Service was good fortunately My main complain is that the shower ran out of cold water in the morning     had to tolerate hot water to wash off the soap off my skin    i think this should not happen in a hotel that charges me SGD300  USD200  per night  Other than that  I don t have anything against them

Stayed in PR for 2 nights in April  Room was very clean  we were even comfortable letting our baby crawl around throughout the room  and large for the style of hotel Breakfast  which was included in our rate  is fantastic  with a buffet catering to a wide variety of western and eastern tastes The hotel is also well located  Farrer Road MRT is across the street and Lavender MRT is about a 10 minute walk in the opposite direction   We were also pleasantly suprised to discover we could walk to the hotel  about 15 min with bags  from Lavender Bus terminus  which is where over land coaches to Malaysia  serving Melaka for example  stop In terms of standard business ammenities it is slightly lacking  the cost of internet is really high for example   Staff were very friendly but not always great at getting things done  having to call repeatedly over a 2hr period to get the alarm clock turned off in the vacant room next door on a Sunday morning was annoying   For location and price though this is an excellent stay

I ve visited Singapore many times over the past few years and have watched hotel prices rise at an alarming rate  I now search high and low for good value hotels  and that s exactly what I found at the Park Royal on Kitchener Road I booked this hotel for an overnight stay via the hotelclub booking site  We paid US  126 for a double room inclusive of all taxes and breakfast for two We were given a quiet room at the end of the hall on the 14th floor  which was completely non smoking  yea    Our room was fresh  clean and inviting  It had a comfortable king sized bed  a desk with comfy lounge chair  a safe  mini bar fridge  powerful air conditioning  two bathrobes and plenty of space I loved the lighting   bright lights over the sink and mirror in the bathroom  plenty of lamps and soft lighting in the bedroom  There was a floor lamp  desk lamp  lights under the bed side tables and individually controlled reading lights attached to the bed The bathroom was modern and spacious with a shower over the tub and ample shelf space This hotel is located right next door to chaotic Mustafa Center  a 24 hour shopping complex that seems to be busy round the clock  It s also right across the street from an MRT station  so it couldn t be more conveniently located All one need do is walk out the door to find Indian food  but we chose the restaurant in the basement of the hotel   Jewel of India   excellent choice   inexpensive and really good   12 nett each for dinner buffet  The hotel breakfast was excellent with a wide array of hot and cold food options The staff was friendly and helpful and allowed us to check out at 2 pm at no extra charge I was really impressed with this hotel and won t hesitate to stay here again

We stayed at this hotel for the past 2 weeks  I have mostly positive things to say about our stay    Our room was lovely and clean and cleaned daily by housekeeping  We had a lovely fruit basket in our room on arrival  The Porters and Concierge were very friendly and helpful to us  We had our breakfast included in our stay so that was a wonderful start to each day  The spice brasserie breakfast catered to everyones tastes and needs   I found the food to be plentiful and delightful  The danish pastries were delish   I think because we had 2 weeks there  we got to know some of the staff  so we were greeted and treated very well I loved the location as i am not keen on being in the city area  Having the Mustafa centre just a 1 minute walk away was great for whenever we needed anything   and i mean anything    This place is the biggest shop i have ever seen and i managed to get lost in there many times  There is also many Hawker centres within a 2 minute walk  so we ate at them a lot and never payed more than  10SING for our 2 meals  The hotel is a busy one  so sometimes waiting for an elevator at peak times was a pain  but i am a patient person  so i just chatted to others who were also waiting  The pool and gym area is just beautiful  Very refreshing after a day out sightseeing  The MRT is so close you can see it from the hotel  Staff are also ready to call a cab for you if required  All in all  i found the Parkroyal a great place to stay

This is quie a nice place  and good value  The room was a pleasent surprise at this price   The room I stayed in was newly refurbished   Very comfy king size bed  pretty firm but good     New LCD TV on the wall with many channels  most in Chinese   In this climate you need good aircon  and the aircon in this room was nice and cold   Didn t eat in the restaurant  but I did have room service breakfast  the full american for  Sing22  Pretty good   and good value  Will try the breakfast buffet next time    The hotel is right next door to a famous 24 hour department store   you just have to see this place      There area is almost entirely Indian  which is great for food variety  Appears to be quite a safe area  On the negative side   The area is not really near orchard road or downtowb singapore   so everywhere is a bit of hike  It s not really in town    The lifts were older  and provided an unimpressive slow service    There is no parking outside the front door   so it is very hard to have a colleague pick you up  The security guys are very agressive   The Bell hops are also quite agressive in taking your bags whether you want them too or not  Really really agressive

I was very disappointed with the Parkroyal on Kitchener Road  The beds are like concrete and I found them almost impossible to sleep on  The room was pleasant  but basic I was very disappointed to be charged  47 for 4 x lemonade drinks in the front bar whle killing some hours waiting for my transfer to the airport  When I explained my concern the reply was very abrupt and unforgiving The hotel is convenient if you wish to go to the Mustafa shopping center which is truly amazing My advice  you can do a lot better with your money in Singapore The best thing about my stay was that it was only for 1 night

Stayed for 2 nights on the way home to UK from Australia  Never been to Singapore so didn t know what to expect  Very happy with hotel  staff helpful  room pretty good  no beer in mini bar  but I guess that s a Singapore thing   free WiFi  breakfast was great   a smorgasbord of eastern cuisines  or while u wait eggs and bacon  Hotel just across road from the brilliant and cheap metro which we used a lot  Pool looked very nice but didn t find time to use it

As soon as you arrive at the hotel  staff help you with your lugage  quickly get you checked in an take all your stuff to your room for you   Very friendly all the way through The rooms are quite allright   Standard hotel rooms   Nothing much to say  The pool and gym are is very nice The hotel is next to a shopping center

We stayed at Park Royal for 3 nights From 26th Feb 2013 in a superior room at the back of the hotel  No noise from the surrounding roads  the only noise came from other guests slamming their doors from around 6am  When a hotel is in a city  not everyone is on holiday and business people use these hotels  up early for meetings  Our room was very clean and well furnished in a typical hotel layout  The bed was extremely comfortable and was actually two 4foot beds zipped together making a really big bed  Bonus As we ate out the nights we were there  the only time we had to sample the food was at breakfast where there is everything you could wish for for breakfast  buffet style  No tablecloths just wipe down tables so a little bit like a canteen  There is an egg station for those that want omelette or scrambled egg etc  It was extremely busy every morning when we came down but we always managed to get a table  Staff could be a bit over zealous on clearing the tables you had to watch if both of you were up getting fruit or cereal as your glass of breakfast orange plus cutlery could be cleared away  We solved this by going up one at a time This hotel is in the Indian quarter of Singapore and it took us about 20 minutes  not walking fast  looking at the buildings and Indian wares on our way  to walk to the nearest stop for the hop on  hop off bus  The bus has a well planned out route as it stops near all the tourist attractions and areas  We did use taxis a couple of times  reasonable fares  especially if you have been out all day and what to get back quickly As with all cities  hotels can be a bit pricey and since the last time we were in Singapore the prices do seem to have rocketed  This hotel seems to strike a happy balance by offering good accommodation and food at an affordable price

Its near mustafa and the bargain shopping area  Lots of good Indian food restaurants around  new rooms  but the ac s have started leaking already  the bathrooms are huge but not planned properly  the tub is very small and you have to stand in the same and take a shower  the chances of you falling while taking a shower are very high  Be careful  The food spread for the breakfast is not up to mark for such a good hotel

When I was reading about this hotel in tripadvisor I was worry if I don t like it   So we decided to try and book the hotel  when we arrived at the hotel reception its look old need some upgrade   So they welcomed us With smile   But ours room wasn t ready yet so they told us to wait at lounge area and give me a drink  then the girl from the front desk can t remember her name very smiley face   Told me sorry for the wait and upgrade us to the club floor but not include the club complimentary wish is ok  get to the room it s was very clean big  the bathroom clean so I was very happy   The staff friendly   House keeping friendly and helpful  The swimming pool it s ok nice and clean   The restaurant staff on the 2nd floor very friendly food is ok   also the hotel close to mtr and Indian street and 20 min to Arab street if u like walking Mustafa mall  so good choice and I will recommend

As am writing now  i am still staying at this hotel  luckily am checking out on 13 Mar 2013 Made a call to service center to complain the room aircond is not functioning but nobody came The temperature was and still at 28C now Feedbacked through email yesterday and John Adam Guayco responded  EnquiryId 606886  but unfortunately its still not fixed when i return to my room today  guess its another sauna night here

We stayed here twice  as a stopover on our way to and from Australia Would like to have longer than an overnighter  The rooms were large very comfortable with a good shower room  and reasonably priced  All the staff were very friendly and helpful  and made us very welcome  The hotel is opposite a new shopping mall  which has many eateries  offering a wide range  And 2 minutes from another huge mall full of bargains  20 minutes from the airport on the shuttle  We will stayh ere whenever we go to Singapore

It was a superb hotel but d service was very Very poor staff dont listen n d room service is to slow but on d conterary it has a awesume location for indians as hardly 15 steps to mustafa with nice swimming pool nice reception and superb king size bed rooms overall nice expirence with d hotel just staff is not at all helpfull very very rude and irresponcible may b bcoz singaporians nature taxi is easily available outside hotel  Room Tip  just take a pool view side between 7 to 13 floor room its really nice  See more room tips

This was the only decent hotel that I could find in Singapore that was close to Little India    Overall my experience was average but there were pros to this hotel and you can choose it based on pros or cons   my pros can be your cons or vice versa   Pros   Strategic Location   Little India  Mustafa    For someone loving Indian food   good food options around  Cons a  No early check in policy   was quite surprised   Checkin took me close to 20 mins   b  Middle Class Hotel   I couldnt find the ROI for the room price paid   comparing it with other hotels in Singapore c  No Breakfast Buffet with room bookingd  Little Old Property   in general I did not get a feeling of a luxury Hotel e  Not a great viewf  Neighbourhood and locality in general isnt cleanRoom Tip  Pick higher floorsSee more room tips

I stayed in hotel in business  It is near to Little India and subway station  There is a new shopping mall  City Square   opposite the hotel  However  it is nothing much as it is still new  There are BreadTalk  Sushi Tei  Fast Food  at least you have some choices for dining The hotel service is great and efficient  The meeting is cold and nice arrangement  Overall the hotel is comfortable to stay  However  there were kids running around the corridor  so it was a bit noisy late night  I smell a very light hair smell on the pillows  unsure whether they change it often The wifi is provided everywhere in hotel boundaries  it is great for business The breakfast is ordinary  if you stay more than 1 day  you will feel not much choice but still filling

We spent 4 nights in this hotel during our trip to Singapore  The rooms are clean and very comfortable  However the check in counter can do with more staff as you have to wait for long periods for your turn  Secondly they are not very friendly and some what arrogant  The breakfast is quite elaborate but for vegetarians there is no change in the menu  It was exactly the same during all the four days of our stay It is a good place for Indians due to its proximity to Little India Lastly the lobby does not befit a 4 star hotel lobby with hardly any seating space

We stayed for 3 nights  the room was comfortable and clean with helpful and pleasant staff  We had breakfast in the restaurant  excellent food and a vast array of dishes to choose from  We also chose the New Year meal one evening  again quality food and served by an attentive young lady  Doreen   who explained the signifance of the rituals and food  The hotel is also convenient to a wide range of other shops and restaurants and is close to the rail station

We had stayed at this hotel during our visit with family to Singapore  This was a good hotel from a family point of view  Neat and clean  Only problem we had was at the time of check in  We were made to wait for almost 3 hours before the room could be alloted to us  Food is very costly at resturant but you have lots of cheap options nearby at the malls  Breakfast was good and had lots of variety  Room service and house keeping was good and prompt

We stayed 3 nights at ParkRoyal hotel for leisure  The lobby is ok but lacks seating in the area  They have friendly check in staff  Room was allocated as requested and on high floor  The rooms are fairly reasonably sized and basic  good bed  The bathroom is reasonably sized with good shower  how ever it had mould on tiles  The most annoying thing was that whenever the wash basin was used it made a loud noise in the open type drain situated next to the toilet  which was very annoying The concierge were not very informative and they lack in depth local knowledge or are unwilling to part with it  being busy I suppose Plenty of Taxis available outside the hotel at all times  Good shopping area and many restaurants close by Room Tip  Definitely not a 4 star hotelSee more room tips

I stayed here for 34 consecutive days near the end of 2011 and I am once again back  I could never say enough about the great friendly staff that are at your disposal to take care of all your little needs and gripes  If there is anything negative that can be said it would be in regards to the hotels internet provider  I don t remember another hotel in which I had to disable my  quot pop up blocker quot  to gain clear access I travel extensively on business and have a fairly good grasp of what my requirements are during my visit  the Park on Kitchener fills the bill nicely  If you have any problems call on Lambda  he works magic for all the guests in the hotel If you are a tourist you would be booking the right hotel  it is in middle of everything and shopping is across the street    Room Tip  The Club Rooms are comfortable and the beds great  get the city facing side See more room tips

We stayed at the Park Royal on Kitchener on our way to Auckland and back home from Sydney  Bit unsure as we hadn t been to this area of Singapore before  but the hotel was in an excellent position  lots of buzz in the area of Little India with a great little bar on the corner for a cool Tiger Beer at the end of a days sightseeing  just opposite the MRT system which is superb  We were upgraded to a De Luxe room  which was available when we arrived early in the morning   a real bonus after a long flight from London  The room was really clean and spacious  with tea and coffee making facilities  complimentary water and a fridge  lovely comfortable bed and VERY QUIET  All the staff the hotel were friendly and courteous and helpful  and the breakfast was very varied and good value We have stayed at more  up market hotels  in Singapore but would definitely return to the Park Royal  Big thank you to all at the hotel Room Tip  We were on a high floor  with a deluxe room  which was spacious and airy  Had no noise from air con   See more room tips

I spent 3 nights in this hotel for business meeting  My experience was not been pleasant at all  The standard room is very basic  with small window and the bed is rock hard  It feels as if you are sleeping on the floor  Bath room is small and lack ventilation  The service especially front desk staff is inexperience and some are not helpful at all  Very strange for Singapore hotel standard  Breakfast is very basic and don t taste good  I ate in the cafe for lunch and dinner too as our meeting was set in the hotel  The food standard is very average  The hotel s neighborhood is not very pleasant for walk or exploration    I will not recommend this hotel for business stay  This is more set up to cater for tour group who do not expect service or quality food

The hotel was beautiful and so clean  The staff were very pleasant and very helpful  My room was so clean and comfortable I had an excellent stay  I could not have picked a better hotel to stay  Whenever I needed help the staff was there to help  Well done to the management for keeping such great standards and a thankyou to the staff for giving me a wonderful stay  I would recommend anyone to stay at this hotel  The hotel is in Little India so a lot of culture around Room Tip  I was on the 10th floor and did not have any problems  I cannot comment on any other floors or rooms   See more room tips

this hotel is located quite well with an MRT station near by  Mustafa Shopping Centre  amp  little India at just a 2   4min walk  the staff at the hotel were courteous n the breakfast served was quite good  Though the hotels in Singapore are expensive   even I found this one to be but overall it was an amazing experience

We stayed here for 2 nights in February  We were supposed to stay with friend but plan had changed so they put us in this hotel  The location is nice with a minute walk to the train station and the mall  The hotel is clean with nice decoration during Chinese new year  The front desk was friendly and helpful  The room we got was a good size with king bed  The bathroom is nice  only one complain is the tub is a bit too high from the floor  so we had to be careful when get in and out

Excellent location  Across the road from MRT  Dhobi Ghat which is a major interchange is 2 stops away  Orchard road is 3 stops away  Staff have a great service attitude  Stayed in an Orchid Club room which was excellent value  Spacious  amp  well decorated  Breakfast in the Executive lounge is good but a larger buffet is available in the main breakfast area  Generous drinks and snacks available in the Executive lounge Room Tip  Orchid club room is well worth it See more room tips

First trip to Singapore and found ParkRoyal to be nice  clean with helpful and professional staff Breakfast is amazing with a buffet catering for western as well as Indian and chinese pallets   try the roti  Had a nice room to an international standard on the 6th floor with easy access to both gym and outside pool Hotel is situated in Little India  which I found to be in walking distance  15 20 min  of downtown shopping on Bugis and Orchard rd Taxis are an affordable alternative to get to other sights in and around the city   which we did often Sunday evening Little India is cramped with people   well  like India

A nice hotel with a small swimming pool The service is very good  it is very safe  and apparently the resto as well Indeed friday evening the resto is full  A good place for a diner  The breakfast is various Close to the hotel you have a quarter with a lot of shops  and restos  you cross the road in using the bridge   If you have time you can walk to the city  it is not so far

We have checked in only today i e 26th March 2013 and the check in experience was just horrific Travelling with daughters and wife and this type of attitude not at all thought of in Singapore where people are just very good  Verr very rude staff and even one was pointing to his name badge and almost threatening us to complain against him  Praying to God that the next four nights turns out nice Madhusudan Ajitsaria

I love Singapore   the food  the shopping  the civilization of it all  but I ve had my fair share of overpriced  overrated accommodations in Asia  and ParkRoyal fits just the bill We stayed here  not by choice  but as part of an organized event chosen by a travel agency  Our first night  the hotel was completely booked  therefore  our nonsmoking option was not an option  So  the smell of the smoking floor and smoking room instantly put me in negative mode  especially since we were three generations traveling   We had requested a family room but we ended up with a small  I think they call it deluxe  room with two twin  not the usual Asian twin and a half  beds and a roll away shoved into the corner against the grungy curtains  They made no effort to remove the furniture  so the room was overcrowded with three of us in it and additional furniture  not to mention they actually charge S 80 night for this  quot upgrade  quot Rather than go off on all kinds of negative tangents  here s a list of why I gave it 2 5  my lowest rating to date for a hotel   smoking room  unacceptable when traveling with a child overcharged for extra bed in an already crowded room rooms in desperate need of remodeling  dated furniture  curtains  and carpets  really grungy carpeting and curtains roll away didn t have any kind of mattress pad between mattress and sheet  yuck   mildew and body hair in the shower  time for new grout  unhelpful staff overall  there were a few friendly staff  so I shouldn t generalize  but one very unhappy concierge and several unhappy front desk staff and even more unhappy restaurant staff breakfast buffet was fair  ambience was cafeteria like location   there is much better in Singapore Honestly  shop around  Check out hotel deals  My favorite place to stay in Singapore is The Intercontinental  and you can get some great rates  Had the service or even the pool area been a bit nicer  I might have given this a 3 4  like I did Traders in Singapore because they have a lovely pool and breakfast area  I won t be returning nor will I recommend

we stayed here on our way back to India from Bali for one night  This is the best place to put one s craving for Indian food to rest  the staff was good and very helpful  if you have an early morning flight to catch  inform the front desk well in advance rooms are well maintained but the food was average  Book this hotel for a short stay  to quench your search for Indian food and shop  Mustafa centre  24 hrs open

I stayed in this hotel for 8 weeks Clean rooms good service and organized Have to comment on the front office staff who ensured that I woke up at 5 30 am every day with coffee and towards the end of the stay became good friends The food gets monotonous when you stay for a long duration but the location in Little India ensured that I never missed Indian food  Would recommend for the budget tourist or the entrepreneur looking for a decent hotel to stay in Singapore Excellent for 5 days and definitely no for 8 weeks Room Tip  I travelled in Jan 2012 and stayed on till Feb end Would recommend the higher rooms which are quite   See more room tips

The hotel is located in the area of Little India  On our arrival to the hotel we were greeted by friendly staff  From the porter at the door to the reception staff inside  the hotel could not do enough for us  We requested interconnecting rooms of which they obliged  We arrived to your standard  garden variety  run of the mill room  Nothing special but it was sufficient for our 4 night stay with 2 teenage boys  The room large  good sized beds  bathroom was clean and spacious and was cleaned and serviced everyday  Unfortunately our room 1234 was located right next to the lift well  so everytime the lift was operated we heard it in the room  There was an in room safe to ensure all valuables were locked away  WI FI was available within the hotel  Breakfast was included in our package each morning and we were not disappointed  A good range of local  western and Indian food   fresh fruits  cereals  cakes  full cooked etc  The gym and pool were maintained to a high standard If there would be any negative to this trip it would be that the hotel services a larger Indian clientele than western customers  They were rude  pushy and had no regard for others within the hotel  I had a couple of instances at breakfast with various people of different cultures just have no idea with the concept of manners and lining up   waiting your turn  The Park Royal as a product was excellent   I would not hesitate to stay at a Park Royal Hotel again but may not in Little India  All in all a fantastic holiday and can t wait to visit again and we will be staying within a Park Royal Hotel Room Tip  Request a room away from the Lift wellSee more room tips

This hotel is located in the Little India area with a large mall right across the street  Below that mall is an MRT station  making it very convenient to go just about everywhere on the island Wifi broadband is complimentary  It s fast but not very stable as the speed sometimes slowed quite a bit  Maybe it s because my wife and I fired up all our internet capable devices   2 laptops  2 iPads and 3 smartphones all at once  I guess it s because of all these simultaneous connections that caused the broadband to be a little sluggish  Our room had a flatscreen TV with RCA inputs for audio and video and also ports for HDMI and USB connections  These were not tested but it s a good thing to have just in case one needs to plug in external media There aren t any toothbrushes or toothpaste in the bathroom so we had to pop down to the nearest 24 hour convenience store to get some  Dental kits should be provided for convenience  Even budget motels will have these basic items in their amenities We stay for just a few hours  checked in late evening and checked out at dawn the following day  The Front Desk ladies on duty should smile a little more as they looked just as tired as we were  They were efficient no doubt but noticeably lacked a friendly and personal touch They could have been more proactive by informing us of a  quot Wake  amp  Take  takeaway breakfast when we told them of an early checkout  We only found out about the  quot Wake and Take quot  express takeaway breakfast much later in our room  Menu choices for the takeaway are limited to juice or coffee  sandwich or croissant  yogurt and fruit  The restaurant manager  Mr  Ganesan  I believe  was very helpful in arranging for our takeaway Other than the lack of dental kits and smiling Front Desk staff  my wife and I decided that the Park Royal Kitchener is not too bad a hotel in a good location Room Tip  Bring your own toothbrush and toothpasteSee more room tips

on a four night business stay in Singapore  this hotel fits the bill  Rooms are large and furnished  clean big bathroom  good sized beds and very comfortable  Breakfast range wasnt over the top but covered all fronts suitably  fresh fruit  continental  full cooked  asian breakfast  cereals etc   The hotels location is superb  its close to a mall  across the road from the MRT station  and lots of good restaurants around the area   there s even a 24 hour mall around the corner for the insomniacs out there  The only recommendation i make to the management is that your conceirge staff should be more present outside the hotel   even on Friday Saturday nights when you are more busy  There are steep steps and the lift taking people up from street to lobby level did not appear to be working and neither did the conveyor belt for luggage   in this situation having a member of staff from the hotel to help with bags would be good  The gym is well sized and well kept  the hotel swimming pool is a good size and well looked after  I d stay at this hotel again if i got the same deal rate and complimentary access to the business centre  all day free non alcoholic drinks  evening drinks and bar bites  free laundry per day and breakfast  If you re looking for a slice of colonial Singapore then this isnt the hotel for you  if you are however looking for somewhere comfortable and close to all main areas with lots of facilities on your door step this is the place  Dont be too perturbed by the large number of migrant Indian workers that hang out over the weekend in the area   they are polite enough and I experienced no problems as a single female traveller

Stayed in the hotel for 4 nights   The people at the concierge were helpful  We needed a change of room as one of our rooms was small   however the other rooms were full   So they offered us to upgrade our room to another floor   The only meals we had here was the breakfast   but it was nevertheless good

My wife and I had a complimentary night in a suite room as part of our wedding package at the hotel  We also booked a couple of superior rooms for our friends who helped at our wedding What we experienced were well appointed rooms  tastefully furnished with quality finishing  From the quality of mattresses and bed linen to the work desks and swivel chairs to the classy bathrooms  we were subtlely overawed  The superior rooms even had a classy lounger on which one can recline and read a book One of the other highlights of our stay is the service quality of the staff  From the doormen and bellhops to the F  amp  B staff  we were warmly treated  Any query or requests from us were met with a ready smile The buffet spread at the ground floor restaurant is also very good  It encompassed a range of western and local delicacies  and we were quite satisfied trying the various choices  This hotel is also centrally located  While it is not in the Central Business District  it is close enough  A mass rapid transit  MRT  train station is just across the road  and for those who are driving  the central expressway is just mere minutes away  The hotel¡¯s centrality and access to the MRT played a huge part in our choosing it for our wedding location Right beside the hotel are 2 major shopping centres  Mustafa is opened 24 hours and caters to a customer base mainly from the Indian sub continent  but is gaining popularity with locals and tourists from other nations as well  City Square Mall is just across the road  and it boasts numerous shops and eateries  Along with many smaller outlets in the vicinity  there is really an eclectic range of food choices around the hotel Room Tip  Ask for a non smoking floor if you don  39 t smoke See more room tips

We stayed at Park Royal on a vacation end of April 2013  We felt it was great value for money because we got a great deal on Booking com  We were supposed to stay for 9 days but unfortunately had to cut it down to 5 days because of a family emergancy back home  Since we had booked cancellable rooms in Booking com  we did not lose any money  but we had to deal with Booking com   who were very helpful  and the hotel goes by what they say  I have read very mixed reviews about this hotel before I travelled and I was a bit apprehensive  To my relief it was good in every aspect  Our rooms were on the 10th floor  We had two rooms and both were well done  spotlessly clean with comfy beds and good bathrooms  This is a standard tourist hotel which you encounter in many touristy cities in the world  It is very much on the expected lines and do not expect anything unique here  It is huge in size with maybe more than 1000 people staying here so dont expect things to be very personalzed  But Singapore hotel rates are so high  I felt this was good value for money  Despite the crowd  the staff are very friendly   I did not find even a single staff unfriendly during my 5 days of stay  I found them very efficient and smiling always  Especially Bella at the front desk  who helped us in so many ways  since we had to cut short our stay  It is true that the front desk is always crowded and the wait can be a bit too much  Since we had an early flight to catch  we finished the formalities the previous evening itself  The location was a plus for us  This is the heart of Little India and one may find it crowded  scruffy OR vibrant depending on your taste  The Farrer Park MRT is just across the street and getting around is no problem at all  The Mustafa Supermarket is right behind  Even though the place looks a bit shoddy  there are stuff one can buy at good rates  Mustafa also has a 24 hour food counter where you can grab a quick pizza slice or something like that late at night   The restaurants around this hotel are mostly Indian or local  So if you want something different you may have to go a bit afar  However in the mall opposite to the hotel there are some good restaurants which offers western breakfast  good coffee  coffee is always good in SG  and other western  fusion food  We did not eat breakfast at the hotel  I think it was a good decision becasue there are lots of cheaper options nearby  For Indian visitors there is Ananda Bhavan which is open 24 hours  couple of streets behind  I read a comment about slow lifts but definiltely the lift to my floor was not slow at all  I guess it was some other set of lifts   Did not visit the pool so no idea how that was  I could see the pool from my 10th floor room  and it was always almost empty  If I am visiting Singapore again I will definitely stay here

We stayed at Parkroyal for 5 nights in May 2013 Our check in at the hotel was later than the standard 2 PM check in time  hence we avoided the crowds which are typical in this property  which caters to a lot of tour groups from the sub continent The hotel is located in Little India next to Mustafa and close to a lot of Indian restaurants  Travellers from other countries may find the huge number of guests in the lobby a little overwhelming at times  but if one ignores the crowded entrance  this is a 534 room property and is mostly full   then the rest of the property is relatively quiet and peaceful Our check in and check out was managed by Kristen  who was efficient and pleasant  We were upgraded to a Family Room on the 15th floor  which was very spacious and comfortable  Room service and concierge services were prompt  The housekeeping service was very good and the room always had a nice  fresh fragrance whenever we returned after our sightseeing trips The hotel is conveniently located off Serangoon Road and is very close to Farrer Park MRT station  We did not eat at any of the hotel s restaurants and hence do not have any views on the food here A special note of appreciation to Gary Moran and his team for their efforts

To me Singapore stood synonymous for uncompromising standards  A developed South Asian country that was completely different from its third world counterparts  After consuming a stale croissant at Night Safari and spoilt fruit juice at Sentosa Island  I feel Singapore seems to be getting closer to its third world neighbors Stayed five nights at this hotel and on the third night I noticed the sheets were replaced with a sheet that had a big red stain  see picture   I was so tired that night that I did not notice the stain until next morning  Clearly the person changing the sheets knew that the sheet was not washed properly but still went ahead and used it anyways  I thought this kind of lapse brings very harsh punishments in Singapore but maybe am wrong Off the five nights we got newspaper delivered only for one day  I may sound very picky here but for the equivalent of 200 US dollars I expect 4 star services  This place is located near Little India and needless to say is filled with Indian guests  If you are allergic to Indians then stay away     Yes we Indians do push and shove people and are generally rude  I got a room close to the elevator but it had average views  see photos  On the plus side if you are an Indian then there is plenty of Indian food options just outside the hotel  The Farrer Place MRT station is very close to the hotel also a big plus The breakfast in the hotel may not be worth the price and am happy I did not include it in my hotel stay package  Overall this hotel is okay and yes sometimes you might get stained sheets

cor was also nice  Bathroom was adequately equipped and of reasonable size  A small fridge  iron  iron stand  tea coffee making facilities  two small mineral water bottles were provided  Bed was comfy and bed sheets were clean  The rooms were also quiet and there was no noise either from the street or from the hallway  Aircon control worked perfect  Vacuuming needs a bit looking into though Location  City square mall which we found to be one of the better ones in Singapore  is just across the road  Mustafa center  a 24 hour  gigantic departmental store is just behind the hotel  Farrer Park MRT station is also across the road  Concierge help you with taxi and luggage  We never had to wait for more than a minute to get a cab  All cab drivers seemed to know the location of this hotel  There are many Indian stores and restaurants  including Halal ones  next to hotel  There is a small mall one level below lobby floor  Taxi fare during day time to the zoo was around SGD17  to Sentosa around SGD 17  to most other places it was SGD6  Even during peak evening hours we rarely had to pay more than SGD10  There are many money exchangers near Mustafa center Hotel Staff  The staff were very courteous and helpful  Once we needed to take my son to a doctor  Manager  Mr  Siva immediately took us to a doctor located next to the hotel  On another occasion Manager Mr  Edmund also helped us out promptly  Highly recommended Room Tip  Get a room on higher floors for good views See more room tips
