This hotel puzzled me   walking into the foyer I was impressed and excited  but that soon changed when I reached my room on the 17th floor Now understand firstly that The Parkroyal on Kitchener is in Little India  as you would expect an area dominated by people from the sub continent  I arrived on a Sunday to find thousands of Indian men  but no women  milling around the streets and shops  some drinking beer  most just hanging around  I understand now that this is the place to go and thing to do on Sundays in Singapore  The sidewalks were very crowded and I felt completely out of place amid the throng The foyer of the hotel is very nice and the air was cool and calm once the auto doors closed behind me  Given the quality of the foyer  I was expecting my room to be equally appealing  Sadly  the room was ordinary at best  Although the room wasn t tiny  it felt cluttered and cramped  The fixtures and finishings were poor quality and it certainly was a disappointment I guess it was the little things that let me down  Like the TV that wasn t tuned properly to half the stations  Like the light inside the robe that wouldn t switch off when the door was closed  Like the tiny shower over the bath  with a shower curtain that clung to me despite my vocal protestations  Like the enormous curvy chair that seemed to consume half the room s floor space  Like the full length mirror covering the outside of the bathroom door  which made me jump every time I walked past it  Like the staff ringing the door bell at 8am just to hand me a newspaper  And the welcoming S 150 deposit that is required when checking in Having said all that  the International Buffet in Spices Brasserie  S 38    was very good  But then again  paying S 9 50 for a can of Coke in Chances bar was outrageous  Credit to all the staff I encountered  except for Mr Morning Newspaper  who were pleasant and efficient In summary I would say this   for the price  there are much better hotels in Orchard and other areas of Singapore  I wouldn t stay in Little India again  but even if the Parkroyal on Kitchener was moved to a different area of Singapore  it would need to pull its socks up to command the asking rate of S 200  per night  Renovation overdue

First let me say that I have lived in hotels for the past twenty years as a long stay guest  usually 2   6 months and have worked as Chief Engineer in a 350 room property  The staff at the front desk are not the sharpest tools in the trade and check in took near thirty minutes with three people to get it done  The elevator situation is terrible as the keys to the room only operate certain elevators  I understand the concept but when they have one lift down for renovation and the front desk staff says you you can use any elevator to your floor     you expect that it would work  The bathroom has black mold on the shower surround  in the grout on walls  and the vent is facing down and very dirty  the clean spot in the picture is what I cleaned whilst showering   The toilet seat is broken too  see picture  It makes one think that housekeeping does not clean the toilet     or care enough to call maintenance  Breakfast     Not sure if they are understaffed or just dont care how long the tables sit with dirty dishes  I sat down and had a long breakfast     didnt see anyone clean off tables whilst I was there  Food was average  fresh plates had food particles on several of the plates  Room 820 wasnt bad for a one night stay but the thermostat is inoperative  Internet worked without problems and TV channel selection was good as The property has so much potential and is a nice building  lobby etc  but the staff do injustice to the hotels reputation  This is not a property I will not recommend to anyone I know or will I be a return guest   Room Tip  The higher the floor the better See more room tips

If you are travelling to Singapore  the only other places that you might have heard of  apart from the Merlion  are the Mustafa Shopping Center and Little India  Both these places are located just behind the hotel  When I say behind the hotel  I mean a 2 minute walk Travelled there owing to an emergency  My parents were on a holiday in Singapore and were staying in the hotel when my mom slipped and had to undergo a surgery  The emergency response from the hotel staff was amazing and mom was in a hospital within 20 minutes It s a business and family hotel with a shopping mall bang opposite it and the Mustafa Shopping Center behind  The connectivity through taxis and public transport is good and there is a metro station at a 5 minute walk  The staff is helpful and are not nosy  as you would expect in a country where tourists from the region flock  They would not try and shove expensive tours down you  The rooms are spacious and the washrooms clean  They do not have HD satellite TV though  A nice reading desk and a comfortable bed coupled with a security locker that opens when you swipe your credit card  yes   makes it for a comfortable stay It s a good place for a short 3 4 day stay and back to the airport  A cab ride from the airport would cost you around 20 20 SGD

I know that people say that you only write bad things about your experiences and never report good but that is not true as I have written two nice reviews about the places I have stayed  Having said that I am not going to be overly positive about the Park Royal on Kitchener  This could be partly because we had just come from a five star resort in Thailand  We arrived at the hotel and were waiting at the check in counter for ages  Male guests kept on pushing in front of us without any sense of courtesy  We were provided with our room key eventually and made our way to our small poky room   queen bed  The bed was hard  We went to the hotel reception and asked what they could do about this  About 1 2 later someone came to our door with a single quilt and gave it to us and said this was all they could do about the bed  We stripped the bed and put the quilt over the mattress   not really a great outcome  the bed was still hard   There was no chair or lounge in the room so when we were in the room we were forced to sit on the bed  I realise that we didn t book a high level room but were looking for some basic comfort  The aircon worked well  We had breakfast included however as we are not Indian we did not really enjoy breakfast  It was a truly Indian influenced menu  Again at breakfast we struck the rudeness of the other patrons   pushy and arrogant  We even considered checking with the airline if we could get an earlier departure home  So sorry Parkroyal on Kitchener we wouldn t stay with you again

Stayed twice in a prior to and post cruise  Hotel slightly dated and work on lifts being done whilst there First two nights fine but last night we were let down by front desk staff  Should have had king bed   single bed in room when we checked in  however nothing there and the room was smaller than previous checking Spoke to front desk who said they could not give us the same size room as previous but would put a single bed in later that day   girl was not very accommodating also Upon our return at 11pm  still no single bed so daughter ended up with us in our bed Spoke to management about what had happened and girl had sent the single bed to a different room      Concierge very efficient and helpfulGood shopping centre across the road

We re staying at this hotel for two weeks  The room is spacious  well maintained and very clean  But surprisingly they always forget to provide the laundry bag during the room service which i believe it s the basic thing they should provide to the customers  It s near to farrer park station  24hrs mall  city square and the little india street  Not much to complaint about the food range provided for breakfast  A lot of choices  but maybe because of my long stay  i found it s not attempting anymore as everyday have the same options  Also had a dinner at the brasserie and i ordered charkuey teaw without realising that the chinese sausage may contain pork  i m a muslim    Luckily the staff there Ganesan  was very attentive and come back to us to address this Room Tip  If you  39 re a non smoker  choose the non smoking level or you  39 ll suffer for the rest of your s   See more room tips

Hotel ParkRoyal in located in the Little India area  The rooms and bath room were clean  comfortable bed  We chose this hotel based on the recommendation from our friend who spends most of his time in Singapore  The hotel offers breakfast with the room  We did not choose it  The breakfast buffet is very good with both Singapore Malay menu along with good selection of western breakfast items  You can order omelettes  Roti Kanai or Masala Dosa  The also serve oriental food  There are ample Indian restaurants within walking distance  with the famous Mustafa stores  Mega mall  just around the corner  The staff is very courteous and friendly  There is a big Mall across the street from the hotel  We will definitely stay here next time in Singapore

Hotel PARKROYAL is located on Kitchener Road near Little India and is a great Hotel to stay in Singapore with very nice spacious rooms  large breakfast spread and great service  The hotel offers neat and clean rooms  nice bathrooms with very good amenities in the room  The Hotel has several Indian restaurants close by and several tourist attractions very near  This is indeed a great place to stay in Singapore

We picked this hotel mainly for its location and availability of vegetarian Indian food  Quite true to that  there is a vast choice ranging from Komala Vilas  Saravana Bhavan  Raj etc etc all at walking distance from the hotel With Mustafa being right next door  doesnt matter if u forgot to carry anything  esp those little things that kiddos need  Room  deluxe  located on the 16th floor was neat and clean  From what i have heard  the room is quite spacious going by Singapore standards   Availability of in room wifi is truly helpfulSince we used taxis for all local commute  transport wasnt an issue  dint get a chance to use the MRT   The bellboys at the hotel entrance always help to flag down taxis when needed What did not go well with us was the treatment we received at the restaurant We were on a breakfast inclusive package  While the food wasnt great  remember we were on the second leg of our vacation in Singapore  having earlier stayed at Moevenpick   which had its own issues too but people willing to listen and rectify the same   there were some veggie Indian options like idlis  parata  rice etc  Glad to have found idlis since that was the only staple our toddler agreed to eat during the entire trip With the kiddo still young  too active  not able to really sit and eat at a crowded restaurant     the best idea was to take the food to the room and feed her  this would perhaps be her first good and single meal in the day   On Day 1  when requested  i was told the hotel policy doesnt allow guests to carry food even for young children to the room  Found a manager  in a black suit  in the restaurant and on request  he readily agreed and even offered to send the food thru their staff  What a nice gesture   On Day 2  i had the same request  The young lady at the reception said  NO  and when i told her i was allowed to do this the previous day  she said  IS YOUR CHILD SICK   CANT SHE COME DOWN  and well i had to explain again that the child was young and could handle the crowd and eat herself  And i did not want the child to miss this meal lest she would get drained by the time we came back from the sightsee trips  Again i had to request the gentleman and he agreed  Day 3  same story  When i asked the restaurant front desk if i could speak to the  gentleman in the black suit  who had earlier helped  i got this curt reply  Everyone here is a gentleman   I dont know who you are looking for   Well finally  i found the saviour and after he agreed  the lady at the front desk says  Maam  you cant take too many things back to the room    well all i took on all 3 days was 2 idlis and a cup of milk  And we had paid for the child breakfast during booking I also remember having read in their in room brochure that take away is possible  All that i am complaining here  and hence had to re produce verbatim  that hotels need to really have some soft heart  if already in their policy else make amends  especially for travellers with little children  How does it feel every morning when you hear such things at the restaurant and need to keep giving answers   all to justify that a hungry little child needs to eat If you plan to buy tickets to any of the attractions  this hotel doesn t help with that  They only have a counter which arranges group tours if needed

We loved our stay stay  Stopped over for 2 days while enroute to Australia  My spouse is wheelchair bound and we were not inconvenienced in anyway during our stay Our request for a wheel chair accessible room was accorded  The room appeared dated and could do with a tad more sprucing  The Hotel itself appears to be a little dated and seems to be busy all the time  Breakfast was good The staff made us feel comfortable right from the start  The boys at the door were always smiling and the girls at the desk were cheerful One particular staff  Siva was super helpful  He went out of his way to make our flight back to Sydney a pleasant one  He assisted us with the online check in  made sure that there was a staff at the airport to assist us with the wheel chair and more importantly made sure that I had my preferred meals  He did not stop here and allowed us to stay in our room till 4pm without having to pay  Besides being a staff  Siva is a great person with genuine sincerity  It was a pity that we could not see on the day we were leaving 4 Stars for the Hotel and 5 Stars for Siva

The hotel is very good  and not that expensive for Singaporean standards  Location is not so good  it is in Little India which is not the tidiest place in town  and is far from the river  so if you go for a couple of days to see the city I would recommend a hotel closer to the river  which is very nice to walk by  Parkroyal on Chinatown has an impressive building with roof gardens and Chinatown is much nicer than Little India  We took the hop on hop off bus which has several routes and you can see the whole city  It is also very easy to take a bus to go anywhere in Singapore

We stayed for 4 nights at the hotel and by the time we left  the place felt a bit like home  The service was great and the rooms were big and spacious  can definitely recommend it to anyone The Farrer Park MRT is just a couple of minutes away  and the location is also very convenient as the mustafa center as well as numerous eating places are nearby

I was heading home and had one more night and needed to be close to Little India so the Parkroyal on Kitchener Road was recommended and I was most impressed with the stay  The hotel is a really good 4 star hotel that offers a few very simple but good points in a perfect location  The room was spacious with a nice king size bed  good view and bathroom to match  The pool  amp  gym on the 6th floor are again as the rest of the hotel  ideal   the gym has plenty of machines to choose from  actually a really good gym for any gym fan  oh I would add one thing     a clock and make sure there is some music on  The pool is again fine for a relaxing swim after work or to sit around with the family  okay its not some big resort pool  but at the average price point of around  200 its very good value  Breakfast was fine  nice balanced selection and the local area will tempt the lovers of excellent Indian food      walk around the corner and the choice is endless  If you need to do a few last minuet shopping then again there is a nice shopping mall one minuet walk      even the MRT is only a one minuet walk that will take you anywhere in Singapore for a buck or two        even the airport  but then if you spend  17 then a taxi can take you there in 20 min compared to 40 on the train Room Tip  Book a club room so you have that added service and a few nice cocktails to come home to See more room tips

Having stayed at Park Royal  on Kitchener Road  on a business trip  there were compelling reasons for me to prefer it during a family visit Location  Close to Farrer Park Metro Station and Little India  In general  SIngapore is safe and there is a lot of activity around this place to make people feel secure  On the down side  on Sunday evenings on nearby Serangoon Road  one can find a number of expatriate males blankly gathering without an agenda or a smile on their faces  It seems a little unsettling at first Accommodation  Spacious and well lit  Mini bar can be filled with items of your liking  There need to be more plug points accommodating international pins Amenities  Gym and swimming pool on the 6th floor are an added advantage Food  Had only breakfast  Excellent  enormous spread from different cuisines Service  Front desk and room service are good  Though it is a 24 hour check in  be prepared to wait if you land early  as do travellers from India Physical Connectivity  As mentioned  closed to Metro rail station  Buses are also nearby  Taxis can be hailed too Network connectivity  WiFi is slow  Wired connection gives acceptable browsing speeds Summary  A pricy  but excellent place to stay  Will recommend to other travellers Room Tip  Ask for a room on the higher floors See more room tips

Stayed here for one night in January 2012 on the way back from Melbourne Australia  ok so the review is a little late  This Hotel is adequate for a one night stay but wouldn t want to stay any longer We had a family room which was an unusual shape to say the least and even more unusually there was a six inch gap by the window which seperates the kids section from the adult section  This didn t worry us as we were tired and just wanted to sleep The amenities were pretty basic but ok for a good priced overnight stay  The only issue I had was with the carpet which just made me feel itchy  fleas  looking at it  We didn t have any issue with either fleas or bites   the carpet was just past it s best and needed replacing The beauty of this hotel is its location  It s right next door to  quot Mustafa quot  which I understand is a shopping centre  we didn t visit as we were on the way back to Blighty after 4 weeks in Australia and just couldn t be bothered   At the front of the hotel was another mall  where we ate and a Metro station that we did use so that we could get another  quot Singapore Sling quot  in at Raffles before returning home  We didn t find the hotel noisy given its location on a busy road in bustling Singapore In summary good for one night at a reasonable price and well located

You can always get a feel for an Hotel on check in  Our checking took a good half hour with the girl finally telling us that she didn t have a room with a double bed on a non smoking floor but to her credit she did offer an upgrade to a deluxe room but on a smoking floor which didn t suite us The room was very small with two also small beds  There was some sort of portable air conditioner in the entrance and a sweets wrap on the floor  the bathroom also had remnants of the mop still there The room was very very tired with scuff marks on lower walls and a grubby thread bare carpet that was poorly laid  The small table and chair were very old and in need of a good clean  Even the back of the entrance door was covered in hand prints that the cleaner had failed to see The Air conditioning control unit was stuck on 22c so we asked for extra blankets but were only delivered one   After a request for a blanket for the second bed the maid called the repair man   it s now 9 45 pm  who fixed the control There is also an exposed electrical terminal block beside the bathroom mirror that could cause a fatality if touched In fairness to the hotel they did offer to change rooms for us on several occasions but as we were only here for one night we couldn t be bothered repacking   Management also offered us compensation which we appreciated  We always contribute  and value other Tripadvisors suggestions and because of the majority of good reviews we chose this Hotel  Sadly this was without doubt the worst experience we have endured at any hotel in the world and would advise others to avoid this Hotel if possible

When we were looking for hotels in Singapore all we could find was squalor with bad reviews in even worse locations or expensive chain hotels which we couldn t afford  This hotel was at the top of our budget but it was the only one that fell in between the two extremes Overall we thought the hotel was good  the lobby and entrance were nice and the staff were very helpful  Our room was slightly dated but we did get one of the un refurbished rooms  that were going cheap   Despite this the room was still very clean and comfortable The hotel is not in central Singapore but it is right next to a subway station so you can get everywhere from there  I would stay in this hotel again

I stayed at the Parkroyal on Kitchener Road with my husband and two teenage daughters in August 2008  I wanted to stay in Little India as I thought it would be an experience for my daughters rather than staying somewhere central like Orchard Road  It certainly was that     we arrived on a Sunday afternoon and the streets were packed with people  The hotel itself was very comfortable and clean and the staff were friendly and helpful   in particular the concierges who were always happy to run around finding us taxis  The rooms and the beds were comfortable  although my daughters  room did smell a little damp  The pool was a welcome oasis after a busy day  The breakfasts were excellent and a great way to start a day of sightseeing  Taxis are a cheap and easy way to travel around the city although we did try the MRT also  A visit to the Mustafa Centre is a must as well as the beautiful temple in Serangoon Road  We loved Boat Quay and Clarke Quay for eating out in the evening and would also recommend a visit to the Botanical and Orchid Gardens  the Night Safari and Raffles for coffee or a drink  Chinatown was charming and we had a great lunch at Old Shanghai in Temple Street  I would recommend the Parkroyal on Kitchener Road if you want to see Singapore from a different perspective

As a family we have been staying together or when travelling solo at the Park Royal on Kitchener for over 10 years  This hotel truly is our home away from home  The hotel is located in Little India  and is surrounded by vibrant shops and Indian restaurants  as well as the 24hr Mustafa Shopping Centre  To the front of the hotel is the City Square Mall   where you will be able to satisfy your shopping  dinning  beauty  banking  money changing  gaming etc needs  There is even a dental clinic there  which I ve used   it s first class  The City Square Mall leeds to the Farrer Park MRT station  from where you can access the Singapore underground train system  As for the hotel  the staff are super friendly and always go the extra mile with regards to helpfulness and attentiveness  The rooms are clean and spacious as far as Asian hotel rooms go  The bathrooms are supplied with above average amenities  and there are robes and slippers to be found in the room  The hotel has a state of the art gym  spa and a lovely outdoor pool area   with a smaller splash pool for children  As for dining  it s a well known fact that Singaporeans love to eat  At this hotel you will be able to experience an international array of cuisines  Buffet breakfasts covering the western  Indian  Chinese and Japanese palate  speciality seafood buffet evenings as well as a la carte menus  There is a Chinese restaurant and tea house serving predominately Szechaun cuisine  which is a particular favourite of mine   especially being served tea with a teapot that has a metre long spout  On the ground level of the hotel there is a pub club where there is always a happy hour of sorts going on and you can indulge in cocktails   not forgetting the Singapore Sling Room Tip  Pay a little bit extra and upgrade to the Orchid Club  These room are located from the 19th floor up   See more room tips

We got to this hotel after we had a delayed flight in from Dubai we got to the hotel at 10 30 and were told that our room that was booked was not available anymore and we would have to stay in a different room with two separate beds  very small  we would have to try and come back to reception tomorrow to see if the superior room was available  as we had booked months in advance we couldn t understand why it wasn t available  breakfast was a bit chaotic  we had this included with our stay booked through a travel agent first day we were not down for breakfast after a lot of getting documents sent over to prove we did have breakfast they let us have it  we thought that would be the end of this  but no everyday day we had to go through the same scenario    They did move us eventually to the room that we had booked on the second day of our stay   it just felt like a battle and I don t like this in a hotel  on the plus side we really enjoyed Singapore  links to the metro and the mall are brilliant  It was some sort of public holiday while we there so maybe that added to our problems as the hotel was very busy  this is my first bad review  but I would not recommend this hotel

Singapore was an unexpected stopover as a result of not being able to fly back to the UK via Bangkok from Koh Samui  So needless to say  we knew nothing of this hotel  let alone Singapore Upon arrival  the concierge helped us with our luggage and the reception staff booked us into a twin room   not an issue as this was the only room available in a hotel that seemed to be taking in all waifs and strays from those attempting to get home from Thailand   The room was located on the 12th floor  adjacent to the lifts and unfortunately for us it was also a smoking floor and the room really really smelled of stale smoke  However  the room was lovely with twin beds  which were a little hard but apparently this is the case with most east Asian countries  We had spectacular views of the city and it was clear the room had recently undergone a series of renovations  particulary the carpet and bathroom  with a shower that was most welcoming  We also received two complimentary bottles of water which again was great as it was some 35c outside Breakfast was superb  I honestly don t think I ve had one quite like it as it met everyone s taste  Excellent As our check out time was midday  we were able to use the pool and gym facilities and of course the showers that came along with it as we did not need to leave for the airport until 7 30pm  The staff were very helpful and as we had lockers we were able to dump out stuff and go and see some of this amazing city  which we intend to visit again  this time  properly    Although we didn t get very far  the smells eminating from the Little India area was sublime and we wished we could have been around long enough to experience the food  The hotel as a whole is between a 3 and 4 star accommodation in my opinion as it seemed when they were busy  they had real trouble ensuring customer services were met and some would say they could have come across as being a little rude  though very much working under pressure   We wanted an extra pillow for the room as my husband suffered from a bad back  however laundry had run out of them  and even if therer were some  they couldn t deliver them as they were closed  it was 10 30pm and we arrived at 10 00pm  When we eventually come back to this amazing city  we shall certainly be staying at this hotel  just on a different level  and I would certainly recommend it to anyone going to Singapore

We spent three weeks travelling in Hong Kong  Australia and Singapore and  of the seven hotels we stayed in  this was by far the worst Upon arrival we were told that the twin  Superior  room we had booked was unavailable and that we had been  upgraded  to a larger  Superior  room on the 12th floor The room was dingy with poor quality furniture  a large old CRT TV  and a carpet that was fraying at the edges  The bathroom had grubby grouting along the bat edge  the shower and taps were old and discoloured  the door hinges rusty and the door paintwork in very poor condition Staff were helpful but those in the brasserie and the Chinese restaurant spoke little English and had difficulty in explaining the menu options  The food in the Chinese restaurant was dry and unappetising and vastly overpriced The bar on the same floor as Reception was also incredibly expensive and the singer in there had the volume turned up to a level more suited to a stadium gig  When we asked for it to be turned down a little so that we could hear each other talk we were told that the level was fine The area in which Park Royal on Kitchener is located is a little down at heel compared with other parts of the city and some distance away from most areas which visitors would want to see  As a result most trips out start with the short walk to the MRT at Farrer Park When making arrangements to leave  Concierge told us that a maxi cab would cost S 45 for the two of us and we would have to pay in advance  Rough Guide says S 7 per person Overall  a very disappointing end to a fabulous trip

Our family stayed for 4 nights at Parkroyal on Kitchener Road  Singapore in early June 2008  It is nicely refurbished and the ambience all over is very welcoming  The room is very comfortable for Singapore standards while the rate is competitive for its class  The staff is friendly  informative and most helpful with sightseeing suggestions Access to transport is good  Vicinity to shopping facilities  amp  food outlets is definitely helpful when one travels with family members   The children enjoyed the swimming pool tremendously Overall I have to admit that the good experience staying at this hotel made my family determined to return for another holiday trip within the next 12 months  We would be happy to return to the familiar Parkroyal on Kitchener Road

I booked this hotel as it seemed to be a good price for a 3 star in Singapore and also had good reviews on trip advisor   We were very pleasantly surprised as the hotel has been recently refurbished and is very modern and swish We found the check in staff who dealt with us to be friendly and polite and they even upgraded us from a superior to a deluxe room as we were staying for a week  Our room was very clean with a good supply of toileteries  tea and coffee making facilities  We ate breakfast just once and it was very good with a wide cultural choice of dishes but it was quite expensive as hotel breakfasts often are and there are cheaper alternatives in the area The concierge was super efficient and could always answer our queries   We were directed to a very reasonable and tasty dim sum restaurant a short walk down Hastings road by the concierge  We really liked eating at the food court which is next door to the park royal and if you like indian food you should try it  They have the best nan bread in Singapore  The Mustaffa centre is close by as are a couple of other smaller shopping cenres and using the MRT from Farrer Park station you can be anywhere in Singapore quite quickly and easily Little India is a fascinating area and I would stay here again

The hotel was very busy the weekend I was there  Despite this and the huge line of people at reception  the reception staff were cold but efficient at first although became much warmer as my stay continued  I had booked a  superior  room and was given a room which smelled of damp  was dirty  including sweet papers under the bed  had broken furniture and paint in serious need of redoing   I can add photos of the room if people would like to see them  It also had an adjoining door to the very noisey family in the room next door     and believe me I was not a happy bunny I met with a Manager to discuss my concerns and she told me that  superior  was the lowest standard room they had at the hotel  Perhaps people booking rooms should be aware of this   it might help them to select a better room  incidentally my  inferior  Superior room cost me 100 euros per night   The receptionist who checked me in reminded me several times that breakfast was not included in a room  at the rate  I had booked  Given the standard of the room I was rather pleased that I had the option to go out for a nice breakfast After much discussion the manager upgraded me to a nicer room  which had all of the comforts you would expect a nice hotel to have  I have to say to its credit the second room was so much nicer than the first and had a nice flat screen TV  more modern    furniture and a bigger bathroom  The rest of my stay went smoothly with the  nicer  room being well cleaned daily   again I have some photos of this room and can add them to the review if required  The area the hotel is in is called Little India and is full of interesting shops  restaurants  food stalls  markets and Indian temples  At weekends a large number of Indian guys congregate outside the hotel and are very chatty and love talking with tourists This is a hotel that I think can improve with a little updating and some training of staff in basic customer services skills  I would certainly consider staying here again subject to having a decent room and of course i would put more work into comparing prices of other hotels If you would like any more info on my experiences of this hotel   or others i have reviewed   please feel free to mail me

I stayed at the Parkroyal for three nights in September  and loved it The lobby is large and airy with a beautiful display of orchids near the lifts  Check in was completed quickly  and we were given a room on the eleventh floor  which looked over the pool area and towards Little India  The room was very big with three 3 4 sized beds  a large wardrobe and a smallish  but well equiped  bathroom  The air conditioning was very efficient  and quiet enough to leave on all night  and boy did we need it  Breakfast was included in our package  and was amazing   there was everything you could possibly think of  and all on a buffet basis  so you could eat as much as you wanted The hotel is well positioned with a MRT  underground train  station just a few minutes walk away  although taxi s are very cheap in Singapore too  a 15 minute ride to Raffles cost just  5  A must do is a visit to the Mustafa Centre which is just round the corner from the hotel  This is a department store like you ve never seen before   piles  and I mean piles  of watches  and jewellery  huge racks full of shoes  more toiletries than you can imagine  and many other things are crammed into the three storey shop While in Singapopre another must is High Tea at Raffles and a Singapore Sling in the Long Bar  also at Raffles  throwing peanut shells on the floor of the Long Bar was great fun  and it s the only place in Singapore where you won t get a hefty fine for throwing things on the floor

Firstly  you get what you pay for  Singapore is an expensive destination where accommodation is concerned  particularly when you have 3 children and may need 2 rooms in a hotel  The Parkroyal on Kitchener is actually very reasonably priced and has a good main restaurant on the ground floor   we had a very good dinner there one night that was also very well priced  S 50 for two people for a full buffet  including steamboat   Breakfast included a good range of food  although on our last morning the croissants were stale  So what went wrong  Firstly  I booked through a third party  booking com  and requested inter connecting rooms well in advance  When we arrived very late at night after our flight from Sydney  after midnight Singapore time and 2am our time  we were informed that we were not in inter connecting rooms  in fact the rooms weren t even adjoining   quot We do not guarantee inter connecting rooms quot  the receptionist stated stiffly  Fair enough  but we did ask 6 months in advance  We also made it clear on the booking form that our family consisted of 5 members  so we needed beds for 5  Our two  non interconnecting  rooms had beds for two people each  So another wait for a rollaway bed to arrive  The rooms themselves were okay  although one overlooked a car park  We also were a little unhappy that we had asked for a room higher up in the building but instead were placed on level 7  Rooms on lower levels obviously have very limited views but there are also other issues   more on that shortly We managed to get moved to inter connecting rooms the next morning after raising this with reception again  We were advised to leave our packed luggage in one of the rooms  which would be moved by staff into the adjoining room of our other room during the day while we were out  However  when we arrived back late in the afternoon the staff at reception seemed to know nothing about this  and yes our bags were still in the former room  Another lengthy wait before the concierge arrived to open up the old room so our luggage could be shifted  The other main issue related to the adequacy of the lifts  Three tiny lifts serve this rather large building   toally inadequate  On one morning we had to wait 15 minutes for a lift that actually had some room in it   lift after lift arrived at our floor that was jam packed with people  In the end several members of our family found the stairs and walked down to breakfast  Another reason for requesting a room on a higher level  Good points of the hotel  with the exception of one person at reception  staff were friendly and did their best to provide information and resolve problems  The pool was large and clean  the children enjoyed it immensely  Pool towels were provided by the hotel  Rooms had charging points for USB devices  Breakfast was generally of a good standard with plenty of variety  for Western guests anyway   The Farrer Park MRT station was a short walk  2   3 minutes  away  and the location of the hotel in the little India district meant there was no shortage of Indian restaurants nearby  Free wi fi was available Overall  however  this hotel needs to lift its game  particularly in the area of communication and front office customer service Room Tip  Request a room on a higher levelSee more room tips

 Save loads on taxi fare if you take the train to Orchard Road  Town   or to VivoCity  universal studios  Sentosa   etc  There is a little mall opposite the hotel  which is modern with about 10 cafes entrance to the MRT station  opposite a great Mall  city mall  and surrounded by lots of places to eat  Alcohol is expensive here   20 for two drinks  but next door is a pub which is cheaper  and in the Mall the supermarket is even cheaper if you just want a cold one by the pool  We chose not to have breakfast include  there are lots of places locally selling toast and coffee or muffins at a much I booked this hotel without a second though when my in laws are planning to visit Singapore early this year  It s because  near little india  near mustafa shopping center   a place where you can buy literally from salt to car s and it s 24x7   near city area  near MRT  so I can visit using Singapore s great public Infra instead of paying for taxi The hotel is located across Farrer Park MRT station  Mass Rapid Transport and it can bring you to any corner of Singapore in less than an hour  and you can see once you enter the hotel lobby a lot of tourists and their bags around the reception  Though not a good sight it shows how popular it is with the tourists  You can also see a lot of chinese  and other nationals around  The hotel Teochew porridge is quite popular too This time I ended up paying a bit more due to the last min booking but most of the times the superior room wont go beyond 150 bucks per night  By the way if you are expecting great views or wonderful scenery then it d be a great disappointment for you

I have returned back to Singapore after almost 5 years and staying at Park Royal brought back so many memories  Located at such a fantastic location with tons of so many Indian restaurants and just next to Mustafa  Park Royal offered everything a visitor wants  With such a fantastic gym  swimming pool and sumptuous breakfast  stay at Park Royal is worth many times the money they charge  I stayed on the executive floor  so they offered breakfast and complimentary drinks in the evevning  I loved the great view from the top floor  I am waiting for a next chance to get there  Just love their hospitality

Pros 1  Fantastic Location2  Very good food around the hotel 3  City Square mall is located right opposite the hotel  Serves one of the best cuisines and fast food and has all the major brands in house for shopping 4  Mustafa is right adjacent to the hotel  What more can you ask for   5  MRT on the opposite side 6  All major tour operators pick you from the hotel 7  Serves Indian food for breakfast plus continental too Cons     Only one  Early Check inn after an overnight flight is difficult  Plan your arrival accordingly  We don t like persuading for rooms   Check inn time is 1500 hrs   Plan your arrival accordingly and you will fall in love with the hotel even more than we did     We arrived at the hotel around 11 Am on 22nd September 2015  after an overnight flight from Mumbai    Reception staff are good and efficient but little bit reluctant to offer rooms early despite having rooms available Firstly it was told the rooms are unavailable and are getting ready but later we were told it is hotel policy  We had already emailed them couple of times before arrival and asked for early check inn   as we are having a 2 year old kid with us   Was it because we booked through a travel agent   we don t know   Mystery remains unsolved    After repeated persuasions   we were offered rooms at around 12 Pm  Had you given the rooms on the first request   we would have been more happier But still  we Loved your hotel and rooms  ambience were fantastic and we would still recommend and stay in your hotel again  Room Tip  We stayed in Seventh Floor 701 and 702  Zero complaints See more room tips

Unfortunately the hotel is in need of a renovation and some sound proofing from the rooms next door  The food selection lacked vegetables and staff hovered over us whilst eating hoping to take away our dirty dishes  The area outside the hotel is very grotty and feels a bit in secure  but the station is close by and easy to use  so we did a lot of visiting to other nicer areas of Singapore  Make sure you ask for an upgrade  as staff won t offer it and for the extra 80 or so Singaporean Dollars  you get breakfast and laundering included  which can be worthwhile  Most staff were friendly  however  some were quite dis engaged and others spoke very little English

I stayed there for 3 days and yes it looks nice and closer to all the attractions  I m not very happy with the food  rice were over cooked and the restaurant manger  Orchid  does not know how to treat their customers  the first look is amazing and the people who work in front office are very friendly  The room service is not fast  had to call few time to ask for an extra bed  the bathrooms are okey but it really needs a repair  the view is nice Room Tip  closer to the attractionsSee more room tips

We stayed at ParkRoyal on Kitchener road for 4 nights from 16th 20th Sept 2015  The hotel is very close to the Farrer park MRT and 30 minutes from Changi Airport on Taxi  The rooms are very comfortable for a family of two adults and two kids  The hotel staff was very friendly and accomodated our requests for early check in and late check out We got a neat deal  despite the hotel being overbooked for the F1 season I would recommend it to my friends and family and would love to stay here again

The Parkroyal is a dated building located well in Little India  The foyer is plain but functional  and the rooms are a good size   the high ceiling provides a sense of space  The bathroom is very old fashioned   shower over the bath  old fashioned basin  old finishes  but all quite serviceable   The beds and pillows are fine  Our room faced away from the street and was very quiet  The pool area is not fancy but again very functional  We had the lunch buffet one day and it was of good standard and very well priced  The hotel is over the road from a modern shopping mall which houses an MRT station  so it is super easy to get around the city  It is also just 100 metres from the Mustafa Centre  a 24 7 shopping mall with an enormous stock of just about everything  All up  the ParkRoyal is a very cost effective option in an interesting part of town  but don t go if you are looking for a modern  flash  five star experience

We had a two bed family room  Okay space  However it had an adjoining room and our neighbours were VERY noisy  Most important thing in a hotel is the ability to sleep and we couldn t  There is no soundproofing between the rooms and add a shouting family and wailing children in to the mix and it is a disaster  Our neighbours were so noisy the children couldn t sleep  But main problem was the connecting door offered no sound proofing  They may as well have been in the room next to us  Really spoiled our trip as we were so tired during the day  On the second night we complained and they did offer to move us but only to a similar room a couple of floors above  So we didn t take them up on the offer  fortunately on our last night the staff put a hold on the room next door so we would have some peace and quiet  So we got one night sleep out of 4  Hmmm  Room always was pretty grubby  Bathroom grout black  Shower parts missing  Wouldn t go here again and wouldn t recommend  If you have booked make sure you get a room without a connecting door

We stayed at the Parkroyal on Kitchener Road for 3 nights over the Grand Prix weekend which corresponded with our return to Australia from Europe  With the GP weekend being a very busy weekend in Singapore I was pleasantly surprised by the value for money that the Parkroyal was offering  The hotel may not be on Orchard Rd or down by the Bay but with the efficiency of the MRT and the closeness of the hotel to the Farrer Park station getting around was not a problem  We were arriving on an early flight so we had asked for an early check in  when we arrived at the hotel the room wasn t ready but the staff at reception promised it as quickly as possible  and in the meantime offered us a number of alternatives where we could wait in relative comfort  Our bags were stored by the hotel and sent promptly to our room once we had checked in  The hotel is not a new one and the decor of the room reflects this  but the room had everything that you expect in a hotel of this standard  Breakfast was included in our package and they certainly offered a wide selection to choose from  We would certainly come back to the Parkroyal on Kitchener Rd for any future visits to Singapore

Fantastic Hotel located at a very good location  Super accessibility with Farrer Park station just round the corner  Mustaffa Shopping mall is hardly 2 minutes walking distance with the Metro station hardly 5 minutes walking distance  the rooms are quite nice with very friendly staff and an excellent spread for breakfast  The property is frequented by Indians  The dinner buffet is a bit overpriced at SGD 45

Great location  quick access to Indian food  which is a big plus if you re traveling with an infant  which was our case   right opposite City Square Mall and on the backside of Mustafa  quite convenient for any last minute shopping   10 min drive away from Orchard  Bugis  Merlion and most other destinations of interest  We generally Uber d our way around and an average to and fro would cost us c S 20  which I was happy to pay given I had a 1 year infant and a stroller to move around with  But if you re a public transport enthusiast  the Farrer Park MRT is at a stone s throw from the hotel Great rooms  very functional  won t say that they exuded luxury but were spick  amp  span and very cozy  housekeeping was very efficient and reasonably quick in responding  in room dining was very expensive though and anyway there were plenty of options available nearby  standard gym  pool and spa facilities were available  very courteous staff except for if you re trying for an early check in  which is usually the case if you re coming in from India    they were ready to let us in at 9 AM for an additional charge of S 100 where the room cost was c S 225  Luckily  we got our room at 12  which was the standard check out time  the standard check in is at 3   after we came back from a stroll nearby picking up a local sim card and some breakfast  The hotel breakfast has a decent spread  and a separate section dedicated to Indian food  which can be said to be average at best  Can t comment on the non vegetarian though On food  you could always order from the Jewel of India restaurant which is situated in the Arcade on Level 1 in the hotel building  Refer my Jewel of India review for further details  but in a nutshell  the food is very palatable  even by Indian standards  and not overpriced Overall  I would recommend this hotel to Indian travelers who are looking for a comfortable stay in Little India

To start off  we were 3 Indian families and stayed there for 6 nights  We wanted to stay in the Indian locality especially due to our preference for Indian vegetarian food  We zeroed in on this hotel based on positive reviews on trip advisor and happy to say that we were not at all dissapointed  We had a very nice and comfortable stay  The staff are very courteous and helpful  The rooms were spacious and clean  Me and my wife didn t try the food in the hotel but were told by my friend that the breakfast spread was very good and had a good variety to choose from The pricing is decent and the best part was all the Indian eateries were within a short walking distance from the hotel  On the whole had a good stay and would recommend the place to any traveller  especially one who is looking for a short stay in Singapore with easy access to Indian veg food  Ananda Bhavan veg restaurant is open 24 hours and is under 5 minutes walking distance from the hotel

The Park Royal on Kitchener is an excellent hotel  offering great facilities and very helpful  friendly staff  Our 9 year old daughter was made to feel very special by the staff  This was our second visit  During our first visit three years ago  our mattress was quite hard  When we booked this time we requested a soft mattress and it was extremely comfortable We arrived early on the morning of our check in  We were given card access to the pool gym and change shower facilities so we could freshen up  swim and come and go until our room was ready The hotel is next door to the Mustafa Department Store  offering a huge range of just about everything  It is at the beginning of Little India  which offers great restaurants from budget to top quality  There are also a myriad of small stores offering great value clothing  jewellery and electronics The in hotel Spice Brasserie offers an amazing range of top quality dishes  all excellent quality Although this is an expensive hotel  it is top quality and offers excellent value for money Highly recommended

This is hotel is 4 star only for name sake  doesnt provide any facilities like that of 4 starReception staff was not at all courteous  and one can see large crowds gathered around reception  since staff is not efficientRooms have basic amenities and washrooms are below averageAn order will take minimum 30mins to be deilvered to your roomRoom phone doesnt have basic information about which numbers to call for each of the destination like room service or receptionOnly good thing about the hotel is location since its close to MRT  hop on hop off bus stop  amp  Mustafa centreSo if you are seeking luxury this is not a place for youClub is damn shady  AC was not working we struggled a lot with the panel yet at night it was hot inside the room

The only positive points of this Hotel is the location  next to Mustafa  metro station across the road and located in Little India  Now to begin the worst points  we booked two rooms  with obvious assumption  we will be given adjoining rooms  When we checked in  we were offered rooms on two different floors  the staff at the reception was too rude especially the guy  I dnt want to mention his name here  we were told some Corporate have booked two floors  I didn t buy this  n I was clear I will check in only when I get rooms on same floor  after struggling for an hour  we were given rooms on same floor  imagine an hour wasted to check in  Now let s enter rooms  air conditioning worst  rooms although clean but were giving shabby feeling  no outside view  none of the staff ever asked us for anything that we would need  Strongly not recommended

Very beautifully located and a gr8 place to stay  was there for 3 nights and had a very good time here  located near little india and the mustafa centre perfect place for shopping   nice view from the rooms And easy to access MRT station right in front of the hotel two malls near by its a perfect place to stay I recommend people to stay here if they are on holiday in Singapore

I checked into a non smoking room and found a strong cigarette smoke smell  Asked for a change of room but the concierge took ages to shift the luggage and finally did it myself  The AC in the re allocated room didn t work and after repair  the temperature control never worked for the 3 nights I stayed there  Good things   location and the breakfast spread Room Tip  Ensure all the in room facilities work before unpacking your luggagebSee more room tips

Welcoming and comfortable hotel  We stayed in a great Family Room that had joining 2 rooms with 2 singles and 1 king  Each had own TV althought only one bathroom in King Bed room  Great location in Little India and to MRT  Farrar Park   On same MRT line for quick access to Sentosa  Vivo City shopping and Chinatown  City Square Shopping Centre across the road gave great options for dinner at the top floor hawkers market and ground floor western food and a supermarket for incidentals  Fabulous local Hawkers Market short walk away for local cuisine which was fabulous for  3 4 a meal   Delicious  Felt like we had experienced part of the real Singapore and not just the expensive  western American orientated Sentosa Island  Would stay again

Thank you Sharmini GM and Shanti Manager for your excellent service  I stayed for 5 nights with children with 2 connecting rooms  Though I booked two standard rooms seperately but hotel staff immediately upgraded me to Deluxe connected rooms as per my email only hours before arriving at hotel  Rooms were ready though we came at 3AM     Check in in no time  The manager came up to me immediately when at reception and asked if I need any more help  The GM though out of country made sure the staff handled all my requests  Simply superb attention  Even gave me late check out  The location was excellent as next to Mustafa  amp  the City Square mall  In house lunch  amp  dinner at room was good value and my kids loved it  Once I even asked for band aid and the staff immediately came with first aid kit     House keeping was very good  Made rooms at our convenience and gave us extra staff when requested  Surely value for money and hope to come back soon again as many times before Only I would recommend that u have more variety of breakfast menu everyday

I checked in at 9 30am in the morning and needed a late check out as my flight was in the evening the next day  Not only did they give me a room straight away but late check out till five pm  full buffet breakfast  dinner with all drinks and access to a lounge with Internet free  and I was able to help myself to all drinks including a great coffee machine  All for  50 extra      what a deal  I also accessed a bus ticket for the hop on hop off bus     ticket to the gardens by the bay and a river cruise  Also booked my lift to the airport with the concierge  All very smooth and helpful     lovely room on the 19th floor with fruit platter on arrival  So interesting being in the Indian quarter of Singapore  All in all a wonderful two days and highly recommend this wonderful hotel for fabulous food and service  Thank you for making my stay

Just across the Farrer Park MRT  this hotel is situated in the heart of Little India area  A lot of eateries are around  so one can never run out of options to eat  And they cater to nearly all the cuisines  The hotel itself is good with sufficient sized rooms and amenities  The service  at times  needs a booster dose because the staff seems slow at times  The other bad thing about the hotel was the lack of variety in daily breakfast buffet  Nearly same options for each day made us  stayed for six nights  crave for variety in the breakfast menu Otherwise  a good hotel for families

Overall this is a pretty good choice for Singapore  Stayed here with two children in the family room  The room was a good size and the beds nice and comfy  The rooms are in need of a bit of TLC  the carpet was quite worn and the cabinetry was showing a lot of wear  Housekeeping should also check under the beds  we found two items left by previous guests  The pool is great  nice size and well maintained  My husband was very happy with the gym  As others have stated the hotel is in a great spot  with lots of shops  restaurants and the subway nearby

Everything was fine about this hotel except the check in  I arrived off a long haul flight and having asked for early check in was told I could have check in immediately   at a price   or in a few hours for free  Since clearly the room was available immediately this felt like a rip off and left a bad taste  Other than this  the hotel was fine  but I would not choose to stay there again

This was our 2nd family trip to Singapore  1st time we stayed at the Novotel Clarke Key  The prices must have gone up and we couldn t afford to stay there again  I was very nervous staying in Little India and was pleasantly surprised  Family rooms are big and beds are comfy  fabulous access to MRT and cheap eating Staff were extremely helpful  would definitely stay here again  Value for money

The hotel was very clean and very well situated  Staff was friendly  especially those outside the hotel  always eager to help with taxis  Someone at the concierge suggested a tour to sentosa island and the agency was great so do not hesitate to ask the hotel staff they have good address for tour operators  The hotel is situated in little India very close to Mustafa centre  Muslims would like the fact that the hotel is near many halal food outlets  Just in front of the hotel is a mall where good food is also available  We did not use room service but am sure it was good also  breakfast was included in my package and it was generally nice  A space is even provided for Indian style breakfast  However  I did not give full stars because I believe the price was a bit excessive even if it is singapore  I ll however come back if I happen to come to Singapore again

Firstly  I would say i dont look forward to staying there again  Staff who checks me in DID NOT GREET NOR SMILE UPON GUEST ARRIVAL  SHOUTED  NEXT    for me to come to her counter for check in  She even smirk when i requested for a smoking room and did not appear to be friendly at all  The lady staff was wearing a black coat  apparently should be a manager or something  To add to that  she even scolded and literally shouted at one of her subordinate when she was checking me in  Is it necessary  Really  HER SERVICE IS HORRIBLE  Secondly  Room service took 1 and half hour to deliver me ice bucket and plates  SERIOUSLY  Phone operator was so unfriendly  It shows in her tone of voice  Room service operator too talks like she wants me to hang up the phone quickly  1 and half of hour for two items is terrible   Checked in on 10th Oct 2015

This hotel is our favourite stay during our visits to singapore   Very near to all amenities Musthafa   Indian food for all classes and requirements  MRT station   malls   great restaurant and breakfast and good staff   early checkin was a great help   the only thing negative this time was that the room was not very clean and to our surprise had cobwebs      but Overall a great place and great location and StaffRoom Tip  would try and avoid the triple roomSee more room tips

Recently  I was on a family vacation to Singapore and selected this hotel for stay  I would say Singapore is a place where there are so many attractions to visit and watch out during the stay  such that 5 days and 6 nights also fall short  When we want to do so many things in limited time commutation connectivity from the hotel is a key element  I would say this hotel is very strategically placed where the MRT station  Farrer Park  is a 1 minute cross over of the road  Another important point is  being in the same vicinity of Little India  in case looking out for vegetarian food options  there are many available options around the hotel and also there is an Indian breakfast buffet spread which really helps if we are looking for only vegetarian options We as a family were travelling with a 3 year old kid and being vegetarian it was really good to have Indian buffet breakfast spread in the morning before we leave for exploring the attractions and also near by vegetarian restaurants also complimented as it was easy to get food anytime Coming to staff  I would say they are really very well managed and process oriented  I really liked the service of all staff members and especially the reception and the concierge staff  They are very polite and always eager to help  The room quality is also good and we ll maintained  I was in the deluxe category  Overall I would say  it s really a good place to stay and would definitely recommend this place for stay on visit to Singapore

Located next to Mustafa  the hotel is one of those places that should be first choice of any Indian visiting Singapore  Lots of places around to get your favourite Indian food  shopping at Mustafa is just 1 minute away  and best of all   the hotel lives up to every standard of the Park group of hotels  Extremely high standards of service  and a lovely staff to brighten your day every morning  I ve stayed here twice and at some of the other Park hotels in Singapore  but this one is my favourite  Highly recommended

The hotel is modern and well situated and ideal if you need to be in the business part of Singapore  I have 2 complaints  There is no option for a small breakfast or a simple coffee and croissant  Just 2 options for  all you can eat  at high prices  My big problem was that they choke the internet to 512 kbs on both the wired and wifi connections  I needed to download some large files from my office Singapore has excellent internet connections so it is unacceptable to restrict internet is this manner  I will not be staying there again

We recently spent eight nights at this hotel and if I m honest  I was a bit reluctant to stay here after reading some of the reviews  however I was pleasantly surprised once we were there  From the moment our family of four  two young boys under 14 years of age  arrived  the staff could not have been more helpful  amp  check in was stress free The family room was spacious and clean  bedding was fresh and crisp and all the usual facilities were at our disposal  The boys enjoyed their daily swim in the pool which for most part was very underutilised  The close proximity to the Farrer Park MRT was a plus  as was the City Square Mall across the road  We were not that impressed my the Mustafa Centre as it was really a multi storey  disposal store  Only negatives would be some of the very rude hotel guest who would try to push in when ordering breakfast from the cooks preparing omelettes and so on  The rooms are in need of an update and a bit musty smelling  but that seem to be the case in many south east Asian hotels  Room Tip  This is one hotel where you can still have a family share a room without needing to book two rooms a   See more room tips

If your a business traveler give this a miss 45 mins to check in   35 to check out   rooms are old and need of a refit  Live and learn  Food was ok but again over priced like every thing in Singapore   It seemed to attract pre booking people so many tour coaches  Front entrance stairs are a killer if your a little older   Staff seemed friendly enough but the hotel is lacking that spark  Also be carful is using Singapore taxis as they DONT take Visa Cards

I made quick visits between Aug Sep Oct 2015  The staff at reception is very professional and efficient  Also  figure out an early check out mechanism in my third visit I stays in superior or king deluxe type  The rooms are very good except 2 3 corner ones  Any problem is very quickly addressed and no point is left unanswered The cleanliness as well as the food is really good  There s a special counter at breakfast for Indian also Over all very much satisfied

Stayed twice at the Hotel and each time the experience was awesome  The hotel is centrally located in Little India and has malls and good amount of hotels  The hotel has an average view   like one side faces the pool  the other side faces the city  and one side the mall  Take the room that faces the city on the top floors  Their in house buffet   breakfast is fascinating  The hotel rooms are spacious and amenities are top class be it arranging a cab  a little tour  the pool  the self do laundry room  gym  etc  Enjoyed my stay each day  The staff are very helpful  A family hotel   i recommend it  Room Tip  Take the top rooms facing the Mall or the City See more room tips

Like all hotels in Singapore this was a bit expensive but our room was quite nice and not too crammy  The best part of this hotel was the awesome breakfast we had every morning on our floor  club breakfast  which had freshly cooked gourmet meats  delicious cheeses  nuts  fruit etc  There was also a chef that cooked omelettes for you as you liked  This hotel is in a great location with lots of streets to explore for shops and cafes  and close to the train

We held our wedding at the Si Chuan Dou Hua Restaurant in the hotel and was blown away by the restaurant and banquet team s good service  We also stayed in the rooms as part of our wedding package  It s a clean and decent 4 star hotel with great wifi and conveniently located opposite Little India MRT  Staff was helpful  Hotel has many Indian guests because its right smacked in Little India  If you don t mind that  I would highly recommend this hotel

great location to the mrt which is very efficient in itself  the pool and restaurant are great  I have a superior king ring  the bed is fantastic but that s about it  The room is tired and needs a renovation  the bathroom is the worst  I m Australian  not large  average in size and not fat  I don t fit in the bath and trying to have a shower is worse  The room is large and comfortable  breakfast is included and it has a great selection of good food  I think for what I have paid it is good value  but very disappointed in the bathroom particularly

I visited Singapore in June for Honeymoon  As this was located in little India  it was a first choice Good for families and couples  Apart from initial hiccup on getting a room  the hotel was better than advertised  The rooms were clean  the bathroom was great as well  Staff was helpful and cordial  Felt I was still in India  cause of the locality  It would certainly be my choice when I visit Singapore again Room Tip  Definitely a recommendation for Indians who are on trip See more room tips

Family of 4 staying 3 nights  It was ok  Definitely not a 4 star  No greeting at door or transfer of luggage  Check in efficient but we knew what to ask  Free Wifi  They were good enough to say when we asked about an upgrade that it wouldn t change the size of the room just the floor we were on  I think it s a 3 star  Rooms definitely very tired  Chipped woodwork  Bathrooms serviceable but again chipped tired  amp  stained bath  Wouldn t rebook but convenient to the mrt station  In comparison to 4 stars we ve stayed in on our 2 week holiday this doesn t stack up for the price paid  Premier inn in the uk is better as it manages your expectations  amp  you know what your getting  This hotel markets itself better than it is  We stayed in superior rooms  Very noisy neighbours  Has a pool which is good  Ultimately not impressed

This is my first time staying in parkroyal hotel for my solo birthday staycation  The check in was slow  the officer was busy chit chatting with her fellow colleagues  amp  missed out thats actually my birthday  I requested to change from a 2 single bed to 1 king size bed and surprisingly that they are charging for that  In additional to my unhappiness experience  what horrifies me most is the cleanliness of the room  I found hairs in the bathroom  amp  missing toiletries  So immediately  I tried to call for the housekeeping and found that the phone is NOT working   Cant believe that this is under the management of Pan pacific   Will never ever step into that place again  Its totally not worth for the price I paid for  P S  but i gonna say that the location is good

The hotel is very well centrally located in little india  Therefore has good options of Indian joints  Very close to Mustafa mall The hotel had a good ambience  The room was well maintauned and clean  Bathrooms had some leaking taps  but they repaired very fast  Food was good and hygenic  But the buffet everyday seemed to be same Average treatment and hospitality especially to Indians

Had no second thoughts when we decided to go back to Park Royal again for our family vacation    This has been a  quot Home away from home quot  for us  We had booked 2 Deluxe rooms for 4 nights between 17th and 21st Oct and I must mention  we had a very pleasant stay The hotel is very well located  Right behind the 24 hr Mustafa center and opposite City Square Mall  it is at a walking distance from Farrer Park station with a plethora of Indian restaurants  MTR  Anand Bhavan  Saravan Bhavan  Komal Vilas to name a few     around the corner The breakfast spread at Spice Brasserie is simply amazing with a wide variety of options  The staff are EXCELLENT and the Laundry service is super fast and neat   The only annoying factor was the inter connected room that was allotted to us which came with a complimentary disturbance  knocking and banging on the door  from our neighbouring guests     The fruit bowl and cookies along with a warm personalized note in our room for the anniversary celebration was a pleasant surprise   Thank you Ms  Sharmin for coordinating everything  Appreciate the wonderful gesture

No doubt the Parkroyal Hotel at Kitchener Road can meet your satisfaction in all respect   The Hotel is in nice location   service from top to bottom is highly appreciable  GM always directly look after the service always even round the clock  24 Hours food service   MRT facility walking distance  All the staffs possess best attitude  But I will advice my friends and others to book room online for Orchid Club room

Our large party arrived from Malaysia by Coach in the evening all tired  I was pleasantly surprised to find out our arrival coincided with the crab night where all manner of crab was on display for eating  i especially loved the crap in marsala sauce  quite spicy just as I would have had it at home  I enjoyed my stay thoroughly at this hotel  It was central enough to dash in and out to the city mall or the Mustapha centre a big shopping complex stretching over a whole street and little india  Some of my colleagues got twin beds instead of double beds but i was lucky to get a double bed  The only problem was that my room was meant to be non smoking but the smell of a smoker lingered on till i left despite requesting for air freshener a number of times

Excellent location of the hotel  I had a late check in and very early check out  Both were handled very efficiently by the hotel staff  They were very friendly and polite  The housekeeping was excellent and the rooms were neat and clean  I had booked a family triple room which was very spacious  Breakfast was part of the room rent and had a wide choice  Appreciate that the hotel had a wide range of vegetarian options for breakfast  The staff were very prompt in handling any service requests  Overall my family were very pleased with the hotel and will recommend it for a stay in Singapore

Stayed at park royal for 4 nights in nov15    hotel rooms  lobby  room service are very much appreciated by us   but disappointed with the indian breakfast    they have a seperate section for indians   where inspite of requesting repeatedly for jain food   what we got was the sme idli wada for our entire dtay everyday    we booked the hotel after confirming by mail whether we will get jain food    but inspite of repeat reminders we didnt get any    so overall what we saw was the hotel doesnt cater to veg or jain meal request as they do to non vegetarian eaters

Stayed at the ParkRoyal on Kitchener Road for 4 nights in November 2015  This hotel was like a breath of fresh air  The rooms are nice and modern   very comfortable  the staff  ready to help  The first night  we had their Crab buffet which was very good  Breakfast too is not bad at all  Directly behind the hotel is the Mustafa Mall  The only criticism I had was the locality where the hotel is situated   the Indian Quarter  There was always a traffic jam around the hotel especially as the Indian New Year was approaching  All in all  it was a good stay Room Tip  Higher floors may be quieter  Watch out for the smoking floors 13th   See more room tips

We stayed in the hotel in the last week of Nov  2015  Best thing about the hotel is its location   just next to Mustafa shopping centre as well as loads of Indian restaurants  We could leisurely stroll for shopping at Mustafa   early mornings as well as late nights   as per our convenience  Plethora of Indian restaurants around provides ample choice for food   Ananda Bhavan  Sarvana Bhavan and many north Indian restaurants Also  Farrer park MRT station as well as City Square Mall is just across the road  providing ease of travel as well as shopping   We visited City Square mall on our last evening in Singapore  but its quite good with many shopping options  and we could have spent more time there  About the hotel  the rooms are quite spacious and have all the amenities such as kettle  iron   ironing board  etc  that u expect from a good hotel  Our 4 yr old kid enjoyed the swimming pool  Breakfast had plenty of options for continental as well as separate layout for Indian food  comprising at least 4 5 daily dishes  Wifi worked seamlessly in the rooms For check in  we had to wait for sometime as we arrived by early morning flight  we utilized the time to have breakfast at nearby Indian restaurants   Our check out was also early morning  and was quite smooth with express packed breakfast provided by the hotel  All in all   a good hotel   especially suited for Indian travelers

This hotel was pretty good really  bedroom was clean  and the air con reasonably quiet  The rooms were of a reasonable size and it had a good shower  Not quite as fancy as the hotels you get in the centre though  The staff were friendly although a bit abrupt at times  My only real problem was the area it was in   it s a little way out of the nice centre or town which is a little inconvenient when needing to be there most of the time  However it was certainly convenient for the show that was actually based in the hotel  Overall an ok hotel

We stayed here on our recent vacation to Singapore  We had booked 3 rooms  Although we arrived at 10 in the morning the staff were very kind enough to make available our rooms for an early check in considering that there were small kids and old parents too  The breakfast spread was very good  A lot of Indians staying here  The close proximity to Mustafa Centre and many eateries nearby and closeness to the MRT make it perfect in terms of location  I am definetly going to use their services again        Cheers for the staff at Parkroyal      You guys Rock  1Room Tip  If you require a King bed do ensure you request in advance at the time of Booking See more room tips

I stayed in Park Royal on Kitchener road from 26th November to 1st December 2015 with my family  We had booked 4 rooms  I can very confidently say this is the best option for Indians visiting singapore  The location is awesome with city square mall and mustafa centre right across the road  Plenty of Indian restaurants around for good quality food  The hotel overall has an amazing feel to it  The staff is very friendly and courteous  The rooms are fairly big and amenities amazing  The housekeeping team does a lovely job and one connect is very prompt in answering any of your queries  The breakfast spread is very good with Indian  including jain  as well as continental fare The swimming pool and the kiddie pool add the fun and the well equipped gym ensures you don t take the holiday weight home  In totality  absolutely recommended hotel

I liked everything  the service was top notch  we were given rooms as early as 8 30am despite the check in time being 3pm  The Orchid Club service was excellent as well  Special thanks to Miss Sharmini  amp  Mr Sudina Hashim who are the actual pearls of ParkRoyal   Kitchener Road  Overall a splendid stay  Hope to come back very soon In Sha Allah

Location is near to mrt  amp  mustafa mall in little india   we had family room here as we are a couple  amp 2 child family room has 1 king size  amp  1 single bed prefferably for indians as they serve very delicious breakfast with splandid verities   menagement here is running this hotel with perfection i would like to stay here in my next trip

We have stayed in this hotel for 6 nights  This hotel is located within a minute walk from Mustafa shopping center and Farrer Park subway station  Clean room and toilet  The room service and breakfast are excellent  Bus 88 depart to Kuala Lumpur outside of this Hotel  You have to pay just S  30 to go to Kuala Lumpur  Taxi to airport is S  20

I am very much disappointed by the charges levied on holding my luggage for 2 nights  I was charged 83 SGD while at the time of check out when i put my luggage in concierge to be hold until next check in after 2 days  This is really not acceptable and i am very much disappointed  Even after lodging my dissatisfaction no action was taken by the front office staff  Next time its a big no to stay in this hotel
