I had the opportunity of staying at the Park Royal hotel on Kitchener Road on a work related trip and thoroughly enjoyed my stay there  The hotel s staff was extremely courteous and everybody from the reception to the concierge and the cleaning staff went out of their way to help me whenever I required assistance The rooms and attached bathrooms were extremely clean and maintained very well  The facilities provided in the room such as the mini bar  tea coffee maker etc  were regularly topped up  The hotel s swimming pool and gymnasium were very good  although I rarely got to use the pool due to time and weather related constraints  My birthday fell during my period of stay at the hotel and they provided me a basket of fresh fruit along with a nice card The breakfast buffet is massive and well laid out  with a variety of cuisines such as Japanese  Western  Indian along with local food  The lifts are plentiful and I rarely had to wait for one  The location  right next to Mustafa Centre in Little India  makes it an ideal location for Indian travelers  All in all  I have nothing but praise for the hotel and its staff and strongly recommend it

Room was ok  bathroom needs some work bit tired but staff and location pretty good  Breakfast was included in the tariff  amp  plenty of options  As I was on my way to India this was good 2 night stopover but as I left really early I missed the 2nd breakfast   would be good to offer a snack for early travellers  I left at 4am and the breakfast didn t start til 6am  Also pool closes when its raining

Done a staycation  Reserved a suite room w club access Suite  old  Nothing fancy  Look more like an deluxe room  Items in room old  Size big but only because of one big empty space in room Club access  lack of service  Serve lousy food  Limited choice Service  checkin slow  Not able to provide clear details of entitlementIf thinking of staycation  would suggest going to conrad n book the deluxe room  Better experience

Had a pleasant stay at the hotel  Approachable staff and centrally located  Good Indian restaurants plenty of them nearby especially hsb murugan idli shop  The staff were responsive for our room ac problem complaint and in middle of night facilitated in room change and called us back next day morning to check on the status of ac temperature settings if it was fine  The swimming pool well maintained overall nice experience  after al day long travel in Singapore city touring  relaxing experience at the hotel  The 3 pm check in checkout 12 pm policy is very inconvenient for us international travellers should b revised to 24 hrs or check in to check out 24 hrs  As provided in any good hotels tats only draw back  The amount of sgd180 equivalent for 21 hrs is not fair

This was our second time staying here  The rooms are fine  the breakfast buffet caters to all tastes  baozi  chicken curry and roti  yogurt  cappucino maker  Indian food   and the location in Little India is very convenient  very near Serangoon Road  the main drag of Little India  as well as a very short walk from Farrer Park MRT and Mustafa s  a 24 hour drug store and department store   The staff were very helpful in getting taxis when we needed them  Not a luxury destination but clean and reliable  with good food and service

The highlight of this hotel is its staff and the general customer service attitude  I am impressed with the concierge desk  in particular Mr  Kari  nothing ever a problem and just very skilled in solving any challenges   great in his job  Our family room for 2 adl 2 kids was great with seperate rooms  amp  TV in each  The hotel is dated and it needs a face lift but ok all round  The beds are in great condition  amp  AC is perfect  Free Wifi is just excellent  The pool area is good   amp  gym too  You can order drinks food at the pool but a bit pricy for a family  The hotel provides free water bottles in your room  which is a god sent  Breakfast has a great variety and has a focus on Asian cuisine  We tried some interesting things we normally would not have for brekky  it all adds to the adventure  I would recommend to review the egg omelette offerings  it s there but not quite right  yet The hotel is quite central  Just across the road a shopping centre with access to the MRT and any trips to the sights by taxi are not further than about 20mins away  And if you are a bit of an adventures eater     Little India is worth a visit

Stayed there for few days on a business visit  Located very close to Mustafa center and Little India area  this hotel is good for shoppers  Lot of Indian restaurants are also in the area  Receptionist explained about what to do in the city during weekends  Breakfast is good with wide options of fresh fruits  juices  eggs and all other essentials you would want for a breakfast

My wife went to the gym to workout at about 3 00 am  in the morning  Feedback by her that although she was alone  security personnel patrol the area frequently during her workout when my children and myself were snoring away in the room  Gym in hotels are mostly tucked away in a secluded corner and most of the time dead quiet during wee hours Room Tip  Be an Orchid Club guest and have a taste of P A cum butler service from their manager  Shirley See more room tips

We stayed at the Park Royal on Kitchener Road in the Little India area twice this month     once for a week prior to a cruise and then again for two weeks of Christmas and New Years after the cruise     we found it to be an extremely well run place with a warm  friendly and welcoming staff and great facilities and amenities     the pool  spa  gym and steam room were well equipped and meticulously maintained     our deluxe room on a high floor had a great view and was spacious and very comfortable with a beautiful bathroom and great TV  free wifi and good A C     except for a noisy family with children next door who disturbed us a few times because the connecting door offers no noise reduction  the room was usually quiet and tranquil     the close proximity of the Farrer Park MRT station and readily available taxis out front make it easy to get anywhere with minimal effort     the service and ambiance in the main restaurant  Spice Brasserie  on the lobby level could be better  but with so many restaurants and food outlets in the mall immediately across the street and in the area  plus great room service and a very good Chinese restaurant on the 3rd Floor  you don t have to rely on this cavernous  brightly lit cafeteria which is more suited to large family groups with children     we were especially impressed with the Hotel Manager who is readily available and eager to assist in a hands on way with any request that cannot be properly handled by one of her staff members     a great property with a lot to offer at a reasonable price     a great value     we would not hesitate to return

Dated rooms Mold in bath room and breakfast time that is free is like a zoo the food quality is low and there are not enough staff  So basically when you try to find a place to sit you can t  Too many people not enough seating and the food is disgusting  The sad thing here is this could be improved with some attention

This hotel is showing its age  Average room standard and presentation and at the expensive end of the scale  Our air on was stuck on Arctic and thus the room was far too cold The simple things like milk in the bar fridge for a morning cup of tea were missing Located adjacent to the Little India precinct there are good food outlets and shops adjacent with a medium size shopping Mall opposite  In addition it is near a SMRT station   Farrer Park  and a HIPPO bus stop   Hop on Hop off tourist bus Staff are good and generous with their time Taxi to the airport ranged between  16 and  22 sgd Included breakfasts are ok but located in a large noisy setting Overall average

Located in the Little India neighbourhood the hotel is perfect for Indian travellers  specially families  There are ample Indian food options in the area and even the hotel breakfast has some options there  There is a mall and a metro station just opposite to the hotel  so that makes it well connected to the city  The staff is very polite and helpful  the rooms are very clean and spacious and have nice view of the Singapore skyline

We stayed close to little India in an immaculately clean hotel with many guests from the international community and really enjoyed our stay  We couldn t fault the cleanliness of our room or anywhere else in the hotel having purchased breakfast in our hotel deal we made good with the choices on offer which included many dishes from countries other than our own all of them good to eat  if you get a chance BOOK BREAKFAST

This hotel is adjacent to very famous shopping mall called  quot MUSTAFA CENTRE quot   It is a massive mall and they sell pretty much everything  Second this hotel is in the area called  quot Little India quot  so if you want to treat your taste buds with indian food it s pretty much near walking distance Third hotel services are upto the mark and the views from room are amazing You can see famous Marina Bay Sands hotel from your room  Whole area of little india  And already breath taking skyline of Singapore This hotel is also near famous electronic mall called  quot Simlim Square quot  roughly 2 Km You can check out the pics i submitted

Stayed in an executive room on the 20th floor which gave us access to the executive lounge on 18th floor  Breakfast was included which was a buffet served in the executive lounge  We had breakfast there the first morning  but the food was barely warm and the only eggs they could serve there were fried  so for the rest of the stay we fought the crowds at the breakfast buffet in the main restaurant  where eggs were cooked to order We dined there on one occasion but the standard of food presented was below par Across the road is a 5 storey shopping mall which is quite good for shopping and had some restaurants as an alternative to eating in the hotel  We ate at Astons grill there which served very good steaks at a reasonable price  They even let you byo a bottle of wine for a  10 corkage The MRT is also located there and Orchard Road is 2 stops away In summary I d say the Hotel is generally quite good but badly let down by the food on offer Room Tip  Pay the extra for executive level and lounge accessSee more room tips

Had a 3 days business trip there in December  Rooms are spacious and the location is convenient with restaurants and food outlets  Had to cancel 1 night stay due to a passing away of a relative and although booking done thru booking com  the management was still able to reverse the transaction for us thru 3rd party It is through these times when hospitality and service levels are proven  My first choice hotel in Singapore whenever I visit  Thanks

Had an awesome stay at the Hotel with my family  Very Well looked after by the Orchid Club Team of Sudina  Monish  amp  Kavita  Very well located  Clean Rooms and Nice Facilities  Will surely come back  An advantage of this location is the Little India and Mustaffa  Nice Indian Restaurants nearby  Surely enjoyed the fresh fruit juices and of cause the shopping mall just across the road with Western and Chinese Cuisine also  Very Awesome place to stay

A hotel very close to Little India   Very welcoming staff  Great pool area and fitness room which wasn t too busy  Close to MRT so easy to get around Singapore if you fancy going underground  Hotel very busy but my room was clean and comfortable and I got a good deal online  Cleaning staff replenished coffee etc daily and I enjoyed the fresh fruit on arrival  The only negative was children allowed to run up the corridor and people coming in late at night and being noisey  soundproofing of room not too good

Stayed here as my regular hotel I usually stay in was fully booked  I saw that the hotel was in quite a convenient area  with a huge shopping centre and the MRT 2 minutes away  This was the good point about the hotel  that there is everything you need within a few minutes walk away  Plenty of restaurants to choose from across the road As it was close to Little India  there was quite a big Indian population stsying at the hotel too  Breakfast was limited  and there were quite a few Indian offerings The rooms were a little old and dated  but still clean nonetheless  Its due a revamp

It s a good hotel  Get a room on the higher floors  15 and above with if you wish to have a room with a view  Lots of rooms mean breakfast can be horribly crowded with hardly any place to seat  You have to either reach before 8 30 or after 9 15 to have a decent breakfast  Believe me the crowd and the chaos can really spoil your mood  Otherwise they have a very decent spread with excellent staff and a great variety to choose from  The rooms are clean  We stayed in the 7th floor in a superior room and it fully served our needs  The highlight of the hotel though is the location  Mustafa is just 2minutes away and city square mall across the road  There are also 2 MRT stations nearby Room Tip  Select rooms on higher floors 15 See more room tips

Good hotel in heart of Littel India good for indian s as they are foodie and shopping freak as this place has lot of advantage with Mustaffa on the back and SMRT station on the front this is the busy hotel for indian tourists and perfect destination for people who love Indian food and want to travel across the Singapore by SMRT  I Enjoyed my family stay and visit gfor 5 days in this hotel had great time with family I never had food in this hotel as i was always irregular so always having food out side hotel Room Tip  might have to checkSee more room tips

The room is okay for the superior one   If you have been before  room upgrade is given to you   the room equipped with all necessary items   Reception also nice  helpful   the breakfast also good as they prepare a lot of dishes and also malay dishes  The location is just beside the little india area  and near to MRT station  Taxi waiting maybe a bit long queue if we ask the concierge  but what i can suggest if taxi is preffered  just walk out to the street and get the taxi from there

A Great Location in little India MRTclose by so you can travel to other suburbs of Singapore in minutes On arrival at the Hotel you are greeted with a warm welcome from the concierge staff all the way through to the front office staff initially with our checkin we had a problem with our room but after discussions with front office staff Clement  amp  Duty Manager Raja Jayasak our issue was solved in an efficient  amp  friendly helpfull manner in a very short time  many thanks to these two gentlemen your understanding was very much appreciated  The Hotel is very clean  rooms are very good with clean linen  amp  towels every day if you require any thing during your stay just call the help line it will be delivered very quickly City Square shopping centre is just across the road many shops  amp  restaurants the restaurant at the hotel is also very good  Mr M Karikalan and his staff are so helpful if you have an inquiry about how to get some where or an attraction they pull out a map mark where you need to go with no fuss at all  I would highly recommend this Hotel it is great value for moneyRoom Tip  Most rooms over look the pool so most are okSee more room tips

I have been staying at this hotel ever since I shifted overseas and travel to Singapore  I book my room on the Orchid Floor which is excellent for business travelers  With City Square Mall in the front where there is an array of food and shopping options  Mustaffa Shopping Center behind which is open 24 hours and the Farrer Park Metro station which is a stone s throw away what more could one ask for  Service at the hotel is Excellent  It couldn t get any better Room Tip  Choose a room on the Orchid Floor which comes with a boutique lounge which serves breakfast and comp   See more room tips

If you need a decent hotel in Little India area  this is it  Nice hotel  friendly staff  good rooms by Singapore standards  near to public transportation  in expensive Indian eateries all around  a shopping mall right opposite to the hotel and Mustafa behind the hotel  Extensive continental and Indian breakfast  Continental breakfast was not up to the mark  but Indian breakfast was great  The Indian breakfast area does get crowded at a certain hour which I believe is due to the tour bus crowds  They need to staff it better to clean up the tables fast

Booked online through web portal  the hotel is located close to farrer mrt  we stayed there for 6 days and had booked a family room  The staff was eager to help and provided with early check in and late check out  The spread of buffet breakfast is too good includes continental and indian too  the service of the staff is good plenty of cabs are available at the hotel lobby  its adjacent to mustafa shopping centre in little india  the rooms are clean and spacious Room Tip  go for higher views as they will have good views especially towards the entrance of the hotel See more room tips

We re just back from a 5 nights at Parkroyal Hotel  Strongly recommended for some reasons  rooms are very bright  spacious  clear and very well equipped  Breakfast is very rich  basically you can choose what you want   Sweet  salt  chinese  indian  european continental    Receptionists are very helpful  happy to assit you for any issue We booked this hotel with an Expedia package  recommended Hotel is really in front of the undergroud  Farrer Park Station

Frontline staff were most professional and friendly  Housekeeping was great  they paid attention to the amount of water we drank and topped up the bottles conscientiously  Only downer was the service during the breakfast hours  It would be expected to be chaotic but the staff was not adequate at all  Tables were left uncleared for long time and overall it is often messy and hurried  not a good way to start your day

Checked in this hotel with 4 rooms just for 1 night after our Star cruise experience  We booked here as we could shop in mustafa and around  It s probably only reason this hotel must be popular  it s less than a minute walk from Mustafa  Hotel however is nice and spacious  Huge  comfortable and clean rooms  Our floor also had a nice sitting and reading lounge  We didn t eat at the hotel as it was close to several Indian joints around and we preferred to eat there  Several of the cruise guests were also booked at this hotel and check in was getting too much time consuming as all reached almost same time  We took quite a long time to check in  It seemed that this hotel takes a lot of group bookings through travel agents Overall we had a comfortable stay with the limited hours we spent at the hotel

Our agent booked this and we didn t realise we were so far away from the Marina  so a taxi was needed for each trip in  We only had a couple of days here as a stop over  so would have researched more if we were staying longer  This hotel is in the Little India district and at weekends is teaming with mainly men  so I wouldn t have been happy being here on my own to be honest  I m sure it was safe  but neither my husband or I wanted to walk around the 24 hour shopping area behind the hotel at all  It wasn t noisy and the hotel was very comfortable and clean with friendly staff  We didn t have breakfast or dinner here so can t comment on that  but it looked very clean Room Tip  avoid being near the liftsSee more room tips

when I arrived at this hotel I found out that ALL children under 12 must share a bed with their parents which was not stated on the website anywhere  even after I checked once I arrived  and to make it worse there was no where to put an extra bed if we wanted to  so we were forced to pay an extra 170 SGD for a deluxe family room  which we certainly did not need  Oh and there is free wifiRoom Tip  Add your children under 12 as adults  unless you want them to share a bed with the adultsSee more room tips

Just finished my six nights stay at this hotel Special note  The GM Of this hotel is a super nice and professional lady  Helped me going out of the way when my online booking process was conked up Location  4 stars For an Indian family with a fussy eater kid  this location is ideal  Right next to Mustafa center for people looking for cheap stuff and across the street from City Square Mall for people looking for mall stuff Ferrer MRT is in the basement of city square mall Reception staff  2 5 starI think there is lots of room for improvement here  I particularly felt that the reception staff was poor at following up on requests and commitments made by themselves  For two days I kept on getting denied the complimentary laundry service that was part of my deal  I had to dig out an email to prove it to them It was my daughter s birthday so I asked if the hotel makes any complimentary small arrangement of cake etc  and I was emphatically told  quot Yes  quot  but nothing happened I had to remind the reception twice to refill the tea amenities in my room The worst part is   you cant call reception directly  The call first goes to operator and he she answers your question and asks if I still want to talk to reception  That s annoying  To be fair  they did give me an upgrade to next category room with nice city view and one hour late checkout when the hotel was overflowing with tourists in what seemed like fully booked hotel Room  4 starNice room ambience and space  Gives a pleasant feeling when you come back in the evening  Housekeeping Staff  5 starVery polite and very prompt Breakfast  5 starBest breakfast spread I have ever seen in any hotel  Lots of variety and quite a big space with many many tables Gym  amp  Pool  4 5 starBig gym with lots of equipment  Pool for kids to play Room Tip  Get a high floor  city view room See more room tips

It was my first visit to Singapore and my first experience with Singapore was with Park Royal on kitchener rd  The hotel is placed backside to Mustafa Plaza and is in Little India  The welcoming was friendly  So was the front desk  The rooms were gr8 with free wifi coonectivity  Unique password for each room   The breakfast was delicious and heavy  It had veg and non veg sections and both had equally good food to offer  The service men were friendly  The room was clean   Ours was a Deluxe room   We dint had our lunch and dinner in the hotel as we had a lots of good and budget Indian restaurants nearby I would say this should be one of the best hotels in the locality   As We saw some 3 or 4 hotels infrastructure too from outside Overall a memorable experience    Thanks Park Royal

The USP of this hotel is its location  It s bang opposite City Square Mall  amp  next to Little India  more importantly Mustafa  Everything else you would need as a vegetarian Indian is just walking distance  We would walk into vegetarian restaurant for Indian meals even arnd 11pm  or go shopping at Mustafa at midnight  On the rest of the parameters  the hotel is average  The rooms are ok  service is also competent keeping in mind that my visit was during Christmas which is the peak season and hotel was jam packed  Breakfast buffet has an elaborate spread of Indian food along with western  Somethings I found a little odd  The night we arrived at the hotel  I asked for just a cup of milk for my toddler  They said I can have a full glass of milk and it will be chargeable at  9  I have stayed at some of the finest hotels in India as well as abroad  and no one ever asked me for money for a tiny cup of milk for the baby  So of course I went and purchased a tetra pack of milk from Mustafa at midnight  At another instance  when we asked for a fork  spoon to be sent to the room from housekeeping  try said that would be chargeable too  Apart from this  our stay was comfortable  The check in and check out were swift  The gym and pool area are neat and clean to use  We found the concierge also helpful in helping us decide our modes of transportation for various tourist attractions  There is MTR station opposite the hotel called Farrer Park  so that s very convenient  This is the only 4  property in Little India so they have tht chip on their shoulder  I hope more such properties come in this area  healthy completion would keep them competent

Whilst staying temporarily in this hotel for a month during my initial migration from my home country to Singapore  I had the  un fortunate pleasure to stay in this hotel fro 4 weeks  The hotel at first glance is aged and dated  When you get to the room it gets even worse  The bathroom basins were painted at some point for renovation but the paint is peeling now  The rooms are fairly spacious  Make sure you stay above the 13th floor to get any kind of a decent view else you will be staring into buildings around The pool area is the best feature of this hotel with decent areas for lounging and a large pool  There is also a gym  spa and user pays launderette with washing machines and dryers The business center on the ground floor was not functioning with the computers not accepting any money to operate and the printer having a big  quot OUT OF SERVICE quot  sign on it Some of the staff are quite rude as well and don t understand the concept of hotel customer service Being in the middle of the Little India district it is a very popular destination for Indian families and tour groups so it does become crowded at times It is directly opposite the Farrer Park MRT station which will give you access to the whole city  Their are ample malls and restaurants with delicious food around the hotel  The hotel s food was quite average The in house club has a great DJ who specializes in Ball Room and Retro music  The bar staff make up for the rudeness of their colleagues as they are fantastically friendly Overall I would not recommend this hotel

Room is spacious but is old and run down Bathroom is moldy and the bathtub shower area is very high almost fell down when get down from the bathtub  The hot water system is not working  The breakfast is variety but taste horrible and is not up to standard seem cook by an un professional chef  Very noisy can heard someone walking or jumping from top floor Convenient and good location

This hotel is in the centre of town and is accessible by Bus  Underground and taxi  the rooms are very well appointed with massive beds   The restaurant has a wide variety of food for breakfast and afternoon nibbles  there is a souvenir shop on site and an evening club bar  gymnasium  laundry room  and atrium Staff are very attentive and well trained  the whole experience was very worth while and I will definitely stay again

We stayed at this hotel for 4 days  during our singapore holiday Likes 5 star accomodation at very reasonable prices provided the booking is done through a tour agency Sumptuous breakfast All amneties like gymnasium  pool  and in the rooms  round the clock hot water  bath tub etc are available A minute s walk from ferrer park metro stationA huge selection of eateries esp indian  available around the hotel A 24 hr shopping centre  mustafa centre available just around the corner A concierge service that holds your luggage even before check in and after check out  until your time of check in or your departure time DislikesNo deal breaker here Check in took nearly half an hour

When we reached hotel after long flight  we realized that there was a long queue at checkin desk    there were only 2 counters and we had to wait for good 35 40 minutes before we could talk to clerk  Check in process took another 15 minutes    So  by the time we were done  it was 3 15 PM and we were told that only one room is ready out of two    Would advice management to increase the staff for checkin OR reduce the process fr the same While first experience was not welcoming  the hotel is situated at good location with lot of options to shop and dine  Overall room was good  We really did not interact with staff except for checkin to rate them  Breakfast was also having good spread with enough options for vegetarians

Came on a business trip but the posh superior room made me feel I was there for a vacation   So relaxed and the cozy bedstead hooks me to it whenever I got back after my hectic day  The entire businesslike room give the luxurious stay  Culinary cuisine served with variaties of desserts   The staffs welcomes you with a generous smile   I had a little delay when I was checking in but after all the stay and experience I had  that was just nothing  Hope you will have fun too

We mainly chose the hotel as it had an MRT station  Farrer Park  just across the road  Little India is nearby and the Mustafa Centre  24 hours shopping   is just behind the hotel  The MRT provides good transport links to the rest of the island Hotel was really nice but our rate didn t include breakfast so we went out of the hotel every morning in search of breakfast  The staff are brilliant and very attentive The swimming pool was lovely and they provided towels to use

During my stay for a period of stay for 6 nights I would say it was value for money  The buffet breakfast was awesome  being a vegeterian   there was always something new for me everyday  Hotel is strategically located  so nearby place Litte India was a few blocks away  And to shoot off for Sentosa Island  the nearest MRT station FERRER Park is also just 3 blocks away The hotel staff were exceptionally courteous and freindly I would recommend this hotel to any one coming to singapore

Great location in Little India just a minute s walk from Farrer Park MRT station  Ideal base to explore all of Singapore  Pool area was lovely and if you are a keep fit fanatic the gym looked 1st class  Plus Mustafa s department store is at rear of hotel  24 hr shopping excellent  Try and visit Fort Canning Park and the Botanic Gardens which are an oasis in the city  Night safari was brilliant too  Sentosa was good but there is a lot of construction work going on  All the restaurants we went to were great and were told all were safe to eat in as they are regularly inspected  Alcohol is very expensive though

Our company organised a sales conference at The Park Royal Hotel situated in the central business district of Singapore The hotel is located a few minutes away from the city s MRT train station thus providing easy access to all parts of Singapore  It has 500  amp  odd spacious luxurious rooms  It can hold conference for ten to five hundred guests at one time The hotel has two restaurants which serve you both local  amp  international cuisine Besides having a well stocked bar where you can unwind after a hard day The staff is courtious  amp  efficient  The hotel has a fully eqipped Gym  amp  a landscaped pool  The hotel really gives you value for money I stayed at the hotel again when I went with the family  Irecommend it to all travellers who would like a comfortable stay in Singapore

In all my trips to Singapore  I have made it a point to stay at Parkroyal at Kitchener road  if available  This place is the best you can get  if you like to stay in and around Little India  The staff is excellent  right from the reception to the housekeeping  I think they are well groomed  very customer friendly and responsive  I have had certain bad experiences in other hotels in Singapore  as far as customer responsiveness and courteous behaviour is concerned  but here at Park Royal  it was always the same good stuff  The lobby  rooms  corridors are well maintained  The rooms are spacious and maintenance perfect  I never had food at parkroyal  as was always out from early morning to late evenings  hence cannot comment on food quality  I would recommend this place to all business travellers  who want to stay near farrer park MRT

Situated adjacent to the road which has a number of Indian places  this is one place in Singapore where i immediately felt like home The hotel is elegant and modern  And the service is fast  They immediately handed over my room keys in flat three minues  As you head for the lifts to go to your room  you can make out everything is structured and systematic in this hotel  Just like the entire singapore  You dont find employees of the hotel strolling around just to greet you with a smile and offer you a helping hand  The rooms are neat and clean  No complains about the bed sheets and towels  The view is good from the 10th floor  A huge number of rooms at the hotel   but still the room service is fast  i think they are atleat four restaurants  seen atleast two on the ground floor  i only had breakfast at the hotel  but the breakfast was good  very good spread The great part of the hotel is that Mustafa the famous mall is backdoor  so you can finish your shopping at one go Its open all night and i rememeber walking into the mall past midnight  a walk on serangoon road and you will see a number of Indian faces and Indian shops  You can also get some good Indian fare there  But stayed away since i have it anyways at home The hotel is not situated in the swanky part of Singapore  But if you have a budget constraint then this hotel is a good bet

This is a very good hotel and is very close to the Mustafa Market in Singapore which is open 24 hrs so you can just hop in to the market whenever you feel like from here Whenever we went out we couldn t wait to get back to the peace and tranquility of the hotel  Overall I would say this is probably the one of the best hotel we have ever stayed in on holiday   May be not the most convenient if all you want to do a lot of sightseeing  but if you want to mix a little luxury with the odd trip to other places then this is an absolute must

I am just returned from 2 week at the Parkroyal in Singapore  The hotel is good  Food is great  breakfast is a lovely continental  asian  amp  order to egg stuff was add on for the change of taste  The pool is lovely  not big but luxurious  Separate baby pool is very good for kids  The Spa is out of this world

Booked the Hotel for the Group   Hotel staff is Very Rude and Check Inn delayed to even 4Pm as group check inn is to be done by another staff and who is not present   Hotel is not having concierge service or Clock Room Service for the Group as they said hotel is not having the enough space  Not a 4  property at all

The location of the hotel is excellent  You have the Mustafa Center right behind the hotel for shopping  The farrer park MRT station is on the opposite side of that hotel at the City Square Mall  Little India is a 2 minute walk  The hotel rooms were standard  Didn t feel like 4 star though  The bathroom is small  Not sure if this is because we had a corner room  The bathroom fixtures looked old  The shower was broken  They have some Indian breakfast items like Idly  wada  Pav Bhaji and vermicelli Upma   But we found all these items to be cold  The continental spread is ok Room Tip  Take a room on floors 14 or aboveSee more room tips

It was my second visit to this hotel  The first time was very good and the second time was excellent  This time i brought my 3 yr old son with us  He cried when we checked out  He liked the hotel that much  The room they gave me this time had an amazing view  The hotel is located in little india with excellent food nearby  Mustapha centre serangoon plaza is just across the road and it is excellent for shopping  The breakfast was great also  muslim travellers will like it there  halal food is available for the breakfast buffet  The front staff were also very nice and helpful  Late check out was however not possible because the hotel was fully booked but they agreed to keep my baggages while i went shopping  Just awesome  I will certainly come back a third time

This is a 3 minute walk from Farrer Park MRT  adjacent to the Musthafa Stores and in the midst of Indian restaurants  In addition it i 4 stops away from Marina Bay  ALl in all the location is very good and especially so for Indians desiring the Indian food I stayed in the 20th floor and had a beautiful view of the Singapore Flyer  Very spacious room I only had breakfast in the Hotel and although the items were many the taste was not too appealing  Hotel is a bit run down and could be maintained better  As with most I have experienced the NFC cards had to reprogrammed thrice during my 3 day stay due to functionality problems All in all a good place to stay  Recommended Room Tip  Choose above 15th floor for good ViewSee more room tips

Singapore is the place for heavy shoping as all international brand of cloths  electronics  cosmetics which attract huge no of Indian tourist  Singapore also has some beautiful tourist spot  since it is very costly city for Indian tourist  finding a good hotel with resonable rate is challenging  The Park royal at Kitchener road is the highly recomended place for Indian  The reasons are many  The rate is reasonable in Singapore Standard  the hotel is beautifully arranged room with all amenities  The most striking part is the proximity to a large shopping mall Mustafa Market which is within 100 meters  The Staffs are very nice  ready to serve you with a smile and no hidden cost  The airport is 20 minutes drive by taxi which cost you 14 SDG  The MRT   Metro  is nearby  200 meters  and one can go to any part of Singapore as cost of the ticket is very reasonable  large no of eating joints are within the vicinity of the hotelRoom Tip  any room one can choose as hotel is 22 floor with plenty of room See more room tips

Good hotel in central part of Singapore As MRT station is a couple of minutes away it makes this hotel a good choice for your visit in Singapore I would rate the hotel between average and very good Brilliant personnel and a good atmosphere in general I didn t eat at the hotel so I have no opinion about the food The bar was good with again very good personnel

Hotel as such is elegant situated in centre with access to many areas and well connected Rooms well maintained  Good house keeping and efficient Restaurant in ground floor is just ok  Nothing much to boast about Biggest minus is  Reception area  Crowded like a railway station  poor floor area Very poor check in and check out  Takes ages to check in  Either the staff are not trained well or they have poor systems  Staff at counter have too many things to ask  where as all are clearly spelt out in reservations and bookings  More is   Neither can they nor check in guest understand each other well     Reason being the accent of English with a slant of La la and almost one gives up  Very sorry for a hotel with international guests their staff needs better training The same story all over years  Sorry despite a good location and comfortable and great rooms much negatives on reception Another factor of minus is the lift  Despite 3 plus 2 lifts it takes long to get one for up or down  In a hurry it is next to impossible to depend on getting one Though have stayed here many times  only for location sake still there should be other equally better ones to try

A good hotel placed in a ideal location for indians  The hotel is located next to the Little India and Mustafa Shopping center  The hotel is located near the MRT Station and opposite to city pride mall  There is lot of indian food options around this place  All the popular indian joints have their outlet in this locality  The rooms are quite comfortable and has free wifi  The breakfast spread has got of lot indian options  For shopping the Mustafa shopping located next door is an ideal place with reasonable price  Stayed with family for 3 nights and had a really good experience  Would definitely prefer to stay there during next visit

Our family of 5 stayed for 4 nights over the busy holiday time between Christmas and into the New Year Upon check in  we found our  family room  was looking a bit tired  beat up and smelling vaguely of cigarette smoke  Management were very courteous and quick to address the problem and offered us an upgrade to 2 interconnecting rooms on a higher  club level floor  These rooms were of a better standard and I really appreciated how swiftly we were relocated This hotel is very popular with Indian families and guests  which makes sense as it is smack bang in the middle of Little India  We enjoyed the cultural experience of the neighborhood  including dinner on top floor of the nearby Mustafa Centre Breakfast was included in our room rate  and we generally tried to get down to the buffet early to find a table and avoid the crowds  and it did get hectic and very crowded as the morning wore on  There was a reasonable selection of western fare  and a significant array of Indian breakfast options  catering to the majority of clientele  I ve never had curry for breakfast before and we were happy to give it a try  We even got a few tips from other guests about how to tackle some of the more unusual dishes The pool was large and clean  but it was often closed because of rain  The gym was good and had a nice view over the pool area The hotel is looking a bit dated  inside and out  It s due for a refit This hotel gets Bonus points from me for LOCATION  very close to Farrer Park MTR station  City Square Mall and airport side of the city  Also  a short ish cab ride to Raffles  Esplanade and Orchard Rd ASIAN DINING OPTIONS  great Indian restaurants close by  plus a fantastic food court with a vast array of Asians cuisines on the top floor of City Square Mall directly across the road MANAGEMENT  amp  HOUSEKEEPING  I must say  Raj  or Raja   was quite possibly one of the kindest and most accommodating staff I ve encountered in many years of hotel stays  He upgraded us with a smile  gave us a very late check out time  3pm  because our kids were sick and was helpful whenever we needed assistance  The housekeeper on Level 18 also did an excellent job with the rooms and was very friendly  saying hello and enquiring after our well being FAMILY FRIENDLY  Kids aren t always made to feel welcome at hotels  but this place was definitely used to having large families stay  All in all  this is a solid  budget friendly choice for families in Singapore  This is a very expensive city and high end accommodation comes at a significant premium  I d describe Parkroyal on Kitchener as  not bad  and pretty good value for money

Lets make this pros and cons  Pros  1 Excelent location  With little india you get good food which is cheap  And singapore isn t cheap  Mustafa is a good place to shop certain items  Money exchange of mustafa is the best rate you will get in singapore from dollar to ruppees 2  Rooms are spacious  bathroom too small Cons 1  Pool is bad  They close it if its drisling outside  It drissles every 2 hours in SGP  hence you have to fight to get it opened with the reception  Chairs are vacant and not atall enjoyable place  Pool itself is fine 2  Some people in the reception are really rude They ask you to follow an imaginary line even if there is no one behind you  I got agitated when one of the receptionist motioned me to keep quite as she was attending another guest  I obliged  After that she flat ignored me and asked the next guest to step in  Outrageous I was 3  Breakfast is lame  Items don t change at all  When they see a Indian they just motion you to the vegitarian indian section  Which is packed with indians and just one waiter attending cleaning  Practically no one is available to help in the entire section Bottomline  If you are on a planned vacation  its the best place to stay in little india

I stay in this hotel for 5 days  Stay was excellent  Had only breakfast in hotel  Nice choice of food was available  only problem with tipical veg  max item was non veg  But still there was nice indian dishes were available in veg category also Room was excellent and city view was also nice Very near to Mustuff mall and indian restonrants Room Tip  best view  high rise and near to indian restorants See more room tips

This bustling hotel in Singapore s Little India is conveniently located for public transport links and ticks all the boxes of pool  gym  wifi and  despite a flight of stairs to the lobby  disabled access  The breakfast buffet speaks to the tastes of the guests  with a wide range of Indian vegetarian options  and a thin choice of cheeses and cold cuts  Unlike its sister hotel featured in the movie Hitman  Agent 47  this is a functional building  without flourishes  The service lifts its rating above average

The experience was good  The service  rooms and facilities were up to the standards  The especial things that we experienced in the hotel were the location and the buffet menu  The hotel is situated very close proximity to shopping areas  which made our shopping pretty easy  The buffet menu was a mix of both Indian and western cuisines  The only weakness we faced was in the delay and misunderstandings happened during checking in  The staff had some difficulty finding the exact booking we made  However though it took some time they cleared everything up and behaved in a very friendly and helpful manner

I went with my family  a group of 12 people  in the month of Jan 16 and stayed there for 4 days  Pros 1  Best location 2  Excellent Staff   specifically people at Reception  Cons 1  Nice Breakfast but need to include more options   specifically for Vegetarians  as all 4 days it was same  quality was never an issue  but variety was 2  Waiting lounge can be more relaxing

We stayed in Park Royal on our recent visit to Singapore  The hotel is conveniently located in the heart of the city and well connected by road and metro  Little india is the little Indian town that houses the temple and Indian restaurants and shops  The nearest metro station is just a few kms away  As we spent very less time in the hotel we couldn t use all the facilities  The view from the hotel is awesome specially the morning dew on the glass panes

I stayed at this hotel for 5 nights from the 19th of December 2015 until the 24th  since I was a solo traveller My room was very nice  but it seems like this hotel is very popular because I asked for a single bed instead of twin beds  but they did not have any with queen or king beds  and I got a twin bed room  Other than that I got the non smoking room I requested  and the rest of my trip was very comfortable and happy  You just walk out of the hotel and down the driveway  and Mustafas is right behind  City Square Mall is right opposite  and the MRT is at the entrance to City Square Mall  This is a superb location

Hotel is conveniently located next to MRT and opposite City Square Mall  Because of it s close proximity to Little India it seems like 95  of the guests are Indian families on holiday  The staff was very helpful  but breakfast was the worse  the restaurant is too small to cope with the number of guests  and with lots of families with little kids it was really messy and noisyRoom Tip  Rooms at the end of the passage has only one little window   best avoidedSee more room tips

We had a 5 day trip to Singapore on the way to Phuket from Sydney  The hotel offered good spacious accommodation with soft hotel sheets and great choice of buffet breakfast  The staff were helpful and friendly  The hotel is situated opposite a shopping mall with plenty of eateries close by  We also made use of the hotel gym and the kids loved the swimming pool  All round an excellent choice  would stay here again

Parkroyal is in little India of Singapore  Hotel is good and budgetary  Around the hotel there are lots of Indian restaurants even Paan Dukan  The famous super market of Singapore named Mustafa is also in this area  The USP of this hotel is its location  Room size is very good  Room amenities are OK  Reception and lobby was always crowded  Staff behaviour was ok  Services were ok  You can not much expected from hotel but in that budget and location it can be a better choice

You have lot of eating options near the hotel and Mustafa is just behind  City sq  mall is just opposite to it  The staffs are friendly and the breakfast is good enough  If you are staying for multiple days  be prepared to have the same menu of breakfast every single day  It happened for 3 days in a row to us Overall a good stay and rooms amenities were satisfactory Room Tip  They have 1 smoking floor See more room tips

Hotel is opposite City Square Mall  Mustafa Centre is just behind it  If you booked your hotel stay without breakfast is alright  surrounding it are few restaurants for you to dine at  Staff at reception were friendly  Check in was fast  We even had a free upgraded room from Superior Twin Room to Orchard Club Twin Room located at Level 21  Room was spacious with elegant furnishings  Standard toiletries were included  Bed was comfortable  Two pillows provided were soft and hard  You may use as you preferred  However  room was not sound proof  so when people talking or walking heavily  you could hear from the room  Anyway  during check out  it was fast too

Best place for Indian tourist in Singapore  very well located and huge property  Breakfast can be better if they change everyday menu a bit but overall a good breakfast available even for a vegetarian Cooperative and courteous staff Rooms are big plus neat and clean Bathrooms can be better if it has a shower cabins at the place of bathtub because they are hardly providing any bathtub material  Location is the biggest plus for Indain tourist Overall a good experience

Very good hotel at a premium location  Adjacent to several Indian premium restaurants and Mustafa shopping complex  The city mall is also near  Good Breakfast choice and I wish they had more vegetarian selection such as Dosa along with Idli The staff were very friendly and helpful  I spent few evenings in the hotel bar and the Indian lady taking orders served well  The reception and luggage staff were also friendly  Hamid was helping everyone load unload luggage and arrange taxis Room Tip  Rooms were goodSee more room tips

The hotel is nicely located  clean and the people can easily make you felt at home  Month of Feb my salute to Thamo the Orchid Club GRO and Dave for job well done  After a long day meetings  this guys can really entertain you even though they have other guest and busy preparing and cleaning  Salute guys  And good job Park Royal   Kitchener

Situated in the heart of Little India  this a very convenient home away from home hotel  for Indian s especially vegetarian or from south indiansPlus  central location   very close to 24x7 Mustafa mall  great temples around  decent rooms  good wifi   pool and gym   Good veg options in breakfastMinus  very crowded breakfast area  lack of cleanliness in rooms or looking a shade oldBut overall a good optionPicked this hotel as most other hotels were booked that week

Average hotel  pleasant enough  pleasant staff  Obviously specialising in Indian market  So non Indians watch out for the noise and jostling of India at the buffet breakfast  Breakfast early if you can  Fittings in rooms and bathrooms looking in need of refurbishing  Good gym and pool but some equipment in gym not working  And why close pool for a few spots of rain  Pools at other hotels still being used in heavy rain

It is a very old hotel  When we asked the taxi guy who was almost 50   booked the hotel is almost his age     Rooms are small  Old carpet  Done some changes to shower etc but still not at all impressive  Service is ok  Nothing great  Rates are not very cheap either  Overall felt that not worth the money  Won t come back If folks want to shop at moustopha place and walk and don t care a lot this is a good place for them

I went there this February  Chose this place as we had work in the Serangoon Beach road area  Wrong choice  Problem started at check in  My flight landed at 6 45 AM  and I landed at the hotel at 7 50  I had called up  mailed twice to request an early check in   and had been assured of help  At the check in counter  I am told there is no room  and I will have to wait till perhaps standard check in time of 3 PM  I protested  and put pressure  A senior guy came in   and said yes  they can give a room but it will cost S  300    Again protested  and finally they agreed to give a room on payment of S  100    By then I was too tired and just wanted to crash Went up to room 1627  and to my horror found that this was a left over space in a corner that had been made into a room 10 feet wide and 20 feet  long  with a tiny window and two small alcoves  Unbelievable that they would charge S 300 for this  I was too tired and just crashed  Stayed two nights  Ate outside as the two eating places did not look appetising  Anyway  Serangoon Road and Race Course road  just outside the hotel have many great eating places  Time to check out  and I went and asked Reception if I could have late checkout  There was a pretty rude girl there who said no way  they were running full because of the Airshow  I asked again  and she says  yes  you can stay on for two hours at  50 hour  I could not fathom how the room miraculously became available  More than the demand for money  it was the indifference and rudeness that was too much  I straightaway went to the room and checked out at 8 30 AM  Was happy to go away from the hotel  Was there anything redeeming about the hotel   No way  Not for S 300 per day  A lesson well learnt  Will never patronise Park Royal

Kitchener Road which just next to so called Little India in Singapore  This location of Hotel is so convenient as if you really getting bored around mid night and want to get up and go for a walk then what can be better than walking into a mall and having fun shopping  It is just across Mustafa centre mall  If you are in a search of indian food then you end up finding multiple Really good indian restaurants just next to the corner of the hotel  Hospitality  staff  cleanliness  rooms  Food  what else not excellent  Thumbs up to Parkroyal

We booked 3 rooms and stayed a couple of weeks at the parkroyal from Jan 31st  There was my wife and I with our son   daughter  son in law  and 6 month old grand daughter Firstly   communicating ones needs is just so easy and simple with this hotel  Communicating with the general manager Mr Shamini is also in complicated unlike most other hotels where most managers are unavailable for day to day visitors  Location is excellent  Just across the road from a large shopping complex and mrt  Also right in the middle of little India area where life does not seem to pause  Restaurants and shops galore around the whole area with mustafars department store open 24hrs right next door A very busy hotel with check ins and outs through out most of the day  Our room was clean and comfortable  A birthday cake got my sons birthday was a very appreciated thought  A special thank you to our room cleaner Saudray  She was such a delight  Always with a smile and a greeting with a quick chat  Thank you Saudray The pool and steam room on the 6th level was wonderful  Always lots of seating available with a baby pool which my grand daughter loved  Pool side food service was quick and delicious without being over priced The staff  concierge and the guys in front of the hotel always willing to help and always with a greeting and smile   A very special thank you to Angu who helped me locate the taxi in which I left my mobile phone in   which was successfully located and returned  Thank you Angu  Overall a very pleasant stay  This is our forth stay at this hotel over the past decade and won t be the last  Value for money   you will not go wrong at this establishment   My wife and I will be returning to Singapore in August and I won t be shopping around for another hotel  Thank you to all at the Park Royal at Kitchener

Stayed in the Orchid Club as we always do  The staff and facilities are excellent  Many thanks to Shirley who always looks after us and everything is perfect  Thamo looked after us in the evening during cocktail hour  Food is lovely with a range of wine and spirits  Rooms very clean and comfortable and our maid was very professional to us  From start to finish it is a wonderful experience

We arrived late in the evening  8pm local time  having booked a superior twin room  We were put in a tiny  quite scruffy room  they were busy and the hotel was full   We asked to be moved and was told that  possibly tomorrow  check in the morning   We duly checked and were told  come back after breakfast   We went back after breakfast and were told  another 15 minutes   In the end we moved to a nice  much bigger  lighter  airier room but had wasted half a day sorting this out  Breakfast has a good selection  western  continental and indian food is available and plentiful  Room service was quick and reasonable quality  Location is a bit far out  we spent a lot of time going to places   i would stay closer to downtown next time   although there is an underground station in the shopping centre opposite  farrer park station in the city square mall   it doesn t show up like this on google maps though  it looks some distance away   so it s cheap and easy to get around

The Park Royal at the Kitchener road was a novelty as this was my first stay there  I like the buzz of the place and loved the overall feel for the hotel  The rooms were simple  elegant and comfortable  It is placed very conveniently close to Mustafa and more important the MRT  As a business customer availability of taxis was a great boon  I would recommend it to anybody who has business in the city as a good hotel to stay in

Stayed 2 nights with family in Deluxe triple room  This room comes with one king size bed and one single bed which is perfect for my family size  The room is spacious compared to standard room size in Singapore  bed was comfortable  the view from the room was unblocked which is a plus in Singapore  We booked this room directly from the hotel website and got a good discount as they were running some promotion during that period We chose the rate without breakfast as there are plenty of restaurants within short walking distance which are open for breakfast  There is a shopping mall  city square  right across the road  and the famous mustafa centre is also just next block  The location of this hotel is central and near to many tourist location Check in and check out was fast  the staff at the front desk was prompt and professional  Contrary to other reviews  I was able to check in earlier than the usual check in time and could also extend the check out time for one hour without any additional charge

The rooms are nice However the staff is extremely ruthless and non  cooperative Except the Reception faces any where u ask for some small service they will show you the Red faces Some Gentleman known as Eisen is literally waiting to take you on for an in required argument over there The Restaurant staff is highly Un professional and Ruthless at times Service  It works at snails pace U ask for a bottle of water it takes 30 35 mins to send them to the Room However the fastest service is provided on the check out day They send things in minutes for an early check out

We stayed once again in the orchard rooms here in Kitchener road right next to little India We have stayed here a few times and found this to be an excellent residence in Singapore  the MRT is just a few yards away  across the main road is a huge supermarket hosting various outlets and a food hall on the top floor underneath the hotel and across a small alley is Mustaphas  a massive store with almost everything you need 24 x7 We have only stayed in the orchard club rooms which are very comfortable and clean  The lounge staff Shirley Thamo Dev are absolutely wonderful and can t seem to do enough for their guests  I burnt my foot  my own fault  and the lounge staff dealt with this superbly and prevented me having to seek further medical treatment  once again well done guysAs previously stated there Is more food choice in the main restaurant but the ambience in the lounge makes all the difference  Just loved the happy hour 6 till 7 30  There are 3 other park royals in Singapore which look great but I am just afraid it won t feel as homely as Kitchener road Already looking forward to my next stay Thank you for making a great start to my holidayRoom Tip  Choose or upgrade to orchard roomsSee more room tips

Just stayed 6 nights at the PARKROYAL Kitchener Road in an Orchid Club level room  After reading some of the reviews I thought that Imay have made a bad choice  however  check in was trouble free  The staff in the lounge are all very helpful  especially Thamo  who looks after the guests very well and is very knowledgeable about the hotel and the local area  The lounge provides a limited  but completely acceptable breakfast in a relaxing environment  The food choice is better in the main restaurant  bu tdue to the number of visitors it is not as relaxing  The  happy hour  between 6pm and 7 30pm provides a very pleasant end to the day  The rooms are not 5 star  but are clean tidy and totally acceptable  The cleaning staff are very good and  Christine  looked after my room and my needs very well  All in all I had a very pleasant stay at the hotel and would definitely return Room Tip  Rooms on the 19th floor are quiet  however  sometimes you have to wait a few minutes for the lift See more room tips

I stayed for 3 nights in this hotel  First of all every day they serve same breakfast all days  No change in menu  And i found staff of this hotel bit rude  Their room service is very slow  U need to call two times if u need some thing  I was on a trip for 10 days and stayed in many 5 star category hotels but had a worst experience with this hotel

The rooms and services are just about OK but that is the best thing about this hotel The staff are horrible and rude  Most rude is the lady at the travel desk  One guy asked where the reception was and she rudely shot back this is a travel desk and not an enquiry counter  Later I went up to her and asked for any activities on our free day and she asked me to come later as she was busy doing nothing   I sat around for a while but she didn t call me to tell me she was free  There was more   The lady at the reception was asked for a lost key card and she rudely asked me to wait for my turn  She could have politely asked me to wait but snapped at me to come later as she was attending a line that was being attended by three more people We ate food from a buffet and there was one table from which everyone was taking but the moment we took food one waiter snapped that we can t take that food and we must pay  When we said OK we will pay   he changed tone and said food was bad and so was being refused  A big fight ensued  There were other incidents  But in short worst ever staff we met at any hotel

We stayed here 8 years ago and chose to return because we liked it so much  We are pleased to her come back but the rooms have become a bit  tired    light fittings hanging off the wall and furniture showing signs of age  A little bit of tlc is what is needed  The restaurant is very popular especially at night when there was a crab special meal on offer  Also the restaurant staff were most helpful   they are pressed but still have time to offer a first class service  Situated in Little India and close to a metro station  albeit with a long walk underground to get to the trains  this hotel is well located as a base from which to enjoy the whole Singapore experience

Our family of 3 decided to spend Christmas and the New Year at Singapore and this time we chose the ParkRoyal based on the reviews and due to the good deal we got for a long stay  Check in was smooth and we were allocated a room facing City Square mall  The rooms lack full length windows but ours was of a good size and not too bad although we found a nail wedged in the floor carpet when walking around and had to have it removed by housekeeping when it kept hurting our feet  The bath looked tired but was functional and the amenities supplied were not of a very high standard   no tooth brushes supplied and housekeeping was a total disaster  The room was either hurriedly and badly cleaned or they would forget to clean it altogether and have to be reminded on several occasions  We had specifically asked for a king bed and received confirmation of the same   but were allotted twin beds which were joined together making it uncomfortable for the one sleeping in the middle since we were 2 adults and a 9 year old  On asking reception about this  they seemed helpless and just gave vague replies  We had complementary use of the minibar    however housekeeping conveniently forgot to refill unless told  After 3 to 4 times  we just got tired of calling them up The place too gets very noisy as noisy guests think nothing about shouting in the corridors or talking to each other across rooms with their doors wide open On Christmas eve  all rooms were given a tiny box of chocolates    a nice gesture We were on the room  breakfast package  Breakfast was adequate but the dining area was chaotic at all times  Park Royal is a total disorganized lot at breakfast time  Why could they not have a system in place where guests are allowed to enter when a table is available and then shown to the table  What we experienced were hoards of people scrambling and rushing around trying to grab tables and seats and on many occasions unknown people would jostle to sit at our table and share it  Going for a second helping or even to get a cup of coffee was not a good idea since by then either our table or the chairs would be taken  The b fast items were repeated all through except for the live counter and maybe an alternate day of pancakes  French toast  I know this place caters mostly to Indians and the food is mostly suited to them  but this ill mannered lot of guests were an eyesore   Things only got a bit better after New Year and after a separate Indian buffet table was set up in the adjacent room  A proper dress code for guests should be in place as well so as to deter people from entering the dining area in their night wear The hotel staff is quite courteous though but I guess they have too much to handle This hotel has a swimming pool which is totally unsupervised and there s no life guard on duty  The pool is quite dangerous since there is no gradual increase in depth  It suddenly drops from 4 feet   or so  and the next minute one encounters a depth of around 6 5 to 7 feet  I might have got the figure a bit incorrect  but you get what i mean by sudden drop     could spell trouble for unsuspecting swimmers if they suddenly lose their foothold  All in all it was an ok stay just for the price  Park Royal needs to work harder in the housekeeping department  Our room windows too were dirty and dusty  The only saving grace is that Mustafa s and City Square mall are around the place and so is the MRT  Vegetarians have a lot of options for dining around the hotel but for us we preferred eating elsewhere  City Square mall has a lot of places to dine in at the basement and also on the roof top food court where plenty of delicious food is available  Must try the pork and beef dishes there Room Tip  rooms facing city square mall and on higher floors away from the lifts See more room tips
