Located in Little India it was our first stay in this area and I would recommend it  It has a very different feel than Orchard Road or Marina Bay areas but it does have a warm and interesting vibe You must visit Mustafa¡¯s just around the corner open 24hrs and full of all sorts of interesting things some junky but worth a visit  Also eat in a local Indian Restaurant the one we found was amazing and very cheap opposite Mustafa¡¯s Parkroyal was great value  the room was musty and outdated but for the price I am not complaining  130 AU including rollaway and breakfast  excellent Pool area is nice and enough to cool off after a day of sightseeing and shopping

My 5th trip to Singapore and I wanted to stay somewhere a little different from my previous trips  when I stayed at either Sentosa or on near Orchard Rd   The Parkroyal on Kitchener Rd is in the heart of Little india and the hustle and bustle is a wonderful contrast to your at times sterile Singapore  We were fortunate to be there during Deepavali celebrations and all of the streets were wonderfully lit up  a real sense of celebration  I understand the hotel has been recently refurbished   it looks great  Rooms are on the small size but well equipped  LCD TV  wireless internet etc   We got a Club Room on the Orchid Floor which among other  benefits  entitiles you to hors douvres and cocktails wine beer in the Club Room from 60 0 to 7 30pm each evening  We didn t really make the most of this as we were typically away from the hotel at that time  however on the couple of occasions we did partake we noticed that the service was well frequented  Breakfast buffet was excellent  although coffee from the machine was insipid  but I have never had a decent coffee in Asia yet   and there was not a good selection of fresh fruit  surprisingly  Pool area and gym were good  although a small complaint was that there were only 6 sun lounges on the deck   not enough by far Service all round was excellent  from the baggage boys to the concierge  Check in service at the Orchid Lounge was efficient All in all  well worth checking out  Good value rooms and great location  The Farrer Park MRT is 100m away and of course public transport in Singapore is second to none so once you are on the MRT you can get almost anywhere on the island quickly

We stayed 4 nights in this Hotel and although the surrounding area was very busy outside the Hotel itself was good   clean and although we only had Breakfast the food was also good  The biggest advantage was it was situated 2 mins from the Underground which obviously could take you anywhere     Remember and cash in your ticket on the underground for a  1 return as this is an excellent idea to save litter

Stayed at the Parkroyal   Kitchener Road for a couple of nights in September on our way back to the UK  Considering that the majority of clients are in transit and are only there for a short stay  the attitude of the staff is to be commended  They treat all the guests with a very pleasant and friendly attitude  We had a midnight flight out of Changi and so extended our room stay until 6 00pm with no problem  We had an excellent last meal in the Spice Brasserie before leaving for the airport  The hotel is a two minute stroll to Little India  Just around the corner from the hotel in Verdun Street is a great India Nepalese restaurant

I stayed in this hotel on 2 Sep 09  room 1229  and 9 11 Sep 09  room 920  when transiting through Singapore  Overall  I thought it was good value for money  S 140 per night  The hotel is located S 25 from the airport by taxi  The nearby MRT can be taken to the airport but you need to swap trains twice so may not be suitable if you have heavy luggage  The rooms met my expectations i e  were clean and well appointed  The only issue I had was that the second room I used  920  was located near the lifts and was very noisy  Other guests wandering the corridors woke me both nights between 3 4 AM  Also the walls of this room seemed thin as I could hear everything occurring in the room next door The hotel has an excellent outdoor pool area and fitness room  It also has a cozy bar with excellent staff  I only used the dining facilities once  but was impressed by the buffet dinner  I understand that the breakfast buffet was also impressive but perhaps not value for money This is a busy hotel and the foyer can be hectic at times  I enjoyed my stay and would definitely consider returning

Arrived in the hotel after a long flight from London  We checked in and were desparate to get some sleep  There was a problem with breakfast booking even though I had written confirmation  The room intially given to us had a terrible smell and requested a room change this was given but took an hour to sort out  We were then disturbed several times apologising for the room and breakfast error  The hotel is in the heart of Little India which a good place to shop and eat South Indian food  I used the Gym every day and the breakfast was great with so much choice  Travelling wise there are cabs but we preferred to use the MRT which is close by and cheap  The staff of the hotel were friendly and informative  Internet is very expensive in the hotel so my advice is to go to one of the local internet places which are very cheap  1 for 30 mins  On Sundays in the afternoon till late you will see lots of South Indian men on the streets as this is their day off and they hang around the area  It is overwhelming to see so many men  There was no trouble but it is a sight  Singpore is very clean you do not see the police patrolling as there is very little crime  China Town was great to shop and to eat especially fresh fruit As the ?   Pound  was weak things did seem expensive in the major branded stores in Oxford Road We took the City tour to get our bearings then we used the public transport to the places we liked  Singaporean people are friendly and speak perfect English Next to the hotel is the 24 hour Mustafa mall again something unusual to see  I did not try it out at 3am  This also has a money exchange facility with no commission

I have mixed felings about the hotel  On Arrival  we had to stand almost 20 mins in a queue to check in and although there are 3 counters at the Desk  at most times only one was manned  However on being told that we were on our honeymoon  the very nice lady at the Desk Nadiah  who spoke english very clearly and was quite courteous  upgraded us all the way from Superior to a room on the Executive floor  The lifts in this hotel are terribly slow and there is no indicator to show you which floor the elevator is stuck at currently  so you just have to wait for an undefined amount of time  The room was very spacious probably because it was a corner room  but my husband notice cobwebs on the ceiling  of a room in a 5 star hotel  and that too on the executive floor   The Bathroom was large and spacious  The waiter who brought our room service order was trying to solicitate us to write good feedback about him on departure  even repeated his name a couple of times so we wouldn t forget  which we found very unprofessional  On the day of arrival  we stopped at the main restaurant to have a cup of tea while waiting to be assigned a room  We were seated at a dirty table and after waiting awhile  thinking that they would come back to clean it  we had to ask for it to be done  We were served tea in a mug  and as I couldn t find a place to keep the tea bag  I asked for a quarter plate  and would you believe it  they picked up a used plate from another empty table which had fruit peels on it  emptied it onto another plate on that table and brought the plate to me to put my tea bag on  Totally unprofessional for a 5 star hotel The hotel is located right across a Mall and Metro station  Ferrer Park  and is right besides Mustafa where you can buy almost anything at bargain rates and get the best exchange rates too  There are plenty of restaurants close by within walking distance  All in all  the hotel was ok  but since they consider themselves to be a top rated hotel  I wouldnt recommend the hotel for someone expecting that high level of standard

The staff were reasonably nice but not compared with everywhere else in Singapore which we found to be an amazingly freindly place The Bed was so hard we had trouble sleeping  The bathroom smelled  was not clean and did not even get cleaned when the room was made up during the day  The televisions are old and pictures are poor  When asking for a wine at the pool bar we were told it would take half an hour to get a glass plus they charge extra to drink by the pool The only good thing about the hotel is the new shopping centre accross the road

We stayed in the Park Royle from the 30 Dec 09 to 2 Jan 10  The hotel was very welcoming from the moment we got there  the check in staff were very friendly and spoke very good english  The rooms were very spacious and very clean with a very good shower in the bath room A nice touch was a news papper left on the door handle every morning  The breakfasts were to a very high standard the wasnt much you could not have If you didnt want to eat in the hotel there was plenty of good food outlet all close by which seemed to be open 24 7  The mtr was only a 3 mins walk away which would take you to any part of the city you wanted and was very cheep and the best way to travel All in all i would recomend this hotel to any one

We booked this after our star cruise and wanted to be near little india  On arrival the doormen was rude so we got a bit upset  Mentioned it to the checkin lass called Sharmilah and she immediately went out of her way to make sure were ok  Lovely rooms and toast box accross the road was good for breakfast  We really enjoyed our stay and will always stay here in future

Stayed one night whilst in transit on the way to Australia  We were late arriving as our flight was delayed but the restaurant was still open  However 2 cheese sandwiches and 2 coffees were rather expensive Room was sufficient for our brief stay but bed was very hard Hotel appeared clean and staff were friendly  shame that the same could not be said about some of the other guests Opposite the hotel is a brand new shopping centre filled with places to eat and shop  so dont eat at the expensive hotel restaurant

Stayed at this hotel from 9th Dec for 2 nights  It s in a great location if you want to be near Little India and Indian food  The hotel itself was clean and the staff were efficient  I got there around 9am in the morning and was told that my room wouldn t be ready until 11 30am  But in the meantime I could use there luggage storage facility and I could use the shower in the gym  Well  let me tell you that the shower was awesome  There was soap  shampoo  towels and a hair dryer  I was very happy to use the facilities and then go and have some breakfast before returning for check in  There was an MRT  Ferrer Park  entrance and a brand new mall across the road  You could catch a bus stop for bus to Orchard Rd about 5 min walk away  Also very convinient was the 24 hour shopping in Mustafa Centre which is right behind the hotel  Within a few mins walk were Komala Vilas and Anand Bhavan   veg restaurants  There clientel at the hotel mainly appeared to be Indians  The room itself was a good size for a single person or a couple  In fact I believe it was on the large side for Singapore hotel rooms  The area surronding the hotel always felt safe even late at night  I give this one a thumb up

I happened to stay for the first time in Parkroyal hotel in Singapoire and I should say that they provided an excellent customer service to me  No matter what time of the day or night it was  their attendant was outside my room within 5 minutes of my phone call if I did need something from them Their food  especially the moring breakfast included so much variety that I really felt as though I was in India and having home made breakfast  the taste was so delicious that I don t have words to express the same Everytime I went around in the hotel  whether its the reception  lobyy  etc  it was quite cool and enjoying I should say that this hotle deserves to be one of the best hotles in singapore

It was a wonderful stay and I will I could have stayed more nights  The hotel is located just beside the Mustafa Center  a 24 hour bargain mall and also a newly opened mall  City Square  My booking did not include breakfast but a very nice restaurant  quot TOAST BOX quot  offering breakfast treats starting at S 3 is just in front at the City Square mall  When we arrived we were greeted by the Front desk person who is not smiling but I think this is Singapore culture  She asked for our preference of a smoking or non smoking room and we said non smoking with 3 beds as said in our booking  We were given a room in the eight floor and as we entered the room  we were surprised that the smell seems that someone just smoked in it and there was just one king size bed  It was a shock so I called front desk and I asked for a change in room which they obliged thankfully  I was given a room at the 9th floor easily and luckily it was a room I requested  During the course of my stay I just had a problem with the air conditioning unit since the coldness started to deteriorate but I never bothered since I was leaving the next day All in all it was a great stay

This was a nice hotel very clean rooms  Nice KIng sized bed The location was good for the MTR  which was just down the road from the hotel and a day ticket was of good value We had breakfast in the hotel which was of good value but a lack of western food  no cold meats or cheese  A good choice of oriental food if you are in for that kind of thing in a morning but  curry is not up our street for breakfast  There was hot western style food but limited for choice We did not eat in the hotel at any other time  we found a nice cafe in China Town cheap with large portions and cheap beer  Reception and portering services were great  Overall it was hard to find anything really wrong with the hotel all the staff were polite and very helpful

This was a quick trip to Singapore from Indonesia on a  quot Visa Run quot   so no business appointments  I selected Parkroyal on Kitchener Road which is located in  quot Little India quot  but still easy access by public transport to all areas  There is a new Shopping Centre opposite the property and Mustafa Centre with its 24 hour shopping around the corner   plus some really interesting restaurants catering to all tastes I had secured an Internet Price of S 220 10  including Tax Service  which was a significant saving on the Published Rate for an Orchid Club Room  Even at this reduced rate  the Orchid Club was still only very average value for money Check in was in the 19th Floor Orchid Club Lounge which was handled efficiently by friendly staff  My Room 1918 close to lounge was well appointed and recently refurbished  there was flat screen TV with good channel selection  great single lounge chair with foot stool for relaxing   also comfortable office style chair and internet connection  free unlimited broadband  providing an excellent work station for the business traveller  In room electronic safe is large enough to hold a laptop and there was an abundance of coat hangers  often missed  plus iron board  Bathroom is well appointed but quite small  Towels were of good quality but no face towels provided  was told by Duty Manager that  quot guests used to steal them so we don t put them in rooms any more quot    The toiletry selection was incomplete and soap  only one piece in a room reserved for two  was inappropriate size for a  quot premium room quot   After my complaints to Duty Managers on two occasions about  quot in room quot  inadequacies  there was a full complement of toiletries  this time for two guests  following the morning room make up   they had also managed to  quot find quot  two face towels In the  quot Orchid Club quot  the  quot signature orchid stem quot  was missing from the room   although a selection of fresh fruits was provided  Orchids   so prevalent in Singapore   were also nowhere to be seen in the Orchid Club Lounge  which is really quite small   causing tables to be placed very close together  more like a coffee shop than a club lounge  and with very limited lounge style seating adjacent to the television reading area  There was just one laptop computer for  complimentary  use by Club guests If you are planning to stay here and expect Club Lounge facilities commensurate with those found in almost any hotel offering this service   but more importantly if you are coming from Parkroyal Kuala Lumpur   you will be shocked to say the least with the gross inadequacies you will find at this property  The  quot all day refreshments quot  offered were just Coffee Tea and Cookies  The evening  quot hors d oeuvres and cocktail quot  between 18 00 and 19 30 were in one word  quot horrible quot   Forget any aspirations you may have about there being a choice here   two  quot dim sum quot  varieties in double layer chafing dish  warm at first but cold when burner went out and wasn t replaced  with lower layer stuck to banana leaf and impossible to remove without falling apart   a  quot fried    quot  served cold on small aluminium foil dishes  no china here    Corn Crisps and commercial Salsa made up the  quot selection quot   NO International Cheese platter here either   just individually wrapped  quot Bonbel quot  and  quot Babybel quot   ok   they DO come from France  with Water Crackers and one variety of Dried Fruit  Staff in Club Lounge are all extremely friendly and do their best under what could be described as  quot extenuating circumstances quot  Breakfast the following morning was equally un inspiring  no kitchen so no choice of fresh cooked eggs  so I had breakfast in Spices Brasserie Cafe which had a reasonable selection and unusually good coffee  I returned to the Club Lounge for Coffee and Pastries Standard Operational Procedures are virtually non existent at Parkroyal on Kitchener Road  I had arranged an appointment with the General Manager to discuss the problems I had encountered  He is extremely personable and has been at this property for around six months   is also very aware of what is needed to  quot bring his property up to speed quot   He explained that the Parkroyal Group is going through a  quot re positioning quot  exercise and is under a recently appointed CEO  On my return later in the day to my room  I found a bottle of excellent Red Wine and a hand written note from the General Manager thanking me for my feed back   a positive sign that the property is in good hands It may be that demand is insufficient for this property to operate a  quot fully fledged quot  Club Lounge  Its owners must decide to either elevate the standard of facilities and services to an acceptable level   or disband the Club concept and return the rooms into regular inventory simply as  quot premium rooms quot  without  quot club extras quot   As it is right now  I expect that there is a very low incidence of  quot repeat quot  business and even less  quot referral quot  business for the Orchid Club The warmth and sincerity of the Club Staff and its very helpful Club Manager   plus the genuine enthusiasm demonstrated during my meeting with the General Manager   would be sufficient for me to return to this property on my next visit to Singapore  I should like to believe that my next report on Parkroyal will be much more positive

We stayed at this hotel twice   once for three nights and again a week later for two nights  The first thing to understand is  that this is a transit hotel and definitely not a holiday hotel  Both rooms we stayed in were not very clean and the bathrooms did not smell too good  The walls in the room were a bit tatty and despite having spent a week in Borneo   this was the only place where we were both bitten by  quot insects quot   The pool is adequate  The bar is almost always empty and at 14 singapore dollars  ? 7  for a small beer we realised why  The evening concierge staff were not too interested and we had to unload our own luggage from the taxi  We were told it would be delivered to our room   after almost an hour I went and fetched it myself  no one stopped me so I could have taken anyones luggage  I reported a faulty clock in the room on our first night   it is probably still not working   no one came

We stayed at the Parkroyal on Kitchener for two nights in January 2010  We were fairly shattered after flying in from the UK  as we d arrived early in the morning  they didn t have any double rooms available  and so upgraded us to a twin room of a better standard than the one we d booked  The room was clean  but the walls were getting a bit tatty  which spoiled the appearance a little  One the upside  the beds were very comfortable  just what we needed  The hotel s situated in Little India  so a perfect location if you re visiting that area  and a short walk to a metro stop to take you elsewhere  We didn t eat in the restaurant  but ordered room service on the first night  The food was a bit iffy  not an experience I d want to repeat All in all  if you re flying in and want a comfortable place to rest your head  this is worth considering

In 1983 my wife and I stayed here for 6 nights and found it to be perfect for our needs  In those days it was named the  quot President Merlin Hotel quot  and appeared to be very new  Our room was large enough  very comfortably furnished  and faced north west which allowed us wonderful views from our very large windows  The staff were friendly and efficient  We did not eat there  preferring the foodhalls along Serangoon Road  I realise that this review is very much out of date but the hotel looks at least as pleasant as when we stayed there 27 years ago and that may indicate that the standard has been maintained

If you like to stay in Little India near Mustaf shopping then this hotel is the best  Newly renovated  Very nice hotel with stylish reception  rooms etc  Big swimming pool  specially large kid s pool  The breakfast variety was huge  but more changes should be done on the menu  otherwise it becomes boring with same options  though lot  Very crowded  have to wait to get seated  Large Indian crowd  The hotel rate is the best for such class of hotel  4 5 star   The concierge staffs are very helpful

This is one of the worst hotels I ve ever stayed at  To begin with  the reception area and lobby are extremely small  When we arrived at the hotel  it took us almost 3 hours to check in  because there was a huge group waiting to check in before us  and the staff were so boggled that they had no clue about what was happening around them  Once we were allotted our rooms finally  we realised what a huge mistake we had made selecting this hotel  The rooms were extremely compact  and with the beds occupying most of the space  they looked very congested  Even the paint on the walls was peeling off at some places  The bathrooms were kinda suffocating  as if you ve been confined to a closed space and neither were the toiletries satisfying  Even the kettle lying in one of our rooms was not operational and when we complained about the same  nobody bothered to replace it Although the hotel is situated in a convenient location  with the mustafa centre as well as the MRT station nearby  but frankly  it is not worth the pain

Stayed at Park Royal on Kitchener Rd early Feb 2010  Foyer is very nice design  staff helpful sometimes  reception a bit slow and all over the place  as if your purchasing a meal at a busy McDonald s but a busy McDonald s would possibly be faster  Rooms were quite average  bathroom was the best part of the room  very Contemporary Designed  and linen was good  but I believe the Family room s are getting a renovation soon or in the process of doing it facilities such as the gym are stunning  and pool is fantastic  very clean and crisp  if your looking for a hotel and not fussed then this is the one for you

The hotel is a long way from the centre but the tube train is realiable and easy  The approach and arrival at the hotel is impressive  I wish the bedrooms matched  Ours was basic  the air conditioning noisy and  worst of all  the fridge did not work  The engineer assured us it did work  if we took all the contents out and left the outside door of the box it was housed in open  Fortunately we were only using the hotel as a base in which case it fulfilled its function  The internet was out of action  we were told we could go down the street to the internet cafe instead   the Spa non functioning and the meals  which we didn t eat  expensive  All in all  over rated I fear

This was my first trip to singapore with my wife  As both of us are vegetarians  we wanted a place where we would be able to find good Indian vegetarian food  which is usually a problem in most of the countries  I was suggested this Hotel by one of my friends  and we were really amazed to see the facilities available near the hotel  Lots and lots of Indian restaurants nearby  24 hr Mustafa opposite to the Hotel and MRT station at walking distance  What more you want  we had an excellant time in Singapore and Park Royal Hotel had a big role to play in that  Would surely visit there

I booked this hotel through email and phone calls  This hotel was recommended to me by my friend  I was very happy to stay with my family at this hotel  This hotel is at funtastic location just behind the famous Mustafa Center and close by to the marketing hub  It has very nice rooms with very very comfortable beds  They had interconnected rooms for family staying in two adjoining rooms  Food in the restaurant is excellent  You get a warm feeling as you arrive at the hotel because of the warm reception that you get on arrival  Check in is only few minutes  I would love to stay again at this hotel

pros  room and bathroom is clean  housekeeping  concierge and restaurant staff are friendly and with smiles most of the time   clean pool and well equipped gym mrt station within walking distance and a mall right opposite hotelcons  unhelpful and unfriendly front desk office staff   VERY SLOW SERVICE  we arrived at the hotel at half hour to midnight and we waited for a good 35 minutes for our turn to check in  the best part was that there were only one person in front of us at the queue  whenever we asked for something to be delivered to the room  it takes at least 25 minutes  even if it s only for a pair of slippers  internet key pass has to be refreshed every 24 hours and whenever we call the operator  they are rude and sound like we re a hassle to them  such unprofessional service

We arrived at the Hotel very early in the morning about 7am after a 10 hour flight  Due to the Hotel being full previous night our room was not ready until 930am  Not a major as we dropped our bags and went for a stroll through Little India  When we returned to the hotel we were upgraded immediately which was great as we were on our honeymoon  The staff were fantastic especially the front of house staff checking us in  very nice and happy to help with anything  We stayed for 4 nights and breakfast was included every morning  The breakfast was great with a huge selection of all sorts  Seen the hotel is located in Little India  there are alot of different nationalities staying so the breakfast catered for all nationalities  The location of the hotel was great  The MRT underground railway was just across the road which you can take to all parts of Singapore  little India on the doorstep  shopping  foods of the world  everything very handy The Pool was very nice and clean  After a hot day it was great relaxing in and beside the pool  Pool staff very freindly also All and all it was a very pleasant stay with a nice room  Hotel Staff very helpful and always smiling Ps  if you time  go to the Zoo  Great day out and probably the best in the world

Nice hotel but a little noisy at night with people returning to their rooms  Staff were very good and helpful  Forget trying to take out money from a ATM on a Saturday  Each machine had an approximate queue of 20 to 30 people  Apart from that I did like it  Singapore is very clean and has a wonderful botanical garden  We went on the Singapore Flyer which is similar to the London Eye only bigger and we also took in the city bus tour  All in all I was really surprise how much I liked Singapore and would go back without hesitation

Stayed at this hotel for 3 nights so that we could explore Singapore   We found it to be comfortable and despite reading that the staff were not too friendly we had no problems with that at all  On arriving at the hotel after a long flight I realised that I had left my hand luggage in the transport from the airport  The staff very kindly got in touch with the driver and it was duly returned to the hotel  I could not thank them enough as this is not a good start to any holiday We arrived early in the morning and the room was not ready until11 00am but this could be the fault of the holiday company and not the hotel  After a 12 hour flight it would have been great to be able to get into a room  When we finally got a room it had a strong smell of smoke and we had specifically asked for non smoking rooms  I suppose you will always get guests who still smoke despite being asked not to  We asked to be moved and at first they said could the room be sprayed but we said no and were finally given another room  The downside was that it was not available until 3 00pm     When we got the room it was worth the wait because it was much better decorated than the first room  which did not look too good at all with paint peeling off the ceiling  Even my husband  who thought that at first I was being fussy  agreed that we had made the right decision in asking to be moved We did not eat at the hotel as we were out all the time but the rooms were very clean and tidy  It was a very good location for sightseeing

The hotel is in the middle of the  quot Little India quot  area of Singapore and has good access to the MRT and there is a shopping centre across the road which seems fairly new but for me the only worthwhile thing at the centre was the wide choice of places to eat Overall I was disapointed with the hotel  The room was clean and reasonable size but thats where the experience ended For me the worst was the dining area  I only had breakfast there  which was complete chaos every morning  There were almost always no teaspoons for the coffee  They sometimes ran out of coffee cups  there were not enough glasses for the juice  the butter was put out frozen solid and completely unusable  the coffee machine  a nice benefit normally  made lukewarm coffee  That being said  there was a fairly extensive choice of food The room walls seemed to me to be made of cardboard  I had a lot of noise from the neighbouring rooms and was woken up several times by the noise and you could hear the room doors slamming from all the neighbouring rooms when people left their rooms  The  20 minutes it took to check out just put the icing on the cake  good thing I was not in a hurry

I stayed at this hotel for 4 nights with wife and 2 kids  I had booked a family room online  On reaching the hotel at around 10 in the morning  i was told that check in time is 2 pm  My younger son  10 years  was not feeling well  so i requested the front desk if they could give him some place to lie down  The person  Rally  rudely turned the request down  saying that we could go to the pool area  We enquired twice or thrice if the room was ready before two pm  but were told that it was being cleaned  I asked them to hurry up due to the condition with my son  but the response was rude both times t their rooms on time At 2 pm  I checked again and was told that the  quot room will be ready in another 15 20 minutes quot   Then i lost it  I told them that the hotel check in time is 2 pm and i want a room NOW    The front desk was still hesitant so i asked them to call the Manager  She came and was gracious enough to give us two connecting rooms on the Orchid Club floors But the experience was bitter  The Rally guy was downright rude  The lobby was full of aged persons and family with young kids all waiting for 2 pm to pass  God knows they got the rooms even then or not The front desk really needs to get its act together  The hotel was full of Indian guests and I felt that they were the most ill treated  Pity for a good hotel on a great location

The location of this hotel is very good  There is an MRT station a few metres away  a new shopping mall with good eateries opposite and Little India behind  The rooms are a good size and the beds comfortable  Staff were helpful and courteous The swimming pool was a good size and there was a separate small shallow pool for children

The hotel was very comfortable with clean rooms which are well maintained  Wondeful spread of breakfast which should not be missed  The biggest plus point is the location  Situated just behind the famous Mustafa shopping centre  one can shop even in the midnight and just walk back to the hotel thereby saving valuable time for sight seeing during the day  Room service is prompt  Overall an unforgettable experience

I have just returned from a Singapore Stopover Holiday  staying at the Parkroyal on Kitchener Road  What a wonderful time was had by all  My 9 month old was thoroughly spoiled by all the staff   especially at meal times   She misses the attention since returning home   We were caught up in the flight disruption due to the volcanic eruption and the staff could not have been more helpful  Throughout the time even when there was no information they made it their business to try and find out from Singapore Airlines if there had neen any updates  They did their best to extend our stay within SIA guidelines which we managed to do for an extra night  We were sad to leave The fact that my two parents  pensioners  look forward to visiting Singapore again is partly down to the friendliness of everyone at Kitchener Road  The hotel itself was in an excellent location to the metro and we travelled around well  If you needed anything then you had a new shopping centre across the road and the Mustafa Centre round the corner  You could buy anything 24 hours a day  We changed money at this centre and got a very good rate We look forward to visiting again and exploring more of the city

Hotel is located in Little India in Singapore  Very Large 23 floors  It had a nice outside large pool area  Staff were really nice and helpful and you felt they tried to do their best for you We had a large room with 1 double bed  1 single bed and 1 roll away  The room was very spacious  but quite expensive  Over 400 SGD Night  I would recommend it  but I am sure their are better hotels in singapore in better locations  We had to get taxi s anywhere interesting

LOCATION  Very near the farrer park MRT and right next to the new shopping mall  SERVICE  staff were friendly and helpful  however  the front desk person took some time to check us in  Overall  I would give 100  for effort  ROOMS  The rooms were nice  comfy and clean  Some of the amenities such as shavers and toothbrushes were not readily available in the bathroom  and the walls between rooms are too thin   I could hear the next door neighbour watching TV all night  BREAKFAST  breakfast buffet at the  quot spice brasserie quot  was fantastic  I loved the variety

Stayed in the Orchid Club rooms for 3 days  Nice rooms and service  Food was also good with a good spread  At check in   1 00PM   the reception had just 2 people handling both check in and check out  Took almost 30 40 min to check  in   Check  out at 7AM was also similarly slow with 4 5 guests and just 1 person in the counter  I found this odd as most of the time I saw a lot of staff in the lobby  being security or others  but rarely more than 2 people manning the reception counters

Date  30 April 2010We booked this hotel as it was in Little India near Mustafa centre  It is really nice place with good service  helpful staff  nice ambience and tasty food also We have seen other hotels in Singapore and talked to friends who stayed in other hotels I recommend this hotel as it is better than others for all of above plus it s location is d best for vegetarian Indians specially It is very conveniently located  It is luxurious and very good value for money  MRT  Taxi  cab  sight seeing  other booking facilities are available They could have provided complimentary mineral water once a day  rather charging too much for it  Apart from charges it is very good option

I checked in on May 25 and checked out on May 29 and this was my worst stay ever globally in any hotel  The ordeal started with the check in process    though the hotel has 4 check in desks  2 were This hotel is located in a very convinient place for Shopping  as this is situated stone throw from Mustafa Shopping Centre  Transport Etc  This is very ideal for stay  specially for South Indians as this located very close to restaurants  who serves south indian foods Actually I went for SPA section   Body massage   amp  I found it was very expensive  amp  compared to other Hotel  Outlets  nearby this hotel  In fact I d asked for a discount which was declined by the Hotel  Probably they may loose customers  if they don t review their tariff for body massaging NR PRASADBANGALORE  INDIA

Booked here since it was suggested by the Travel sites and travel companies Was pretty impressed on arrival  We had booked into a Suite   so  we had our own private check in at the Club Floor The staff were very courteous   the business center and club room were very elegant and serves complimentary drinks  coffee  tea and snacks on all evenings Complimentary laundry and many other attractions The breakfast was very impressive   great spread and nice choice  Pool  fitness center  bars were very nice and enjoyable  The hotel is right on Little India   so  if you have shopping and food on top of your priorities   this is the place to stay  Gives you a complete feeling of living in India   there are a few Indian temples too within walking distance The 24 hr shopping   Mustafa is just next door and hence a shopping delight  Streets and streets of very good restaurants closeby   which almost work 24 hrs  Nice staff  nice services If you like a calm and scenic locale   this is not the place   you must look for a resort Will recommend this place if you like being close of a lot of facilities

We booked a room at Parkroyal on Kitchener Road thru a known contact in Singapore for 4 days  May 23   26  for a holiday The biggest USP of this place is its location  the heart of Little India  For a vegetarian like me and my family  this was a blessing since a good no  of veg  Indian restaurants  Saravana Bhavan  Komalas  Ananda Bhavan  located nearby  Also just behind this place is the 24 hour Mustafa shopping centre  Since its open throughout the night  one can always hop in at the wee hours and shop rather than putting in daytime Another advantage of Mustafa is that they offer the best currency exchange rates in Singapore and accept most of the known currencies  Indian Rupee included The service is quick  friendly and with a smile The buffet breakfast spread is good even for vegetarians  The rooms are clean and the housekeeping staff really efficient  Overall  great service with just one word of caution on the tour desk The travel   tour desk is manned by staff  very specifically  Mala from RMG Tours  which seem friendly but do not really mean to deliver  My experience was bad when I booked for our Universal Studios tour thru them  Mala did not bother to tell us that every visitor at Universal Studios is entitled for meal and souvenir vouchers worth SGD10  It was only after we returned from the place did some fellow hotel guest mentioned this to me  When Mala was asked about this she was curt and said that they are not supposed to tell this to the visitors and it is the responsibility of Universal Studios to inform the visitors  My only issue here is then why should any hotel guest opt for booking thru this Tour desk if the basics are not informed Barring this incident which leaves a sour taste  overall experience was good

1  Location   Its good for indians and veggies  several indian restaurants nearby  The MRT station is nearby and buses to the city elsewhere are available from nearby bus stops  And for shoppers  mustafa is next door though not sure if you get very cheap deals 2  Taxis are very readily available  the hotel staff helps you fetch taxis3  Rooms  especially on the upper floors  are neat and tidy  I got special rates  and free breakfast  since I had singapore airlines boarding pass  4  Breakfast is lavish with a mix of continental and indian  though the menu doesn t change much over days 5  The hotel is very strict with checkin checkout times  I don t believe the hotel was full  yet the hotel made me wait till the the checkin time  2pm  after I had reached early  The checkin reception is quite often a bottleneck with long waits in the checkin queue

We stayed in Park Royal  with a side trip to Kuala Lumpur over New years eve  twice  Upon arrival in Singapore and upon returning from KL  Helpfulness of the staff seemed to be mainly dependent on the rush of customers they were exposed to  though there weren? t extreme negatives  I had an individual I did not know leave messages for the room number daily  and even though I told the staff I did not care for them  they were still forwarded Some of the rooms are basic and well used  but all the rooms we lived in had bath tubs  After a long day in Singapore heat I found them nice with AC and the beds comfy  Be wary of the rooms with the connecting doors  unless it? s your own two parties   they are merely blocking views  not noise  Internet is pay per hour During the first stay and per request we got switched to a much nicer room close to the pool  That didn? t work after our return  The hotel was almost overbooked   if you plan to go around holiday time  DO reserve in advance  and reconfirm  if you leave for a while   so there was no choice but the dreaded door room  It was louder  but we survived  Try the pool  We had robes  slippers  and fresh towels  It? s not exotic  but you? ll like it  and I found the seating areas inviting  There is also a fitness room adjacent  but I did not use that Breakfast is o k   if a bit of a stretch  as it tries to accomodate European  American  African and Asian tastes at the same time  For a supply of fresh fruit other than daily melons  make the short trip around the corner to to Mustafa s shopping center  If you find the restaurant pricey  by all means don? t stay in the hotel to eat  Asian folk just LOVE to eat  and you find cheap and cheapest foodstalls and restaurants all over Little India  At a little African place at a nearby corner we had more fresh food cooked under our eyes than we could clean up  and for next to nothing  If you prefer vegetarian  Indian places offer variety  And if you absolutely need a burger  by all means  this can be accomplished too  I don? t recommend sticking with an average hotel kitchen  if the sounds and smells of Asia are waiting right outside your doorstep  And there is always the underground close by  if you think you need to go farther  or fancy a somewhat more upscale surrounding It is probably wise to expect some construction in progress somewhere close to the hotel  Singapore seems to be hustling  bustling and moving constantly  Nothing will stay the same for long as far as buildings go  But don? t let it keep you from enjoying what? s to see in Singapore  Immerse yourself  instead of staying put

Our stay was enjoyable the rooms were clean and of a good size even though 4 of us stayed in the room location in little india was a busy area with a lot going on at all times  The pool was a great relief from the heat of singapore but the surrounds of the pool were dangerously slippery  We all enjoyed the breakfast lots of variety for all and poached eggs done to order  check in and out were ok and staff very friendly and helpful  A good busy hotel

We chose Parkroyal on the basis of other reviews here  As mentioned in other reviews it is pretty well across the road from Farrer Park MRT Station  For shoppers it s sandwiched between the incredible Mustapha Centre and a new shopping mall  The new mall has plenty of western and tame eastern food for the unadventurous  For gourmets  and in particular vegetarians  the proximity to Little India is fantastic The pool got top marks from our 6 year old  we sampled three hotels on our trip   It s big and deep  The change rooms have lockers unlike some other hotels  The gym has a nice outlook over pool and looks as though it has had a recent freshen up The rooms are comfortable enough  but suffer from adjoining doors with poor soundproofing  We asked to move after two nights next door to a man who conducted phone calls at high volume well into the night  The hotel was accommodating in this regard

We travelled to Singapore on family vacation  Reached Singapore in afternoon from Langkawi  On arriving at Singapore was greeted by an agent who transferred us to the Hotel Parkroyal on Kitchener Road  The hotel has a modern facade just like all other buildings in Singapore  It is situated right outside the Farrer Park Metro Station  in one corner of the Little India  On the back of Hotel is the famous Mustafa Departmental store  So it is most convenient for Indians who are traveling on their first tour  vacation outside country  Being on the one corner of Little India there are lots of Indian Restaurants offering vegetarian food at convenient price The Hotel lobby was small  but it seems that they have purposely kept it small and have created a separate lounge for visitors since it attracts lots of visitors waiting for their transfer or various Singapore city tour  We had to wait for our room as the check in time is 2 00 PM  There is nothing to write about the check in process since the associate on reception worked in mechanical manner with no emotions or expressions on face  We were given a room on 7 8 th floor with a view of the swimming pool on 3rd floor of the hotel and the city line outside it The rooms were simple with no frills  The bath rooms did not have any guest towel  in repeated reminders to the Guest Assistance  it took long to get the same delivered The breakfast at hotel was sumptuous and elaborate

My wife and I stayed here for our honeymoon  We got upgraded to an executive room so don t know how the standard rooms are  but the executive rooms were nice and spacious  we did notice cobwebs however    There was a fruit basket on arrival but we didn t get newspapers  The hotel seemed really crowded  we had to queue up for almost 20mins before we could check in  and similarly at the coffee shop for breakfast  service was slow  the staff seemed rushed and the tables looked dirty  We were even seated at a dirty table and had to wait for them to clean it up  The location is good  in case u re looking for some bargain shopping  coz it s right next door to Mustafa s  You get reimbursed the GST for anything you buy there and their currency exchange rates are good  There s also another mall across the road as well as a metro station  The hotel is in Little India  so for Indians  that s good as there are many Indian restaurants around if you feel a bit home sick or are a vegetarian

Stayed in Hotel Park Royal in Kitchener Road Adjacent on the Hotel s side is the Traditional 24x7 and ever expanding Mustafa shopping centre and right opposite is City Mall  the newest addtion to Singapore s showy shopping centres Religious Walk spots in the Serangoon road are the South Indian Hindu temple and Isalmic mosque  For business meets Suntec and Singapore s CBD is 10 minutes away by Taxi  For fun travellers MRT s pink line is just in the Serangoon   Kitchner Road taraffic signal  Internationaly popular South Indian eating branded hotels are one after another Certainly a good spot for stay both for business as well as leasure travellers

Me and my colleagues had to visit Singapore for a week long conferences  Though it was booked by the inviting company and expenses paid by them  I would next time book it for personal reasons  It is rightly priced at around SGD 120 for the facilities provided  However I did notice many people returning without booking or had some issues with bookings as the hotel is mostly booked  Hence you might want to book it in advance before checking in Did not have any hassles in particular at the hotel and the staff was quite friendly however checking in took 30 mins  could be my bad luck as most of the guests were checking in then  You may also want to note their check in time mentioned on their site which is around 12 00 if I am not mistaken  Connectivity You may take a MRT  Mass Rapid Transport  i e  metro rail  from the Changi airport till Ferrer Park station  The hotel is at 2 mins walking distance from the metro station which implies excellent connectivity for any place around Singapore through MRT  Since it is close to the city commercial area location is quite suited for the ones looking for something close to offices  Specially for Indians the nearby locality rightly called  Little India  suits well for food and other requirements Overall the hotel would not upset you on any part unless you are looking for luxurious amenities which you could find in other five star hotels

We found this hotel very good  our room was on 14th floor and was very quiet  one of the quietest we ve ever been in  bathroom had a bath which was very nice  We also had nice views across the city  I also liked that you can switch the room AC off completely if you wish The staff were actually friendly and the check in and check out didn t take long at all despite I can imagine it can if there is a large group of people waiting  The bar area downstair is nice  We didn t have breakfast in the hotel so can t comment on this  We found the City Square Mall opposite excellent for breakfast with Toast Box  Kopitiam  Banquet  Coffee Bean and more to choose from  The MRT Farrer Road MRT station is a short walk away and is accessible from the City Square Mall shopping centre from B1

This was to be the grand finale to a wonderful gathering of family from all over the world  What a let down  One room booked for three eventually had a fold away camp bed delivered  In one room the bath emptied very quickly not down the plug hole but through the tiles on the side of the bath over the floor  Tiles around the pool were dangerously slippery  A dinner for 4 adults and two small children cost over  300  The rooms and corridors were musty and in need of refurbishment Have informed our travel agent

Room was clean if a bit dated  First impression was brown and drab  But room is large and facilties fine Staff are very friendly and helpful  Even gave me a birthday cake Public areasare better than the rooms  We didn t eat in hotel so can t comment on food  It is very close to Ferrer MRT so very convenient and you can eat in Central Mall for very little If you can get a good deal then it is a very acceptable hotel but don t expect 5

I booked this hotel based from the reviews here  My husband and my 3 teenage children went to Singapore for a holiday and we stayed in this hotel  The staff are so hospitable  courteous and kind especially the Filipino staff  At first we do not know that they are Filipinos because my family looks chinese  We overheard them talking in our language in one of the guests but still  i dont introduce myself as a Filipino so that i would know if they are treating the guest fairly   and i am right  They treat each and every guest fairly as i have observed during my stay  Everyone is SPECIAL  The family room is spacious enough for my teenage children  They have a variety of food to choose from in the breakfast buffet  We had a nice time in this hotel and i will surely go back in this hotel whenever me and my family will go to Singapore again

On transit back to Brisbane and needed a night at this hotel  Booked over internet after seeing such wonderful pictures but was absolutely horrified at the state of the hotel  The foyer was tired and old looking but the rooms were by far the worst I have ever experienced  Walls were dirty  not marked but dirty  the rooms were barely furnished and the airconditioning in my brothers room didn t work in Singapore in August  Breakfast was a total joke and we all booked via there website only to have problems checking in  Also not the best part of town to stay in  I would never recommend this tip to anyone

We booked this hotel for our stop over en route back to the UK from Brisbane  It wasn t our preferred choice at the time but all that was available at the time We booked a family room which was large enough for three of us  The room was spotless and being on the 16th floor gave us a good view over the city  Room service was excellent but on the pricey side  We spent much time round the pool area  this was fine but there was little shade and the pool side was very slippy when wet  Breakfast was included with our room rate and this was an experience in itself  By the time I had queued and got my fried eggs  everyone else had eaten their food  One major plus for us with this hotel was the location  It was handy for just about everything  even 24hour shopping if your that way inclined The staff were very friendly and helpful  We loved the little shop in the lobby One negative thing was the stair case leading up to lobby  not good for some Overall we had a pleasurable experience but would most likely stay elsewhere on a repeat visit

I had stayed in Parkroyal hotel on kitchener road during my trip to Singapore  We selected this hotel based on the excellent reviews it had received  Its Centrally located in Singapore with easy access to the MRT  The service offered is excellent  The rooms were posh and clean  The room service was very prompt Overall an amazing experience and total worth for the money

Spent a wonderful 4 days here  Staff very friendly and helpful  Breakfast great  Bar  relaxing and good choice of bar meals and deals on drinks  Plenty of sun beds round pool Located in Little India   Mustafa  market behind and loads of restaurants offering good value for money meals  Metro across the road from the front of the hotel offering quick and efficient travel to city centre

Just returned from Singapore  Stayed for a week at Parkroyal at Kitchner road  I tell you sirs  this is an excellent place to stay  Prime location in Little India  right opposite the Farrer park MRT station  entry through City square mall   Just behind the hotel is Mustafa mall  a haven for shoppers who don t have their nose in the air  for them there is Orchard street  high end   A word about Mustafa  This place a massive  fixed priced  crowded and very competitive  Compared with several other malls including Sim Lim mall  electronics   one can t beat Mustafa  Few reviewers have criticised Parkroyal for facilities  This place has 18 storeys  354 rooms  spic span  swimming pool  spa  well equipped gym  shopping arcade  courteous staff  prompt service  spacious rooms  LCD TV  coffee maker and what else do you need   I for one give full marks to the place

I had been booked in to the Hotel thru my office for 3 days starting from Sep 16th morning  called early booking  since check in is 2 pm and check out 12 pm till sep 18th 12 pm  and to my shock on my arrival  i was told to wait till 12 pm and take bath in one of the baths located near swimming pool in their room  despite booking early by 15 days  In case u r booking into thotel for pre block or early check in pl confirm before taking a chance  However   the room quality and service cleanliness are very good  but the quality of programmes in inhouse telivision is not to an international choice  if you were an international traveller and the first your body clock is not to Singapore timing u r left with not much inhouse entertainment The location is ideal if u are a shopping lover   since it is right next to Mustaffa Shopping Centre in Little India which open 24 hours with all GST reimbursement convenience I need to definitely comment about one of the best thing in this hotel  which is the quot  Spice Bassiere quot   i am not sure i am spelling it right   The restaurant  The food is very good and of variety of choices of international cuisine and tastes divine  particularly break fast Except for the starting hitch  one can enjoy the over all stay

My husband and I had booked a double room in this hotel for four nights in February 2010 and had paid the whole amount in advance through the travel agent  On checking into the hotel  we were told that there were no double rooms available and were given a room with twin beds  We were very disappointed as we could not go to another hotel because of the advance payment already having been made  After speaking to the manager we were given a double room for the last two nights of our stay The rooms were lovely and there was no problem at all there I would recommend this hotel but would ask everyone to make sure beforehand and to confirm the room type directly from the hotel staff before making the payment

Stayed at the hotel once again this year visiting for the Grand Prix  Hotel  Location was as expected from my previous stays  however checking in service was slow this time  waited a few hours before I got a room  although check in was 12pm I believe  I arrived 6 hrs prior  however they got me a room ready within 3 5 hrs  had a sleep in their lobby   overall the experience from the hotel was decent  if your not fussed and want a place to sleep its very good for that  if you want 18k gold plated toilet seats and diamond encrusted door handles and a bottle of Bollinger and caviar in the fridge  this isn t the hotel for you    however if your a person who is seeking something that isn t dirty  or nasty but is looking for a quality comfortable experience in a hotel that rooms have fairly good setups  then this is the place for you   D

Chose this hotel if you have to be in the  quot Little India quot  area or want to spend shopping at the Famous Mustapha center  But if you d like to get a taste of Singapore this is the WRONG area to stay in  The Hotel in itself was great  go for the Orchid Club rooms which are worth the extra money especially since you get to use the lounge through out the day which well stocked with snacks and drinks  in the evenings they serve cocktails and Sushi The main gripe I had with the hotel was that the room has connecting doors to the next room and through the door you can hear everything that goes on  As I had noisy neighbors who joked and laughed until the wee hours of the morning  I did not get much sleep The Free WIFI was most welcome

We picked the hotel primarily for its proximity to the Little India to resolve our  quot vegetarian quot  food constraints  Apart from this the hotel ensures a comfortable stay in cozy rooms  Do not miss the breakfast at any cost   the very generous spread ensures you start your day on the right foot  The check in is a little tedious   took us about half hour for the lone receptionist to send the 3 of us to our rooms   not the best way to shake off your jetlag  Amenities include the fitness centre and the pool  but unfortunately not utilizable for the business traveler as they close quite early  LAN internet is available free of cost  The Mustafa shopping centre is literally in the backyard and being open 24 hours can provide retail therapy for even the insomniacs

The hotel is fine for sleeping taking a bath or shower and there is a good breakfast buffet but the Chinese restaurant  Hai Xiang  will put dishes you did not order on your table  you must pay for these  They also ask you to sign a second receipt when you pay by credit card  This looks very much like an authorization to charge the bill to your room   I refused to sign this even after they said   quot Oh  just a quick signature for our financial records is OK quot   They were insistent that I sign   I saw no reason to sign a second time  The food was mediocre The only other gripe is that WiFi is NOT available in your room  as erroneously advertised  but there are  quot hot spots quot  inside the hotel   try near the lifts Parkroyal is better than the York Hotel and the location is great   the City Square Mall  opposite  has a supermarket and lots of FOOD COURTS plus the usual shops  MUSTAFA CENTRE  behind the hotel  is an emporium but without alcohol  Nearby restaurants are mainly Indian   includiing vegetarian  inexpensive and good  The MRT is less than 5 mins  away

The hotel location is close to the subway  about five minutes walk   The room is very cosy and clean  also the staff is very helpfull and friendly  I book with breakfast which where I could choose from indian  japanese and continental offers  I always had japanese and afterwards indian   not the other way round    After a sweaty stroll through the city enjoy the pool

Park royal on kitchener road  Singapore was the best hotel we stayed during the course of our honeymoon in SE Asia    the suites were classy and comfortable    staff was courteous and the food was gud too    being centrally located in Singapore also helped   and the location is esp gud for Indians as the area has a lot of indian outlets too    out n out the experience was very satisfying for me

This is the first time I ve ever felt the need to write a bad review for a hotel  Rooms were clean but old   very run down and many things broken  Drains in bathroom smelt strongly of urine  Spare blankets unwashed and extremely smelly  Food very overpriced  and so were our rooms  Staff mostly very helpful and pleasant and pool gym good but AVOID this hotel  We have stayed at much better hotels in Singapore for less  I think Parkroyal have spent money doing up lobby and nothing else Other Parkroyal  on beach  much better hotel all round

A Tourist to Singapore I and my wife stayed in the hotel in the first week of Dec 09  while on a vacation trip to Singapore  We had very good services suggested by their staff especially  when I had my vehicle broken down on a rainy day  none of the normal crisis answer businesses had persons to drive to gaze for fixes asap   That is when their Concierge staff on obligation  Jason Chan  went out of his way to seek and find a service business to arrive in speedily and determination my car s difficulty  in order that we could start the excursion back to our dwelling asap  All of us actually treasured Jason s individual engagement to join to our difficulty  till it was settled  regardless of a hefty hurry of jobs that hotel employees has  throughout night hours  It is an very good hotel with large service

The Park Royal is a great hotel in a very good location  At the edge of little India there is plenty to see and do in the evenings and plenty of restuarants to choose from  Getting to the MRT is a 2 minute walk and very easy to get anywhere from there  Hotel itself is very clean and staff are excellent  Breakfasts had amazing choice and overall a very good hotel

We stayed at this hotel as a result of a recommendation from our Travel agent  The location was good and Little India is a must see but the hotel is a bit tired  We were particularly disappointed that even though we requested adjoining rooms we were in fact put 2 floors apart  We filled out a questionnaire emailed by the hotel on our return and mentioned this but received no response The concierge service was very good and those staff should be commended  would I return   probably not  would look in the Orchard Road area next time

This hotel has unbelievably clueless staff  I was visiting Singapore this week and one of my business colleagues was staying here  and called me from the hotel  The hotel staff were unable to trace the room number  or take messages  or connect me to my friend  I must have called up a dozen times on Nov 8  but each time got stonewalled  Then they connected me to someone else with the same surname who has been staying there since Octover 7 but who was not my friend  When I protested  they told me my friend s booking had been cancelled on Nov 2  So I had to wait until my friend made contact    and it turned out he had been staying there all the time  Amateurish  disorganised  what else can I say  Beware if you decide to stay here  they can t accomplish the simplest tasks

We had 3 wonderful days in singapore  Only thing sad was the haze  The hotel was good and the location was on the NE  purple  line  Little India  China Town Clarke Quay Marina  Dhouby Ghaut stops and thats the most famous lines for S pore  This is 4th time stay and this time was better  The room was on the 6th floor  spa floor and not bad  Carpets and corridor didnt stink of moss  Well kept  Bfast was not bad though too pricey  If you want a lovely toast go across to the new shopping mall to Toast Box or if you like indian go behind the hotel for arrays for indian restaurants  Excellant location     Value for money for sure YES

We stayed here for 3 nights to spend some time in Singapore before moving onto Thailand  The hotel is clean and the staff are friendly so couldn t find any fault  The only downside we felt was that it s location is quite a distance from the main sights and taxis were required to get anywhere but not really that expensive  and not the hotel s fault  There was a swimming pool but didn t get a chance to try it  Breakfast buffet offered good choice  and plenty Indian choice being in Little India  but there was also a lovely bakery across the road and plenty malls located close by for last minute shopping

Located right next to the mustafa shopping centre and easily accessible by car to any part of city  Park Royal has been our favourite hotel in singapore  The service is excellent and we got the best deal through the hotel which was quite lucrative to accomodate our family of four  We were given a family suite with two rooms  since we reached early at 10 am we still got an early check in without any hassles  The hotel breakfast is a wide spread of different cuisines and we are always spoilt for choice  The staff was very courteous and friendly They took care of our little needs when asked for  my husband needed a shaving kit as he lost his at the airport  The hotel has revamped its interiors and is looking more elegant since our last visit Its always our first choice in Singapore

My Husband and I stayed at the Parkroyal on Kitchener for 2 nights after spending 7 days in Langkawi  We have previously been to Singapore 4 times and stayed at different hotels each time and loved it  We found this hotel to be a little run down and it didnt meet our expectations for a 4star hotel or the price we paid  I read a lot of reviews on this hotel before booking   with mixed feelings  Being vegetarian myself  but not my husband   I thought this might be a great area to try despite never having had any problems in the past getting vegetarian food in Singapore  We were a little surprised when we ordered room service for breakfast   my husband called asking if we could get poached eggs on toast and grilled tomato to which he was told that he could only order off the menu and no changes were permitted  So he then told them his wife was vegetarain and what could they offer me and her reply was cornflakes with no other suggestions  We also were turned away from 2 other restaurants in little india when asked if they could do something vegetarian  This has never happened to us before   we ve always found the restaurants to be most flexible We also called into the hotel bar after a night of shopping  around 10 30pm   We sat down and waited to have our drinks order taken only to be told that the bar was closed while other patrons had drinks  On the plus side   the hotel does have a nice pool area which features little areas with 2 sunloungers covered by a canvas gazebo with inbuilt fan aswell as a serviced bar offering some nice drinks and snacks All in all I wouldnt stay here again   was definitely not a fan of the location or the hotel  I think for the same price you can find a better standard of hotel with a bit more life and ambience about it

The hotel was very good and surrounded by shopping malls  Not just Mustafa   Close to the Metro station and within walking distance of a few 24x7 restaurants  Our flight got in very early and hotel check in was at 2pm  it wasn t a problem since we walked around and found many eating joints  The staff was very helpful  welcoming and organised despite full occupancy Though it was CRAZY on the weekends since practically all Indians who live in Singapore gather around in Little India   so avoid staying here if it overlaps a weekend

If you can t do without indian food  aim to shop till the wee hours at Mustafa and come back to sleep in relative comfort  this is perhaps the best option Located adjacent to the famed 24 hour shopping centre Mustafa and within easy walking distance of a multitude of indian eateries including several pure vegetarian outlets  the hotel is convenience personified The fact that the Farrer park MRT station is just across the road is an added bonus The hotel is pretty well maintained and the staff is smiling and helpful There is always someone eager to help you out with your luggage or hail a taxi The healthclub and the swimming pool are quite good The rooms are not very cramped as one sees in Hongkong and if needed an extra bed can be put The rooms come with a work table and chair which I thought was nice Since we were travelling with old parents who wouldn t eat in a restaurant serving non vegetarian food couldn t try the food in the onsite restaurants Though the hotel appears to be expensive  it is not so when you compare hotel prices in Singapore which are indeed quite steep compared to Malaysia Thailand and Indonesia By the way  the bottled water you will find near the tea coffee service is chargeable

Decent location  average sized room for 4 star property with good beds but only fair bathroom  poor shower without no separate shower cubicle in a Deluxe room   good pool and gym  good breakfast and really friendly helpful staff Got a very good deal with 50  a promotion rate off 2nd room for the children  Makes it excellent value for money  Will stay again if the price is right

Stayed here for 4 nights in August 2013 and being a new hotel it is was of a high standard  Very clean  modern  service was excellent and the breakfast selection was amazing and plentiful  We had a lovely open view from our room on the 9th floor overlooking buildings at a good distance and the roads with traffic  no noise  which at nighttime was particularly mesmerising  We had Wifi in our room and it was fast with no problems  The hotel is a little distant from the main city area but it is well worth the stay value wise for what you get as it is only 2 train stops from Orchard Road  Singapore s train system  MRT  is extremely easy to use  not expensive  is fast and efficient as the lines are colour coded  There is a complimentary shuttle bus approx every 30 min from to the hotel and Novena station which is the closest train station  although you could walk it in 15 20 minutes as it is mostly flat terrain  The seats are on a first come  first serve basis so when leaving the hotel make sure you book your seat early with the concierge at the counter eg  Night before or immediately when you know what time you need to leave the hotel  as these spots fill up fast  as the bus also picks up passengers from another hotel  Coming home by shuttle bus from Novena station is a bit more challenging as there is no pre booking of seats and again are on a first come first serve basis  On our first evening we waited for 20 mins for the shuttle to arrive and when it did all these people seem to appear from nowhere and ran frantically to the bus  with us and 3 others left behind as all the seats were taken  So we walked back to the hotel together after told by the driver he does not come back to pick us up but only returns when the next shuttle is scheduled  So it is best to ensure your options are open eg  Taxi or walking back to the hotel  For me this was the only disappointing factor in staying at this hotel  Other than that  I would most definitely stay at Ramada again and would have no hesitation of recommending this hotel as I already have done

Spent two nights at the new Ramada Singapore at Zhongshan Park  near the Novena MRT station   There was a promotion which effectively priced the hotel at almost half the rate of the alternatives in the more downtown Orchard Marina area so it was a definitely a good deal  especially with the WiFi included   It is only about a S 15 taxi ride and much cheaper subway ride into the downtown CBD areas that takes about 15 25mins  but it s relatively painless As befitting a new international hotel chain   the rooms are decently sized and fitted out  The gym was small  but equipped with more equipment than I ve seen in 90  of the hotel gyms that I ve been to On the downside  the hotel is still clearly getting up to speed  There was a long wait at the reception when I checked in and checked out  The security system is still buggy   room keys not recognized by the elevator and the rooms  When I arrived at 11pm at night  my room was not available and I had to wait for over half an hour  There s a shuttle bus to the MRT station in the morning  but the reception forgot to tell me that I should register for it beforehand if I wanted to take the shuttle and so I ended up having to take a taxi because there was no room on the shuttle when I showed up in the morning  Singaporean restaurants and hotels have a widely acknowledged problem with service quality due to high staff turnover and general inexperience of the staff  but this was about as bad as I ve experienced  These problems were also exacerbated by the large number of tour groups that frequent the hotel   clogging up the elevators and reception  Recommendation   stay here if you re on a budget and get a good discount relative to more established and centrally located hotels

The Ramada is an excellent 3 star property in many aspects  Experienced Management expertise is demonstrated daily in the quality of service delivered by the well trained motivated staff members  It is one of the few hotels where you witness employees changing duties with others  and enjoying the opportunities  The property is new so the rooms are fresh  and well maintained  with upscale linens upon a lux mattress  The fitness center is well planned  overlooking the pool with floor to ceiling windows  Personal instructors are there for your needs and provide professional advice  The pool and the sun bathing areas are inviting  causing you to stay for extended periods  well into the sunset hours  Some of the loungers even extend into the pool  providing a unique experience  The food presentation and the menu selection in the main restaurant is a pleasant surprise  Unexpected are the dinner steaks  perfect  delicious  and a nice portion Many will say the location is a disadvantage  but the attached shopping mall and the two free shuttle services  discounts that comment  Even more  the numerous local neighborhood restaurants and sidewalk caf? s serve exciting varied cuisines  at unbelievable low prices when compared to the upper scale dining in Singapore  Definitely not to be missed  as all these restaurants are within immediate walking distance for the front door of the hotel  The attached Zhongshan Park provides a serene flavor to the hotel location  An added value is that with your room key allows you free admission to the Chinese Historical Museum across the street  A positive review has to include some tips for improvement  One would be ice service  One has to call guest services to have ice delivered to the room  which can take over 30 minutes  A centrally located self service ice machine would be more convenient  than waiting so long for an ice bucket  Second  the free internet terminals in the business center are the latest high tech  but to print  involves sending documents to a hotel email address  This is in an undue process  and with confidential documents can be worrisome  Overall  this property is a true value  a hidden jewel in the Balistier area of Singapore  No doubt this is the reason why the hotel is robust with guest activity  I would truly recommend this hotel for short and long term stays  as additional benefits accrue for guests who plan extended stays

I was apprehensive but then based on the majority of the reviews and the fact that it was a brand new hotel   though away from most places of interest  I chose this  The price was also quite attractive considering mine was a last minute peak season Christmas holiday booking  First of all it lacks all that warmth at the reception  the wait is forever  the accent difficult to follow  I was checked in twice  I had requested for a room higher up   but then had to settle for a room just above the smoking floor  The phones didn t work   had to dial reception several times but no one would call back  The wi fi was pathetic  The breakfast was okay  In fact we got bored of the same menu   went to the zhongshan mall to eat  The park view rooms are priced higher   but they are just the same size and not great views either  The worst was yet to come though  Singapore was just utter chaos on new years eve  We hadn t booked our taxi back in advance and none of the cab companies were taking they flatly refused  inspite of giving evidence of staying at the hotel  We were stranded all night on the streets of Singapore begging cabbies to drive us back to our hotel for even 4 times the charge  But  they just won t as apparently they all had bookings  The entire time the hotel staff didn t even care about its guests being stranded in the city  Even worse I had lost my phone in their lobby 2 nights before this episode  I requested the front desk to pull up the security footage and it just fell on deaf ears  I finally had to get a report filed in the local police station and on showing them the report did they care to tell me that the cab company which sent me the taxi  I m still a little doubtful that I might have left my phone at the bell desk when I was asking the bellhop to hail me a cab  However  the new years night incident just rattled me as to how insensitive a hotel can be towards its own guests  We took shelter in the Carlton hotel s lobby for the night like most of other tourists and they didn t even object  That s what I call a hospitality and humanity  A Ramada   never again for me  Even if it were the last hotel on earth
