Operating under the Wyndham Hotel Group  Ramada Hotel Singapore is casual and modern  while still acknowledging the traditional Chinese heritage of the Zhong Shan Park and surrounding area  Since its opening in 2013  Ramada Hotel Singapore has quickly made a name for itself as an affordable venue for both short stays  as well as events Ambience at Ramada Hotel Singapore is a mix of modern and quirky  and traditional Chinese decor  Colour themes of red  gold and white are prevalent throughout the hotel  while whimsical artwork are present in the main lobby and ballroom   conference room areas  Ramada Hotel Singapore also benefits from having the scenie Zhong Shan Park just outside  and the view is pretty nice Service at Ramada Hotel Singapore is very good  I particular  the banquet and events team is excellent  very experienced at handling all manner of situations  unexpected or not  Furthermore  they are able to accomodate various requests  The room service and hotel reception staff are also good  professional  efficient and helpful  However  really out of the normal sort of requests may take them some time to sort out  if at all  Wifi connection in the hotel is decent  and guests have complimentary 24 hours internet access The room and facilities at Ramada Hotel Singapore are excellent  The rooms themselves are comfortable  though rather small  and the bathroom is functional at best  There isn t any kitchen or cooking equipment in the rooms  However  the roof garden is scenic  and the swimming pool is sufficiently large  The gymnasium is well equipped and of a decent size  Conference rooms offer a scenic view  and projectors and equipment function well  But the main ballroom is small compared to other hotels It also helps that Ramada Hotel Singapore is directly next to Zhong Shan Mall  which is very convienent  They also offer regular shuttle services to Novena MRT and Orchard Road throughout each day  which makes commuting for guests much easier  I must also commend Tasneem Banu Yunos  the banquet service manager  and her number 2 man  Zap  for their excellent assistance and recommendations throughout our event

I d say my stay here was average  I guess  like any hotel in Singapore  the issue I had to deal with was the size of the room  the room was small  On the upside  since it is new  it s clean and well maintained  The hotel isn t near the MTR station but they provide a shuttle service at designated points  True hotel is also connected to a small mall so it s easy to find a place to eat  I d stay in this hotel again if needed but I d search for other options

We have enjoyed several  quot Singapore Stopovers quot  when traveling between Melbourne and London  This has been one of the best due to the Ramada Singapore hotel  The rooms are clean and modern  The beds are comfortable and the breakfast was quite good and well priced  The hotel is located somewhat north of the hustle and bustle of the CBD  but the MRT is nearby and a taxi ride to Marina Bay cost just over  10 There are several nearby local restaurants that look quite nice and we were happy to eat locally on our last night before heading out to the airport for a late evening departure Overall  we were very satisfied with our stay here Room Tip  The top floor  17 was very quiet  I don  39 t know about other floors See more room tips

We were delighted with the wonderful service and friendly  amp  helpful staff at Ramada Singapore  Not only was the service excellent  but this smoke free hotel is also new  the rooms are beautiful and well equipped  Would stay there again on next visit  The hotel is located further away from town centre  but we used taxis anyway as it s so hot in Singapore  so no real issue really

Third stay in this hotel  My first was a bit problematic but this stay and my second stay have been perfect  Really friendly helpful staff  good quality rooms  great pool and gym all for a really reasonable price for Singapore  The setting on Belestier road and Zhongshan park is really nice with various temples and museums close by  If you don t need to be in the centre of town this is a really convenient  comfortable and pleasant hotel to stay in

This hotel is a little out of the way  however it does offer a return shuttle service to Novena should you want to travel on the MRT  Breakfast was average  but adequate  The staff generally were very friendly and efficient  Our room on the 10th floor was clean  comfortable and quiet  Great to have a small shopping area adjacent to the hotel with a NTUC Fairprice supermarket on the top floor

I booked this hotel the day before i went to Singapore and did not get a chance to read a lot of reviews before booking  But as i went to the hotel i was highly satisfied with the room which was given to us  The customer service is perfect  The customer service representatives recommended proper tourist places which helped us a lot as we did not have any idea of where to visit Overall a satisfied stay

I visited the Dr  Sun Yan Sun Hotel behind the hotel and was very impressed by the collection  What s more the admission fee was more since I was a resident of the hotel  The buffet breakfast there was nice and I loved the sight of a green meadow before the hotel  I will certainly recommend my friend to go there again

We stayed here for 6 nights after a long trip to New Zealand  We were looking for something comfortable with a good swimming pool at less than a ? 100 a night  Not that easy in Singapore The Ramada came up complete trumps  Contrary to earlier reports the reception staff were very helpful and they gave us a late checkout of 2pm  The room though a standard hotel room was a decent size with a comfy bed and a first rAte shower room  There was free unlimited internet which was fast for a hotel  The swimming pool was excellent for a business hotel  Large with a decent set of sun beds and pleasant landscaping  it was a nice temperature as it was not overshadowed by tAll buildings  The depth was never over 1 4m  There was a good sized hotel gym too The breakfast was a good mix of Chinese  Indian and European  My only criticism was that it virtually never changed over 6 days  One of the useful hotel features is that it is part of a small mall with a cafe  restaurants  hairdressers  and a large full service supermarket open until 11pm Finally the hotel has clearly improved the shuttles  They were very regular well into the evening  And there was no problem getting a seat  The destination Novena is a big mall with lots of eateries  The street outside has a small food centre nearby as well as a number of restaurants To anyone worrying the hotel is far out of the centre  don t  It is an easy and short trip to Orchard Road  Chinatown  Little India or the new bay developments  As I said earlier we paid less than a ? 100 including breakfast through an agency

A good stay overall  Breakfast was very good with a wide selection of food  We enjoyed the free shuttle bus to the MRT as it is a humid uphill walk away  Its proximity to shopping and food outlets next door is a big plus  Room was a good size  easily able to accommodate a cot for our baby  Staff very helpful and able to sort out taxis and advise on local attractions  Nice swimming pool especially for a infant

A new modern hotel with all the facilities required  The great thing I found about the hotel was the young staff who although still learning were first class from the receptionists to the cleaners  They all were very welcoming and went out of their way to assist in every way  For value and service this hotel in Singapore is hard to match

This hotel surprised me with its beautiful modern deco with upmarket amenities  The toilet is spacious and the bed is really comfortable  The room has lots of space and the viewing deck to the Balestier Road is wonderfulI like their breakfast as its spread of international buffet is wide and I was spoiled for choices on the range of food to eat I like the cool swimming pool when it has the 1 6 size of a football field but the actual size is much smaller as the half of the pool allows you to put the sun deck n sun tan with the pool water flowing just below your deck  This is my first experience and I must say the sound of the water has added to my wonderful chill out experience  The gym is surprising well equipped and you will appreciate the help of the service staff there as well as the new range if equipment to pump up yr body  The price is on the high side but it is worth the experience

Not the most central but hey  nowhere is far in SIN  15 20 mins to the airport  same to centre of town  Rooms clean and comfortable  great pool and lots of interesting stuff nearby  Buddhist temples  a mall with a good super market on site and in particular great food stalls in the hawker markets   Good value rooms too  Would definitely recommend and stay again

It only took us 12 mins to walk leisurely from Novena Square MRT cutting through Ren Ci community hospital or Tan Tock Seng hospital basement NNI side  keeping left down Irrawaddy road  past some beautiful condos to reach the hotel  From Ibis hotel  cross the road to the shopping mall in dark grey black opposite  it has a bus stop right in front of the shopping centre  Entrance to the hotel connected directly via this  The mall also has a NTUC supermarket with all groceries you could need  a bakery  Golden Jade restaurant with dim sum and bubble tea shop  Local hawker food in the shophouses just 3 mins down the road has Thai  Western  Chicken rice etc  and fruit juices  and it was simple to takeaway and eat in the comfort of our hotel room for no more than 5 SGD a person   We tried the hotel s dinner buffet and it was very decent  with an exotic  amp  fresh salad bar  seafood  good range of yummy desserts and mains  have a browse before you decide to dine in   there was roast duck and siew mai  which I was craving   Nice ambience overlooking the park and tree  Also a wine bar just round the corner with tapas  and a pub across the green field that looked quite popular and a nice place to chill out  Also had drinks at the bar and was decently priced and quiet after dinner  bartender polite and patient despite it being obvious we were the last guests close to 12 midnight  People have complained about the size of the room but this is clearly stated in all booking websites  so really  you should be doing your research  The rooms are no smaller than standard city hotels in Singapore  and much more reasonably priced for its location near Orchard Rd   Sourced online for under 170SGD night   The bathroom was well designed  it didn t feel cramped and there was still a bathtub  We had a room at the end of the corridor and weren t disturbed by any noise despite being light sleepers  Check in and out was a breeze  the hotel called a taxi for us during peak hour when we left  and it took no longer than 10 mins after checkout for the taxi to arrive Big pluses for this hotel compared to others I have seen is the intimate but very well equipped 24 hour gym   you can even swing some kettlebells and do your kickboxing with the punching bag  Also  great pool area  We didn t get the time to use it  but it was spacious  clean and very inviting  Would have been perfect for some laps  Pool towels free to take from poolside  We never found it troublesome to shop down Orchard to Dhoby Ghaut with this hotel as a base  Travelling back via MRT train didn t tire us out  Even if you re laden with shopping  a taxi to the city shouldn t cost you more than 15SGD  One thing that stood out to be was the labelling of the room numbers   really clear and well lit  easy to see along the corridor and you could indicate if you wanted room cleaning or not with a simple press of a button  There are universal plug points as well so no need for your adaptor Room Tip  End of corridor was quiet and private See more room tips

It is what it is and if you re happy to book  200 for a room the size of a postage stamp    In it s favour  it is clean  tidy and most of what you need is there including an iron  tea making facility etc  But it is so very small  I enquired if there was a larger room  but apparently all their rooms are the same size  And the area is not great for going for a walk and finding something to do or eat  And the window has views of other ugly high rise building close by  There has got to be better options than this in S pore

It took me a while to consider Ramada to be our hotel in our last trip to singapore  april15 20  given its location  however due to budget issue  Ramada offers a good rate We arrived at the hotel around 1030am and they have accommodated our early check in and given a room at higher floors  Thanks for that my family was able to rest well given an early flight  They also offered to be a member of wyndam group Despite some reviews of the rooms were small  for us  room was just fair  Bed are so comfy though the room gets so cold which is good for a hot weather outside    I loved the rain shower We never tried the breakfast  The mall connected to the hotel is okay   no much choices on food  Toast box  subway  breadtalk and 4 other resto i think  Try to order the pizza in pizza mania  eat ramen at the japanese resto and thai express  The food was delicious  Good thing also there s gong cha One down side is the location  though hotel provide shuttle service  but cant hardly take chance to ride as it is mostly fully booked  So better book ahead if you want to utilize such Taxi waiting will take about 5 10mins  You can walk around to novena mrt but advise to take cab  It will cost around 5 7sgd Note also that most of the taxi we rode didnt know Ramada even saying zhongshan park  But if you tell them days hotel and balestier road they somehow know how to get to the area  The hotel is quite new that s why I requested as well a simple set up for our wedding anniv and niece bday and they suprise my niece with a carrot cake  Thanks Fast check out is great Overall we were relaxed staying at Ramada and refer to our friends But if you consider the location  i think for convinience hotel within orchard or near to mrt like oasia  with direct link  will be better since at end the cost is just the same   hotel taxi cost  Hope this review helps

Although it s not located in the heart of the city  the surrounding is very nice with the attached small mall giving us the possibilities to get our needs with various of small restaurants and kiosks  Also the free shuttle bus to Novena helps a lot  although the taxi fare is not expensive in Singapore  The staffs are very helpful and friendly Beautiful roof top swimming pool  clean and comfortable room  good breakfast buffet  etc etc All in all we were very pleased with the hotel and really enjoyed our stay  Nadya narendraputra

Rooms are very comfortable and while not large  they are decently sized by Singapore standards  The price is also very reasonable compared with other hotels in Singapore  The hotel is new  which means everything is in great condition and everything works  The pool and gym areas were also excellent  Service was efficient and helpful if not quite to the same level of enthusiasm we experienced in Vietnam The one let down with this hotel was the location   it s quite a trek from the airport and not within easy striking distance of major tourist attractions either  There is an MRT station about 1 3 km walk away which is fine for younger guests  however there is an uphill stretch and unfortunately my mother just couldn t cope with this walk in the tropical heat  There is a shuttle bus which we had no trouble booking from the hotel  but which we tried and failed to use twice to get home  The first time  14th of May   we turned up at 9 24 pm for the 9 30 pm shuttle bus and it either must have gone early  or just didn t show up  The next night  we turned up at the same time  and the bus was there at exactly 9 30 pm  however  my elderly mother was hustled out of the way by other hotel guests and there was no space left on the bus  This meant we had to trudge around looking for a taxi after long and exhausting days of sightseeing which really took the shine off the experience  There is also no way to pre book the shuttle BACK to the hotel On the upside  there is a nice little mall attached to the lobby which has everything you need and nothing you don t

Visited The Ramada  Singapore in May 2014  we stayed from the 1st to 8th of May  summarized below are the positives and negatives of our experience with this hotel   Positives of the hotel   1  Location though not very convenient is complemented by free shuttle bus services provided by the hotel to Novena station MRT and Orchard Road  2  Shopping mall attached to the hotel premises 3  Nice  clean   amp  well maintained pool 4  Overall hotel premises well maintained 5  Kind behavior of Front Office staff who try to help on quires raised 6  Early check in raequest very kindly accepted by the hotel  probably due to our correspondence with the GM prior to booking  7  Very kind and helping GM Negatives of the hotel   1  The service centre executives who reply to the correspondence done via email are either Novice or need extensive training as they just do not understand what you are trying to convey  It is a task to try and make them understand if you have many quires like we had  2  We had clearly indicated before booking the hotel that we prefer a room on a higher floor preferably above 10th floor  during check in we were informed that there is only 1 room available on the 10th floor and all other rooms on the higher floor are already occupied  Reluctantly we agreed to the 10th floor room  however when we opened the door of the room we were disappointed to see that the room had not been cleaned  On informing the reception we were told that it has already been cleaned as confirmed by the hotel Housekeeping  We then invited the receptionist to come and have a look at the room for their satisfaction  We were then immediately offered another room on the 16th floor   which was supposed to be occupied as confirmed during check in    3  Though we were two of us in the room  to our surprise on the second day housekeeping had provided only one towel and no shower gel in the bathroom and had to be requested for 4  On the subsequent day we found some brown color stains on the inner side of the Quilt on return to are room at night  When we requested for a change of cover  housekeeping was not working at night at the hotel hence had to wait till the next day morning for the same 5  The hotel was kind enough to give us some fruits on our first day of arrival as we had a long stay at the hotel  The kind staff who had provided us these fruits also asked us for preference of fruits and informed us that the same would be refilled after 2 3 days  The same was done however the preference of fruit we had given did not seem to affect this refill  however our preferential fruits were kept in our room the night before departure  Since we needed to the reach the airport by 5 30am for our flight back  we could only admire those fruits  6  On the first day we Have been visiting Singapore for several short trips lately and thought of giving it a try to this hotel this time Stayed for a night early this month  Booked online on Hotel club website  Reached the hotel front desk at around 10 am and filled up a Wyndham rewards membership form just before being allowed to check in      Well  No problems there as that would actually allow me to go to an affiliate hotel to get an early check in without hassles Check in process was quick  albeit the 50 SGD being taken as a refundable deposit which I never paid in any Singapore hotel earlier  Anyway  was allotted a room on 12th floor which had a pretty decent view of the city The rooms are just ok with the space part and the furnishings are very much matching with the international standards  Internet was complementary and fast as well  TV was large enough but had very limited channels may be about 20  so did not use it for more than 5 minutes  Overall cleanliness was excellent The staff and employees were friendly and helpful with a smile on their face  There is a free shuttle from the Hotel to Novena MRT and return every hour which makes it easy to connect to the rest of the city That is something like a USP of the hotel  Not many options for Indian food in and around which I made up for by travelling to Little India by Cab costing around 6 SGD There is a shopping mall attached to the hotel with good options to eat and shop along with a fair price shop with huge variety All in all  a very good hotel and recommended Will certainly consider this one on my next visit

Stayed in for fianc?  s birthday  Check in was efficient by Sabrina  went thru everything but was not offered newspaper  No big deal  Room was clean and view was great a bit thad small but it was all compensate by the hotel s facilities  pool  gym  business centre  restaurants and a mall link to the hotel  Everything you need is there  Staffs are extremely friendly and helpful  Always greeted by their friendly housekeeping staffs  Quick to response whenever needed  Tried both restaurants   breakfast at Flavours  amp  dinner at 21 At Rajah  Great food overall  Love the park too  with an old huge Banyan Tree right in the middle  Children playing amongst themselves   Feels like home  This hotel feels larger with the essence than it looks  Kudos

It s a four star property located in the Zongshan Park area which is not too crowded  but is away from the more exciting areas  There is a small town in that area but there are no eating places around  There is a small food court on the side of the hotel and also a fair price super market which has everything one would like to buy  Book the hotel on a B amp B basis  so that your breakfast is taken care of  One may feel it is a little pricey at S 15   per head  but the spread is good and worth it  Only one or two of the food outlets in the food court open before 10am  Hence  one s choices for breakfast are very limited  If you are a breakfast person and do not like eating toast or laksa every morning  you will be well advised to book your room on a B  amp  B basis  There is a shuttle service from the hotel to the Novena MRT station and Orchard Plaza every 30 mins  But you have to call about two hours before and reserve your seats with the hotel concierge to avoid disappointment  Once you get to the Novena area  there are many breakfast options  You can also use taxies  which are conveniently available on a regular basis at the the hotel  The concierge at the hotel is very helpful if you want to book your tours  The rooms have free wifi  for which you can obtain the password from the front desk  Then you can even book your tours online or buy the tickets once you get to any of the parks you will be visiting  The rooms are quite small and as we took a triple room  once the third bed was placed  we had to practically jump over the beds to get about in the room  The luggage had to be placed mindfully  as it is not easy to find space to place three suitcases  We used to close it up once we had taken out what we needed and then keep it upright against the wall  The beds were quite comfortable and the AC worked well  so we had wonderful sleep every night  The bathrooms were new and well appointed and not too small  Housekeeping was great as they used to come every morning and clean the bathrooms and give fresh towels and top up the toiletries  tea  coffee etc  We didn t have a great view from our room  but it really didn t matter  as we were in the room only to sleep or rest and as everyone does in Singapore  we were out most of the time either site seeing or shopping   lt grin gt  The lobby area of the hotel is not very large like most business hotels  but it was bigger than most other places and had sufficient seating space for us to wait for our taxi or shuttle  Please check your bills well in time without waiting for the last minute  so you have sufficient time to iron out any discrepancies  Please ensure you check your bills during office hours so that the manager is available to resolve any issue and you won t be at the mercy of the front office staff who are unable to make any decisions  I was offered a special rate as a corporate customer  but when I received my bill  I had been charged a higher rate which was the normal rate  The front office team did not understand this difference in rate and it took me quite sometime to drive my point through to them  Then  finally  they agreed to amend my bill to be in line with the special rate offered  If you try to settle your bill in the last minute while you are checking out to leave for the airport  you may not have sufficient time to resolve any issues with the front office team and end up paying the higher rate  as you will want to get to the airport in time for your flight Taxi Drivers were not exactly familiar with the hotel when we first mentioned the name  as it was relatively new at the time we visited  probably re opened after refurbishing and re branding only a few months prior to our visit  and we had to show the address from an email I carried along  They are familiar with Zongshan Park  so first mention that  if they don t seem to know the hotel Room Tip  certain rooms overlook Zonghsan Park and if you are hoping to spend a lot of time in your room  it m   See more room tips

Excellent hotel and staff  This is my second stay at this hotel  I stayed last November and had written a bit of a negative review because I had been charged a full days rate when I only arrived at 0700hrs in the morning  Well it is important that I mention that the hotel management reached out to me after the review and credited me for 1 2 a days rate  This was excellent customer service that should make anyone go back to this hotel  I truly appreciated the follow up  For that reason I chose to stay at this hotel for another 10 day trip recently  I also brought 3 colleagues with me who each had rooms there as well  We were all very happy with this well kept hotel  It is very clean and staff very courteous and friendly  The gym is excellent and the restaurant is pretty good  I look forward to going back to this hotel  GM

This was our first visit to beautiful Singapore  We knew that finding a nice place to stay would be difficult  and at the last minute we booked a room at the Ramada  We were greeted by the staff and promptly checked in Our room was spacious and very clean and had everything we wanted  The bed was comfortable  the shower was great and the WiFi worked without any problems  After reading the reviews on TripAdvisor we were a bit concerned about the location but this concern was laid to rest with the hotel s shuttle which runs every 30 minutes and takes you to the nearest SMRT station  From there it takes about 7 minutes to the city center The neighborhood itself has some Asian restaurants and there is a small shopping mall connected to the hotel which also has some restaurants and a supermarket The hotel was clean  spacious with a nice location and affordable We had a great stay and would come again

I stayed here last year in September  sorry i am a bit late to review this hotel but i would share my experience  I was surprised when i checked in to this hotel  spacious lobby  yummy breakfast  good rooms and sparkling clean bathrooms  I never expected this budget hotel to be so good  The breakfast spread was too good  try their mushroom chicken omelets  Now let s talk about the location  it is not city center like orchard road or bay area but it has all the facility to reach city center in about 10   15 minutes  cab charges SGD 30 per way  which is quite decent  Singapore is a small city with all the accessibility so no problem at all with this tiny but lovely hotel Ramada  I would definitely come back

This hotel  although a bit off the main shops and sights  is truly a very good hotel  The surroundings are peaceful and the hotel is clean and stylish with excellent personnel and service  The rooms are very comfortable and the bathrooms are fresh and modern  The breakfast was very tasty with a large variety of both western and asian food  The hotel also has a nice pool and gym for a quick exercise

For the price paid  I thought this was a decent value 4 star hotel Being a new hotel  it is not yet known to taxi drivers  so make sure you can remember the address on Ah Hood Rd Free shuttle to the MRT is helpful because it is not close to much Zhongshan Park itself is a contemporary garden setting and is quite lovely  particularly at night The rooms are not large  but reasonable  The furnishings are still new and in good condition The staff were excellent  Polite  keen  attentive and efficient Close to some excellent eateries  of all ranging prices   supermarket and laundry facilities  I am told the hotel restaurant is very good  but chi huo should go around corner to Whampoa Keng Oh  and Balestier Rd is famous for its lighting stores should that be your thing  My only real criticism is the TV had no sports channel  Really  The world cup was on

We  3 adults  stayed here as a Singapore Airlines stopover for 2 nights   well we booked for two nights knowing that we would arrive very early in the morning  The Ramada is a new modern hotel situated beside a small shopping mall but close to some major shopping centres  Its location is a bit out of the centre but with two shuttle buses and cheap plentiful taxis  this was not a problem Our check in seemed rather prolonged as the young man had difficulty finding our reservation and then required that our passports be copied  I have never had this happen before  amp  have stayed in many different hotels  When we arrived at our room  there was no third bed  Several phone calls resulted in the fold away bed arriving but once put down the room became very cramped  This was disappointing as we had specifically asked for a room that would be suitable for three adults  That aside  the room was beautifully furnished with every convenience that modern hotels provide  The beds were big  amp  very comfortable  Air conditioning was very good and easily adjusted  The complimentary water and wifi were much appreciated  The gardens  amp  pool area looked very inviting but unfortunately we did not have time to spend there The staff was friendly and helpful  especially the young man at the front door  He helped us on several occasions  Breakfast was really good with a vast array of different breakfast foods and in a roomy dining area  We did not have any other meals at the hotel even though they seemed to be reasonably priced  The mall next door provides a number of choices of eateries as well as a laundry and good supermarket I would recommend this hotel for a stopover for 2 adults per room but it was not suitable for the third bed  Maybe there are some larger rooms and that would solve the problem

We stayed at the Ramada for 1 night following our flight from the UK  The location of the hotel is not ideal but a short 5 10min taxi ride away is Marina bay  Gardens by the Bay  the Flyer and so on  We checked in early around 9am and to our surprise our room was ready for us  This was also the Grand Prix weekend so we expected it to be busy  The rooms are very modern and well furnished which is what you would expect from a brand new hotel  This is what prompted our booking in the first place  We found all the staff very friendly but some seemed to lack knowledge of the area  Maybe it was due to my accent but nonetheless they were always smiling and did their best to help throughout our stay  Of course you can find more plush hotels offering more pleasing amenities fronting Marina Bay  however  if you are looking for a clean nice all round hotel which is not going to break the bank  the Ramada is certainly a good option and hard to beat  Great value for Money  I would not hesitate to stay again if we visit Singapore

We were returning for short visit to our old home of Singapore  before heading on to Sydney  This was a reasonably priced hotel in an interesting non tourist part of the city  The hotel is part of the Wyndham group and its quality is well above the average Ramada  Much more like a true Wyndham Hotel  The staff were excellent and very willing to help with questions and advice  Be aware that it is a busy place as there are several training facilities nearby  It is well worth the money Room Tip  The quietest rooms are on the side facing the park See more room tips

We accepted the opportunity offered by singapore airlines for cheaper accom if we stopped over for a couple of nights instead of the usual couple of hours transit  The deals seemed to offer lower stars hotels  so we chose Ramada as Zhongshan Park A very good hotel  reception and concierge were excellent  Ordinarily check in is 2 00pm but we had arrived from Rome 7 00am D oh  We were able to get into our room at about 10 45 thanks to the receptionist juggling a few things There is a small mall next door with a supermarket  hairdressers  laundry  fast foods etc which was all very convenient  A shuttle service to Orchard Rd   dont bother   things arent what they were 20 years ago  the much closer Velocity Mall is just as good and much closer

We arrived late on Friday evening  All we wanted to do was to have a quick shower and then go to bed  My friend answered nature s call and proceeded to have his shower  As there wasn t any hair shampoo nor shower gel  I called the reception to ask for assistance  During the call  I highlighted that my friend had been naked in the bathroom for quite a while and I would appreciate if she could arrange for the toiletries to be delievered to our room as soon as possible  As I didn t hear from her after ten minutes  I called the reception again  The call was answered by the same girl who answered the first call  She informed that her colleague was already on his way to our room  Although twenty minutes had passed since we placed the first call  he was nowhere to be found  We waited in vain  We had to make the third call to the reception before a staff  apparently a bell boy  arrived about ten minutes later with tubes of shampoo  body lotion and a hand soap in his hands  Shower gel was nowhere in sight  When we asked for the shower gel  he informed that that s all he had and we could use the hand soap for shower  Amazing  We had to get the shower gel from the chambermaid s room ourselves  Unbelievable  We found out the next day that the person who answered our first and second call had been making mistakes at work and she was not aware that all the chambermaid had left for the day  What does it say about this hotel  The staff are not equipped with relevant knowledge to perform his her duties  I have not been to a hotel where the toiletries have been overlooked  This is my first and I hope it will be my last  Ramada should get back to getting the basic right  It was an unpleasant experience  A frustrating weekend  It was a let down  Do we expect to return to Ramada to give it a second chance  The answer is clear  It is a big NO

We had an unscheduled night at the Ramada as a result of a flight change requiring an extra night in Singapore  We  and many others  booked in together very late one night and the front desk staff handled the book ins very professionally and quickly  The room was a good size  especially for Singapore  and had a bench desk along the length of the window which was perfect for setting up computers etc  As the hotel is only about a year old  everything in the room is nice and new and clean and modern  The beds were extremely comfortable and obviously higher end beds  Bathroom was nice and shower had the choice of a rainshower head or a handheld shower hose  no bath  Very good size in room safe and not one of the little iddy biddy ones that can hardly fit a passport in  Free Wifi available throughout the hotel was fast and reliable  Excellent and helpful staff Breakfast was a pretty good buffet with plenty of western and Asian choices The huge pool is magnificent with plenty of room for everyone  Nice furniture at the side of the pool and sun lounges actually in the water at the side of the pool  Pool is sparkly clean  Hotel is connected to a two level shopping mall but I found the mall to be of little interest as it is mainly a big supermarketThe position of the hotel is about 20 minutes or so from the airport so a good option when looking for something close enough to the airport  The surrounding area is much quieter than say Orchard Road but we saw that as a bonus   sleep was undisturbed by outside street noise  There are a lot of eating options outside the hotel  many very fairly priced  No exciting shops to speak of but the hotel does have a shuttle bus that takes you to a local shopping mall  Velocity  and to Orchard Road  The shuttle bus has a printed schedule and it absolutely sticks with the schedule  Don t be a minute late or you will find the bus gone  If you are punctual  this bus works very well as you can be sure of departure and pick up times  I used the bus on several occasions and it worked perfectly  Because of the punctuality of the bus  and a nearby MRT stations  staying at this new  spacious hotel with lovely facilities  becomes an attractive alternative to staying in other closer in areas of Singapore  There is a sense of respite from the madness and heat and yet you can dip back into the madness and heat very easily indeed

Conveniences  having a grocery  which closes late    shops and food outlets were a big plus  shuttle to novena square and orchard plaza  for my purpose  daily meetings at novena square  was most usefulthe bars in the park were convenient for late night snack drinkpool and gym are good amenities to have   a historical site nearbyFlaws somehow noise from closing of doors of the adjacent rooms as well as the cabinets can be heard from within the guest room  some outside noise  music  also from the balcony can be heard

I have visited last week and found this hotel excellent  They have given the best service one can expect  I found problem with vegetarian food expect it all services were excellent  They have facility for free local traveling best security access to rooms  good location  They provided me early check in and late check out which I was really needing  I will surely be using this hotel on my next trrip

i like this hotel  not located in crowd areas  but enough to find delicious food with worth price   the only things that annoyed us just the shuttle bus schedule we have to wait about half hour if we miss the shuttle from novena square to hotel  because if we want to use public bus  we have to walk around 500m to get to the bus stop but the room was very nice   hall room  lobby   also nice  zhongshan park also nicestaff also very nice  fast check in and check outRoom Tip  higher floor will be better  so u can see better viewSee more room tips

This was our first stay at the Ramada  only overnight  but we weren t disappointed  The hotel is not in the middle of all the action  but we found it great for a short stopover  There is a shopping complex  including many good eateries  located next to the hotel  The reception staff were professional and welcoming  just what we needed after a long flight  The rooms are clean and comfortable and nothing was too much trouble for any of the staff  The small bar is comfortable  with a good selection of drinks and not too expensive by Singapore standards  I m sure we would have enjoyed a longer stay

Well Ramada is good hotel if you are on business trip  Being with family I found its quite Ok hotel Location  The hotel is adjacent to mall so you may roam in mall and shopping senses may be awaken      Most of the taxi driver don t know the location of this hotel so make sure twice taxi driver is taking you to right hotel    Hotel provides complimentary services to Novada MRT  amp  Orchid Road which is quite frequent The room size is average but very clean     We haven t availed breakfast services as we found it bit pricey and missing Indian breakfast  You may take breakfast in mall since most of eatery are there     Not to mention travel desk is very efficient  They have ensured all timely booking to all places alongwith airport drop    Also we checked in early and they were kind enough to provide us room  Great help since we were accompanied by small child

Hotel room is small and some rooms have only shower and no tub A rather new hotel nestled outside Orchard  therefore location is pretty convenient Hotel provides Shuttle services at 29mins intervals to Novena MRT train station  Trains will lead you to all of popular destinations  If weather is too hot  u may find reasonable price restaurant within the hotel next door There is a big local supermarket within the same building if you want to buy gifts back home too Walking distance in the main streets  you can find 2 big famous chicken rice stalls Loy Khee Chicken rice amd Boon Tong Kee Chinese rice  One Hainaness and the other is Cantonese There is many Bak Ku Teh Stalls and a prime old Hongkong Hebal Tea stall  good for Singapore Hot weather Don t miss Whampoo Hawkers  it houses good local food stalls at local prices  Many of the hawkers moved here from the Old Long House hawker at Thomson Rd  Nasi Padang  Bugis St Chicken Rice  Fried Bananas  etc

Checked in at the Ramada Simgapore hotel today  When I read the reviews about how small the room would be  I was pretty nervous about it  But once I was here  it s not small at all  Based on Singaporean standards  this room is pretty ok and large  There is a small shopping mall attached to the hotel  and a supermarket as well  Can t get any more convenient than this  Free shuttle buses are also a plus  Overall  happy to have made the right choice by booking at Ramada   Zhongshan Park  P S  the room has a fresh minty smell  too  Love it

Firstly your people give me a room that was filthy dirty and had not been cleaned  Bed wasn t made bathroom garbage can full with used toothbrush and shaver in the sink  Old Packages of food on the desk in the room  Then I get a new room  After I check out I pay the bill that clearly states 247 dollars Sing  When I arrive home I find my credit card has been charged over 300 dollars Canadian  All I did was sleep in the room and drank one complimentary bottle of water so looks like you may have some thieves working for you as well  Good thing is I will be back to Singapore in less then a month so I will be able to bring this up with the hotel manager

Ramada Hotel just celebrate their 1 year Anniversary in May  4 star hotel located at Zhongsan Park  Ramada and Days hotel are under the same management  Hotel is more spacious  clean and comfort  Staff are polite and helpful  Ramada hotel is link with shopping centre and you can enjoy your shopping and dining there  By 5  10 minutes walking distance  you are reaching the Balestier Food Court  offering you a local Singapore Cuisine and traditional Singapore breakfast  Kopi O   half boiled eggs   roti kaya butter  Novena MRT station is 15 min walking distance from the hotel but there is a free shuttle bus provided for every 30 minutes  Hotel do also provide Shuttle Bus to Orchard at certain hours  you can get the shuttle bus schedule from the reception counter  There are 2 shopping centre at Novena MRT station  Novena Square and Velocity Room Tip  Choose a Garden view non smoking room See more room tips

Rooms are of a good size and so was the wash area  The bed more comfortable than I expected it to be which is a great bonus for its price  Place was clean and I really can t fault anything in the room except for a bland TV Channel list and perhaps some room to room sound proofing  Because of the comfort and value for money  I would give this 4 out of 5 stars for room scores Due to its location in the Balestier district  this place is not the ideal choice for first timers to Singapore  If you frequent Singapore then this would be a challenge easily navigated  The Front Desk is small but the staff are hardworking  The lounge on the first floor I won t recommend as Starker which is just round the corner provides GREAT beer at reasonable prices  Not to mention that Balestier is actually quite a food paradise if you are accustomed to local cuisine I like this place  Will definitely be back

I need to start this review by advising that I recently spent a week in Singapore 7 weeks ago and stayed at the Mandarin Oriental  Everything was perfect  everything worked  it was conveniently located  staff were helpful  amp  lovely  and the room was significantly more expensive  Unfortunately  despite reviewing the website of the Ramada Zhongshan Park before travelling and actually thinking that it would probably be ok  what a nightmare  I was told that the hotel was only 1 year old  but it seems a lot happens in a year  The hotel was selected for me by my Asia office  I arrived by taxi and my bags were taken and placed in the lobby which was great  The check in process  Where do I begin  What a disaster  People everywhere  two staff on check in and a complete shambles  No order  nothing that made me feel welcome  Just noise  people and a lot of waiting  This is how a guest perceives your hotel from the first instance  Get it right  I finally was able to check in and was disappointed to learn that I was on the 3rd floor  I think there are 17 floors in the hotel  Especially since I was checked in 4 nights  I arrived in my room and it was nice enough although the dreaded bathroom with the door you need to close to get into the shower again  Why  Why  Why  There is a sheet of frosted glass that backs on to the bed from the shower and they have a roller blind  In the shower  Why  No bath  Very disappointed  Whenever I travel  I always bath at night time and shower in the morning  No rooms available with a bath I tried to place my passports in the safe only to find out that the safe was already locked and couldn t be opened  I decided to go and have some dinner and thought that staff could come and open the safe while I was gone  No  I have to be in the room when the duty manager comes up to reset it  I wonder what will happen when housekeeping wants to clean the room tomorrow  Will I need to come back from the office  I had hot water on the first night except for the few instances where it suddently went cold  when I assume someone else was using the water  Then on the first morning  No hot water  Only luke warm water  By this stage  I was already ready for my shower so I had my shower and then called the service centre  I had three occasions of no hot water during my stay  Unacceptable  The service centre  I should address this before we get back to the shower  There is a button on the phone that one would assume connects you with the service centre  It is on the phone pad  it says service centre  No  My mistake  When you press this button  you get an engaged signal  No service centre  So  whenever I have come across a difficulty  I have had to get an outside line by pressing 9 and call the hotel directly  The duty manager came up last night and said  no you need to dial 0 to get the service centre  You don t press the service centre button  Silly me  Of course  where in the room does it tell you to dial 0 for the service centre  NOWHERE When I returned to my room on the second day  a message button was flashing on the phone  I picked up the handset and it immediately dialed for the voicemail but kept dialling to an engaged tone  So  this meant that I was unable to use the phone from this point because it would only dial the engaged number  over and over again  Hope the message wasn t urgent       Engineer comes up this morning and runs my basin tap and the shower for about 10 minutes  I carry on getting ready for work while he stands in my bathroom  Finally  victory  We have hot water although it is set at a set temperature so it won t be too hot   Funny  it was hot last night  but we ll move on  So  I ask the engineer  does this mean that I need to run my shower for 30 minutes before I want to get hot water  Exaggerating to make a point  No  just 10 minutes should be fine he says  He says the hotel has many pipes to run water through and it takes time to get hot water  What  And  you want me to run water for 10 minutes for no reason  What a waste  Then  you want me to hang my towels up and keep the same bed sheets to save water and the environment  Seriously Lighting in the room is good and workdesk would be good if I could get my legs under it without having to scrape the tops of my legs  Only one power supply though within reach of the desk which also has the kettle There is an alarm clock in the room that was not set when I checked in and with no instructions  impossible to set  Ridiculous  Loud music playing outside the room on my first night but manager was able to stop that when asked  Breakfast was included and just as well because if I had to pay for it  I would have been pretty annoyed  Cold milk was warm  I think they tried to kill me with the coffee  and most dishes on the hot buffet looked like leftovers from the night before  Food was average  So  overall very disappointing  On my last visit to Singapore at the Mandarin Oriental I was kicking myself every day that I hadn t brought my husband and daughter with me  They would have loved every minute there  Extremely pleased that they didn t come with me on this trip  It would have been awful  Very disappointed  Won t be back  If you re after a very budget hotel that is more expensive than a budget hotel  this is your place  It is attached to a small shopping mall which has a pharmacy  small convenience store  laundry and restaurants and this is really good  Thai Express which seems to be a chain thai restaurant in Singapore was pretty good   The mango sticky rice was awesome   Although I wouldn t put up with this hotel for a serve of mango sticky rice   Room Tip  Select another hotel is my best advice See more room tips

I stayed in this property for 5 nights and it was an excellent stay  The staff is very cordial and cooperative  Every time we asked for something from the room service or housekeeping  they were very prompt and forthcoming  The best part is that there is a mall connected with the hotel and you get all the basic stuff in the super mart there  The location is apt and is well connected to all the hubs in Singapore like orchard street  little India  buggy s  universal  sentosa etc  The spread at the breakfast is nice but is repetitive  All 5 days the spread was the same The rooms are very well appointed and overall it was a comfortable stay Room Tip  Rooms facing the park have a better view See more room tips

I stayed at this hotel whilst travelling on business  The first thing to comment on was the outstanding level of service provided to by all the staff  The hotel was immaculately clean throughout  The rooms were large and we ll air conditioned  Location is perfect with a large shopping mall attached to the hotel  There is also a lovely pool and gym to enjoy A great stay with excellent standards

I had booked this hotel almost a month in advance and I was following all the reviews given by various people regarding its location that it is far from the city   be it hospitality   food   staff etc  And frankly it made me think again whether I have made a right decision to spend my holidays in this property till day I reached the hotel  If I talk about location the area is amazing the surroundings of the hotel are just perfect   Mall attached to it is a plus plus thing  Food  staff   shuttle service everything great  Yes for vegetarians options are limited but good   People like Mr dave at the front desk and Mr ben at bell desk are really helpful  Room size are fine but if you are taking an extra bed it might become congested   Overall whether its your holidays or some business work this is the place to be     Kudos to ramada singapore

Very nice new hotel in a convenience location  Approximately 15 min west of Orchard Road  The hotel also connect to small shopping center with restaurants and supermarket  Bed are very comfortable with good quality bed linen  Free shuttle service to Orchard road or nearby MRT station  Enjoy yr nice afternoon at the Sky Lounge on the 16th floor  Bus stop in front of the hotel

we stayed here for 6 nights  excellent service  a little away from the tourist spots  We didnt get a breakfast inclusive package and I was travelling with my 6 year old daughter and we had to opt for the hotel buffet breakfast  The breakfast was quiet good  There have been various reviews about there not being much Indian food  Almost everyday  there s been idli and sambhar on the buffet and an odd curry which i didnt know which to pair with  The rest of the buffet especially the local food were simply superb  they have an excellent team  The swimming pool is just lovely  The tiny mall next door comes in very handy  you can buy a beer or an ice cream  PLEASE do try the kopi kaya toast in the restaurant in the mall  yummmm  if you are on a budget and get a breakfast inclusive package  go for Ramada

Despite its somewhat obscure location where one would not find the usual tourist spots  save for the Sun Yat Sen Museum across the street  this hotel offers a few pleasant surprises and makes for a comfortable weekend stay For the price one pays  it is good value for money  The rooms are large enough to accommodate a couple with 1 child  Any more kids and the room would be too small  The pool and very well equipped gymnasium located on the third floor are hidden gems  both being quite underutilized  For smokers  this floor is also where you will find the designated smokers  area  The food and beverage outlets  the main restaurant and the tiny lounge  are nothing to shout about  Besides  you will be spoilt for choice as the hotel is situated next to a mall  where local delights await  There is even an entire floor dedicated to a supermarket  The staff are pleasant enough and obviously get the job done  But service flair is lacking  and this is the winning factor for a lot of hotels nowadays  It is what sets one hotel apart from another

Stayed there for 5 night on a family trip We booked 3 rooms  while we got 2 rooms immediately but we have to wait for third room which we got at 5 p m  as it was not cleaned  The rooms were of ok size but very clean  amp  designed tastfully  The toilet was clean  amp  functional  The pool was good  amp  not crowded though we used it twice that too in evening Hotel is 8 10   away from most of the tourist attraction  amp  market place  Not many of driwers know about this hotel Please tell them its on balister road  amp  Carry hotel card with you Only problem with hotel is its breakfast  Same dull  amp  boring menu with little change  The hotel is flushed with indians yet only one or two indian dishes  amp  that too without any good combination  Sambar idli all days was tasteless  The management should look into this  amp  have more veg  dishes

The hotel was central in location easy to locate  very comfortable room  The only Robles I faced was the time it took to check in and out     It could have been quicker I would recommend this hotel to anyone and everyone and I personally would go back to the same place to stay again  It was good value for money and the complimentary breakfast was great

Happy with the overall service provided by the staff  The Tv remote ran out of battery and maintenance staff came within 10mins to have it fixed  The corner room has nice view of the surroundings and thanks to the hotel staff  we got nice amenities for our anniversary  The bathroom has quality furnishings  The bed is super comfortable  I almost didn t want to get up at all  Zhongshan mall is connected to the hotel with a supermarket and pharmacy for guests needs  Along Balestier road  there are many eateries with nice local food and durian stalls  Overall  it was an excellent stay and I would recommend staying there

I ve checked in on 24 July with a service manager named Weber who wasn t helpful nor friendly  Despite so  the room was ok and clean except that it was a connecting room  Everything seemed ok until all commotion started at about 1am  Just as I was resting  the occupants staying at the room beside mine  I e  the connecting room  began to become rowdy  I could hear everything and they even tried to open the connecting door to my room  I tried calling the service helpdesk for help but to my disgust  the phone was not working at all  I had no choice but to bear with all these noises and fear that they will barge into my room all the way till 4am in the morning  I was wondering why did the management arrange me to stay in a connecting room with a spoilt phone  An absolutely unpleasant stay cuz it s not even a place for you to rest given the rowdy occupants and I ve given instructions to my company that I will never stay in Ramada Hotel Singapore ever again  Unfortunately  I still have to rate it as  quot 1 star quot  despite it not deserving any

We checked in the hotel on 16th July  the hotel looks very nice and maintained  During Checkin I was informed that there is no king size bed available  even though my booking was for 2 Adults and 1 infant  I was told that for king size bed booking needs to be done 6 months in advance  This was something hilarious Rest the overall stay was really nice  Breakfast did not lure me at all  Also mentioned in other reviews too even though lot of indians staying in the hotel  they do not offer much in breakfast for indians  Breakfast is something which can really be worked out In terms of service it was great  Everytime we reached the hotel a bell boy came to our taxi to pick up our stuff  This was really nice There is also a nice small shopping mall next to the hotel where they have Subway and also a nice small Italian restaurant where we had our meals twice I would recommend this place to all  just beware about the food option

We stayed in this hotel in transit so was only for 1 night  Beautiful rooms and lobby area and hotel is attached to a mall  but not much to see or eat in the mall  Rooms are very modern  but does not really cater for families  We booked for 2 adults and 2 kids through hotelclub  but when we arrived at 4am the room not not accommodate us even though we stated the nbr of guests  they were helpful in getting us a room to fit  Pool was beautiful and big and shallow enough for the kids to enjoy

We stayed at this hotel for a stopover on both legs of our recent Australia Europe trip  primarily to sleep and secondly to revisit Singapore after an absence of more than 30 years  We chose the hotel for it s location  hoping that it would be quieter than the frenetic downtown area and we were not disappointed  The location  apart from being quiet  also gave us a glimpse of the old Singapore and the chance to enjoy some green space in the adjacent park which was cool and shady We did not eat in the hotel however had fantastic food at a local eatery   cheap and very cheerful despite no English being spoken  It was so good we looked no further and ate there every night  The room was well laid out and while not huge  was not pokey and made very clever use of storage space  We had excellent service at this hotel with staff literally running to help us with luggage  taxis etc  and will definitely stay here again should we return to Singapore Room Tip  High floor and end of the corridorSee more room tips

Stayed in 4 Ramada hotels before  namely  1  Ramada in US 2  Ramada Resort Bintang Bali 3  Ramada Naples 4  Ramada Zhongshan   We love Ramada Zhongshan best while we think Ramada Naples needs a total upgrade of its amenities in its rooms to befit its image as a Ramada hotel  The breakfast at Ramada Naples was good though  The Ramada Resort Bintang Bali we stayed in late 2012 was not new  however  it was well kept and we enjoyed its breakfast  and the artificial rain at breakfast area was interesting  The pool and its close proximity to the beach were great too  Well  back to the subject on Ramada Zhongshan  we saw its construction and from Jan 2013 when the hotel started its operation  we have been wanting to stay and finally had a chance to recently  Yes  it was a good experience  The hotel is flanked by Sun Yat Sun home in the past  a Myanmar temple  Zhongshan Park  many residential developments  schools  a recreational club for the Police and small eateries  Additionally  the hotel is located in the Balestier Road vicinity which is culturally rich that is worth exploring  Look for a plaque erected on a pedestal near the entrance at Zhongshan Park to learn more about it  Front desk staff  Stacie was friendly  cheerful and efficient  Room size was not bad  250sf at least  Bathroom size was ok  For guests who like a less open bathroom concept  this hotel is an answer for them  There is a frosted glass divider between the bathroom and the room  even without the blinds  it is almost opaque  And yes  the bathroom has a proper timber door  For a 4 star hotel  Ramada Zhongshan has gone all out to impress  Grohe taps  Grohe shower head  Grohe rainforest shower  Samsung Smart TV  iron  ironing board and cordless phone  This is the FIRST hotel we stayed that uses cordless phones  Toiletries  shaver  shaver cream and toothbrush sets are the usual stuff that almost all hotels in Asia provide are also available Ramada Zhongshan  of course  Wifi and local calls are free  The view  be it park or city view  is just as nice  We really could not find anything unpleasant about the hotel except we felt the peripheral of the shower area could have been cleaner  perhaps re grouting or bleaching may help to remove the near brown stain  ibis Balestier Irrawaddy and Days hotel nearby have smaller rooms  We saw ibis  rooms before and they are about 200sf only  hence  Ramada Zhongshan s rooms are more comfortable  Moreover  Ramada Zhongshan enjoys a direct link to Zhongshan Mall  thus apart from the F amp B at the hotel  you can dine at other restaurants eateries in the mall like  quot Crystal Jade Steamboat restaurant quot    quot Thai Express quot   a Japanese restaurant   quot Subway quot    quot Toast Box quot  etc   quot Crystal Jade Steamboat restaurant quot  serves one of the best steamboat meals that we have tried in Singapore  The soup base is good  the raw food is clean and the sauce is really nice  You can have dim sum and other Chinese dishes there too  The mall has a fairly big supermarket on the 2nd storey that only closes at 11pm which offers loads of convenience to travellers  There is a bakery  Bread Talk    laundromat  hair salon  money changer  newspaper magazine shop  foot reflexology massage shop on the 1st storey of the mall  All these are just 1 min away from the hotel  Chill out with a drink by the park  Alfresco dining  Just walk across Zhongshan park from the hotel to  quot Starker quot  which closes at 1am nightly  Its beer is fabulous and its western food is delicious  Please note that it opens only at 4pm daily except Sundays   quot Starker quot  starts early on Sundays and it serves Brunch right from morning  For tourists who want to taste a kind of red bean or green bean paste local biscuits  don t miss them  a few shops selling them and they are like 3 min walk from the hotel  For example  No  603 or 639 Balestier Road   These shops are well known for the biscuits and Singaporeans living in other parts of Singapore travel to Balestier Road just to buy them  The hotel has free shuttle bus services to Novena MRT station and DFS Scotts  near Orchard Road   If you missed them  you can easily catch a bus  bus no 21  from bus stop just opposite Zhongshan Mall to Novena MRT station where it is just 2 stops away from Orchard Road station  If you do not mind a 15 min stroll  you may even want to walk to Novena MRT via a short cut through Irrawaddy Road  just look for ibis and that s the road   Note that it is a little hilly  Once you reach the end of Irrawaddy Road  head straight towards Square 2  name of a mall  or Velocity  name of another mall  for direct link to MRT station in air con comfort  There is one more entrance to the MRT station right before  quot Old Town White Coffee quot if you can locate the eatery  Facility wise  the pool is fairly big  not too deep too  Though we thought locating an infinity pool on the top floor like Capri by Fraser  KL might have been even nicer  There is a gym but we did not use it  All in all  Ramada Zhongshan has so much to offer  We enjoyed our staycation thoroughly and we will be back
